mandarin_meaning: 倒流; 回流; 淹没
english_meaning: to flow backwards; to backflow; backflow; to flood (backwards)
explanation_mandarin: 水或其他液体逆方向流动，通常指从高处向低处或从排水口向源头流动。
explanation_english: To flow in the reverse direction, usually referring to water or other liquid flowing from a higher place to a lower place or from a drain to the source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨嘅時候，啲水成日倒灌入我屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 jyu5 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 seoi2 sing4 jat6 dou2 gun3 jap6 ngo5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨的时候，水经常倒灌到我家。
examples.english_sentence: When it rains heavily, water often backflows into my house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為渠口塞咗，所以啲污水倒灌返上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 keoi4 hau2 sak1 zo2, so2 ji5 di1 wu1 seoi2 dou2 gun3 faan1 seung5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为下水道口堵塞了，所以污水倒流回去了。
examples.english_sentence: Because the drain is blocked, the sewage flowed back up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋驚海水倒灌，所以起咗個防洪堤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 geng1 hoi2 seoi2 dou2 gun3, so2 ji5 hei2 zo2 go3 fong4 hung4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们害怕海水倒灌，所以建了一个防洪堤。
examples.english_sentence: They were afraid of seawater flooding back, so they built a flood barrier.

english_meaning: to spoil the fun, to ruin something, to fail, to flop
explanation_mandarin: 指本来进行顺利的事情突然出现意外而失败，或者令人扫兴的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where something that was going smoothly suddenly fails due to an unexpected event, or a situation that spoils the fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原本諗住同佢慶祝生日，點知佢病咗，真係倒灶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 bun2 nam2 zyu6 tung4 keoi5 hing3 zuk1 sang1 jat6, dim2 zi1 keoi5 beng6 zo2, zan1 hai6 dou2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来想和他庆祝生日，结果他病了，真是扫兴。
examples.english_sentence: I originally planned to celebrate his birthday, but he got sick, which really spoiled the fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個project明明就嚟成功，點知最後畀佢搞倒灶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 project ming4 ming4 zau6 lai4 sing4 gung1, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的项目明明就要成功了，结果最后被他搞砸了。
examples.english_sentence: Our project was clearly about to succeed, but in the end he ruined it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚間餐廳啲嘢食好難食，真係倒灶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 naan4 sik6, zan1 hai6 dou2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚这家餐厅的食物很难吃，真扫兴。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is terrible tonight, it's really disappointing.

english_meaning: tooth-aching, extremely sour (to the point of making your teeth feel sensitive)
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物非常酸，以至于令人感到牙齿发软、酸痛。
explanation_english: Describes food that is extremely sour, causing a sensation of teeth being soft and aching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲山楂餅酸到倒牙，我食唔落呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 saan1 zaa1 beng2 syun1 dou3 dou2 ngaa4, ngo5 sik6 m4 lok6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些山楂饼酸得倒牙，我吃不下去啊。
examples.english_sentence: These hawthorn cakes are so sour they make my teeth ache; I can't eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲檸檬茶好酸，飲咗之後倒牙咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ning4 mung1 caa4 hou2 syun1, yam2 zo2 zi1 hau6 dou2 ngaa4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些柠檬茶很酸，喝了之后感觉牙齿都倒了。
examples.english_sentence: That lemon tea is very sour, it makes my teeth ache after drinking it.

english_meaning: To lose heart; to be discouraged; to be a letdown; to betray someone's trust; to back out of something
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事令人失望，丧失信心，或者出卖别人，令人感到泄气。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is disappointing, causing a loss of confidence, or betraying someone, leading to discouragement. It also implies not fulfilling a promise or expectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗幫手，點知到咗最後關頭又倒瓤，真係令人失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 sing3 zo2 bong1 sau2, dim2 zi1 dou3 zo2 zeoi3 hau6 gwaan1 tau4 jau6 dou2 joeng4, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应了帮忙，没想到到了最后关头却临阵退缩，真是让人失望。
examples.english_sentence: You promised to help, but you backed out at the last minute, which is really disappointing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好相信佢嘅，點知佢竟然倒瓤，將我哋嘅秘密講晒出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 ge3, dim2 zi1 keoi5 ging2 jin4 dou2 joeng4, zoeng1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 bei3 mat6 gong2晒seoi3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很相信他，没想到他竟然背叛了我，把我们的秘密都说出去了。
examples.english_sentence: I trusted him a lot, but he betrayed me and revealed all our secrets.

english_meaning: to roll one's eyes; to give someone the side-eye
explanation_mandarin: 表示不满或不屑，向上或向旁边翻动眼珠。
explanation_english: To roll one's eyes or give a sideways glance as a sign of disapproval, boredom, or contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一講嘢佢就倒眼，真係唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 gong2 je5 keoi5 zau6 dou2 ngaan5, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一说话他就翻白眼，真不知道他想干嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Every time I speak, he rolls his eyes. I really don't know what his problem is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日倒眼啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dou2 ngaan5 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是翻白眼了，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't roll your eyes all the time, it's very impolite.

english_meaning: to stand upside down; to do a handstand
explanation_mandarin: 身体颠倒，头下脚上地站立。
explanation_english: To stand upside down with your hands on the ground and your legs straight up in the air; to perform a handstand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識得倒立，好犀利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 dak1 dou3 lap6, hou2 sai1 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会倒立，很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to do a handstand, he's very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我成日喺屋企倒立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 dou3 lap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常在家里倒立。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often did handstands at home.

mandarin_meaning: 浪费粮食；搞砸事情；帮倒忙
english_meaning: Waste rice; to mess things up; to be counterproductive; to sabotage
explanation_mandarin: 原本指浪费粮食，后来引申为搞砸事情，做了反而更糟糕，帮倒忙的意思。
explanation_english: Originally meant to waste rice, but it has been extended to mean messing things up, making things worse than they were, and being counterproductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再幫手啦，你越幫越倒米咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 bong1 sau2 laa1, nei5 yut6 bong1 yut6 dou2 mai5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再帮忙了，你越帮越帮倒忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't help anymore, you're just making things worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴嘅餐廳，啲嘢食又唔好食，真係倒米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 caan1 teng1, di1 je5 sik6 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6, zan1 hai6 dou2 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的餐厅，东西又不好吃，真是浪费钱。
examples.english_sentence: Such an expensive restaurant, and the food is not good, what a waste of money (lit. waste rice).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都倒米，所以老闆唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 dou2 mai5, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是帮倒忙，所以老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes things up at work, so the boss doesn't like him.

english_meaning: Old codger who brings ruin/wasteful old man
explanation_mandarin: 指上了年纪，不但不能为家庭或事业带来帮助，反而因为能力不足或决策失误而造成损失的老人。
explanation_english: Refers to an elderly person who, instead of contributing to the family or career, causes losses due to incompetence or poor decision-making. It implies someone who is old and a burden, wasting resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁老都唔肯退休，仲成日搞搞震，真係倒米壽星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lou5 dou1 m4 hang2 teoi3 jau1, zung6 sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, zan1 hai6 dou2 mai5 sau6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么老了还不肯退休，还总是搞事情，真是个败家老头。
examples.english_sentence: He's so old and still refuses to retire, and he's always stirring things up. He's really a wasteful old man.

english_meaning: Turn upside down; turn inside out; turn things upside down; a complete mess; chaotic
explanation_mandarin: 既可以指物理上的翻转，也可以指情况或状态的彻底改变，变得混乱或颠倒。
explanation_english: Can refer to a physical turning upside down, or a complete change in a situation or state, becoming chaotic or inverted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間房倒翻轉咁，都冇位行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 dou2 faan1 zyun3 gam3, dou1 mou5 wai2 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间乱得翻天覆地，都没地方走路。
examples.english_sentence: His room is such a mess, there's no space to walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場波輸咗，成個計劃都倒翻轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bo1 syu1 zo2, seng4 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 dou2 faan1 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球赛输了，整个计划都完全被打乱了。
examples.english_sentence: The game was lost, and the whole plan was turned upside down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽唔喺屋企，佢哋咪將間屋搞到倒翻轉囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 m4 hai2 uk1 kei2, keoi5 dei6 mai1 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 gaau2 dou3 dou2 faan1 zyun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈不在家，他们就把房子弄得乱七八糟。
examples.english_sentence: Mom isn't home, so they made the house a complete mess.

english_meaning: To know (something) backwards; to know (something) by heart; to know (something) perfectly
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某种事物非常熟悉，即使倒过来也能像流水一样背诵出来。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely familiar with something, to the point where they can recite it backwards fluently, as easily as flowing water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢本書嘅內容倒背如流，你問咩佢都識答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 noi6 jung4 dou2 bui3 jyu4 lau4, nei5 man6 me1 keoi5 dou1 sik1 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这本书的内容倒背如流，你问什么他都会回答。
examples.english_sentence: He knows the content of this book backwards; he can answer anything you ask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份稿寫得好好，背到倒背如流咁濟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gou2 se2 dak1 hou2 hou2, bui3 dou3 dou2 bui3 jyu4 lau4 gam2 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份稿子写得很好，背诵得倒背如流似的。
examples.english_sentence: His draft is written very well, he recites it as if he knows it backwards.

english_meaning: to lie prostrate; to collapse and lie down
explanation_mandarin: 指人或物体倒下并躺着。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or object falling and lying down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒，倒臥喺條街度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zau2, dou2 ngo6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒，倒卧在街上。
examples.english_sentence: He got drunk and collapsed and lay in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，好多建築物都倒臥咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 gin3 zuk1 mat6 dou1 dou2 ngo6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，很多建筑物都倒塌了。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, many buildings collapsed and lay down.

english_meaning: to throw into the sea; to waste
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是扔到海里，引申意义是指浪费，把本来有用或宝贵的东西白白丢弃。
explanation_english: Literally means to throw into the sea. Figuratively, it means to waste something, to throw away something useful or valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣嘥錢啦，好似倒落海咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 saai1 cin2 laa1, hou2 ci5 dou2 lok6 hoi2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样浪费钱了，好像扔到海里一样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste money like that, it's like throwing it into the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁好嘅機會你唔把握，咪即係倒落海囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 hou2 ge3 gei1 wui2 nei5 m4 baa2 ak1, mai1 zik1 hai6 dou2 lok6 hoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么好的机会你不把握，不就是浪费了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't seize such a good opportunity, you're just wasting it.

english_meaning: to act in opposition to moral principles; to go against the tide of history; to act perversely; to move backwards
explanation_mandarin: 指做事违反常理，不顺应时代潮流，甚至倒退。
explanation_english: Refers to acting against reason and common sense, going against the trend of the times, and even regressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府如果一味倒行逆施，最終一定會失去民心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jyu4 gwo2 jat1 wai6 dou2 hang4 jik6 si1, zeoi3 chung1 jat1 ding6 wui5 sat1 heoi3 man4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府一味倒行逆施，最终一定会失去民心。
examples.english_sentence: If the government insists on acting perversely, it will eventually lose the support of the people.

mandarin_meaning: 退步; 倒退; 开倒车
english_meaning: to regress; to backslide; to go backwards; to become less advanced
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展不如以前，变得更差。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where things are getting worse, becoming less advanced than before; to regress or backslide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅經濟好似倒褪咗幾年咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 hou2 ci5 dou2 teoi3 zo2 gei2 nin4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的经济好像倒退了几年一样。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economy seems to have regressed a few years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做簡直係倒褪啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 dou2 teoi3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做简直是倒退啊！
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is simply a regression!

english_meaning: handstand; headstand
explanation_mandarin: 指身体倒转，用双手或头部支撑身体站立的姿势。
explanation_english: Refers to the posture of standing upside down, supporting the body with hands or head. It can refer to the act of doing a handstand/headstand, or the posture itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度做緊倒豎葱呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 dou3 syu6 cung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在那里做倒立呢。
examples.english_sentence: He is doing a handstand over there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日都玩倒豎葱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waan2 dou3 syu6 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常玩倒立。
examples.english_sentence: I often played handstand when I was a kid.

english_meaning: handstand; to stand upside down; to turn somersaults; to fall head over heels
explanation_mandarin: （动）指身体颠倒，头朝下，脚朝上的姿势，类似于倒立。（名）也指这种倒立的姿势。
explanation_english: (Verb) Refers to a posture where the body is inverted, head down and feet up, similar to a handstand. (Noun) Also refers to this inverted posture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日都玩倒豎蔥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 dou1 waan2 dou2 syu6 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常玩倒立。
examples.english_sentence: He used to always do handstands when he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時唔小心，差啲仆親倒豎蔥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 m4 siu2 sam1, caa1 di1 puk1 can1 dou2 syu6 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时不小心，差点摔倒栽了个跟头。
examples.english_sentence: He was careless for a moment and almost fell head over heels.

english_meaning: to fall head over heels; to do a headstand; to turn upside down
explanation_mandarin: 形容头朝下栽倒，或指做倒立动作。也形容事情完全颠倒。
explanation_english: Describes falling headfirst, doing a headstand, or things being completely turned upside down (in a figurative sense).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心喺樓梯度跌咗落嚟，成個人倒豎蔥咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 hai2 lau4 tai1 dou6 dit3 zo2 lok6 lai4, seng4 go3 jan4 dou2 syu6 cung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心在楼梯上摔了下来，整个人倒栽葱一样。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell down the stairs, head over heels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲報告寫到亂晒籠，成件事都倒豎蔥噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 lyun6 saai3 lung1, seng4 gin6 si6 dou1 dou2 syu6 cung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报告写得乱七八糟，整件事都颠倒了。
examples.english_sentence: The report is a complete mess; the whole thing is upside down.

english_meaning: To pay extra, to subsidize, to lose money on something; (slang) to shower someone with gifts or affection without reciprocation
explanation_mandarin: 本意是指额外贴钱，赔本。在恋爱语境下，指一方付出很多感情和金钱，但没有得到相应的回报。
explanation_english: Literally means to pay extra or lose money on something. In a romantic context, it refers to a situation where one person invests a lot of emotion and money but does not receive corresponding returns or affection. It can also generally describe subsidizing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫佢男朋友還錢，根本就係倒貼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 waan4 cin2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 dou2 tip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是帮她男朋友还钱，根本就是在倒贴。
examples.english_sentence: She is always helping her boyfriend pay back money; she's basically subsidizing him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔好諗住一定賺錢，有時可能會倒貼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 jat1 ding6 zaan6 cin2, jau5 si4 ho2 nang4 wui2 dou2 tip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不要想着一定赚钱，有时可能会赔钱。
examples.english_sentence: When doing business, don't always expect to make money; sometimes you might lose money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對佢咁好，但係佢唔領情，唔好再倒貼啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 keoi5 gam3 hou2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 ling5 cing4, m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 tip3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对她那么好，但是她不领情，不要再倒贴了！
examples.english_sentence: You're so good to her, but she doesn't appreciate it. Don't keep giving without getting anything back!

english_meaning: Reverse the car; Back up (the car); (Figuratively) To regress; to backslide
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指驾驶车辆向后行驶。引申义可以指事情退步、倒退。
explanation_english: Literally means to drive a vehicle backward. Figuratively, it can refer to things regressing or backsliding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識得倒車，好驚撞到後面啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 dak1 dou3 ce1, hou2 geng1 zong6 dou2 hau6 min6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会倒车，很怕撞到后面的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to reverse, I'm scared of hitting things behind me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策完全係倒車，令情況變得更差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jing1 caak3 waan4 cyun4 hai6 dou3 ce1, ling6 cing4 fong3 bin3 dak1 gang3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策完全是倒退，让情况变得更糟。
examples.english_sentence: This policy is a complete regression, making the situation worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好倒車啦，繼續向前行啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dou3 ce1 laa1, gai3 zuk6 hoeng3 cin4 haang4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要倒退了，继续向前走吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't backslide, keep moving forward!

english_meaning: to turn upside down; to invert; to reverse
explanation_mandarin: 指将事物上下或内外颠倒。
explanation_english: To turn something upside down or inside out; to reverse the order of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倒轉隻杯，啲水會倒晒出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dou2 zyun3 zek3 bui1, di1 seoi2 wui5 dou2 saai3 ceot1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把杯子倒过来，水会全部倒出来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't turn the cup upside down, the water will all spill out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將成件事倒轉嚟講，顛倒是非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 sing4 gin6 si6 dou2 zyun3 lai4 gong2, din1 dou2 si6 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把整件事颠倒来说，颠倒是非。
examples.english_sentence: He twisted the whole story, turning right and wrong on their head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該掉返轉諗下，睇下有冇其他嘅可能性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 diu6 faan1 zyun3 lam2 haa5, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该反过来想一下，看看有没有其他的可能性。
examples.english_sentence: We should think about it the other way around and see if there are any other possibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 回头, 反过来, 掉头
english_meaning: to turn back, to go back, to turn around, to reverse (direction)
explanation_mandarin: 指调转方向，往回走；也可以引申为重新考虑，改变主意。
explanation_english: Refers to changing direction and going back; it can also be extended to mean reconsidering or changing one's mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發覺唔記得帶銀包，要倒轉頭返屋企攞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 gok3 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1, jiu3 dou2 zyun3 tau4 faan1 uk1 kei2 lo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我发现忘记带钱包了，要回头回家拿。
examples.english_sentence: I realized I forgot to bring my wallet, I need to turn back and go home to get it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到咁嘅地步，我都唔會倒轉頭嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 gam3 ge3 dei6 bou6, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 dou2 zyun3 tau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都说到这个地步了，我也不会回头的。
examples.english_sentence: He has said it to this point, I won't turn back (change my mind).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺路口倒轉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 lou6 hau2 dou2 zyun3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车在路口掉头。
examples.english_sentence: The car turned around at the intersection.

english_meaning: to turn upside down; to reverse; to invert; the other way around
explanation_mandarin: 指将某物翻转，使其上下颠倒；也指反过来，与原本的顺序或方向相反。
explanation_english: Refers to turning something upside down or reversing it; also means the other way around, in the opposite order or direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將杯嘢倒返轉擺呀，會漏晒啲水出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 bui1 je5 dou2 faan1 zyun3 baai2 aa3, wui5 lau6 saai3 di1 seoi2 chut1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把杯子倒过来放，会漏出水的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the cup upside down, it will leak water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日倒返轉嚟講，搞到我聽唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 sing4 jat6 dou2 faan1 zyun3 lai4 gong2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是颠三倒四的，搞得我听不明白。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks in a reversed order, making it hard for me to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工咁少，倒返轉貼錢返工咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 gam3 siu2, dou2 faan1 zyun3 tip3 cin2 faan1 gung1 gam3 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资那么少，简直是倒贴钱上班一样。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is so low that it's almost like he's paying to work.

english_meaning: to regress; to go backwards; to backslide
explanation_mandarin: 指向后退或者情况比以前更差。
explanation_english: To move backwards physically or metaphorically; to become worse or less advanced than before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗廣東話之後，講得仲差咗，好似倒退咗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zi1 hau6, gong2 dak1 zung6 caa1 zo2, hou2 ci5 dou3 teoi3 zo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了广东话之后，说得更差了，好像退步了一样。
examples.english_sentence: After learning Cantonese, he speaks it even worse, like he's regressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟咁差，社會好似倒退緊咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, se5 wui2 hou2 ci5 dou3 teoi3 gan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济这么差，社会好像在倒退。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad, it's like society is regressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔可以倒退㗎，要不斷進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 dou3 teoi3 gaa3, jiu3 bat1 dyun6 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不可以退步的，要不断进步。
examples.english_sentence: You can't regress in your work; you have to constantly improve.

mandarin_meaning: 把钱扔进海里; 白费力气
english_meaning: To throw money into the sea; to throw money away; to waste money; to be a fruitless endeavor.
explanation_mandarin: 形容白白浪费金钱，做了没有意义的事情，就像把钱扔进海里一样，没有任何回报。
explanation_english: Describes wasting money on something that is pointless and yields no return, just like throwing money into the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咁多無謂嘢，咪即係倒錢落海囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 mou4 wai6 je5, mai1 zik1 hai6 dou2 cin2 lok6 hoi2 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买这么多没用的东西，不就是等于把钱扔进海里吗！
examples.english_sentence: Buying so much useless stuff is like throwing money into the sea!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資喺呢間蝕本嘅公司度，根本就係倒錢落海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 hai2 ni1 gaan1 sit6 bun2 ge3 gung1 si1 dou6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 dou2 cin2 lok6 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资在这家亏损的公司，根本就是把钱扔进海里。
examples.english_sentence: Investing in this loss-making company is basically throwing money into the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日賭錢，唔係倒錢落海係咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat6 dou2 cin2, m4 hai6 dou2 cin2 lok6 hoi2 hai6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天赌钱，不是把钱扔进海里是什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: He gambles every day, isn't that throwing money into the sea?

english_meaning: to go bankrupt; to close down (due to business failure)
explanation_mandarin: 指企业因经营不善而破产、倒闭。
explanation_english: Refers to a business going bankrupt or closing down due to poor management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司做蝕本生意，好快就會倒閉㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 sit3 bun2 sang1 ji3, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 dou2 bai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司做亏本生意，很快就会倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: This company is losing money, it will go bankrupt soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多細鋪頭因為疫情而倒閉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 sai3 pou3 tau2 jan1 wai6 jik6 cing4 ji4 dou2 bai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多小店铺因为疫情而倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: Many small shops have closed down due to the pandemic.

english_meaning: unlucky, to have bad luck, to be out of luck
explanation_mandarin: 指运气不好，遭遇不顺。
explanation_english: Refers to having bad luck, experiencing unfortunate circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係倒霉，出門口踩到狗屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 dou2 mui1, chut1 mun4 hau2 caai2 dou2 gau2 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真倒霉，出门踩到狗屎了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really unlucky today, I stepped in dog poop when I went out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁倒霉，都唔好意思笑你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou2 mui1, dou1 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 siu3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么倒霉，都不好意思笑你了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so unlucky, I'm embarrassed to laugh at you.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, unyielding
explanation_mandarin: 形容性格固执，不听劝告。(Xíngróng xìnggé gùzhí, bù tīng quàngào.)
explanation_english: Describes a personality that is stubborn and does not listen to advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好倔，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gwat6, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很倔强，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stubborn person, he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倔啦，聽下人哋嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gwat6 laa1, ting1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么倔强了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條頸好倔，一啲都唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 geng2 hou2 gwat6, jat1 dik1 dou1 m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很倔强，一点都不肯认错。
examples.english_sentence: He is very stubborn and refuses to admit his mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 倔强的人, 不听劝告的人
english_meaning: stubborn person, headstrong person, someone who doesn't listen to advice
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，不听别人的意见，一意孤行。 “倔”是固执，“尾龍”是比喻不听话，难管束。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stubborn and doesn't listen to others' opinions, going their own way. "倔" means stubborn, and "尾龍" metaphorically refers to someone who is disobedient and difficult to control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係隻倔尾龍，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zoek3 gwat6 mei5 lung4, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个倔强的人，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a stubborn person, he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣佢都幾倔尾龍㗎，而家大個咗就聽話好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 keoi5 dou1 gei2 gwat6 mei5 lung4 gaa3, ji4 gaa1 daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 ting1 waa6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候他挺倔强的，现在长大了就听话多了。
examples.english_sentence: He was quite stubborn when he was young, but now that he's grown up, he's much more obedient.

english_meaning: stubborn, unyielding, obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 形容性格刚强，不服输，不轻易改变自己的想法。
explanation_english: Describing a person's character as being strong, unwilling to admit defeat, and not easily changing their mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔好倔強㗎，唔肯認衰嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 gwat6 goeng6 gaa3, m4 hang2 ying6 seoi1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那个人很倔强，不肯认错的。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is very stubborn, he doesn't admit his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倔強啦，聽吓人哋意見都冇壞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gwat6 goeng6 laa1, ting1 haa5 yan4 dei6 ji3 gin3 dou1 mou5 waai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么倔强了，听听别人的意见也没什么坏处。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, there's no harm in listening to other people's opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 固执的情感；执拗的情感
english_meaning: Stubbornness in feelings; stubborn affection; being emotionally fixated
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人对某件事或某人的情感非常固执，即使知道没有结果或是不应该继续，仍然放不下。
explanation_english: Describes someone's emotional attachment to something or someone as stubborn and unyielding, even when they know it's futile or inappropriate to continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對舊愛仲好倔情，都咁耐啦都放唔低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gau6 oi3 zung6 hou2 gwat6 cing4, dou1 gam3 noi6 laa1 dou1 fong3 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对旧爱还很执着，都这么久了都放不下。
examples.english_sentence: He's still stubbornly attached to his ex, he can't let go even after all this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁倔情啦，人哋根本唔鍾意你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gwat6 cing4 laa1, yan4 dei6 gan1 bun2 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么执着了，人家根本不喜欢你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, that person doesn't even like you.

english_meaning: Stubborn; obstinate; inflexible
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，不听劝告，像擂棒一样硬。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stubborn, inflexible, and unwilling to listen to advice, like a pestle used for grinding ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁倔擂槌，講極你都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 gwat6 leoi4 ceoi4, gong2 gik1 nei5 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么倔强，怎么说你都不听。
examples.english_sentence: You're so stubborn, you don't listen no matter what I say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係倔擂槌，做錯咗都唔肯認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gwat6 leoi4 ceoi4, zou6 co3 zo2 dou1 m4 hang2 ying6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个倔脾气，做错了都不肯承认。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stubborn, he won't admit he's wrong even when he is.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, inflexible
explanation_mandarin: 形容人性格固执，不容易改变想法或行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stubborn, inflexible, and unwilling to change their mind or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好倔篤，講極都唔聽。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很倔强，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He is very stubborn, he doesn't listen no matter how much you tell him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倔篤啦，聽下人哋意見啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么固执了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, headstrong, not listening to advice
explanation_mandarin: 形容人性格倔强，像雷打都打不动一样，不听劝告。
explanation_english: Describes a person's stubborn personality, so immovable that even thunder striking them wouldn't change their mind; not listening to advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係倔雷搥，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 gwat6 leoi4 cheui4, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 teng1.

examples.english_sentence: He is so stubborn, he doesn't listen no matter how much you tell him.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gwat6 leoi4 cheui4 laa1, teng1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么固执了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: stubborn; obstinate; pig-headed
explanation_mandarin: 形容人固执，不听劝告，性格顽固。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stubborn, doesn't listen to advice, and has an obstinate personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好倔頭，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwat6 tau4, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是太倔了，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stubborn, he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么倔强了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: Dead end; blind alley; impasse
explanation_mandarin: 比喻走进了没有出路的地方或境地。
explanation_english: A dead end or blind alley, literally or figuratively. It refers to a situation or path with no way out or forward progression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋再咁落去，咪盞行入掘頭巷囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoi3 gam2 lok6 heoi3, mai6 zaan2 haang4 jap6 gwat6 tau4 hong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们再这样下去，不就走进了死胡同吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we keep going like this, we'll just end up in a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅投資策略已經行咗入掘頭巷，冇得救喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 zi1 caak3 leuk6 ji5 ging1 haang4 zo2 jap6 gwat6 tau4 hong2, mou5 dak1 gau3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的投资策略已经走进了死胡同，没救了。
examples.english_sentence: His investment strategy has reached a dead end; there's no saving it.

english_meaning: dead end; blind alley; a path leading nowhere; obstinately pursuing a course of action that is destined to fail
explanation_mandarin: 指一条走不通的路，也比喻固执地做一件注定失败的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to a dead end or a path that leads nowhere. It also metaphorically describes obstinately pursuing a course of action that is destined to fail. Implies stubbornness and a lack of willingness to change course despite evidence of futility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只會行倔頭路㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zi2 wui5 haang4 gwat6 tau4 lou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做只会走死路的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way will only lead you to a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁固執，唔聽人勸，擺明係行緊倔頭路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu3 zap1, m4 ting1 jan4 hyun3, baai2 ming4 hai6 haang4 gan2 gwat6 tau4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么固执，不听人劝，摆明是走死路。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stubborn, doesn't listen to advice, it's obvious he's heading down a dead end.

english_meaning: lucky; fortunate; by luck; by chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示僥倖、幸運的意思。 指意外地或偶然地得到好處，或避免了不好的事情發生。
explanation_english: Expresses luck or fortune. Refers to unexpectedly or by chance obtaining a benefit or avoiding a bad thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試倖倖然合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hang6 hang6 jin4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试僥倖及格了。
examples.english_sentence: He luckily passed the exam this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以次次都倖得過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 ci3 ci3 dou1 hang6 dak1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着每次都能僥倖過關。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can always get away with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倖住佢唔會嚟，始終都要做定準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hang6 zyu6 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4, ci2 zung1 dou1 jiu3 zou6 ding6 zyun2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要僥倖地认为他不会来，始终都要做好准备。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it for granted that he won't come; you should always be prepared.

english_meaning: to escape by luck; to be spared; to avoid by chance
explanation_mandarin: 侥幸地避免，幸而没有遭到（灾祸）。
explanation_english: To escape something bad or unpleasant by luck or chance; to be spared from harm or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次咁大鑊，佢竟然倖免於難，真係好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gam3 daai6 wok6, keoi5 ging2 jin4 hang6 min5 jyu1 naan6, zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这么严重，他竟然侥幸免于灾难，真是幸运。
examples.english_sentence: This time it was so serious, yet he was spared the disaster by luck; it's really fortunate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇人可以倖免於生老病死嘅自然規律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 hang6 min5 jyu1 sang1 lou5 beng6 sei2 ge3 zi6 jin1 kwai1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有人可以幸免于生老病死的自然规律。
examples.english_sentence: No one can escape the natural laws of birth, aging, illness, and death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢場經濟風暴入面，冇咩行業可以倖免。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 coeng4 ging1 zai3 fung1 bou6 jap6 min6, mou5 me1 hang4 jip6 ho2 ji5 hang6 min5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这场经济风暴中，没有什么行业可以幸免。
examples.english_sentence: In this economic storm, few industries can escape unscathed.

english_meaning: to survive; to remain alive; survivor
explanation_mandarin: 指在灾难或危险情况下得以存活。
explanation_english: To survive a disaster or dangerous situation; to remain alive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 空難之後，得佢一個倖存者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung1 naan6 zi1 hau6, dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 hang6 cyun4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空难之后，只有他一个幸存者。
examples.english_sentence: After the air crash, he was the only survivor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，好多人失蹤，倖存嘅人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 zung1, hang6 cyun4 ge3 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，很多人失踪，幸存的人们都很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, many people were missing, and the survivors were very sad.

english_meaning: survivor
explanation_mandarin: 在灾难或危险事件中幸免于难的人。
explanation_english: A person who survives a disaster or dangerous event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係場空難嘅唯一倖存者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 coeng4 hung1 naan6 ge3 wai4 jat1 hang6 cyun4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是那场空难的唯一幸存者。
examples.english_sentence: He is the sole survivor of that plane crash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭之後，倖存者努力重建家園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zaang1 zi1 hau6, hang6 cyun4 ze2 nu5 lik6 cung4 gin3 gaa1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争之后，幸存者努力重建家园。
examples.english_sentence: After the war, the survivors worked hard to rebuild their homes.

english_meaning: if, in case, supposing
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的连词，相当于“如果”、“假使”。
explanation_english: A conjunction used to express a hypothetical condition; equivalent to "if" or "supposing".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倘若你唔嚟，我就自己去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 joek6 nei5 m4 lai4, ngo5 zau6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假如你不来，我就自己去了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't come, I'll go by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倘使佢肯幫手，件事就好辦得多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 sai2 keoi5 hang2 bong1 sau2, gin6 si6 zau6 hou2 baan6 dak1 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假使他肯帮忙，这件事就好办多了。
examples.english_sentence: If he's willing to help, the matter will be much easier to handle.

english_meaning: if, in case, supposing that
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的连词，相当于“如果”、“假如”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing a hypothetical condition; equivalent to "if", "in case", or "supposing that".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倘若聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 joek6 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倘若你有任何問題，可以隨時問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 joek6 nei5 jau5 jam6 ho4 man6 tai4, ho2 ji5 ceoi4 si4 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有任何问题，可以随时问我。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any questions, you can ask me anytime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倘若我中咗六合彩，我就會環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 joek6 ngo5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, ngo5 zau6 wui5 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我中了彩票，我就会环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: If I win the lottery, I will travel around the world.

english_meaning: to wait; wait for; time; season
explanation_mandarin: 动词：等待；名词：时间，时候。
explanation_english: Verb: To wait; Noun: Time, moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度候你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 hau6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm waiting for you here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到時候再算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 si4 hau6 zoi3 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到时候再说。
examples.english_sentence: We'll talk about it when the time comes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等候消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 hau6 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等待消息。
examples.english_sentence: Waiting for news.

english_meaning: designate, designate (official), incoming (official), official-elect
explanation_mandarin: 指已被选出或任命，但尚未正式上任的职位候选人或官员。
explanation_english: Refers to a candidate or official who has been selected or appointed but has not yet officially assumed office. An official-elect or designate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係下一任嘅行政總裁候任人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 haa6 jat1 jam6 ge3 hang4 zing3 zung2 coi4 hau6 jam6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是下一任的行政总裁候任人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the designate for the next CEO.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 候任特首即將發表佢嘅施政報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 jam6 dak6 sau2 zik1 zoeng1 faat3 biu2 keoi5 ge3 si1 zing3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 候任特首即将发表他的施政报告。
examples.english_sentence: The chief executive-designate will soon release his policy address.

english_meaning: to be on call; to be on standby; awaiting orders
explanation_mandarin: 等待命令；准备好随时执行任务。
explanation_english: To be ready and waiting for orders; to be on call and prepared to execute a task at any moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋部隊依家喺度候命，等緊上頭嘅指示。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou6 deoi2 yi1 ga1 hai2 dou6 hau6 ming6, dang2 gan2 soeng6 tau4 ge3 zi2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的部队现在在这里待命，等着上级的指示。
examples.english_sentence: Our troops are on standby here now, waiting for instructions from the superiors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日要候命，隨時準備出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hau6 ming6, ceoi4 si4 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天需要待命，随时准备出发。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be on call today, ready to depart at any time.

english_meaning: awaiting trial, remanded in custody pending trial
explanation_mandarin: 等待审判，通常指被拘留等待审判。
explanation_english: To await trial; to be remanded in custody while waiting for a trial to begin. It implies that the person is suspected of a crime and is being held until the trial takes place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拉咗之後一直都喺度候審。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2 zi1 hau6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai2 dou6 hau6 sam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被捕后一直都在候审。
examples.english_sentence: He has been awaiting trial since he was arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個疑犯依家仲喺監倉度候審。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji4 faan2 ji1 gaa1 zung6 hai2 gaam1 cong1 dou6 hau6 sam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个嫌疑犯现在还在监狱里候审。
examples.english_sentence: The suspect is still in jail awaiting trial.

english_meaning: waiting room (airport departure lounge)
explanation_mandarin: 指机场内供旅客等待登机的房间。
explanation_english: A room in an airport where passengers wait to board their flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺候機室等咗成個鐘，都仲未開始登機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hau6 gei1 sat1 dang2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, dou1 zung6 mei6 hoi1 chi2 dang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在候机室等了一个小时了，都还没有开始登机。
examples.english_sentence: We've been waiting in the departure lounge for an hour, and boarding hasn't started yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間候機室好多人，搵到位坐都難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hau6 gei1 sat1 hou2 do1 jan4, wan2 dou3 wai2 co5 dou1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 候机室里很多人，找到座位都很难。
examples.english_sentence: The departure lounge is so crowded that it's hard to find a seat.

english_meaning: reserve, candidate, alternate
explanation_mandarin: 作为备选的人或物; 预备的，等待机会的。
explanation_english: A person or thing held in reserve; to be in reserve, waiting for an opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揀三個正選，兩個候補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaan2 saam1 go3 zeng3 syun2, loeng5 go3 hau6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要选三个正选，两个候補。
examples.english_sentence: We need to choose three main candidates and two reserves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係候補名單入面嘅其中一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hau6 bou6 ming4 daan1 jap6 min6 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是候选名单里的其中一个。
examples.english_sentence: He is one of the candidates on the reserve list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你哋有人唔嚟，就由候補嘅人頂上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dei6 jau5 jan4 m4 lei4, zau6 jau4 hau6 bou6 ge3 jan4 ding2 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你们有人不来，就由候補的人顶上。
examples.english_sentence: If any of you don't come, the reserve candidate will fill in.

english_meaning: to wait for a bus, train, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 等待交通工具（通常指公共汽车、火车等）。
explanation_english: To wait for a vehicle, usually referring to public transportation like a bus or train.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺巴士站候車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 baa1 si2 zaam6 hau6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公共汽车站等车。
examples.english_sentence: I'm waiting for the bus at the bus stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺月台邊候車，危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jyut6 toi4 bin1 hau6 ce1, ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在站台边缘等车，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait for the train at the edge of the platform, it's dangerous.

english_meaning: candidate, to be a candidate, shortlisted
explanation_mandarin: 有资格被选择或任命的人；被选择的可能对象。
explanation_english: A person who is eligible to be selected or appointed; a potential choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係市長嘅候選人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 si5 zoeng2 ge3 hau6 syun2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是市长的候选人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a candidate for mayor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工我哋得三個候選人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ngo5 dei6 dak1 saam1 go3 hau6 syun2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作我们只有三个候选人。
examples.english_sentence: We only have three candidates for this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定參加候選港姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 caam1 gaa1 hau6 syun2 gong2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她决定参加竞选香港小姐。
examples.english_sentence: She decided to run for Miss Hong Kong.

english_meaning: candidate
explanation_mandarin: 指参加选举，有资格被选为某种职务的人。
explanation_english: A person who applies for a job or is nominated for election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年區議會選舉有好多候選人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ku1 ji5 wui6 syun2 geoi2 jau5 hou2 do1 hau6 syun2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的区议会选举有很多候选人。
examples.english_sentence: There are many candidates in this year's District Council election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要仔細考慮每個候選人嘅政綱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zai2 sai3 haau2 leui6 mui5 go3 hau6 syun2 jan4 ge3 zing3 gong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要仔细考虑每个候选人的政纲。
examples.english_sentence: We need to carefully consider each candidate's political platform.

mandarin_meaning: 准备受罪; 准备挨打; 等着倒霉
english_meaning: To be in trouble; to be in for it; to be about to get punished; to be on the hook.
explanation_mandarin: 形容即将面临惩罚或承担责任，处境不妙。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is about to face punishment or bear responsibility, indicating they are in a bad situation. Often implies a sense of impending doom or negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次衰咗咁大鑊，一定候鑊㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 seoi1 zo2 gam3 daai6 wok6, jat1 ding6 hau6 wok6 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这次搞砸了这么大的事，肯定要倒霉了！
examples.english_sentence: You messed up so badly this time, you're definitely going to be in trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir話邊個再唔交功課，就預備候鑊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir2 waa6 bin1 go3 zoi3 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, zau6 jyu6 bei6 hau6 wok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师说谁再不交功课，就准备受罚！
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said whoever doesn't hand in their homework again will be in for it!

english_meaning: migratory bird
explanation_mandarin: 指随着季节变化而迁徙的鸟类。
explanation_english: Birds that migrate seasonally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年冬天都有好多候鳥嚟香港過冬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 dung1 tin1 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 hau6 niu5 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 gwo3 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年冬天都有很多候鸟来香港过冬。
examples.english_sentence: Every winter, many migratory birds come to Hong Kong to spend the winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似隻候鳥咁，一年到黑都喺唔同嘅地方生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zoek3 hau6 niu5 gam2, jat1 nin4 dou3 hak1 dou1 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像一只候鸟一样，一年到头都在不同的地方生活。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a migratory bird, living in different places all year round.

english_meaning: to lean on, to rely on
explanation_mandarin: 靠着，依赖。
explanation_english: To lean on something for support; to depend or rely on someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢倚住道牆度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji2 zyu6 dou6 coeng4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠着墙。
examples.english_sentence: He is leaning against the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倚賴人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji2 laai6 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要依赖别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rely on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以倚靠你嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 ji2 kaau3 nei5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以依靠你吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I rely on you?

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 依靠某种事物或人来获得支持或帮助。
explanation_english: To depend on something or someone for support or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢倚仗住佢老豆嘅關係，先可以升得咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji2 zoeng6 zyu6 keoi5 lou5 dau2 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他倚仗着他父亲的关系，才能升得这么快。
examples.english_sentence: He relied on his father's connections to get promoted so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以倚仗政府嘅幫助，要靠自己努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 ji2 zoeng6 zing3 fu2 ge3 bong1 zo6, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能依赖政府的帮助，要靠自己努力。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot rely on government assistance; we have to rely on our own efforts.

english_meaning: to lean on; to rely on; to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 依靠、依赖某人或某事物。
explanation_english: To depend on or rely on someone or something for support or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好倚傍佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ji2 bong6 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很依赖他的妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He is very dependent on his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倚傍人，自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji2 bong6 jan4, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要依赖别人，自己搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rely on others, sort it out yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好倚傍政府嘅資助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ji2 bong6 zing3 fu2 ge3 zi1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很依赖政府的资助。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very reliant on government subsidies.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on, to lean on
explanation_mandarin: 依靠，依赖。指在某人或某事物上取得支持或帮助。
explanation_english: To depend on someone or something for support or help. To rely on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日倚凭阿爸嘅钱生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 ji2 pang4 aa3 baa1 ge3 cin2 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是依靠爸爸的钱生活。
examples.english_sentence: They always depend on their father's money to live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔應該倚凭其他人做所有嘢，自己都要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 ji2 pang4 kei4 taa1 jan4 zou6 so2 jau5 je5, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不应该依靠其他人做所有的事情，自己也要努力一些。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't rely on others to do everything; you need to work harder yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以倚凭你嘅經驗嚟解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ji2 pang4 nei5 ge3 ging1 jim6 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以依靠你的经验来解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We can rely on your experience to solve this problem.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 依靠，依仗。
explanation_english: To rely on something or someone; to depend on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好倚憑政府嘅資助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ji2 pang4 zing3 fu2 ge3 zi1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很依赖政府的资助。
examples.english_sentence: They heavily rely on government funding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倚憑運氣，要靠自己嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji2 pang4 wan6 hei3, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要依赖运气，要靠自己的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rely on luck; rely on your own efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以倚憑人哋幫你做曬所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 ji2 pang4 yan4 dei6 bong1 nei5 zou6 saai3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能依赖别人帮你做所有的事情。
examples.english_sentence: You can't rely on others to do everything for you.

english_meaning: to trade on one's age; to act old and bossy; to use one's age as an excuse for being demanding or unreasonable
explanation_mandarin: 仗着自己年纪大，摆老资格，自以为是，不尊重他人。
explanation_english: To act superior or demand special treatment based on one's age; to exploit one's seniority or age to be bossy or unreasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日倚老賣老，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ji2 lou5 maai6 lou5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是倚老卖老，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trading on his age, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好倚老賣老啦，後生仔嘅意見都應該聽下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji2 lou5 maai6 lou5 laa1, hau6 sang1 zai2 ge3 ji3 gin3 dou1 ying1 goi1 ting1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要倚老卖老了，年轻人的意见也应该听听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trade on your age, you should listen to the opinions of young people too.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 依靠，依赖。
explanation_english: To rely on, depend on, or be dependent on someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倚賴人哋，自己都要識得搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji2 laai6 jan4 dei6, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 sik1 dak1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么依赖别人，自己也要学会搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rely on others so much; you also need to learn how to handle things yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好倚賴屋企人嘅經濟支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ji2 laai6 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 ging1 zai3 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很依赖家人的经济支持。
examples.english_sentence: He relies heavily on his family's financial support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想太倚賴呢個軟件，萬一壞咗就麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 taai3 ji2 laai6 ni1 go3 jyun5 gin2, maan6 jat1 waai6 zo2 zau6 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想太依赖这个软件，万一坏了就很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to rely too much on this software; it would be troublesome if it broke down.

english_meaning: to rely heavily on, to count on, to value highly
explanation_mandarin: 重视并依赖；看重而信任。
explanation_english: To rely heavily on someone; to value and trust them significantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細好倚重佢嘅能力，所以好多重要嘅任務都交俾佢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 hou2 ji2 zung6 keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jam6 mou6 dou1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板很倚重他的能力，所以很多重要的任务都交给他做。
examples.english_sentence: The boss relies heavily on his abilities, so he assigns him many important tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋團隊好倚重你嘅經驗，希望你可以幫手解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi2 hou2 ji2 zung6 nei5 ge3 ging1 jim6, hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们团队很倚重你的经验，希望你可以帮忙解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: Our team relies heavily on your experience, and we hope you can help solve this problem.

english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 依赖；依靠。
explanation_english: To depend on someone or something for support, help, or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好倚靠屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ji2 kaau3 uk1 kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很依靠家人。
examples.english_sentence: He relies heavily on his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日倚靠人哋，自己都要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ji2 kaau3 jan4 dei6, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是依赖别人，自己也要努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on others, you need to put in your own effort as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺困難嘅時候，我哋應該互相倚靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 wu6 seung1 ji2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在困难的时候，我们应该互相依靠。
examples.english_sentence: We should rely on each other in times of difficulty.

english_meaning: untrammelled, unrestrained, dashing (appearance), handsome
explanation_mandarin: 形容人洒脱，不拘束；也形容人俊俏。
explanation_english: Describes a person as unrestrained, free, and not bound by conventions; also describes a person as handsome or dashing in appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好倜儻，好受女仔歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 tik1 tong2, hou2 sau6 neoi5 zai2 waan1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很洒脱，很受女孩子欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very dashing person and very popular with girls.

mandarin_meaning: 吸引; 漂亮; 使人眼前一亮
english_meaning: striking; attractive; eye-catching
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常吸引人，使人眼前一亮，通常指外貌漂亮或事物有特色。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very attractive and eye-catching, usually referring to appearance or unique characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到好倞喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 leng3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: She looks very striking today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好倞，好啱打卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 leng3, hou2 ngaam1 daa2 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很吸引人，很适合拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very striking, very suitable for taking photos.

english_meaning: to borrow, to lend, to use as a pretext
explanation_mandarin: 从别人那里取得东西暂时使用，以后归还；把东西给别人暂时使用。
explanation_english: To borrow something from someone for temporary use, with the intention of returning it; to lend something to someone for temporary use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以借你枝筆用吓嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 ze3 nei5 zi1 bat1 yung6 haa5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，借借。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ze3 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，借过。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, let me through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借啲嘢嚟講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 di1 ye5 lai4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借题发挥。
examples.english_sentence: He's using this as a pretext to say something else.

english_meaning: to take the opportunity (to do something); to use as an excuse; to do something deliberately but subtly
explanation_mandarin: 指趁机，利用机会做某事；有时带有负面含义，指故意找借口或机会做某事。
explanation_english: To take advantage of an opportunity to do something; sometimes carries a negative connotation, implying deliberately using an excuse or opportunity to do something, often in a subtle or opportunistic way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借d意摸我隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 di1 ji3 mo2 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意摸我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately took the opportunity to touch my hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我借d意請佢食飯，順便問下佢意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze3 di1 ji3 cheng2 keoi5 sik6 faan6, seon6 bin2 man6 haa5 keoi5 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我借机请他吃饭，顺便问问他的意见。
examples.english_sentence: I took the opportunity to treat him to a meal and ask for his opinion while I was at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都借d意搵我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 ze3 di1 ji3 wan2 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都找借口来找我说话。
examples.english_sentence: He finds an excuse to talk to me every day.

english_meaning: to use...as an excuse; to use...as a stepping stone; to use...as a pretext
explanation_mandarin: 利用某事物或某人作为借口或跳板，达到自己的目的。
explanation_english: To use something or someone as an excuse or a stepping stone to achieve one's own goals. It often implies manipulation or using someone or something to one's advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借阿媽個名過橋，問公司借咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 aa3 maa1 go3 meng2 gwo3 kiu4, man6 gung1 si1 ze3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借用妈妈的名义作为借口，从公司借了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He used his mother's name as an excuse to borrow a lot of money from the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好借啲仔女過橋，你哋大人嘅事自己解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 di1 zai2 neoi5 gwo3 kiu4, nei5 dei6 daai6 jan4 ge3 si6 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拿孩子们当借口，你们大人的事情自己解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use the children as a pretext; you adults should solve your own problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借病過橋，唔想做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze3 beng6 gwo3 kiu4, m4 soeng2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拿生病当借口，不想工作。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses sickness as an excuse to avoid working.

english_meaning: Excuse me (to pass through or borrow something briefly)
explanation_mandarin: 客气地请求别人让一下，或者短暂借用一下东西。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to request someone to move aside or to borrow something briefly. It implies a temporary and quick action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借一借，唔該晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 jat1 ze3, m4 goi1 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借一下，谢谢！
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, thank you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借一借支筆嚟用得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 jat1 ze3 zi1 bat1 lai4 yung6 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能借一下这支笔用一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could I borrow this pen for a moment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借一借，我想出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 jat1 ze3, ngo5 soeng2 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借一下，我想出去。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I want to go out.

synonyms: 唔該借借 (m4 goi1 ze3 ze3)

english_meaning: metonymy, substitution
explanation_mandarin: 修辞手法，不直说某人或某事物的名称，借用与它密切相关的名称来代替。
explanation_english: A figure of speech in which something is referred to by the name of something closely associated with it (metonymy). In rhetoric, it is also a form of substitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重老人家，唔可以冇大冇細，佢哋係我哋嘅「經驗」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 lou5 jan4 gaa1, m4 ho2 ji5 mou5 daai6 mou5 sai3, keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 "ging1 gim6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重老年人，不可以没大没小，他们是我们的“经验”。
examples.english_sentence: We must respect the elderly and not be disrespectful. They are our "experience" (wisdom).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗「金牌」返嚟，真係好叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 "gam1 paai4" faan1 lai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了“金牌”回来，真是很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He brought back the "gold medal", he's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「筆桿子」嘅力量唔可以睇少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: "bat1 gon3 zi2" ge3 lik6 loeng6 m4 ho2 ji5 tai2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “笔杆子”的力量不容小觑。
examples.english_sentence: The power of the "pen" should not be underestimated.

english_meaning: Forced perspective, borrowing position (for photo or camera angle)
explanation_mandarin: 在摄影时，通过巧妙的构图和角度，使两个或多个物体在照片中呈现出一种不真实的比例关系或位置关系。通常用于拍摄有趣的、产生视觉错觉的照片。
explanation_english: In photography, it refers to using composition and camera angle to create an illusion of altered size or position of objects in a photograph. Commonly used to create fun or surreal visual effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋借位影張相，好似我捉住咗個月亮咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ze3 wai2 ying2 zoeng1 soeng3, hou2 ci5 ngo5 zuk1 zyu6 zo2 go3 jyut6 loeng6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们借位拍张照片，好像我抓住月亮一样。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a forced perspective photo, it will look like I'm holding the moon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋借位影咗張好搞笑嘅相，好似個巨人踩住咗間屋咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ze3 wai2 ying2 zo2 zoeng1 hou2 gaau2 siu3 ge3 soeng3, hou2 ci5 go3 geoi6 jan4 caai2 zyu6 zo2 gaan1 uk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们借位拍了一张很搞笑的照片，好像一个巨人踩着房子一样。
examples.english_sentence: They took a very funny forced perspective photo, it looks like a giant is stepping on a house.

english_meaning: Excuse me (to pass through)
explanation_mandarin: 在拥挤的环境中，请求他人让开道路时的礼貌用语。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used when asking someone to move aside to allow you to pass through, typically in a crowded environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，借借，我想出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1, ze3 ze3, ngo5 soeng2 cheot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，让一下，我想出去。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借借，唔該你讓開啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 ze3, m4 goi1 nei5 joeng6 hoi1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让一下，麻烦你让开一点。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, please move aside a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 借刀杀人 (jiè dāo shā rén)
english_meaning: To use someone as a tool; to kill with a borrowed knife; to use a third party to achieve one's own ends
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用别人去达到自己的目的，自己不亲自出面。
explanation_english: A metaphor for using someone else to achieve one's own goals without directly getting involved. It implies manipulation and indirect action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住借刀，自己乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 ze3 dou1, zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着借刀杀人，自己什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about using people as tools, doing nothing himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住借刀對付佢哋，咁樣唔好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ze3 dou1 deoi3 fu6 keoi5 dei6, gam2 joeng2 m4 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着借刀对付他们，这样做不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about using others to deal with them; it's not a good thing to do.

english_meaning: To kill with a borrowed knife; to use someone else to do your dirty work; to use a person to get rid of an enemy while appearing blameless oneself.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用别人去达到自己的目的，而自己不承担任何责任。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes using someone else to achieve one's own goals, while avoiding personal responsibility or blame. It implies manipulating a situation so that another person unwittingly carries out an action that benefits you, often to the detriment of a third party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借刀殺人，自己就扮曬無辜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ze3 dou1 saat3 jan4, zi6 gei2 zau6 baan3 saai3 mou4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是借刀杀人，自己却装作无辜。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses people to do his dirty work, while pretending to be innocent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢哋借刀殺人啊，小心啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 ze3 dou1 saat3 jan4 aa3, siu2 sam1 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他们借刀杀人啊，小心点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let them use you as a pawn, be careful!

english_meaning: to borrow strength; to use external force; to use leverage; to take advantage of a situation; to capitalize on something
explanation_mandarin: 利用外部力量或优势来达到目的。
explanation_english: To use external forces or advantages to achieve a goal; to gain momentum or advantage from something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借力上位，好快就升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 lik6 soeng5 wai2, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借力上位，很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He used leverage to get ahead and was promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑步嘅時候，有時可以借力風嘅方向，跑得快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 bou6 ge3 si4 hau6, jau5 si4 ho2 ji5 ze3 lik6 fung1 ge3 fong1 hoeng3, paau2 dak1 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步的时候，有时候可以借力风的方向，跑得快点。
examples.english_sentence: When running, you can sometimes use the wind direction to your advantage and run faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司借力政府嘅政策優惠，發展得好迅速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ze3 lik6 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3 jau1 wai6, faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 sun3 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司借力政府的政策优惠，发展得很迅速。
examples.english_sentence: This company has developed rapidly by capitalizing on the government's preferential policies.

english_meaning: To use someone's strength against them; To turn the tables; To use an opponent's force against them; To use leverage
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用对方的力量反击对方，或借用外力来达到自己的目的。
explanation_english: An idiom that means to use someone's strength or force against them, turning their own power to one's advantage. It also implies using external resources or leverage to achieve one's goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想借力打力，用我哋嘅資源去發展佢自己嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ze3 lik6 daa2 lik6, yung6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 faat3 zin2 keoi5 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想借力使力，用我们的资源去发展他自己的生意。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use our resources to develop his own business, using our strength against us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判嘅時候，你可以嘗試借力打力，將對手嘅弱點轉化為自己嘅優勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 paan3 ge3 si4 hau6, nei5 ho2 ji5 soeng4 si3 ze3 lik6 daa2 lik6, zoeng1 deoi3 sau2 ge3 joek6 dim2 zyun2 faa3 wai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 yau1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在谈判的时候，你可以尝试借力使力，将对手的弱点转化为自己的优势。
examples.english_sentence: In negotiations, you can try to use leverage, turning your opponent's weaknesses into your own advantages.

english_meaning: to draw support from; with the help of; to avail oneself of; to use
explanation_mandarin: 利用某种事物或力量来达到目的。
explanation_english: To use something or some force to achieve a goal; to rely on or draw support from something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借助科技去解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 zo6 fo1 gei6 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借助科技去解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: He uses technology to solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以借助圖書館嘅資源做研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ze3 zo6 tou4 syu1 gun2 ge3 zi1 jyun4 zou6 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以借助图书馆的资源做研究。
examples.english_sentence: We can use the resources of the library to do research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借助朋友嘅幫忙先至可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 zo6 pang4 jau5 ge3 bong1 mong4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借助朋友的帮助才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: He was able to succeed only with the help of his friends.

english_meaning: to take advantage of a trend or situation; to ride on the coattails of something; to use someone's influence
explanation_mandarin: 利用有利的形势或别人的力量。
explanation_english: To take advantage of a favorable situation, trend, or someone else's power/influence to achieve one's own goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借勢上位，好快就升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 sai3 soeng5 wai2, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借势上位，很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He took advantage of the situation to climb the ranks and got promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司借勢搞環保活動，提高自己嘅形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ze3 sai3 gaau2 waan4 bou2 wut6 dung6, tai4 gou1 zi6 gei2 ge3 hing3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司借势搞环保活动，提高自己的形象。
examples.english_sentence: This company is taking advantage of the trend to promote environmental activities, improving its image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借勢話自己識好多人，其實都係得個講字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 sai3 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 hou2 do1 jan4, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借势说自己认识很多人，其实只是说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: He boasts about knowing a lot of people to leverage influence, but it's all talk.

english_meaning: excuse, pretext
explanation_mandarin: 用作掩盖真相或逃避责任的理由。
explanation_english: A reason given to cover up the real reason for something or to avoid taking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搵借口唔返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 wan2 ze3 hau2 m4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是找借口不来上班。
examples.english_sentence: He always finds excuses to not come to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再搵借口啦，認錯咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 wan2 ze3 hau2 laa1, jing6 co3 mai6 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再找借口了，认错就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses, just admit your mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借口話唔舒服，所以冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 hau2 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借口说不舒服，所以没来。
examples.english_sentence: He made the excuse that he was unwell, so he didn't come.

english_meaning: to use the past to criticize the present, to use historical allusions to comment on current events
explanation_mandarin: 借用历史故事或典故来讽刺或批评当今的社会现象或政治局势。
explanation_english: To satirize or criticize current social phenomena or political situations by alluding to historical stories or events. It implies drawing parallels between the past and the present to make a point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都借古諷今，講埋啲我哋明佢想講乜嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ze3 gu2 fung3 gam1, gong2 maai4 di1 ngo5 dei6 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 mat1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是借古喻今，说的那些我们都明白他想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses the past to criticize the present, saying things that make it clear what he wants to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲好多地方都係借古諷今，你睇就明㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 hai6 ze3 gu2 fung3 gam1, nei5 tai2 zau6 ming4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏很多地方都是借古喻今，你看就明白了。
examples.english_sentence: This play uses the past to criticize the present in many places. You'll understand it once you watch it.

jyutping: ze3 zo2 lung4 ji5 can4 zek3 ji5
english_meaning: To pretend not to hear; to turn a deaf ear; to ignore deliberately.
explanation_mandarin: 这句话的意思是假装听不见，故意忽略。聋耳陈是一个历史人物，传说他听力不好。所以，这句话就用来形容一个人假装听不见，拒绝听取别人的意见或要求。
explanation_english: This idiom means to pretend not to hear, to deliberately ignore something. "Lung Ear Chan" (聾耳陳) is a historical figure rumored to have poor hearing. The idiom is used to describe someone pretending not to hear, refusing to listen to others' opinions or requests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗好多次唔好咁做，佢都係借咗聾耳陳隻耳，當冇聽到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, keoi5 dou1 hai6 ze3 zo2 lung4 ji5 can4 zek3 ji5, dong3 mou5 teng1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他说了好多次不要这样做，他都假装没听见，当作没听到。
examples.english_sentence: I've told him many times not to do that, but he just pretends not to hear and acts like he didn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好借咗聾耳陳隻耳啦，我都已經求咗你咁多次，幫幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ze3 zo2 lung4 ji5 can4 zek3 ji5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 ji5 ging1 kiu4 zo2 nei5 gam2 do1 ci3, bong1 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要装聋作哑了，我都已经求了你这么多次，帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend not to hear, I've already begged you so many times, please help.

english_meaning: Excuse me (when asking a question); May I ask
explanation_mandarin: 用于礼貌地询问问题，表示请求允许提问。与普通话的“请问”意思相同。
explanation_english: Used as a polite way to begin a question. Equivalent to "Excuse me" or "May I ask".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借問聲，呢度係咪去旺角㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 man6 seng1, ni1 dou6 hai6 mai1 heoi3 wong6 gok3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问一下，这里是去旺角的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, is this the way to Mong Kok?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借問，而家幾點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 man6, ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问，现在几点了？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, what time is it now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借問聲，邊度有廁所呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 man6 seng1, bin1 dou6 jau5 chi3 so2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问一下，哪里有洗手间？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

synonyms: 唔該問聲 (m4 goi1 man6 seng1)

english_meaning: Excuse me; May I ask
explanation_mandarin: 客气地询问问题前的礼貌用语，表示打扰一下，想问个问题。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used before asking a question, indicating a brief interruption to inquire something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借問聲，想問下尖沙咀點樣去呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 man6 seng1, soeng2 man6 haa5 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 dim2 joeng2 heoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问一下，我想问一下尖沙咀怎么去啊？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'd like to ask how to get to Tsim Sha Tsui?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借問聲，依度有無洗手間呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 man6 seng1, ji1 dou6 jau5 mou5 sai2 sau2 gaan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问一下，这里有没有洗手间啊？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, is there a restroom here?

english_meaning: to find an excuse; to use something as a pretext; to take advantage (of the situation)
explanation_mandarin: 指找个理由或借口，通常带有想要达到某种目的的意图。
explanation_english: Refers to finding an excuse or pretext, usually with the intention of achieving a certain goal. It often implies opportunistic behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借啲意話唔舒服，所以唔嚟開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 di1 ji3 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 m4 lei4 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找借口说不舒服，所以不来开会。
examples.english_sentence: He made an excuse that he wasn't feeling well, so he didn't come to the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借啲意掂我隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 di1 ji3 dim6 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁机碰了我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He took advantage to touch my hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借啲意問我攞電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 di1 ji3 man6 ngo5 lo2 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找借口问我要电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: He made an excuse to ask me for my phone number.

english_meaning: metaphor
explanation_mandarin: 一种修辞手法，不直接说出本体，而借用跟本体有相似点的其他事物来比喻。
explanation_english: A figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable. It's a type of figurative language that compares two things without using 'like' or 'as'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一隻懶惰嘅豬噉，成日瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 zek3 laan5 do6 ge3 zyu1 gam2, seng4 jat6 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他像一只懒惰的猪一样，整天睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: He is like a lazy pig, sleeping all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說話好似刀噉，好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3 waa6 hou2 ci5 dou1 gam2, hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的话像刀一样，很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: His words are like knives, very hurtful.

english_meaning: to stay overnight; to ask to stay the night; to seek lodging
explanation_mandarin: 请求别人提供住宿，过夜。
explanation_english: To request accommodation from someone, to stay overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚趕唔切返屋企，可唔可以借宿一宵呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 gon2 m4 cit3 faan1 uk1 kei2, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 suk1 jat1 siu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚赶不及回家，可以借宿一晚吗？
examples.english_sentence: I can't make it home tonight, can I stay overnight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇錢，唯有周圍借宿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 cin2, wai4 jau5 zau1 wai4 ze3 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没钱，只好到处借住。
examples.english_sentence: He has no money, so he has to seek lodging everywhere.

english_meaning: to excuse oneself to go to the bathroom as an excuse to leave (a situation); to take a 'bathroom break' to escape
explanation_mandarin: 指以去洗手间为借口，从而逃避某种尴尬或不愿面对的局面。
explanation_english: Refers to using the excuse of going to the bathroom as a way to escape an awkward or undesirable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個gathering度覺得好悶，於是就借尿遁走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 gathering dou6 gok3 dak1 hou2 mun6, yu1 si6 zau6 ze3 niu6 deon6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在聚会上觉得很无聊，于是就借故离开走了。
examples.english_sentence: He felt bored at the gathering, so he excused himself to go to the bathroom and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好借尿遁呀，我哋仲有嘢要傾㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 niu6 deon6 aa3, ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 je5 jiu3 king1 gaa3!
