examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要借故离开啊，我们还有事情要谈呢！
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to excuse yourself, we still have things to discuss!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見佢面色唔好，我知佢想借尿遁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 min6 sik1 m4 hou2, ngo5 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 ze3 niu6 deon6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他的脸色不好，我知道他想借故离开了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his pale face, I knew he wanted to take a bathroom break to escape.

english_meaning: to return as a ghost in another's corpse; to reincarnate; to revive in a different form; to stage a comeback under a different guise
explanation_mandarin: 比喻已经死亡或没落的事物借助某种形式得以复活或重新出现。
explanation_english: An idiom that figuratively means something that has died or declined revives or reappears in a different form or guise. It can also refer to reincarnation or staging a comeback under a different form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司本來就嚟執笠，但係俾一間大公司收購咗之後，就借屍還魂，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 bun2 lai4 zau6 lai4 zap1 lap1, daan6 hai6 bei2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 sau1 gau3 zo2 zi1 hau6, zau6 ze3 si1 waan4 wan4, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司本来就要倒闭了，但是被一家大公司收购之后，就借尸还魂，重新开始了。
examples.english_sentence: His company was about to go bankrupt, but after being acquired by a large corporation, it made a comeback and started anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊嘅品牌，重新包裝之後，就借屍還魂咁，再次受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau6 ge3 pin3 paai4, cung4 san1 baau1 zong1 zi1 hau6, zau6 ze3 si1 waan4 wan4 gam2, zoi3 ci3 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个旧的品牌，重新包装之后，就借尸还魂一样，再次受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This old brand, after being repackaged, made a comeback and became popular again.

english_meaning: to feign needing to defecate as an excuse to leave; to make an excuse to leave (especially an awkward or undesirable situation)
explanation_mandarin: 假装要上厕所，以此为借口离开不喜欢的场合。是一种比较委婉的脱身方式。
explanation_english: To pretend to need to defecate as an excuse to leave an undesirable or awkward situation. It's a relatively subtle way to excuse oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個party咁悶，我借屎遁走先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 party gam3 mun6, ngo5 ze3 si2 deon6 zau2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个派对太无聊了，我先找个借口溜了。
examples.english_sentence: This party is so boring, I'll make an excuse to leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到前度，佢即刻借屎遁，真係尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 cin4 dou6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 ze3 si2 deon6, zan1 hai6 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 见到前任，他立刻找借口离开了，真尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his ex, he immediately made an excuse to leave, it was really awkward.

english_meaning: to use as a pretext; to feign; to use an excuse
explanation_mandarin: 找借口或理由去做某事。
explanation_english: To use a pretext or excuse to do something; to do something under the guise of another reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借意話唔舒服，所以早走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 ji3 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 zou2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借口说不舒服，所以早走了。
examples.english_sentence: He used the excuse that he wasn't feeling well, so he left early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我借意問佢拎電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze3 ji3 man6 keoi5 ling1 din6 waa6 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我借故问他要电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: I used a pretext to ask him for his phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好借意偷懶呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 ji3 tau1 laan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要借故偷懒啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't use that as an excuse to slack off!

english_meaning: IOU; promissory note; written acknowledgement of debt
explanation_mandarin: 借款时写的凭证，上面写明借款金额、日期、利息（如有）等。
explanation_english: A written document acknowledging a debt, specifying the amount borrowed, date, interest (if any), and other relevant details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我借咗錢畀佢，佢寫咗張借據畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze3 zo2 cin2 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 se2 zo2 zoeng1 ze3 geoi3 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我借了钱给他，他写了一张借条给我。
examples.english_sentence: I lent him money, and he wrote me an IOU.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住要攞返張借據，唔係到時就口同鼻拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 jiu3 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 ze3 geoi3, m4 hai6 dou3 si4 zau6 hau2 tung4 bei6 ngaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记住要拿回借条，不然到时候就争执不清了。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to get back the IOU, or else there will be disputes later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張借據要寫清楚借幾多錢，幾時還，仲有冇利息㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 ze3 geoi3 jiu3 se2 cing1 co2 ze3 gei2 do1 cin2, gei2 si4 waan4, zung6 jau5 mou5 lei6 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借条要写清楚借了多少钱，什么时候还，还有没有利息。
examples.english_sentence: The IOU needs to clearly state how much money was borrowed, when it is to be repaid, and whether there is any interest.

english_meaning: to use as an excuse; under the pretext of; on the pretext of
explanation_mandarin: 以某事为借口。
explanation_english: To use something as an excuse or pretext.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借故話唔舒服，所以冇嚟開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 gu3 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 mou5 lai4 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他藉口说不舒服，所以没来开会。
examples.english_sentence: He used feeling unwell as an excuse for not attending the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借故有嘢做，推咗個約會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 gu3 jau5 je5 zou6, teoi1 zo2 go3 joek3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他藉口有事要做，推掉了约会。
examples.english_sentence: He used having something to do as an excuse to cancel the appointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日借故唔做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ze3 gu3 m4 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是找借口不做事了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always make excuses for not doing work.

english_meaning: to take the opportunity; to seize the chance; to use as a pretext
explanation_mandarin: 利用机会做某事。指趁着有利的时机或情况。
explanation_english: To take advantage of an opportunity; to seize a chance to do something; to use something as a pretext or excuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借機請我食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 gei1 cheng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借机会请我吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He took the opportunity to treat me to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借機走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 gei1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借机走了。
examples.english_sentence: He seized the chance to leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我借機問佢攞電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze3 gei1 man6 keoi5 lo2 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我借机会问他要电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: I took the opportunity to ask him for his phone number.

english_meaning: loan; to borrow money
explanation_mandarin: 名词指借来的钱，动词指借钱的动作。
explanation_english: As a noun, it refers to the money borrowed. As a verb, it refers to the act of borrowing money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住去銀行借款嚟買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 ze3 fun2 lai4 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算去银行贷款买房。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to get a loan from the bank to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司借款融資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ze3 fun2 yung4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司借款融资。
examples.english_sentence: Their company borrowed money for financing.

english_meaning: to make excuses, to yield/compromise (often unwillingly)
explanation_mandarin: 指找借口，或者不情愿地迁就、妥协。
explanation_english: To make excuses, or to reluctantly yield, compromise, or make concessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再借歪啦，做錯嘢就認咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 ze3 waai1 laa1, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jing6 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再找借口了，做错了就承认了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses, just admit that you did something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想借歪，但係老細講到咁，都冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 ze3 waai1, daan6 hai6 lou5 sai3 gong2 dou3 gam2, dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想妥协，但是老板都这样说了，也没有办法。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to compromise, but the boss said so, so there's nothing I can do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借歪唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze3 waai1 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是找借口不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes excuses for not working.

english_meaning: shell corporation; back door listing; backdoor IPO; figuratively, using an existing entity to achieve a goal or to avoid scrutiny
explanation_mandarin: 原指企业通过收购或兼并一家已上市的公司，从而实现自己上市的目的。也引申为借助现有的资源或平台达到某种目的，有时带有规避风险或审查的含义。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a company achieving its own listing by acquiring or merging with an already listed company. By extension, it means using existing resources or platforms to achieve a certain goal, sometimes with the connotation of avoiding risks or scrutiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司借殼上市，避開咗好多審查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ze3 hok3 soeng5 si5, bei6 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 sam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司借壳上市，避开了许多审查。
examples.english_sentence: The company went public through a back door listing, avoiding a lot of scrutiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想借殼發展新業務，但係風險好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 ze3 hok3 faat3 zin2 san1 ngip6 mou6, daan6 hai6 fung1 him2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想借壳发展新业务，但是风险很大。
examples.english_sentence: They want to use a shell corporation to develop new businesses, but the risks are very high.

english_meaning: to slip away; to make an excuse to leave (often subtly and quietly)
explanation_mandarin: 一种委婉的说法，指偷偷溜走或找借口离开，通常是为了避免尴尬或不愉快的局面。 类似“三十六计，走为上计”中的“走”。“水遁”源自忍者忍术。
explanation_english: A euphemism for slipping away or making an excuse to leave, often to avoid an awkward or unpleasant situation. It is similar to the saying "the best of the 36 stratagems is to flee." "Water escape (水遁)" originates from the ninja technique of the same name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老細黑晒面，即刻借水遁走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 lou5 sai3 hak1 saai3 min6, zik1 hak1 ze3 seoi2 deon6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到老板脸色铁青，立刻找借口溜走了。
examples.english_sentence: He saw his boss's face turn black and immediately slipped away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我借水遁先，遲啲再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ze3 seoi2 deon6 sin1, ci4 di1 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我先溜了，晚点再聊。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'll slip away first, we'll talk later.

english_meaning: to borrow; to use temporarily; to adopt (an idea, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 暂时使用；借用。
explanation_english: To use something temporarily, often with permission; to adopt or adapt something for one's own use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我借用一下你支筆得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze3 jung6 jat1 haa5 nei5 zi1 bat1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借用一下你的笔吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以借用你個廁所嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 ze3 jung6 nei5 go3 ci3 so2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借用一下你的厕所吗？
examples.english_sentence: May I use your restroom?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個概念係我哋借用咗外國嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaam3 nim6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ze3 jung6 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个概念是我们借用了国外的。
examples.english_sentence: This concept is borrowed from foreign countries.

english_meaning: Help me take a look; Lend me your eyes (to see)
explanation_mandarin: 请求别人帮忙看一下（通常指看某个东西，或者帮忙留意某件事）。含略带俏皮、轻松的语气。
explanation_english: To ask someone to help take a look at something, or to keep an eye out for something. It carries a slightly playful and lighthearted tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該借眼睇下佢返咗嚟未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 ze3 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 faan1 zo2 lai4 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我看看他回来了没有。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me check if he's back yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借眼望下邊個嚟咗啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 ngaan5 mong6 haa5 bin1 go3 lai4 zo2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我看看谁来了？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me take a look who's here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，借眼幫我睇住個袋呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, ze3 ngaan5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 doi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，帮我照看一下包。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, can you help me keep an eye on my bag?

synonyms: 幫手睇睇 (bong1 sau2 tai2 tai2)

english_meaning: To present borrowed flowers to Buddha; to offer something acquired from someone else; to give away something that doesn't belong to you.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用别人的东西做人情。
explanation_english: A metaphor for using other people's things to gain favor or to make a gesture without genuine effort or cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都借花敬佛，攞人哋嘅嘢去氹老闆開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ze3 faa1 ging3 fat6, lo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 heoi3 tam2 lou5 baan2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是借花献佛，拿别人的东西去哄老板开心。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses other people's things to please the boss, offering something that isn't his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好借花敬佛啦，呢份報告係阿明寫嘅，唔係你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ze3 faa1 ging3 fat6 laa1, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 aa3 ming4 se2 ge3, m4 hai6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要借花献佛了，这份报告是阿明写的，不是你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take credit for something that isn't yours. This report was written by Ah Ming, not you.

english_meaning: loanword, borrowing (of a word)
explanation_mandarin: 指從其他語言借用過來的詞語。
explanation_english: A word adopted from another language and incorporated into the vocabulary of the recipient language without translation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「巴士」係一個借詞，嚟自英文嘅「bus」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 hai6 jat1 go3 ze3 ci4, lai4 zi6 jing1 man4 ge3 "bus".
examples.mandarin_sentence: “巴士”是一个借词，来自英文的“bus”。
examples.english_sentence: "Bus" is a loanword from the English word "bus".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人嘅口頭禪都係借詞，好似「cheap」噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 hau2 tau4 saan4 dou1 hai6 ze3 ci4, hou2 ci5 "cheap" gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港人的口头禅都是借词，比如“cheap”这样。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong people's catchphrases are loanwords, like "cheap".

english_meaning: lending and borrowing, credit
explanation_mandarin: 指借入和贷出钱财的行为，也指借贷关系。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of lending and borrowing money, also refers to the credit relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行提供借貸服務俾市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 cung4 gung1 ze3 daai3 fuk6 mou6 bei2 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行向市民提供借贷服务。
examples.english_sentence: Banks provide lending and borrowing services to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借貸嘅金額好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 daai3 ge3 gam1 ngaak6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借贷的金额很大。
examples.english_sentence: The amount of money he borrowed is very large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借貸要小心，唔好借得太多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 daai3 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 ze3 dak1 taai3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借贷要小心，不要借太多。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful with borrowing, don't borrow too much.

english_meaning: to borrow something briefly; to let someone use something for a short while; to pass (something) for a moment
explanation_mandarin: 指借用或让别人短暂使用某物。
explanation_english: Indicates borrowing something briefly or allowing someone to use something for a short time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借轉支筆嚟睇下得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 zyun2 zi1 bat1 lai4 tai2 haa5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借我一下笔看一下可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I borrow your pen for a moment to have a look?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借轉你個電話用下，我打個電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 zyun2 nei5 go3 din6 waa2 yung6 haa5, ngo5 daa2 go3 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借我一下你的电话用一下，我打个电话。
examples.english_sentence: Let me borrow your phone for a moment, I need to make a call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書借轉俾你睇下先，你啱唔啱睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ze3 zyun2 bei2 nei5 tai2 haa5 sin1, nei5 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书先借给你看一下，你喜不喜欢看。
examples.english_sentence: Let me lend you this book for a moment to see if you like it.

english_meaning: Excuse me; let me pass
explanation_mandarin: 表示请别人让开，以便自己通过。
explanation_english: Used to ask someone to move aside to allow you to pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，借過借過，我趕時間呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ze3 gwo3 ze3 gwo3, ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，借光借光，我赶时间。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, excuse me, I'm in a hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借過一借，我拎啲嘢過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 gwo3 jat1 ze3, ngo5 ling1 di1 je5 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借光一下，我拿点东西过去。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I need to carry some things through.

synonyms: 唔該借借 (m4 goi1 ze3 ze3)

english_meaning: drowning one's sorrows in alcohol; drinking to forget one's troubles
explanation_mandarin: 通过喝酒来消除内心的忧愁。指试图用酒精麻痹自己，以减轻痛苦。
explanation_english: To drown one's sorrows in alcohol. It refers to trying to numb oneself with alcohol to alleviate pain or sadness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後日日都借酒消愁，睇見都慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 jat1 jat1 dou1 ze3 zau2 siu1 sau4, tai2 gin3 dou1 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后每天都借酒浇愁，看着都可怜。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up, he drowned his sorrows in alcohol every day. It's pitiful to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借酒消愁唔係解決問題嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 zau2 siu1 sau4 m4 hai6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借酒浇愁不是解决问题的方法。
examples.english_sentence: Drowning your sorrows in alcohol is not a way to solve problems.

english_meaning: to borrow money, to lend money
explanation_mandarin: 指向别人借入钱款，也指借出钱款给别人。具体指哪种行为需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: To borrow money from someone, or to lend money to someone. The specific meaning (borrow or lend) depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住借錢買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ze3 cin2 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算借钱买房。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to borrow money to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借錢俾我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 cin2 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以借钱给我吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me some money?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借錢唔還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze3 cin2 m4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是借钱不还。
examples.english_sentence: He always borrows money and doesn't pay it back.

english_meaning: to learn from; to draw lessons from; to use as a reference; to take as a warning
explanation_mandarin: 以别人的经验或教训作为自己行动的参考。
explanation_english: To learn from someone else's experience, success or failure, and use it as a reference for one's own actions. Can also imply taking something as a warning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要借鏡上次嘅失敗，今次一定要成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ze3 geng3 soeng6 ci3 ge3 sat1 baai6, gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要借鉴上次的失败，这次一定要成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn from our last failure, and we must succeed this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其他國家嘅成功經驗，我哋可以借鏡一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 sing4 gung1 ging1 jim6, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ze3 geng3 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其他国家的成功经验，我们可以借鉴一下。
examples.english_sentence: We can learn from the successful experiences of other countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅失敗，就係我哋嘅借鏡，唔好重蹈覆轍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 sat1 baai6, zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ze3 geng3, m4 hou2 cung4 dou2 fuk1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的失败，就是我们的借鉴，不要重蹈覆辙。
examples.english_sentence: Their failure serves as a lesson for us, so we shouldn't repeat their mistakes.

english_meaning: to draw lessons from; to use as a reference; to learn from
explanation_mandarin: 指吸取经验或教训，以供自己参考。
explanation_english: To draw lessons or experience from something and use it as a reference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以借鑑吓其他公司嘅成功經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ze3 gaam3 haa5 kei4 taa1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以借鉴一下其他公司的成功经验。
examples.english_sentence: We can learn from the successful experiences of other companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃可以借鑑外國嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ho2 ji5 ze3 gaam3 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划可以借鉴国外的做法。
examples.english_sentence: This plan can draw lessons from foreign practices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想借鑑香港嘅發展模式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 ze3 gaam3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 faat3 zin2 mou4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想借鉴香港的发展模式。
examples.english_sentence: They want to learn from Hong Kong's development model.

english_meaning: to draw lessons from; to use as a reference; to learn from (an experience, a success, a mistake)
explanation_mandarin: 以别人或别的事作为借鉴。参考、学习、吸取经验。
explanation_english: To draw lessons or inspiration from something or someone; to use as a reference point for learning or improvement. It implies learning from successes, failures, or experiences of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以借鑒吓人哋嘅成功經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ze3 gaam3 haa5 yan4 dei6 ge3 sing4 gung1 ging1 yim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以借鉴一下别人的成功经验。
examples.english_sentence: We can draw lessons from other people's successful experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃借鑒咗外國嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ze3 gaam3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划借鉴了外国的做法。
examples.english_sentence: This plan draws on foreign practices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該從失敗中借鑒教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 cung4 si1 baai6 zung1 ze3 gaam3 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该从失败中借鉴教训。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn lessons from failures.

english_meaning: To be in the habit of borrowing; to frequently borrow; used to borrowing
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人经常借用某物，或者习惯了借用某物。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is in the habit of borrowing something, or is used to borrowing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借開我啲書，所以我唔介意借俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 hoi1 ngo5 di1 syu1, so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 gaai3 ji3 ze3 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常借我的书，所以我不在意借给他。
examples.english_sentence: He's in the habit of borrowing my books, so I don't mind lending them to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借開錢唔還，唔好借俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 hoi1 cin2 m4 waan4, m4 hou2 ze3 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他借钱不还，不要借给他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's used to borrowing money and not returning it, don't lend it to him.

english_meaning: to borrow and read; to check out (books, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 借来看，通常指借书或刊物阅读。
explanation_english: To borrow and read something, usually referring to borrowing books or publications to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想借閱呢本小說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ze3 jyut6 ni1 bun2 siu2 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想借阅这本小说。
examples.english_sentence: I want to borrow and read this novel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你借閱咗幾多本書啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ze3 jyut6 zo2 gei2 do1 bun2 syu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你借阅了多少本书啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many books have you borrowed and read?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館提供免費借閱服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 tai4 cung4 min5 fai3 ze3 jyut6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆提供免费借阅服务。
examples.english_sentence: The library offers free borrowing and reading services.

english_meaning: to borrow and read (books, documents etc.); to consult (a document)
explanation_mandarin: 借来看，通常指借书或文件等进行阅读。
explanation_english: To borrow and read. Usually refers to borrowing books or documents for reading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館可以借閲書本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 ho2 ji5 ze3 jyut6 syu1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆可以借阅书籍。
examples.english_sentence: You can borrow and read books at the library.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以借閲呢份文件，但係唔可以帶走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 ze3 jyut6 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2, daan6 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 daai3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以借阅这份文件，但是不可以带走。
examples.english_sentence: You can consult this document, but you can't take it away.

english_meaning: Excuse me (when squeezing through a crowd); Pardon me (for getting in the way); May I pass?
explanation_mandarin: 在拥挤的环境下，为了穿过人群或者避免挡路，礼貌地请求别人让开。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used when trying to pass through a crowded area or when feeling like you are in someone's way. It literally translates to 'borrow head, borrow road'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，借頭借路，唔該晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ze3 tau4 ze3 lou6, m4 goi1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，借光一下，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, may I pass? Thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街咁多人，借頭借路都借到口乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 gam3 do1 jan4, ze3 tau4 ze3 lou6 dou1 ze3 dou3 hau2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上这么多人，一直说借光都说到口渴。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people on the street, I'm getting thirsty from constantly saying "excuse me".

synonyms: 唔該借借 (m4 goi1 ze3 ze3)

english_meaning: To make a mountain out of a molehill; to exaggerate; to use a pretext to achieve an ulterior motive; to elaborate on a minor point.
explanation_mandarin: 利用一个话题或借口，加以夸大或延伸，以达到某种目的或表达某种情感。
explanation_english: To use a topic or pretext to exaggerate or extend, in order to achieve a certain goal or express a certain emotion. Often carries a negative connotation of exploiting a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係借題發揮，想鬧你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 ze3 tai4 faat3 fai1, soeng2 naau6 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是借题发挥，想骂你而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's just making a mountain out of a molehill, he just wants to scold you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆借啲嘢嚟講，借題發揮，話我哋做嘢唔夠落力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 ze3 di1 je5 lai4 gong2, ze3 tai4 faat3 fai1, waa6 ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 m4 gau3 lok6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板找借口，借题发挥，说我们工作不够努力。
examples.english_sentence: The boss used some things as an excuse, making a mountain out of a molehill, saying we weren't working hard enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好借題發揮啦，件事根本冇咁嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 tai4 faat3 fai1 laa1, gin6 si6 gan1 bun2 mou5 gam3 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别借题发挥了，这件事根本没那么严重。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill, the matter is not that serious at all.

synonyms: 小題大做 (siu2 tai4 daai6 zou6)

english_meaning: to advocate; to promote; to initiate
explanation_mandarin: 提议，发起，带头做某事。
explanation_english: To advocate, promote, or initiate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該倡環保，鼓勵市民減少浪費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 coeng3 waan4 bou2, gu2 lai6 si5 man4 gim2 siu2 long6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该提倡环保，鼓励市民减少浪费。
examples.english_sentence: The government should promote environmental protection and encourage citizens to reduce waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好倡運動，日日都跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 coeng3 wan6 dung6, jat1 jat1 dou1 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很提倡运动，每天都跑步。
examples.english_sentence: He advocates exercise and runs every day.

english_meaning: to advocate, to promote
explanation_mandarin: 提倡，引导。主张、发起并引导。
explanation_english: To advocate for something; to promote a cause or idea; to take the lead in suggesting and supporting a particular action or principle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該倡導健康嘅生活方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 coeng3 dou6 gin6 hong1 ge3 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该倡导健康的生活方式。
examples.english_sentence: The government should advocate for a healthy lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要倡導環保意識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 coeng3 dou6 waan4 bou2 ji3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要倡导环保意识。
examples.english_sentence: We need to promote environmental awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋積極倡導動物權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zik1 gik1 coeng3 dou6 dung6 mat6 kyun4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们积极倡导动物权益。
examples.english_sentence: They actively advocate for animal rights.

english_meaning: to propose; to advocate; to initiate; proposal; initiative
explanation_mandarin: 提出建议，发起行动。
explanation_english: To propose or advocate for something; to initiate a plan or action; can also refer to the proposal or initiative itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府倡議緊環保政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 coeng3 ji5 gan2 waan4 bou2 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正在倡议环保政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is advocating for environmental protection policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋倡議嘅新計劃得到好多人支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 coeng3 ji5 ge3 san1 gai3 waak6 dak1 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们倡议的新计划得到很多人的支持。
examples.english_sentence: The new plan they proposed has received a lot of support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個倡議對改善社區有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 coeng3 ji5 deoi3 gai2 sin6 se5 keoi1 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个倡议对改善社区有帮助。
examples.english_sentence: This initiative is helpful in improving the community.

english_meaning: worth, worthwhile, value
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有某种价值或意义，值得去做或拥有。
explanation_english: To be worth, to have value, to be worthwhile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好値做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 zik1 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很值得做的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is worth doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書好値睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 zik1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很值得看。
examples.english_sentence: This book is worth reading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅付出係値得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 fu6 ceot1 hai6 zik1 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的付出是值得的。
examples.english_sentence: Your effort is worthwhile.

english_meaning: tired; weary; fatigued
explanation_mandarin: 感到疲乏，没有精神。
explanation_english: Feeling tired, weary, or lacking energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好倦呀，想早啲瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gyun6 aa3, soeng2 zou2 di1 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很疲倦，想早点睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very tired today, I want to go to bed early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗成日嘢，真係攰到人都倦晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 seng4 jat6 je5, zan1 hai6 gui6 dou3 jan4 dou1 gyun6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了一整天的事情，真是累得人都疲倦了。
examples.english_sentence: After working the whole day, I'm really exhausted and weary.

english_meaning: weary of work; tired of one's job; to be weary of one's duties
explanation_mandarin: 指对工作感到厌倦，不想继续努力或认真工作。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling weary or tired of work, not wanting to continue to work hard or diligently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多年，開始有啲倦勤喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, hoi1 chi2 jau5 di1 gyun6 kan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多年，开始有些厌倦工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working for so many years, he's starting to feel a bit weary of his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為經濟唔好，搞到好多人都變得倦勤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 ging1 jai3 m4 hou2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 yan4 dou1 bin3 dak1 gyun6 kan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为经济不好，搞得很多人都变得怠工。
examples.english_sentence: Because the economy is bad, many people have become weary of work.

english_meaning: tired look; weary countenance
explanation_mandarin: 指因疲劳而显现出的疲惫的容貌。
explanation_english: Refers to a tired or weary appearance due to fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊面好攰，一眼就睇得出佢有倦容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 min6 hou2 gui6, yat1 ngaan5 jau6 tai2 dak1 cheut1 keoi5 yau5 gyun6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的脸色很疲惫，一眼就能看出她有倦容。
examples.english_sentence: Her face looks very tired, you can tell at a glance that she has a tired look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 通宵加班之後，佢嘅倦容好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung1 siu2 gaa1 baan1 ji1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 gyun6 yung4 hou2 ming4 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 通宵加班之后，他的倦容很明显。
examples.english_sentence: After working overtime all night, his tired look is very obvious.

english_meaning: arrogant, haughty, supercilious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度傲慢，看不起别人。
explanation_english: Describes a person's attitude as arrogant and looking down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好倨，成日睇唔起人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 geoi3, seng4 jat6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很傲慢，总是看不起人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very arrogant person and always looks down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁倨啦，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 geoi3 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么傲慢了，谦虚一点好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, it's better to be more humble.

english_meaning: beautiful; pretty; please (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，'倩' 一般不单独使用，多用于人名或一些书面语中，表示美好、漂亮的意思。也可用作“请”，但比较文雅，不常用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '倩' is generally not used alone. It's commonly found in names or literary expressions, signifying beauty or prettiness. It can also mean 'please,' but it's a more formal and less frequently used equivalent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個女仔個名有個「倩」字，聽落好優雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 neoi2 zai2 go3 ming2 jau5 go3 "sin6" zi6, ting1 lok6 hou2 jau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个女孩的名字里有个“倩”字，听起来很优雅。
examples.english_sentence: This girl's name has the character '倩' in it, it sounds very elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「倩人捎書」，即係請人幫你帶信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: "sin6 jan4 saau1 syu1", zik1 hai6 ceng2 jan4 bong1 nei5 daai3 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “倩人捎书”，就是请人帮你带信。
examples.english_sentence: '倩人捎書' means asking someone to help you deliver a letter.

english_meaning: beautiful silhouette; graceful figure
explanation_mandarin: 指美丽的女子身影。通常形容女子身姿优美、令人印象深刻的影子。
explanation_english: Refers to the beautiful silhouette or figure of a woman. It usually describes a woman's graceful and impressive figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅倩影喺陽光下顯得特別迷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sin6 jing2 hai2 yeung4 gwong1 haa6 hin2 dak1 dak6 bit6 mai4 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的倩影在阳光下显得特别迷人。
examples.english_sentence: Her beautiful silhouette looked especially captivating in the sunlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攝影師捕捉到新娘最美麗嘅倩影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se3 ying2 si1 bo2 zuk1 dou2 san1 noeng2 zeoi3 mei5 lai6 ge3 sin6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摄影师捕捉到了新娘最美丽的倩影。
examples.english_sentence: The photographer captured the bride's most beautiful silhouette.

english_meaning: to glance at; to peek; corner (of the eye)
explanation_mandarin: （書面語）看，斜視；稍微看一下。
explanation_english: (Formal) to look at, to glance at, to peek; to look askance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係倪咗一眼，就知佢唔係好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 ngai4 zo2 jat1 ngaan5, zau6 zi1 keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只瞥了一眼，就知道他不是好人。
examples.english_sentence: I only glanced once, and I knew he wasn't a good person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偷偷地倪人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tau1 tau1 dei2 ngai4 jan4 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要偷偷地看别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't secretly peek at other people.

mandarin_meaning: 类, 等, 轮, 比, 辈
english_meaning: type, category, grade, sequence, order, generation
explanation_mandarin: 类别，等次；轮次，顺序；辈分。
explanation_english: Category, type, grade; sequence, order; generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係同一倫人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 tung4 jat1 leon4 jan4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是同一辈人来的。
examples.english_sentence: They are from the same generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋排住倫嚟做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 paai4 zyu6 leon4 lai4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们排队轮流做。
examples.english_sentence: We take turns doing it in sequence.

english_meaning: ethical relations; proper social order; family relations; morality in human relationships
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间，特别是家庭成员之间的道德关系和秩序，也泛指社会人伦道德。
explanation_english: Refers to the ethical relationships and order between people, especially family members. It also refers to general social ethics and morality in human relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲違反倫常嘅事，俾人鬧到狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 wai4 faan2 leon4 soeng4 ge3 si6, bei2 jan4 nau6 dou3 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了一些违背伦常的事情，被人骂得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: He did something against ethical relations, and he was scolded severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個仔咁樣對待父母，真係違反倫常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zai2 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 doi6 fu6 mou5, zan1 hai6 wai4 faan2 leon4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子这样对待父母，真是违反伦常。
examples.english_sentence: The son treating his parents like that is really against ethical relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲關於倫常嘅觀念，喺唔同文化入面可能會好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gwaan1 jyu1 leon4 soeng4 ge3 gun1 nim6, hai2 m4 tung4 man4 faa3 jap6 min6 ho2 nang4 wui5 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些关于伦常的观念，在不同文化里面可能会很不同。
examples.english_sentence: These concepts about ethical relations may be very different in different cultures.

english_meaning: Lun Jiao Gao (steamed rice cake from Lun Jiao)
explanation_mandarin: 一种用大米磨浆发酵蒸制而成的糕点，原产于广东顺德伦教镇。
explanation_english: A type of steamed rice cake made from fermented rice flour, originating from Lun Jiao Town, Shunde, Guangdong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一底倫敎糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 dai2 leon4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一份伦教糕。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a Lun Jiao Gao.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅倫敎糕做得好彈牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 leon4 gaau1 zou6 dak1 hou2 taan4 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的伦教糕做得很有弹性。
examples.english_sentence: The Lun Jiao Gao from this shop is very springy.

english_meaning: Luncheon Cake; a type of steamed white sugar sponge cake
explanation_mandarin: 一种用米浆发酵蒸制而成的广东传统糕点，口感松软弹牙，味道清甜。
explanation_english: A traditional Cantonese steamed cake made from fermented rice batter. It has a soft, spongy, and slightly chewy texture with a subtly sweet flavor. It's also known as white sugar sponge cake. Legend says it originated from Luncheon, Guangdong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，成日都食倫教糕當下午茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 sik6 leon4 gaau3 dong3 haa6 ng5 caa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，经常吃白糖糕当下午茶。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often had luncheon cake as afternoon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅倫教糕整得好彈牙，好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau4 ge3 leon4 gaau3 zing2 dak1 hou2 taan4 ngaa4, hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的白糖糕做得很有弹性，非常好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: This shop's luncheon cake is very chewy and delicious!

english_meaning: London
explanation_mandarin: 英国的首都和最大的城市。
explanation_english: The capital and largest city of England and the United Kingdom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年想去倫敦旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 leon4 deon1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年想去伦敦旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to London next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 倫敦嘅天氣成日都落雨咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leon4 deon1 ge3 tin1 hei3 seng4 jat6 dou1 lok6 jyu5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伦敦的天气总是下雨似的。
examples.english_sentence: The weather in London is always like it's raining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺倫敦大學畢業嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 leon4 deon1 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是从伦敦大学毕业的。
examples.english_sentence: I graduated from the University of London.

mandarin_meaning: 伦敦金, 杠杆式黄金交易
english_meaning: London Gold, Leveraged Gold Trading
explanation_mandarin: 指一种高杠杆的黄金交易方式，风险较高，通常与欺诈行为有关。
explanation_english: Refers to a high-leverage gold trading method, which carries high risks and is often associated with fraudulent activities. It is a financial product offered by some Hong Kong companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好掂倫敦金啊，好多都係騙局嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dim6 leon4 deon1 gam1 aa3, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 pin3 guk6 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要碰伦敦金，很多都是骗局。
examples.english_sentence: You better not touch London Gold; many of them are scams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資倫敦金輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 leon4 deon1 gam1 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资伦敦金输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money investing in London Gold.

english_meaning: Lun Jiao cake, a type of steamed rice cake
explanation_mandarin: 伦教糕是一种广东顺德伦教镇的传统糕点，以米浆发酵蒸制而成，口感软滑香甜，略带酸味。
explanation_english: Lun Jiao cake is a traditional Cantonese steamed rice cake originating from Lun Jiao town in Shunde, Guangdong. It is made from fermented rice batter and has a soft, smooth, sweet, and slightly sour taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日食倫滘糕，好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 sik6 leon4 gaau3 gou1, hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常吃伦教糕，很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often ate Lun Jiao cake, it was so delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶樓嘅倫滘糕做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 lau4 ge3 leon4 gaau3 gou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 zeng3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶楼的伦教糕做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: The Lun Jiao cake made at this dim sum restaurant is very authentic.

english_meaning: ethics; morality
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间、人与社会之间所应遵守的道德规范和行为准则。
explanation_english: A system of moral principles; the rules of conduct recognized in respect to a particular class of human actions or a particular group or culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員應該遵守專業倫理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 yan4 yun4 ying1 goi1 zeon1 sau2 zyun1 jip6 leon4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医护人员应该遵守专业伦理。
examples.english_sentence: Healthcare professionals should adhere to professional ethics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行為違反咗社會倫理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 wai4 wai4 faan2 zo2 se5 wui2 leon4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行为违反了社会伦理。
examples.english_sentence: This behavior violates social ethics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅倫理觀念好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 leon4 lei5 gun1 nim6 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的伦理观念很不同。
examples.english_sentence: Their ethical values are very different.

english_meaning: short, dwarf; (derogatory, old-fashioned) Japanese
explanation_mandarin: 形容矮小，亦指（旧时蔑称）日本。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as short or dwarfish. Also, a derogatory and old-fashioned term for Japanese people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身材好倭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 choi4 hou2 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身材很矮。
examples.english_sentence: He is very short.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日叫日本人做「日本仔」、「倭寇」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 giu3 jat6 bun2 jan4 zou6 "jat6 bun2 zai2", "wo1 kau3".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人经常叫日本人做“日本仔”，“倭寇”。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people often called Japanese people "Japanese brats" and "Japanese pirates".

english_meaning: naked, bare; bald
explanation_mandarin: 指没有遮盖物，裸露的。在粤语中较少单独使用，多用于复合词。
explanation_english: Refers to being uncovered, naked, or bare. In Cantonese, it's rarely used alone and is more commonly found in compound words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光倮倮咁曬太陽會曬傷嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 lo2 lo2 gam2 saai3 tai3 joeng4 wui5 saai3 soeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光着身子晒太阳会晒伤的。
examples.english_sentence: Sunbathing completely naked can cause sunburn.

english_meaning: to be worth; value; worthy
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有一定的价值或意义; 物有所值。
explanation_english: To be worth a certain amount; to have value; to be worthwhile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書幾值錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 gei2 zik6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很值钱。
examples.english_sentence: This book is very valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工唔值做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 m4 zik6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作不值得做。
examples.english_sentence: This job is not worth doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人都幾值信嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 dou1 gei2 zik6 seon3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人还挺值得信任的。
examples.english_sentence: He is quite trustworthy.

english_meaning: to be on duty, to be on shift
explanation_mandarin: 指按规定的时间担任职务，处理事务。
explanation_english: To be on duty; to be on shift, fulfilling one's responsibilities during a specified time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要值勤，唔可以同你哋去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zik6 kan4, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 dei6 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天值班，不可以和你们去玩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm on duty today, so I can't go out with you guys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班醫生護士日夜值勤，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 baan1 ji1 sang1 wu6 si6 jat6 je6 zik6 kan4, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这群医生护士日夜值班，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This group of doctors and nurses are on duty day and night, it's very tiring.

english_meaning: Worth the ticket price, worth the money, worth the experience
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物（通常是娱乐活动或演出）的质量或体验非常好，使得观众或参与者觉得花的钱是值得的。
explanation_english: Describes something (usually an entertainment event or performance) of very high quality or experience, making the audience or participants feel that the money spent was worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係好睇，值回票價呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2, zik6 wui4 piu3 gaa3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真的很好看，值回票价啊！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really good, it's worth the ticket price!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅舞台效果好震撼，絕對值回票價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 mou5 toi4 haau6 gwo2 hou2 zan3 han6, zyut6 deoi3 zik6 wui4 piu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的舞台效果很震撼，绝对值回票价。
examples.english_sentence: The stage effects of the concert were very impressive, definitely worth the ticket price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然入場費貴咗啲，但係博物館嘅展覽好精彩，都算值回票價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jap6 coeng4 fai3 gwai3 zo2 di1, daan6 hai6 bok3 mat6 gun2 ge3 zin2 laam5 hou2 zing1 coi2, dou1 syun3 zik6 wui4 piu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然门票贵了一点，但是博物馆的展览很精彩，也算值回票价。
examples.english_sentence: Although the admission fee was a bit expensive, the museum's exhibition was excellent, so it was worth the ticket price.

english_meaning: worth, worthwhile, deserving, to be worth
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有某种价值或意义，值得去做或拥有。
explanation_english: To be worthy of; to deserve; to be worth (doing/having). Indicates that something possesses a certain value or significance, making it worthwhile to do or possess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲好值得睇，你一定要去睇啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 hou2 zik1 dak1 tai2, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很值得看，你一定要去看啊！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really worth watching, you definitely have to go see it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗佢，付出幾多都值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 keoi5, fu6 ceot1 gei2 do1 dou1 zik1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了他/她，付出多少都值得。
examples.english_sentence: For him/her, no matter how much I give, it's worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢個投資唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 tau4 zi1 m4 zik1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这个投资不值得。
examples.english_sentence: I don't think this investment is worth it.

english_meaning: on duty (for the day); to be on duty; day duty
explanation_mandarin: 轮流承担一天的工作或任务（通常指在学校或集体单位）。
explanation_english: To be on duty for the day, usually in a school or collective unit, carrying out assigned tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日到我哋班值日啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 baan1 zik1 jat6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天轮到我们班值日了。
examples.english_sentence: It's our class's turn to be on duty today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日值日，記得早啲返嚟開門啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 zik1 jat6, gei3 dak1 zou2 di1 faan1 lai4 hoi1 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天值日，记得早点回来开门啊。
examples.english_sentence: You are on duty tomorrow, remember to come back early to open the door.

english_meaning: Monitor (duty student); student of the day
explanation_mandarin: 学校中负责当天事务的学生，例如擦黑板、维持秩序等。
explanation_english: A student assigned to perform specific duties for the day, such as cleaning the blackboard or maintaining order in the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅值日官要記得抹黑板啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 zik6 jat6 gun1 jiu3 gei3 dak1 mut3 hak1 baan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的值日生要记得擦黑板啊。
examples.english_sentence: The monitor today needs to remember to clean the blackboard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔記得做值日官嘅職責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 zou6 zik6 jat6 gun1 ge3 zik1 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是忘记做值日生的职责。
examples.english_sentence: He always forgets his duties as monitor.

english_meaning: Student on duty, duty student
explanation_mandarin: 指学校里轮流负责教室清洁、维护秩序等工作的学生。
explanation_english: A student who is assigned to be responsible for tasks such as cleaning and maintaining order in the classroom on a rotational basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日到你做值日生，記得抹黑板啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dou3 nei5 zou6 zik6 jat6 sang1, gei3 dak1 mut3 hak1 baan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天轮到你做值日生，记得擦黑板啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's your turn to be the duty student today, remember to wipe the blackboard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，做值日生次次都好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, zou6 zik6 jat6 sang1 ci3 ci3 dou1 hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤奋，每次做值日生都很干净。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and always does a good job when he is the duty student.

english_meaning: check-in (for a flight)
explanation_mandarin: 在机场办理登机手续，领取登机牌。
explanation_english: To check in for a flight at the airport and receive a boarding pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋晏啲去機場值機啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aan3 di1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zik1 gei1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们待会儿去机场办理登机手续吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the airport to check in later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你已經喺網上值咗機未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 ging1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 zik1 zo2 gei1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已经在网上办理登机手续了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you already checked in online?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間航空公司叫我早啲去機場值機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hong4 hung1 gung1 si1 giu3 ngo5 zou2 di1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zik1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 航空公司叫我早点去机场办理登机手续。
examples.english_sentence: The airline asked me to go to the airport earlier to check in.

english_meaning: to be on duty, to work a shift
explanation_mandarin: 指按照排定的班次工作。
explanation_english: To be on duty, to work a shift according to a schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要值班，唔可以同你去街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zik1 baan1, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 heoi3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要值班，不能和你去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work tomorrow, so I can't go shopping with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生成日都要值班，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zik1 baan1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生经常都要值班，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors often have to work shifts; it's very tiring.

english_meaning: committee member; director; person in charge (in a traditional organization, temple, or village)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指在宗族、村落、庙宇等组织中负责管理事务的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person responsible for managing affairs in traditional organizations, villages, temples, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟啲值理好盡責㗎，成日都見到佢哋搞活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 di1 zik6 lei5 hou2 zeon6 zaak3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 gaau2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座庙的理事们很尽责，经常看到他们举办活动。
examples.english_sentence: The committee members of this temple are very responsible; you can often see them organizing activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋村嘅值理開會決定咗今年唔搞花炮會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cyun1 ge3 zik6 lei5 hoi1 wui2 kyut3 ding6 zo2 gam1 nin4 m4 gaau2 faa1 paau3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们村的理事们开会决定了今年不举办花炮会。
examples.english_sentence: The committee members of their village had a meeting and decided not to hold the flower cannon festival this year.

english_meaning: Management committee; board of directors (typically for a traditional organization like a temple or clan association)
explanation_mandarin: 负责管理和运营传统组织（如庙宇、宗亲会）的委员会。
explanation_english: A management committee or board of directors responsible for the administration and operation of a traditional organization, such as a temple or clan association.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟嘅值理會最近換屆，新嘅值理都好有幹勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 ge3 zik6 lei5 wui2 zeoi3 gan6 waan6 gaai3, san1 ge3 zik6 lei5 dou1 hou2 jau5 gon3 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座庙的理事会最近换届了，新的理事们都很有干劲。
examples.english_sentence: The management committee of this temple recently had a change of leadership, and the new members are very energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺係祠堂值理會嘅成員，喺村入面好有地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 hai6 ci4 tong4 zik6 lei5 wui2 ge3 sing4 jyun4, hai2 cyun1 jap6 min6 hou2 jau5 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷是祠堂理事会的成员，在村里很有地位。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather is a member of the ancestral hall's management committee and holds a respected position in the village.

english_meaning: worth renting; worth the rent
explanation_mandarin: 形容某房屋或其他物品的租金是合理的，值得支付。
explanation_english: Describes the rent of a house or other item as reasonable and worth paying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲樓都好貴，但係呢間嘅租金都算值租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 lau2 dou1 hou2 gwai3, daan6 hai6 ni1 gaan1 ge3 zou1 gam1 dou1 syun3 zik6 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的房子都很贵，但是这间的租金还算值得租。
examples.english_sentence: The apartments here are all very expensive, but the rent for this one is considered worth renting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然個位置唔係好方便，但係個租金咁平，都算值租啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 go3 wai6 zi3 m4 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6, daan6 hai6 go3 zou1 gam1 gam3 peng4, dou1 syun3 zik6 zou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然位置不是很方便，但是租金这么便宜，也算值得租了。
examples.english_sentence: Although the location isn't very convenient, the rent is so cheap, it's worth renting.

english_meaning: valuable; precious; worth money; expensive
explanation_mandarin: 指东西有价值，价格高。
explanation_english: Describes something that is valuable, with a high price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻錶好值錢㗎，唔好整爛佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 biu1 hou2 zik6 cin2 gaa3, m4 hou2 zing2 laan6 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表很值钱的，不要弄坏它啊。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is very valuable, don't break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲樓好值錢，想買都買唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 lau2 hou2 zik6 cin2, soeng2 maai5 dou1 maai5 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的房子很值钱，想买也买不起。
examples.english_sentence: Houses are very expensive now, I can't afford to buy one.

english_meaning: to stop, to fall down, to lie down
explanation_mandarin: 停止；倒下；放倒；躺下。
explanation_english: To cease, to stop; to fall down; to lay down; to recline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢地傾到天光都唔偃旗息鼓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 dou3 tin1 gwong1 dou1 m4 jin2 kei4 sik1 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们聊到天亮都没有偃旗息鼓。
examples.english_sentence: They talked until dawn without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偃低瞓陣先啦，咁眼瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 dai1 fan3 zan6 sin1 laa1, gam3 ngaan5 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先躺下睡一会儿吧，这么困。
examples.english_sentence: Lie down and sleep for a while, you look so sleepy.

english_meaning: to cease operations; to beat a retreat; to stop making noise or fuss
explanation_mandarin: 比喻停止行动或活动，不再张扬或制造声势。通常指停止某种活动，不再继续。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to cease operations or activity; to stop making noise or drawing attention; to beat a retreat; to stop continuing with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老細發曬脾氣，佢哋即刻偃旗息鼓，唔敢再講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 lou5 sai3 faat3 saai3 pei4 hei3, keoi5 dei6 zik1 hak1 jin2 kei4 sik1 gu2, m4 gam2 zoi3 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到老板发脾气了，他们立刻偃旗息鼓，不敢再说话了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the boss was angry, they immediately ceased talking and didn't dare say anything more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺經濟唔景嘅時候，好多計劃都偃旗息鼓咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 gai3 waak6 dou1 jin2 kei4 sik1 gu2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在经济不景气的时候，很多计划都停止了。
examples.english_sentence: When the economy was bad, this company stopped many of its plans.

english_meaning: fake, false, artificial, sham, leave (vacation)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 不真实的，不是真的；2. 借用的时间，假期。
explanation_english: 1. Not real, not genuine, artificial; 2. Borrowed time, vacation, leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係假嘅，唔係真㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 gaa2 ge3, m4 hai6 zan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是假的，不是真的。
examples.english_sentence: This is fake, it's not real.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想攞幾日假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 lo2 gei2 jat6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想请几天假。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a few days off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話，全部都係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在说谎，全部都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: He's lying, it's all fake.

english_meaning: hypocritical; feigned benevolence; sanctimonious
explanation_mandarin: 表面上裝作仁義道德，實際上心懷鬼胎。
explanation_english: Pretending to be benevolent and righteous on the surface, but actually harboring ulterior motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度假仁假義，唔好信佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是假仁假义的，不要相信他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being hypocritical, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢咁做只係假仁假義，唔係真心幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 gam2 zou6 zi2 hai6 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6, m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他这样做只是假仁假义，不是真心帮人。
examples.english_sentence: I think what he's doing is just hypocritical, not genuinely helping people.

english_meaning: given time; with time
explanation_mandarin: 给予时间；假若给予时间。
explanation_english: Given enough time; if given time. Implies that something will improve or be accomplished with time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家廣東話講得唔係咁好，但係假以時日，一定會講得好流利嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2, daan6 hai6 gaa2 ji5 si4 jat6, jat1 ding6 wui5 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在粤语说得不是很好，但是假以时日，一定会说得很流利的。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't speak Cantonese very well now, but given time, he will definitely speak it fluently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目而家仲有啲困難，但係假以時日，我哋一定可以完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ji4 gaa1 zung2 jau5 di1 kwan3 naan4, daan6 hai6 gaa2 ji5 si4 jat6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目现在还有些困难，但是假以时日，我们一定可以完成。
examples.english_sentence: This project still has some difficulties, but given time, we will definitely be able to complete it.

english_meaning: if; suppose; in case
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的连词，相当于“如果”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing a hypothesis or condition, similar to "if".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假使聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 si2 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假使你覺得唔舒服，就應該睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 si2 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6, zau6 jing1 goi1 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得不舒服，就应该去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel unwell, you should see a doctor.

english_meaning: if, in case, supposing
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设，相当于“假如”、“如果”。
explanation_english: Expressing a hypothesis, equivalent to "if," "in case," or "supposing."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假使間聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 si2 gaan1 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假如明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假使間你唔舒服，就早啲返屋企休息啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 si2 gaan1 nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6, zau6 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 jau1 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不舒服，就早点回家休息吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not feeling well, go home and rest earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 借用, 冒用, 假冒
english_meaning: to borrow, to make use of under false pretenses, to pass oneself off as, to impersonate, to assume a role
explanation_mandarin: 利用虚假的身份或名义；冒充。
explanation_english: To use a false identity or name; to impersonate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假借公司嘅名義去呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 ze3 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 ji5 heoi3 aak1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假借公司的名义去骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He's using the company's name to scam people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好假借我嘅身份去做壞事呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaa2 ze3 ngo5 ge3 san1 fan2 heoi3 zou6 waai6 si6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要冒充我的身份去做坏事啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't you impersonate me and do bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲騙徒成日假借政府嘅名義嚟呃錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pin3 tou4 sing4 jat6 gaa2 ze3 zing3 fu2 ge3 ming4 ji5 lai4 aak1 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骗子经常冒用政府的名义来骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: Scammers often impersonate the government to swindle money.

mandarin_meaning: 好歹, 至少, 稍微
english_meaning: At least, even if it's just, no matter how little/bad, to some extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示“至少”，“就算……也……”，“无论怎样，哪怕只是一点点”。带有一种退而求其次的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates 'at least', 'even if it's just', 'no matter how little/bad'. It carries a sense of settling for something less than ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假假哋都飲啖水先啦，唔係好易中暑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 yam2 daam6 seoi2 sin1 laa1, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 zung3 syu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 至少也喝口水吧，不然很容易中暑的。
examples.english_sentence: At least drink some water, otherwise you'll easily get heatstroke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢唔係好叻，但係假假哋都讀完大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 duk6 jyun4 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他不是很聪明，但至少也读完了大学。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's not very smart, at least he finished university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你假假哋都幫下手啦，唔好淨係喺度睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你至少也帮下手吧，不要只是在那里看戏。
examples.english_sentence: At least give a hand, don't just stand there watching.

mandarin_meaning: 好歹; 至少; 稍微
english_meaning: At least; even if only a little; to some extent; nominally
explanation_mandarin: 表示“好歹”、“至少”、“哪怕只是稍微”的意思。指即使程度不高，但总比没有好。
explanation_english: Indicates 'at least', 'even if only a little', or 'to some extent'. It suggests that even if the degree isn't high, it's still better than nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假假地都買返份保險，有事都有個保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 maai5 faan1 fan6 bou2 him2, jau5 si6 dou1 jau5 go3 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 至少也买一份保险，有事也有个保障。
examples.english_sentence: At least buy an insurance policy, so there's some protection if something happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假假地都係我阿哥，我都要俾啲面佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 bei2 di1 min6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好歹也是我哥哥，我都要给他点面子。
examples.english_sentence: He's at least my older brother, so I have to give him some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你假假地都讀過大學，點解連咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaa2 gaa2 dei2 dou1 duk6 gwo3 daai6 hok6, dim2 gaai2 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你至少也上过大学，为什么连这么简单的东西都不懂？
examples.english_sentence: You've at least been to university, why don't you understand something so simple?

english_meaning: to use public office for private gain; to feather one's nest; to profit at public expense
explanation_mandarin: 利用公家的名义或职权来谋取私人的利益。
explanation_english: To use one's public position or authority for personal benefit; to exploit public resources for private gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日假公濟私，幫自己啲朋友攞着數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaa2 gung1 zai3 si1, bong1 zi6 gei2 di1 pang4 jau5 lo2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是假公济私，帮自己的朋友捞好处。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses his position for personal gain, helping his friends get advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好假公濟私啊，呢啲資源係公家嘅，唔係你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaa2 gung1 zai3 si1 aa3, ni1 di1 zi1 jyun4 hai6 gung1 gaa1 ge3, m4 hai6 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要假公济私啊，这些资源是公共的，不是你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use public office for private gain, these resources are public, not yours.

english_meaning: to impersonate, to counterfeit, to pass off as genuine, to fake, to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 冒充别人或仿制假的东西来欺骗别人。
explanation_english: To impersonate someone or counterfeit something to deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假冒警察呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 mau6 ging2 caat3 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冒充警察骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He impersonated a police officer to scam people out of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲全部都係假冒名牌嘅貨品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gaa2 mau6 ming4 paai4 ge3 fo3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些全部都是假冒名牌的商品。
examples.english_sentence: These are all counterfeit branded goods.

mandarin_meaning: 冒牌货; 假冒的; 不真实的
english_meaning: imitation; fake; sham; not genuine
explanation_mandarin: 比喻冒牌货、假货，或者指某人或某事名不副实，不真实。
explanation_english: A metaphor for something that is fake, counterfeit, or someone or something that is not what it seems to be; not genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰啲名牌手袋全部都係假分數嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 di1 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gaa2 fan1 sou3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那些名牌手提包全都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: All his branded handbags are fakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘢，佢個人好假分數嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5, keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaa2 fan1 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他这个人很虚伪。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust what he says, he is a very fake person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅評價咁高，但係啲嘢食好難食，根本係假分數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ping3 gaa3 gam3 gou1, daan6 hai6 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 naan4 sik6, gan1 bun2 hai6 gaa2 fan1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的评价这么高，但是食物很难吃，根本是虚有其表。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has such high ratings, but the food is terrible, it's just a sham.

mandarin_meaning: 虚张声势; 假装出力
english_meaning: to feign strength; to pretend to put in effort; to bluff
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上看起来很努力或很有实力，但实际上并没有付出真正的努力或者实力不足。 形容一个人装腔作势，做表面功夫。
explanation_english: Describes someone who pretends to be working hard or have a lot of strength, but in reality, they are not putting in real effort or lack the ability. It describes someone who is putting on a show and doing superficial work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日係度假力，其實咩都冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gaa2 lik6, kei4 sat6 me1 dou1 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在虚张声势，其实什么都没做过。
examples.english_sentence: He's always pretending to work hard, but actually he hasn't done anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺老細面前假力，俾佢睇穿咗就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 gaa2 lik6, bei2 keoi5 tai2 chyun1 zo2 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在老板面前假装努力，被他看穿了就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to put in effort in front of the boss, it's not good if he sees through you.

english_meaning: Alias; pseudonym; assumed name; fictitious name
explanation_mandarin: 不是真名的名字，為了隱藏真實身份而使用的名字。
explanation_english: A name used to conceal one's real identity; a fictitious name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗個假名喺網上發表文章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 go3 gaa2 ming2 hai2 mong5 soeng6 faat3 biu2 man4 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了一个假名字在网上发表文章。
examples.english_sentence: He used an alias to publish articles online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人懷疑佢提供嘅係假名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 yan4 waai4 yi4 keoi5 tai4 gung1 ge3 hai6 gaa2 ming2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察怀疑他提供的名字是假名。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect that the name he provided is an alias.

english_meaning: false ceiling, suspended ceiling
explanation_mandarin: 一种室内装饰，指悬挂在原始天花板下方的第二层天花板，通常用于隐藏电线、管道等，或改善声学效果和美观。
explanation_english: A secondary ceiling, hung below the main (structural) ceiling. It may be installed to hide wiring, ductwork, or to improve acoustics or aesthetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間辦公室裝咗假天花，睇落去靚好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baan6 gung1 sat1 zong1 zo2 gaa2 tin1 faa1, tai2 lok6 heoi3 leng3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个办公室安装了吊顶，看起来漂亮多了。
examples.english_sentence: This office installed a false ceiling, it looks much nicer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝假天花可以遮住啲電線同水管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 gaa2 tin1 faa1 ho2 ji5 ze1 zyu6 di1 din6 sin3 tung4 seoi2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 安装吊顶可以遮住一些电线和水管。
examples.english_sentence: Installing a false ceiling can cover some electrical wires and water pipes.

english_meaning: if, supposing that, in case, provided that
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的情况。与“如果”、“假设”意思相近。
explanation_english: Indicates a hypothetical situation, similar in meaning to "if" or "supposing".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假如聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 jyu4 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假如你有時間，可唔可以幫我手？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 jyu4 nei5 jau5 si4 gaan3, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有时间，可不可以帮我一下？
examples.english_sentence: If you have time, could you give me a hand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假如我中咗六合彩，我會環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 jyu4 ngo5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 caai2, ngo5 wui5 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我中了彩票，我会环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.

english_meaning: to assume; to suppose; assumption; hypothesis
explanation_mandarin: 假设，认定某件事为真，以便进行推论或研究。
explanation_english: To assume something to be true, often as a basis for reasoning or investigation; an assumption or hypothesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋假定佢會嚟開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa2 ding6 keoi5 wui5 lai4 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们假定他会来开会。
examples.english_sentence: We assume that he will come to the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係一個假定，唔一定係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 gaa2 ding6, m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是一个假定，不一定是真的。
examples.english_sentence: This is just an assumption, it's not necessarily true.

mandarin_meaning: 虚伪, 假装, 装模作样
english_meaning: fake, phony, hypocritical, pretending
explanation_mandarin: 形容人虚伪、不真诚，装模作样。类似于“装蒜”。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is fake, insincere, or pretentious. Similar to 'putting on an act' or 'playing dumb'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友咁假尻嘅，唔好信佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau2 gam3 gaa2 hau1 ge3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人太虚伪了，不要相信他啊。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is so fake, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前扮晒嘢，真係好假尻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 baan3 saai3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 gaa2 hau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在老板面前装模作样，真的很虚伪。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act in front of the boss, he's really fake.

english_meaning: false hope, illusion of hope
explanation_mandarin: 指不切实际的，虚假的希望。
explanation_english: Refers to hope that is unrealistic, unfounded, or illusory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾假希望我啦，我都知冇機會㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 gaa2 hei1 mong6 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 zi1 mou5 gei1 wui2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要给我虚假的希望了，我知道没有机会了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give me false hope, I know there's no chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都俾假希望啲病人，其實好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bei2 gaa2 hei1 mong6 di1 beng6 jan2, kei4 sat6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是给病人虚假的希望，其实很不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He always gives patients false hope, which is actually very irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲政客成日都俾假希望市民，但係最後都冇兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zing3 hak1 seng4 jat6 dou1 bei2 gaa2 hei1 mong6 si5 man4, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 deoi3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些政客总是给市民虚假的希望，但是最后都没有兑现。
examples.english_sentence: Those politicians always give the citizens false hope, but in the end, they never fulfill their promises.

english_meaning: imaginary enemy, hypothetical enemy
explanation_mandarin: 想象中的敌人。指没有实际存在的敌人，纯粹出于心理或者战略上的需要而假定出来的敌人。
explanation_english: An imaginary or hypothetical enemy. Refers to an enemy that does not actually exist but is assumed for psychological or strategic purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將同事當做假想敵，咁樣好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 tung4 si6 dong3 zou6 gaa2 soeng2 dik6, gam2 joeng2 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把同事当作假想敌，那样很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat your colleagues as imaginary enemies, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都將自己個假想敵設得好強大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 go3 gaa2 soeng2 dik6 sat3 dak1 hou2 koeng4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是把自己的假想敌设置得很强大。
examples.english_sentence: He always sets his imaginary enemy to be very strong.

english_meaning: hypocritical, feigned, acting insincerely, putting on an act
explanation_mandarin: 形容人虚伪做作，故意装出一副热情或关心的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is being hypocritical and putting on an act, feigning warmth or concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前扮晒嘢，假惺惺咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 baan6 saai3 je5, gaa2 sing1 sing1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前装模作样，假惺惺的。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an act in front of the boss, being so hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁假惺惺啦，你根本就唔關心我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gaa2 sing1 sing1 laa1, nei5 gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 gwaan1 sam1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么假惺惺了，你根本就不关心我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hypocritical, you don't care about me at all.

english_meaning: insincere; feigned; hypocritical; false intention
explanation_mandarin: 指不是真心实意的，做出来的样子。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is not sincere, but rather a pretense or facade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲嘢假意到呢，聽落好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 gaa2 ji3 dou3 ni1, teng1 lok6 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话太假意了，听起来很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was so insincere; it felt uncomfortable to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想接受佢啲假意嘅關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zip3 sau6 keoi5 di1 gaa2 ji3 ge3 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想接受他虚假的关心。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to accept his feigned concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同啲假意嘅人做朋友，會好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 di1 gaa2 ji3 ge3 jan4 zou6 pang4 jau5, wui5 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和虚伪的人交朋友，会很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be friends with insincere people; it'll be tough.

synonyms: 虛情假意 (heoi1 cing4 gaa2 ji3)

english_meaning: To make believe become reality; what started as a game or pretense becomes real
explanation_mandarin: 本来是假的，为了某种目的而装作真的，结果弄到后来却真的发生了。
explanation_english: Originally fake or pretended for a specific purpose, but later it becomes real; what started as acting or a pretense eventually becomes genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍戲拍拍吓，竟然假戲眞做，真係拍拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 hei3 paak3 paak3 haa5, ging2 jin4 gaa2 hei3 zan1 zou6, zan1 hai6 paak3 to1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拍戏拍着拍着，竟然弄假成真，真的谈恋爱了。
examples.english_sentence: They were filming, and then what started as a performance became real; they're actually dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原本我諗住扮下嘢咋嘛，點知佢當真，搞到假戲眞做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 bun2 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 baan6 haa5 je5 zaa3 maa3, dim2 zi1 keoi5 dong3 zan1, gaau2 dou3 gaa2 hei3 zan1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我原本只是想假装一下，没想到他当真了，结果弄假成真。
examples.english_sentence: I originally just intended to pretend, but unexpectedly he took it seriously, and as a result, what was fake became real.

english_meaning: To make a pretense into reality; to take something lightly and end up being serious; to turn make-believe into reality
explanation_mandarin: 原指演戏时演员太过投入，以致分不清戏里戏外，把戏当真。现多比喻本是开玩笑，结果却弄假成真。
explanation_english: Originally referred to actors becoming so immersed in their roles that they couldn't distinguish between the play and reality, taking the play as real. Now it's often used metaphorically to describe a situation where something started as a joke or pretense, but eventually turned into reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最初係為咗扮情侶呃屋企人，點知最後假戲真做，真係拍拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 co1 hai6 wai6 zo2 baan6 cing4 leoi5 ngaak1 uk1 kei2 jan4, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 gaa2 hei3 zan1 zou6, zan1 hai6 paak3 to1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最初是为了假装情侣骗家人，结果最后假戏真做，真的谈恋爱了。
examples.english_sentence: They initially pretended to be a couple to trick their family, but in the end, their pretense turned into reality, and they really started dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來只係講笑話要辭職，點知阿老闆當真咗，噉就假戲真做咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 lai4 zi2 hai6 gong2 siu3 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1, dim2 zi1 aa3 lou5 baan2 dong3 zan1 zo2, gam2 zau6 gaa2 hei3 zan1 zou6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来只是开玩笑说要辞职，结果老板当真了，那就弄假成真了。
examples.english_sentence: Originally, it was just a joke to say I would resign, but the boss took it seriously, so now it's turned from make-believe into reality.

english_meaning: to employ other people to do something; to use someone else's hand; to do something through others
explanation_mandarin: 借助他人的力量或手段来达到自己的目的。
