explanation_english: To achieve one's goal by using the power or methods of others; to delegate or outsource a task to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲粗重嘢，我哋可以假手於人去做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cou1 cung5 je5, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gaa2 sau2 jyu1 jan4 heoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些粗重的工作，我们可以找人来做。
examples.english_sentence: We can get someone else to do these heavy tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果件事太複雜，我寧願假手於人，費事自己搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gin6 si6 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, ngo5 ning4 jyun2 gaa2 sau2 jyu1 jan4, fai3 si6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果事情太复杂，我宁愿交给别人去做，免得我自己搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: If the matter is too complicated, I would rather delegate it to someone else, so I don't mess it up myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆鍾意假手於人，自己就歎世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zung1 ji3 gaa2 sau2 jyu1 jan4, zi6 gei2 zau6 taan3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板喜欢把事情交给别人做，自己就享受生活。
examples.english_sentence: The boss likes to delegate tasks and enjoy life himself.

english_meaning: to borrow (a name, title, etc.) falsely; to use as a pretext; to feign; to impersonate; to falsely claim
explanation_mandarin: 假借、冒用别人的名义或称号，用来掩盖自己的真实意图或行为。
explanation_english: To falsely borrow or claim someone else's name, title, or authority to conceal one's true intentions or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假托公司嘅名義去呃錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 tok3 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 ji5 heoi3 aak1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假托公司的名义去骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: He fraudulently used the company's name to swindle money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲騙徒成日假托政府人員嚟行騙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pin3 tou4 seng4 jat6 gaa2 tok3 zing3 fu2 jan4 jyun4 lai4 haang4 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骗子经常假冒政府人员来进行诈骗。
examples.english_sentence: Scammers often impersonate government officials to commit fraud.

english_meaning: to pretend; to masquerade; to disguise oneself
explanation_mandarin: 伪装成另一种身份或状态。
explanation_english: To pretend to be someone or something else, often to deceive or entertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假扮醫生呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 baan6 ji1 sang1 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假扮医生骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be a doctor to cheat people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日假扮超人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 gaa2 baan6 ciu1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子经常假扮超人。
examples.english_sentence: Kids often pretend to be Superman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好假扮無知啦，你明明知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaa2 baan6 mou4 zi1 laa1, nei5 ming4 ming4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要假装无知了，你明明知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be ignorant, you clearly know what happened.

english_meaning: holiday, day off
explanation_mandarin: 休息日；非工作日。
explanation_english: A day of rest or recreation; a day off from work or school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日放假日呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3 jat6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天放假啦！
examples.english_sentence: We have a holiday tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你假日通常會做啲乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaa3 jat6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 zou6 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你假日通常会做些什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What do you usually do on holidays?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想假日去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gaa3 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想假日去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel during the holidays.

mandarin_meaning: 假日司机 (jià rì sī jī)
english_meaning: Weekend driver
explanation_mandarin: 指平时不常开车，只在周末或节假日开车的司机。
explanation_english: Refers to a driver who doesn't drive regularly, only driving on weekends or holidays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸車唔叻，只係個假日司機啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 m4 lek1, zi2 hai6 go3 gaa3 jat6 si1 gei1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开车技术不太好，只是个假日司机而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's not very good at driving, he's just a weekend driver.

english_meaning: holiday; vacation
explanation_mandarin: 指一段不用工作或上学的休息时间。
explanation_english: A period of time when one is not required to work or attend school; a vacation or holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜有個禮拜嘅假期，去旅行好唔好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 go3 lai5 baai3 ge3 gaa3 kei4, heoi3 leoi5 hang4 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个星期有一个星期的假期，去旅行好不好啊？
examples.english_sentence: We have a week's holiday next week, how about going travelling?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今年有幾多日假期啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 nin4 jau5 gei2 do1 jat6 gaa3 kei4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今年有多少天假期啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many days of vacation do you have this year?

english_meaning: Hypocritical, fake, pretentious, putting on airs
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人虚伪做作，不真诚，喜欢装模作样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is hypocritical, insincere, and pretentious, liking to put on airs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好假柳㗎，你唔好信佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaa2 lau5 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很虚伪的，你不要相信他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very hypocritical person, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁假柳啦，做返自己咪好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaa2 lau5 laa1, zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 mai1 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么虚伪啦，做回自己不是很好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pretentious, just be yourself, isn't that better?

english_meaning: false teeth, dentures
explanation_mandarin: 人造牙齿，用于替代缺失的天然牙齿。
explanation_english: Artificial teeth used to replace missing natural teeth; dentures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆啲假牙甩咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 di1 gaa2 ngaa4 lat1 zo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶的假牙掉了出来。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma's dentures fell out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢笑嗰陣會露出佢嘅假牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu3 go2 zan6 wui5 lou6 ceot1 keoi5 ge3 gaa2 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他笑的时候会露出他的假牙。
examples.english_sentence: He shows his dentures when he smiles.

mandarin_meaning: 冒牌货; 假冒者; 不正经的人
english_meaning: fake; impostor; insincere person
explanation_mandarin: 指虚假、冒牌的东西或人。 也指不真诚、虚伪的人。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone that is fake or counterfeit. Also refers to a person who is insincere or hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好假狗，你小心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gaa2 gau2, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人很虚伪，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very insincere person, be careful around him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲名牌嘅假狗周街都係，真係要睇清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ming4 paai4 ge3 gaa2 gau2 zau1 gaai1 dou1 hai6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些名牌的假货到处都是，真要看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Fake versions of these brand names are everywhere, you really have to look carefully.

english_meaning: artificial rockery; fake person (insincere, lacking genuine feelings)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 用人工堆叠成的假山。 2. 比喻虚伪、不真心的人。
explanation_english: 1. Literally refers to an artificial rockery, often found in gardens. 2. Figuratively describes a person who is fake, insincere, and lacks genuine emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似假石山咁，永遠都唔知佢諗緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 gaa2 sek6 saan1 gam2, wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 gan2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人好像假山一样，永远都不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: That person is like an artificial rockery; you never know what they are thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園整咗個好靚嘅假石山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun2 zing2 zo2 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 gaa2 sek6 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园建造了一个很漂亮的假山。
examples.english_sentence: This garden has built a beautiful artificial rockery.

english_meaning: Fake document; forged paper; bogus document
explanation_mandarin: 指伪造的、虚假的证明文件，例如病假单、成绩单、身份证明等。
explanation_english: Refers to a fake or forged document, such as a sick leave certificate, transcript, identity document, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想返工，所以買咗張假紙請病假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 faan1 gung1, so2 ji5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 gaa2 zi2 ceng2 beng6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想上班，所以买了一张假病假单请病假。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to go to work, so he bought a fake sick leave certificate to take sick leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為可以靠假紙呃到我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 kaau3 gaa2 zi2 aak1 dou2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为可以靠假文件骗到我们。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can fool us with fake documents.

synonyms: 偽造文件 (ngai6 zou6 man4 gin2)

english_meaning: falsetto, false voice
explanation_mandarin: 唱歌时用的一种高于正常音域的发声方法，声音比较高亢但不够自然。
explanation_english: A vocal register occupying the frequency range just above the modal voice register and overlapping with it by approximately one octave. Produced by the vibration of the ligaments in the vocal folds rather than the entire folds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌嗰陣成日用假聲，聽落好唔自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 ge2 zan6 seng4 jat6 yung6 gaa2 seng1, teng1 lok6 hou2 m4 zi6 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌的时候总是用假声，听起来很不自然。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses falsetto when he sings, it sounds very unnatural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲男歌手嘅假聲唱得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 naam4 go1 sau2 ge3 gaa2 seng1 coeng3 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些男歌手的假声唱得很好听。
examples.english_sentence: Some male singers sing very beautifully in falsetto.

english_meaning: insincere; feigning politeness; pretending to be humble or helpful; false modesty
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人虚伪客气，并非真心实意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is insincerely polite or humble, not genuinely meaning what they say or do. It implies a pretense of being helpful or modest when the underlying motivation is often self-serving or simply going through the motions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁假膊啦，我哋自己搞得掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 gaa2 bok3 laa1, ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么假客气了，我们自己能搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so insincerely polite, we can handle it ourselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都扮晒好幫得手咁，其實都係假膊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 baan3 saai3 hou2 bong1 dak1 sau2 gam2, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 gaa2 bok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装作很能帮忙的样子，其实都是假客气。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be so helpful, but it's all insincere.

mandarin_meaning: 故意捣乱的人, 假装幽默的人
english_meaning: Someone who intentionally trolls or acts silly, pretending to be funny (but often annoying)
explanation_mandarin: 指那些故意捣乱、开玩笑或说一些很无聊的事情的人，通常是为了引起注意或者让人觉得好笑，但实际上往往让人觉得很烦。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who intentionally trolls, jokes around, or says pointless things, usually to get attention or be funny, but often ends up being annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做假膠啦，好悶呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 gaa2 gaau1 laa1, hou2 mun6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再故意捣乱了，很无聊啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stop trolling, it's so boring!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上扮假膠，博人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng5 baan6 gaa2 gaau1, bok3 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在网上装作假胶，博取别人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts like a troll online to get attention.

english_meaning: if; supposing that; in case
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的连词，相当于“假如”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing a hypothetical situation, equivalent to "if; supposing that".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假若聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 joek6 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假如明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假若你有時間，不如幫我做啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 joek6 nei5 jau5 si4 gaan3, bat1 jyu4 bong1 ngo5 zou6 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假如你有时间，不如帮我做点事吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you have time, why don't you help me with some things?

english_meaning: to pretend; to feign; to simulate
explanation_mandarin: 裝出某種樣子，不是真實的。
explanation_english: To assume a particular appearance or behavior, often to deceive or mislead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假裝唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 zong1 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他假装不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended not to know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度假裝可憐啦，冇用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gaa2 zong1 ho2 lin4 laa1, mou5 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里假装可怜了，没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be pitiful here, it's useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我面前假裝好開心，但係我知道佢唔係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 gaa2 zong1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 m4 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我面前假装很开心，但是我知道他不是真的。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be very happy in front of me, but I know he wasn't genuine.

english_meaning: to suppose; to presume; to assume; hypothesis; supposition
explanation_mandarin: 提出一个前提或条件，以供推理或讨论。
explanation_english: To put forward a premise or condition for reasoning or discussion; a hypothesis or supposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假設我中咗六合彩，我會買間大屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa2 sat1 ngo5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, ngo5 wui5 maai5 gaan1 daai6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假设我中了彩票，我会买一栋大房子。
examples.english_sentence: Assuming I win the lottery, I will buy a big house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假設唔成立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa2 sat1 m4 sing4 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假设不成立。
examples.english_sentence: This assumption is not valid.

english_meaning: lie, falsehood, untruth
explanation_mandarin: 不真实的话，与事实不符的话。
explanation_english: A statement that is not true; a statement that contradicts the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講假話，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 gaa2 waa6, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说假话，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells lies, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅係假話，我唔會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 hai6 gaa2 waa6, ngo5 m4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的都是假话，我不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying are lies, I won't believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講假話，要誠實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 gaa2 waa6, jiu3 sing4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说假话，要诚实。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell lies, be honest.

english_meaning: hypothesis
explanation_mandarin: 一种为了解释某些现象而提出的、未经证实的理论或推测。
explanation_english: A proposed explanation for a phenomenon made as a starting point for further investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出咗個新嘅假說嚟解釋呢個現象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 gaa2 syut3 lai4 gaai2 sik1 ni1 go3 hin3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出了一个新的假设来解释这个现象。
examples.english_sentence: He proposed a new hypothesis to explain this phenomenon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要驗證呢個假說嘅真確性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jim6 zing3 ni1 go3 gaa2 syut3 ge3 zan1 kok3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要验证这个假设的真实性。
examples.english_sentence: We need to verify the validity of this hypothesis.

english_meaning: hypothesis, conjecture, assumption
explanation_mandarin: 根据已知事实对事物规律性的一种推测性说明。
explanation_english: A tentative explanation for an observation, phenomenon, or scientific problem that can be tested by further investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假說睇嚟幾合理噉喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa2 syut3 tai2 lai4 gei2 ho2 lei5 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假设看起来挺合理的。
examples.english_sentence: This hypothesis seems quite reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要更多數據去驗證呢個假說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 so3 geoi3 heoi3 jim6 zing3 ni1 go3 gaa2 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多数据去验证这个假设。
examples.english_sentence: We need more data to verify this hypothesis.

english_meaning: hypothesis
explanation_mandarin: 一种尚未经过验证的解释或理论，作为进一步研究的基础。
explanation_english: A proposed explanation or theory that is yet to be proven, used as a basis for further investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家提出咗好多假説去解釋呢個現象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 tai4 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa2 syut3 heoi3 gaai2 sik1 ni1 go3 hin3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家提出了很多假设来解释这个现象。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists have proposed many hypotheses to explain this phenomenon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要更多數據嚟驗證呢個假説。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 sou3 geoi3 lai4 jim6 zing3 ni1 go3 gaa2 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多数据来验证这个假设。
examples.english_sentence: We need more data to verify this hypothesis.

english_meaning: illusion, false appearance, facade
explanation_mandarin: 虚假的表象，不是真实的情况。
explanation_english: A false appearance or impression; something that is not what it seems to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係表面嘅假象，實際上佢哋好窮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 biu2 min6 ge3 gaa2 zoeng6, sat6 zai3 soeng6 keoi5 dei6 hou2 pung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是表面的假象，实际上他们很穷的。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a facade; in reality, they are very poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾眼前嘅假象蒙蔽咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 gaa2 zoeng6 mung4 bai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被眼前的假象蒙蔽了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be blinded by the illusion before your eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇穿佢哋製造嘅假象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 cyun1 keoi5 dei6 zai3 zou6 ge3 gaa2 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要看穿他们制造的假象。
examples.english_sentence: We must see through the illusion they created.

english_meaning: fake goods; counterfeit goods; imitation
explanation_mandarin: 指仿造的，冒充正品的商品。
explanation_english: Refers to goods that are fake, counterfeit, or imitations of genuine products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲名牌手袋好多都係假貨嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi2 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaa2 fo3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些名牌手提包很多都是假货。
examples.english_sentence: Many of these designer handbags are fake goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好喺啲唔可靠嘅網站買嘢，好容易買到假貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 hai2 di1 m4 ho2 kao3 ge3 mong5 zaam6 maai5 je5, hou2 jung4 ji6 maai5 dou3 gaa2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要在那些不可靠的网站买东西，很容易买到假货。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy things from unreliable websites, it's easy to buy fake goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間舖頭專賣假貨，唔好幫襯呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zyun1 maai6 gaa2 fo3, m4 hou2 bong1 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的店专门卖假货，别光顾啊！
examples.english_sentence: His shop specializes in selling fake goods, don't patronize it!

english_meaning: Extremely fake; so fake it's unbelievable; more fake than selling cats (implies deception)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人极其虚假，虚假程度超出常理，甚至带有欺骗性质。 "賣貓"在过去指一些不道德的商人会用其他动物冒充猫来出售，以此欺骗顾客。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being extremely fake, to the point of being unbelievable and deceptive. "Selling cats" refers to the unethical practice of some merchants in the past who would try to pass off other animals as cats to deceive customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲嘢全部都係假貨嚟㗎，假過賣貓！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gaa2 fo3 lai4 gaa3, gaa2 gwo3 maai6 maau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的东西全部都是假货，假的太离谱了！
examples.english_sentence: All of his stuff is fake, ridiculously fake!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢假過賣貓，一句都唔可以信啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gaa2 gwo3 maai6 maau1, jat1 geoi3 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话假的离谱，一句都不能相信。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is so fake, you can't believe a word of it.

english_meaning: parole
explanation_mandarin: 指被判刑的罪犯，经过一定时间的服刑后，因表现良好，经监狱机关报请法院裁定，提前有条件地释放。
explanation_english: The release of a prisoner temporarily (for a special purpose) or permanently before the completion of a sentence, on the promise of good behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為喺監獄表現良好，所以獲得假釋出獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 hai2 gaam1 juk6 biu2 hin3 loeng4 hou2, so2 ji5 wok6 dak1 gaa2 sik1 ceot1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为在监狱表现良好，所以获得假释出狱。
examples.english_sentence: He was released on parole due to his good behavior in prison.

english_meaning: Mask; facade; pretense
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是面具，引申为伪装的外表或虚假的人格。
explanation_english: Literally means mask. Figuratively refers to a false appearance or a fake persona used to hide one's true feelings or intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日戴住個假面具做人，睇唔透佢嘅真心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 go3 gaa2 min6 geoi2 zou6 jan4, tai2 m4 tau3 keoi5 ge3 zan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是戴着假面具做人，看不透他的真心。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears a mask when dealing with people, and it's impossible to see his true feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上，好多人都會戴住個假面具，保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 daai3 zyu6 go3 gaa2 min6 geoi2, bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上，很多人都会戴着假面具，保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, many people wear a mask to protect themselves.

english_meaning: falsetto
explanation_mandarin: 指演唱时发出的比正常音域高的声音，通常是男歌手用的一种发声技巧。
explanation_english: Falsetto refers to a vocal register occupying the frequency range just above the modal voice register and overlapping with it considerably. It is produced by men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌成日用假音，好鬼特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 seng4 jat6 yung6 gaa2 jam1, hou2 gwai2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌总是用假声，非常特别。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses falsetto when singing, which is very special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅假音好靚，好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaa2 jam1 hou2 leng3, hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的假声很好听，很难得。
examples.english_sentence: His falsetto is beautiful, it's rare.

english_meaning: wig; false hair
explanation_mandarin: 指用人造或动物毛发制成的，用来覆盖或修饰头发的假发。
explanation_english: A wig or false hair, made of synthetic or animal hair, used to cover or decorate the hair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶咗個假頭髮去派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 go3 gaa2 tau4 faat3 heoi3 paai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴了一顶假发去派对。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a wig to the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假頭髮望落好真咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa2 tau4 faat3 mong6 lok6 hou2 zan1 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假发看起来很逼真。
examples.english_sentence: This wig looks very realistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗個新嘅假頭髮，想變下造型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 gaa2 tau4 faat3, soeng2 bin3 haa5 zou6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她买了一顶新的假发，想换个造型。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a new wig to change her hairstyle.

english_meaning: wig
explanation_mandarin: 用人造的或天然的头发制成的帽子，戴在头上以改变发型或掩盖秃顶。
explanation_english: An artificial covering of hair for the head, used to alter one's appearance or conceal baldness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗遮住個光頭，成日都戴假髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ze1 zyu6 go3 gwong1 tau4, seng4 jat6 dou1 daai3 gaa2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了遮住光头，他总是戴假发。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears a wig to cover his bald head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個明星成日喺舞台上面戴假髮表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 ming4 sing1 seng4 jat6 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 min6 daai3 gaa2 faat3 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个明星经常在舞台上戴假发表演。
examples.english_sentence: That celebrity often wears a wig to perform on stage.

english_meaning: Artificial fish maw; Fake fish maw; Used to describe something of inferior quality passed off as something better
explanation_mandarin: 指用其他材料（如合成材料或劣质鱼类）制成的，冒充高级鱼肚的产品。 也常用来比喻以次充好，冒牌货。
explanation_english: Refers to a product made from other materials (such as synthetic materials or inferior fish) that is being sold as high-quality fish maw. Often used metaphorically to describe something of inferior quality passed off as something better; a fake or imitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅魚肚羹啲魚肚好似假魚肚咁，完全冇魚味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 ting1 ge3 jyu4 tou5 gang1 di1 jyu4 tou5 hou2 ci5 gaa2 jyu4 tou5 gam2, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jyu4 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的鱼肚羹，里面的鱼肚好像是假的，完全没有鱼的味道。
examples.english_sentence: The fish maw in this restaurant's fish maw soup seems like fake fish maw, it has no fish taste at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係名牌手袋，但係睇落去似假魚肚咁，啲手工好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi2, daan6 hai6 tai2 lok6 heoi3 ci5 gaa2 jyu4 tou5 gam2, di1 sau2 gung1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她的是名牌手提包，但是看起来像假的，做工很差。
examples.english_sentence: She said her handbag is a designer brand, but it looks like fake fish maw, the craftsmanship is very poor.

english_meaning: fake, false, phony, not genuine
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物是假的，不真实的，或者某人是虚伪的。程度比“假”更强烈，带有轻蔑的意味。
explanation_english: Describes something as fake, false, or not genuine. It carries a stronger connotation than just '假' (gaa2), often implying contempt or disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲假鳩嘢你都信？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaa2 gau1 je5 nei5 dou1 seon3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些假货你都信？
examples.english_sentence: You believe in this fake stuff?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好假鳩㗎，千祈唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaa2 gau1 gaa3, cin1 cai4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很虚伪，千万不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: That person is very phony, never trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 表面吃素；假装清高；虚伪
english_meaning: To pretend to be vegetarian; hypocritical; feigning piety
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上做出吃素的样子，实际上并没有真正遵守素食的规定；比喻虚伪、装模作样。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who pretends to be vegetarian but doesn't actually adhere to the rules of vegetarianism; metaphorically describes someone who is hypocritical or putting on airs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好環保，但係出街又亂咁掉垃圾，真係假齋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 waan4 bou2, daan6 hai6 chut1 gaai1 jau6 lyun6 gam2 diu1 laap1 saap3, zan1 hai6 gaa2 zaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说自己很环保，但是出门又乱扔垃圾，真是假装清高。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's very environmentally friendly, but then he litters when he goes out. He's really just pretending to be virtuous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢份人好假齋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 ye5, keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gaa2 zaai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他这个人很虚伪的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's a very hypocritical person.

english_meaning: to chat, to talk
explanation_mandarin: 指闲谈，聊天，通常指比较随意的谈话。
explanation_english: Refers to casual chatting or talking, usually in a relaxed manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋得閒出嚟傾下偈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dak1 haan4 cheut1 lai4 king1 ha5 gai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有空出来聊聊天吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's chat when we are free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度傾緊偈，唔好騷擾佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 king1 gan2 gai2, m4 hou2 sou1 jiu2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在聊天，不要打扰他们。
examples.english_sentence: They are chatting, don't disturb them.

english_meaning: Engine oil
explanation_mandarin: 指用于内燃机润滑的油品，以减少摩擦、冷却引擎、清洁和防腐。
explanation_english: Engine oil, also known as motor oil, is used for lubricating internal combustion engines. It reduces friction, cools the engine, cleans, and protects against corrosion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部車要換偈油喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ce1 jiu3 wun6 gai2 jau4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的车需要换机油了。
examples.english_sentence: My car needs an oil change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔換偈油，搞到部車好快壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 wun6 gai2 jau4, gaau2 dou3 bou6 ce1 hou2 faai3 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不换机油，搞得车很快就坏了。
examples.english_sentence: He never changes the engine oil, which is why the car breaks down so quickly.

english_meaning: great; grand; mighty; eminent
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物具有非常出色的品质或成就，令人敬佩。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something possessing exceptionally outstanding qualities or achievements that command respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好偉大嘅科學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 wai5 daai6 ge3 fo1 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很伟大的科学家。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very great scientist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程真係好偉大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai5 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程真的很伟大。
examples.english_sentence: This project is really great.

english_meaning: Great person; great figure; eminent person
explanation_mandarin: 指在历史上做出巨大贡献，具有崇高品德和伟大功绩的人物。
explanation_english: A person who has made significant contributions to history and possesses noble virtues and great achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毛澤東喺中國歷史上係一個好重要嘅偉人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maau4 zaak6 dung1 hai2 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 soeng6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 wai5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毛泽东在中国历史上是一个非常重要的伟人。
examples.english_sentence: Mao Zedong is a very important great person in Chinese history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望自己第日可以成為一個對社會有貢獻嘅偉人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 zi6 gei2 dai6 jat6 ho2 ji5 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 deoi3 se5 wui2 jau5 gung3 hiun3 ge3 wai5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望自己将来可以成为一个对社会有贡献的伟人。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes that he can become a great person who contributes to society in the future.

english_meaning: Viagra
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于治疗男性勃起功能障碍的药物，其通用名为西地那非。
explanation_english: A medication, generically known as sildenafil, used to treat erectile dysfunction in men. 'Viagra' is the brand name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想買啲偉哥嚟試吓，睇吓係咪真係咁有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 maai5 di1 wai5 go1 lai4 si3 haa5, tai2 haa5 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 gam3 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想买一些伟哥来试试，看看是不是真的那么有效。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to buy some Viagra to try and see if it's really that effective.

english_meaning: great; mighty; grand
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物在规模、意义或影响力上非常巨大、杰出。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very large, outstanding, or influential in scale, meaning, or impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅貢獻對社會好偉大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung3 hiun3 deoi3 se5 wui2 hou2 wai5 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的贡献对社会非常伟大。
examples.english_sentence: His contribution to society is very great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毛澤東係一個好有爭議性但係好偉大嘅人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 zaak6 dung1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 zang1 yi5 sing3 daan6 hai6 hou2 wai5 daai6 ge3 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毛泽东是一个很有争议性但是很伟大的人物。
examples.english_sentence: Mao Zedong is a very controversial but great figure.

english_meaning: brilliant idea; profound discourse; insightful opinion (often used ironically)
explanation_mandarin: 指高明的见解、精辟的理论。有时也用于讽刺，指自以为是的言论。
explanation_english: Refers to brilliant ideas and insightful theories. It can also be used ironically to describe someone's self-righteous or pompous remarks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽你講嘅偉論，真係獲益良多啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 nei5 gong2 ge3 wai5 leon6, zan1 hai6 wok6 yik1 loeng4 do1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听了你的高论，真是获益良多啊！
examples.english_sentence: Listening to your brilliant ideas, I've really benefited a lot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再發表你啲偉論啦，冇人想聽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 faat3 biu2 nei5 di1 wai5 leon6 laa1, mou5 jan4 soeng2 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再发表你的高论了，没人想听的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop expressing your profound opinions, no one wants to listen.

english_meaning: so; such; so much; so great
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、数量等，相当于“这么”、“那么”。
explanation_english: Indicates degree or quantity, equivalent to 'so', 'such', or 'that much'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偌大嘅地方都搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 daai6 ge3 dei6 fong1 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么大的地方都找不到他。
examples.english_sentence: I can't find him even in such a big place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解要用偌多錢買呢樣嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 yung6 joek6 do1 cin2 maai5 ni1 yeung2 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么要用这么多钱买这个东西？
examples.english_sentence: Why did you spend so much money on this?

english_meaning: so big, so large, such a large
explanation_mandarin: 形容面积或体积非常大。
explanation_english: Describes an area or volume that is very large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偌大嘅花園，淨係得佢一個喺度打理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 daai6 ge3 faa1 jyun2, zing6 hai6 dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 hai2 dou6 daa2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么大的花园，只有他一个人在打理。
examples.english_sentence: Such a large garden, only he is managing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多錢，唔好隨便拎去投資，偌大個數目，蝕咗就弊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 cin2, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 ling1 heoi3 tau4 zi1, joek6 daai6 go3 sou3 muk6, sit3 zo2 zau6 bai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么多钱，不要随便拿去投资，这么大的数目，亏了就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: So much money, don't casually invest it. Such a large amount, it would be terrible if you lost it.

english_meaning: to snuggle; to cuddle; to lean on; to nestle; to be close to
explanation_mandarin: 指身体靠拢，表示亲近、依赖。
explanation_english: To lean against or snuggle up to someone or something, indicating closeness, affection, or dependence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔鍾意偎住阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 zung1 ji3 wai1 zyu6 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩喜欢依偎着妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: This child likes to snuggle with his/her mom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到偎埋我度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 dou3 wai1 maai4 ngo5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得紧紧地靠着我。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he snuggled close to me.

english_meaning: deliberately; intentionally; to lean; to incline; partial; biased; contrary to expectation
explanation_mandarin: 1. 表示故意、偏要、与愿望或常理相反：他偏不听我的话。2. 表示方向倾斜：这根柱子有点偏。3. 表示偏向一方，不公正：他太偏心了。
explanation_english: 1. Indicates deliberate action, going against expectations or common sense: He deliberately doesn't listen to me. 2. Indicates a deviation or inclination: This pillar is a bit skewed. 3. Indicates bias or partiality: He is too biased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫佢唔好咁做，佢偏要咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, keoi5 pin1 jiu3 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我让他别这么做，他偏要这么做。
examples.english_sentence: I told him not to do that, but he insisted on doing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽對細佬仔偏心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 deoi3 sai3 lou2 zai2 pin1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈对小儿子偏心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Mum is a bit biased towards the younger son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋企好似偏咗一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 kei2 hou2 ci5 pin1 zo2 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子好像偏向一边了。
examples.english_sentence: This house seems to be leaning to one side.

english_meaning: deliberately; contrary to expectations; against one's will; unfortunately; on the contrary; precisely because
explanation_mandarin: 表示事與願違，不符合預期，有出乎意料之外的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that things go against one's wishes, contrary to expectations, with the implication of being unexpected or deliberate opposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕住出門口，偏偏落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 ceot1 mun4 hau2, pin1 pin1 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶着出门，偏偏下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: I was rushing to go out, but it rained heavily instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽我講，偏偏要自己試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2, pin1 pin1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听我的话，偏偏要自己试。
examples.english_sentence: He wouldn't listen to me and insisted on trying it himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋諗住去沙灘，偏偏打風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 saa1 taan1, pin1 pin1 daa2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们计划去沙滩，偏偏刮台风。
examples.english_sentence: We were planning to go to the beach, but a typhoon struck instead.

english_meaning: remote; out-of-the-way; secluded; isolated
explanation_mandarin: 指地理位置远离城镇、交通不便，人口稀少的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a place geographically far from towns, with inconvenient transportation, and a sparse population.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條村好偏僻，搭車要搭成三個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 cyun1 hou2 pin1 pik1, daap3 ce1 jiu3 daap3 seng4 saam1 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个村子很偏僻，坐车要坐三个小时。
examples.english_sentence: That village is very remote; it takes three hours by bus to get there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意住喺咁偏僻嘅地方，乜都唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 zyu6 hai2 gam3 pin1 pik1 ge3 dei6 fong1, mat1 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢住在这么偏僻的地方，什么都不方便。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like living in such a remote place; nothing is convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方太偏僻啦，連電話信號都收唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 taai3 pin1 pik1 laa1, lin4 din6 waa2 seon3 hou6 dou1 sau1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方太偏僻了，连电话信号都收不到。
examples.english_sentence: This place is too remote, you can't even get a phone signal.

english_meaning: to favour; to be biased towards; to lean towards; tendency
explanation_mandarin: 指对一方有所偏袒，或者倾向于某种观点、事物等。
explanation_english: To favor, be biased towards, or have a tendency towards something or someone. It can also mean to lean towards a particular viewpoint or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細好偏向佢，咩好嘢都益晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 hou2 pin1 hoeng3 keoi5, me1 hou2 je5 dou1 jik1 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板很偏袒他，什么好东西都给他了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is very biased towards him, he gives all the good stuff to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我偏向呢個計劃，因為佢比較實際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pin1 hoeng3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, jan1 wai6 keoi5 bei2 gaau3 sat6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我倾向于这个计划，因为它比较实际。
examples.english_sentence: I lean towards this plan because it's more practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個有啲偏向保守嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jau5 di1 pin1 hoeng3 bou2 sau2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个有些倾向保守的想法。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them have some tendency towards conservative ideas.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, biased, dogmatic, paranoid
explanation_mandarin: 固执己见，听不进别人的意见。
explanation_english: Being stubborn and clinging to one's own opinion, unwilling to listen to others' views.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好偏執，根本聽唔入人哋講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 pin1 zap1, gan1 bun2 teng1 m4 jap6 jan4 dei6 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很偏执，根本听不进别人说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stubborn person and can't listen to what others say at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁偏執啦，試吓接受其他人嘅意見吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 pin1 zap1 laa1, si3 haa5 zip3 sau6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么偏执啦，试着接受其他人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, try to accept other people's opinions.

synonyms: 死牛一面頸 (sei2 ngau4 jat1 min6 geng2)

english_meaning: deviation; error; bias
explanation_mandarin: 偏离标准或预期值的情况。
explanation_english: The act of deviating from a standard or expected value; an error or bias.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅實驗結果同預期嘅有啲偏差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 sat1 jim6 git3 gwo2 tung4 jyu6 kei4 ge3 jau5 di1 pin1差caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次实验的结果和预期的有点偏差。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this experiment have some deviation from what was expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅報告帶有個人嘅偏差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 bou3 gou3 daai3 jau5 go3 jan4 ge3 pin1差caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告带有个人偏差。
examples.english_sentence: His report has personal bias.

english_meaning: to be biased; to favor; to side with
explanation_mandarin: 指不公正地支持或偏袒某一方。
explanation_english: To unfairly support or favour one side over another; to show bias.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好偏幫細佬呀，佢今次真係唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 pin1 bong1 sai3 lou2 aa3, keoi5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要偏袒弟弟啊，他这次真的不对。
examples.english_sentence: Don't favour your younger brother, he's really in the wrong this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都偏幫家姐，我咩都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 pin1 bong1 gaa1 je1, ngo5 me1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是偏袒姐姐，我什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: Mum always favours my older sister, I get nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官唔可以偏幫任何一方，一定要公正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 m4 ho2 ji5 pin1 bong1 jam6 ho4 jat1 fong1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gung1 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官不可以偏袒任何一方，一定要公正。
examples.english_sentence: A judge cannot favor any party, they must be impartial.

english_meaning: biased, partial, to favor
explanation_mandarin: 指对一方有偏袒或偏爱的行为或态度。
explanation_english: To show bias or favoritism towards one person or thing over another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽對細佬偏心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 deoi3 sai3 lou2 pin1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈对弟弟偏心一些。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is a little biased towards my younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偏心，要公平啲噉對待每個小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 pin1 sam1, jiu3 gung1 ping4 di1 gam2 deoi3 dai6 mui5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要偏心，要更公平地对待每个小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be biased; treat each child more fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得老師對佢偏心，成日讚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 lou5 si1 deoi3 keoi5 pin1 sam1, seng4 jat6 zaan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得老师对他偏心，总是称赞他。
examples.english_sentence: I think the teacher is biased towards him, always praising him.

english_meaning: to favor, to be partial to, to have a preference for
explanation_mandarin: 特别喜爱，对一方有所偏向。
explanation_english: To have a special fondness or preference for something or someone; to show partiality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好偏愛細佬，咩都俾佢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 pin1 oi3 sai3 lou2, me1 dou1 bei2 keoi5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很偏爱弟弟，什么都先给他。
examples.english_sentence: Mom favors my younger brother a lot, always giving him things first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對粵菜偏愛啲，覺得佢哋嘅味道更加啱我口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 jyut6 coi3 pin1 oi3 di1, gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mei6 dou6 gang3 gaa1 ngaam1 ngo5 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对粤菜偏爱一些，觉得它们的味道更适合我的口味。
examples.english_sentence: I have a slight preference for Cantonese cuisine, I feel their flavors suit my taste better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偏愛黑色嘅衫，衣櫃入邊全部都係黑色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pin1 oi3 hak1 sik1 ge3 saam1, ji1 gwai6 jap6 bin1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 hak1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她偏爱黑色的衣服，衣柜里面全部都是黑色的。
examples.english_sentence: She has a preference for black clothes, her wardrobe is all black.

english_meaning: folk remedy; unorthodox treatment; unproven cure
explanation_mandarin: 指未经官方认可或科学验证，主要在民间流传的药方或治疗方法。
explanation_english: Refers to a folk remedy or treatment method that is not officially recognized or scientifically proven and is mainly circulated among the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆話呢個係個偏方，對醫咳嗽幾有效㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 waa6 ni1 go3 hai6 go3 pin1 fong1, deoi3 yi1 hau3 sau3 gei2 jau5 haau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶说这是个偏方，对治疗咳嗽挺有效的。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother said this is a folk remedy, and it's quite effective for treating coughs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁試偏方呀，有病都係要睇醫生嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 si3 pin1 fong1 aa3, jau5 beng6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 tai2 yi1 sang1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱试偏方啊，有病还是要看医生的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly try folk remedies, you still need to see a doctor if you are sick.

english_meaning: radical (of a Chinese character)
explanation_mandarin: 汉字中构成字的一部分，通常用来表示字义或字音的类别，例如“木”字旁、“氵”字旁等。
explanation_english: A component part of a Chinese character, usually indicating the meaning or pronunciation category of the character. For example, the "木" radical or the "氵" radical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「語」字嘅偏旁係「言」字邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 zi6 ge3 pin1 pong4 hai6 「jin4」 zi6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “语”字的偏旁是“言”字旁。
examples.english_sentence: The radical of the character "語" is the "言" radical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學寫中文字，首先要認得啲偏旁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 se2 zung1 man4 zi6, sau2 sin1 jiu3 jing6 dak1 di1 pin1 pong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学写中文字，首先要认识一些偏旁。
examples.english_sentence: When learning to write Chinese characters, you first need to recognize some radicals.

english_meaning: extreme, radical, biased, extremist
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的思想、观点或行为过于极端，不客观，缺乏理性的判断。
explanation_english: Describing a person's thoughts, views, or actions as being too extreme, not objective, and lacking rational judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好偏激，成日講啲嘢都好離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 pin1 gik1, seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 je5 dou1 hou2 lei4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很偏激，经常说一些很不靠谱的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very extreme person and often says outrageous things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁偏激啦，嘗試理解下其他人嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 pin1 gik1 laa1, soeng4 si3 lei5 gaai2 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么偏激啦，尝试理解一下其他人的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so extreme, try to understand other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信曬佢講嘅嘢，佢好偏激㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 hou2 pin1 gik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要全信他说的话，他很偏激的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe everything he says, he's very extreme.

english_meaning: partiality, bias, favouritism
explanation_mandarin: 指不公正地对待不同的人或事，对一方有所偏袒。
explanation_english: Describes unfair treatment towards different people or things, showing favouritism towards one side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對細佬偏私啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sai3 lou2 pin1 si1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对弟弟偏袒一些。
examples.english_sentence: He is a bit partial to his younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個判決好偏私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 pun3 kyut3 hou2 pin1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个判决很偏袒。
examples.english_sentence: This verdict is very biased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔應該偏私任何一個員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 ying1 goi1 pin1 si1 jam6 ho4 jat1 go3 waan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不应该偏袒任何一个员工。
examples.english_sentence: The boss shouldn't show favouritism to any one employee.

english_meaning: to be biased; to favor; to show partiality
explanation_mandarin: 指不公正地对待，向一方倾斜。
explanation_english: To unfairly favor one side or party over another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁偏袒細佬啦，佢做錯嘢都要罰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 pin1 taan2 sai3 lou2 laa1, keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 dou1 jiu3 fat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么偏袒弟弟了，他做错事也要惩罚的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so biased towards your younger brother. He needs to be punished if he does something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir好偏袒啲靚女，有乜著數都預佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 hou2 pin1 taan2 di1 leng3 neoi2, jau5 mat1 zoek3 sou3 dou1 jyu6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师很偏袒那些美女，有什么好处都先想到她们。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is very biased towards the pretty girls. They always get the benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得球證偏袒主場球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 kau4 zing3 pin1 taan2 zyu2 coeng4 kau4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得裁判偏袒主场球队。

examples.english_sentence: His behavior reflects his prejudice against women.

english_meaning: somewhat soft; leaning towards weakness; inclined to be yielding/compliant

explanation_english: Describes a character or way of handling things that is not very assertive or tough, with a tendency towards weakness or compliance.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他处理事情的手法比较软弱，没有什么魄力。
examples.english_sentence: His approach to handling matters is rather soft, lacking decisiveness.

english_meaning: remote; faraway; out-of-the-way
explanation_mandarin: 指距离中心区域或主要城市较远，交通不便，经济文化发展相对滞后的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a place that is far from the central area or major cities, inconvenient to access, and relatively underdeveloped economically and culturally.

examples.english_sentence: Educational resources are very scarce in these remote areas.

english_meaning: to overemphasize; to favor; to be biased towards
explanation_mandarin: 侧重于某一方面，不公平地重视某物。
explanation_english: To emphasize one aspect more than others; to give more weight to something unfairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校偏重學術成績，其他方面就唔係咁重視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 pin1 zung6 hok6 seot6 sing4 zik1, kei4 taa1 fong1 min6 zau6 m4 hai6 gam2 zung6 si6.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 bou3 gou3 pin1 zung6 lei5 leon6, kyut3 fat6 sat6 zai3 ying3 yung6.

examples.english_sentence: His report emphasizes theory too much, lacking practical application.

mandarin_meaning: 旁门左道, 非正当途径

explanation_mandarin: 指不正当的途径、方法或行业，通常带有负面含义。也指通过非主流或不正规的渠道。
explanation_english: Refers to unconventional or unorthodox methods, pathways, or businesses, often with negative connotations. It also refers to going through non-mainstream or irregular channels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠做偏門嘢發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zou6 pin1 mun4 je5 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠做不正当的生意发财。
examples.english_sentence: He made a fortune by doing shady business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住行偏門呀，腳踏實地先至係正路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 haang4 pin1 mun4 aa3, goek3 daat3 sat6 dei6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zeng3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着走旁门左道，脚踏实地才是正道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about taking unconventional ways; being down-to-earth is the right path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好似有啲偏門嘢做緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 pin1 mun4 je5 zou6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司好像在做一些不正当的事情。
examples.english_sentence: This company seems to be doing something shady.

english_meaning: deviate, diverge, stray, depart from
explanation_mandarin: 离开原定的轨道或方向，走向不同的方向。
explanation_english: To depart from an established course, direction, or standard; to diverge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機偏離咗航道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 pin1 lei4 zo2 hong4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机偏离了航道。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane deviated from its course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅意見開始偏離咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 hoi1 chi2 pin1 lei4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的意见开始偏离了。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions started to diverge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好偏離主題啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: chin1 kai4 m4 hou2 pin1 lei4 zyu2 tai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要偏离主题啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't stray from the subject!

english_meaning: biased, partial, one-sided
explanation_mandarin: 指不公正、不客观，倾向于一方的观点或态度。
explanation_english: Describes being unfair, not objective, leaning towards one side's view or attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個報告好偏頗，淨係講好嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou3 gou3 hou2 pin1 po2, zing6 hai6 gong2 hou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告很偏颇，只说好的方面。
examples.english_sentence: This report is very biased, only talking about the good things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好偏頗，唔可以信曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 pin1 po2, m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很偏颇，不能完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is very biased, you can't believe it completely.

english_meaning: migraine; one-sided headache
explanation_mandarin: 指头部一侧或主要在一侧发生的搏动性头痛，常伴有恶心、呕吐、畏光等症状。
explanation_english: Refers to a throbbing headache that occurs on one side of the head, often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都偏頭痛，痛到想嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 pin1 tau4 tung3, tung3 dou3 seung2 au2.

examples.english_sentence: I often have migraines, and they're so painful that I feel like throwing up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢琴日偏頭痛發作，所以冇返工。

examples.english_sentence: He said he had a migraine yesterday, so he didn't go to work.

english_meaning: picky eating; faddish diet; selective eating
explanation_mandarin: 指对食物有选择性，只吃某些食物，不吃其他食物。
explanation_english: Refers to being picky about food, only eating certain foods and refusing to eat others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好偏食，淨係食薯條同炸雞。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩很挑食，只吃薯条和炸鸡。
examples.english_sentence: That child is a very picky eater, only eating fries and fried chicken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁偏食啦，要食多啲唔同嘅嘢先至夠營養㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 pin1 sik6 laa1, jiu3 sik6 do1 di1 m4 tung4 ge3 ye5 sin1 zi3 gau3 wing4 yeung5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么挑食了，要多吃一些不同的东西才有足够的营养。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't be so picky, you need to eat more different things to get enough nutrition.

english_meaning: together, jointly, along with
explanation_mandarin: 表示共同，一起的意思，通常用于书面语。
explanation_english: Indicates together, jointly, usually used in formal written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定偕手合作，創一番事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 haai4 sau2 hap6 zok3, cong3 jat1 faan1 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定携手合作，创造一番事业。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to work together to build a career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋偕老好唔好？

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们白头偕老好不好？
examples.english_sentence: How about we grow old together?

english_meaning: together with, along with, in company with, to accompany
explanation_mandarin: 表示一起，一同，通常用于较为正式的场合，指陪同或与某人一起做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates being together, usually used in more formal situations, referring to accompanying or doing something together with someone.

examples.english_sentence: He attended the banquet together with his wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅經理會偕同啲員工去參觀工廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 ging1 lei5 wui5 haai4 tung4 di1 wun4 gung1 heoi3 caam1 gun1 gung1 cong2.

examples.english_sentence: Our company's manager will visit the factory with the employees.

english_meaning: to do, to make, to produce, to become, to act as
explanation_mandarin: 表示进行某种动作或行为，也指制作、成为等。
explanation_english: Indicates performing an action or behavior; also refers to making, becoming, etc.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开了一家新公司。
examples.english_sentence: They started a new company.

english_meaning: to have a facial (beauty treatment)
explanation_mandarin: 指的是进行面部美容护理，包括清洁、按摩、敷面膜等步骤。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of having a facial beauty treatment, including steps like cleansing, massaging, and applying a face mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日放假，想去做個facial relax下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 fong3 gaa3, soeng2 heoi3 zou6 go3 facial relax haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天放假，想去做个美容护理放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: I'm off work today, I want to go get a facial to relax.

examples.english_sentence: She goes for a facial every month to maintain her skin.

english_meaning: to work out, to go to the gym
explanation_mandarin: 指进行健身活动，通常在健身房进行。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in physical fitness activities, typically in a gym.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai1 zou6 saam1 ci3 gym1 gaa3.

explanation_english: To perform work in a laboratory, including experiments and research.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 leb1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都要做实验，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: They have to do lab work every day, it's very tiring.

english_meaning: to put on a show; to act; to perform for appearances; to grandstand
explanation_mandarin: 指为了给别人看，故意表演或装模作样，以博取关注或达到某种目的。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately performing or acting in a showy manner to impress others, gain attention, or achieve a specific goal. Often implies insincerity or a focus on appearances.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 zou6 sau2, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在老板面前作秀，想升职呗。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁做show啦，我知你唔係真心幫佢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么作秀了，我知道你不是真心帮他。
examples.english_sentence: Stop putting on a show, I know you're not really helping him sincerely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政客成日做show，講一套做一套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 hak1 sing4 jat6 zou6 sau2, gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政客整天作秀，说一套做一套。
examples.english_sentence: This politician is always grandstanding, saying one thing and doing another.

english_meaning: Conducting the seventh-day memorial service (for the deceased)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教和道教的一种丧葬习俗，指人死后每七天举行一次祭祀仪式，一共七次，共四十九天，祈求逝者安息。
explanation_english: A Buddhist and Taoist funeral custom. It refers to holding a memorial service every seven days after a person's death, for a total of seven times (49 days). It is done to pray for the peace of the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆啱啱走咗，屋企人要幫佢做七。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 zo2, uk1 kei2 jan4 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 zou6 cat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶刚去世了，家里人要帮她做七七。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma just passed away, the family has to conduct the seventh-day memorial services for her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋忙住幫阿爺做七，冇時間嚟玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mong4 zyu6 bong1 aa3 je4 zou6 cat1, mou5 si4 gaan3 lai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们忙着给爷爷做七，没时间来玩。
examples.english_sentence: They are busy conducting the seventh-day memorial services for grandpa, they don't have time to come and play.

mandarin_meaning: 瞎搞, 胡闹, 乱来
english_meaning: To mess things up, to create chaos, to act recklessly, to cause trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指制造混乱，搞砸事情，或行为鲁莽导致不良后果。
explanation_english: Refers to creating chaos, messing things up, or acting recklessly leading to negative consequences. It implies a lack of responsibility and disregard for the consequences of one's actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再做世界啦，搞到成件事咁麻煩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zou6 sai3 gaai3 laa1, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 gam3 maa4 faan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再胡闹了，弄得整件事这么麻烦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess things up again, you've made the whole thing so troublesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔成日做世界，搞到阿媽好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 seng4 jat6 zou6 sai3 gaai3, gaau2 dou3 aa3 maa1 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩子整天胡闹，搞得妈妈很头痛。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is always causing trouble, making his mom have a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔認真做嘢，淨係識做世界，遲早俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 jing6 zan1 zou6 je5, zing6 hai6 sik1 zou6 sai3 gaai3, ci4 zou2 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你再不认真工作，只会胡闹，迟早会被炒鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't start working seriously and just keep messing around, you'll be fired sooner or later.

english_meaning: to decide; to make a decision; to be in charge; to take responsibility; to call the shots
explanation_mandarin: 表示有权决定或负责某事；可以指替别人做决定，也可以指自己有权决定。
explanation_english: Indicates having the authority to decide or be responsible for something. Can refer to making a decision for someone else or having the right to make one's own decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢話曬事，佢做主嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 waa6 saai3 si6, keoi5 zou6 zyu2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事他说了算，他做主的。
examples.english_sentence: He has the final say on this matter; he's the one who decides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好幫佢哋做主，等佢哋自己傾掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bong1 keoi5 dei6 zou6 zyu2, dang2 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 king1 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要帮他们做主，让他们自己谈妥吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions for them, let them sort it out themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以幫你做主，畀多你兩個星期考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zou6 zyu2, bei2 do1 nei5 loeng5 go3 sing1 kei4 haau2 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以为你做主，多给你两个星期考虑。
examples.english_sentence: I can make the decision for you to give you two more weeks to consider.

english_meaning: What are you doing?; Why?
explanation_mandarin: “做乜”在粤语中表示“做什么”的意思，也可以引申为“为什么”。 具体语境下，意思会略有不同。通常表达疑问。
explanation_english: "做乜" in Cantonese means "What are you doing?" or "Why?". The specific meaning depends on the context. It usually expresses a question or inquiry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度做乜呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 mat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里做什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔返工，做乜呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1, zou6 mat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不来上班，为什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why isn't he coming to work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜咁唔開心呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 gam3 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么这么不开心啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so unhappy?

english_meaning: What are you doing?
explanation_mandarin: 询问对方正在做的事情。也常用于表达惊讶或质疑。
explanation_english: Used to ask what someone is doing. Can also be used to express surprise or questioning what someone is doing and why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度做乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都唔做嘢，淨係喺度做乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5, zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 zou6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整天都不工作，只在这里做什么？
examples.english_sentence: You don't work all day, what are you just doing here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你攞住把刀做乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lo2 zyu6 baa2 dou1 zou6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿着把刀做什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing with that knife?

english_meaning: to work; to do things; to handle matters; to get things done
explanation_mandarin: 指进行工作或处理事务。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of working or handling affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，好識做事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, hou2 sik1 zou6 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤奋，很会做事。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and knows how to do things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做事嘅時候要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 si6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事的时候要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: You should be more careful when you are working/doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭讚佢做事做得好快手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 zaan3 keoi5 zou6 si6 zou6 dak1 hou2 faai3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板称赞他做事做得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The boss praised him for doing things quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 为人, 做人, 生活, 处世
english_meaning: To be a person; to conduct oneself; to live; to deal with people and situations; one's conduct; to live one's life.
explanation_mandarin: 既可以指作为一个人而存在，也可以指为人处世的态度和行为。可以指生活，也可以指做人的原则。
explanation_english: Can refer to existing as a person or to one's attitude and behavior in dealing with people and situations. It can refer to life or to the principles of being a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人最緊要開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人最重要的是开心。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in life is to be happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好成功，好多朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 sing4 gung1, hou2 do1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很成功，有很多朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is successful in the way he conducts himself, and he has many friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要有良心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 loeng4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要有良心。
examples.english_sentence: One should have a conscience in life.

english_meaning: To suffer hardships in life; to have a difficult life; to endure hardship
explanation_mandarin: 指生活过得很辛苦，遭受许多磨难，艰难地度日。
explanation_english: Refers to living a difficult and challenging life, enduring many hardships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就冇咗父母，一個人喺街邊乞食，真係做人世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 mou5 zo2 fu6 mou5, jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 gaai1 bin1 hat1 sik6, zan1 hai6 zou6 jan4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就失去了父母，一个人在街边乞讨，真是受苦受罪。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his parents when he was young and begged for food on the streets alone. He really suffers a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，唔捱得，做少少嘢就嗌曬救命，同以前啲人比，唔算做人世啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, m4 ngaai4 dak1, zou6 siu2 siu2 je5 zau6 aai3 saai3 gau3 ming6, tung4 ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 bei2, m4 syun3 zou6 jan4 sai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人们，吃不了苦，做一点点事情就喊救命，和以前的人比，不算受苦受罪啦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays young people can't handle hardship. They complain about doing a little work. Compared to the people of the past, they are not really suffering.

english_meaning: to do a favour (for someone); to give face; to be obliging
explanation_mandarin: 指为了维护关系或者为将来得到好处而给予别人帮助或者方便。通常指帮助并非完全出于真心，而是带有目的性。
explanation_english: To do a favour for someone, usually with the expectation of reciprocation or to maintain a good relationship. It implies an act that's not entirely selfless and may have ulterior motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次幫佢係做人情啫，第時有事佢都會幫返我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bong1 keoi5 hai6 zou6 jan4 cing4 ze1, dai6 si4 jau5 si6 keoi5 dou1 wui5 bong1 faan1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次帮他只是卖个人情，以后有事他也会帮我的。
examples.english_sentence: Helping him this time is just doing him a favour, he will help me in return when I need it in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭成日都做人情，啲下屬咪更加肯幫佢賣命囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 sing4 jat6 dou1 zou6 jan4 cing4, di1 haa6 suk6 mai1 gang3 gaa1 hang2 bong1 keoi5 maai6 ming6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 领导总是卖人情，那些下属不就更愿意为他卖命了吗？
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always doing favours for people, so the subordinates are even more willing to work hard for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你搞掂件事，唔係因為想做人情，而係真係想幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6, m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 soeng2 zou6 jan4 cing4, ji4 hai6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你搞定这件事，不是因为想卖人情，而是真的想帮你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm helping you with this, not because I want to do you a favour, but because I genuinely want to help you.

english_meaning: to accompany, to keep company, to be a companion
explanation_mandarin: 陪伴，一起做事或生活。
explanation_english: To accompany someone, to do something or live together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你得閒嘅話，可唔可以陪我做伴去睇醫生啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak1 haan4 ge3 waa2, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 pui4 ngo5 zou6 bun6 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有空的话，可不可以陪我作伴去看医生啊？
examples.english_sentence: If you are free, can you accompany me to see the doctor?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆一個人住喺度，好悶，佢需要有人做伴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6 hai2 dou6, hou2 mun6, keoi5 seoi1 jiu3 jau5 jan4 zou6 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶一个人住在这里，很闷，她需要有人作伴。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma lives here alone, she's very bored, she needs someone to keep her company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我養咗隻狗仔做伴，咁就唔會咁寂寞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joeng5 zo2 zek3 gau2 zai2 zou6 bun6, gam2 zau6 m4 wui2 gam3 zik6 mok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我养了一条小狗作伴，这样就不会那么寂寞了。
examples.english_sentence: I raised a puppy to keep me company, so I won't be so lonely.

english_meaning: to eliminate, to get rid of, to kill (someone, especially in a violent way)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指通过暴力或不正当手段解决某人或某事，使其不再构成威胁或障碍。
explanation_english: Usually refers to eliminating someone or something through violence or unethical means, so that they no longer pose a threat or obstacle. Often implies an act of aggression or foul play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住做低佢，等佢冇機會再出嚟搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naam2 zyu6 zou6 dai1 keoi5, dang2 keoi5 mou5 gei1 wui6 zoi3 ceot1 lai4 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想着干掉他，让他没有机会再出来搞事。
examples.english_sentence: They're planning to eliminate him so he won't have a chance to cause trouble again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆想做低競爭對手，用咗好多唔正當嘅手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 soeng2 zou6 dai1 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2, yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 zeng3 dong3 ge3 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板想干掉竞争对手，用了许多不正当的手段。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wanted to eliminate the competitor and used many unfair tactics.

english_meaning: affected; artificial; pretentious; unnatural; contrived
explanation_mandarin: 指言语、行为等不自然，故意装腔作势。
explanation_english: Describes speech, behavior, etc. that is unnatural, deliberately affected, or pretentious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好做作，聽落好唔自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 zou6 zok3, teng1 lok6 hou2 m4 zi6 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说话很做作，听起来很不自然。
examples.english_sentence: She speaks very affectedly, it sounds very unnatural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁做作啦，你真啲自然啲好睇好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zou6 zok3 laa1, nei5 zan1 dik1 zi6 jin1 di1 hou2 tai2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么做作了，你真实一点自然一点好看多了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so affected, you look much better being genuine and natural.

english_meaning: to fake; to fabricate; to cheat; to commit fraud
explanation_mandarin: 指制造虚假的事物或行为，欺骗他人。
explanation_english: To create something false or to act in a deceptive way; to cheat or defraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做假，老老實實咁做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gaa2, lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6 gam2 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要作假，老老实实地工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fake it, just work honestly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試做假俾人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 zou6 gaa2 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊被人抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught cheating in the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅賬目做假，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zoeng3 muk6 zou6 gaa2, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的账目作假，迟早会出事的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is falsifying its accounts, something bad will happen sooner or later.

english_meaning: to falsify accounts, to cook the books, to manipulate figures
explanation_mandarin: 指在财务账目上作假，捏造虚假数据，以达到欺骗或掩盖真实情况的目的。
explanation_english: To falsify financial records, fabricate data, and manipulate figures in accounts with the intent to deceive or conceal the true financial situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司俾人發現做假數，搞到股價大跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 zou6 gaa2 sou3, gaau2 dou3 gu2 gaa3 daai6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司被人发现做假账，导致股价大跌。
examples.english_sentence: Their company was discovered to be falsifying accounts, causing the stock price to plummet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住做假數可以瞞天過海，始終會俾人發現㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 zou6 gaa2 sou3 ho2 ji5 mun4 tin1 gwo3 hoi2, ci2 chung1 wui5 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为做假账可以瞒天过海，最终会被人发现的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get away with falsifying accounts; you'll eventually get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為做假數俾廉政公署調查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 zou6 gaa2 sou3 bei2 lim4 zing3 gung1 syu2 diu6 caa4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司因为做假账正在被廉政公署调查。
examples.english_sentence: The company is under investigation by the ICAC (Independent Commission Against Corruption) for falsifying accounts.

english_meaning: To mark up the price; to manipulate the price (of stocks or other assets); market making
explanation_mandarin: 指故意抬高价格，或在证券市场中进行做市活动，以影响市场价格。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of deliberately inflating prices, or engaging in market making activities in the securities market to influence market prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋夾埋嚟做價，呃啲散戶入局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaap3 maai4 lai4 zou6 gaa3, aak1 di1 saan2 wu6 jap6 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们合伙抬价，骗散户入局。
examples.english_sentence: They colluded to manipulate the price, tricking retail investors into joining the game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻股票俾人做價做到好高，風險好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 bei2 jan4 zou6 gaa3 zou6 dou3 hou2 gou1, fung1 him2 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支股票被人为抬价抬得很高，风险很大。
examples.english_sentence: This stock has been marked up artificially to a very high level, the risk is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 證監會會嚴厲打擊做價嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 gam1 wui2 wui5 jim4 lai6 daa2 gik1 zou6 gaa3 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 证监会会严厉打击抬价的行为。
examples.english_sentence: The Securities and Futures Commission will severely crack down on the practice of price manipulation.

english_meaning: Winter Solstice Festival celebration
explanation_mandarin: 指庆祝冬至的节日。 冬至是中国传统节日，家人会聚在一起吃饭庆祝。
explanation_english: Refers to celebrating the Winter Solstice Festival. The Winter Solstice is a traditional Chinese festival where families gather to eat and celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋屋企人會一齊做冬，食餐豐富嘅團圓飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jan4 wui5 jat1 cai4 zou6 dung1, sik6 caan1 fung1 fu3 ge3 tyun4 jyun4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们家人会一起过冬至，吃一顿丰盛的团圆饭。
examples.english_sentence: This year, our family will celebrate the Winter Solstice together and have a big reunion dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做冬一定要食湯圓，寓意一家團圓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 dung1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sik6 tong1 jyun4, jyu3 ji3 jat1 gaa1 tyun4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过冬至一定要吃汤圆，寓意一家团圆。
examples.english_sentence: We must eat tangyuan during the Winter Solstice, symbolizing family reunion.

english_meaning: to put on a show; to do things superficially; to go through the motions; to create a facade
explanation_mandarin: 指做事情只做表面功夫，不注重实际效果，给人看的样子，虚张声势。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things superficially, only focusing on appearances and not caring about the actual effectiveness or results. It implies putting on a show or creating a facade for others to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都淨係做出面，實際上咩都冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zing6 hai6 zou1 ceot1 min6, sat6 zeoi3 so2 mai1 dou1 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是只做表面功夫，实际上什么也没做过。
examples.english_sentence: He always just puts on a show, but in reality, he hasn't done anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係做出面，要實際解決問題先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zou1 ceot1 min6, jiu3 sat6 zai3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是做表面功夫，要实际解决问题才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just put on a show, you need to actually solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆最憎人做出面，最緊要係做到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zeoi3 zang1 jan4 zou1 ceot1 min6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zou6 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板最讨厌人做表面功夫，最重要的是把事情做好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss hates people who only put on a show; the most important thing is to get the job done.

english_meaning: able to do; able to achieve; able to accomplish; to be capable of; to manage to do
explanation_mandarin: 表示有能力或方法去完成某件事情。可以指能力上的可以，也可以指經過努力後成功完成。
explanation_english: Indicates the ability or means to accomplish something. Can refer to the ability to do something, or to successfully completing something through effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係做到㗎？我唔係好信喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 zou6 dou2 gaa3? ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 seon3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真的能做到吗？我不太相信。
examples.english_sentence: Can you really do it? I don't really believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚一定要做到呢份功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 dou2 ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚一定要完成这份作业。
examples.english_sentence: I must finish this homework tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力，一定做到佢嘅目標嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nou5 lik6, jat1 ding6 zou6 dou2 keoi5 ge3 muk6 biu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，一定能实现他的目标。
examples.english_sentence: He is so hardworking, he will definitely achieve his goal.

english_meaning: To be so tired from working that you're breathless; to be exhausted from work
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作非常劳累，累到喘不过气来。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely tired from work, to the point of being out of breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排做到氣咳，都冇時間瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 zou6 dou3 hei3 kat1, dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作累到我喘不过气，都没时间睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I've been so exhausted from work lately that I haven't even had time to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日搬屋搬到氣咳，全身都痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 bun1 uk1 bun1 dou3 hei3 kat1, cyun4 san1 dou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天搬家累到气喘，全身都疼。
examples.english_sentence: I was so exhausted from moving house yesterday that my whole body aches.

english_meaning: Extremely exhausted from overwork; to be worked to the bone; to be completely worn out (like a sandal/clog)
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常疲惫，累得像鞋子一样。因为鞋子经常被穿着走来走去，所以用来比喻人过度劳累。
explanation_english: This phrase describes a state of extreme exhaustion, comparing the person's condition to that of a sandal or clog which is constantly being worn and walked in, thus worn out. It implies being overworked and extremely tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排日日都做到隻屐咁，真係想瞓多陣都冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 jat6 jat6 dou1 zou6 dou3 zek3 gek6 gam2, zan1 hai6 soeng2 fan3 do1 zan6 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近每天都累得像只鞋子一样，真是想多睡一会儿都没时间。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working like a dog lately, I don't even have time to sleep a bit longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份報告，做到隻屐咁，連飯都冇時間食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3, zou6 dou3 zek3 gek6 gam2, lin4 faan6 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了那份报告，他累得像只鞋子一样，连饭都没时间吃。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of that report, he's been working his tail off, he doesn't even have time to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 非常忙碌、累得像只鞋一样
english_meaning: Extremely busy, overworked to the point of exhaustion (literally: working like a clog)
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常忙碌，疲惫不堪，像一只木屐一样被不断踩踏、磨损。
