explanation_english: Describes being extremely busy and exhausted, as if constantly being stepped on and worn out like a wooden clog (a type of sandal). The 'gam2' adds emphasis to the degree of busyness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排我做到隻屐噉，日日都OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 ngo5 zou6 dou3 zek3 gek6 gam2, jat1 jat1 dou1 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我忙得像只鞋一样，每天都在加班。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working like a clog lately, working overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老闆好衰，成日叫佢做到隻屐噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 baan2 hou2 seoi1, seng4 jat6 giu3 keoi5 zou6 dou3 zek3 gek6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的老板很坏，总是让他忙得像只鞋一样。
examples.english_sentence: His boss is terrible, always making him work like a clog.

english_meaning: To be exhausted from working like a donkey/mule; to be overworked to the point of extreme fatigue.
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作非常辛苦，累得筋疲力尽，像一头不停拉磨的驴子一样。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is extremely tired from working very hard, comparing them to a donkey/mule that tirelessly grinds grain, indicating extreme exhaustion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排忙到死，日日做到隻積咁，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 mong4 dou3 sei2, jat1 jat1 zou6 dou3 zek3 zik1 gam2, zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近忙死了，每天都累得像驴一样，真的受不了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so busy lately, I'm working like a donkey every day, I really can't take it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工咁辛苦，日頭做到隻積咁，夜晚仲要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, jat1 tau3 zou6 dou3 zek3 zik1 gam2, je6 maan5 zung6 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作那么辛苦，白天累得像驴一样，晚上还要加班。
examples.english_sentence: His job is so tiring, he works like a donkey during the day and still has to work overtime at night.

english_meaning: To be worked like a beast of burden/like a donkey
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作非常辛苦，像动物一样劳累。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely tired and overworked, to the point of feeling like an animal of burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排做到隻積噉，日日都OT到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 zou6 dou3 zek3 zik1 gam2, jat1 jat1 dou1 OT dou3 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近工作累得像只驴一样，每天都加班到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working like a donkey lately, doing overtime until very late every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾公司搾到隻積噉呀，要識得保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 gung1 si1 zaak3 dou3 zek3 zik1 gam2 aa3, jiu3 sik1 dak1 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让公司把你榨取得像只驴一样，要懂得保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let the company exploit you like a donkey, you need to know how to protect yourself.

synonyms: 做到死死下 (zou6 dou3 sei2 sei2 haa5)

english_meaning: to do homework; to do research; to prepare (for something)
explanation_mandarin: 指完成学校布置的作业；也指事前进行调查研究，做好准备。
explanation_english: Refers to completing school assignments; also refers to conducting prior research and preparation for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要留喺屋企做功課啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 gung1 fo3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要留在家里做作业啊。
examples.english_sentence: I have to stay home and do my homework tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買股票之前，你要做啲功課先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 gu2 piu3 zi1 cin4, nei5 jiu3 zou6 di1 gung1 fo3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买股票之前，你得先做些功课。
examples.english_sentence: Before buying stocks, you have to do some research first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋開會之前，每個人都要做定功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2 zi1 cin4, mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jiu3 zou6 ding6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们开会之前，每个人都要做好准备。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting, everyone needs to prepare beforehand.

english_meaning: to put on an act, to make a show of strength, to posture, to feign, to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做出某种姿态或行为，以给人留下深刻印象或达到某种目的。
explanation_english: To deliberately adopt a certain posture or behavior to create an impression or achieve a specific goal. Often implies insincerity or exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度做勢，扮晒好叻噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 dou6 zou6 sai3, baan6 saai3 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在那里装腔作势，装作很厉害的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act, pretending to be very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得做勢，要做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zou6 sai3, jiu3 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会摆架势，要干活啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just put on a show, you need to do the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想做勢嚇走我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zou6 sai3 haak3 zau2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想摆出架势吓走我们。
examples.english_sentence: They want to make a show of force to scare us away.

cantonese: 做又三十六，唔做又三十六
jyutping: zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6, m4 zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6
mandarin_meaning: 做也一样，不做也一样；做不做都一样
english_meaning: Doing it or not makes no difference; it's all the same whether you do it or not; same outcome regardless of effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论做与不做，结果都是一样的，没有区别，通常带有消极或无奈的意味。说明付出努力并不能改变结果，不如不付出。
explanation_english: Expresses that whether you do something or not, the result is the same, there is no difference. It often carries a negative or helpless connotation. It implies that putting in effort will not change the outcome, so it's better not to put in any effort at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，點溫都無用，做又三十六，唔做又三十六啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, dim2 wan1 dou1 mou4 jung6, zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6, m4 zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么难，怎么复习都没用，做也一样，不做也一样啦。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is so difficult, it's useless to study, it's all the same whether you do it or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細都唔聽我哋意見，做又三十六，唔做又三十六，我哋都係是是但但算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dou1 m4 ting1 ngo5 dei6 ji3 gin3, zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6, m4 zou6 jau6 saam1 sap6 luk6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 si6 si6 daan6 daan6 syun3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板都不听我们的意见，做不做都一样，我们随便应付一下就算了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't listen to our opinions, so it's all the same whether we do it or not, we'll just do it haphazardly and be done with it.

jyutping: zou6 jau6 saa1 luk6, m4 zou6 jau6 saa1 luk6
mandarin_meaning: 做也一样，不做也一样；做了和没做一样
english_meaning: It makes no difference whether you do it or not; the outcome is the same either way.
explanation_mandarin: 表示做了和没做结果一样，形容徒劳无功，或事情的结果已经注定，个人的努力无法改变。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses that the result is the same whether you do something or not. It describes a situation where effort is futile or the outcome is predetermined and individual effort cannot change it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知佢唔會聽我講㗎，講咗都係做又卅六，唔講又卅六。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 keoi5 m4 wui5 ting1 ngo5 gong2 gaa3, gong2 zo2 dou1 hai6 zou6 jau6 saa1 luk6, m4 gong2 jau6 saa1 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道他不会听我的，说了也一样，不说也一样。
examples.english_sentence: I know he won't listen to me. It's the same whether I say it or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都話個市唔會升，你買股票都係做又卅六，唔買又卅六，蝕硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 waa6 go3 si5 m4 wui5 sing1, nei5 maai5 gu2 piu3 dou1 hai6 zou6 jau6 saa1 luk6, m4 maai5 jau6 saa1 luk6, sit8 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都说了股市不会涨，你买股票也是一样，不买也一样，肯定亏本。
examples.english_sentence: It's already said that the stock market won't go up. Buying stocks is the same as not buying; you'll definitely lose money.

english_meaning: to support, to patronize; to play along; to act as an accomplice
explanation_mandarin: 原意指舞台的支脚，比喻为给予支持、捧场，或在某种不光彩的活动中充当帮凶。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the legs of a stage, it's used metaphorically to mean providing support or patronage, or to act as an accomplice in a disreputable activity. It can also mean to play along with someone, sometimes in a silly or exaggerated way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咪幫佢做台腳啦，佢成日都呃人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai5 bong1 keoi5 zou6 toi4 goek3 laa1, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 aak1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别帮他捧场了，他总是骗人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't support him; he's always deceiving people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度亂噏廿四，你唔好做台腳啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 lyun6 ap1 jaa6 sei3, nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 toi4 goek3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在胡说八道，你别跟着起哄了！
examples.english_sentence: He's talking nonsense, don't play along!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想幫佢哋做台腳，做埋啲犯法嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bong1 keoi5 dei6 zou6 toi4 goek3, zou6 maai4 di1 faan6 faat3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想帮他们做帮凶，做些违法的事。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be their accomplice and do illegal things.

english_meaning: to be ripped off; to be scammed; to be taken for a sucker
explanation_mandarin: 指被人欺骗，付出高昂的价格购买不值钱的东西，或者在交易中被严重剥削。
explanation_english: Refers to being cheated or ripped off, paying an exorbitant price for something worthless, or being severely exploited in a transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上次買嗰部電話，原來係水貨嚟嘅，真係做咗人豬仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 ci3 maai5 go2 bou6 din6 waa2, jyun4 loi4 hai6 seoi2 fo3 lai4 ge3, zan1 hai6 zou6 zo2 jan4 zyu1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上次买的那个手机，原来是水货，真是被人当猪宰了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone I bought last time turned out to be a grey market product. I was really ripped off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易信人呀，好易做咗人豬仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 jan4 aa3, hou2 ji6 zou6 zo2 jan4 zyu1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易相信别人啊，很容易被人当猪宰的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, it's easy to be ripped off.

synonyms: 俾人搵笨 (bei2 jan4 wan2 ban6)

english_meaning: What are you doing? / What's up? / Why?
explanation_mandarin: 询问对方正在做什么、发生了什么事，或者表达一种不解、疑问的情绪。
explanation_english: Used to ask what someone is doing, what's happening, or to express confusion or questioning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里干什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁嬲做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 nau1 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那么生气干什么？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so angry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔做嘢，做咩啫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5, zou6 me1 ze1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都不工作，为什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't work all day, why is that?

mandarin_meaning: 做不下去; 干不下去; 无法维持
english_meaning: unable to continue; unable to manage; unable to cope; can't hold on (to a job, position, etc.); unable to make ends meet
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为困难、压力或无法承担等原因，无法继续做某件事或维持某种状态。
explanation_english: Indicates the inability to continue doing something or maintain a certain state due to difficulties, pressure, or an inability to bear the burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司生意咁差，佢哋都做唔住，執咗笠喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 saang1 yi3 gam3 caa1, keoi5 dei6 dou1 zou6 m4 zyu6, zap1 zo2 lap1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司生意这么差，他们都做不下去了，倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business was so bad that they couldn't keep going and went bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工壓力咁大，我都驚我做唔住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6, ngo5 dou1 geng1 ngo5 zou6 m4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作压力这么大，我都怕我干不下去。
examples.english_sentence: The pressure of this job is so high, I'm afraid I won't be able to cope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲樓價咁貴，好多人都做唔住，要搬走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zou6 m4 zyu6, jiu3 bun1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在房价这么贵，很多人都住不下去，要搬走了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that house prices are so expensive, many people can't afford to live here anymore and have to move away.

english_meaning: to work; to do things; to get things done
explanation_mandarin: 意思是工作、做事。在香港，“做嘢”是很常用的口语表达。
explanation_english: Means 'to work' or 'to do things'. It is a common colloquial expression in Hong Kong used to describe working or getting things done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要返工做嘢，好攰呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 zou6 je5, hou2 gui6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去上班工作，好累啊。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work today, I'm so tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住我做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要妨碍我工作了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't disturb me while I'm working!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好快手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很麻利。
examples.english_sentence: He is very efficient at his work.

english_meaning: To put on a big show; to create a scene; to make a fuss; to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指故意制造一个夸张的场面，通常带有负面含义，例如为了吸引注意、博取同情或者达到某种目的而做的表演。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately creating an exaggerated scene, usually with negative connotations. It implies a performance done to attract attention, elicit sympathy, or achieve a certain goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度做場大戲啦，大家都知你咩料啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 hei3 laa1, daai6 ga1 dou1 zi1 nei5 me1 liu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里演戏了，大家都知道你是什么样的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on a big show here, everyone knows what you're like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗呃多啲錢，喺間公司度做場大戲，扮到好慘咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 aak1 do1 di1 cin2, hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 hei3, baan6 dou3 hou2 caam2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了骗更多的钱，他在公司里演了一出戏，装得很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: In order to scam more money, he put on a big show in the company, pretending to be very pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢哋一齊，成日做場大戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4, seng4 jat6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他们一起，总是演戏。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be with them, they are always putting on a big show.

english_meaning: To put on a show; to stage a performance; to create a false impression; to be deceitful
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做出虚假的姿态或行为来迷惑他人，通常带有贬义，表示弄虚作假，欺骗。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately putting on a false pretense or behavior to mislead others, usually with a negative connotation, indicating deception and fraudulence. It often implies a large-scale, elaborate performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都喺度做場大龍鳳，想呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 lung4 fung6, soeng2 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是在这里做戏，想骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They are always putting on a show here, trying to cheat people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢只係做場大龍鳳啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 zi2 hai6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 lung4 fung6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的，他只是在做戏而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's just putting on a show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司話會改善服務，但係我覺得只係做場大龍鳳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 waa6 wui5 goi2 sin6 fuk6 mou6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi2 hai6 zou6 coeng4 daai6 lung4 fung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司说会改善服务，但是我觉得只是做戏。
examples.english_sentence: The company says it will improve services, but I think it's just a performance.

mandarin_meaning: 演一出好戏 / 唱一出好戏
english_meaning: to put on a good show; to stage a performance; to create a spectacle; to act out a charade
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某种目的，故意表演或制造一个引人注目的场面，带有欺骗或夸张的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately staging a show or creating a noteworthy scene for a specific purpose, often with deceptive or exaggerated intent. It implies putting on an act, sometimes to deceive or impress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明唔鍾意份工，但係喺老細面前就做場好戲，扮到好投入噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 m4 zung1 ji3 fan6 gung1, daan6 hai6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zau6 zou6 coeng4 hou2 hei3, baan3 dou3 hou2 tau4 jap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明不喜欢这份工作，但是在老板面前就演一出好戏，装作很投入的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't like the job, but he's putting on a good show in front of the boss, pretending to be very engaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁恩愛，可能只係做場好戲畀人睇啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 yan1 oi3, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 zou6 coeng4 hou2 hei3 bei2 yan4 tai2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么恩爱，可能只是演一出好戏给人看而已。
examples.english_sentence: The way they show their affection is probably just an act they're putting on for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉嘅時候，啲政客成日都做場好戲，氹啲選民支持佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 zing3 haak3 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 coeng4 hou2 hei3, tam5 di1 syun2 man4 zi1 chi4 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举的时候，那些政客经常演一出好戏，哄选民支持他们。
examples.english_sentence: During elections, politicians often put on a good show to persuade voters to support them.

english_meaning: to put on an act; to stage a show; to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某种目的而故意做出某种行为，表演一番。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately performing or putting on a show for a specific purpose; to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁恩愛，都係做場戲啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 yan1 oi3, dou1 hai6 zou6 coeng4 hei3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么恩爱，都是在演戏而已。
examples.english_sentence: Their affection is just an act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使做場戲俾我睇，我唔會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zou6 coeng4 hei3 bei2 ngo5 tai2, ngo5 m4 wui sin3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用演戏给我看，我不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on an act for me, I won't believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係想做場戲哄下你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 zou6 coeng4 hei3 hung2 haa5 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是想演戏哄哄你而已。
examples.english_sentence: He just wants to put on an act to appease you.

english_meaning: to set a bad precedent, to create a bad rule, to establish a bad practice
explanation_mandarin: 指开了不好的先例，制定了不好的规则或习惯，导致以后难以纠正。
explanation_english: Refers to setting a bad precedent, establishing a bad rule or habit, making it difficult to correct in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次幫佢開後門，遲啲個個都咁樣，咪做壞規矩囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 bong1 keoi5 hoi1 hau6 mun4, ci4 di1 go3 go3 dou1 gam2 joeng2, mai1 zou6 waai6 kwai1 geoi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这次帮他开后门，以后每个人都这样做，不就开了坏头了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're helping him by opening the back door this time. If everyone does this later, aren't you setting a bad precedent?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔阻止佢，佢就會繼續咁樣，做壞規矩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 zo2 zi2 keoi5, keoi5 zau6 wui5 gai3 zuk6 gam2 joeng2, zou6 waai6 kwai1 geoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不阻止他，他就会继续这样做，开坏头的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't stop him, he will continue to do so, setting a bad precedent.

english_meaning: to celebrate a birthday (especially for elderly people); to give a birthday celebration
explanation_mandarin: 为长辈庆祝生日，举办寿宴。
explanation_english: To celebrate someone's birthday, especially for older people, often involving a banquet or party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺今年八十歲，我哋要幫佢好好地做壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gam1 nin4 baat3 sap6 seoi3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 hou2 hou2 dei6 zou6 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷今年八十岁，我们要好好地给他做寿。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa is eighty years old this year, we need to give him a grand birthday celebration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係阿婆嘅生日，我哋諗住去酒樓做壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 aa3 po4 ge3 saang1 jat6, ngo5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 zau2 lau4 zou6 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是奶奶的生日，我们打算去酒楼做寿。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is grandma's birthday, we plan to celebrate her birthday at a restaurant.

english_meaning: to dream; to have a dream; to daydream; wishful thinking; pipe dream
explanation_mandarin: 1. 睡觉时产生的幻觉。2. 比喻幻想或不可能实现的想法。
explanation_english: 1. To experience images, sounds, or feelings during sleep. 2. To have a daydream or unrealistic hope; wishful thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發達？你做緊夢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 daat3? nei5 zou6 gan2 mung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发财？你做梦呢？
examples.english_sentence: Get rich? Are you dreaming?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋晚做咗個好奇怪嘅夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 maan1 zou6 zo2 go3 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚做了一个很奇怪的梦。
examples.english_sentence: I had a very strange dream last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做夢啦，返工啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 mung6 laa1, faan1 gung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做梦了，上班吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop daydreaming, get back to work!

synonyms: 發白日夢 (faat3 baak6 jat6 mung6)

mandarin_meaning: 做大; 扩大; 扩张
english_meaning: to expand; to enlarge; to grow bigger; to inflate (figures)
explanation_mandarin: 使规模或数量变大。可以指实际的规模扩大，也可以指虚报夸大。
explanation_english: To make something larger, either in actual size or quantity, or figuratively, such as inflating figures or exaggerating the scale of something. It can refer to genuine expansion or to exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想做大佢盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 zou6 daai6 keoi5 pun4 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想扩大他们的生意规模。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to expand their business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲數做大咗好多，想呃人投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 sou3 zou6 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1, soeng2 aak1 jan4 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把数字夸大了好多，想骗人投资。
examples.english_sentence: He inflated the figures a lot, trying to trick people into investing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要諗辦法做大個品牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 zou6 daai6 go3 pin1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要想办法扩大品牌的影响力。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find ways to expand the brand's influence.

english_meaning: To be a bridesmaid; to be a bride's maid of honor/bridesmaid
explanation_mandarin: 在婚礼中担任新娘的助手，通常是未婚女性。负责协助新娘处理婚礼事务，并陪伴在新娘身边。
explanation_english: To act as a bridesmaid at a wedding. It involves assisting the bride with wedding arrangements and providing support on her special day. It's usually done by unmarried women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要幫我個best friend做女呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 bong1 ngo5 go3 best friend zou6 neoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要帮我最好的朋友做伴娘。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to be a bridesmaid for my best friend next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結咗婚三次，做女都做到厭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 zo2 hun1 saam1 ci3, zou6 neoi2 dou1 zou6 dou3 jim3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她结了三次婚，做伴娘都做腻了。
examples.english_sentence: She's been married three times; she's probably tired of being a bridesmaid.

english_meaning: When I was a girl; in my younger days (as a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性年轻的时候，未婚或刚结婚不久的时候。
explanation_english: Refers to the time when a woman was young, unmarried, or newly married.  A phrase used by women when reminiscing about their past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做女嗰時，我成日去Disco跳舞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 neoi2 go2 si4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 Disco tiu3 mou5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当我还是姑娘的时候，我经常去迪斯科跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a girl, I used to go to discos to dance all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做女嗰時，我嘅頭髮好長㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 neoi2 go2 si4, ngo5 ge3 tau4 faat3 hou2 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当我还是姑娘的时候，我的头发很长。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a girl, my hair was very long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做女嗰時，我覺得自己好瘦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 neoi2 go2 si4, ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当我还是姑娘的时候，我觉得自己很瘦。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a girl, I thought I was very slim.

mandarin_meaning: 做得好也好，做得不好也好；不管好坏
english_meaning: Whether it's done well or poorly; Regardless of the outcome; For better or worse
explanation_mandarin: 形容无论结果好坏都承担责任，或者表示不计较结果好坏，放手去做。
explanation_english: Describes taking responsibility regardless of the outcome, whether good or bad. It can also mean not caring about the outcome and just doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱，我講明先，呢件事做好做醜，都係我自己負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa4, ngo5 gong2 ming4 sin1, ni1 gin6 si6 zou2 hou2 zou2 cau2, dou1 hai6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先声明，这件事做得好不好，都是我自己负责。
examples.english_sentence: Let me state this clearly, I'm responsible for this matter whether it's done well or poorly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然決定咗做，就唔好諗咁多，做好做醜咪知囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zou6, zau6 m4 hou2 lam2 gam3 do1, zou2 hou2 zou2 cau2 mai1 zi1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然决定做了，就不要想那么多，做得好不好做了就知道。
examples.english_sentence: Now that we've decided to do it, don't think so much, we'll know if it's done well or poorly once we've done it.

english_meaning: to do good deeds; to be charitable; to be kind
explanation_mandarin: 指做有益于他人或社会的事情，带有善意的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things that benefit others or society, actions with good intentions. It can also be used to describe someone who is kind and helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做好心，捐錢俾慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou2 hou2 sam1, gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常做好事，捐钱给慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: He often does good deeds, donating money to charities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫佢咁多，真係做好心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 keoi5 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 zou2 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮了他这么多，真是好心。
examples.english_sentence: You've helped him so much; you're really kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到人有困難，應該做好心幫下手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jan4 jau5 kwan3 naan4, ying1 goi1 zou2 hou2 sam1 bong1 haa5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到别人有困难，应该做好事帮一下忙。
examples.english_sentence: When you see someone in difficulty, you should do a good deed and offer a helping hand.

english_meaning: to act as a matchmaker; to arrange a marriage
explanation_mandarin: 指担任媒人，为男女双方介绍对象，促成婚姻。
explanation_english: To act as a matchmaker, introducing potential partners to each other with the goal of facilitating marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽好鍾意幫人做媒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 hou2 zung1 ji3 bong1 jan4 zou6 mui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她妈妈很喜欢帮人做媒。
examples.english_sentence: Her mother really likes acting as a matchmaker for people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我做媒，我先識到我而家嘅男朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 zou6 mui4, ngo5 sin1 sik1 dou3 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 naam4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我做媒，我才认识了我现在的男朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for being a matchmaker for me. That's how I met my current boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔多數自己搵對象，好少人會搵人做媒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 do1 sou3 zi6 gei2 wan2 deoi3 zoeng6, hou2 siu2 jan4 wui5 wan2 jan4 zou6 mui4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人都自己找对象，很少人会找人做媒了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people mostly find partners themselves; very few people seek matchmakers.

english_meaning: to act cute; to be overly cute; to feign innocence
explanation_mandarin: 指故意装出可爱、天真的样子，以博取他人的喜爱或同情。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately acting cute or innocent, often in a calculated way, to gain favor or sympathy from others. It implies a degree of artificiality or insincerity in the cuteness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度做尖啦，我知你諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zou6 zim1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里装可爱了，我知道你在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act cute here, I know what you're thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前做尖，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 zou6 zim1, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天在老板面前卖萌，想升职嘛。
examples.english_sentence: She's always acting cute in front of the boss, she wants a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做尖都無用，我唔會幫佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zim1 dou1 mou5 yung6, ngo5 m4 wui5 bong1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她装可爱也没用，我不会帮她的。
examples.english_sentence: Her acting cute is useless, I won't help her.

english_meaning: to work; to do manual labor
explanation_mandarin: 进行体力劳动；从事工作。
explanation_english: To work; to perform physical labor; to be employed in a job, often referring to manual labor or working class jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都要做工，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 gung1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都要工作，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: They have to work every day, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺以前係工廠做工嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 hai6 gung1 cong2 zou6 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷以前是在工厂工作的。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa used to work in a factory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔做工邊有錢使得啫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 zou6 gung1 bin1 jau5 cin2 sai2 dak1 ze1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不做工哪来的钱用呢？
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work, where will we get the money to spend?

mandarin_meaning: 下功夫; 做功课; 做准备工作
english_meaning: to put in effort; to do homework; to do preparatory work; to prepare (for something)
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某个目的而付出努力，进行准备或练习。
explanation_english: Refers to putting in effort, preparing, or practicing in order to achieve a goal. It can also mean doing homework or preparatory work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試之前要做好多工夫㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zi1 cin4 jiu3 zou6 hou2 do1 gung1 fu1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试之前要做很多准备工作的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to do a lot of preparation before the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗呢個項目做咗好多工夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这个项目下了很多功夫。
examples.english_sentence: He put a lot of effort into this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想學好廣東話，就要多啲做工夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, zau6 jiu3 do1 di1 zou6 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想学好粤语，就要多下功夫。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to learn Cantonese well, you need to put in more effort.

english_meaning: able to handle; able to cope; able to stay (in a job or situation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示能够胜任某项工作或适应某种状况，通常指能够坚持下去或承受住压力。
explanation_english: Indicates the ability to handle a job, cope with a situation, or stay in a particular role, often implying resilience and the ability to withstand pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工咁辛苦，唔知你做得住唔做得住呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, m4 zi1 nei5 zok3 dak1 zyu6 m4 zok3 dak1 zyu6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作这么辛苦，不知道你能否做得住呢？
examples.english_sentence: This job is so tough, I wonder if you can handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個壓力咁大嘅環境，睇下邊個做得住囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6 ge3 waan4 ging2, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 zok3 dak1 zyu6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种压力这么大的环境下，看看谁能坚持下去吧。
examples.english_sentence: In this high-pressure environment, let's see who can stick it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日OT，唔知佢做得住幾耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 OT, m4 zi1 keoi5 zok3 dak1 zyu6 gei2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都加班，不知道他能坚持多久。
examples.english_sentence: He works overtime every day, I wonder how long he can keep it up.

english_meaning: to hold a memorial service for the deceased
explanation_mandarin: 为逝者举行祭祀仪式，通常在逝世周年或特定节日进行。
explanation_english: To hold a memorial service for a deceased person, typically on the anniversary of their death or during specific festivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係阿爺嘅死忌，我哋要返去屋企做忌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 aa3 je4 ge3 sei2 gei6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faan1 heoi3 uk1 kei2 zou6 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是爷爷的忌日，我们要回家做祭。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Grandpa's death anniversary, we need to go back home to hold a memorial service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年因為疫情，我哋決定喺屋企簡單噉做忌就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 jan1 wai6 jik6 ching4, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 hai2 uk1 kei2 gaan2 daan1 gam2 zou6 gei6 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年因为疫情，我们决定在家里简单地做祭就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: This year due to the pandemic, we decided to just hold a simple memorial service at home.

english_meaning: to have sex, to make love
explanation_mandarin: 指进行性行为。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚之後就開始做愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zou6 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚之后就开始做爱了。
examples.english_sentence: They started having sex after they got married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢哋尋晚做咗愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 dei6 cam4 maan1 zou6 zo2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他们昨晚做爱了。
examples.english_sentence: They said they had sex last night.

jyutping: zou6 gwaan3 hat1 ji4 laan5 zou6 gun1
mandarin_meaning: 习惯了当乞丐，懒得当官
english_meaning: Accustomed to being a beggar, too lazy to be an official; used to describe someone who is comfortable in their current (often undesirable) situation and unwilling to change, even for something better.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个人安于现状，即使有机会改变现状，变得更好，也不愿意去改变。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a person who is content with their current situation, even if it's undesirable, and is unwilling to change or strive for something better, even when given the opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明佢有能力搵份更好嘅工，但係佢做慣乞兒懶做官，唔想改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 keoi5 jau5 nang4 lik6 wan2 fan6 gang3 hou2 ge3 gung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zou6 gwaan3 hat1 ji4 laan5 zou6 gun1, m4 soeng2 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明他有能力找一份更好的工作，但是他习惯了当乞丐，懒得当官，不想改变。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly has the ability to find a better job, but he's accustomed to being a beggar, too lazy to be an official, and doesn't want to change.

mandarin_meaning: 演戏, 做作, 假装
english_meaning: to act (in a play or movie), to put on an act, to feign, to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 1. 扮演角色，表演节目。2. 比喻虚假地表现，装模作样。
explanation_english: 1. To perform in a play or movie. 2. To put on an act, to feign emotions or actions, to pretend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁慘都係做戲㗎，你唔好信佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 caam2 dou1 hai6 zou6 hei3 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么可怜都是装的，你不要相信他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's just putting on an act to look miserable; don't believe him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日喺度做戲，扮晒好friend咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zou6 hei3, baan6 saai3 hou2 friend gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩整天在那儿演戏，装作很友好的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always putting on an act, pretending to be good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識做戲，講唔出咁假嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 zou6 hei3, gong2 m4 chut1 gam3 gaa2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂得演戏，说不出这么假的话。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to put on an act; I can't say such false things.

mandarin_meaning: 演戏演全套; 要做就做到底
english_meaning: If you're going to do something, do it properly; Go the whole nine yards; Commit fully to the act; All or nothing.
explanation_mandarin: 指既然要演戏，就要把所有的细节都做到位，力求逼真，引申为既然要做某件事情，就要尽全力把所有相关的事情做好，做到完美。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if you're going to put on an act or do something, you should commit to it fully and pay attention to all the details to make it believable. It can also be used more broadly to mean that if you're going to do something, you should do it properly and put in the effort to do it well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮到好似真係唔識咁，真係做戲做全套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 dou3 hou2 ci5 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 gam2, zan1 hai6 zou6 hei3 zou6 cyun4 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他装得好像真的不认识一样，真是演戏演全套。
examples.english_sentence: He's pretending as if he really doesn't know, he's really going all the way with his act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然我哋決定要幫佢，就要做戲做全套，唔好半途而廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5, zau6 jiu3 zou6 hei3 zou6 cyun4 tou3, m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然我们决定要帮他，就要做到最好，不要半途而废。
examples.english_sentence: Since we've decided to help him, we should do it properly and not give up halfway.

synonyms: [做到足 (zou6 dou3 zuk1) – do it thoroughly]

english_meaning: trick; trickery; manipulation; rigging (e.g., a game); doctoring (accounts)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当的手段进行操作，以达到某种目的。通常带有欺骗或作弊的意味。可以指具体的操作手法，也可以指进行这种操作的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to using unfair or dishonest methods to achieve a certain goal. Usually implies deception or cheating. Can refer to a specific technique or the act of carrying out such operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽度做手，呃咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 dou6 zou6 sau2, ngaak1 zo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中作弊，骗取了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated in the competition and swindled the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅會計賬目肯定有人做手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wui6 gai3 zoeng3 muk6 hang2 ding6 jau5 jan4 zou6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的会计账目肯定有人做了手脚。
examples.english_sentence: Someone must have doctored the accounting books of this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多做手啦，直接啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 zou6 sau2 laa1, zik6 zip3 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搞那么多花样了，直接一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use so much trickery, it's better to be more direct.

english_meaning: to rig; to tamper with; to fix (e.g., an election); to pull strings
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中舞弊、作弊、动手脚，通过不正当的手段来达到目的。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly cheating, tampering, or manipulating things to achieve a goal through dishonest means. It implies secretly interfering to gain an unfair advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懷疑間公司喺盤數度做咗手腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waai4 ji4 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 pun4 sou3 dou6 zou6 zo2 sau2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们怀疑这家公司在账目上做了手脚。
examples.english_sentence: They suspect that the company has rigged the accounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為可以喺考試度做手腳，俾人捉到就大鑊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 hai2 haau2 si3 dou6 zou6 sau2 goek3, bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 daai6 wok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为可以在考试中作弊，被人抓到就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can cheat on the exam, it'll be a disaster if you get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場比賽嘅結果肯定有人做咗手腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ge3 git3 gwo2 hang2 ding6 jau5 jan4 zou6 zo2 sau2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛的结果肯定有人做了手脚。
examples.english_sentence: The result of this match must have been rigged.

english_meaning: to have surgery, to undergo an operation
explanation_mandarin: 进行外科手术。指为了治疗疾病或修复损伤而进行的医疗操作。
explanation_english: To undergo a surgical procedure to treat an illness or repair an injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日要做手術呀，祝佢順利啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 aa3, zuk1 keoi5 seon6 lei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天要做手术，祝他顺利吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's having surgery tomorrow, wish him good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我隻腳要做手術先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 zek3 goek3 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的脚要做手术才行。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to have surgery on my leg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使唔使做手術啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 zou6 sau2 seot6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要做手术吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you need to have surgery?

english_meaning: to work undercover, to be an undercover agent/cop, to be a mole
explanation_mandarin: 指从事卧底工作，秘密潜入某个组织内部进行侦查或情报搜集。
explanation_english: Refers to working undercover, secretly infiltrating an organization to conduct reconnaissance or gather intelligence. Often refers to undercover cops or agents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做扒做咗好耐，終於捉到個大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 paa1 zou6 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 zuk1 dou2 go3 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了很久的卧底，终于抓到了大佬。
examples.english_sentence: He worked undercover for a long time and finally caught the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講咁多嘢，我懷疑佢係做扒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 gam3 do1 je5, ngo5 waai4 ji5 keoi5 hai6 zou6 paa1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和他讲那么多，我怀疑他是卧底。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell him too much, I suspect he's working undercover.

mandarin_meaning: 耍花招; 变戏法; 搞鬼
english_meaning: to play tricks; to show off; to perform magic tricks; to pull a fast one; to be up to something
explanation_mandarin: 指耍弄花招，玩弄手段，或表演魔术等。有时也指暗中搞鬼，不真诚的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to playing tricks, using underhanded tactics, or performing magic tricks. Sometimes it also implies doing something secretly, insincerely, or dishonestly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住做把戲呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 zou6 baa2 hei3 ngaak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天想着耍花招骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about pulling tricks to cheat people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度做把戲啦，認真啲做嘢得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zou6 baa2 hei3 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里耍花招了，认真一点工作行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Stop fooling around and get serious about your work, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個魔術師好叻做把戲，啲觀眾睇到嘩嘩聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mo1 seot6 si1 hou2 lek1 zou6 baa2 hei3, di1 gun1 zung3 tai2 dou3 waa1 waa1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个魔术师很会变戏法，观众们看得都哇哇叫。
examples.english_sentence: This magician is very good at performing magic tricks; the audience watched with gasps of amazement.

english_meaning: To do accounting; to falsify accounts; to cook the books; to doctor figures
explanation_mandarin: 原意为做会计工作，整理账目。现在常指为了达到某种目的，通过不正当手段修改或伪造账目，使数据看起来更好看。
explanation_english: Originally meaning to do accounting work and organize accounts. Now it often refers to modifying or falsifying accounts through improper means in order to achieve a certain purpose, making the data look better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司年尾要交數，梗係要做數㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 nin4 mei5 jiu3 gaau1 sou3, gang2 hai6 jiu3 zou6 sou3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司年底要交账，肯定要做账的啦。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to submit the accounts at the end of the year, so they definitely have to cook the books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲數做得好靚，但係明眼人都知係做數嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 sou3 zou6 dak1 hou2 leng3, daan6 hai6 ming4 ngaan5 jan4 dou1 zi1 hai6 zou6 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做的账目很漂亮，但是明眼人都知道是造假的。
examples.english_sentence: Their accounts look very good, but anyone with discerning eyes knows they are cooked.

english_meaning: to make a fuss over; to exaggerate; to make a mountain out of a molehill; to exploit a situation; to spin (a story)
explanation_mandarin: 指利用某种事物或机会，加以渲染、夸大，或从中谋取利益。含有贬义。
explanation_english: To make use of something or an opportunity to exaggerate, embellish, or exploit it for personal gain. It often has a negative connotation, implying manipulation or ulterior motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得喺份報告度做文章，要實際啲解決問題先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hai2 fan6 bou3 gou3 dou6 zou6 man4 zoeng1, jiu3 sat6 zai3 di1 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只懂得在报告里大做文章，要实际地解决问题才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just make a fuss over the report; you need to actually solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋擺明想喺呢件事上面做文章，抹黑我哋公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baai2 ming4 soeng2 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 seong6 min6 zou6 man4 zoeng1, mut3 hak1 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们摆明了想在这件事上面大做文章，抹黑我们公司。
examples.english_sentence: They clearly want to exploit this incident to smear our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲傳媒成日都鍾意喺啲小事上面做文章，博人眼球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cyun4 mui4 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 hai2 di1 siu2 si6 seong6 min6 zou6 man4 zoeng1, bok3 jan4 ngaan5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些媒体总是喜欢在小事上大做文章，博人眼球。
examples.english_sentence: The media always likes to make a mountain out of a molehill to grab attention.

english_meaning: to treat (someone to a meal); to host (a banquet, event); to pay the bill
explanation_mandarin: 请客，宴请别人；承担费用。
explanation_english: To treat someone, usually to a meal or event; to act as host and pay the expenses. It implies taking responsibility for the costs associated with a gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我做東，大家一齊去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zou6 dung1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我做东，大家一起去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm treating tonight, let's all go out for dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使爭，今日等我做東啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zaang1, gam1 jat6 dang2 ngo5 zou6 dung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用争，今天让我做东吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue, let me treat you today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗慶祝佢升職，我哋決定集資做東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 hing3 zuk1 keoi5 sing1 zik1, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zaap6 zi1 zou6 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了庆祝他升职，我们决定集资做东。
examples.english_sentence: To celebrate his promotion, we decided to pool our money and treat him.

english_meaning: to put on an act; to pretend; to fake it; to do something superficially to make it look good
explanation_mandarin: 指为了给人留下好印象或应付场面而表面上做一些事情，实际上并没有认真对待或投入。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something superficially or pretending to do something in order to create a good impression or to cope with a situation, without actually being serious or invested in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做架兩，扮晒好勤力咁，但係實際上乜都冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zou6 gaa2 loeng5, baan6 saai3 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeoi3 seung6 mat1 dou1 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在做样子，装作很勤奋的样子，但实际上什么都没做。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act, pretending to be very hardworking, but actually he hasn't done anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做架兩啦，認真做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gaa2 loeng5 laa1, jing6 zan1 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做样子了，认真工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop putting on an act, and get to work seriously!

english_meaning: to put on an act, to show off, to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 指为了给人留下好印象而故意表现出某种姿态或行为，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately displaying a certain posture or behavior to leave a good impression on others, often with a negative connotation. It implies insincerity and showiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前做架梁，扮到好勤力咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zou6 gaa3 loeng4, baan6 dou3 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是老板面前装腔作势，假装很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act in front of the boss, pretending to be very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度做架梁啦，有咩幫手就直接講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zou6 gaa3 loeng4 laa1, jau5 me1 bong1 sau2 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里装腔作势了，有什么需要帮忙的就直接说。
examples.english_sentence: Stop putting on an act here, just tell me directly if you need help.

english_meaning: to show off, to put on airs, to act pretentious
explanation_mandarin: 指摆出高人一等的姿态，让人感到不舒服或不真实。形容人自命不凡，装腔作势。
explanation_english: To act in a pretentious manner, putting on airs of superiority or importance. It implies insincerity and a desire to impress others with a false image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度做架樑，好似自己好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zou6 gaa3 loeng4, hou2 ci5 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在那里摆架子，好像自己很厉害似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always showing off there, acting like he's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我面前做架樑啦，我知你咩料㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 zou6 gaa3 loeng4 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 me1 liu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在我面前摆架子了，我知道你是什么货色。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on airs in front of me, I know what you're made of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使同佢客氣，佢都係做架樑啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 tung4 keoi5 hak3 hei3, keoi5 dou1 hai6 zou6 gaa3 loeng4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用对他客气，他只是在装模作样而已。
examples.english_sentence: No need to be polite with him, he's just putting on airs.

english_meaning: to pretend; to put on an act; to go through the motions; to do something for show; lip service
explanation_mandarin: 指为了给别人看而做表面功夫，实际上没有真心实意。
explanation_english: To perform an action merely for appearances or show, without genuine intention or effort. It implies insincerity and a lack of real commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得做樣，根本冇心幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zou6 joeng2, gan1 bun2 mou5 sam1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会做样子，根本没真心想帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to put on an act; he has no intention of really helping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係做樣，要實際啲行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zou6 joeng2, jiu3 sat6 zai3 di1 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是做样子，要实际行动起来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just pay lip service; take some real action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細巡視嘅時候，佢哋先至做樣勤力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ceon4 si5 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 dei6 sin1 zi3 zou6 joeng2 kan4 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板巡视的时候，他们才做样子勤奋点。
examples.english_sentence: They only pretend to be diligent when the boss is inspecting.

english_meaning: to go straight (to give up criminal activities and get a legitimate job)
explanation_mandarin: 指放弃不正当的职业或行为，转而从事正当的职业。
explanation_english: To give up illegal or dishonest activities and start working a legitimate job; to go straight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐完監出嚟之後，決定做正行，搵份工安安穩穩噉過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 jyun4 gaam1 ceot1 lai4 zi1 hau6, kyut3 ding6 zou6 zeng3 hang4, wan2 fan6 gung1 on1 on1 wan2 wan2 gam2 gwo3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐完牢出来之后，决定做正当职业，找一份工作安安稳稳地过日子。
examples.english_sentence: After being released from prison, he decided to go straight and find a stable job to live a peaceful life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明以前成日喺街度搞搞震，而家佢女朋友叫佢做正行，唔好再做埋啲犯法嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ji4 gaa1 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 giu3 keoi5 zou6 zeng3 hang4, m4 hou2 zoi3 zou6 maai4 di1 faan6 faat3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明以前经常在街上惹是生非，现在他女朋友叫他做正当职业，不要再做那些犯法的事。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming used to cause trouble in the streets all the time. Now his girlfriend is telling him to go straight and stop doing illegal things.

mandarin_meaning: 做法, 措施, 手法
english_meaning: method, way of doing things, practice, approach, recipe (for food)
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情的方式、方法，或烹饪食物的配方。
explanation_english: Refers to the method, approach, or way of doing something. Can also refer to a recipe for cooking food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個做法好有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hou2 jau5 haau6 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个做法很有效率。
examples.english_sentence: This method is very efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點睇呢個做法？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 tai2 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得这个做法怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think of this approach?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學下點樣煮呢個菜嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 zyu2 ni1 go3 coi3 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想学习一下怎么做这道菜的配方。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn how to cook this dish's recipe.

english_meaning: to be in prison, to serve jail time, to be imprisoned
explanation_mandarin: 指因犯罪而被关进监狱服刑。
explanation_english: To be imprisoned, to serve time in jail due to committing a crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢衰咗搶劫，依家要去做波監啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 zo2 coeng2 gip3, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 heoi3 zou6 bo1 gaam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为抢劫而被判刑，现在要去坐牢了。
examples.english_sentence: He was convicted of robbery and now he has to go to jail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔守法，遲早都要做波監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 sau2 faat3, ci4 zou2 dou1 jiu3 zou6 bo1 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不守法，迟早都要坐牢。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't obey the law, you will end up in jail sooner or later.

mandarin_meaning: 搞坏市场；扰乱市场秩序
english_meaning: to spoil the market; to disrupt the market; to undercut prices excessively; to cause market collapse
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当手段，如过度降价、以次充好等方式，扰乱市场秩序，导致市场价格下跌，损害行业利益。
explanation_english: Refers to disrupting the market order and causing a decline in market prices by improper means such as excessive price reductions, selling inferior goods, etc., thereby harming the interests of the industry. It can also mean engaging in practices that drive down prices and make it difficult for others to compete fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司成日做爛市，搞到好多細公司都執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 zou6 laan6 si5, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 sai3 gung1 si1 dou1 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司总是搞坏市场，导致很多小公司都倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: Their company always spoils the market, causing many small companies to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再做爛市啦，大家都冇錢賺㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zou6 laan6 si5 laa1, daai6 ga1 dou1 mou5 cin2 zaan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再搞坏市场了，大家都赚不到钱啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spoil the market anymore, no one can make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種惡性競爭只會做爛市，對大家冇好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 ok3 sing3 ging6 zang1 zi2 wui5 zou6 laan6 si5, deoi3 daai6 ga1 mou5 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种恶性竞争只会搞坏市场，对大家没有好处。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of vicious competition will only spoil the market, and it's not good for anyone.

synonyms: 削價競爭 (soek3 gaa3 ging6 zang1) - price war

english_meaning: to have a feast; to eat something delicious to celebrate or treat oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指以较好的食物来款待自己或他人，相当于“打牙祭”。传统上，商家每月初二、十六祭拜土地公，祭拜后会分食祭品，后来引申为吃好吃的食物。
explanation_english: Refers to treating oneself or others with better food than usual, equivalent to 'having a feast'. Traditionally, merchants would worship the Earth God on the 2nd and 16th of each month, and after the worship, they would share the offerings. Later, it was extended to mean eating delicious food to celebrate or treat oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚出糧，我哋去食餐好嘅，做牙啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ceot1 leong4, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 caan1 hou2 ge3, zou6 ngaa4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚发工资，我们去吃顿好的，打牙祭吧！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight is payday, let's go eat something good, let's have a feast!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日都話以前生活艱苦，一年都冇幾次機會做牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 ji5 cin4 sang1 wut6 gaan1 fu2, jat1 nin4 dou1 mou5 gei2 ci3 gei1 wui6 zou6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是说以前生活艰苦，一年也没几次机会打牙祭。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always says that life used to be hard, and there were only a few chances a year to have a feast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試，梗係要食餐勁嘅做牙啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3, gang2 hai6 jiu3 sik6 caan1 ging6 ge3 zou6 ngaa4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试，当然要吃一顿好的打牙祭啦！
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, of course we have to have a big meal to celebrate!

english_meaning: to work like a horse; to be a beast of burden; to slave away
explanation_mandarin: 比喻像牛马一样辛苦地工作，任劳任怨，毫无怨言地为他人服务。
explanation_english: A metaphor for working very hard like an ox or horse, being a beast of burden, and serving others tirelessly and without complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗頭家，日日做牛做馬咁，真係好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zo2 tau4 gaa1, jat6 jat6 zou6 ngau4 zou6 maa5 gam2, zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了家庭，我每天都像牛马一样工作，真的很累。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of my family, I work like a horse every day, I'm really tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司做牛做馬咁多年，都冇升職，真係唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 ngau4 zou6 maa5 gam2 do1 nin4, dou1 mou5 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司辛辛苦苦工作这么多年，都没有升职，真是不值得。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working like a horse in the company for so many years but hasn't been promoted, it's really not worth it.

english_meaning: to die, to kick the bucket, to be finished, to be over
explanation_mandarin: 表示死亡、失败或结束。通常用于非正式场合，带有幽默或轻蔑的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates death, failure, or the end of something. Usually used in informal situations and can carry a humorous or contemptuous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日交通意外做咗瓜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 zou6 zo2 gwaa1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在交通事故中去世了。
examples.english_sentence: He died in a traffic accident yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我聽日唔交功課，我就實做瓜啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, ngo5 zau6 sat6 zou6 gwaa1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我明天不交作业，我就死定了！
examples.english_sentence: If I don't hand in my homework tomorrow, I'm doomed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司咁樣落去，遲早都做瓜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, chi4 zou2 dou1 zou6 gwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样下去，这家公司迟早完蛋。
examples.english_sentence: If the company continues like this, it will be finished sooner or later.

jyutping: zou6 saang1 bat1 jyu4 zou6 suk6
mandarin_meaning: 熟能生巧；熟手比生手好
english_meaning: Practice makes perfect; familiarity breeds competence; it's better to stick with what you know.
explanation_mandarin: 指做不熟悉的事情不如做熟悉的事情容易成功，效率更高。强调经验的重要性。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the value of experience. It means it's generally better and more efficient to do something you're familiar with rather than something new or unfamiliar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工做咗好多年，就算人工唔係好高，佢都唔想轉，都話做生不如做熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4, zau6 syun3 yan4 gung1 m4 hai6 hou2 gou1, keoi5 dou1 m4 soeng2 zyun2, dou1 waa6 zou6 saang1 bat1 jyu4 zou6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这份工作做了很多年，即使工资不是很高，他也不想换，总是说熟能生巧。
examples.english_sentence: He's been doing this job for many years, even if the salary isn't that high, he doesn't want to change because he believes practice makes perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次整蛋糕好難，但係做多幾次就熟手㗎喇，始終都係做生不如做熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 yat1 ci3 zing2 daan6 gou1 hou2 naan4, daan6 hai6 zou6 do1 gei2 ci3 zau6 suk6 sau2 gaa3 laa3, chi2 chung1 dou1 hai6 zou6 saang1 bat1 jyu4 zou6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次做蛋糕很难，但是多做几次就熟练了，始终还是熟能生巧。
examples.english_sentence: It's difficult to make a cake for the first time, but you'll get the hang of it after making it a few times. After all, practice makes perfect.

english_meaning: To work like a dog; to slave away; to work oneself to death
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作非常辛苦，非常卖力，几乎要累死。表示一种抱怨或者无奈的情绪。
explanation_english: Describes working extremely hard, toiling tirelessly, almost to the point of exhaustion or death. Often expresses a feeling of complaint or helplessness about the workload.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都做生做死，都唔夠錢用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zou6 sang1 zou6 sei2, dou1 m4 gau3 cin2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都累死累活的，还是不够钱用。
examples.english_sentence: I work like a dog every day, and still don't have enough money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁做生做死啦，小心身體啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6 sang1 zou6 sei2 laa1, siu2 sam1 san1 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么累死累活的了，小心身体啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard! Take care of your health!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份工，真係做到做生做死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 zou6 dou3 zou6 sang1 zou6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这份工作，真是做到累死累活。
examples.english_sentence: He really works like a dog for this job.

synonyms: 捱生捱死 (ngaai4 sang1 ngaai4 sei2)

english_meaning: to follow trends, to be trendy
explanation_mandarin: 指追求时下的流行事物或行为，赶时髦。
explanation_english: Refers to following current trends and fashions; to be trendy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔好鍾意做盛行，咩 hit 咪做咩囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 zung1 ji3 zou6 sing6 hang4, me1 hit3 mai1 zou6 me1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人都很喜欢赶时髦，什么流行就做什么。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays really like to follow trends, they do whatever is popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日做盛行啦，做返自己咪幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zou6 sing6 hang4 laa1, zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 mai1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是赶时髦了，做回自己不是很好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always follow trends, being yourself is great.

english_meaning: to be stuck in the middle, to be the one caught in the crossfire, to be the buffer between two conflicting parties
explanation_mandarin: 指在两个或多个有矛盾、冲突的人或团体之间，被迫承受双方的压力，左右为难，两边都不讨好。
explanation_english: Refers to being caught in the middle of a conflict between two or more people or groups, forced to bear the pressure from both sides, making it difficult to please either party. Often implies being blamed or criticized by both sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥同阿嫂成日嘈交，我夾喺中間做磨心，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 tung4 aa3 so2 seng4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, ngo5 gaap3 hai2 zung1 gaan1 zou6 mo4 sam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥和嫂子总是吵架，我夹在中间做磨心，真的好辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother and sister-in-law always argue. I'm stuck in the middle as a buffer, it's really exhausting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司老闆同同事唔啱，我做磨心，兩邊都難做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 lou5 baan2 tung4 tung4 si6 m4 ngaam1, ngo5 zou6 mo4 sam1, loeng5 bin1 dou1 naan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司老板和同事不和，我夹在中间做磨心，两边都难做。
examples.english_sentence: At the company, the boss and colleagues don't get along, I'm stuck in the middle as a buffer, it's difficult to please both sides.

synonyms: 豬八戒照鏡－裏外不是人

mandarin_meaning: 作弊投票; 舞弊投票; 伪造选票
english_meaning: Vote rigging; ballot stuffing; electoral fraud
explanation_mandarin: （动词）指在选举中采取不正当手段，例如伪造选票、重复投票等，以达到操纵选举结果的目的。（名词）指通过舞弊手段产生的虚假选票或选举结果。
explanation_english: (Verb) To engage in electoral fraud, such as ballot stuffing, double voting, or manipulating the vote count to influence the outcome of an election. (Noun) Refers to fraudulent ballots or election results obtained through such malpractice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話呢次選舉有人做票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 ni1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 jau5 jan4 zou6 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人说这次选举有人舞弊投票。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say there was vote rigging in this election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方介入調查做票嘅指控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gaai3 jap6 diu6 caa4 zou6 piu3 ge3 zi2 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方介入调查舞弊投票的指控。
examples.english_sentence: The police intervened to investigate the allegations of vote rigging.

english_meaning: observe the traditional lunar monthly feast of the 2nd and 16th day of the month for business prosperity (usually by offering food to deities and enjoying a meal together)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时商家每月初二、十六祭拜土地公的习俗，祈求生意兴隆，也犒劳员工。
explanation_english: A traditional practice among businesses, especially smaller shops and restaurants, to celebrate on the 2nd and 16th days of each lunar month. It involves offering food to the Earth God (土地公), praying for good business, and treating the employees to a good meal. It’s a form of appreciation and a way to boost morale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間餐廳每個初二、十六都會做禡，啲伙計好開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 caan1 teng1 mui5 go3 co1 ji6、sap6 luk6 dou1 wui5 zou6 maa6, di1 fo2 gai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们餐厅每个初二、十六都会做牙，员工们都很开心。
examples.english_sentence: Our restaurant observes 'zou maa' on the 2nd and 16th of every lunar month, and the employees are very happy about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲鋪頭好興做禡㗎，而家就少咗好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 pou3 tau2 hou2 hing1 zou6 maa6 gaa3, ji4 gaa1 zau6 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的商店很流行做牙，现在就少了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, shops were very fond of observing 'zou maa', but nowadays it's much less common.

english_meaning: To celebrate a festival; to observe a festival; to have a festive meal
explanation_mandarin: 指在传统节日期间，进行庆祝活动，通常包括家人团聚、准备和享用美食等。
explanation_english: Refers to celebrating a traditional festival, typically involving family gatherings, preparing and enjoying festive meals, and participating in relevant customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節我哋一家人會一齊做節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 jat1 cai4 zou6 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋节我们一家人会一起过节。
examples.english_sentence: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, our family will celebrate together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年冬至你哋屋企點樣做節啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 dung1 zi3 nei5 dei6 uk1 kei2 dim2 joeng2 zou6 zit3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年冬至你们家怎么过节啊？
examples.english_sentence: How will your family celebrate the Winter Solstice this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年做節梗係要食蘿蔔糕㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 zou6 zit3 gang2 hai6 jiu3 sik6 lo4 baak6 gou1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年过节当然要吃萝卜糕啦！
examples.english_sentence: Of course, you have to eat turnip cake when celebrating the New Year!

mandarin_meaning: 当挡箭牌; 承担责任
english_meaning: To be a scapegoat; to take the blame for someone else; to take responsibility (often unwillingly).
explanation_mandarin: 替人顶罪，充当替罪羊；被迫承担责任。
explanation_english: To act as a shield or scapegoat for someone else, taking the blame or responsibility for their actions, often against one's will. It implies being used or manipulated into accepting the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗錯，但係搵我嚟做膽，真係冇陰功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 co3, daan6 hai6 wan2 ngo5 lai4 zou6 daam2, zan1 hai6 mou5 jam1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了错误，但是找我来当替罪羊，真是不讲道理。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake, but he's using me as a scapegoat. It's really unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁大鑊，邊個肯出嚟做膽呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si2 gam3 daai6 wok6, bin1 go3 hang2 ceot1 lai4 zou6 daam2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，谁肯出来承担责任啊？
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, who is willing to step up and take the fall?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住搵我做膽，我唔會幫你頂罪嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 wan2 ngo5 zou6 daam2, ngo5 m4 wui5 bong1 nei5 ding2 zeoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想找我当替罪羊，我不会帮你承担罪责的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about using me as a scapegoat, I won't take the blame for you.

synonyms: 孭鑊 (be1 wok6) - to carry the wok (take responsibility)
頂罪 (ding2 zeoi6) - to take the blame

english_meaning: To do one's own thing; to mind one's own business; to focus on one's own tasks/interests.
explanation_mandarin: 专注于做自己的事情，不干涉他人。
explanation_english: To focus on one's own tasks, interests, or activities, often implying avoiding interference in others' affairs or doing what makes one happy regardless of external pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都係做自己嘢啦，唔好理人哋啲八卦嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 hai6 zou6 zi6 gei2 je5 laa1, m4 hou2 lei5 jan4 dei6 dik1 baat3 gwaa3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还是做自己的事情吧，不要管别人的八卦事。
examples.english_sentence: You should just mind your own business and don't get involved in other people's gossip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要趕住做自己嘢，冇時間同你吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gon2 zyu6 zou6 zi6 gei2 je5, mou5 si4 gaan3 tung4 nei5 cheui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在要赶着做自己的事情，没时间和你聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I need to hurry up and do my own thing now, I don't have time to chat with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗職之後，就決定做自己嘢，開咗間咖啡店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 ci4 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 kyut3 ding6 zou6 zi6 gei2 je5, hoi1 zo2 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后，就决定做自己喜欢的事情，开了一家咖啡店。
examples.english_sentence: After quitting his job, he decided to do his own thing and opened a coffee shop.

english_meaning: to be the banker (in gambling); to be the host; to take the lead; to take responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 在赌博游戏中担任庄家。引申为承担责任，发起组织某事，或者充当主人。
explanation_english: In gambling, to be the banker or dealer. By extension, it means to take responsibility, to initiate or organize something, or to act as the host.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋打麻雀，不如你做莊啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 daa2 maa4 zoek3, bat1 jyu4 nei5 zou6 zong1 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们打麻将，不如你来做庄吧？
examples.english_sentence: We're playing mahjong tonight, why don't you be the banker?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次活動由佢哋做莊搞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 wut6 dung6 jau4 keoi5 dei6 zou6 zong1 gaau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动是由他们负责组织的。
examples.english_sentence: This event was organized by them; they took the lead on this event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我做莊請大家食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zou6 zong1 cheng2 daai6 gaa1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我请客，请大家吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm hosting tonight, I'm treating everyone to dinner.

english_meaning: to testify, to be a witness, to provide testimony
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭或正式场合提供证据或证明，证明某事为真。
explanation_english: To provide evidence or testimony in a court or formal setting, to attest to the truth of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺法庭上面做證，證明佢當時唔喺現場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 min6 zou6 zing3, zing3 ming4 keoi5 dong1 si4 m4 hai2 yin6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在法庭上作证，证明他当时不在现场。
examples.english_sentence: I testified in court, proving that he wasn't at the scene at the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢肯唔肯出嚟幫我做證啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang2 m4 hang2 ceot1 lai4 bong1 ngo5 zou6 zing3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他肯不肯出来帮我作证啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is he willing to come out and testify for me?

english_meaning: to welcome; to greet (guests)
explanation_mandarin: 迎接客人；一般指比較正式的迎接場面。
explanation_english: To welcome guests, usually in a more formal or ceremonial manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有貴賓嚟，我哋要做好啲準備，做迓佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 gwai3 ban1 lei4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 di1 zeon2 bei6, zou6 ngaa6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有贵宾来，我们要做好一些准备，迎接他们。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow we have VIP guests coming, we need to prepare well to welcome them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府官員出動做迓外國元首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 ceot1 dung6 zou6 ngaa6 ngoi6 gwok3 jyun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府官员出动迎接外国元首。
examples.english_sentence: Government officials mobilize to welcome foreign heads of state.

english_meaning: to do exercise, to work out
explanation_mandarin: 进行体育活动，锻炼身体。
explanation_english: To engage in physical activity for the purpose of improving one's health and fitness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都會做運動，保持身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 wui5 zou6 wan6 dung6, bou2 ci4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都会做运动，保持身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: I exercise every day to stay healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想減肥就應該多啲做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 gaam2 fei4 zau6 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想减肥就应该多做运动。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to lose weight, you should exercise more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每個禮拜都去gym房做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 heoi3 gym fong2 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每个星期都去健身房做运动。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the gym to work out every week.

mandarin_meaning: 从事哪个行业；做什么工作
english_meaning: What line of work are you in?; What do you do for a living?
explanation_mandarin: 询问对方所从事的行业或工作。
explanation_english: An expression used to ask someone about their occupation or profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱識，唔知你做邊行㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 sik1, m4 zi1 nei5 zou6 bin1 hong4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚认识，不知道你是做什么工作的？
examples.english_sentence: We just met, I don't know what line of work you are in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年輕人，好多都唔想打工，想自己創業，唔知佢哋到時會做邊行呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4, hou2 do1 dou1 m4 soeng2 daa2 gung1, soeng2 zi6 gei2 cong3 jip6, m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 dou3 si4 wui5 zou6 bin1 hong4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，很多都不想打工，想自己创业，不知道他们到时候会从事哪个行业呢？
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people don't want to work for others, they want to start their own businesses, I wonder what line of work they will be in then.

english_meaning: to play the bad guy, to be the one who delivers unpleasant news or makes unpopular decisions
explanation_mandarin: 指承担不受欢迎的角色，说难听的话，做不得人喜欢的事，以达成某种目的。
explanation_english: To play the role of the 'bad guy' or 'ugly person'. It involves being the one who delivers bad news, enforces unpopular decisions, or says things that others are unwilling to say, often for the greater good or to achieve a specific outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次阿頭要我做醜人，逼啲同事OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 aa3 tau4 jiu3 ngo5 zou6 cau2 jan4, bik1 di1 tung4 si6 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次老板要我扮黑脸，逼同事加班。
examples.english_sentence: This time, the boss wants me to play the bad guy and force colleagues to work overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道呢個決定唔好聽，但係我都要做醜人，話俾你哋聽公司真係冇錢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 m4 hou2 teng1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zou6 cau2 jan4, waa6 bei2 nei5 dei6 teng1 gung1 si1 zan1 hai6 mou5 cin2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道这个决定不好听，但是我还是要扮演坏人，告诉你们公司真的没钱了。
examples.english_sentence: I know this decision isn't pleasant to hear, but I still have to play the bad guy and tell you all that the company really has no money.

english_meaning: To work as a prostitute, to be a prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指从事卖淫活动，做妓女。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in prostitution, working as a prostitute. It is typically used for women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣為咗搵錢，逼住去做雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 wai6 zo2 wan2 cin2, bik1 zyu6 heoi3 zou6 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她年轻的时候为了赚钱，被迫去做妓女。
examples.english_sentence: When she was young, she was forced to work as a prostitute in order to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住咁容易就可以靠做雞搵到大錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 gam3 jung4 ji6 dak1 ji5 kaau3 zou6 gai1 wan2 dou3 daai6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为那么容易就可以靠卖淫赚到大钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think it's so easy to make a lot of money by being a prostitute.

english_meaning: to cook; to prepare a meal
explanation_mandarin: 指烹饪食物，准备饭菜。
explanation_english: To cook food; to prepare a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要做飯畀屋企人食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 zou6 faan6 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要给家人做饭吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to cook for my family tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識做飯㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zou6 faan6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会做饭啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to cook?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻做飯，煮咩都好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 zou6 faan6, zyu2 me1 dou1 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很会做饭，做什么都好吃。
examples.english_sentence: She's a great cook; everything she makes is delicious.

english_meaning: to put on a show; to grandstand; to act for show; to create a spectacle for publicity
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某种目的，故意做出引人注目的行为，通常带有虚假或夸张的成分。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately putting on a show or performing actions to attract attention for a specific purpose, often with an element of falseness or exaggeration. It implies that the actions are primarily for show rather than genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公眾面前做騷，想搏人哋嘅同情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 zung2 min6 cin4 zou6 sau1, soeng2 bok3 jan4 dei6 ge3 tung4 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在公众面前作秀，想博取别人的同情。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on a show in public, trying to gain people's sympathy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政治人物成日做騷，但係實際上咩都冇做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6 sing4 jat6 zou6 sau1, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeoi3 soeng6 me1 dou1 mou5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政治人物经常作秀，但实际上什么都没做。
examples.english_sentence: This politician is always putting on a show, but in reality, he does nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得做騷，要做啲實際嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zou6 sau1, jiu3 zou6 di1 sat6 zai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会作秀，要做一些实际的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just know how to put on a show, you need to do something practical.

mandarin_meaning: 尽心尽力, 多方奔走
english_meaning: To do everything possible; to go to great lengths; to pull every string
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了达到某个目的，尽了最大的努力，四处奔走，想尽一切办法。
explanation_english: Describes putting in maximum effort, running around everywhere, and thinking of all possible ways to achieve a certain goal. Similar to 'moving heaven and earth'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫佢攞到呢個合約，我真係做鬼做馬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 bong1 keoi5 lo2 dou2 ni1 go3 hap6 joek3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 zou6 gwai2 zou6 maa5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮他拿到这个合同，我真是尽心尽力了。
examples.english_sentence: To help him get this contract, I really went to great lengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗仔女嘅將來，真係做鬼做馬都願意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 zai2 neoi5 ge3 zoeng1 loi4, zan1 hai6 zou6 gwai2 zou6 maa5 dou1 jyun6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了子女的将来，他真是做什么都愿意。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his children's future, he is willing to do everything possible.

mandarin_meaning: 一点用都没有；做什么都不灵验
english_meaning: Completely useless; ineffective even as a ghost; utterly hopeless.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事毫无用处，即使死了变成鬼也没有任何能力或作用。表示极其否定和讽刺。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as completely useless, even to the point that they would be ineffective even if they became a ghost. Expresses extreme negativity and sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，做鬼都唔靈啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, zou6 gwai2 dou1 m4 ling4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么笨，就算做鬼也没用！
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he wouldn't be effective even as a ghost!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦壞咗咁耐，做鬼都唔靈啦，不如買部新嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zou6 gwai2 dou1 m4 ling4 laa1, bat1 jyu4 maai5 bou6 san1 ge3 laa1.
