examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑坏了这么久，彻底没用了，不如买一台新的吧。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been broken for so long, it's completely useless, better to buy a new one.

english_meaning: male prostitute, gigolo
explanation_mandarin: 指从事性服务的男性，通常以收取女性的费用为生。
explanation_english: Refers to a male who engages in sexual services, usually earning a living by charging women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拉咗，因為佢喺酒吧做鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai2 baa1 geui2 zou6 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被抓了，因为他在酒吧当男妓。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested because he worked as a gigolo in a bar.

english_meaning: To work as a prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指从事卖淫活动。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in prostitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢窮到要做鷄，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kung4 dou3 jiu3 zou6 gai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穷到要卖淫，真的很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: She's so poor that she has to work as a prostitute, it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多女仔為咗買名牌袋去做鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 neoi5 zai2 wai6 zo2 maai5 ming4 paai4 doi2 heoi3 zou6 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多女孩子为了买名牌包去做妓女。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many girls become prostitutes to buy designer bags.

english_meaning: to put on a good show; to act out a charade; to feign; to put on an act
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某种目的，故意表演、装模作样。
explanation_english: Refers to intentionally acting or putting on an act, often to achieve a certain goal. It implies deception or insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前做齣好戲，扮晒好勤力咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zou6 ceot1 hou2 hei3, baan6 saai3 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前演一出好戏，假装很勤奋的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on a good show in front of the boss, pretending to be very diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我面前做齣好戲啦，我知你講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 zou6 ceot1 hou2 hei3 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在我面前演戏了，我知道你在说谎。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on an act in front of me, I know you're lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗攞獎，可以做齣好戲，乜都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 lo2 zoeng2, ho2 ji5 zou6 ceot1 hou2 hei3, mat1 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了拿奖，他可以演一出好戏，什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get the award, he can put on a good show and do anything.

english_meaning: to stop, to pause, to park
explanation_mandarin: 停止，不再继续进行；车辆停止不动。
explanation_english: To cease moving or operating; to come to a halt; to park (a vehicle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車停咗喺路邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ting4 zo2 hai2 lou6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车停在路边了。
examples.english_sentence: The car is parked on the roadside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你停一停，諗清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting4 jat1 ting4, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你停一下，想清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Pause for a moment, think it through first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機突然停咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 dat6 jin4 ting4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器突然停止运转了。
examples.english_sentence: The machine suddenly stopped.

english_meaning: to stop, to halt
explanation_mandarin: 停止不动。
explanation_english: To cease moving; to stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你停低啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 ting4 dai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你停下！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, stop!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺路口停低咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 lou6 hau2 ting4 dai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车在路口停下来了。
examples.english_sentence: The car stopped at the intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到有人叫佢，就停低咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 jau5 jan4 giu3 keoi5, zau6 ting4 dai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到有人叫他，就停了下来。
examples.english_sentence: He stopped when he heard someone calling him.

english_meaning: to cease publication; to stop publishing
explanation_mandarin: 停止出版刊物。
explanation_english: To stop or discontinue the publication of a newspaper, magazine, or other periodical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本雜誌因為銷量太差，所以決定下個月停刊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 zaap6 zi3 yan1 wai4 siu1 loeng6 taai3 caa1, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ting4 hon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本杂志因为销量太差，所以决定下个月停刊。
examples.english_sentence: This magazine has decided to cease publication next month because of its poor sales.

english_meaning: Shut up; Stop talking
explanation_mandarin: 停止说话；闭嘴。
explanation_english: To stop talking; to be quiet; shut up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你停口啦！我唔想再聽你講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting4 hau2 laa1! ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 teng1 nei5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住口吧！我不想再听你说话。
examples.english_sentence: Shut up! I don't want to hear you anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嬲起上嚟，就會叫人停口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nau1 hei2 soeng5 lei4, zau6 wui5 giu3 jan4 ting4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生气起来，就会叫人住口。
examples.english_sentence: When he gets angry, he'll tell people to shut up.

english_meaning: To suspend from school; to stop attending school; school suspension
explanation_mandarin: 指学生被学校处分，暂时或永久停止上学。
explanation_english: Refers to a disciplinary action taken by a school, resulting in a student being temporarily or permanently suspended from attending classes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為打交俾學校停學一個禮拜。

examples.english_sentence: Affected by the pandemic, many schools have to suspend classes.

english_meaning: to stop broadcasting; to go off the air; to be suspended (broadcasting)

examples.english_sentence: The machine broke down, and the production line needs to be shut down for a few days before it can be repaired.

english_meaning: to park; to put; to place

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，健姐出马，一定能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, if Ken Jie takes action, she'll definitely handle it.

english_meaning: ace; top player; strongman; excellent player
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一方面特别擅长的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is particularly skilled in a certain area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係足球隊嘅入波健將。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zuk1 kau4 deoi2 ge3 jap6 bo1 gin6 jeung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是足球队的进球健将。
examples.english_sentence: He is the top scorer of the football team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺數學方面係一個健將，咩難題都難唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 sou3 hok6 fong1 min6 hai6 jat1 go3 gin6 jeung3, me1 naan4 tai4 dou1 naan4 m4 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在数学方面是一个健将，什么难题都难不倒他。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is an ace in mathematics; no difficult problem can stump him.

english_meaning: health; healthy
explanation_mandarin: （名）身体或精神没有疾病，机能正常的状态。（形）身体或精神处于健康状态的。
explanation_english: (noun) the state of being free from illness or injury. (adjective) in a good physical or mental condition; in good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 注意飲食，先可以保持健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu3 yi3 jam2 sik6, sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 注意饮食，才可以保持健康。
examples.english_sentence: Pay attention to your diet, only then can you maintain good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅健康狀況好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin6 hong1 zong6 fong3 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的健康状况很差。
examples.english_sentence: His health condition is very poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你身體健康！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你身体健康！
examples.english_sentence: Wish you good health!

english_meaning: fitness dance, aerobics
explanation_mandarin: 一种以音乐配合身体动作，旨在增强体质、保持健康的舞蹈。
explanation_english: A type of dance that combines music and physical movements, designed to improve physical fitness and maintain health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班師奶日日都落公園跳健康舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 baan1 si1 naai1 jat6 jat6 dou1 lok6 gung1 jyun2 tiu3 gin6 hong1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这群家庭主妇每天都去公园跳健身舞。
examples.english_sentence: Our group of housewives goes to the park to do aerobics every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話跳健康舞可以減肥，所以佢就報咗名去學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 tiu3 gin6 hong1 mou5 ho2 ji5 gaam2 fei4, so2 ji5 keoi5 zau6 bou3 zo2 ming4 heoi3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说跳健身舞可以减肥，所以她就报名去学了。
examples.english_sentence: She said doing aerobics can help lose weight, so she signed up to learn.

english_meaning: forgetful, having a poor memory
explanation_mandarin: 容易忘记事情，记性不好。
explanation_english: Having a poor memory; tending to forget things easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近好健忘，成日唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 gin6 mong4, seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近很健忘，总是忘记带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very forgetful lately, always forgetting to bring my keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆開始有啲健忘，成日問我哋食咗飯未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hoi1 chi2 jau5 di1 gin6 mong4, seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5 dei6 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶开始有点健忘，总是问我们吃过饭没有。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is starting to get a little forgetful, she keeps asking us if we've eaten yet.

synonyms: 唔記得嘢 (m4 gei3 dak1 je5)

english_meaning: to walk as if flying; to walk with great speed; to walk swiftly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人走路非常快，好像飞起来一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone walking very quickly, as if they are flying. It implies a sense of lightness and speed in their gait.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆啱啱做完手術，行路都健步如飛，真係好厲害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 ngaam1 ngaam1 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6, haang4 lou6 dou1 gin6 bou6 jyu4 fei1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶刚做完手术，走路都健步如飞，真是很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma just had surgery, but she's already walking as if flying. It's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時唔做運動，但係趕住返工嗰陣時，行路都健步如飛噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 m4 zou6 wan6 dung6, daan6 hai6 gan2 zyu6 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 si4, haang4 lou6 dou1 gin6 bou6 jyu4 fei1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时不做运动，但是赶着上班的时候，走路都健步如飞。
examples.english_sentence: He usually doesn't exercise, but when he's rushing to work, he walks as if flying.

english_meaning: Exercise ball; Swiss ball; massage ball
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于健身的球，通常很大，可以坐在上面或者用它进行各种运动。有时也指用于按摩的小球。
explanation_english: A large inflatable ball used for exercising, often referred to as a Swiss ball or exercise ball. It can be sat on or used for various exercises. It can also refer to a small ball used for massage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個健球返屋企做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 gin6 kau4 faan1 uk1 kei2 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个健身球回家做运动。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an exercise ball to do exercise at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用健球按摩可以舒緩肌肉酸痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yung6 gin6 kau4 on3 mo1 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 gei1 yuk6 syun1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用按摩球按摩可以舒缓肌肉酸痛。
examples.english_sentence: Using a massage ball for massage can relieve muscle soreness.

english_meaning: robust, strapping, well-built, sturdy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或动物的身体强壮结实。
explanation_english: Describes a person or animal as strong and well-built.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔生得好健碩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 sang1 dak1 hou2 gin6 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的儿子长得很健壮。
examples.english_sentence: His son is very well-built.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻馬好健碩，一定跑得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 maa5 hou2 gin6 sek6, jat1 ding6 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这匹马很健壮，一定跑得很快。
examples.english_sentence: This horse is very sturdy, it must run very fast.

english_meaning: gifted writer, prolific writer, facile pen
explanation_mandarin: 形容写作能力很强，文笔流畅、优秀的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone with strong writing skills, possessing a smooth and excellent writing style. It often refers to a prolific or gifted writer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位健筆，啲文章寫得又快又好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 gin6 bat1, di1 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 jau6 faai3 jau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位健笔，文章写得又快又好。
examples.english_sentence: He is a gifted writer. His articles are written quickly and well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報館請咗個健筆嚟寫專欄，希望可以吸引更多讀者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gun2 ceng2 zo2 go3 gin6 bat1 lai4 se2 zyun1 laan4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 gang3 do1 duk6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报社请了一位健笔来写专栏，希望可以吸引更多读者。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper hired a prolific writer to write a column, hoping to attract more readers.

english_meaning: bodybuilding; fitness; muscular and attractive
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体健康且体格健壮、匀称，多指通过锻炼达到这种状态。
explanation_english: Describing a state of being healthy, fit, and muscular, often achieved through exercise and training. Can also refer to the practice of bodybuilding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都去健身室做健美運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 gin3 san1 sat1 zou6 gin6 mei5 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都去健身房做健美运动。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the gym every day to do bodybuilding exercises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身材好健美，睇得出佢好勤力做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 coi4 hou2 gin6 mei5, tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身材很健美，看得出他很努力做运动。
examples.english_sentence: His figure is very fit, you can tell he works out hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得健美比賽嘅評審標準係咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 gin6 mei5 bei2 coi3 ge3 ping4 sam2 biu1 zeon2 hai6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得健美比赛的评审标准是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think are the judging criteria for a bodybuilding competition?

english_meaning: good hearing; hard of hearing (ironic, often used to imply someone is being intentionally deaf)
explanation_mandarin: 指听力很好，听觉很灵敏。有时也反讽指某人装作听不见，不听劝告。
explanation_english: Refers to having good hearing; being able to hear clearly. Sometimes used ironically to imply someone is pretending not to hear or is ignoring advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲咁大，你都聽唔到？你都幾健聽喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 gam3 daai6, nei5 dou1 ting1 m4 dou2? nei5 dou1 gei2 gin6 ting1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他声音那么大，你都没听到？你听力真好啊！（讽刺）
examples.english_sentence: His voice was so loud, and you didn't hear it? You must have very good hearing! (said sarcastically)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆雖然年紀大，但係仍然好健聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seoi1 jin4 nin4 gei2 daai6, daan6 hai6 jing4 jin4 hou2 gin6 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶虽然年纪大，但是听力仍然很好。
examples.english_sentence: Although grandma is old, she still has good hearing.

english_meaning: talkative, articulate, good at conversation
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人善于交谈，口才好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is good at talking, articulate, and enjoys conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好健談，同佢傾偈好開心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gin6 taam4, tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很健谈，和他聊天很开心的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very talkative person, it's a pleasure to chat with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做銷售員一定要夠健談先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 siu1 sau6 jyun4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gau3 gin6 taam4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做销售员一定要足够健谈才行。
examples.english_sentence: You have to be talkative enough to be a salesperson.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然唔係好靚，但係勝在夠健談，好多人都鍾意同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 hou2 leng3, daan6 hai6 sing3 zoi6 gau3 gin6 taam4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她虽然不是特别漂亮，但是胜在够健谈，很多人都喜欢和她做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Although she's not particularly beautiful, she's good at conversation, and many people like to be friends with her.

english_meaning: to work out; to exercise; fitness
explanation_mandarin: 通过运动来保持或增强身体健康。
explanation_english: To improve or maintain physical health through exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都去健身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 heoi3 gin3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个星期都去健身。
examples.english_sentence: I go to the gym every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重健身，身材好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 gin3 san1, san1 coi4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很注重健身，身材很好。
examples.english_sentence: She pays a lot of attention to fitness, she has a great figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 健身唔單止係為咗靚，都為咗健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 san1 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 wai4 zo2 leng3, dou1 wai4 zo2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 健身不仅是为了漂亮，也是为了健康。
examples.english_sentence: Working out is not just for beauty, it's also for health.

mandarin_meaning: 健身单车 / 动感单车
english_meaning: Exercise bike / Stationary bike
explanation_mandarin: 一种室内健身器材，模拟自行车骑行，用于锻炼身体。
explanation_english: A piece of indoor exercise equipment that simulates bicycle riding, used for physical exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都會踩健身單車半個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 caai2 gin3 san1 daan1 ce1 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都会骑健身单车半个小时。
examples.english_sentence: I ride the exercise bike for half an hour every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部健身單車，想喺屋企做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 gin3 san1 daan1 ce1, soeng2 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆健身单车，想在家里做运动。
examples.english_sentence: He bought an exercise bike and wants to exercise at home.

english_meaning: gym, fitness center
explanation_mandarin: 提供健身器材和服务的场所。
explanation_english: A place equipped with exercise equipment and facilities for physical fitness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日去咗健身室做gym。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 gin3 san1 sat1 zou6 gym1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天去了健身房健身。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the gym yesterday to work out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間健身室嘅設備好新㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gin3 san1 sat1 ge3 sat1 bei6 hou2 san1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家健身房的设备很新。
examples.english_sentence: The equipment in this gym is very new.

english_meaning: to think of, to miss, to consider
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，偲通常带有书面语色彩，表示想念或思考。 相对口语化的表达方式是“諗” (諗nam2) 或者 “諗住” (諗住nam2 zyu6)。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "偲" is often used in a more formal or literary context to mean to think of, to miss someone, or to consider something. More colloquial alternatives are "諗" (諗nam2) or "諗住" (諗住nam2 zyu6).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都偲起細個嗰陣嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 coi1 hei2 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我也想起了小时候的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I also thought of things from when I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知佢有冇偲起我呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 mou5 coi1 hei2 ngo5 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道他有没有想起我呢？
examples.english_sentence: I wonder if he has thought of me?

english_meaning: side, lateral, to lean, to incline
explanation_mandarin: 指物体的旁边或倾斜的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the side of an object or a state of inclination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢側住個頭諗嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caak1 zyu6 go3 tau4 lam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他歪着头想事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is tilting his head thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱有啲側，擺唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 jau5 di1 caak1, baai2 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子有点倾斜，放不稳。
examples.english_sentence: The table is a bit tilted, it's not stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車側埋一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 caak1 maai4 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子倾斜到一边。
examples.english_sentence: The car is tilted to one side.

english_meaning: side; beside; next to
explanation_mandarin: 表示方位，指某物体的旁边。
explanation_english: Refers to a location, indicating the side or beside of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱側便有張櫈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 chek1 bin6 jau5 zoeng1 dang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子旁边有一张凳子。
examples.english_sentence: There's a stool beside the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺我側便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 chek1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在我旁边。
examples.english_sentence: He's standing next to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所喺餐廳嘅側便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 hai2 caan1 teng1 ge3 chek1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所在餐厅的旁边。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is beside the restaurant.

english_meaning: to shirk responsibility, to pass the buck, to be half-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 指某人做事不认真，推卸责任，只想应付过去。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious about their work, shirks responsibility, and only wants to get by without putting in effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都側側膊，點搞得掂啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 seng4 jat6 dou1 cek3 cek3 bok3, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是敷衍了事，怎么能做成事呢？
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks responsibility in his work, how can anything get done?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好側側膊啦，認真啲做，唔係會出事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cek3 cek3 bok3 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6, m4 hai6 wui5 chut1 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要敷衍了事，认真点做，不然会出事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be half-hearted, do it seriously, or something bad will happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目唔可以側側膊，一定要做好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 m4 ho2 ji5 cek3 cek3 bok3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目不可以敷衍了事，一定要做好。
examples.english_sentence: This project cannot be done half-heartedly; it must be done well.

jyutping: cek1 cek1 bok3 m4 do1 gok3
mandarin_meaning: 蒙混过关，得过且过，不引人注意
english_meaning: To get away with something by subtly shifting responsibility; to avoid being noticed when shirking responsibility; to slack off and hope nobody notices.
explanation_mandarin: 形容偷偷地承担一部分责任，希望不被发现。通常指在集体工作中，不尽力，希望蒙混过关。
explanation_english: Describes subtly shifting responsibility or shirking duty in a way that is hoped to go unnoticed. Commonly used in situations where someone avoids full responsibility in a group setting, hoping to get away with doing less work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺小組入面側側膊唔多覺，結果搞到成個project都做得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 siu2 zou2 jap6 min6 cek1 cek1 bok3 m4 do1 gok3, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 project dou1 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在小组里蒙混过关，结果导致整个项目都做得不好。
examples.english_sentence: He slacked off in the group project hoping nobody would notice, and as a result, the entire project was done poorly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住側側膊唔多覺呀，老細睇住你做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 cek1 cek1 bok3 m4 do1 gok3 aa3, lou5 sai3 tai2 zyu6 nei5 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着蒙混过关，老板盯着你工作呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can slack off and nobody will notice, the boss is watching you work.

english_meaning: unorthodox, unconventional, not mainstream, a bit dodgy
explanation_mandarin: 指不正当的手段，不正统的方法，带贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to unorthodox or unconventional methods, often implying that they are a bit dodgy, underhanded, or not quite legitimate. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗埋啲側堂嘅方法嚟搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lam2 maai4 di1 caak1 tong4 ge3 fong1 faat3 lai4 wan2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想一些旁门左道的方法来赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks of unorthodox ways to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用側堂方法解決問題，遲早會出事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 caak1 tong4 fong1 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用旁门左道解决问题，迟早会出事的。
examples.english_sentence: Using unorthodox methods to solve problems will eventually lead to trouble.

english_meaning: cartwheel
explanation_mandarin: 一种体操动作，身体侧向，依次以两手和两脚着地，身体倒立并旋转。
explanation_english: A gymnastic exercise in which a person turns sideways, placing first one hand and then the other on the ground, raising the legs in the air between, and landing on first one foot and then the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺草地上面表演咗個側手翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cou2 dei6 soeng6 min6 biu2 jin2 zo2 go3 caak1 sau2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在草地上表演了一个侧手翻。
examples.english_sentence: He performed a cartwheel on the grass.

english_meaning: Side leakage (usually referring to menstrual leakage)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指女性月经期间，经血从卫生巾或卫生棉条侧面漏出。
explanation_english: Typically refers to menstrual blood leaking from the side of a sanitary pad or tampon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日瞓覺嗰陣側漏，搞到張床單都污糟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 cak1 lau6, gaau2 dou2 zoeng1 cong4 daan1 dou1 wu1 zou1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天睡觉的时候侧漏了，把床单都弄脏了。
examples.english_sentence: I had side leakage while sleeping yesterday, and it stained the bedsheets.

english_meaning: to look askance at, to regard with disapproval or suspicion
explanation_mandarin: 斜着眼睛看，表示不满、厌恶、怀疑或惧怕。
explanation_english: To look at someone or something sideways, often implying disapproval, suspicion, fear, or contempt. It suggests a negative or critical observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，搞到同事側目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 tung4 si6 caak1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，搞得同事侧目。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, causing his colleagues to look askance at him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁嘅行為，唔怪得人哋側目啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ge3 hang4 wai4, m4 gwaai3 dak1 jan4 dei6 caak1 muk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样的行为，难怪别人侧目。
examples.english_sentence: With behavior like yours, it's no wonder people look at you with disapproval.

english_meaning: to hear indirectly; to hear from the grapevine; to overhear
explanation_mandarin: 指间接地听到，不是直接听到的消息。
explanation_english: Refers to hearing something indirectly, not directly hearing the news or information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我側聞佢好快會升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 caak1 man4 keoi5 hou2 faai3 wui5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说他很快就会升职。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he will be promoted soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 側聞你哋公司就嚟執笠，係咪真㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: caak1 man4 nei5 dei6 gung1 si1 zau6 lei4 zaap1 laap1, hai6 mai6 zan1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说你们公司快要倒闭了，是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: I heard your company is going bankrupt, is it true?

mandarin_meaning: 不负责任, 推卸责任
english_meaning: To shirk responsibility; to pass the buck; to evade responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 指推卸责任，不肯承担。
explanation_english: Refers to shirking responsibility and refusing to take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢永遠都側膊，乜都唔肯負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 cek3 bok3, mat1 dou1 m4 hang2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是推卸责任，什么都不肯负责。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks responsibility at work and is unwilling to take responsibility for anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好側膊啦，件事係你搞出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cek3 bok3 laa1, gin6 si6 hai6 nei5 gaau2 chut1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要推卸责任了，这件事是你搞出来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pass the buck, you're the one who caused this problem.

english_meaning: to closely follow, to shadow, to tail
explanation_mandarin: 紧贴跟随某人或某物，通常带有监视或保护的意味。
explanation_english: To closely follow someone or something, often with the implication of surveillance or protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢側跟住個疑犯，睇吓佢會去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cak1 gan1 zoek6 go3 ji4 faan6, tai2 haa5 keoi5 wui5 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧跟着那个嫌疑犯，看看他会去哪里。
examples.english_sentence: He is closely following the suspect to see where he goes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日側跟住我，好似怕我會唔見咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 cak1 gan1 zoek6 ngo5, hou2 ci5 paa3 ngo5 wui5 m4 gin3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈整天紧跟着我，好像怕我会走丢一样。
examples.english_sentence: My mom follows me around all day, as if she's afraid I'll get lost.

english_meaning: to turn sideways; to move aside; to edge one's way
explanation_mandarin: 身体向旁边转动或移动。
explanation_english: To turn or move the body sideways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你側身讓下，我出唔到去呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 cek1 san1 joeng6 haa5, ngo5 ceot1 m4 dou2 heoi3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你侧身让一下，我出不去啊。
examples.english_sentence: Please move aside a bit, I can't get out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺人群度側身行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jan4 kwan4 dou6 cek1 san1 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在人群中侧身行走。
examples.english_sentence: He edged his way through the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢側身避開咗架車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cek1 san1 bei6 hoi1 zo2 gaa3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他侧身躲开了车。
examples.english_sentence: He moved aside to avoid the car.

english_meaning: close associate; confidant; right-hand man
explanation_mandarin: 指非常亲近和信任的人，通常在权力或影响力方面扮演重要角色，是领导者或重要人物身边的心腹。
explanation_english: Refers to a close and trusted associate, often playing a significant role in terms of power or influence, and being a confidant of a leader or important figure; someone very close to the person in power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係老細嘅側近，好多嘢都係佢搞掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lou5 sai3 ge3 caak3 gan6, ho2 do1 ye5 dou1 hai6 keoi5 gaau2 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是老板的亲信，很多事情都是他搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss's close associate, and he handles many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要上位，首先要搞掂佢嘅側近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yiu3 soeng5 wai2, sau2 sin1 yiu3 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 ge3 caak3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要上位，首先要搞定他的亲信。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to climb up the ladder, you first need to deal with his close associates.

english_meaning: side, beside, next to
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或空间的侧面，旁边。
explanation_english: Refers to the side of an object or space, or the area next to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺我側邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 cek3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在我旁边。
examples.english_sentence: He is standing beside me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖頭喺銀行側邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau4 hai2 ngan4 hong4 cek3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店在银行旁边。
examples.english_sentence: The shop is next to the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我張枱側邊有本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 toi2 cek3 bin1 jau5 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的桌子旁边有一本书。
examples.english_sentence: There is a book on the side of my desk.

english_meaning: to emphasize; to put/lay stress on; to focus on; to give priority to
explanation_mandarin: 偏重于某一方面，重视。
explanation_english: To place particular emphasis on one aspect or area; to give more weight or importance to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校側重學生嘅學術成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 caak1 zung6 hok6 sang1 ge3 hok6 seot6 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校侧重学生的学术成绩。
examples.english_sentence: This school emphasizes students' academic performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該側重培養學生嘅批判性思維。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 caak1 zung6 pui4 yeung5 hok6 sang1 ge3 pai1 pun3 sing3 si1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该侧重培养学生的批判性思维。
examples.english_sentence: We should focus on cultivating students' critical thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府側重發展經濟，但係忽略咗環境保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 caak1 zung6 faat3 zin2 ging1 zai3, daan6 hai6 fat1 lyue6 zo2 waan4 ging2 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府侧重发展经济，但是忽略了环境保护。
examples.english_sentence: The government emphasizes economic development, but neglects environmental protection.

english_meaning: side mirror; wing mirror
explanation_mandarin: 汽车或其他车辆的侧面安装的后视镜，用于驾驶员观察车辆侧后方的交通情况。
explanation_english: A side mirror or wing mirror on a vehicle, used by the driver to see traffic behind and to the side of the vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇側鏡嗰陣要留意盲點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 cak1 geng3 go2 zan6 jiu3 lau4 ji3 maang5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看后视镜的时候要注意盲点。
examples.english_sentence: When looking in the side mirror, be aware of blind spots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我架車嘅側鏡爛咗，要換過個新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 ge3 cak1 geng3 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 gwo3 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的车的后视镜坏了，要换一个新的。
examples.english_sentence: My car's side mirror is broken, I need to replace it with a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 侧门; 后门; 非正规途径
english_meaning: Side door; back door; unofficial channel; workaround; shortcut
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是旁边的门，也常比喻非正规的途径或者方法，指通过不正当或者不公开的手段达到目的。
explanation_english: Literally means 'side door'. Figuratively, it often refers to an unofficial channel or method, referring to achieving a goal through improper or non-public means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想行側門入政府部門做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hang4 cak1 mun4 jap6 zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想走后门进政府部门工作。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use a back door to get into a government department to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住行側門，正正經經考入去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 hang4 cak1 mun4, zing3 zing3 ging1 ging1 haau2 jap6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着走后门，正正经经地考进去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about taking shortcuts; just study and pass the exam fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入大學係靠阿爸行側門嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 daai6 hok6 hai6 kaau3 aa3 baa1 hang4 cak1 mun4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上大学是靠他爸走后门的关系。
examples.english_sentence: He got into university because his father used connections (went through the back door).

english_meaning: side; lateral aspect; indirectly; from the side; from an angle; to insinuate
explanation_mandarin: （名词）指物体或事情的旁边或侧边的部分；（副词）指不直接地，婉转地。
explanation_english: (noun) side; lateral aspect; (adverb) indirectly; obliquely; from the side; from an angle; to insinuate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢側面咁睇好靚仔喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caak1 min6 gam3 tai2 hou2 leng3 zai2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他侧面看很帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: He looks so handsome from the side!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以側面了解下佢嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 caak1 min6 liu4 gaai2 haa5 keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以从侧面了解一下他的想法。
examples.english_sentence: We can try to understand his thoughts indirectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢側面問我幾時結婚，好似想做媒人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caak1 min6 man6 ngo5 gei2 si4 git3 fan1, hou2 ci5 soeng2 zou6 mui4 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他侧面问我什么时候结婚，好像想做媒人一样。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me indirectly when I'm getting married, it seems like he wants to be a matchmaker.

english_meaning: Tilting one's head repeatedly and suspiciously; acting evasively or shiftily; behaving in a sneaky or dodgy manner
explanation_mandarin: 形容人经常歪着头，让人觉得很可疑，或者形容人行为举止不正经、鬼鬼祟祟的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who repeatedly tilts their head, giving off a suspicious or evasive impression. It can also refer to someone behaving in a shifty, sneaky, or untrustworthy manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢側頭側腦，睇落好古惑咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 cek3 tau4 cek3 nou5, tai2 lok6 hou2 gu2 waak6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话歪头歪脑的，看起来很狡猾。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks while tilting his head, looking very cunning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好側頭側腦，有咩就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cek3 tau4 cek3 nou5, jau5 me1 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要歪头歪脑的，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be evasive, just say what you want to say directly.

synonyms: 鬼鬼鼠鼠 (gwai2 gwai2 syu2 syu2)

english_meaning: side wind, crosswind
explanation_mandarin: 从侧面吹来的风。
explanation_english: Wind blowing from the side; a crosswind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日揸車要小心啲，側風好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, caak1 fung1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天开车要小心一点，侧风很大。
examples.english_sentence: Drive carefully today, the crosswind is strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭飛機嗰陣遇到側風，搞到架機好顛簸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 fei1 gei1 go2 zan6 jyu6 dou2 caak1 fung1, gaau2 dou3 gaa3 gei1 hou2 din1 bo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐飞机的时候遇到侧风，搞得飞机很颠簸。
examples.english_sentence: We encountered crosswind during the flight, making the plane very bumpy.

english_meaning: to investigate; to detect; to spy; detective
explanation_mandarin: 调查，暗中察看情况；侦探，从事侦查工作的人。
explanation_english: To investigate or detect something covertly; also refers to a detective or someone who does investigative work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係偵緝人員，專門負責調查啲罪案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 zing1 ap1 yan4 yun4, zyun1 mun4 fu6 zaak3 di1 zeoi6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是侦缉人员，专门负责调查罪案。
examples.english_sentence: They are detectives, specializing in investigating crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方需要多啲線索嚟偵破呢單案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 seoi1 yiu3 do1 di1 sin3 sok3 lai4 zing1 po3 ni1 daan1 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方需要更多的线索来侦破这起案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police need more clues to solve this case.

english_meaning: to scout; to reconnoiter; reconnaissance
explanation_mandarin: 指为了了解敌情、地形等情况而进行的调查或活动。
explanation_english: To observe or explore (an area or enemy) in order to gain information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋派咗啲士兵去偵察敵軍嘅位置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 paai3 zo2 di1 si6 bing1 heoi3 zing1 caat3 dik6 gwan1 ge3 wai6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们派了一些士兵去侦察敌军的位置。
examples.english_sentence: We sent some soldiers to scout out the enemy's position.

english_meaning: reconnaissance aircraft, spy plane
explanation_mandarin: 用于侦察敌情的飞机。
explanation_english: An aircraft used for reconnaissance, gathering information about enemy forces or activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架偵察機喺邊境附近飛行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 zing1 caat3 gei1 hai2 bin1 ging2 fu6 gan6 fei4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那架侦察机在边境附近飞行。
examples.english_sentence: That reconnaissance aircraft is flying near the border.

english_meaning: detective, investigator
explanation_mandarin: 指以调查研究为职业，搜集证据以查明案件真相的人。
explanation_english: A person whose profession is to investigate facts, collect evidence, and solve crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係做個私家偵探。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 go3 si1 gaa1 zing1 taam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一名私家侦探。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a private detective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲講述一位偵探點樣破解一單神秘案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 suk6 jat1 wai2 zing1 taam3 dim2 joeng6 po3 gaai2 jat1 daan1 san4 bei3 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述了一位侦探如何破解一起神秘案件。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of how a detective solves a mysterious case.

english_meaning: investigate; reconnaissance; investigation
explanation_mandarin: 为查明案件事实而进行的调查活动。也可以指军事上的侦察活动。
explanation_english: To investigate and gather information, especially concerning a crime; reconnaissance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正喺度偵查緊呢單案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 hai2 dou6 zing1 caa4 gan2 ni1 daan1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在侦查这起案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police are investigating this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派咗偵查隊去搜集情報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 zo2 zing1 caa4 deoi2 heoi3 sau1 zip6 cing4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派出了侦查队去搜集情报。
examples.english_sentence: They sent out a reconnaissance team to gather intelligence.

english_meaning: to detect; to sense; detection
explanation_mandarin: 通过仪器或方法发现、探测到某事物。
explanation_english: To discover or detect something through instruments or methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機可以偵測到空氣入面嘅有害物質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 ho2 ji5 zing1 caak1 dou3 hung1 hei3 jap6 min6 ge3 wui6 hoi6 mat6 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器可以侦测到空气中的有害物质。
examples.english_sentence: This machine can detect harmful substances in the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦病毒偵測到一個新嘅病毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 beng6 duk6 zing1 caak1 dou3 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 beng6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑病毒侦测到一个新的病毒。
examples.english_sentence: The computer antivirus detected a new virus.

english_meaning: to solve (a crime); to crack (a case)

explanation_english: Refers to an entertainer or public figure being overly concerned about their image and afraid of doing anything that might damage it. It can also refer to ordinary people being overly concerned about what others think of them and constantly trying to maintain a perfect image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁大嘅偶包，唔敢喺街邊食嘢㗎。

examples.english_sentence: He used many tricks, stealing the sky and replacing the sun, to transfer the company's money to his own account.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司经常偷梁换柱，卖假货给顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This company often deceives its customers by selling counterfeit goods.

english_meaning: to cut corners (on a project); to skimp on materials; to do a shoddy job
explanation_mandarin: 在工程或产品制作中，偷懒减少工序或使用劣质材料以降低成本。
explanation_english: To reduce labor or use inferior materials in a project or product manufacturing process in order to lower costs, resulting in poor quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司起樓偷工減料，遲早出事。

examples.english_sentence: This company cuts corners when building, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 kau4 kei4, jat1 ding6 hai6 tau1 gung1 gaam2 liu2.

english_meaning: to learn secretly by observing; to steal knowledge or skills; to learn on the sly; to pick up skills without formal training
explanation_mandarin: 暗中学习别人的技能或知识。通常指未经允许或正式学习，通过观察模仿来获取。
explanation_english: To learn skills or knowledge secretly by observing others. This usually refers to acquiring skills or knowledge through observation and imitation without permission or formal training.

explanation_mandarin: 指未经许可或秘密地拍摄照片或视频。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人偷拍了我的证件。
examples.english_sentence: Someone secretly took a picture of my ID card.

jyutping: tau1 dak1 fau4 sang1 bun3 jat6 haan4
english_meaning: To steal a moment of leisure in a busy life; to snatch a break from a hectic schedule.
explanation_mandarin: 在繁忙的生活中偷得一点空闲时间享受生活。
explanation_english: Describes the act of finding a rare moment of peace and relaxation amidst a busy or stressful life. It emphasizes the appreciation of this brief respite.

explanation_english: Refers to the act of subtly changing the meaning of a concept during an argument, making it appear the same on the surface but actually different, in order to deceive or mislead.

explanation_english: To subtly change the meaning of a term during an argument, often to mislead or deceive. It involves using the same word or phrase with different meanings in different parts of the argument, making the conclusion appear to follow logically when it actually doesn't.

examples.english_sentence: He was arrested by the police for theft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場入面周不時都有偷竊案發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 zau1 bat1 si4 dou1 jau5 tau1 sit3 on3 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场里面时不时都会发生偷窃案。
examples.english_sentence: Thefts happen from time to time in shopping malls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偷竊係犯法嘅，唔好貪一時之快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau1 sit3 hai6 faan6 faat3 ge3, m4 hou2 taam1 jat1 si4 zi1 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 偷窃是犯法的，不要贪图一时之快。
examples.english_sentence: Stealing is illegal, don't give in to momentary greed.

english_meaning: to chuckle; to snicker; to laugh secretly
explanation_mandarin: 偷偷地笑，不让人发现。
explanation_english: To laugh secretly, often trying to conceal the laughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到我講嘅嘢之後，喺度偷笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 ngo5 gong2 ge3 ye5 zi1 hau6, hai2 dou6 tau1 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到我说的话之后，在那里偷笑。
examples.english_sentence: After he heard what I said, he was chuckling to himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁樣衰，我忍唔住偷笑咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 joeng2 seoi1, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 tau1 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他那个样子，我忍不住偷笑了出来。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him looking so ridiculous, I couldn't help but snicker.

english_meaning: to eavesdrop, to listen in secretly
explanation_mandarin: 暗中、偷偷地听别人讲话。
explanation_english: To secretly listen to other people's conversations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偷聽人哋講嘢啦，冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tau1 teng1 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 laa1, mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要偷听别人说话，没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eavesdrop on other people's conversations, it's impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係有意偷聽，係佢哋講嘢太大聲啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 ji3 tau1 teng1, hai6 keoi5 dei6 gong2 je5 taai3 daai6 seng1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是故意偷听，是他们说话声音太大了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't mean to eavesdrop, it's just that they were talking too loud.

english_meaning: To have an affair, to cheat on (a partner)
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚或有稳定伴侣的人与他人发生不正当关系，搞外遇。
explanation_english: Refers to a married person or someone in a stable relationship having an affair or cheating on their partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結咗婚冇耐就偷腥，真係離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1 mou5 noi6 zau6 tau1 sing1, zan1 hai6 lei4 pu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结婚没多久就偷情，真是离谱。
examples.english_sentence: He had an affair shortly after getting married, it's really outrageous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再偷腥喇，唔係嘅話後果自負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 tau1 sing1 laa3, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 hau6 gwo2 zi6 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再偷情了，不然的话后果自负。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat anymore, or you'll be responsible for the consequences.

english_meaning: to cut corners (in work); to skimp on materials; to do shoddy work; to be slipshod
explanation_mandarin: 指工作时偷懒，减少工序或使用劣质材料以节省成本，导致质量下降。
explanation_english: Refers to cutting corners during work, reducing the amount of work done, or using inferior materials to save costs, resulting in a decrease in quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個裝修佬好鍾意偷薄，啲料用得好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zong1 sau1 lou2 hou2 zung1 ji3 tau1 bok6, di1 liu2 yung6 dak1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个装修工人很喜欢偷工减料，用的材料很差。
examples.english_sentence: This renovation worker really likes to cut corners, using very poor quality materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好偷薄呀，唔係會出問題㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tau1 bok6 aa3, m4 hai6 wui5 chut1 man6 tai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要偷工减料，不然会出问题的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cut corners, or there will be problems!

english_meaning: surprise attack, sneak attack
explanation_mandarin: 指在敌人毫无防备的情况下突然进行攻击。
explanation_english: To attack unexpectedly and secretly; a surprise or sneak attack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋夜晚偷襲敵人嘅營地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 je6 maan5 tau1 sik6 dik1 jan4 dei6 ge3 jing4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们晚上偷袭敌人的营地。
examples.english_sentence: They launched a surprise attack on the enemy's camp at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次偷襲令到對方損失慘重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 tau1 sik6 ling6 dou3 deoi3 fong1 syun2 sat1 caam2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次偷袭让对方损失惨重。
examples.english_sentence: This surprise attack caused heavy losses to the other side.

english_meaning: to steal; to sneak away; to run off with
explanation_mandarin: 指偷偷地拿走或带走。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly taking or running away with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁我唔注意偷走咗我部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 ngo5 m4 zyu3 yi3 tau1 zau2 zo2 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁我不注意偷走了我的手机。
examples.english_sentence: He stole my phone while I wasn't paying attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓偷走咗條魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 tau1 zau2 zo2 tiu4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫偷走了鱼。
examples.english_sentence: The cat stole the fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想偷走啲機密文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 tau1 zau2 di1 gei1 mat6 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想偷走一些机密文件。
examples.english_sentence: They wanted to steal some confidential documents.

mandarin_meaning: 暗中约会; 背着伴侣约会
english_meaning: to date secretly; to cheat on (a partner) by going out with someone else; to go behind someone's back
explanation_mandarin: 指背着伴侣，暗中与其他人约会，通常带有不正当关系的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly dating someone other than your partner, usually implying an illicit relationship. It suggests betrayal and secrecy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚之後仲成日偷跳，真係唔要得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zung6 seng4 jat6 tau1 tiu3, zan1 hai6 m4 jiu3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结婚之后还经常偷偷约会，真是不应该。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps dating secretly even after getting married; it's really unacceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我唔知你同阿玲偷跳啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 dou3 nei5 tung4 aa3 ling4 tau1 tiu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为我不知道你和阿玲偷偷约会的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I don't know about you dating Ah Ling secretly.

english_meaning: to smuggle; to traffic; to stow away
explanation_mandarin: 指秘密地运输违禁品或人员非法出入境。
explanation_english: To secretly transport contraband goods or people illegally across borders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懷疑佢偷運毒品入境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waai4 ji4 keoi5 tau1 wan6 duk6 ban2 jap6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们怀疑他偷运毒品入境。
examples.english_sentence: They suspect him of smuggling drugs into the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲人偷運咗好多象牙出非洲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jan4 tau1 wan6 zo2 hou2 do1 zoeng6 ngaa4 chut1 fei1 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人从非洲偷运了很多象牙出来。
examples.english_sentence: Those people smuggled a lot of ivory out of Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關捉到有人偷運走私煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 zuk1 dou2 jau5 jan4 tau1 wan6 zau2 si1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关抓到有人偷运走私烟。
examples.english_sentence: Customs caught someone smuggling contraband cigarettes.

english_meaning: to steal a moment of leisure; to snatch some free time; to take a break
explanation_mandarin: 在繁忙之中抽出空閒的時間休息或做自己喜歡的事情。
explanation_english: To take a moment of leisure or do something you enjoy amidst a busy schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏晝食完飯，我偷閒落公園行咗陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 zau3 sik6 jyun4 faan6, ngo5 tau1 haan4 lok6 gung1 jyun2 haang4 zo2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中午吃完饭，我偷空去公园走了一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: After lunch, I stole a moment to take a walk in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 難得今日唔使OT，等我偷閒睇套戲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naan4 dak1 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 OT, dang2 ngo5 tau1 haan4 tai2 tou3 hei3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 难得今天不用加班，让我偷空看部电影先。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare that I don't need to work overtime today, let me snatch some free time to watch a movie first.

mandarin_meaning: 偷懒取巧; 占小便宜
english_meaning: To slack off; to cut corners; to cheat a little; to take advantage of a loophole; to try to get away with something; to get away with something easily.
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或学习中偷懒、耍滑头，想用不正当手段获得好处或避免困难。也指抓住机会占小便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to slacking off, cutting corners, or trying to gain advantages or avoid difficulties through dishonest means in work or study. It can also refer to seizing an opportunity to take a small advantage or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偷雞呀！要認真做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tau1 gai1 aa3! jiu3 jing6 zan1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别偷懒！要认真工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off! You need to work seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日偷雞，所以老細唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tau1 gai1, so2 ji5 lou5 sai3 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是偷懒，所以老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off, so the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想偷雞過關，點知俾人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tau1 gai1 gwo3 gwaan1, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想偷偷蒙混过关，结果被人抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to try to get away with it, but he got caught.

jyutping: tau1 gai1 m4 dou2 sit3 zaa3 mai5
english_meaning: To try to gain a small advantage by dishonest means but end up losing more than you gained.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻想占小便宜，结果反而吃了大亏。偷鸡指想通过不正当的手段获取好处。拃米指一把米，表示很小的利益。整个成语形容贪小便宜吃大亏。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone attempts to gain a small, unfair advantage (represented by 'stealing a chicken') but ends up losing more than they initially intended to gain (represented by 'losing a handful of rice'). It's used to illustrate the consequences of being greedy or trying to cut corners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住炒賣口罩賺一筆，點知買貴咗，偷雞唔到蝕拃米，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 caau2 maai6 hau2 zaau3 zaan6 jat1 bat1, dim2 zi1 maai5 gwai3 zo2, tau1 gai1 m4 dou2 sit3 zaa3 mai5, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想炒卖口罩赚一笔钱，结果买贵了，偷鸡不成蚀把米，赔了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could make a profit by speculating on masks, but he bought them at a high price. He tried to gain a small advantage but ended up losing a lot of money.

jyutping: tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5
english_meaning: Trying to take a shortcut and failing, ending up losing more than you initially had.
explanation_mandarin: 原意是想偷鸡没偷成，反而把用来引诱鸡的米也赔进去了。比喻想占便宜没占到，反而吃了亏。
explanation_english: The literal meaning is 'trying to steal a chicken but failing and losing the rice used as bait.' It figuratively means attempting to gain a small advantage but failing and ending up worse off than before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住炒股賺快錢，點知偷雞唔到蝕揸米，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 caau2 gu2 zaan6 faai3 cin2, dim2 zi1 tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想着炒股赚快钱，结果偷鸡不成反蚀把米，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was thinking of making quick money by speculating on stocks, but he ended up losing more than he had, trying to get a free ride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住走精面，分分鐘偷雞唔到蝕揸米㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 zau2 zing1 min6, fan1 fan1 zung1 tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着占小便宜，很可能会偷鸡不成反蚀把米啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to be too clever, you might end up losing more than you gain.

synonyms: 得不償失 (dak1 bat1 soeng4 sat1)

jyutping: tau1 gai1 m4 sing4 sit3 zaa1 mai5
english_meaning: Tried to steal a chicken but ended up losing rice; attempted a petty advantage but suffered a greater loss; a failed attempt to cheat or gain a small advantage resulted in a larger loss.
explanation_mandarin: 想占小便宜没占到，反而吃了大亏。比喻想耍小聪明反而损失更大。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone tries to take a shortcut or gain a small advantage, but their plan backfires and they end up losing more than they would have if they had just done things properly or honestly. It implies that the person was trying to be clever or sneaky, but was ultimately unsuccessful and suffered a greater loss as a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想考試偷睇人哋嘅答案，點知俾老師捉到，結果成科唔合格，真係偷雞唔成蝕揸米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 haau2 si3 tau1 tai2 jan4 dei6 ge3 daap3 aan3, dim2 zi1 bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2, git3 gwo2 sing4 fo1 m4 hap1 gaak3, zan1 hai6 tau1 gai1 m4 sing4 sit3 zaa1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想考试偷看别人的答案，没想到被老师抓到，结果这门课不及格，真是偷鸡不成反蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to cheat on the exam by looking at other people's answers, but he got caught by the teacher, and as a result, he failed the whole subject. It's a classic case of trying to steal a chicken and losing rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住炒股賺快錢，點知輸晒啲錢，真係偷雞唔成蝕揸米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 caau2 gu2 zaan6 faai3 cin2, dim2 zi1 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2, zan1 hai6 tau1 gai1 m4 sing4 sit3 zaa1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本想炒股赚快钱，没想到把钱都输光了，真是偷鸡不成反蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I could make a quick buck by playing the stock market, but I lost all my money. It's really trying to steal a chicken and losing rice.

english_meaning: Sneaky; furtive; engaging in underhanded activities
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为不光明正大，偷偷摸摸，暗中做一些不好的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting furtively or underhandedly, engaging in sneaky or dishonest activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都偷雞摸狗，唔知搞乜鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都偷偷摸摸的，不知道在搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting so sneaky, I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偷雞摸狗，有咩事咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2, jau5 me1 si6 mai5 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要偷偷摸摸的，有什么事就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sneaky, if you have something to say, just say it directly.

english_meaning: To eat on the sly; to have an affair; to cheat (on a partner)
explanation_mandarin: 指偷偷地吃东西，也指婚外情或不忠行为。
explanation_english: Refers to eating something secretly. Also refers to extramarital affairs or infidelity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老公喺出面偷食，俾佢發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 gung1 hai2 cheut1 min6 tau1 sik6, bei2 keoi5 faat3 yin6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她老公在外面搞外遇，被她发现了。
examples.english_sentence: Her husband had an affair and she found out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔偷食糖，俾阿媽鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 tau1 sik6 tong2, bei2 aa3 maa1 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子偷吃糖，被妈妈骂了。
examples.english_sentence: The child secretly ate candy and was scolded by his mother.

english_meaning: To steal food without wiping your mouth; to do something wrong and leave obvious evidence; to deny wrongdoing in the face of clear evidence.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做了坏事，却留下明显的痕迹，试图掩盖却无法掩盖。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone has done something wrong or committed an indiscretion and then tries to cover it up, but does so clumsily, leaving obvious evidence of their guilt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明偷食唔抹嘴，啲口紅印晒喺恤衫度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 tau1 sik6 m4 maat3 zeoi2, di1 hau2 hung4 jan3 saai3 hai2 seot1 saam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很明显就是偷吃了不擦嘴，口红印全都印在衬衫上了。
examples.english_sentence: He's clearly trying to get away with something, but he's done a terrible job covering it up. The lipstick stains are all over his shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，仲話唔關佢事，真係偷食唔抹嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zung6 waa6 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6, zan1 hai6 tau1 sik6 m4 maat3 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常迟到，还说和他没关系，真是偷吃不擦嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late and claims it's not his fault, it's a clear case of trying to hide the evidence.

synonyms: 掩耳盜鈴 (jim2 ji5 dou3 ling4)
欲蓋彌彰 (juk6 goi3 mei4 cheung1)

jyutping: tau1 sik6 m4 sik1 kiu4 zeoi2
english_meaning: To steal food without knowing how to wipe your mouth; to do something wrong and not cover your tracks well; to be sloppy in covering up wrongdoing.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做了坏事却不懂得掩饰，留下明显破绽。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who has done something wrong, like 'stealing food', but doesn't know how to cover it up effectively, leaving obvious clues or evidence of their wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次偷懶都俾老細捉到，真係偷食唔識撟嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 tau1 laan5 dou1 bei2 lou5 sai3 zuk1 dou2, zan1 hai6 tau1 sik6 m4 sik1 kiu4 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次偷懒都被老板抓到，真是偷吃不擦嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets caught slacking off by the boss; he really doesn't know how to cover his tracks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋做得咁唔小心，偷食唔識撟嘴，遲早會出事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 zou6 dak1 gam3 m4 siu2 sam1, tau1 sik6 m4 sik1 kiu4 zeoi2, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们做得这么不小心，偷吃不擦嘴，迟早会出事的。
examples.english_sentence: You guys are being so careless, not covering your tracks. Sooner or later, something bad will happen.

mandarin_meaning: 偷机 (tōu jī); 偷懶 (tōu lǎn); 佔便宜 (zhàn piányi)
english_meaning: To slack off; to cut corners; to take a shortcut; to cheat; to pull a fast one; to get away with something
explanation_mandarin: 本意指偷雞，引申為偷懶、耍滑頭，或者以不正當手段佔便宜。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to steal a chicken'. Figuratively, it means to slack off, try to get away with something, cut corners, cheat, or take advantage of a situation using illegitimate methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日偷雞，所以老闆好唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 tau1 gai1, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 hou2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是偷懒，所以老板很不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off at work, so the boss doesn't like him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺考試偷雞，一定要努力溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 haau2 si3 tau1 gai1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着在考试中作弊，一定要努力复习。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about cheating on the exam, you must study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想偷雞走數，點知俾人發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tau1 gai1 zau2 sou3, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想赖账，没想到被人发现了。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to get away without paying, but he was found out.

jyutping: tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5
english_meaning: Trying to steal a chicken but failing and losing the rice used as bait; to try to gain an advantage but end up worse off than before.
explanation_mandarin: 本想占便宜，结果反而吃了亏。形容想占小便宜反而损失更大。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone tries to take advantage of a situation or gain a small benefit, but ends up losing more than they would have gained. The 'chicken' represents the desired gain, and the 'rice' represents the resources lost in the failed attempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺股票市場撈油水，點知偷鷄唔到蝕揸米，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 gu2 piu3 si5 coeng4 laau1 jau4 seoi2, dim2 zi1 tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在股票市场捞点好处，结果偷鸡不成反蚀把米，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to make a quick profit in the stock market, but he ended up losing a lot of money because he tried to cut corners and failed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明想呃公司啲辦公用品，點知俾人發現咗，結果仲俾人炒埋，真係偷鷄唔到蝕揸米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 soeng2 aak1 gung1 si1 di1 baan6 gung1 jung6 ban2, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin3 zo2, git3 gwo2 zung6 bei2 jan4 caau2 maai4, zan1 hai6 tau1 gai1 m4 dou3 sit3 zaa1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明想骗取公司的一些办公用品，结果被人发现了，结果还被解雇了，真是偷鸡不成反蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming tried to embezzle some office supplies from the company, but he got caught and ended up getting fired. It was truly a case of trying to steal a chicken and losing the rice used as bait.

jyutping: tau1 gai1 m4 sing4 sit1 zaa1 mai5
mandarin_meaning: 偷鸡不成蚀把米 (tōu jī bù chéng shí bǎ mǐ)
english_meaning: To try to steal a chicken and end up losing the rice you were holding; to try to gain a small advantage but end up losing more than you intended.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻想占小便宜，结果反而吃了大亏。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone attempts to gain a small advantage or profit, but ultimately ends up losing something more valuable. The imagery comes from trying to steal a chicken but losing the rice they were carrying while trying to do so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想呃人啲錢，點知俾人反呃，真係偷鷄唔成蝕揸米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 aak1 jan4 di1 cin2, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 faan2 aak1, zan1 hai6 tau1 gai1 m4 sing4 sit1 zaa1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想骗别人的钱，没想到被别人反骗了，真是偷鸡不成蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to cheat others out of their money, but unexpectedly got scammed himself. It's a classic case of trying to steal a chicken and losing the rice.

mandarin_meaning: 偷偷摸摸; 搞不正当关系
english_meaning: To be sneaky and underhanded; to engage in illicit affairs (romantic or otherwise); to be up to no good.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为不正，偷偷摸摸地做坏事，或者指男女之间有不正当的关系。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is sneaky and does bad things secretly, or refers to an illicit romantic relationship between a man and a woman. It implies engaging in shady or underhanded activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都偷鷄摸狗，唔知搞乜鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天偷偷摸摸的，不知道在搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being sneaky, I wonder what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個偷鷄摸狗，公司啲人都知道晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2, gung1 si1 di1 jan4 dou1 zi1 dou3晒 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个偷偷摸摸的，公司的人都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are having an affair, everyone in the company knows.

synonyms: 鬼鬼祟祟 (gwai2 gwai2 seoi3 seoi3)

mandarin_meaning: 狸猫换太子 (lí māo huàn tài zi)
english_meaning: Switching the dragon for a phoenix; Substitution; Palming off an inferior item as a superior one; To pull a fast one.
explanation_mandarin: 原指用狸猫调换刚出生的太子，比喻用假的东西冒充真的东西。引申为用不正当的手段进行替换，以达到某种目的。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the historical event of substituting a newborn prince with a raccoon cat. It is used as a metaphor for replacing something genuine with a fake or inferior substitute. By extension, it means to use dishonest means to make a substitution for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經常用啲次貨偷龍轉鳳當正貨賣畀顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 soeng4 yung6 di1 ci3 fo3 tau1 lung4 zyun2 fung6 dong3 zing3 fo3 maai6 bei2 gu3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司经常用次品冒充正品卖给顾客。
examples.english_sentence: That company often sells inferior goods as genuine products to customers through substitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住偷龍轉鳳，將啲舊零件換入部新機度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 tau1 lung4 zyun2 fung6, zoeng1 di1 gau6 ling4 gin2 wun6 jap6 bou6 san1 gei1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打算偷梁换柱，把旧零件换到新机器里。
examples.english_sentence: They planned to switch old parts into the new machine.

synonyms: 偷梁換柱 (tau1 loeng4 wun6 cyu5)

english_meaning: false, fake, counterfeit, artificial, pseudo-
explanation_mandarin: 虚假的，不真实的。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not genuine or real; fake or artificial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲全部都係偽鈔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ngai6 caau1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些全都是假钞。
examples.english_sentence: These are all counterfeit banknotes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容好偽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 hou2 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容很假。
examples.english_sentence: His smile is very fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢好偽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 hou2 ngai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他很虚伪。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's very hypocritical.

english_meaning: hypocrite, phony, fake person
explanation_mandarin: 指言行不一致，表面一套背后一套，虚情假意的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is hypocritical, says one thing but does another, and is insincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮嘢，根本係個偽人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 je5, gan1 bun2 hai6 go3 ngai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装模作样，根本就是一个伪君子。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act, he's basically a hypocrite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘢，佢係個偽人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5, keoi5 hai6 go3 ngai6 jan4 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他是个虚伪的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's a fake person.

english_meaning: to impersonate, to counterfeit, to pass off as genuine
explanation_mandarin: 指假冒、冒充他人身份或商品，使其看起来像是真实的或合法的。
explanation_english: To impersonate, to counterfeit, or to pass something off as genuine; to pretend to be someone or something one is not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偽冒警察啊，犯法㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ngai6 mau6 ging2 chaat3 aa3, faan6 faat3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要冒充警察啊，是犯法的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't impersonate a police officer, it's illegal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻錶係偽冒嘅，唔係真貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 biu1 hai6 ngai6 mau6 ge3, m4 hai6 zan1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只表是假冒的，不是真货。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is counterfeit, it's not genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人偽冒我嘅身份去呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 ngai6 mau6 ngo5 ge3 san1 fan2 heoi3 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人冒充我的身份去骗人。
examples.english_sentence: Someone is impersonating me to deceive people.

english_meaning: hypocrite, false gentleman
explanation_mandarin: 表面上装作正人君子，实际上却做着卑鄙无耻的事情的人。
explanation_english: A hypocrite; someone who pretends to be virtuous or morally good but does not act in accordance with their professed beliefs or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮好人，其實係個偽君子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 hou2 jan4, kei4 sat6 hai6 go3 ngai6 gwan1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天装好人，其实是个伪君子。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be a good person, but he's actually a hypocrite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢嘅外表呃到，佢係個徹頭徹尾嘅偽君子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 ge3 ngoi6 biu2 ak1 dou3, keoi5 hai6 go3 cit3 tau4 cit3 mei5 ge3 ngai6 gwan1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他的外表骗到，他是个彻头彻尾的伪君子。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his appearance, he's a complete hypocrite.

english_meaning: false proposition, pseudo-proposition
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏实质内容，没有实际意义的命题或论点。通常用来形容一些表面看起来是问题，但实际上无法验证或证明，或是已经包含了预设的错误假设。
explanation_english: Refers to a proposition or argument that lacks substance and real meaning. It's often used to describe something that appears to be a problem, but in reality, it cannot be verified or proven, or already contains a presupposed false assumption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢根本就係個偽命題，冇討論嘅價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 go3 ngai6 ming6 tai4, mou5 to2 leon6 ge3 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的东西根本就是个伪命题，没有讨论的价值。
examples.english_sentence: What he's saying is fundamentally a false proposition, not worth discussing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「讀書一定搵到好工」呢個講法，喺今日嘅香港，好可能係一個偽命題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 jat1 ding6 wan2 dou2 hou2 gung1 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3, hai2 gam1 jat6 ge3 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 ho2 nang4 hai6 jat1 go3 ngai6 ming6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “读书一定能找到好工作”这种说法，在今天的香港，很可能是一个伪命题。
examples.english_sentence: The saying "Studying hard will definitely lead to a good job" might be a false proposition in Hong Kong today.

english_meaning: hypocrisy, sanctimony, false benevolence
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上表现出善良或道德高尚的行为，但实际上动机不纯，并非真心实意。
explanation_english: Acting in a way that is superficially virtuous or morally upright, but with impure motives; feigning goodness or piety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話幫人，但我覺得佢好偽善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 bong1 jan4, daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ngai6 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说要帮助别人，但我认为他很伪善。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he wants to help others, but I think he's very hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種偽善嘅行為真係令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 ngai6 sin6 ge3 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种伪善的行为真令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of hypocritical behavior is really disgusting.

english_meaning: Trap, cross-dressing man appearing as a woman
explanation_mandarin: 指男性通过化妆、服饰等手段装扮成女性，以达到外貌上酷似女性的效果。通常带有一定的性暗示意味，但在不同语境下含义可能有所不同。
explanation_english: Refers to a male who dresses up as a female through makeup, clothing, and other means, achieving a physical appearance that closely resembles a woman. It often carries some sexual undertones, but the meaning may vary depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮偽娘扮得好似，差啲畀佢呃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 ngai6 noeng4 baan6 dak1 hou2 ci5, caa1 di1 bei2 keoi5 aak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扮伪娘扮得很像，差点被他骗了。
examples.english_sentence: He cross-dresses so convincingly, I almost got fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多動漫都有偽娘嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 dung6 maan6 dou1 jau5 ngai6 noeng4 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多动漫都有伪娘的角色。
examples.english_sentence: Many anime nowadays feature trap characters.

mandarin_meaning: 假文青 / 伪文艺青年
english_meaning: Pseudo-intellectual; Fake hipster; Someone who pretends to be cultured and intellectual.
explanation_mandarin: 指那些表面上追求文艺和文化，但实际上只是为了装作有品味和格调，缺乏真正文化底蕴的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who superficially pursues artistic and cultural interests, but in reality, does so only to appear sophisticated and cultured, lacking genuine cultural understanding or depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去獨立咖啡店打卡，又喺Instagram post啲唔知乜嘢嘅詩句，咪又係一個偽文青。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 duk6 laap6 gaa3 fe1 dim3 daa2 kaat1, jau6 hai2 Instagram post di1 m4 zi1 mat1 je5 ge3 si1 geoi3, mai1 jau6 hai6 jat1 go3 ngai6 man4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天去独立咖啡店打卡，又在Instagram发一些不知所谓的诗句，不就是一个假文青吗。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to independent coffee shops all the time to check in, and posts nonsensical poems on Instagram. Isn't he just a pseudo-intellectual?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做偽文青啦，真係鍾意睇書咪睇書囉，唔好剩係擺出嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 ngai6 man4 cing1 laa1, zan1 hai6 zung1 ji3 tai2 syu1 mai1 tai2 syu1 lo1, m4 hou2 sing6 hai6 baai2 ceot1 lai4 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做假文青了，真的喜欢看书就看书，不要只是摆出来拍照。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a fake hipster. If you genuinely like reading, then read. Don't just display books for photos.

english_meaning: Fake geek, poser (pretending to be a geek/nerd)
explanation_mandarin: 指假装成“毒男”的人。 “毒男”通常指沉迷于动漫、游戏等，社交能力较弱的男性。 “偽毒”指并非真的对动漫游戏等有深入了解或喜爱，只是为了迎合潮流或吸引异性而假装成“毒男”的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who pretends to be a "duk naam" (geek/nerd). A "duk naam" is usually a male who is obsessed with anime, games, etc., and has weak social skills. A "ngai duk" is someone who isn't genuinely knowledgeable or interested in anime, games, etc., but pretends to be a "duk naam" to follow trends or attract the opposite sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明唔睇動漫㗎，但係為咗溝女，就扮曬偽毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 m4 tai2 dung6 maan6 gaa3, daan6 hai6 wai6 zo2 kau1 neoi2, zau6 baan3 saai3 ngai6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明不看动漫的，但是为了泡妞，就装成假宅男。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't watch anime, but he's pretending to be a fake geek to pick up girls.

english_meaning: pseudoscience
explanation_mandarin: 指宣称具有科学性，但实际上并不符合科学方法和标准的主张、理论或实践。
explanation_english: A collection of beliefs or practices mistakenly regarded as being based on scientific method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲所謂嘅量子產品，根本就係偽科學，唔好信佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 so2 wai6 ge3 loeng6 zi2 saan2 ban2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 ngai6 fo1 hok6, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些所谓的量子产品，根本就是伪科学，不要相信它们。
examples.english_sentence: These so-called quantum products are completely pseudoscience, don't believe them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水有啲位好似係偽科學咁，好難證實到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 jau5 di1 wai2 hou2 ci5 hai6 ngai6 fo1 hok6 gam2, hou2 naan4 zing3 sat6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水有些地方好像是伪科学，很难证实。
examples.english_sentence: Some aspects of feng shui seem like pseudoscience; it's difficult to prove.

english_meaning: to falsely claim, to misrepresent oneself as, to pretend to be
explanation_mandarin: 虚假地声称，冒充
explanation_english: To falsely claim to be someone or something; to misrepresent oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偽稱自己係醫生，但其實佢係個騙子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngai6 cing1 zi6 gei2 hai6 yi1 sang1, daan6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 hai6 go3 pin3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冒充自己是医生，但其实他是个骗子。
examples.english_sentence: He falsely claimed to be a doctor, but in reality, he's a swindler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司偽稱自己嘅產品係歐洲製造，但係實際上係喺大陸生產嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ngai6 cing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 caan2 ban2 hai6 au1 zau1 zai3 zou6, daan6 hai6 sat6 zai3 soeng6 hai6 hai2 daai6 luk6 sang1 caan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司假称自己的产品是欧洲制造的，但实际上是在大陆生产的。
examples.english_sentence: That company falsely claimed that their products were made in Europe, but they are actually manufactured in mainland China.

english_meaning: disguise, pretend, feign, camouflage
explanation_mandarin: 掩饰真相，使人不易识破; 改变外形或性质以适应环境。
explanation_english: To disguise or conceal one's true nature, identity, or intentions; to camouflage or alter appearance to blend in or deceive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想偽裝到自己好堅強噉，但係我睇得出佢好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ngai6 zong1 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 gin1 koeng4 gam2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想伪装成自己很坚强，但是我看得出他很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to disguise himself as being strong, but I could tell he was very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個士兵嘅偽裝好成功，敵人睇唔到佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si6 bing1 ge3 ngai6 zong1 hou2 sing4 gung1, dik6 jan4 tai2 m4 dou2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个士兵的伪装很成功，敌人看不到他们。
examples.english_sentence: The soldier's camouflage was very successful; the enemy couldn't see them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容只係一種偽裝，遮掩住佢真正嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 zi2 hai6 jat1 zung2 ngai6 zong1, ze1 jim2 zyu6 keoi5 zan1 zing3 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容只是一种伪装，遮掩住他真正的感受。
examples.english_sentence: His smile is just a disguise, concealing his true feelings.

english_meaning: perjury, false evidence
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭或类似法律场合上，故意提供不真实的证词。
explanation_english: The act of intentionally giving false testimony under oath or affirmation in a court of law or similar legal setting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭度作偽證，俾人告咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 dou6 zok3 ngai6 zing3, bei2 jan4 gou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法庭上作伪证，被人起诉了。
examples.english_sentence: He committed perjury in court and was sued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作偽證係犯法㗎，要坐監㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 ngai6 zing3 hai6 faan6 faat3 gaa3, jiu3 co5 gaam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作伪证是犯法的，要坐牢的。
examples.english_sentence: Perjury is illegal and punishable by imprisonment.

english_meaning: to forge, to counterfeit, to fabricate
explanation_mandarin: 仿造真的东西，使其看起来是真的，但实际上是假的。
explanation_english: To create a copy of something valuable or important with the intention to deceive; to fabricate something false.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人捉到佢偽造身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 keoi5 ngai6 zou6 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人抓到他伪造身份证。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught forging an ID card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偽造文件係犯法嘅。
