explanation_english: Refers to gradually accumulating or storing things, little by little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我儲埋咗好多錢，準備去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cyu5 maai4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zyun2 bei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我存了很多钱，准备去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I've saved up a lot of money and am planning to go travelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢儲埋好多舊衫，都唔捨得掉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyu5 maai4 hou2 do1 gau6 saam1, dou1 m4 se2 dak1 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他积攒了很多旧衣服，都不舍得扔掉。
examples.english_sentence: He's accumulated a lot of old clothes and can't bear to throw them away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好剩係識得儲埋儲埋，都要學吓享受生活嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 cyu5 maai4 cyu5 maai4, dou1 jiu3 hok6 haa5 hoeng2 sau6 sang1 wut6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会积攒积攒，也要学着享受生活。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just know how to save up, you need to learn to enjoy life too.

english_meaning: Crown Princess (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 古代指被指定为未来皇后的人，是皇太子的正妻。
explanation_english: In ancient times, it referred to the person designated as the future empress, the principal wife of the crown prince.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身份係儲妃，將來會成為皇后。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 fan2 hai6 cyu5 fei1, zoeng1 loi4 wui5 sing4 wai4 wong4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的身份是储妃，将来会成为皇后。
examples.english_sentence: Her status is Crown Princess, and she will become the Empress in the future.

english_meaning: to store; to save; to deposit
explanation_mandarin: 把东西存放起来，以备日后使用；也指把数据保存在电脑或其他存储设备中。
explanation_english: To keep something for future use; also to save data in a computer or other storage device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要儲存呢份文件喺電腦度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 cyu5 cyun4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 hai2 din6 nou5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要把这份文件储存在电脑里。
examples.english_sentence: I need to save this file on the computer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢儲存咗好多錢喺銀行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyu5 cyun4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 hai2 ngan4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她存了很多钱在银行。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has saved a lot of money in the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式可以幫你儲存資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 cyu5 cyun4 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序可以帮你储存资料。
examples.english_sentence: This program can help you store data.

english_meaning: to store water; to hoard water; to save water
explanation_mandarin: 指储存水，以备不时之需。
explanation_english: To store water, usually for future use or in case of emergency or water shortage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風之前，最好儲定啲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 zi1 cin4, zeoi3 hou2 cyu5 ding6 di1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风来之前，最好储存一些水。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to store some water before the typhoon comes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為水塘水位低，所以政府呼籲市民儲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 seoi2 tong4 seoi2 wai2 dai1, so2 ji5 zing3 fu2 fu1 yu6 si5 man4 cyu5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为水库水位低，所以政府呼吁市民储水。
examples.english_sentence: Because the reservoir water level is low, the government is calling on citizens to conserve/store water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋啲救生艇上面有冇儲水㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 di1 gau3 sang1 teng5 soeng6 min6 jau5 mou5 cyu5 seoi2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们的救生艇上面有没有储水啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any stored water on your lifeboats?

english_meaning: locker, storage cabinet
explanation_mandarin: 用来存放物品的柜子，通常有锁。
explanation_english: A cabinet, usually with a lock, used for storing personal belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲書擺喺儲物櫃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 syu1 baai2 hai2 cyu5 mat6 gwai6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把书放在储物柜里面。
examples.english_sentence: I put the books inside the locker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校嘅儲物櫃唔夠用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 ge3 cyu5 mat6 gwai6 m4 gau3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校的储物柜不够用。
examples.english_sentence: The school lockers are not enough.

english_meaning: to save (money); savings
explanation_mandarin: 指积累钱财，积攒下来以备将来使用。也可以指积累下来的钱财。
explanation_english: To save money; the act of putting money aside for future use. It can also refer to the money that has been saved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每個月都儲蓄一啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 cyu5 cuk1 jat1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每个月都储蓄一些钱。
examples.english_sentence: He saves some money every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為咗將來嘅教育費用儲蓄多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 zo2 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 gaau3 juk6 fai3 yung6 cyu5 cuk1 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们为了将来的教育费用要储蓄多一些钱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to save more money for future education expenses.

english_meaning: Savings account
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于存放和积累资金的银行账户，通常会提供利息。
explanation_english: A bank account used to hold and accumulate funds, typically offering interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我開咗個儲蓄戶口，想儲錢買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoi1 zo2 go3 cyu5 cuk1 wu6 hau2, soeng2 cyu5 cin2 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我开了一个储蓄账户，想存钱买房。
examples.english_sentence: I opened a savings account, wanting to save money to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間銀行嘅儲蓄戶口利息幾高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ngan4 hang4 ge3 cyu5 cuk1 wu6 hau2 lei6 sik1 gei2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家银行的储蓄账户利息挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: This bank's savings account interest rate is quite high.

synonyms: 銀行戶口 (ngan4 hang4 wu6 hau2)

english_meaning: Savings account
explanation_mandarin: 一种专门用于储蓄的银行账户，通常有利息。
explanation_english: A bank account specifically designed for saving money, usually offering interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我開咗個儲蓄户口，想儲啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoi1 zo2 go3 cyu5 cuk1 wu6 hau2, soeng2 cyu5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我开了一个储蓄账户，想存点钱。
examples.english_sentence: I opened a savings account, I want to save some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好將啲錢擺入儲蓄户口，賺啲利息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zoeng1 di1 cin2 baai2 jap6 cyu5 cuk1 wu6 hau2, zaan6 di1 lei6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好把钱存进储蓄账户，赚点利息。
examples.english_sentence: You should put the money in a savings account to earn some interest.

english_meaning: to store, to hoard, to reserve
explanation_mandarin: 指将物品储存起来，以便以后使用。
explanation_english: To store away or reserve something for future use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天之前要儲藏啲糧食，預防唔夠食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 cyu5 zong6 di1 loeng4 sik6, jyu6 fong4 m4 gau3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天之前要储存一些粮食，预防不够吃。
examples.english_sentence: We need to store some food before winter in case there isn't enough to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 松鼠會喺秋天儲藏好多果仁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sung1 syu2 wui5 hai2 cau1 tin1 cyu5 zong6 hou2 do1 gwo2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 松鼠会在秋天储存很多坚果。
examples.english_sentence: Squirrels store a lot of nuts in the autumn.

english_meaning: to store away, to save up, to put away
explanation_mandarin: 把东西存放起来，留着以后用。
explanation_english: To store something away for later use; to save or accumulate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我儲起咗啲錢，諗住第時買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cyu5 hei2 zo2 di1 cin2, nam2 zyu6 dai6 si4 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我存了一些钱，想着以后买房。
examples.english_sentence: I've saved up some money, planning to buy a house in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好儲起啲糧食，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 cyu5 hei2 di1 loeng4 sik6, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好储备一些粮食，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better store some food, just in case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊衫我唔捨得掉，諗住儲起佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 saam1 ngo5 m4 se2 dak1 diu6, nam2 zyu6 cyu5 hei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧衣服我舍不得扔，想着存起来。
examples.english_sentence: I can't bear to throw away these old clothes, I'm thinking of keeping them.

english_meaning: to save money
explanation_mandarin: 积攒钱财，把钱存起来。
explanation_english: To accumulate money, to save up money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住儲錢去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 cyu5 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算存钱去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to save money to go travelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力儲錢買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 cyu5 cin2 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地存钱买房。
examples.english_sentence: He is working hard to save money to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該儲多啲錢，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 goi1 cyu5 do1 di1 cin2, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该多存点钱，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: You should save more money, just in case.

english_meaning: to interrupt; to butt in; to speak nonsense; to talk drivel
explanation_mandarin: 指不该说的话说了出来，或没有根据地说； 多指打断别人说话。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking out of turn or speaking without basis; often refers to interrupting someone's speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日儳嘴啦，人哋講緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 caam4 zeoi2 laa1, jan4 dei6 gong2 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是插嘴了，人家在说话呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always butt in, people are talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都儳儳儳，都唔知佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 caam4 caam4 caam4, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡说八道，都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always talking nonsense, I don't even know what he's saying.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说八道；说话不着边际
english_meaning: To talk nonsense; to ramble on without a clear point; to talk incoherently; to speak off-topic; to be irrelevant in speech.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话杂乱无章，没有主题，或离题万里，胡说八道。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is disorganized, lacks a clear topic, is off-topic, or is nonsensical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再儳亂歌柄啦，講返正題啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 caam4 lyun6 go1 bing3 laa1, gong2 faan1 zing3 tai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再胡说八道了，说回正题吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense and get back to the topic!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都儳亂歌柄，冇人知佢想講咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 caam4 lyun6 go1 bing3, mou5 jan4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡说八道，没有人知道他想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense; no one knows what he's trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，佢儳亂歌柄咗一輪，搞到大家都唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6, keoi5 caam4 lyun6 go1 bing3 zo2 jat1 leon4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他胡说八道了一通，弄得大家都不知道他想怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, he rambled on for a while, making everyone confused about what he wanted.

english_meaning: paired; couple; mate; spouse
explanation_mandarin: 指成双成对，配偶。在粤语中常用于书面语，例如“伉俪情深”。
explanation_english: Refers to being in pairs or couples, a spouse. In Cantonese, it's more commonly used in written language, such as in phrases like '伉儷情深'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩位伉儷情深，非常恩愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 wai2 hong3 lai6 ching4 sam1, fei1 soeng4 yan1 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两位伉俪情深，非常恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are a loving couple, very affectionate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對新人真係天作之合，佢哋嘅婚禮好浪漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 san1 jan4 zan1 hai6 tin1 zok3 zi1 hap6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 lai5 hou2 long6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这对新人真是天作之合，他们的婚礼很浪漫。
examples.english_sentence: This newlywed couple is truly a match made in heaven; their wedding was very romantic.

english_meaning: if; supposing that; in case
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的连词，相当于“如果”、“假如”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing a hypothetical situation; equivalent to 'if' or 'supposing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 儻若你唔去，咁我就自己去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 joek6 nei5 m4 heoi3, gam2 ngo5 zau6 zi6 gei2 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不去，那我就自己去了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't go, then I'll go by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 儻唔係你幫手，我點搞得掂呢件事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong2 m4 hai6 nei5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不是你帮忙，我怎么能搞定这件事呢？
examples.english_sentence: If it weren't for your help, how could I have handled this matter?

english_meaning: as if, just like, solemn, dignified
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示好像，如同，或形容莊嚴、嚴肅的樣子。
explanation_english: Indicates 'as if' or 'just like', or describes a solemn, dignified appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢儼如一個皇帝咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jim5 jyu4 jat1 go3 wong4 dai3 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就像一个皇帝一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is just like an emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢個樣儼然一個專家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 go3 joeng2 jim5 jin4 jat1 go3 zhun1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的样子简直就像一个专家。
examples.english_sentence: The way he speaks is just like an expert.

english_meaning: seemingly; just like; resembling
explanation_mandarin: 好像；如同；很像的样子。
explanation_english: Seemingly, just like, resembling. Describes something that appears to be the same as something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰個樣，儼然一個大人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 go3 joeng2, jim5 jin4 jat1 go3 daai6 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子，俨然一个大人一样。
examples.english_sentence: His appearance is just like an adult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度儼然係另一個世界噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jim5 jin4 hai6 ling6 jat1 go3 sai3 gaai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里俨然是另一个世界一样。
examples.english_sentence: This place is seemingly another world.

english_meaning: thing, matter, affair
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，指的是“东西”或“事情”。较为口语化。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it refers to 'thing' or 'matter'. It is colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲儿要搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 ji4 jiu3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些事情要处理。
examples.english_sentence: There are some things to take care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲儿都系佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ji4 dou1 hai6 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西都是他的。
examples.english_sentence: These things are all his.

mandarin_meaning: 笨拙; 不灵活; 呆笨
english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; stupid; inflexible; blockheaded
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝、笨拙、不灵活。 多用于形容人的行为或想法。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow, clumsy, inflexible, or blockheaded. Often used to describe someone's behavior or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好兀㗎，講嘢轉唔到彎嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ngat1 gaa3, gong2 waa2 zyun2 m4 dou2 waan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很笨拙，说话不会转弯。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very clumsy person, he can't beat around the bush when he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁兀啦，快啲諗辦法啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngat1 laa1, faai3 di1 nam2 baan6 faat3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么呆笨了，快点想办法吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, think of a solution quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁兀噉做嘢啦，會搞衰晒㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ngat1 gam2 zou6 je5 laa1, wui5 gaau2 sai2晒 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨拙地做事，会搞砸的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things so clumsily, you'll mess everything up!

english_meaning: to allow, to permit, to consent, to promise
explanation_mandarin: 表示答应，允许。是书面语用法，口语中较少单独使用。
explanation_english: To allow, permit, or consent. Primarily used in written Cantonese and formal speech; less common in everyday spoken Cantonese on its own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔允你咁樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wan5 nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不允许你这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't allow you to do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承咗，即係允咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ying1 sing4 zo2, jik1 hai6 wan5 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应了，也就是允许了。
examples.english_sentence: He promised, which means he allowed it.

english_meaning: to permit, to allow, to approve
explanation_mandarin: 同意；批准。
explanation_english: To give permission; to approve or authorize something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細允准咗我請假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 wan5 zeon2 zo2 ngo5 ceng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板批准我请假了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss approved my leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔會允准你咁做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 wui5 wan5 zeon2 nei5 gam2 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不会允许你这么做的。
examples.english_sentence: He won't allow you to do that.

english_meaning: to allow, to permit
explanation_mandarin: 同意，准许。
explanation_english: To give permission for something to happen or be done; to authorize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細唔允許我哋遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 m4 wan5 heoi2 ngo5 dei6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不允许我们迟到。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't allow us to be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽唔允許我夜晚出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 m4 wan5 heoi2 ngo5 je6 maan5 chut1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈不允许我晚上出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: My mother doesn't allow me to go out and play at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇我嘅允許唔可以掂我啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 ngo5 ge3 wan5 heoi2 m4 ho2 ji5 dim6 ngo5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你没有我的允许不可以碰我的东西。
examples.english_sentence: You can't touch my things without my permission.

english_meaning: dollar (Cantonese); origin; first; primary; basic
explanation_mandarin: （1）作为货币单位时，指“元”，通常用于正式场合；口语中常用“块”。 (2) 本源；开始；第一。
explanation_english: (1) As a currency unit, it refers to 'dollar', usually used in formal occasions; in colloquial Cantonese, '塊' (faai3) is commonly used. (2) Origin; beginning; first; fundamental.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫賣幾多元呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 maai6 gei2 do1 jyun4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服卖多少元？
examples.english_sentence: How many dollars does this shirt cost?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係得返十蚊，唔夠錢搭車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 dak1 faan1 sap6 man1, m4 gau3 cin2 daap3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只剩下十块钱，不够钱坐车。
examples.english_sentence: I only have ten dollars left, not enough for the bus fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 元旦快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 daan3 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 元旦快乐！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year's Day!

english_meaning: chief culprit, prime offender, ringleader, mastermind
explanation_mandarin: 指首恶分子，罪恶的主要发起者或负责人。
explanation_english: The principal culprit; the primary instigator or person responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就係呢單案嘅元兇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 hai6 ni1 daan1 on3 ge3 jyun4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是这起案件的元凶。
examples.english_sentence: He is the chief culprit of this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要捉到呢個元兇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zuk1 dou2 ni1 go3 jyun4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要抓住这个元凶。
examples.english_sentence: We must catch this ringleader.

mandarin_meaning: 香港新界西北部三个区域的简称
english_meaning: Abbreviation for the three districts in the Northwest New Territories of Hong Kong: Yuen Long, Tin Shui Wai, and Tuen Mun
explanation_mandarin: “元天屯”是香港新界西北部三个地区的简称，分别指元朗（元朗區）、天水圍（天水圍）和屯門（屯門區）。由于这三个区域地理位置相近，且在城市规划和发展上有所联系，因此经常被一起提及。
explanation_english: "Yuen Tin Tun" is an abbreviation for three districts in the Northwest New Territories of Hong Kong: Yuen Long, Tin Shui Wai, and Tuen Mun. These districts are geographically close and have connections in urban planning and development, so they are often mentioned together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家元天屯嘅發展都幾快下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jyun4 tin1 tyun4 ge3 faat3 zin2 dou1 gei2 faai3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在元朗、天水围、屯门的發展都挺快的。
examples.english_sentence: The development of Yuen Long, Tin Shui Wai, and Tuen Mun is quite fast now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 住喺元天屯出市區返工都幾遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu6 hai2 jyun4 tin1 tyun4 ceot1 si5 keoi1 faan1 gung1 dou1 gei2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 住在元朗、天水围、屯门去市区上班都挺远的。
examples.english_sentence: Living in Yuen Long, Tin Shui Wai, or Tuen Mun and commuting to the city center for work is quite far.

english_meaning: Lantern Festival; sweet dumplings made of glutinous rice flour eaten during the Lantern Festival
explanation_mandarin: 农历正月十五，是中国的传统节日元宵节。也指元宵节吃的用糯米粉做的甜馅汤圆。
explanation_english: The Lantern Festival, also called Yuan Xiao Festival, is a Chinese festival celebrated on the fifteenth day of the first month in the lunar calendar. It also refers to the sweet dumplings (Tangyuan) made of glutinous rice flour eaten during this festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚出去食元宵啦，順便睇埋花燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 jyun4 siu1 laa1, seon6 bin2 tai2 maai4 faa1 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚出去吃元宵吧，顺便看花灯。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out for Tangyuan tonight and see the lanterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆整嘅元宵特別好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po2 zing2 ge3 jyun4 siu1 dak6 bit6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶做的元宵特别好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma's Tangyuan is especially delicious.

english_meaning: sycee, silver ingot (shaped like a saddle)
explanation_mandarin: 古代的一种货币，通常用金或银制成，形状像船，两头翘起。
explanation_english: A type of ancient Chinese currency, typically made of gold or silver, shaped like a boat with upturned ends; a sycee or silver ingot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，有啲人會喺屋企擺啲假元寶，希望可以招財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 baai2 di1 gaa2 jyun4 bou2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 ziu1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，有些人会在家里摆一些假元宝，希望可以招财。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, some people will display fake sycees at home, hoping to attract wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係以前用嚟買嘢嘅元寶，而家都變晒古董啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ji5 cin4 yung6 lai4 maai5 je5 ge3 jyun4 bou2, ji4 gaa1 dou1 bin3 saai3 gu2 dung2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是以前用来买东西的元宝，现在都变成古董了。
examples.english_sentence: These are sycees that were used to buy things in the past, now they have all become antiques.

english_meaning: Gold ingot-shaped candle
explanation_mandarin: 形状像金元宝的蜡烛，常用于祭祀，寓意着财富和祈福。
explanation_english: A candle shaped like a gold ingot, often used in religious ceremonies or ancestor veneration, symbolizing wealth and good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺神枱上面點咗兩支元寶蠟燭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 san4 toi2 soeng6 min6 dim2 zo2 loeng5 zi1 jyun4 bou2 laap6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶在神台上点了两支元宝蜡烛。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma lit two gold ingot-shaped candles on the altar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嗰陣，好多人都會買元寶蠟燭返屋企拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 maai5 jyun4 bou2 laap6 zuk1 faan1 uk1 kei2 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，很多人都会买元宝蜡烛回家拜神。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many people buy gold ingot-shaped candles to burn at home for ancestral worship.

english_meaning: Ingots, candles, and incense (religious offerings)
explanation_mandarin: 指祭祀用的物品，包括元宝（纸钱，代表金钱）、蜡烛和香。
explanation_english: Refers to items used for religious offerings, including ingots (paper money representing wealth), candles, and incense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，好多人會買元寶蠟燭香去拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 maai5 jyun4 bou2 laak6 zuk1 hoeng1 heoi3 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人会买元宝蜡烛香去拜神。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many people buy ingots, candles, and incense to worship the gods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日都喺屋企燒元寶蠟燭香，保佑一家平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 siu1 jyun4 bou2 laak6 zuk1 hoeng1, bou2 jau6 jat1 gaa1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常在家里烧元宝蜡烛香，保佑一家平安。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often burns ingots, candles, and incense at home to pray for the safety of the family.

english_meaning: Marshal (military rank); Commander-in-chief
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中最高的军衔称号。也指某些民间信仰中的神祇的称号。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest military rank in an army. It can also refer to the title of certain deities in folk beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅總司令係一位戰功彪炳嘅元帥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zung2 si1 ling6 hai6 jat1 wai2 zin3 gung1 biu1 bing2 ge3 jyun4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的总司令是一位战功卓著的元帅。
examples.english_sentence: Their commander-in-chief is a marshal with remarkable military achievements.

english_meaning: New Year's Day
explanation_mandarin: 指公历一月一日，即新年的第一天。
explanation_english: New Year's Day, referring to January 1st of the Gregorian calendar, the first day of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋元旦會去日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 daan3 wui5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们元旦会去日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Japan for New Year's Day.

english_meaning: Yuen Long (a district in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港新界西北部的一个地区，以围村文化和美食著称。
explanation_english: Yuen Long is a district located in the northwestern New Territories of Hong Kong, known for its walled village culture and food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去元朗食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 jyun4 long5 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去元朗吃东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Yuen Long for food tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 元朗嘅交通都幾方便，有西鐵同巴士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 long5 ge3 gaau1 tung1 dou1 gei2 fong1 bin6, jau5 sai1 tit3 tung4 baa1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 元朗的交通挺方便的，有西铁和巴士。
examples.english_sentence: The transportation in Yuen Long is quite convenient, with West Rail and buses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺元朗好耐，對嗰度好熟悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 jyun4 long5 hou2 noi6, deoi3 go2 dou6 hou2 suk6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在元朗很久了，对那里很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: He has lived in Yuen Long for a long time and is very familiar with it.

english_meaning: severely weakened; vitality greatly impaired; to suffer a great loss of vitality
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物受到极大的损害，精神或力量受到严重削弱。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing suffering a great loss of vitality, energy, or strength; severely weakened or impaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次間公司蝕咗咁多錢，真係元氣大傷呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seong6 ci3 gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 jyun4 hei3 daai6 soeng1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次公司亏损了这么多钱，真是元气大伤啊。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost so much money last time, it really suffered a big loss of vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗咁耐，元氣大傷，要好好休養先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gam3 noi6, jyun4 hei3 daai6 soeng1, jiu3 hou2 hou2 jau1 joeng5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了这么久，元气大伤，要好好休养才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for so long and is severely weakened, he needs to rest well to recover.

english_meaning: originator, founder, prototype, first generation
explanation_mandarin: 最初的，第一代的；也指某个领域或事物最早的创始人或开创者。
explanation_english: Refers to the original, first-generation version of something. Can also refer to the founder or originator of a certain field or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話呢間舖頭係珍珠奶茶嘅元祖呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 hai6 zan1 zyu1 naai5 caa4 ge3 jyun4 zou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说这家店是珍珠奶茶的鼻祖啊。
examples.english_sentence: They say this shop is the originator of bubble tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話初代高達先至係元祖，之後嗰啲都係變種㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 co1 doi6 gou1 daat6 sin1 zeoi3 hai6 jyun4 zou2, zi1 hau6 go2啲 dou1 hai6 bin3 zung2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说第一代高达才是元祖，之后那些都是变种的。
examples.english_sentence: They say the first generation Gundam is the original, the ones after that are all variants.

mandarin_meaning: 元神; 本性; 靈魂
english_meaning: Original spirit; vital spirit; innate nature; soul (often in a Taoist context)
explanation_mandarin: 道教用語，指人體的本原之神，也泛指人的靈魂或本性。
explanation_english: In Taoism, refers to the original spirit of the human body, also broadly refers to the soul or innate nature of a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢嘅元神好虛弱，要好好休養下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 jyun4 san4 hou2 heoi1 joek6, jiu3 hou2 hou2 jau1 joeng5 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的元神很虚弱，需要好好休养一下。
examples.english_sentence: He said his vital spirit is very weak and needs to rest and recuperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 練功嘅目的係要提升元神嘅力量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin6 gung1 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 jiu3 tai4 sing1 jyun4 san4 ge3 lik6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 练功的目的是要提升元神的力量。
examples.english_sentence: The purpose of practicing qigong is to enhance the power of the vital spirit.

english_meaning: element, factor
explanation_mandarin: 指构成事物的基本成分或要素。
explanation_english: Refers to a basic component or factor that constitutes something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有好多唔同嘅元素組成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 jyun4 sou3 zou2 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划由很多不同的元素组成。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is composed of many different elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創意係成功嘅重要元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 ji3 hai6 sing4 gung1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创意是成功的重要元素。
examples.english_sentence: Creativity is an important element of success.

english_meaning: Periodic table of elements
explanation_mandarin: 一种以元素原子序数为基础排列的化学元素表格，反应了元素的性质随着原子序数的递增而出现的周期性变化规律。
explanation_english: A tabular arrangement of the chemical elements, ordered by their atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties. The periodic table reflects the periodic trends in the properties of the elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日會學元素週期表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 hok6 jyun4 sou3 zau1 kei4 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天会学元素周期表。
examples.english_sentence: We will learn the periodic table tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個元素週期表嘅設計好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyun4 sou3 zau1 kei4 biu2 ge3 sai3 gai3 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个元素周期表的设计很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this periodic table is very clear.

english_meaning: elder statesman, veteran, founding member, old guard
explanation_mandarin: 指资历老、地位高的成员或领导者，尤指在一个组织或机构中早期加入并做出过重要贡献的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a senior and highly respected member or leader, especially one who joined an organization or institution early on and made significant contributions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅元老級人馬，咩都知晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 jyun4 lou5 gap1 jan4 maa5, me1 dou1 zi1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的元老级人物，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's one of the company's veteran figures, he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位元老對公司貢獻良多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 jyun4 lou5 deoi3 gung1 si1 gung3 hiun3 loeng4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位元老对公司贡献很大。
examples.english_sentence: This veteran has contributed a lot to the company.

english_meaning: dried scallop
explanation_mandarin: 将新鲜的扇贝肉晒干制成的干货食品，是珍贵的食材。
explanation_english: Dried scallop, made by drying fresh scallop meat. It is a prized ingredient in Chinese cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚整元貝粥好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zing2 jyun4 bui3 zuk1 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚做干贝粥好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we make dried scallop congee tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲元貝好大粒，睇嚟質素唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jyun4 bui3 hou2 daai6 lap1, tai2 lai4 zat1 so3 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些干贝很大颗，看起来质量不错。
examples.english_sentence: These dried scallops are very big, looks like the quality is good.

english_meaning: braised pork knuckle
explanation_mandarin: 指經過烹調的豬肘子，通常是先滷後燉，使肉質軟爛入味。
explanation_english: Refers to a braised pork knuckle, usually prepared by first marinating and then stewing it to make the meat tender and flavorful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年過年我哋整咗個元蹄，一家人食得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 zing2 zo2 go3 jyun4 tai4, jat1 gaa1 jan4 sik6 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年过年我们做了一个肘子，一家人吃得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: This Chinese New Year, we made a braised pork knuckle, and the whole family enjoyed it very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅元蹄做得好入味，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jyun4 tai4 zou6 dak1 hou2 jap6 mei6, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的肘子做得非常入味，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The braised pork knuckle at this restaurant is very flavorful and delicious.

english_meaning: first wife; original spouse
explanation_mandarin: 指最初结婚的妻子，与后来的配偶相对。
explanation_english: Refers to the first wife or original spouse, in contrast to subsequent spouses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚五十年，元配一直都喺佢身邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ng5 sap6 nin4, jyun4 pui3 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai2 keoi5 san1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚五十年，原配一直都在他身边。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for fifty years, and his first wife has always been by his side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好少講元配呢個詞，通常都講『老婆』或者『太太』。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 siu2 gong2 jyun4 pui3 ni1 go3 ci4, tung1 soeng4 dou1 gong2 'lou5 po4' waak6 ze2 'taai3 taai2'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人很少说原配这个词，通常都说『老婆』或者『太太』。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people rarely use the term 'first wife,' usually they say 'wife' or 'madam'.

english_meaning: vowel
explanation_mandarin: 语音学中指发音时气流不受阻碍而发出的音。
explanation_english: In phonetics, a vowel is a speech sound produced without significant constriction of the air flowing from the lungs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東話有九個元音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 waa2 jau5 gau2 go3 jyun4 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粤语有九个元音。
examples.english_sentence: Cantonese has nine vowels.

english_meaning: Head of state, chief of state
explanation_mandarin: 指国家的最高领导人。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest leader of a country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個國家都有自己嘅元首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个国家都有自己的元首。
examples.english_sentence: Every country has its own head of state.

english_meaning: elder brother
explanation_mandarin: 指同父母或义父母所生的男子中排行最大的。
explanation_english: Elder brother; the eldest male sibling from the same parents or adoptive parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個兄好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 hing1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥很疼爱我。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother loves me very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿兄，唔該幫我手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 hing1, m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥，麻烦帮我一下。
examples.english_sentence: Brother, please give me a hand.

english_meaning: Brother, Sir (formal and archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 对男子的敬称，略带古风，表示尊敬或客气。
explanation_english: A respectful term of address for a man, similar to 'brother' or 'sir', carrying a slightly archaic and formal tone. Often used in a humorous or theatrical context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，兄台，借問聲，呢度點樣去尖沙咀呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, hing1 toi4, ze3 man6 seng1, ni1 dou6 dim2 yeung2 heoi3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，这位仁兄，请问一下，这里怎么去尖沙咀啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, brother, may I ask, how do I get to Tsim Sha Tsui from here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，兄台，唔好咁勞氣，有咩慢慢傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, hing1 toi4, m4 hou2 gam2 lou4 hei3, yau5 me1 maan6 maan6 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，这位仁兄，别这么生气，有什么慢慢谈。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, brother, don't be so angry, let's talk about it calmly.

english_meaning: Brother and sister
explanation_mandarin: 指哥哥和妹妹，或者哥哥和姊姊的组合。
explanation_english: Refers to a brother and sister, or a brother and younger/older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一對感情好好嘅兄妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2 ge3 hing1 mui6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一对感情很好的兄妹。
examples.english_sentence: They are a brother and sister with a very good relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有一個大我三年嘅哥哥，我哋係兄妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 jat1 go3 daai6 ngo5 saam1 nin4 ge3 go1 go1, ngo5 dei6 hai6 hing1 mui6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一个大我三年的哥哥，我们是兄妹。
examples.english_sentence: I have a brother who is three years older than me, we are brother and sister.

english_meaning: brothers; brethren; brother; fellows; mate; pal
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是兄弟。在粤语中，也可用来称呼男性朋友，类似于“哥们儿”。
explanation_english: Literally means brothers. In Cantonese, it can also be used to address male friends, similar to "mate" or "pal" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，兄弟，今晚出嚟飲嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, hing1 dai6, gam1 maan1 ceot1 lai4 yam2 ye5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，兄弟，今晚出来喝点东西吧！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, mate, let's go out for a drink tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢係識咗好耐嘅兄弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai6 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 ge3 hing1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他是认识很久的兄弟。
examples.english_sentence: He and I have been brothers for a long time (meaning friends).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟感情好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: The two brothers have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: Groomsmen, Best Man's party
explanation_mandarin: 指婚礼中，新郎的朋友组成的团队，主要负责协助新郎完成婚礼流程，活跃气氛等。其中通常包括伴郎。
explanation_english: Refers to the group of the groom's friends at a wedding, who are responsible for assisting the groom with the wedding process, livening up the atmosphere, etc. It usually includes the best man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚嗰日，佢班兄弟團玩得好癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 go2 jat6, keoi5 baan1 hing1 dai6 tyun4 waan2 dak1 hou2 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结婚那天，他的伴郎团玩得很疯狂。
examples.english_sentence: His groomsmen were crazy and had lots of fun on his wedding day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做兄弟團都幾辛苦㗎，要幫手搞好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hing1 dai6 tyun4 dou1 gei2 san1 fu2 gaa3, jiu3 bong1 sau2 gaau2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做伴郎团还挺辛苦的，要帮忙处理很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: Being a groomsman is quite tiring, you have to help with a lot of things.

english_meaning: siblings; brothers and sisters
explanation_mandarin: 指同父母或其中一方的子女。
explanation_english: Refers to children who share the same parents or one parent in common; siblings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有三個兄弟姊妹，兩個細佬同一個家姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 saam1 go3 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6, loeng5 go3 sai3 lou2 tung4 jat1 go3 gaa1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有三个兄弟姐妹，两个弟弟和一个姐姐。
examples.english_sentence: I have three siblings, two younger brothers and an older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兄弟姊妹感情好好，成日一齊出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们兄弟姐妹感情很好，经常一起出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: Their sibling relationship is very good, they often go out to play together.

english_meaning: brother, friend (formal, often used between men)
explanation_mandarin: 对男性的尊称，略带古典或江湖气息，不常用。
explanation_english: A respectful term of address for a man, often implying a classical or江湖 (gangster-like) atmosphere. It is not commonly used in modern conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，兄臺，借問聲，點去旺角啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, hing1 toi4, ze3 man6 seng1, dim2 heoi3 wong6 gok3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，老兄，请问一下，怎么去旺角？
examples.english_sentence: Hey brother, excuse me, could you tell me how to get to Mong Kok?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位兄臺身手唔錯喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 hing1 toi4 san1 sau2 m4 co3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位老兄身手不错啊！
examples.english_sentence: This brother is quite skilled!

english_meaning: elder brother
explanation_mandarin: 年长的哥哥。是对兄长的尊称。
explanation_english: Elder brother. A respectful term for one's older brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅兄長係一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 hing1 zoeng2 hai6 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的兄长是一位医生。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother is a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好尊重佢嘅兄長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5 ge3 hing1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尊重他的兄长。
examples.english_sentence: He respects his elder brother very much.

english_meaning: to pretend to be; to pass oneself off as; to impersonate; to pose as; to charge; to fill
explanation_mandarin: 装作，假扮；填充
explanation_english: To pretend to be something one is not; to impersonate; to fill or charge something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好充大頭鬼啦，你根本唔識佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cung1 daai6 tau4 gwai2 laa1, nei5 gan1 bun2 m4 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别装蒜了，你根本不认识他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be someone you're not, you don't even know him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我充咗少少電先，陣間再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung1 zo2 siu2 siu2 din6 sin1, zan6 gaan1 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先充一下电，一会儿再聊。
examples.english_sentence: I'll charge a little bit of battery first, we'll chat later.

english_meaning: to serve as; to act as; to fulfill the role of
explanation_mandarin: 担任某种职务或角色。指承担某项工作或任务。
explanation_english: To serve in a certain position or role; to undertake a task or duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個委員會充任主席嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 cung1 jam6 zyu2 zik6 ge3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在委员会担任主席的职位。
examples.english_sentence: He serves as the chairman of the committee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充任咗我哋嘅翻譯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 jam6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 faan1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他充当了我们的翻译。
examples.english_sentence: He acted as our translator.

english_meaning: ample; sufficient; full; abundant
explanation_mandarin: 足够，充足；非常。
explanation_english: Enough, sufficient; ample. Used to describe something that is adequate or plentiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要俾充份嘅時間佢哋去完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bei2 cung1 fan6 ge3 si4 gaan3 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要给他们充分的时间去完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to give them ample time to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做功課之前，要充份咁理解啲題目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 gung1 fo3 zi1 cin4, jiu3 cung1 fan6 gam2 lei5 gaai2 di1 tai4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在做作业之前，要充分理解题目。
examples.english_sentence: Before you do your homework, you need to fully understand the questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有充份嘅理由去反對呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 cung1 fan6 ge3 lei5 jau5 heoi3 faan2 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有充分的理由反对这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: They have sufficient reasons to oppose this plan.

english_meaning: to pass oneself off as, to masquerade as, to serve as (in a false capacity)
explanation_mandarin: 假装，冒充，以不真实的身份或事物来代替真实的。
explanation_english: To pretend to be; to pass oneself off as; to serve as something in a false or misleading capacity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充作醫生去呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 zok3 yi1 sang1 heoi3 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冒充医生去骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be a doctor to swindle money from people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞啲爛嘢充作古董嚟賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 di1 laan6 je5 cung1 zok3 gu2 dung2 lai4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿一些破烂的东西冒充古董来卖。
examples.english_sentence: He took some broken things and passed them off as antiques to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇經驗，但係就充作專家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 ging1 jim6, daan6 hai6 zau6 cung1 zok3 zhun1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有经验，但是却冒充专家。
examples.english_sentence: He has no experience, but he pretends to be an expert.

english_meaning: to top up; to recharge (a prepaid card, phone credit, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 给预付费的卡或账户增加余额。通常指给电话卡、交通卡、游戏账户等充入金额。
explanation_english: To add credit or funds to a prepaid card or account. Commonly refers to adding money to phone cards, transportation cards, game accounts, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺便利店充值咗八達通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 cung1 zik6 zo2 baat3 daat6 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在便利店给八达通卡充值了。
examples.english_sentence: I topped up my Octopus card at the convenience store yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你部電話無錢啦，快啲充值啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 cin2 laa1, faai3 di1 cung1 zik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的手机没钱了，快点充值吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your phone has no credit left, top it up quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想問吓點樣可以喺網上充值遊戲點數？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 cung1 zik6 jau4 hei3 dim2 sou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问一下怎么样可以在网上充值游戏点数？
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask how I can top up game points online.

english_meaning: to pretend to be an expert; to bluff knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 指明明不了解某领域或某件事，却装作很懂的样子。
explanation_english: To pretend to be an expert in a field or about a matter that one is not actually knowledgeable about; to bluff or feign understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都唔識，但係又成日充內行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 seng4 jat6 cung1 noi6 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，但是又总是装内行。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he always pretends to be an expert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺專家面前充內行，盞獻醜啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 zhun1 ga1 min6 chin4 cung1 noi6 hong4, zaan2 hin3 cau2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在专家面前装内行，只会出丑而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be an expert in front of experts, you'll only make a fool of yourself.

english_meaning: to confiscate; to expropriate; to nationalize; to forfeit to the state
explanation_mandarin: 把私人或集体的财产没收归公。
explanation_english: To confiscate private or collective property and transfer it to the public or the state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋走私毒品，啲錢俾政府充公咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zau2 si1 duk6 ban2, di1 cin2 bei2 zing3 fu2 cung1 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们走私毒品，那些钱被政府没收了。
examples.english_sentence: They smuggled drugs, and the money was confiscated by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 犯咗法嘅財產可能會俾人充公㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 zo2 faat3 ge3 coi4 saan2 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 jan4 cung1 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 犯法的财产可能会被没收的。
examples.english_sentence: Illegal property may be confiscated.

english_meaning: at most; at best; to the maximum
explanation_mandarin: 表示最大限度的估计；最多。
explanation_english: Indicates the maximum possible estimate; at most; at best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充其量都係得十歲，你唔好expect佢做到啲咩好複雜嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 kei4 loeng6 dou1 hai6 dak1 sap6 seoi3, nei5 m4 hou2 expect keoi5 zou6 dou3 di1 me1 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他充其量也只有十岁，你不要期望他能做些什么很复杂的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He's at most only ten years old, don't expect him to do anything too complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我充其量都係幫你問吓，唔保證一定幫到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung1 kei4 loeng6 dou1 hai6 bong1 nei5 man6 haa5, m4 bou2 zing3 jat1 ding6 bong1 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我充其量只是帮你问一下，不保证一定能帮到你。
examples.english_sentence: At best, I can only help you ask around, I don't guarantee I can definitely help you.

english_meaning: sufficient, ample, full, abundant, thoroughly
explanation_mandarin: 足够，充足，完备。
explanation_english: Enough, sufficient, adequate, complete, thorough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經有充分嘅時間去準備呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 jau5 cung1 fan1 ge3 si4 gaan3 heoi3 zyun2 bei6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经有充分的时间去准备这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We already have sufficient time to prepare for this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有充分嘅理由唔相信你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 cung1 fan1 ge3 lei5 jau5 m4 soeng1 seon3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有充分的理由不相信你。
examples.english_sentence: They have sufficient reasons not to trust you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該充分利用呢個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 goi1 cung1 fan1 lei6 jung6 ni1 go3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该充分利用这个机会。
examples.english_sentence: You should make full use of this opportunity.

mandarin_meaning: 撑场面, 捧场, 充人数
english_meaning: to fill the place, to pack the house, to be a seat filler, to boost attendance
explanation_mandarin: 指为了使场面显得热闹或正式，而故意安排一些人去增加人数，撑场面。通常是帮忙或受雇。
explanation_english: To fill the place, usually for appearances or to make an event seem more popular than it actually is. It refers to the act of artificially increasing the number of attendees, often through hired individuals or favors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋請咗啲臨時演員嚟充場，等間個show睇落去熱鬧啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 di1 lam4 si4 jin2 jyun4 lai4 cung1 coeng4, dang2 gaan1 go3 show tai2 lok6 heoi3 jit6 naau6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们请了一些临时演员来充场，等会演出看起来热闹一些。
examples.english_sentence: We hired some extras to fill the place, so the show will look more lively later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞開幕典禮，搵咗好多人嚟充場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 hoi1 muk6 din2 lai5, wan2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 cung1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们举办开幕典礼，找了很多人来捧场。
examples.english_sentence: They held an opening ceremony and found many people to fill the seats.

english_meaning: to act like a big boss, to pretend to be important, to throw one's weight around
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人没有相应的地位或能力，却装作很有权势，摆架子，摆谱，耍威风。
explanation_english: Describes someone who pretends to be important or has authority they don't actually possess; to act like a big shot or a leader without actually being one; to throw one's weight around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係一個普通文員，但係成日充大班咁，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 man4 jyun4, daan6 hai6 sing4 jat6 cung1 daai6 baan1 gam2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是一个普通职员，但是总是装老大，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's just an ordinary clerk, but he always acts like a big boss, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日充大班啦，有咩本事先？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sing4 jat6 cung1 daai6 baan1 laa1, jau5 me1 bun2 si6 sin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别老是装老大了，你有什么本事啊？
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting like a big boss all the time, what skills do you even have?

mandarin_meaning: 装阔佬, 打肿脸充胖子
english_meaning: To act rich, to show off when you're not wealthy, to pretend to be someone you're not
explanation_mandarin: 指明明经济能力不足，却要装作很有钱的样子，以满足虚荣心。
explanation_english: Refers to pretending to be rich or capable when you are not, usually to impress others or satisfy vanity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇錢，但係都要充大頭鬼買名牌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 cin2, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 cung1 daai6 tau4 gwai2 maai5 ming4 paai4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没钱，但是也要装阔佬买名牌的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't have money, but he still acts rich and buys branded goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪鬼充大頭鬼啦，你嘅情況我好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gwai2 cung1 daai6 tau4 gwai2 laa1, nei5 ge3 cing4 fong3 ngo5 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别装阔佬了，你的情况我很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be rich, I know your situation very well.

english_meaning: fulfilled, enriched, substantial, full
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活或内容丰富、有意义；使生活或内容变得丰富、有意义。
explanation_english: Describing something as full, enriched, or substantial; or to make something full, enriched, or substantial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今年嘅生活可以過得充實啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ge3 sang1 wut6 ho2 ji5 gwo3 dak1 cung1 sat6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望今年的生活可以过得充实一些。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to have a more fulfilling life this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀書可以充實自己嘅知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 ho2 ji5 cung1 sat6 zi6 gei2 ge3 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 读书可以充实自己的知识。
examples.english_sentence: Reading can enrich your knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個暑假我做咗好多義工，覺得好充實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 syu2 gaa3 ngo5 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 ji6 gung1, gok3 dak1 hou2 cung1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个暑假我做了很多义工，觉得很充实。
examples.english_sentence: I did a lot of volunteer work this summer vacation, and I feel very fulfilled.

mandarin_meaning: 撑场面, 撑台面, 充场面
english_meaning: to hold the fort, to keep up appearances, to maintain a facade, to support a situation (often financially or by presence)
explanation_mandarin: 勉强维持场面，使不致冷场或失败。亦可指在经济上支持、维持。
explanation_english: To keep up appearances or maintain a facade, often under difficult circumstances. It can also refer to financially supporting someone or something, or simply being present to lend support and prevent a situation from failing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司生意麻麻，都係靠佢老婆充撐緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 sang1 ji3 maa4 maa4, dou1 hai6 kaau3 keoi5 lou5 po2 cung1 caang1 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司生意一般般，都是靠他老婆在撑着。
examples.english_sentence: His company's business is so-so; it's all thanks to his wife holding it together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都要去充撐下場面，唔係會俾人話唔夠朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 cung1 caang1 haa5 coeng4 min6, m4 hai6 wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 m4 gau3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都要去撑撑场面，不然会被人说不够朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We should go and show our support, otherwise people will say we aren't good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢只係攞嚟充撐場面㗎啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 zi2 hai6 lo2 lai4 cung1 caang1 coeng4 min6 gaa3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西只是用来撑场面的。
examples.english_sentence: These things are just for show.

mandarin_meaning: 撑场面; 撑台面; 场面上的支持
english_meaning: To put on a show; to keep up appearances; to maintain a facade; to hold the fort; to save face; to fill a gap (often in a performance or event)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个场合，为了不让场面冷清或尴尬，而勉强支撑或表现出某种样子。常用于形容能力不足或不情愿但又不得不做的情形。
explanation_english: Refers to putting on a show or keeping up appearances in a situation to prevent it from becoming dull or awkward. It often describes a situation where someone is trying to hold the fort, even if they lack the necessary skills or willingness, but are obligated to do so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唔係咁好聽，但係佢都盡力充撐場面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 teng1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 zeon6 lik6 cung1 caang1 coeng4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌不是很好听，但他还是尽力撑场面。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't sing very well, but he tries his best to put on a show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司生意唔好，所以要充撐場面，扮到好似好好咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 jiu3 cung1 caang1 coeng4 min6, baan3 dou3 hou2 ci5 hou2 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司生意不好，所以要撑场面，装作很好的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Their company isn't doing well, so they have to keep up appearances and pretend that everything is fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨時搵佢嚟充撐場面，希望佢搞得掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 si4 wan2 keoi5 lai4 cung1 caang1 coeng4 min6, hei1 mong6 keoi5 gaau2 dak1 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 临时找他来撑场面，希望他能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He was brought in at the last minute to fill a gap, hopefully he can handle it.

english_meaning: to be full of, to be permeated with, to be flooded with
explanation_mandarin: 指某种事物充满某个空间或地方。
explanation_english: Refers to something filling a space or place completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街充斥住非法泊車嘅車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 cung1 cik1 zyu6 fei1 faat3 paak3 ce1 ge3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街到处都是非法停车的车辆。
examples.english_sentence: This street is full of illegally parked cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上充斥住好多假新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 cung1 cik1 zyu6 hou2 do1 gaa2 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上充斥着很多假新闻。
examples.english_sentence: The internet is flooded with a lot of fake news.

english_meaning: to inflate; inflatable
explanation_mandarin: 用空气或其他气体填充物体；可充气的
explanation_english: To fill something with air or gas; something that can be inflated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波漏氣，要充氣先玩得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 lau6 hei3, jiu3 cung1 hei3 sin1 waan2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球漏气了，要充气才能玩。
examples.english_sentence: The ball is leaking air, we need to inflate it before we can play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係充氣城堡，小朋友好鍾意玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 cung1 hei3 sing4 bou2, siu2 peng4 jau5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个充气城堡，小朋友们很喜欢玩。
examples.english_sentence: This is an inflatable castle, kids love to play with it.

english_meaning: abundant, full of energy, vigorous
explanation_mandarin: 形容精力、力量、情感等非常充足。
explanation_english: Describing energy, strength, or emotion as abundant and sufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日精神好充沛呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zing1 san4 hou2 cung1 pui3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天精神很充沛啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's full of energy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個團隊充滿咗創造力，活力充沛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi2 cung1 mun5 zo2 cong3 zou6 lik6, wut6 lik6 cung1 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个团队充满了创造力，活力充沛。
examples.english_sentence: This team is full of creativity and is very energetic.

english_meaning: full of, brimming with, filled with
explanation_mandarin: 充满：指事物内部或空间被填满，也可以形容情绪饱满。
explanation_english: Full of, filled with; describes something being full of a substance or quality. Can also describe a strong emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個花樽充滿住水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 faa1 zyun1 cung1 mun5 zyu6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花瓶里充满了水。
examples.english_sentence: The vase is full of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充滿自信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 mun5 zi6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他充满自信。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度充滿住歡樂嘅氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 cung1 mun5 zyu6 fun1 lok6 ge3 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里充满了欢乐的气氛。
examples.english_sentence: This place is full of a joyful atmosphere.

english_meaning: To make up the numbers; to fill a space/role inadequately; to be a mere placeholder; to be there just to fill a quota.
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到规定的数量或要求，勉强凑足人数或事物；也指能力不足的人勉强顶替某个职位。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of filling a quota or meeting a requirement by adding inadequate people or things. It also describes a person with insufficient ability勉强 to fill a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲能力咁差，擺佢喺度充班㗎啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 nang4 lik6 gam3 caa1, baai2 keoi5 hai2 dou6 cung1 baan1 gaa3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的能力这么差，把他放在那里只是凑数而已。
examples.english_sentence: His abilities are so poor; he's just there to make up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想淨係充班，我想真係學到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 cung1 baan1, ngo5 soeng2 zan1 hai6 hok6 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不只想凑数，我想真的学到东西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't just want to be a placeholder; I want to actually learn something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搵啲冇經驗嘅人嚟充班，搞衰晒件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wan2 di1 mou5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jan4 lai4 cung1 baan1, gaau2 saai2 saai3 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要找一些没有经验的人来凑数，搞砸了所有的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't find some inexperienced people to fill the role, they'll ruin everything.

mandarin_meaning: 冒充内行; 假装很懂
english_meaning: To act like you know everything; to pose as an expert; to feign expertise; know-it-all
explanation_mandarin: 指明明不懂装懂，假装自己很了解的样子。
explanation_english: Refers to pretending to know something when you actually don't, posing as if you are an expert on the subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，但係又成日充生晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 seng4 jat6 cung1 sang1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，但是又总是装作很懂的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he always acts like he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好充生晒啦，你根本唔了解呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cung1 sang1 saai3 laa1, nei5 gan1 bun2 m4 liu2 gaai2 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别装懂了，你根本不了解这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend you know, you don't even understand this project.

english_meaning: to act as, to serve as, to play the role of
explanation_mandarin: 担任某种职务或角色，起某种作用。
explanation_english: To act in a certain role, function, or position; to serve as.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充當緊我哋嘅翻譯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 dong3 gan2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 faan1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在担任我们的翻译。
examples.english_sentence: He is acting as our translator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充當咗一個和事佬嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 dong3 zo2 jat1 go3 wo4 si6 lou2 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扮演了一个和事佬的角色。
examples.english_sentence: He played the role of a peacemaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊報紙可以充當包裝材料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2 ho2 ji5 cung1 dong3 baau1 zong1 coi4 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧报纸可以充当包装材料。
examples.english_sentence: These old newspapers can serve as packing material.

english_meaning: to turn a deaf ear; to ignore; to pay no attention
explanation_mandarin: 形容故意不听取别人的意见或劝告。
explanation_english: Describes deliberately ignoring other people's opinions or advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日打機唔做功課，我哋勸佢都充耳不聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 daa2 gei1 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, ngo5 dei6 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 cung1 ji5 bat1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天打游戏不做作业，我们劝他都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games every day and doesn't do his homework. We advise him, but he turns a deaf ear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府對市民嘅訴求充耳不聞，令到好多人唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 deoi3 si5 man4 ge3 sou3 kau4 cung1 ji5 bat1 man4, ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府对市民的诉求充耳不闻，让很多人不满意。
examples.english_sentence: The government turns a deaf ear to the people's demands, making many people dissatisfied.

english_meaning: congestion; hyperemia; engorgement; to be congested with blood
explanation_mandarin: 指身体某部位的血管内血液过多，导致该部位肿胀或发红。
explanation_english: Refers to an excessive amount of blood in the blood vessels of a certain part of the body, leading to swelling or redness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻眼唔知點解充哂血，紅卜卜咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 cung1 saai3 hyut3, hung4 buk1 buk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼睛不知道为什么充血了，红红的。
examples.english_sentence: His eye is congested with blood for some reason, it's all red.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路講嘢，講到面紅耳熱，好似充血咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 gong2 je5, gong2 dou3 min6 hung4 ji5 jit6, hou2 ci5 cung1 hyut3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直讲话，讲到面红耳赤，好像充血一样。
examples.english_sentence: He kept talking until his face and ears were red, like he was congested.

english_meaning: abundant, ample, sufficient, plentiful
explanation_mandarin: 指數量或程度非常充足，足夠。
explanation_english: Referring to a quantity or degree that is very ample and sufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有充裕嘅時間去完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 cung1 jyu6 ge3 si4 gaan3 heoi3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有充裕的时间来完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We have ample time to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅雨水好充裕，唔使擔心旱災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 jyu5 seoi2 hou2 cung1 jyu6, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 hon5 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的雨水很充足，不用担心旱灾。
examples.english_sentence: This year's rainfall is abundant, so there's no need to worry about drought.

english_meaning: sufficient; adequate; ample
explanation_mandarin: 足够，富余，满足需要的。
explanation_english: Enough; sufficient; adequate; ample; meeting the requirements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有充足嘅時間準備考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 cung1 zuk1 ge3 si4 gaan3 zyun2 bei6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有充足的时间准备考试。
examples.english_sentence: We have ample time to prepare for the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有充足嘅資源去完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 cung1 zuk1 ge3 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有充足的资源去完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: They have sufficient resources to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睡眠充足對身體健康好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi6 min4 cung1 zuk1 deoi3 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡眠充足对身体健康很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Sufficient sleep is very important for good health.

english_meaning: exile, banishment, transportation (historical punishment)
explanation_mandarin: 古代的一种刑罚，把犯人发配到边远地区服役。
explanation_english: Historically, a form of punishment where convicts were exiled to remote regions to perform labor or military service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代，犯咗重罪嘅人可能會被充軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6, faan2 zo2 cung5 zeoi6 ge3 jan4 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 cung1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，犯了重罪的人可能会被流放。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, people who committed serious crimes might be exiled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污而被充軍到邊疆地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 ji4 bei6 cung1 gwan1 dou3 bin1 goeng1 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为贪污而被流放到边疆地区。
examples.english_sentence: He was exiled to a frontier region for corruption.

english_meaning: to put on airs; to try to look rich; to pretend to be wealthy; to flash the cash
explanation_mandarin: 指明明经济状况不好，却装作很有钱的样子，为了面子而挥霍。
explanation_english: To pretend to be rich when one is not, often by spending lavishly in order to impress others. It implies a discrepancy between appearance and reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇乜錢，但係成日充闊佬，買啲好貴嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 mat1 cin2, daan6 hai6 sing4 jat6 cung1 fut3 lou2, maai5 di1 hou2 gwai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没什么钱，但是整天装阔，买些很贵的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't have much money, but he's always putting on airs and buying expensive things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好充闊佬啦，慳啲錢好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cung1 fut3 lou2 laa1, haan1 di1 cin2 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别装阔了，省点钱更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to act rich, it's better to save some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為咗面子而充闊佬，腳踏實地最重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 min6 zi2 ji4 cung1 fut3 lou2, goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为了面子而装阔，脚踏实地最重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be rich for the sake of face, being down-to-earth is the most important thing.

english_meaning: to charge (electronics); to recharge (oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 给电池补充电量；比喻补充能量，恢复精力。
explanation_english: To charge a battery; metaphorically, to recharge oneself, to replenish energy or motivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電話冇電，要充電先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6, jiu3 cung1 din6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手机没电了，要充电才行。
examples.english_sentence: My phone is out of battery. I need to charge it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放完假要返工，都要畀自己充下電，準備迎接新嘅挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 jyun4 gaa3 jiu3 faan1 gung1, dou1 jiu3 bei2 zi6 gei2 cung1 haa5 din6, zeon2 bei6 jing4 zip3 san1 ge3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放完假要回去工作，也要给自己充充电，准备迎接新的挑战。
examples.english_sentence: After the holiday, I have to go back to work. I also need to recharge myself to prepare for new challenges.

english_meaning: power bank, portable charger
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以为移动设备充电的便携式充电器。
explanation_english: A portable charger for mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出街一定要帶定個充電寶，費事部電話冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 chut1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai3 ding6 go3 cung1 din6 bou2, fai3 si6 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我出门一定要带上充电宝，免得手机没电。
examples.english_sentence: I always bring a power bank when I go out, in case my phone runs out of battery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個充電寶嘅電量好大，可以叉幾次電話。
