examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道佢哋會搞事，所以決定先下手為強，報警囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 wui5 gaau2 si6, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 sin1 haa6 sau2 wai4 koeng4, bou3 ging2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道他们会闹事，所以决定先下手为强，报警了。
examples.english_sentence: I knew they would cause trouble, so I decided to strike first to gain the upper hand and called the police.

english_meaning: Attack is the best form of defense; To strike first is to gain the upper hand.
explanation_mandarin: 指先采取行动，就能掌握主动，取得优势。
explanation_english: This idiom means that taking action first will allow you to seize the initiative and gain an advantage. It implies that it is better to be proactive than reactive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個競爭激烈嘅市場，先下手為強，唔係嘅話好快俾人淘汰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ging6 zang1 gik1 lit6 ge3 si5 coeng4, sin1 haa6 sau2 wai4 koeng4, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 hou2 faai3 bei2 jan4 tau4 tai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个竞争激烈的市场中，先下手为强，不然很快会被淘汰。
examples.english_sentence: In this highly competitive market, it's better to strike first; otherwise, you'll be eliminated quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就截標，我哋先下手為強，今日就遞咗標書啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 zit6 biu1, ngo5 dei6 sin1 haa6 sau2 wai4 koeng4, gam1 jat6 zau6 dai6 zo2 biu1 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就截标了，我们先下手为强，今天就把标书递交了吧。
examples.english_sentence: The bidding closes tomorrow, so let's get ahead of the game and submit our proposal today.

english_meaning: ancestors, deceased person(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指已故的祖先或去世的人，较为委婉的说法。
explanation_english: A respectful term referring to deceased ancestors or people who have passed away. It's a euphemistic way to avoid directly mentioning death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節我哋要去拜先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 sin1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节我们要去祭拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: During the Qingming Festival, we need to go and pay respects to our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺度講先人嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 sin1 jan4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在这里说已经过世的家人的事情。
examples.english_sentence: They often talk about the affairs of their deceased family members here.

synonyms: 過身嘅人 (gwo3 san1 ge3 jan4)

english_meaning: prescient, prophetic, clairvoyant; a sixth sense
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有预知能力，能提前预知未来可能发生的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is prescient, possessing the ability to foresee or predict future events. Having a sense of what will happen before it actually does.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似有啲先令咁，次次買股票都賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 sin1 ling4 gam2, ci3 ci3 maai5 gu2 piu3 dou1 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像有点先知先觉，每次买股票都赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: It's like he has some kind of sixth sense; he makes money every time he buys stocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁迷信啦，邊有人真係有先令㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 mai4 seon3 laa1, bin1 jau5 jan4 zan1 hai6 jau5 sin1 ling4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么迷信了，哪里有人真的有先知先觉的能力啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so superstitious; no one really has clairvoyance.

english_meaning: to spend money you don't yet have; to spend future earnings; to live beyond one's means
explanation_mandarin: 指提前花费未来才能获得的钱，形容过度消费，入不敷出。
explanation_english: Refers to spending money that you have not yet earned or received. It describes excessive consumption and living beyond one's means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都先使未來錢，所以成日爭人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 sin1 sai2 mei6 loi4 cin2, so2 ji5 sing4 jat6 zaang1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是提前消费，所以总是欠别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always spends money he doesn't have yet, so he's always in debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年輕人好多都鍾意先使未來錢，買好多奢侈品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 hou2 do1 dou1 zung1 ji3 sin1 sai2 mei6 loi4 cin2, maai5 hou2 do1 che1 chi2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人喜欢提前消费，买很多奢侈品。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people like to spend future earnings and buy a lot of luxury goods.

english_meaning: precedent, example
explanation_mandarin: 先前做过的事情，可作为后来类似事情的榜样或依据。
explanation_english: An earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide to be considered in subsequent similar circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次咁做開咗個壞先例，以後就好難管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gam2 zou6 hoi1 zo2 go3 waai6 sin1 lai6, ji5 hau6 zau6 hou2 naan4 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这样做开了一个坏的先例，以后就很难管理了。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way this time sets a bad precedent, and it will be difficult to manage in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事冇先例可循，我哋要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 sin1 lai6 ho2 ceon4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事没有先例可循，我们要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: There is no precedent for this matter, we need to handle it carefully.

english_meaning: omen, sign, indication, harbinger
explanation_mandarin: 事情发生前所出现的迹象。
explanation_english: A sign or indication that something is about to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨前通常都會有啲先兆嘅，例如好焗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 cin4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 jau5 di1 sin1 siu6 ge3,例如好焗。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨前通常都会有一些预兆的，例如很闷热。
examples.english_sentence: There are usually some signs before it rains, such as it being very stuffy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功唔係冇先兆嘅，佢一直都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 mou5 sin1 siu6 ge3, keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功不是没有预兆的，他一直都很努力。
examples.english_sentence: His success wasn't without signs; he's always been very hardworking.

english_meaning: just now, a moment ago
explanation_mandarin: 表示不久前发生的事情。
explanation_english: Indicates something that happened a short time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先先見到佢喺樓下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 sin1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 hai2 lau2 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在楼下见到他了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw him downstairs just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先先做緊乜啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 sin1 zou6 gan2 mat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你刚才在做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What were you doing just now?

english_meaning: preconceived notion; to have a preconceived idea; to form a judgment based on first impressions; to be prejudiced
explanation_mandarin: 指在接受新的信息之前，已经因为先前的印象或信息而形成的固定看法或偏见。
explanation_english: Refers to having a preconceived notion or prejudice before receiving new information, often based on initial impressions or prior information. It implies a biased perspective that can influence judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好先入為主，覺得佢一定係壞人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2, gok3 dak1 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hai6 waai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要先入为主，觉得他一定是坏人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have a preconceived notion that he must be a bad person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該先入為主咁樣睇待新嚟嘅同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2 gam2 joeng2 tai5 doi6 san1 lai4 ge3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该先入为主地看待新来的同事。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't have preconceived notions when dealing with new colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為之前嘅經驗，佢對呢間公司已經先入為主，覺得唔會好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 zi1 cin4 ge3 ging1 jim6, keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2, gok3 dak1 m4 wui5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为之前的经验，他对这家公司已经先入为主，觉得不会好。
examples.english_sentence: Because of previous experiences, he already has a preconceived notion about this company and doesn't think it will be good.

english_meaning: preconceived notion; prejudice; to be biased from the start; to form an opinion before knowing all the facts
explanation_mandarin: 指事先形成的某种看法影响了对事物的客观判断，带有主观偏见。
explanation_english: Refers to a preconceived notion or bias that affects one's objective judgment of something, often leading to prejudice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好先入為主咁諗佢哋啦，俾啲時間睇清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2 gam2 nam2 keoi5 dei6 laa1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 tai2 cing1 chu2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要先入为主地这样想他们，给点时间看清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so prejudiced about them. Give it some time to see clearly first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅印象已經先入為主，好難改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 jan3 zoeng6 ji5 ging1 sin1 jap6 wai4 zyu2, hou2 naan4 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对她的印象已经先入为主，很难改变。
examples.english_sentence: His impression of her is already a preconceived notion, it's hard to change.

english_meaning: then; after that
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间顺序，指做完一件事之后再做另一件事。
explanation_english: Indicates the sequence of events, meaning doing one thing and then doing another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯先再做功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 sin1 zoi3 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭然后再做作业吧。
examples.english_sentence: Eat dinner first, then do your homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我沖埋涼先再瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung1 maai4 loeng4 sin1 zoi3 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我洗完澡然后再睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take a shower and then go to sleep.

english_meaning: first come, first served
explanation_mandarin: 按照先来的顺序得到，多用于资源分配或机会获取。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that resources or opportunities are allocated in the order in which people arrive or apply. First come, first served.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲飛先到先得㗎，早啲去排隊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fei1 sin1 dou3 sin1 dak1 gaa3, zou2 di1 heoi3 paai4 deoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些票是先到先得的，早点去排队吧。
examples.english_sentence: These tickets are first come, first served, so go and queue up early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日特價貨品先到先得，賣晒就冇㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dak6 gaa3 fo3 ban2 sin1 dou3 sin1 dak1, maai6 saai3 zau6 mou5 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的特价商品先到先得，卖完就没有了！
examples.english_sentence: Today's special items are first come, first served; once they're sold out, they're gone!

english_meaning: previously; before; formerly
explanation_mandarin: 指时间上较早或较前的时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a time earlier or before the present time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先前已經同你講過呢件事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 cin4 ji5 ging1 tung4 nei5 gong2 gwo3 ni1 gin6 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先前已经跟你说过这件事了。
examples.english_sentence: I already told you about this matter previously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先前我喺嗰度做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 cin4 hai2 go2 dou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我之前在那里工作。
examples.english_sentence: I used to work there before.

english_meaning: the other day; a while ago; recently; some time back
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的一段时间，通常指比较近的一段时间，但具体时间长短根据语境而定。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time in the past, usually a relatively recent period. The exact length of time depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先嗰排我好忙，冇時間覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 go2 paai4 ngo5 hou2 mong4, mou5 si4 gaan3 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前段时间我很忙，没时间回复你。
examples.english_sentence: I was very busy the other day, so I didn't have time to reply to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先嗰排落咗好多雨啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 go2 paai4 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 jyu5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前段时间下了好多雨啊。
examples.english_sentence: It rained a lot a while ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先嗰排去咗旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 go2 paai4 heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前段时间去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: I went traveling some time back.

english_meaning: the previous period; a while ago; recently
explanation_mandarin: 指过去一段时间，通常是不久之前。
explanation_english: Refers to a past period of time, usually not long ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先嗰輪我好忙，日日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 go2 leon4 ngo5 hou2 mong4, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前段时间我很忙，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: I was very busy a while ago, I had to work overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先嗰輪嘅樓價好貴，依家都仲係咁貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 go2 leon4 ge3 lau4 gaa3 hou2 gwai3, ji1 gaa1 dou1 zung1 hai6 gam3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 之前一段时间的房价很贵，现在还是这么贵。
examples.english_sentence: The house prices were very expensive a while ago, and they are still so expensive now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先嗰輪佢去咗旅行，所以冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 go2 leon4 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4, so2 ji5 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前段时间他去旅行了，所以没上班。
examples.english_sentence: He went on a trip a while ago, so he didn't go to work.

english_meaning: innate; congenital; inherent
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物生来就具有的；与“后天”相对。
explanation_english: Referring to something a person or thing is born with; innate or congenital; opposite of 'acquired'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有先天性嘅心臟病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 sin1 tin1 sing3 ge3 sam1 zong6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有先天性的心脏病。
examples.english_sentence: He has a congenital heart disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好埋怨自己嘅先天條件，後天嘅努力都好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 maai4 jyun3 zi6 gei2 ge3 sin1 tin1 tiu4 gin2, hau6 tin1 ge3 nou5 lik6 dou1 hou2 cung5 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抱怨自己的先天条件，后天的努力也很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't complain about your innate conditions; acquired efforts are also very important.

english_meaning: better; preferably; first
explanation_mandarin: 表示最好这样做，或者表示先做某事，然后再做其他事。
explanation_english: Indicates that it is better to do something, or indicates doing something first before doing something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先好打電話畀佢，問清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 hou2 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5, man6 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好先给他打电话，问清楚。
examples.english_sentence: You better call him first and ask clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先好食咗飯，再去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 hou2 sik6 zo2 faan6, zoi3 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们最好先吃饭，再去电影。
examples.english_sentence: We'd better eat first and then go to the movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先好諗清楚，唔好咁快決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 hou2 lam2 cing1 co2, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好想清楚，不要那么快决定。
examples.english_sentence: You better think it through carefully, don't decide so quickly.

english_meaning: to lead, to guide, leader, pioneer, guiding
explanation_mandarin: 带领，引导，走在前面。
explanation_english: To lead, to guide, to be at the forefront. Often used to describe something or someone that initiates or paves the way for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個項目嘅先導者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sin1 dou6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个项目的先导者。
examples.english_sentence: He is the pioneer of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃應該可以先導經濟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ying1 goi1 ho2 yi5 sin1 dou6 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划应该可以引导经济发展。
examples.english_sentence: This plan should be able to guide economic development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺科技方面一直都做緊先導嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 fo1 gei6 fong1 min6 yat1 zik6 dou1 zou6 gan2 sin1 dou6 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在科技方面一直都扮演着先导的角色。
examples.english_sentence: This company has always played a leading role in technology.

jyutping: sin1 siu2 jan4 hau6 gwan1 zi2
english_meaning: Better to be explicit and upfront about expectations and rules from the beginning than to rely on good faith and risk misunderstandings later.
explanation_mandarin: 指事先把丑话说在前头，把条件讲清楚，免得日后发生纠纷，这样才能保持君子之风。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests it's wiser to clearly state the potential downsides, rules, or expectations upfront to avoid misunderstandings and maintain a respectable and harmonious relationship later on. It emphasizes clarity and preventing future disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先小人後君子，份合約嘅條款要寫清楚啲，到時有乜事都好辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 siu2 jan4 hau6 gwan1 zi2, fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4 kwan2 jiu3 se2 cing1 co2 di1, dou3 si4 jau5 mat1 si6 dou1 hou2 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先小人后君子，合同的条款要写清楚一些，到时有什么事都好办。
examples.english_sentence: Let's be upfront about this, the terms of the contract should be written clearly, so that it will be easier to handle things if anything happens later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋先小人後君子，講清楚晒啲責任，唔好到時嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 sin1 siu2 jan4 hau6 gwan1 zi2, gong2 cing1 co2 saai3 di1 zaak3 jam3, m4 hou2 dou3 si4 caau2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们先小人后君子，说清楚所有的责任，不要到时候吵架。
examples.english_sentence: How about we be upfront about things and clearly state all the responsibilities, so we don't argue later.

english_meaning: deceased teacher; late teacher; former teacher (used respectfully)
explanation_mandarin: 敬称已故的老师。用于缅怀或追忆时。
explanation_english: A respectful term for a deceased teacher or mentor. Used when remembering or referring to them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要永遠懷念先師嘅教誨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wing5 jyun5 waai4 nim6 sin1 si1 ge3 gaau3 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该永远怀念先师的教诲。
examples.english_sentence: We should always remember the teachings of our late teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先師嘅哲學思想對我影響好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 si1 ge3 zit3 hok6 si1 soeng2 deoi3 ngo5 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先师的哲学思想对我的影响很深。
examples.english_sentence: The philosophical ideas of my late teacher have had a profound influence on me.

english_meaning: order; sequence; priority; successively; one after another
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生的先后次序，或排列的先后顺序。
explanation_english: Refers to the order in which things happen, or the order of arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋先後嚟到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sin1 hau6 lai4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们先后到了。
examples.english_sentence: They arrived one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要分清楚事情嘅先後次序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 fan1 ching1 chu2 si6 ching4 ge3 sin1 hau6 chi3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要分清楚事情的先后次序。
examples.english_sentence: You need to distinguish the order of priority of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞亂先後次序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 loan6 sin1 hau6 chi3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搞乱先后次序。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess up the order.

english_meaning: only then; only if; only can
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有在某种情况下，才能实现某种结果；强调条件的重要性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something can only happen or be possible under certain conditions; emphasizes the importance of the condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要努力讀書先得㗎，唔係第時點搵到好工啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1 sin1 dak1 gaa3, m4 hai6 dai6 si4 dim2 wan2 dou3 hou2 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你必须努力学习才行啊，不然以后怎么找到好工作啊？
examples.english_sentence: You must study hard, only then can you find a good job in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔道歉先得㗎，我唔會原諒你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 dou6 hip3 sin1 dak1 gaa3, ngo5 m4 wui5 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你必须道歉才行，我不会原谅你的。
examples.english_sentence: You have to apologize, only then will I forgive you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買夠一百蚊先得，先有得抽獎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 gau3 jat1 baak3 man1 sin1 dak1, sin1 jau5 dak1 cau1 zoeng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买满一百块钱才可以，才能参加抽奖。
examples.english_sentence: You have to spend 100 dollars first, only then can you join the lucky draw.

mandarin_meaning: 先机, 优势, 先着
english_meaning: initiative, advantage, first move
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在竞争中占据有利的地位或时机。指抢先一步，获得主动权。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to taking the initiative or gaining an advantage in a competition. It means to be one step ahead and gain control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個項目度攞咗先手，贏嘅機會大好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 dou6 lo2 zo2 sin1 sau2, wing4 ge3 gei1 wui2 daai6 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个项目里抢占了先机，赢的机会大很多了。
examples.english_sentence: He gained the initiative in this project, so his chances of winning are much higher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺競爭入面攞到先手，就要快人一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 ging6 zang1 yap6 min6 lo2 dou2 sin1 sau2, zau6 jiu3 faai3 yan4 yat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要在竞争中取得先机，就要比别人快一步。
examples.english_sentence: To gain the initiative in competition, you have to be one step ahead of others.

mandarin_meaning: 前些日子; 前段时间
english_meaning: a while ago; some time ago; recently
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的一段时间，但具体时间长短并不明确，可能是几天，几周，甚至几个月前。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time in the past, but the exact duration is not specified. It could be a few days, weeks, or even months ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先排天氣好熱，而家涼爽好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 paai2 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6, ji4 gaa1 loeng4 song2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前段时间天气很热，现在凉爽多了。
examples.english_sentence: The weather was very hot a while ago, but it's much cooler now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先排去咗旅行，所以冇覆你信息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 paai2 heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4, so2 ji5 mou5 fuk1 nei5 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前些日子去旅行了，所以没有回复你的信息。
examples.english_sentence: I went on a trip a while ago, so I didn't reply to your messages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢先排好忙，依家應該得閒啲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin1 paai2 hou2 mong4, ji1 gaa1 jing1 goi1 dak1 haan4 di1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他前段时间很忙，现在应该空闲些了。
examples.english_sentence: He was very busy some time ago, he should be free now.

mandarin_meaning: 先动手的人理亏，先挑衅的人卑鄙
english_meaning: Whoever starts it is in the wrong; the one who initiates the provocation is despicable.
explanation_mandarin: 指先挑衅或者先动手的人是卑鄙的，理亏的。强调主动挑起事端者的责任和道德谴责。
explanation_english: This idiom implies that the person who initiates a conflict or provocation is in the wrong and considered despicable. It emphasizes the responsibility and moral condemnation of those who actively start trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好郁手呀，先撩者賤㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 juk1 sau2 aa3, sin1 liu1 ze2 zin6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要动手啊，先动手的人理亏!
examples.english_sentence: Don't you dare lay a hand on me, whoever starts it is in the wrong!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明係佢撩我先，先撩者賤，我打佢都唔過份！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 hai6 keoi5 liu1 ngo5 sin1, sin1 liu1 ze2 zin6, ngo5 daa2 keoi5 dou1 m4 gwo3 fan6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明是他先挑衅我的，先动手的人理亏，我打他也不过分！
examples.english_sentence: It was clearly him who provoked me first, whoever starts it is in the wrong, it's not too much for me to hit him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢衰咗啲，但係你唔應該先撩佢，先撩者賤嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 seoi1 zo2 di1, daan6 hai6 nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 sin1 liu1 keoi5, sin1 liu1 ze2 zin6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他有些不好，但是你不应该先挑衅他，先挑衅的人理亏嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has some faults, you shouldn't have provoked him first, whoever starts it is in the wrong.

jyutping: sin1 liu1 ze2 zin6, daa2 sei2 mou4 jyun3
mandarin_meaning: 先惹事的人卑鄙可耻，被打死也不值得同情
english_meaning: He who starts the trouble is despicable, and deserves no sympathy even if beaten to death.
explanation_mandarin: 指首先挑衅或惹事的人行为卑鄙，即使因此受到严重的惩罚，也不值得同情。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the sentiment that the person who initiates trouble or provokes others is despicable and deserves no sympathy, even if they suffer severe consequences as a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔應該搞人哋先啦，而家俾人打到咁，真係先撩者賤，打死無怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 gaau2 jan4 dei6 sin1 laa1, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 daa2 dou3 gam3, zan1 hai6 sin1 liu1 ze2 zin6, daa2 sei2 mou4 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你本来就不应该先惹别人，现在被人打成这样，真是先惹事的人卑鄙可耻，被打死也不值得同情。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't have provoked them in the first place. Now that you've been beaten up like this, it's really a case of 'he who starts the trouble is despicable, and deserves no sympathy even if beaten to death.'

jyutping: sin1 ging3 lo4 ji1 hau6 ging3 jan4
english_meaning: One judges by appearances before substance; first respect the clothes, then the person.
explanation_mandarin: 指人们往往先根据一个人的衣着打扮来判断其身份地位和价值，然后再决定是否给予尊重。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the tendency to judge a person based on their appearance and clothing before considering their character or worth. It highlights the superficiality of judging individuals by outward appearances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁高級嘅餐廳，梗係先敬羅衣後敬人㗎啦，睇你著得夠唔夠體面先決定點招呼你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 gou1 kap1 ge3 caan1 teng1, gang2 hai6 sin1 ging3 lo4 ji1 hau6 ging3 jan4 gaa3 laa1, tai2 nei5 zoek3 dak1 gau3 m4 gau3 tai2 min6 sin1 kyut3 ding6 dim2 ziu1 fu1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么高级的餐厅，肯定是先敬罗衣后敬人，看你穿得是否体面才决定怎么招待你。
examples.english_sentence: A high-end restaurant like that definitely judges by appearances first. They will decide how to treat you based on how well you're dressed.

mandarin_meaning: 先斩后奏 (xiān zhǎn hòu zòu)
english_meaning: to act first and report later; to act without prior authorization; to present someone with a fait accompli
explanation_mandarin: 指先采取行动，然后才向上级报告或请求批准。通常用于形容在紧急情况下或认为一定会被批准的情况下采取的行动。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to taking action first and reporting to superiors or requesting approval later. It's often used to describe actions taken in urgent situations or when it is believed that approval will definitely be granted. It often implies that permission might not have been granted had it been sought beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知道阿爸唔會俾佢去旅行，所以佢決定先斬後奏，買咗機票先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 dou3 aa3 baa1 m4 wui5 bei2 keoi5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, so2 ji5 keoi5 kyut3 ding6 sin1 zaam2 hau6 zau3, maai5 zo2 gei1 piu3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道爸爸不会让他去旅行，所以他决定先斩后奏，先买了机票。
examples.english_sentence: He knew his dad wouldn't let him go on the trip, so he decided to act first and report later, buying the plane ticket first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經常先斬後奏，搞到員工怨聲載道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 seung4 sin1 zaam2 hau6 zau3, gaau2 dou3 yun4 gung1 yun3 seng1 zoi3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司经常先斩后奏，搞得员工怨声载道。
examples.english_sentence: This company often acts first and reports later, causing employees to complain constantly.

synonyms: [斬釘截鐵 (zaam2 ding1 zit3 tit3) - decisive and firm (but doesn't capture the 'report later' aspect)]

english_meaning: to state beforehand, disclaimer, preliminary statement
explanation_mandarin: 在正式开始之前，预先声明某些事情，以避免误解或引起不必要的争议。
explanation_english: To state something in advance, often as a disclaimer or to avoid misunderstandings or unnecessary controversy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先旨聲明啊，我淨係幫你攞，唔包你一定借到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 zi2 sing1 ming4 aa3, ngo5 zing6 hai6 bong1 nei5 lo2, m4 baau1 nei5 jat1 ding6 ze3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 预先声明，我只是帮你拿，不保证你一定能借到。
examples.english_sentence: Just so you know, I'm just helping you get it, I don't guarantee you'll be able to borrow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先旨聲明，呢個只係我嘅個人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 zi2 sing1 ming4, ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 go3 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 预先声明，这只是我的个人意见。
examples.english_sentence: Just to be clear, this is just my personal opinion.

english_meaning: previously, before, formerly
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的一段时间，通常指不久前。
explanation_english: Refers to a period in the past, usually not long ago. Indicates 'previously', 'before', or 'formerly'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先時佢喺呢間公司做嘢㗎，不過而家轉咗工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 si4 keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6嘢gaa3, bat1 gwo3 ji4 gaa1 zyun2 zo2 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前在这家公司工作，不过现在换工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to work at this company, but he's changed jobs now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先時我哋成日一齊去飲嘢嘅，但係而家大家都忙，好少見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 si4 ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 yam2嘢ge3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 mong4, hou2 siu2 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前我们经常一起去喝酒，但是现在大家都忙，很少见面。
examples.english_sentence: We used to go drinking together often, but now everyone is busy and we rarely see each other.

english_meaning: my late mother
explanation_mandarin: 对已故母亲的尊称。
explanation_english: A respectful term for one's deceased mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對先母嘅回憶仍然好深刻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 sin1 mou5 ge3 wui4 jik1 ying4 yin4 hou2 sam1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对已故母亲的回忆仍然很深刻。
examples.english_sentence: My memories of my late mother are still very vivid.

english_meaning: prerequisite; precondition
explanation_mandarin: 预先决定的、必须具备的条件。
explanation_english: A condition that must be met before something else can happen or be done; a prerequisite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 識講英文係入呢間公司嘅先決條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 gong2 ying1 man2 hai6 yap6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sin1 kyut3 tiu4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会说英语是进这家公司的先决条件。
examples.english_sentence: Speaking English is a prerequisite for joining this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先符合咗所有嘅先決條件，我哋先可以繼續傾落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 fup1 ho4 zo2 so2 yau5 ge3 sin1 kyut3 tiu4 gin2, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 yi5 gai3 zuk6 king1 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先符合了所有的先决条件，我们才可以继续谈下去。
examples.english_sentence: Only after you meet all the prerequisites can we continue talking.

english_meaning: precedent, to set an example, to start a trend, to be the first of its kind
explanation_mandarin: 指先例，或者开创某种新局面。
explanation_english: Refers to a precedent, or the creation of a new situation; to be the first one to do something and set an example for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個做法喺香港開咗先河㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hoi1 zo2 sin1 ho4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的这种做法在香港开了先例。
examples.english_sentence: His approach has set a precedent in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺環保方面開創咗先河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 waan4 bou2 fong1 min6 hoi1 chong3 zo2 sin1 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在环保方面开创了先河。
examples.english_sentence: This company has pioneered in environmental protection.

english_meaning: my late father
explanation_mandarin: 对已故父亲的尊称。
explanation_english: A respectful term for one's deceased father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先父生前成日教我做人嘅道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 fu6 sang1 cin4 seng4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 zou6 jan4 ge3 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已故的父亲生前经常教我做人的道理。
examples.english_sentence: My late father often taught me the principles of life when he was alive.

english_meaning: Mr.; teacher; doctor; husband
explanation_mandarin: 1. 对男性的尊称，相当于“先生”。2. 老师。3. 医生（多指西医）。4. 丈夫。
explanation_english: 1. A respectful form of address for a man, equivalent to "Mr.". 2. Teacher. 3. Doctor (usually referring to Western medicine). 4. Husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生，你好！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 saang1, nei5 hou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生，你好！
examples.english_sentence: Hello, Mr. Li!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，佢係我嘅先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，他是我的老师。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young, he was my teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個先生喺醫院做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 sin1 saang1 hai2 ji1 jyun2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我丈夫在医院工作。
examples.english_sentence: My husband works in the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇醫生嘅時候，護士會叫你先生，好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 ji1 sang1 ge3 si4 hau6, wu6 si2 wui5 giu3 nei5 sin1 saang1, hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看医生的时候，护士会叫你先生，很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: When you see a doctor, the nurse will call you 'Mr.', which is very polite.

synonyms: 老竇 (lou5 dau6 - father, can be slang for husband)

english_meaning: to gain the initiative by striking first; to take preemptive action; to forestall
explanation_mandarin: 指在事情发生之前，或在对方采取行动之前，先下手采取措施，以控制局势，取得优势。
explanation_english: It refers to taking action before something happens, or before the other party takes action, in order to control the situation and gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上面，有時要先發制人，搶佔市場先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6 min6, jau5 si4 jiu3 sin1 faat3 zai3 jan4, coeng2 zim3 si5 coeng4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，有时候要先发制人，抢占市场才行。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, sometimes you need to gain the initiative by striking first to seize the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔先發制人，就會俾佢哋搶咗個合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 sin1 faat3 zai3 jan4, zau6 wui5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 coeng2 zo2 go3 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不先发制人，就会被他们抢走合同。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't take preemptive action, they'll snatch the contract from us.

mandarin_meaning: 先看到为快乐; 先睹为快
english_meaning: To be among the first to see something; to enjoy a sneak preview; to get a head start.
explanation_mandarin: 以能先看到新奇的事物而感到快乐。形容对新事物的期待和渴望。
explanation_english: To take pleasure in being among the first to see something new or exciting. Describes the anticipation and eagerness for new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部新電影聽講好正，等上映之後我一定要先睹為快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 san1 din6 jing2 ting1 gong2 hou2 zeng3, dang2 soeng5 ying2 zi1 hau6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sin1 dou2 wai4 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这部新电影很好看，等上映后我一定要先睹为快。
examples.english_sentence: I heard this new movie is really good. I definitely want to be among the first to see it when it's released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個科技展覽有好多新發明，我哋一齊去先睹為快啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo1 gei6 zin2 laam5 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 faat3 ming4, ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sin1 dou2 wai4 faai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个科技展览有很多新发明，我们一起去先睹为快吧。
examples.english_sentence: This technology exhibition has many new inventions. Let's go and be among the first to see them.

english_meaning: to be among the first to see (something new and exciting); to be eager to see something before anyone else
explanation_mandarin: 形容抢先看到新奇的事物而感到高兴的心情。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being happy to see something new and exciting before others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲我一定要先睹為快，聽講好好睇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sin1 dou2 wai4 faai3, ting1 gong2 hou2 hou2 tai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影我一定要先睹为快，听说很好看。
examples.english_sentence: I must be among the first to see this movie. I heard it's very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新出嘅電子產品，當然要先睹為快啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ceot1 ge3 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2, dong1 jin4 jiu3 sin1 dou2 wai4 faai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新出的电子产品，当然要先睹为快啦！
examples.english_sentence: Of course, I want to be among the first to see the newly released electronic products!

english_meaning: prophet, seer, someone who knows in advance
explanation_mandarin: 指预先知道或预见到未来事情的人。可以指宗教意义上的先知，也可以指有远见卓识的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who knows or anticipates future events in advance. Can refer to a religious prophet or someone with foresight and vision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似先知咁，一早估到會發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 sin1 zi1 gam2, jat1 zou2 gu2 dou3 wui5 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像先知一样，早就猜到会发生什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a prophet, he predicted what would happen early on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔係先知，點會知道咁多嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hai6 sin1 zi1, dim2 wui5 zi1 dou3 gam3 do1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又不是先知，怎么会知道这么多事？
examples.english_sentence: You're not a prophet, how would you know so much?

english_meaning: courtesy first, then force; exhaust all peaceful means before resorting to force
explanation_mandarin: 指先以礼貌待人，如果礼貌的方式行不通，就采取强硬的手段。
explanation_english: This idiom means to exhaust all peaceful and polite means of resolving a situation before resorting to force or aggressive action. It implies an attempt at a diplomatic solution before escalating to conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都想同佢哋傾掂數，但如果佢哋唔合作，就唯有先禮後兵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 king1 dim6 sou3, daan6 jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 m4 hap6 zok3, zau6 wai4 jau5 sin1 lai5 hau6 bing1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都想和他们商量好，但如果他们不合作，就只能先礼后兵了。
examples.english_sentence: We want to negotiate with them to reach an agreement, but if they don't cooperate, we'll have to try courtesy first, then force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經試過好多方法勸佢，但佢都唔聽，睇嚟都要先禮後兵至得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 si3 gwo3 ho2 do1 fong1 faat3 hyun3 keoi5, daan6 keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1, tai2 lai4 dou1 jiu3 sin1 lai5 hau6 bing1 zi3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经尝试过很多方法劝他，但他都不听，看来只能先礼后兵了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already tried many ways to persuade him, but he won't listen. It seems we have to try courtesy first, then force.

english_meaning: To try reasoning or negotiation before resorting to force; exhaust all diplomatic means before resorting to war.
explanation_mandarin: 先以礼貌待人，如果无效，再采取强硬手段解决问题。 比喻先用好言好语去说服别人，如果说服不了，就诉诸武力或采取强制措施。
explanation_english: This idiom means to first try to resolve a situation with courtesy and reason. If that fails, then resort to more forceful methods. It implies exhausting diplomatic or persuasive options before resorting to conflict or coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該先禮而後兵，試下同佢哋傾吓先，如果唔得先再諗其他辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 sin1 lai5 ji4 hau6 bing1, si3 haa5 tung4 keoi5 dei6 king1 haa5 sin1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 dak1 sin1 zoi3 naam2 kei4 taa1 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该先礼后兵，先试着和他们谈谈，如果不行再想其他办法。
examples.english_sentence: We should try to reason with them first, and only resort to other measures if that doesn't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 解決商業糾紛最好先禮而後兵，律師信係第一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai2 kyut3 soeng1 jip6 gau2 fan1 zeoi3 hou2 sin1 lai5 ji4 hau6 bing1, leot6 si1 seon3 hai6 dai6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 解决商业纠纷最好先礼后兵，律师信是第一步。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to resolve business disputes by first attempting negotiation, a lawyer's letter is the first step.

english_meaning: pre-Qin period (before 221 BC)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国历史上的秦朝建立之前的时期，大约从公元前21世纪到公元前221年。
explanation_english: Refers to the period in Chinese history before the establishment of the Qin dynasty, roughly from the 21st century BC to 221 BC.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先秦嗰陣時啲思想家，對中國文化影響好深遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 ceon4 go2 zan6 si4 di1 si1 soeng2 gaa1, deoi3 zung1 gwok3 man4 faa3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先秦时期的思想家，对中国文化影响很深远。
examples.english_sentence: The thinkers of the pre-Qin period had a profound influence on Chinese culture.

english_meaning: to gain the initiative by a show of strength; to overwhelm (the adversary) with a pre-emptive strike; to make a strong first impression
explanation_mandarin: 指一开始就用强大的声势或行动来压倒对方，以取得优势。
explanation_english: To gain the upper hand by overwhelming the opponent with a strong initial show of force or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論比賽入面用咗個好有力嘅開場白，先聲奪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 yung6 zo2 go3 hou2 jau5 lik6 ge3 hoi1 coeng4 baak6, sin1 seng1 dyut6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论比赛中用了一个很有力的开场白，先声夺人。
examples.english_sentence: He used a very powerful opening statement in the debate competition, gaining the upper hand right from the start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用新嘅營銷策略，想喺市場度先聲奪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yung6 san1 ge3 ying4 siu1 caak3 leok6, soeng2 hai2 si5 coeng4 dou6 sin1 seng1 dyut6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司使用新的营销策略，想在市场中先声夺人。
examples.english_sentence: The company is using a new marketing strategy, hoping to make a strong impression and gain dominance in the market.

english_meaning: only then, only to, until then, before
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的先后顺序，前一个动作发生之后，才能有后一个动作；或者表示强调必须先满足某个条件，才能达到某个结果。
explanation_english: Indicates the sequence of events, where the second action can only happen after the first one. It can also emphasize that a condition must be met before a certain result can be achieved. Can also mean 'only to find'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做完功課先至可以睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做完作业才能看电视。
examples.english_sentence: You can only watch TV after you finish your homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住佢會幫我，點知佢先至搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 keoi5 wui5 bong1 ngo5, dim2 zi1 keoi5 sin1 zi3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他会帮我，结果他反而捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he would help me, only to find he was causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要考到好成績，先至可以入到好大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jap6 dou3 hou2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要考到好成绩，才能进入好大学。
examples.english_sentence: You can only get into a good university if you get good grades.

english_meaning: It's best to... / You better... / It's advisable to...
explanation_mandarin: 表示最好先做某事，带有建议或警告的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that it's best to do something first. It often carries a sense of advice, warning, or priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先至好做完功課先出街玩呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 zi3 hou2 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 chut1 gaai1 waan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好先做完作业再出去玩啊。
examples.english_sentence: You better finish your homework before going out to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先至好準時到，唔係嘅話就瀨嘢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 zi3 hou2 zeon2 si4 dou3, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 zau6 laai6 je5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好准时到，不然的话就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: You better be on time, otherwise you'll be in trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先至好諗清楚，唔好咁快決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 zi3 hou2 nam2 cing1 co2, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好想清楚，不要这么快做决定。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better think carefully before making a decision so quickly.

english_meaning: only then will it do; only then is it acceptable; only then is it possible; it is necessary to; have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有先做了某事，之后才能达到某种结果或可以接受某种情况。强调必要性。
explanation_english: Expresses that something must be done first before a certain result can be achieved or a situation can be accepted. Emphasizes necessity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做完功課先至得去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 zi3 dak1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做完作业才可以去玩。
examples.english_sentence: You can only go play after you finish your homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要買樓，儲夠首期先至得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 maai5 lau2, cou5 gau3 sau2 kei4 sin1 zi3 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要买房，攒够首付才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to buy a house, you have to save enough for the down payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你親口同佢道歉先至得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 can1 hau2 tung4 keoi5 dou3 hip3 sin1 zi3 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你必须亲自向他道歉才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: You absolutely have to apologize to him in person.

english_meaning: to go first; to proceed; to take the lead; to do something in advance
explanation_mandarin: 指走在前面；领先；提前进行。
explanation_english: To go first, ahead, or in advance; to take the lead; to proceed ahead of others; to do something earlier than scheduled or expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先行走啦，陣間見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 hang4 zau2 laa1, zan6 gaan1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先走了，一会儿见。
examples.english_sentence: We'll go ahead first, see you in a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你先行處理咗啲文件先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sin1 hang4 cyu5 lei5 zo2 di1 man4 gin2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先处理一下那些文件吧。
examples.english_sentence: You should handle those documents first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢先行一步，去攞位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin1 hang4 jat1 bou6, heoi3 lo2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他先走一步，去拿座位。
examples.english_sentence: He went ahead to get a seat.

mandarin_meaning: 先行者; 先驱者; 先锋
english_meaning: Pioneer; Forerunner; Trailblazer
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域或行动中，第一个开始或做出贡献的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is the first to start or contribute in a particular field or action; a pioneer or trailblazer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺科技界係個先行者，發明咗好多新嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo1 gei6 gaai3 hai6 go3 sin1 hang4 ze2, faat3 ming4 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在科技界是个先行者，发明了很多新的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He is a pioneer in the technology industry, inventing many new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司致力成為行業嘅先行者，不斷推出創新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zi3 lik6 sing4 wai4 hong4 jip6 ge3 sin1 hang4 ze2, bat1 dyun6 tui1 ceot1 chong3 san1 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司致力于成为行业的先行者，不断推出创新产品。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is committed to being a pioneer in the industry, constantly launching innovative products.

english_meaning: foresight; prescience; vision
explanation_mandarin: 事先看清事物发展的趋势和结果的眼力。
explanation_english: The ability to predict the future or the consequences of an action; foresight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一早買定啲股票，真係有先見之明呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zou2 maai5 ding6 di1 gu2 piu3, zan1 hai6 jau5 sin1 gin3 zi1 ming4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他早就买好了那些股票，真是有先见之明啊！
examples.english_sentence: He bought those stocks early on, he really had foresight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你預先做好晒準備，證明你有先見之明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jyu6 sin1 zou6 hou2晒準備, zing3 ming4 nei5 jau5 sin1 gin3 zi1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你预先做好了全部准备，证明你有先见之明。
examples.english_sentence: You prepared everything in advance, proving that you have foresight.

english_meaning: advanced; progressive; pioneer
explanation_mandarin: 指技术、思想、方法等处于领先地位，或具有创新性。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is advanced, progressive, or a pioneer, usually in terms of technology, ideas, or methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅科技好先進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fo1 gei6 hou2 sin1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的科技很先进。
examples.english_sentence: This company's technology is very advanced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅教育方法好先進，值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gaau3 juk6 fong1 faat3 hou2 sin1 zeon3, zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的教育方法很先进，值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: Their educational methods are very advanced and worth learning from.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅醫療技術喺亞洲都算好先進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ji1 liu4 gei6 seot6 hai2 aa3 zau1 dou1 syun3 hou2 sin1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的医疗技术在亚洲也算很先进。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's medical technology is considered very advanced in Asia.

english_meaning: vanguard, pioneer, avant-garde, striker (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指走在最前面的人或事物，起带头作用的人或事物。 也指体育运动中，进攻时位置最靠前的队员。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or thing at the forefront, taking the lead. It also refers to the player in the foremost position during attack in sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺科技創新方面一直都係先鋒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo1 gei6 cong3 san1 fong1 min6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 sin1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在科技创新方面一直都是先锋。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been a pioneer in technological innovation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藝術家嘅作品好前衛，可以話係藝術界嘅先鋒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngai6 seot1 gaa1 ge3 jok3 ban2 hou2 cin4 wai6, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 ngai6 seot1 gaai3 ge3 sin1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个艺术家的作品很前卫，可以说是艺术界的先锋。
examples.english_sentence: This artist's work is very avant-garde and can be said to be a pioneer in the art world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢足球踢得好好，成日做先鋒，幫球隊入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 zuk1 kau4 tek3 dak1 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 zou6 sin1 fung1, bong1 kau4 deoi2 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球踢得很好，经常当前锋，帮球队进球。
examples.english_sentence: He plays football very well, often playing as a striker and helping the team score.

english_meaning: just now, a moment ago, previously
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间，指刚过去不久的时间，相当于“刚才”、“先前”。
explanation_english: Indicates a time in the recent past, equivalent to "just now" or "previously."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先頭喺街度見到你啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 tau4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 gin3 dou2 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在街上看到你了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw you on the street just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先頭我仲話唔肚餓，而家就好肚餓喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 tau4 ngo5 zung6 waa6 m4 tou5 ngo6, ji4 gaa1 zau6 hou2 tou5 ngo6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才我还说不饿，现在就好饿了。
examples.english_sentence: I said I wasn't hungry just now, but now I'm very hungry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 先頭佢仲喺度，唔知去咗邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin1 tau4 keoi5 zung6 hai2 dou6, m4 zi1 heoi3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才他还在，不知道去哪儿了。
examples.english_sentence: He was here just now, I don't know where he went.

english_meaning: vanguard; advance troops; spearhead
explanation_mandarin: 行军或作战时，走在最前面的部队。比喻在某项活动中，走在最前面的人或组织。
explanation_english: Troops that advance ahead of the main force during a march or battle. Figuratively, it refers to people or organizations at the forefront of an activity or movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係公司嘅先頭部隊，負責開拓新市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 sin1 tau4 bou6 deoi2, fu3 zaak3 hoi1 tok3 san1 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是公司的先头部队，负责开拓新市场。
examples.english_sentence: They are the company's vanguard, responsible for developing new markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要做呢個項目嘅先頭部隊，一定要成功！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sin1 tau4 bou6 deoi2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing4 gung1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要做这个项目的先头部队，一定要成功！
examples.english_sentence: We must be the spearhead of this project, we must succeed!

english_meaning: pioneer, forerunner, trailblazer
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域率先倡导或从事某项事业的人。
explanation_english: A person who initiates or pioneers in a particular field or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係香港電影新浪潮嘅先驅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 din6 ying2 san1 long6 ciu4 ge3 sin1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是香港电影新浪潮的先驱。
examples.english_sentence: He is a pioneer of the Hong Kong New Wave cinema.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位科學家喺基因工程方面係一位先驅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 fo1 hok6 gaa1 hai2 gei1 yan1 gung1 cing4 fong1 min6 hai6 jat1 wai2 sin1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位科学家在基因工程方面是一位先驱。
examples.english_sentence: This scientist is a pioneer in the field of genetic engineering.

english_meaning: light; bright; bare; used up; finished
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词; 形容词; 动词
explanation_mandarin: （1）光线，明亮。（2）裸露的，没有遮盖的。（3）用完，耗尽。
explanation_english: (1) Light; brightness. (2) Bare; uncovered. (3) Used up; finished; all gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房好光猛呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 hou2 gwong1 maang5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间很明亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: The room is very bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啲錢用光晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 di1 cin2 yung6 gwong1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的钱都用光了。
examples.english_sentence: We've used up all our money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日光住隻腳喺屋企行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwong1 zyu6 zek3 goek3 hai2 uk1 kei2 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是光着脚在家里走。
examples.english_sentence: He always walks around barefoot at home.

english_meaning: bright; shining; luminous
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物表面光滑而明亮。
explanation_english: Describing something that is smooth and bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房抹到好光亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 mut3 dou3 hou2 gwong1 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间擦得很光亮。
examples.english_sentence: The room has been wiped very clean and bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對皮鞋擦到光亮光亮噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 pei4 haai4 caat3 dou3 gwong1 loeng6 gwong1 loeng6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的皮鞋擦得亮闪闪的。
examples.english_sentence: His leather shoes are polished until they are shining.

english_meaning: Lithography machine, lithographic scanner
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于制造集成电路的关键设备，通过光刻技术将电路图案转移到硅片上。
explanation_english: A critical piece of equipment used in the manufacturing of integrated circuits (microchips). It uses photolithography to transfer circuit patterns onto silicon wafers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇咗光刻機，我哋整唔到最先進嘅晶片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 zo2 gwong1 hak1 gei1, ngo5 dei6 zing2 m4 dou2 zeoi3 sin1 zeon3 ge3 zing1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有了光刻机，我们就制造不出最先进的芯片。
examples.english_sentence: Without lithography machines, we cannot manufacture the most advanced microchips.

english_meaning: To be completely naked, stark naked (especially bottom)
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全赤裸，尤指光着下身或屁股。多带戏谑或略带粗俗的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is completely naked, especially the lower half or buttocks. Often used humorously or with a slightly vulgar connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日光劣出周圍走，都唔怕醜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 seng4 jat6 gwong1 lyut6 ceot1 zau1 wai4 zau2, dou1 m4 paa3 cau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子总是光着屁股到处跑，都不怕羞的。
examples.english_sentence: The little boy always runs around naked, not ashamed at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒之後，竟然光劣出喺街度跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zi1 hau6, ging2 jin4 gwong1 lyut6 ceot1 hai2 gaai1 dou6 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒之后，竟然光着屁股在街上跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: After he got drunk, he actually danced naked in the street.

english_meaning: photosynthesis
explanation_mandarin: 植物利用光能将二氧化碳和水转化为有机物，并释放氧气的过程。
explanation_english: The process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods with carbon dioxide and water. Photosynthesis in plants generally involves the green pigment chlorophyll and generates oxygen as a byproduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 植物係通過光合作用產生能量嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 mat6 hai6 tung1 gwo3 gwong1 hap6 zok3 yung6 chan2 sang1 nang4 loeng6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 植物是通过光合作用产生能量的。
examples.english_sentence: Plants produce energy through photosynthesis.

english_meaning: halo; aura; aperture (photography)
explanation_mandarin: 1. （摄影）照相机镜头中可变孔径的环状装置，用来控制光线进入的量。2. （比喻）围绕在某些人或事物周围的光环，比喻美好的、理想化的形象。
explanation_english: 1. (Photography) Aperture: A variable opening in a camera lens that controls the amount of light passing through. 2. (Figurative) Halo or aura: An idealized or glamorous image surrounding a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋部相機個光圈壞咗，影出嚟嘅相好暗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bou6 soeng3 gei1 go3 gwong1 hyun1 waai6 zo2, ying2 chut1 lei4 ge3 soeng3 hou2 am3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的相机光圈坏了，拍出来的照片很暗。
examples.english_sentence: The aperture of their camera is broken, so the photos taken are very dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明星成日都畀人套上光圈，但係佢哋都係普通人嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 sing1 seng4 jat6 dou1 bei2 jan4 tou3 soeng5 gwong1 hyun1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明星总是被人套上光环，但他们都只是普通人而已。
examples.english_sentence: Celebrities are often given a halo, but they are just ordinary people.

english_meaning: broad daylight; in broad daylight
explanation_mandarin: 指在光天化日之下，一般形容公开的，毫无顾忌地做坏事。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something bad or illegal openly and brazenly in broad daylight, without any regard for consequences or fear of being caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢光天化日之下搶嘢，真係無法無天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwong1 tin1 faa3 jat6 zi1 haa6 coeng2 je5, zan1 hai6 mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他光天化日之下抢东西，真是无法无天。
examples.english_sentence: He robbed something in broad daylight. He is really lawless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光天化日，佢都夠膽打人，都唔知諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 tin1 faa3 jat6, keoi5 dou1 gau3 daam2 daa2 jan4, dou1 m4 zi1 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光天化日之下，他都敢打人，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He dares to hit people in broad daylight. I don't know what he is thinking.

english_meaning: optics
explanation_mandarin: 研究光的性质、行为以及光与物质相互作用的科学。
explanation_english: The branch of physics that studies the behavior and properties of light, including its interactions with matter and the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊大學光學工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6 gwong1 hok6 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在读大学光学工程。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying optical engineering at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部相機嘅光學質素好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 soeng3 gei1 ge3 gwong1 hok6 zat1 so3 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台相机的光学质量很好。
examples.english_sentence: The optical quality of this camera is very good.

english_meaning: to bring honor to one's ancestors; to glorify one's ancestors
explanation_mandarin: 意思是使祖先增光，使家族显耀。指子孙做了大官或出了大名而使祖先和家族都荣耀。
explanation_english: It means to bring honor to one's ancestors and glorify the family name. It refers to the descendants achieving high positions or great fame, thus bringing honor to their ancestors and the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻，第日一定可以光宗耀祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1, dai6 jat6 ding1 jyun4 ji5 gwong1 zung1 yiu6 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，将来一定可以光宗耀祖。
examples.english_sentence: He is so smart; he will surely bring honor to our ancestors in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日都話希望我哋可以光宗耀祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 hei1 mong6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gwong1 zung1 yiu6 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是说希望我们可以光宗耀祖。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always says that he hopes we can bring honor to our ancestors.

english_meaning: light-year
explanation_mandarin: 天文学中常用的距离单位，指光在真空中一年内传播的距离。
explanation_english: A unit of astronomical distance equivalent to the distance that light travels in one year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個星系離我哋有幾多光年咁遠呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sing1 hai6 lei4 ngo5 dei6 jau5 gei2 do1 gwong1 nin4 gam3 jyun5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个星系离我们有多远啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many light-years away is that galaxy from us?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文學家用光年嚟度量宇宙嘅距離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 yung6 gwong1 nin4 lai4 dou6 loeng4 jyu5 zu6 ge3 keoi5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文学家使用光年来测量宇宙的距离。
examples.english_sentence: Astronomers use light-years to measure distances in the universe.

mandarin_meaning: 光彩; 光荣; 体面
english_meaning: glory; honor; splendour; credit; reputation; honorable; creditable; glorious
explanation_mandarin: （名）光荣、荣耀。 （形）光荣的；体面的。
explanation_english: (noun) glory, honor; (adjective) glorious, honorable, creditable, splendid. It refers to something that brings honor or credit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就令屋企人感到好光彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 ling6 uk1 kei2 jan4 gam2 dou3 hou2 gwong1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就让家人感到非常光彩。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements made his family feel very honored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞到呢個獎係我哋公司嘅光彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 dou2 ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 gwong1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 获得这个奖是我们公司的光荣。
examples.english_sentence: Winning this award is an honor for our company.

english_meaning: to restore, to recover (territory, etc.); restoration
explanation_mandarin: 恢复失去的领土、政权、文化等。
explanation_english: To restore or recover something that has been lost, such as territory, political power, or cultural identity. It often carries a strong political connotation, implying a previous state of independence or freedom that is now being reclaimed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光復香港，時代革命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 fuk6 hoeng1 gong2, si4 doi6 gaak3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光复香港，时代革命。
examples.english_sentence: Liberate Hong Kong, revolution of our times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅目標係光復舊日嘅榮耀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 gwong1 fuk6 gau6 jat6 ge3 wing4 yiu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的目标是光复昔日的荣耀。
examples.english_sentence: Their goal is to restore the glory of the old days.

english_meaning: grotesque and motley; bizarre and variegated; fantastic and absurd
explanation_mandarin: 形容奇异、古怪、色彩繁杂的景象。
explanation_english: Describes a strange, grotesque, and colorful scene; bizarre and fantastical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒吧裝修得光怪陸離，好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baa1 geui2 zong1 sau1 dak1 gwong1 gwaai3 luk6 lei4, hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒吧装修得光怪陆离，很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: This bar is decorated in a bizarre and motley style, very unique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個演唱會嘅舞台設計光怪陸離，令人眼花繚亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 mou4 toi4 cit3 gai3 gwong1 gwaai3 luk6 lei4, ling6 jan4 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的演唱会的舞台设计光怪陆离，令人眼花缭乱。
examples.english_sentence: The stage design for their concert was grotesque and motley, dazzling to the eye.

english_meaning: all talk, no action; just empty words; all bluster
explanation_mandarin: 形容人只会说漂亮话，却没有实际行动。
explanation_english: Describes someone who only makes grand promises or talks a big game, but doesn't follow through with any actual work or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咪光捋出啦，做啲嘢嚟睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai5 gwong1 lyut3 cheut1 laa1, zou6 di1 je5 lai4 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别光说不做，做点事情来看看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk the talk, show me some action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好叻，但係咪光捋出㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 mai1 gwong1 lyut3 cheut1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己很厉害，但其实只是光说不做而已。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's great, but he's actually just all talk and no action.

synonyms: 講就天下無敵，做就有心無力

english_meaning: Completely naked; stark naked; bare
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全赤裸，一丝不挂。也形容事情毫无掩饰，彻底坦白。
explanation_english: Describes being completely naked, without any clothes. It can also describe a situation being completely undisguised or thoroughly frank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢沖完涼光捋脫咁走出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 jyun4 loeng4 gwong1 lyut3 tyut3 gam2 zau2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他洗完澡，光着身子走出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He came out completely naked after taking a shower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將件事光捋脫咁講咗出嚟，冇任何隱瞞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gwong1 lyut3 tyut3 gam2 gong2 zo2 ceot1 lai4, mou5 jam6 ho4 yan2 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把这件事赤裸裸地讲了出来，没有任何隐瞒。
examples.english_sentence: He told the whole story plainly and frankly, without hiding anything.

english_meaning: bright, promising, open and aboveboard
explanation_mandarin: 指事物明亮，也指前途有希望，或者行为正直。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is bright. It can also mean having a promising future or behaving honestly and openly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅前景好光明呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 cin4 ging2 hou2 gwong1 ming4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的前景很光明啊。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a very bright future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要光明正大咁做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6 gam2 zou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要光明正大地做人。
examples.english_sentence: We should live our lives in an honest and upright way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房好光明，望落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 hou2 gwong1 ming4, mong6 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间很明亮，看起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The room is very bright and looks comfortable.

english_meaning: upright and honorable; fair and aboveboard; honest and straightforward
explanation_mandarin: 形容行为正直坦荡，没有不可告人的事。
explanation_english: Describes conduct that is upright, honorable, and transparent, with nothing to hide. It implies acting fairly and honestly in all matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要光明正大咁競爭，唔可以用啲卑鄙嘅手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6 gam2 ging6 zang1, m4 ho2 ji5 yung6 di1 bei1 pei3 ge3 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要光明正大地竞争，不可以使用卑鄙的手段。
examples.english_sentence: We must compete fairly and honorably, and not use any underhanded tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人光明正大，所以大家都好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6, so2 ji5 daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人光明正大，所以大家都非常信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is an upright and honorable person, so everyone trusts him very much.

mandarin_meaning: 光明磊落 (guāng míng lěi luò)
english_meaning: upright and honest; open and aboveboard; having nothing to hide
explanation_mandarin: 形容人心地光明坦白，言行正大光明，不做见不得人的事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is upright, honest, and straightforward, with nothing to hide. Their words and actions are open and honest, and they don't engage in underhanded or secretive behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人光明磊落，好受人尊重嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 gwong1 ming4 leoi5 lok3, hou2 sau6 jan4 zyun1 zung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做人光明磊落，很受人尊重。
examples.english_sentence: He is upright and honest, so he is highly respected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做生意要光明磊落，唔可以呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 seng1 ji3 jiu3 gwong1 ming4 leoi5 lok3, m4 ho2 ji5 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做生意要光明磊落，不可以骗人。
examples.english_sentence: We must be honest and aboveboard in business; we cannot cheat people.

synonyms: 襟懷坦蕩 (kam1 waai4 taan2 dong6)

english_meaning: Hanukkah, Feast of Lights, Festival of Dedication
explanation_mandarin: 光明节，又称哈努卡节、修殿节、献殿节、烛光节等，是犹太教的节日，为纪念犹太人在马加比家族的领导下，从塞琉古帝国手中夺回耶路撒冷，并重新将耶路撒冷第二圣殿献给上帝。
explanation_english: Hanukkah (also spelled Chanukah) is a Jewish festival commemorating the rededication of the Second Temple in Jerusalem at the time of the Maccabean Revolt against the Seleucid Empire. It is also known as the Festival of Lights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年都會慶祝光明節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 dou1 wui5 hing3 zuk1 gwong1 ming4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年也会庆祝光明节。
examples.english_sentence: We will also celebrate Hanukkah this year.

mandarin_meaning: 情况, 景象, 景况
english_meaning: circumstances, situation, scenery, prospects
explanation_mandarin: 指情况、景象、景况。可以指一段时间内的境况，也可以指未来的展望。
explanation_english: Refers to circumstances, situation, scenery, or prospects. It can refer to the situation over a period of time or the future outlook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多公司嘅光景都好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 ge3 gwong1 ging2 dou1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多公司的情况都很差。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, and many companies are in a bad situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟今年嘅光景都唔錯，應該可以賺到唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 gam1 nin4 ge3 gwong1 ging2 dou1 m4 co3, jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou2 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来今年的景况不错，应该可以赚到不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: It seems the prospects for this year are good, we should be able to make a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅光景一日差過一日，好擔心會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 gwong1 ging2 jat1 jat6 caa1 gwo3 jat1 jat6, hou2 daam1 sam1 wui5 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的情况一天比一天差，很担心会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's situation is getting worse day by day, I'm very worried that it will go bankrupt.

english_meaning: Light and darkness; contrast (in lighting or situation); shade
explanation_mandarin: 指光线明亮和阴暗的对比，也常用来比喻处境、前途的好坏。
explanation_english: Refers to the contrast between light and darkness. It can also be used figuratively to describe the good and bad aspects of a situation or future prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅相影得好好，光暗處理得好有層次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 soeng3 jeng2 dak1 hou2 hou2, gwong1 am3 cyu2 lei5 dak1 hou2 jau5 cang4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片拍得很好，光暗处理得很有层次。
examples.english_sentence: This photo is taken very well; the contrast of light and darkness is handled with good layers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生充滿光暗，經歷咗好多高低起伏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 cung1 mun5 gwong1 am3, ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 gou1 dai1 hei2 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生充满明暗，经历了很多高低起伏。
examples.english_sentence: His life is full of light and darkness, and he has experienced many ups and downs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業前景光暗未明，投資要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 cin4 ging2 gwong1 am3 mei6 ming4, tau4 zi1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业前景明暗未定，投资要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The prospects of this industry are uncertain, so be careful with investment.

english_meaning: light switch; also used metaphorically to describe a person with unpredictable and quickly changing moods or behavior.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指控制灯光明暗的开关。比喻一个人情绪变化无常，像开关一样，一会儿很开心，一会儿又很低落。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a light switch (specifically one that controls brightness). Metaphorically, it describes a person whose moods or behavior are unpredictable and fluctuate rapidly between extremes (e.g., happy to sad, energetic to lethargic). They are often seen as inconsistent or unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似光暗掣咁，一時一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 gwong1 am3 zai3 gam2, jat1 si4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人就像明暗开关一样，一会儿一个样。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is like a light switch, constantly changing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞佢啦，佢今日心情好似光暗掣咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 gam1 jat6 sam1 ching4 hou2 ci5 gwong1 am3 zai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他了，他今天心情像个明暗开关一样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother him. His mood is like a light switch today.

english_meaning: beam of light; light beam
explanation_mandarin: 指一束集中的光线。
explanation_english: Refers to a concentrated beam of light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺漆黑嘅房間裏面，有一道光束射入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cat1 hak1 ge3 fong2 gaan1 leoi5 min6, jau5 jat1 dou6 gwong1 suk1 se6 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在漆黑的房间里，有一道光束射进来。
examples.english_sentence: In the dark room, a beam of light shone in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用光束照住個舞台，令表演更加精彩。

english_meaning: bachelor; hooligan; rogue; someone without a partner or family (negative connotation); a bare stick
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指没有配偶的男子，即单身汉。带有贬义，指生活上没有依靠，孤苦伶仃。2. 指流氓，地痞。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a man without a spouse, i.e., a bachelor. It often carries a negative connotation, implying a lack of support and loneliness. 2. Refers to a hooligan, rogue, or thug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都咁大個仔喇，仲係光棍一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 gam3 daai6 go3 zai2 laa3, zung6 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 jat1 tiu4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同啲光棍佬埋堆，費事學壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 di1 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 maai4 deoi1, fai3 si6 hok6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要和那些流氓混在一起，免得学坏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hang out with those hooligans, lest you learn bad habits.

english_meaning: bachelor, single man
explanation_mandarin: 指没有结婚的男人，通常带有调侃或玩笑的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to an unmarried man, often with a teasing or joking connotation. It can also sometimes imply a lack of social skills or desirability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都四十幾歲啦，都仲係光棍佬一條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 sei3 sap6 gei2 seoi3 laa1, dou1 zung6 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 jat1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都四十多岁了，还是个单身汉。
examples.english_sentence: He's over forty years old, and still a bachelor.

mandarin_meaning: 单身汉教儿子；没人可依靠，只能靠自己
english_meaning: A bachelor teaching his son; to rely on oneself only, self-taught, often implying a lack of proper guidance or skill due to the teacher's inexperience or lack of support.
explanation_mandarin: 指单身汉教儿子，比喻指没有人可以依靠，只能靠自己摸索学习，也暗示因为缺乏指导，技术可能不够专业或不完美。
explanation_english: This idiom literally translates to 'a bachelor teaching his son.' It metaphorically refers to a situation where someone is self-taught or learning without proper guidance. It often implies a degree of self-reliance born out of necessity but can also suggest a lack of polish or complete understanding due to the absence of expert instruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學整嘢乜都係光棍佬教仔，冇人教佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zing2 je5 mat1 dou1 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 gaau3 zai2, mou5 jan4 gaau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学做东西都是自己摸索的，没人教他。
examples.english_sentence: He learned to make things by himself; no one taught him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢啲手藝就知佢係光棍佬教仔，唔夠專業嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5 di1 sau2 ngai6 zau6 zi1 keoi5 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 gaau3 zai2, m4 gau3 zyun1 jip6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他的手艺就知道他是自己摸索的，不够专业。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at his craftsmanship, you can tell he is self-taught; it's not professional enough.

jyutping: gwong1 gwan3 lou2 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4
mandarin_meaning: 一穷二白的人碰上一个更穷的人; 穷鬼碰上穷鬼
english_meaning: A poor bachelor meets a penniless person; Beggar meets beggar.
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个都很穷的人碰在一起，都无法互相帮助。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two very poor people meet, and neither can offer any help to the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個都冇錢，真係光棍佬遇着冇皮柴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 leong5 go3 dou1 mou5 cin2, zan1 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个都没钱，真是穷鬼碰上穷鬼。
examples.english_sentence: Both of us have no money; it's really beggar meets beggar.

jyutping: gwong1 gwan3 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4
mandarin_meaning: 光棍碰上老油条; 棋逢对手
english_meaning: An experienced bachelor meets a cunning rogue; diamond cuts diamond; a match made in hell (in a negative context).
explanation_mandarin: 光棍指经验丰富的单身男子，冇皮柴指老奸巨猾、很难对付的人。这句话形容两个不好对付的人碰到了一起，通常带有负面含义，指他们可能会互相算计，造成麻烦。
explanation_english: "光棍 (gwong1 gwan3)" refers to a seasoned bachelor, often implying resourcefulness and experience in navigating life, sometimes with a hint of mischievousness. "冇皮柴 (mou5 pei4 caai4)" refers to someone who is slippery, cunning, and difficult to deal with, often implying a lack of moral scruples. The phrase describes a situation where two such individuals meet, suggesting a potentially problematic and competitive interaction. It implies that neither will back down, and they might scheme against each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個搞搞震嘅人一齊合作，真係光棍遇着冇皮柴，實冇好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 ge3 yan4 jat1 cai4 hap6 jok3, zan1 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4, sat6 mou5 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个惹事生非的人一起合作，真是棋逢对手，肯定没有好事。
examples.english_sentence: These two troublemakers working together, it's really a cunning rogue meeting an experienced bachelor, definitely nothing good will come of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明咁醒目，遇到阿強呢個老油條，真係光棍遇着冇皮柴，唔知邊個著數啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 gam3 sing2 muk6, jyu6 dou2 aa3 keung4 ni1 go3 lou5 yau4 tiu4, zan1 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4, m4 zi1 bin1 go3 zoek3 sou3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明这么精明，遇到阿强这个老油条，真是旗鼓相当，不知道谁能占到便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Ming is so clever, meeting Keung who is such a sly fox, it's really a match made in hell, who knows who will get the upper hand.

english_meaning: shiny; bright; gleaming

explanation_english: Describes a surface that is very smooth and bright; gleaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車洗完之後，光棖棖，好似新嘅一樣。

examples.english_sentence: After washing the car, it's shiny and bright, just like a new one.

examples.english_sentence: His leather shoes are polished to a gleam, making him look very energetic.

english_meaning: glory, honor, glorious, honorable
explanation_mandarin: 指值得尊敬的荣誉，也形容光彩荣耀。
explanation_english: Refers to deserving respect and honor; also describes something glorious and honorable.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得为国服务是很光荣的。
examples.english_sentence: He feels that serving the country is very honorable.

english_meaning: varnish, clear coat
explanation_mandarin: 一种透明的油漆，用于保护物体表面并使其光滑有光泽。
explanation_english: A transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. It is intended to protect the surface and make it glossy.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有了光源，就很难看清楚东西。
examples.english_sentence: Without a light source, it's hard to see things clearly.

english_meaning: smooth; glossy; sleek
explanation_mandarin: 表面平滑，没有粗糙、阻碍或不平整之处。
explanation_english: Having a smooth surface, free from roughness, bumps, or unevenness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個檯面好光滑，抹得好乾淨。

examples.english_sentence: This table surface is very smooth, wiped very clean.

english_meaning: luster, gloss, sheen
explanation_mandarin: 物体表面所发出的光彩。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啲絲質好靚，有種特別嘅光澤。

examples.english_sentence: Her hair is very healthy and looks very glossy.

english_meaning: bright, well-lit
explanation_mandarin: 形容光线充足，非常明亮。
explanation_english: Describes a place with ample lighting, very bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房光猛咗好多，住得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gwong1 maang5 zo2 hou2 do1, zyu6 dak1 syu1 fuk1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间亮堂了很多，住起来也舒服多了。

examples.english_sentence: It's very bright here at night, so there's no need to be afraid.

english_meaning: halo, aura, prestige, reputation
explanation_mandarin: 比喻加在人或事物上的某种荣誉或美好印象。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to the aura, prestige, or good reputation associated with a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前喺大公司做過，所以有光環。

english_meaning: shiny; glossy; smooth (often implying something is bare or barren)
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面非常光滑明亮，有时也指缺少覆盖物，显得光秃秃的。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is very smooth and shiny. It can also imply a lack of covering, making something appear bare or barren.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋嘅地板擦到光瓦噉，行路都要小心。

examples.english_sentence: The floor in his house is polished so shiny, you have to be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個頭剃到光瓦，好似粒雞蛋咁。

examples.english_sentence: His head is shaved completely bald, like an egg.

mandarin_meaning: 光盘行动; 吃光盘子里的食物

explanation_english: Originally refers to optical discs (CDs, DVDs, etc.). Now, it primarily refers to the "Clean Plate Campaign," which promotes finishing all the food on one's plate to avoid food waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日都叫我光盤，唔好嘥嘢食。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗支持光盤運動，我每次食飯都盡量食晒所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 zi1 chi4 gwong1 pun4 wan6 dung6, ngo5 mui5 ci3 sik6 faan6 dou1 zeon6 leung6 sik6 saai3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了支持光盘运动，我每次吃饭都尽量吃完所有东西。
examples.english_sentence: In order to support the Clean Plate Campaign, I try my best to finish everything I eat every time.

english_meaning: bright and shiny; smooth and bare
