examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱面俾佢抹到光瞪瞪。

english_meaning: Compact Disc (CD), DVD

english_meaning: CD-ROM drive; optical disc drive
explanation_mandarin: 一种读取光盘数据的电脑硬件。
explanation_english: A computer hardware component that reads data from optical discs such as CDs and DVDs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦冇光碟機，裝唔到個軟件呀。

examples.english_sentence: This computer doesn't have a CD-ROM drive, I can't install the software.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少人用光碟機啦，大家都用USB手指多。

examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few people use CD-ROM drives. Everyone uses USB flash drives more.

english_meaning: Completely bare; stark naked; bald
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面光秃秃，什么都没有，多用来形容光头、赤裸等状态。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is completely bare and devoid of anything. Often used to describe a bald head, nakedness, or a completely empty surface.

examples.english_sentence: His head is completely bald, he doesn't have any hair at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱光禿碌，咩嘢都冇擺。

explanation_english: Refers to a head without hair, or describes a person as having no hair (bald).

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai3 zo2 go3 gwong1 tau4, tai2 lok6 hau6 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剃了个光头，看起来年轻了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He shaved his head bald, and he looks much younger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯個光頭好光滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 go3 gwong1 tau4 hou2 gwong1 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯伯的光头很光滑。
examples.english_sentence: The old man's bald head is very smooth.

english_meaning: Bald-headed kid, little bald boy
explanation_mandarin: 指头发很少或者没有头发的小男孩。
explanation_english: Refers to a young boy with very little or no hair on his head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇下個光頭仔幾得意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 haa5 go3 gwong1 tau4 zai2 gei2 dak1 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看看那个小光头多可爱！
examples.english_sentence: Look how cute that little bald boy is!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時都係光頭仔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 dou1 hai6 gwong1 tau4 zai2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候也是个小光头。
examples.english_sentence: He was a little bald boy when he was young.

english_meaning: bald man, baldy
explanation_mandarin: 指头发脱落，头部光秃的男人。有时候略带戏谑或不尊重的意味，但具体取决于语境。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who is bald. Sometimes used playfully or disrespectfully, depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁大聲話人係光頭佬，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 daai6 seng1 waa6 jan4 hai6 gwong1 tau4 lou2, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么大声说别人是光头，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout that someone is a baldy, it's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔離嗰個光頭佬成日都遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 lei4 go2 go3 gwong1 tau4 lou2 seng4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我旁边那个光头佬总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: That bald man next to me is always late.

cantonese: 光頭佬擔遮 - 無髮無天
jyutping: gwong1 tau4 lou2 daam1 ze1 -- mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1
english_meaning: Lawless; Unscrupulous; Acting with reckless disregard for the consequences.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是光头佬打伞，既没有头发也没有天。引申为形容人肆无忌惮，胡作非为，没有任何约束。
explanation_english: Literally, it means 'a bald man holding an umbrella - no hair, no sky'. It's a play on words where 'hair' (髮 faat3) is a homophone for 'law' (法 faat3) and 'sky' (天 tin1) represents authority or consequence.  It describes someone who is lawless and doesn't fear authority or consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣貪污呃錢，真係光頭佬擔遮——無髮無天！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 taam1 wu1 aak1 cin2, zan1 hai6 gwong1 tau4 lou2 daam1 ze1 -- mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样贪污骗钱，真是无法无天！
examples.english_sentence: The way he embezzles and scams money, it's truly lawless!

english_meaning: Bald tire; worn-out tire (with little to no tread)
explanation_mandarin: 指轮胎的胎面花纹几乎完全磨平，失去抓地力，非常危险。
explanation_english: Refers to a tire where the tread is almost completely worn away, resulting in poor grip and making it dangerous to drive on. The tire appears 'bald'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架車啲呔已經變咗光頭呔，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa1 ce1 di1 taai1 ji5 ging1 bin3 zo2 gwong1 tau4 taai1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那辆车的轮胎已经变成光头胎了，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: The tires on his car have become bald tires; it's very dangerous.

english_meaning: to patronize; to visit (a shop or restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 指顾客到商店或餐厅消费。
explanation_english: To visit a shop or restaurant as a customer and spend money there; to patronize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝光顧！下次再嚟啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 gwong1 gu3! haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢光顾！下次再来啊！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your patronage! Please come again next time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日都光顧呢間餐廳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 gwong1 gu3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常光顾这家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: We often patronize this restaurant.

english_meaning: bright, fresh, smart (in appearance), glossy
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表光亮、鲜艳、体面。
explanation_english: Describes something as bright, fresh, and presentable in appearance; glossy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着得好光鮮喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 gwong1 sin1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得很光鲜啊。
examples.english_sentence: He is dressed very smartly today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修得好光鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 dak1 hou2 gwong1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修得很光鲜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is decorated very brightly and freshly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋表面好光鮮，但實際上經濟好拮据。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 biu2 min6 hou2 gwong1 sin1, daan6 sik6 zeoi3 soeng6 ging1 zai3 hou2 gat1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们表面上很光鲜，但实际上经济很拮据。
examples.english_sentence: They appear to be well-off on the surface, but actually they are financially strapped.

english_meaning: neat, tidy, and presentable; smart-looking
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表非常干净、整洁、漂亮，给人一种神清气爽的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something looking very clean, tidy, and attractive, giving a refreshed and well-put-together impression. Can refer to appearance, clothing, or general presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打扮得好光鮮企理，唔知去邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2扮dak1 hou2 gwong1 sin1 kei5 lei5, m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天打扮得很整洁漂亮，不知道要去哪里。
examples.english_sentence: He is dressed very neatly and smartly today; I wonder where he's going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋執拾到光鮮企理，睇落都舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zap1 sap6 dou3 gwong1 sin1 kei5 lei5, tai2 lok6 dou1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子收拾得整洁亮丽，看起来也舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: The house is tidied up nicely and neatly; it looks much more comfortable.

english_meaning: Shiny, glossy, glistening
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面非常光滑明亮。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very smooth and shiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架新車抹到光𥋇𥋇，好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 san1 ce1 mut3 dou3 gwong1 lat6 lat6, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆新车擦得亮晶晶的，真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: This new car is polished to a glistening shine, so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲玻璃抹完之後光𥋇𥋇，睇嘢都清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bo1 lei1 mut3 jyun4 zi1 hau6 gwong1 lat6 lat6, tai2 je5 dou1 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些玻璃擦完之后亮晶晶的，看东西都清楚些了。
examples.english_sentence: After wiping, the glass is shiny and clear, making it easier to see things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搽咗啲唇膏，嘴唇光𥋇𥋇噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa4 zo2 di1 seon4 gou1, zeoi2 seon4 gwong1 lat6 lat6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她涂了些唇膏，嘴唇亮晶晶的。
examples.english_sentence: She applied some lipstick, making her lips shiny and glossy.

mandarin_meaning: 克服; 攻克; 克制
english_meaning: to overcome; to conquer; to restrain; to gram (unit of weight)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 克服，战胜。 2. 抑制，约束。 3. 用作质量单位，等于千分之一公斤。
explanation_english: 1. To overcome, conquer, or defeat. 2. To restrain or control. 3. Gram: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一定要克服呢個困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hak1 fuk6 ni1 go3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一定要克服这个困难。
examples.english_sentence: I must overcome this difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得克制自己嘅脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 hak1 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会克制自己的脾气。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to control his temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個藥有五克重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 joek6 jau5 ng5 hak1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个药有五克重。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine weighs five grams.

english_meaning: to restrain, to control, to exercise self-control
explanation_mandarin: 抑制、约束自己的情感或行为。
explanation_english: To restrain or control one's emotions or actions; to exercise self-control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一定要克制住自己嘅脾氣呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hak1 zai3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 pei4 hei3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要控制住自己的脾气啊。
examples.english_sentence: You must restrain your temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力咁克制住自己唔喊出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 hak1 zai3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 m4 haam3 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地克制自己不哭出来。
examples.english_sentence: He tried hard to restrain himself from crying.

english_meaning: cracker; biscuit
explanation_mandarin: 一种薄而脆的饼干。通常比较咸，也可以是甜的。
explanation_english: A thin, crisp biscuit, often savoury but can also be sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好肚餓呀，食塊克力架先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 tou5 ngo6 aa3, sik6 faai3 hak1 lik6 gaak3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好饿啊，先吃一块饼干。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so hungry, I'll eat a cracker first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲克力架配芝士好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hak1 lik6 gaak3 pui3 zi1 si6 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些饼干配芝士很好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: These crackers with cheese are very delicious.

english_meaning: formidable; impressive; capable; awesome; tough; able
explanation_mandarin: 形容人能力强，厉害，不易对付。
explanation_english: Describes a person's strong abilities, impressive capabilities, and difficulty to deal with; formidable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好克戟㗎，你搞唔掂佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hak1 gik1 gaa3, nei5 gaau2 m4 dim6 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很厉害的，你搞不定他的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very capable person, you won't be able to handle him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲銷售員個個都好克戟，所以業績咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 siu1 sau6 jyun4 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 hak1 gik1, so2 ji5 jip6 jik1 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的销售员个个都很厉害，所以业绩这么好。
examples.english_sentence: Every salesperson in this company is very capable, that's why their performance is so good.

english_meaning: to conquer the enemy and achieve victory; to overcome and prevail
explanation_mandarin: 战胜敌人，取得胜利。形容在战斗或竞争中获得成功。
explanation_english: To conquer the enemy and achieve victory; describes success in battle or competition. It implies overcoming challenges and emerging as the winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經過充分嘅準備，最終克敵制勝，贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 cung1 fan1 ge3 zeon2 bei6, zeoi3 chung1 hak1 dik6 zai3 sing3, wing4 zo2 cheung4 bei2 choi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经过充分的准备，最终克敌制胜，赢了这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: After thorough preparation, they finally conquered the enemy and won the game.

synonyms: 戰無不勝 (zin3 mou4 bat1 sing3)
旗開得勝 (kei4 hoi1 dak1 sing3)

english_meaning: to overcome, to surmount, to conquer
explanation_mandarin: 战胜、制服 (zhànshèng, zhìfú)。指用力量或意志战胜困难、障碍。
explanation_english: To overcome, surmount, or conquer difficulties or obstacles, often through effort and determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢克服咗好多困難先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hak1 fuk6 zo2 ho2 do1 kwan3 naan4 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他克服了很多困难才能成功。
examples.english_sentence: He overcame many difficulties before he could succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要克服自己嘅恐懼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hak1 fuk6 zi6 gei2 ge3 hung2 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要克服你自己的恐惧。
examples.english_sentence: You need to overcome your own fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要克服呢個難關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hak1 fuk6 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要克服这个难关。
examples.english_sentence: We must overcome this difficulty.

mandarin_meaning: 尽心尽力做好自己的职责
english_meaning: to fulfill one's duty to the best of one's ability; to perform one's duty conscientiously
explanation_mandarin: 尽心尽力做好自己应该做的事情。
explanation_english: To do one's duty to the utmost, to the best of one's ability. It emphasizes the importance of fulfilling one's responsibilities conscientiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要克盡己任，先可以完成呢個咁大嘅工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hak1 zeon6 gei2 jam6, sin1 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 gam3 daai6 ge3 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要尽心尽力做好自己的工作，才能完成这个这么大的工程。
examples.english_sentence: We must fulfill our duties to the best of our abilities in order to complete such a large project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都克盡己任，所以老闆好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hak1 zeon6 gei2 jam6, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都尽心尽力做好自己的工作，所以老板很信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He has always performed his duties conscientiously, so the boss trusts him a lot.

english_meaning: to follow in one's father's footsteps; to carry on the family tradition
explanation_mandarin: 比喻继承父祖的事业。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes someone continuing or inheriting the profession or legacy of their ancestors, especially their father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老豆係一個好出名嘅律師，佢都想克紹箕裘，將律師行發揚光大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 dau2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 leot6 si1, keoi5 dou1 soeng2 hak1 siu6 gei1 cau4, zoeng1 leot6 si1 hang4 faat3 joeng4 gwong1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是一个很有名的律师，他也想继承父业，将律师事务所发扬光大。
examples.english_sentence: His father is a very famous lawyer, and he also wants to follow in his footsteps and develop the law firm.

english_meaning: Croatia
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲国家，克罗地亚
explanation_english: Croatia, a country in Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去克羅地亞旅行啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 hak1 lo4 dei6 aa3 leoi5 hang4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好想去克罗地亚旅行啊！
examples.english_sentence: I really want to travel to Croatia!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 克羅地亞嘅海岸線好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hak1 lo4 dei6 aa3 ge3 hoi2 ngon6 sin3 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 克罗地亚的海岸线很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The coastline of Croatia is very beautiful.

english_meaning: Klein bottle
explanation_mandarin: 克莱因瓶是一种没有“内部”和“外部”之分的不可定向的曲面，类似于莫比乌斯带，但莫比乌斯带是二维表面，克莱因瓶是三维空间中的一个表面，尽管实际上它只能在四维空间中实现。
explanation_english: A Klein bottle is a non-orientable surface with no "inside" or "outside". It's analogous to a Möbius strip, but where the Möbius strip is a 2-dimensional surface, a Klein bottle is a 3-dimensional surface, though in reality, it can only be realized in four dimensions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 克萊因瓶嘅結構好得意，佢係一個冇內外之分嘅曲面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hak1 loi4 yan1 ping4 ge3 git3 kau3 hou2 dak1 yi3, keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 mou5 noi6 ngoi6 zi1 fan1 ge3 kuk1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 克莱因瓶的结构很有意思，它是一个没有内外之分的曲面。
examples.english_sentence: The structure of a Klein bottle is very interesting. It's a surface with no distinction between inside and outside.

english_meaning: Crimea
explanation_mandarin: 指位于黑海北岸的克里米亚半岛。
explanation_english: Refers to the Crimean Peninsula, located on the northern coast of the Black Sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 克里米亞嘅局勢好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hak1 lei5 mei5 aa3 ge3 guk6 sai3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 克里米亚的局势很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The situation in Crimea is very complicated.

english_meaning: Clone, to clone
explanation_mandarin: 指复制生物体的技术，也指模仿或复制行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the technique of creating an identical copy of an organism. Also refers to imitating or replicating behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想克隆呢隻狗，因為佢好聰明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 hak1 lung4 ni1 zek3 gau2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 cung1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想克隆这只狗，因为牠很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: They want to clone this dog because it's very smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲騙徒成日克隆人哋個網站嚟呃錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pin3 tou4 seng4 jat6 hak1 lung4 jan4 dei6 go3 mong5 zaam6 lai4 aak1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骗子经常克隆别人的网站来骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: Scammers often clone other people's websites to scam money.

english_meaning: to exchange, to convert, to cash (a check)
explanation_mandarin: 指将一种东西转换成另一种东西，例如货币兑换。
explanation_english: To exchange or convert something, typically referring to currency exchange or cashing a cheque.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想兌錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 deoi3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想兑换钱。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行可以幫你兌外幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 deoi3 ngoi6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行可以帮你兑换外币。
examples.english_sentence: The bank can help you exchange foreign currency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張支票可以去邊度兌？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi1 piu3 ho2 ji5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 deoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张支票可以去哪里兑换？
examples.english_sentence: Where can I cash this cheque?

mandarin_meaning: 兑换, 兑现, 折合
english_meaning: to exchange, to convert, to cash (a check)
explanation_mandarin: 兑换：将一种货币或物品换成另一种；兑现：将支票或承诺变成现金；折合：将一种单位或数量换算成另一种。
explanation_english: To exchange: to change one currency or item for another. To cash: to convert a check or promise into cash. To convert: to change one unit or quantity into another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將啲美金兌港幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 di1 mei5 gan1 deoi3 gong2 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把这些美元兑换成港币。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange these US dollars for Hong Kong dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張支票幾時可以兌錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi1 piu3 gei2 si4 ho2 ji5 deoi3 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张支票什么时候可以兑现啊？
examples.english_sentence: When can I cash this check?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢如果兌換成人民幣係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 wun6 sing4 jan4 man4 bai6 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格如果兑换成人民币是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What is this price if converted to Renminbi?

english_meaning: to exchange, to convert (currency)
explanation_mandarin: 将一种货币或票据换成另一种货币或票据。
explanation_english: To exchange one currency for another, or to convert one form of payment into another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想兌換港幣去美金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 deoi3 wun6 gong2 bai6 heoi3 mei5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把港币兑换成美元。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange Hong Kong dollars for US dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺邊度兌換外幣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 deoi3 wun6 ngoi6 bai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在哪里兑换外币？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you exchange foreign currency?

english_meaning: to exchange; to convert (currency)
explanation_mandarin: 把一种货币换成另一种货币，或把东西换成等值的其他东西。
explanation_english: To exchange one currency for another, or to exchange something for something else of equal value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將啲美金兌換成港幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 di1 mei5 gam1 deoi3 wun6 sing4 gong2 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把一些美元兑换成港币。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange some US dollars into Hong Kong dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺邊度兌換錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 deoi3 wun6 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在哪里兑换钱？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you exchange money?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我想兌換一百英鎊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 soeng2 deoi3 wun6 jat1 baak3 jing1 bong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，我想兑换一百英镑。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange one hundred pounds.

english_meaning: to cash (a check, etc.); to honor (a promise); to make good (a promise); to materialize; to fulfil; to realize
explanation_mandarin: 实现诺言、承诺、支票等。
explanation_english: To fulfill a promise, commitment, check, etc.; to make something promised or expected become a reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承我嘅嘢，終於兌現咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing1 sing4 ngo5 ge3 je5, zung1 jyu1 deoi3 jin6 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应我的事情，终于兑现了。
examples.english_sentence: The things he promised me have finally been fulfilled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張支票可以喺銀行兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 deoi3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张支票可以在银行兑现。
examples.english_sentence: This check can be cashed at the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢承諾過會幫我，希望佢會兌現啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 nok6 gwo3 wui5 bong1 ngo5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 wui5 deoi3 jin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他承诺过会帮我，希望他会兑现诺言。
examples.english_sentence: He promised to help me, I hope he will honor his promise.

english_meaning: to fulfill; to honour (a promise); to cash (a cheque)
explanation_mandarin: 實現、履行（諾言、承諾等）；將票據換成現金。
explanation_english: To fulfill or honour a promise, pledge, or commitment; to convert a cheque or other negotiable instrument into cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗嘅嘢，一定要兌現啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 sing4 zo2 ge3 je5, jat1 ding6 jiu3 deoi3 hin6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应的事情，一定要兑现啊。
examples.english_sentence: You must fulfill what you promised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將張支票兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 deoi3 hin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把这张支票兑现。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to cash this cheque.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望佢可以兌現承諾，唔好再拖落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 deoi3 hin6 sing4 nok6, m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望他可以兑现承诺，不要再拖下去了。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, he can fulfil his promise and stop procrastinating.

english_meaning: to avoid, to exempt, to waive, free (of charge)
explanation_mandarin: 表示避免，免除，或者免费的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates to avoid, exempt, or something being free of charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 免費入場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min5 fai3 jap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 免费入场。
examples.english_sentence: Free admission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被免職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 min5 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被免职了。
examples.english_sentence: He was dismissed from his post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事你可以免去唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 nei5 ho2 ji5 min5 heoi3 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事你可以免去做。
examples.english_sentence: You can avoid doing this.

english_meaning: Take your pick; Feel free to choose
explanation_mandarin: 指不用客气，可以随意选择或挑选。
explanation_english: It means 'feel free to choose' or 'take your pick'. It implies that you don't need to hesitate and can choose freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲糖喺度，免㨂啦，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tong2 hai2 dou6, min5 zaang2 laa1, m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糖在这里，随便挑吧，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: The candies are here, feel free to choose. Don't be polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意邊件衫啊？免㨂啦，我送俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 gin6 saam1 aa3? min5 zaang2 laa1, ngo5 sung3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢哪件衣服？随便选吧，我送给你。
examples.english_sentence: Which piece of clothing do you like? Feel free to choose, I'll give it to you as a gift.

english_meaning: unavoidable; bound to happen; inevitable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种情况难以避免，一定会发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain situation is difficult to avoid and will definitely happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工時間搭地鐵，免不了要逼啲㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 si4 gaan3 daap3 dei6 tit3, min5 bat1 liu5 jiu3 bik1 di1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班时间坐地铁，免不了要挤一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking the subway during rush hour, it's inevitable that it will be crowded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試之前咁緊張，免不了會失眠嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zi1 cin4 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, min5 bat1 liu5 wui5 sat1 min4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试之前这么紧张，难免会失眠的。
examples.english_sentence: Being so nervous before the exam, it's inevitable that you'll have trouble sleeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做錯嘢免不了要俾人鬧㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 co3 je5 min5 bat1 liu5 jiu3 bei2 jan4 naau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做错事难免要被人骂的。
examples.english_sentence: If you do something wrong, it's unavoidable that you will be scolded.

english_meaning: Commission-free, no commission
explanation_mandarin: 指不需要支付佣金。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where no commission fee is required to be paid, often used in real estate or financial transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間地產公司話買樓免佣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dei6 caan2 gung1 si1 waa6 maai5 lau2 min5 yung2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家房地产公司说买房免佣金。
examples.english_sentence: This real estate company says that buying a house is commission-free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好多股票户口都免佣金交易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 gaa1 hou2 do1 gu2 piu3 wu6 hau2 dou1 min5 yung2 gam1 gaau1 yik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多股票账户都是免佣金交易。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many stock accounts offer commission-free trading.

english_meaning: to avoid; to be spared from; to be exempt from
explanation_mandarin: 避免或防止受到（不好的事物）。
explanation_english: To avoid or prevent being subjected to (something undesirable). To be exempt from something negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打咗疫苗就可以免受重症嘅風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zo2 jik6 miu4 zo6 jau5 ho2 ji5 min5 sau6 zung6 zing3 ge3 fung2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打了疫苗就可以避免遭受重症的风险。
examples.english_sentence: Having the vaccine can prevent you from the risk of severe illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個法律嘅修改可以令到市民免受不公平對待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faat3 leot6 ge3 sau1 goi2 ho2 ji5 ling6 dou3 si5 man4 min5 sau6 bat1 gung1 ping4 deoi3 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项法律的修改可以使市民免受不公平的待遇。
examples.english_sentence: This amendment to the law can protect citizens from unfair treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗免受塞車之苦，我決定搭地鐵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 min5 sau6 sak1 ce1 zi1 fu2, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 daap3 dei6 tit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了避免堵车之苦，我决定搭地铁。
examples.english_sentence: In order to avoid the suffering of traffic jams, I decided to take the subway.

english_meaning: exemption from military service
explanation_mandarin: 免除服兵役的义务。
explanation_english: To be exempt from military service; exemption from compulsory military service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣身體唔好，所以免役咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2陣 san1 tai2 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 min5 jik6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候身体不好，所以免除了兵役。
examples.english_sentence: He was in poor health when he was young, so he was exempted from military service.

english_meaning: so as to avoid; lest; in order to avoid
explanation_mandarin: 表示避免发生某种不希望出现的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates avoiding an undesirable situation from happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好帶多件衫，免得凍親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 daai3 do1 gin6 saam1, min5 dak1 dung3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好多带一件衣服，免得冻着。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better bring an extra piece of clothing, so as to avoid catching a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋早啲出門口，免得塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2, min5 dak1 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们早点出门，免得堵车。
examples.english_sentence: Let's leave earlier, so as to avoid traffic congestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你細聲啲講嘢，免得嘈醒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai3 seng1 di1 gong2 je5, min5 dak1 cou4 sing2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小声点说话，免得吵醒他。
examples.english_sentence: Speak softer, so as not to wake him up.

english_meaning: interest-free
explanation_mandarin: 不收取利息的。
explanation_english: Without interest; interest-free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話做緊免息分期，可以分十二個月俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 zou6 gan2 min5 sik1 fan1 kei4, ho2 ji5 fan1 sap6 ji6 go3 jyut6 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款手机正在做免息分期，可以分十二个月付款。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is being offered with interest-free installments, you can pay in twelve months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行有時會提供免息貸款俾學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 jau5 si4 wui5 tai4 cung1 min5 sik1 taai3 fun2 bei2 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行有时会提供免息贷款给学生。
examples.english_sentence: Banks sometimes offer interest-free loans to students.

english_meaning: No need to choose; whatever; anything
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要特别挑选，什么都可以；也可以表示随便、无所谓的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no need to choose specifically, anything will do; can also mean 'whatever', 'don't care'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 是但啦，免揀啦，你鍾意乜就乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 daan6 laa1, min5 gaan2 laa1, nei5 zung1 ji3 mat1 zau6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便吧，不用挑了，你喜欢什么就什么。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever, don't bother choosing, whatever you like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏啲食飯，你免揀嘅，我請你食好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 di1 sik6 faan6, nei5 min5 gaan2 ge3, ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚点吃饭，你随便点，我请你吃好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have dinner later, you can order anything, I'll treat you to something good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔緊要嘅，免揀都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gan2 jiu3 ge3, min5 gaan2 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没关系的，随便都可以。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter, anything will do.

english_meaning: hands-free
explanation_mandarin: 指电话或音响设备具有不用手持麦克风或听筒就能通话或播放音乐的功能。
explanation_english: Refers to a feature in phones or audio devices that allows users to talk or play music without holding a microphone or receiver in their hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我開咗免提，你可以大聲啲講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoi1 zo2 min5 tai4, nei5 ho2 ji5 daai6 seng1 di1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我开了免提，你可以大声点说话。
examples.english_sentence: I've turned on the hands-free mode, you can speak louder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸車嘅時候，最好用免提聽電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 jung6 min5 tai4 teng1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车的时候，最好用免提听电话。
examples.english_sentence: When driving, it's best to use hands-free to answer the phone.

english_meaning: license to kill; get-out-of-jail-free card; something that protects someone from consequences
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代皇帝赐给臣子的，可以免除死罪的牌子。现在比喻可以免除惩罚或者后果的凭证或特权。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to a tablet bestowed by the emperor to officials in ancient times, which could exempt them from the death penalty. Now, it's a metaphor for a certificate or privilege that can exempt someone from punishment or consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸係老細，佢好似攞住張免死金牌咁，點做都冇人敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 hai6 lou5 sai3, keoi5 hou2 ci5 lo2 zyu6 zoeng1 min5 sei2 gam1 paai4 gam2, dim2 zou6 dou1 mou5 jan4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是老板，他好像拿着免死金牌一样，做什么都没人敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: His father is the boss, it's like he's holding a get-out-of-jail-free card, no one dares to say anything no matter what he does.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人覺得有學位就好似攞咗張免死金牌，唔使再努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 jau5 hok6 wai2 zau6 hou2 ci5 lo2 zo2 zoeng1 min5 sei2 gam1 paai4, m4 sai2 zoi3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人觉得有了学位就好像拿了免死金牌，不用再努力。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think that having a degree is like having a get-out-of-jail-free card, they don't need to work hard anymore.

english_meaning: minced (meat)
explanation_mandarin: 指被绞碎的肉，通常指猪肉、牛肉等。是英文“minced”的音译。
explanation_english: Refers to meat that has been minced or ground. Usually refers to pork, beef, etc. It's a transliteration of the English word "minced".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日晚餐我想食免治牛肉飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 maan5 caan1 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 min5 zi6 ngau4 juk6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天晚餐我想吃肉末牛肉饭。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat minced beef rice for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲免治豬肉好新鮮喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 min5 zi6 zyu1 juk6 hou2 san1 sin1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的猪肉馅很新鲜啊。
examples.english_sentence: The minced pork here is very fresh.

english_meaning: immunity, immune
explanation_mandarin: 指身体具有抵抗疾病的能力；也指免除某种义务或责任。
explanation_english: The ability of the body to resist disease; also refers to being exempt from certain obligations or responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打咗疫苗之後，身體就會對嗰種病有免疫力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zo2 yik6 miu4 zi1 hau6, san1 tai2 zau6 wui5 deoi3 go2 zung2 beng6 jau5 maan5 yik6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打了疫苗之后，身体就会对那种病有免疫力。
examples.english_sentence: After getting vaccinated, the body will have immunity to that disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢件事上面係有免疫權嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 seong6 min6 hai6 jau5 maan5 yik6 kuen4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这件事上是有免疫权的。
examples.english_sentence: He has immunity in this matter.

english_meaning: immunity
explanation_mandarin: 身体抵抗疾病的能力。
explanation_english: The ability of the body to resist disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多啲做運動可以增強免疫力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 di1 zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 zang1 koeng4 maan5 jik6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多做运动可以增强免疫力。
examples.english_sentence: Doing more exercise can boost your immunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢免疫力差，成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan5 jik6 lik6 caa1, seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他免疫力差，经常生病。
examples.english_sentence: He has poor immunity and gets sick often.

english_meaning: Immune system
explanation_mandarin: 生物体抵抗病原体和其他有害物质的复杂系统。
explanation_english: The complex system of the body that defends against disease-causing organisms and other harmful substances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅免疫系統好弱，所以成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 maan5 yik6 hai6 tung2 hou2 joek6, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的免疫系统很弱，所以经常生病。
examples.english_sentence: His immune system is weak, so he gets sick often.

english_meaning: tax-free; duty-free
explanation_mandarin: 指不需要缴纳税款的，一般用于商品。
explanation_english: Describing something that is exempt from taxes or duties, typically used for goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣好多免稅嘅化妝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 min5 seoi3 ge3 faa3 zong1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖很多免税的化妆品。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells a lot of duty-free cosmetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺機場買免稅煙通常平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gei1 coeng4 maai5 min5 seoi3 jin1 tung1 soeng4 peng4 di1.
