examples.english_sentence: We need to declare our income for the whole year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠投資增加入息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 tau4 zi1 zeng1 gaa1 jap6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠投资增加收入。
examples.english_sentence: He increases his income through investments.

english_meaning: Income tax
explanation_mandarin: 政府根据个人或企业的收入征收的税款。
explanation_english: A tax levied by the government on income earned by individuals or businesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年要交好多入息稅呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 jiu3 gaau1 hou2 do1 jap6 sik1 seoi3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年要交很多所得税呀！
examples.english_sentence: I have to pay a lot of income tax this year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計入息稅好複雜，最好搵會計師幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 jap6 sik1 seoi3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, zeoi3 hou2 wan2 wui6 gai3 si1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 计算所得税很复杂，最好找会计师帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Calculating income tax is complicated, it's best to find an accountant to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工人工高，所以要交好多入息稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1, so2 ji5 jiu3 gaau1 hou2 do1 jap6 sik1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作工资高，所以要交很多所得税。
examples.english_sentence: His job pays well, so he has to pay a lot of income tax.

english_meaning: to get into character, to become immersed in a role, to be caught up in the drama (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指演员投入到角色中，或者形容一个人在某种情境中表现得非常投入、逼真，仿佛身临其境。
explanation_english: Refers to an actor getting deeply involved in a role, or describes a person's behaviour in a certain situation as being very committed and realistic, as if they were actually in that situation. Can be used literally for actors, or figuratively for someone overreacting or playing a part in real life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍戲好入戲，睇到我都信以為真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 hei3 hou2 jap6 hei3, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 seon3 ji5 wai4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他演戏很入戏，看得我都信以为真。
examples.english_sentence: He gets so into character when he's acting that I believe it's real.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁入戲啦，都係一場戲啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jap6 hei3 laa1, dou1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 hei3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么入戏啦，都只是一场戏而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get so caught up in it, it's just a play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起佢嘅遭遇，真係好入戲，搞到我差啲信咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 keoi5 ge3 zaau1 geoi6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jap6 hei3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 seon3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲起他的遭遇，真的非常入戏，搞得我差点就相信了。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about his experience, he was really into it, making me almost believe him.

mandarin_meaning: 得到, 获得, 购买
english_meaning: to obtain, to acquire, to purchase, to get one's hands on
explanation_mandarin: 取得, 获得, 通常指购买或得到某物。
explanation_english: To obtain or acquire something, often through purchase or acquisition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於入手咗最新嘅iPhone喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jap6 sau2 zo2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 iPhone laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我终于买到最新的iPhone了！
examples.english_sentence: I finally got my hands on the latest iPhone!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個樓盤好搶手，唔快啲入手就冇㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lau4 pun4 hou2 coeng2 sau2, m4 faai3 di1 jap6 sau2 zau6 mou5 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个楼盘很抢手，不快点买就没了。
examples.english_sentence: This property is in high demand, if you don't buy it soon, it will be gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫幾靚喎，我都想入手一件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gei2 leng3 wo3, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 jap6 sau2 jat1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服挺漂亮的，我也想买一件。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is quite nice, I want to get one too.

english_meaning: to be in sync; to click (with someone); to be compatible; to get along well
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人或多个人在性格、兴趣、做事方式等方面非常合得来，容易相处。
explanation_english: Describes two or more people being compatible in terms of personality, interests, work style, etc., making it easy to get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好入拍，成日一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 jap6 paak3, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很合得来，经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: I get along with him very well, we often play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好入拍，好快就變咗好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 jap6 paak3, hou2 faai3 zau6 bin3 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个很合得来，很快就变成了好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Those two clicked really well and quickly became good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個team嘅人好入拍，做嘢都順利好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 team1 ge3 jan4 hou2 jap6 paak3, zou6 je5 dou1 seon6 lei6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们团队的人很合拍，工作也顺利多了。
examples.english_sentence: The people in our team are very compatible, and the work is much smoother.

english_meaning: to deposit money (into an account)
explanation_mandarin: 把钱存入银行账户。
explanation_english: To deposit money into a bank account. It refers to the action of physically or electronically transferring funds into an account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想入數去你個戶口度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jap6 sou3 heoi3 nei5 go3 wu6 hau2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把钱存到你的账户里。
examples.english_sentence: I want to deposit money into your account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得今日要入數俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 gam1 jat6 jiu3 jap6 sou3 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得今天要给他存钱。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to deposit money for him today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你入咗數未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jap6 zo2 sou3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你存钱了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you deposited the money yet?

english_meaning: deposit slip
explanation_mandarin: 银行存款后，银行给出的凭证，证明已存入相应金额。
explanation_english: A document issued by a bank confirming that money has been deposited into an account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得攞返張入數紙，證明你交咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 jap6 sou3 zi2, zing3 ming4 nei5 gaau1 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拿回存款凭条，证明你交了钱。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take back the deposit slip as proof that you have paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗張入數紙，點算好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 zoeng1 jap6 sou3 zi2, dim2 syun3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把存款凭条弄丢了，怎么办好？
examples.english_sentence: I've lost the deposit slip, what should I do?

english_meaning: fashionable, trendy, stylish, up-to-date
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人很时髦，符合当前的流行趋势。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as fashionable, trendy, stylish, or up-to-date, conforming to current trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著衫好入時㗎，成日都跟住潮流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 hou2 jap6 si4 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 gan1 zoek3 ciu4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿衣服很时髦，总是跟随潮流。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses very fashionably, always following the trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生仔嘅髮型都好入時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 ge3 faat3 jing4 dou1 hou2 jap6 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人的发型都很时髦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, the hairstyles of young people are very fashionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話設計好入時，好多人都想買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 sai3 gai3 hou2 jap6 si4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款手机设计很时髦，很多人都想买。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has a very trendy design, many people want to buy it.

english_meaning: to join a membership; to become a member
explanation_mandarin: 指加入某个组织、社团、俱乐部或成为会员。
explanation_english: To join an organization, association, club, or to become a member of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想入會打波，你覺得點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jap6 wui2 daa2 bo1, nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想加入会员打球，你觉得怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: I want to join the membership to play ball. What do you think?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入會費幾多錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 wui2 fai3 gei2 do1 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入会费多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much is the membership fee?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗工會會，爭取權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 gung1 wui2 wui2, zaang1 ceoi2 kuen4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他加入了工会，争取权益。
examples.english_sentence: He joined the labor union to fight for his rights.

mandarin_meaning: 入木三分 (rù mù sān fēn)
english_meaning: Penetrating; incisive; profound; to write or express something in a very forceful and effective way; deeply affecting
explanation_mandarin: 形容书法笔力遒劲。也比喻分析问题很深刻或对事物观察得很透彻。
explanation_english: Originally used to describe calligraphy where the brush strokes are so powerful they seem to penetrate the wood. Now it is used as a metaphor to describe profound insight, a deeply affecting portrayal, or an incisive analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戲入面嘅演技真係入木三分，好感動人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hei3 jap6 min6 ge3 jin2 gei6 zan1 hai6 jap6 muk6 saam1 fan1, hou2 gam2 dung6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在戏里的演技真是入木三分，很感人。
examples.english_sentence: His acting in the movie was truly penetrating and deeply moving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇評論寫得好入木三分，將問題嘅核心都點出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 ping3 leon6 se2 dak1 hou2 jap6 muk6 saam1 fan1, zoeng1 man6 tai4 ge3 hak1 sam1 dou1 dim2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇评论写得很好，入木三分地指出了问题的核心。
examples.english_sentence: This commentary is written very incisively and points out the core of the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢分析得入木三分，令我哋對件事嘅睇法更加清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan1 sik1 dak1 jap6 muk6 saam1 fan1, ling6 ngo5 dei6 deoi3 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 gang3 ga1 cing1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他分析得很入木三分，让我们对这件事的看法更加清晰。
examples.english_sentence: His analysis was very penetrating, making our views on this matter clearer.

english_meaning: to intrude, to interfere, to get involved (uninvited)
explanation_mandarin: 指未经允许或不被欢迎的情况下，插入、介入到某个事件、关系或讨论中。
explanation_english: To intrude or interfere in a matter, relationship, or discussion without invitation or welcome. Often implies unwelcome involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾緊偈，你唔好入楔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 gan2 gai2, nei5 m4 hou2 jap6 sit3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在聊天，你不要插足进来。
examples.english_sentence: We're talking, don't intrude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆嗌交，你唔好入楔咁多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 aai3 gaau1, nei5 m4 hou2 jap6 sit3 gam3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻吵架，你不要插手那么多。
examples.english_sentence: They are a couple arguing, don't interfere so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔關你事，你唔好入楔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6, nei5 m4 hou2 jap6 sit3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不关你的事，你不要插手。
examples.english_sentence: This is none of your business, don't interfere.

english_meaning: to submit a tender; to bid
explanation_mandarin: 参与竞标，提交投标书。
explanation_english: To submit a tender or bid for a project or contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今次都有入標，希望可以攞到呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 ci3 dou1 jau5 jap6 biu1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 lo2 dou3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司这次也投标了，希望可以拿到这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Our company also submitted a tender this time, hoping to win this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今次入標嘅公司好多，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gam1 ci3 jap6 biu1 ge3 gung1 si1 hou2 do1, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这次投标的公司很多，竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that many companies are bidding this time, and the competition is fierce.

english_meaning: to dunk (in basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 在篮球比赛中，跳起将球从篮筐上方扣入篮筐。
explanation_english: To dunk; to jump and force the basketball down through the hoop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勁呀，可以入樽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ging6 aa3, ho2 ji5 jap6 zeon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害，可以灌篮。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good, he can dunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我夢想有朝一日可以喺正式比賽入樽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mung6 soeng2 jau5 ziu1 jat6 ho2 ji5 hai2 zing3 sik1 bei2 coi3 jap6 zeon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我梦想有一天能在正式比赛中灌篮。
examples.english_sentence: I dream of being able to dunk in a real game someday.

english_meaning: to be closeted (regarding one's sexual orientation)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人隐藏自己的同性恋、双性恋或跨性别身份，不向他人公开。
explanation_english: Refers to a person hiding their homosexual, bisexual, or transgender identity and not revealing it to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都入櫃，唔敢同屋企人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 jap6 gwai6, m4 gam2 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都隐藏着自己的性取向，不敢和家人说。
examples.english_sentence: He's been closeted all along, not daring to tell his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定出櫃，唔想再入櫃生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 cheut1 gwai6, m4 seung2 zoi3 jap6 gwai6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定出柜，不想再过隐藏的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to come out of the closet, not wanting to live a hidden life anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，好多同志仍然被迫入櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2, hou2 do1 tung4 zi3 jing4 jin4 bei1 bik1 jap6 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，很多同性恋者仍然被迫隐藏自己的性取向。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, many LGBTQ+ people are still forced to be closeted.

english_meaning: to encoffin; to place the corpse in the coffin; to prepare the deceased for burial
explanation_mandarin: 指将死者放入棺材的过程。通常包括为死者穿戴寿衣，整理仪容，放入棺材，以及在棺材中放置陪葬品等环节。
explanation_english: The process of placing a deceased person into a coffin. It usually includes dressing the deceased in burial clothes, tidying up their appearance, placing them in the coffin, and placing burial objects inside the coffin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日佢哋已經幫婆婆入殮喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 bong1 po4 po2 jap6 lim5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天他们已经为奶奶入殓了。
examples.english_sentence: They already encoffined grandma yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入殮嗰陣，記得放啲佢生前鍾意嘅嘢入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 lim5 go2 zan6, gei3 dak1 fong3 di1 keoi5 sang1 cin4 zung1 yi3 ge3 je5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入殓的时候，记得放一些他生前喜欢的东西进去。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put some of his favorite things inside when encoffining him.

english_meaning: to get angry; to pump air (into something); to give encouragement
explanation_mandarin: 1. （生气）表示感到生气或不满。2. （打气）指将空气或其他气体注入物体内部。3. (给予鼓励)给予鼓励或者支持。
explanation_english: 1. (To get angry) To feel angry or upset. 2. (To pump air) To inflate something with air or gas. 3. (To give encouragement) To give encouragement or support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再激佢啦，再激佢就入氣㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gik1 keoi5 laa1, zoi3 gik1 keoi5 zau6 jap6 hei3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹他了，再惹他他就要生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, if you do he's going to get angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架單車冇氣，我要入氣先踩得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 daan1 ce1 mou5 hei3, ngo5 jiu3 jap6 hei3 sin1 caai2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自行车没气了，我要打气才能骑。
examples.english_sentence: The bicycle tire is flat, I need to pump it up before I can ride it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就比賽啦，我哋要幫佢哋入氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 bei2 coi3 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 dei6 jap6 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要比赛了，我们要给他们加油！
examples.english_sentence: The competition is tomorrow, we need to give them encouragement!

english_meaning: to refuel; to get gas; to fill up with gas
explanation_mandarin: 给汽车、摩托车等交通工具添加燃料（汽油、柴油等）。
explanation_english: To fill a vehicle (car, motorcycle, etc.) with fuel (gasoline, diesel, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車冇油喇，我哋要去入油先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 jap6 jau4 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车没油了，我们得去加油才行。
examples.english_sentence: The car is out of gas, we need to refuel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，入滿佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, jap6 mun5 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦，加满！
examples.english_sentence: Please fill it up!

english_meaning: to score a goal
explanation_mandarin: 指在足球或其他球类运动中，将球射入对方球门，得分。
explanation_english: To score a goal in football or other ball games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先場波佢入咗兩球呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 coeng4 bo1 keoi5 jap6 zo2 loeng5 kau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那场球赛他进了两个球啊！
examples.english_sentence: He scored two goals in the game just now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波一定要入波先得㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jap6 bo1 sin1 dak1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队一定要进球才行！
examples.english_sentence: Our team must score a goal!

english_meaning: to be mainstream; to be fashionable; to be in the 'in' crowd; to be part of the current trend
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某人变得流行，被大众所接受和追捧，成为主流的一部分。也可以形容人很时髦，跟得上潮流。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone becoming popular, accepted, and sought after by the public, becoming part of the mainstream. It can also describe someone who is fashionable and keeps up with trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家興緊呢隻牌子嘅衫，著咗就即刻入流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hing3 gan2 ni1 zek3 paai4 zi2 ge3 saam1, zoek3 zo2 zau6 zik1 hak1 jap6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在流行这个牌子的衣服，穿了就立刻变得时髦。
examples.english_sentence: This brand of clothes is popular now, wearing it will instantly make you fashionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好留意潮流，所以永遠都好入流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lau4 ji3 ciu4 lau4, so2 ji5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hou2 jap6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很关注潮流，所以永远都很时髦。
examples.english_sentence: She pays a lot of attention to trends, so she's always fashionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種音樂已經唔入流喇，依家啲後生仔鍾意聽其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 jam1 ngok6 ji5 ging1 m4 jap6 lau4 laa3, ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 zung1 ji3 teng1 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种音乐已经过时了，现在的年轻人都喜欢听其他的。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of music is no longer mainstream; young people nowadays like to listen to other things.

english_meaning: Built-in wardrobe, built-in cabinet, fitted wardrobe
explanation_mandarin: 指嵌入墙壁内的柜子，通常是衣柜或储物柜，节省空间。
explanation_english: Refers to a cabinet built into the wall, usually a wardrobe or storage cabinet, to save space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我間房有好多入牆櫃，可以放好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaan1 fong2 jau5 hou2 do1 jap6 coeng4 gwai6, ho2 ji5 fong3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的房间有很多壁橱，可以放很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: My room has a lot of built-in wardrobes, so I can store a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝修嘅時候，我哋決定要整多啲入牆櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 sau1 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 zing2 do1 di1 jap6 coeng4 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修的时候，我们决定要多做一些壁橱。
examples.english_sentence: During the renovation, we decided to build more built-in cabinets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個入牆櫃嘅設計好實用，充分利用咗空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jap6 coeng4 gwai6 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 sat6 jung6, cung1 fan1 lei6 jung6 zo2 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个壁橱的设计很实用，充分利用了空间。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this built-in wardrobe is very practical and makes full use of the space.

english_meaning: to be imprisoned, to go to jail
explanation_mandarin: 指被判刑并被送入监狱服刑。
explanation_english: Refers to being sentenced and sent to prison to serve a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗法，俾人判咗入獄五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 faat3, bei2 jan4 pun3 zo2 jap6 juk6 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了法，被人判处入狱五年。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the law and was sentenced to five years in prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污嘅官員最終都係要入獄㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 ge3 gun1 jyun4 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 jiu3 jap6 juk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污的官员最终还是要入狱的。
examples.english_sentence: Corrupt officials will eventually have to go to jail.

english_meaning: to fall asleep
explanation_mandarin: 进入睡眠状态。
explanation_english: To enter the state of sleep; to fall asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都好難入眠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 naan4 jap6 min4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是很难入睡。
examples.english_sentence: I always have trouble falling asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯熱牛奶可以幫助你入眠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 bui1 jit6 ngau5 naai5 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 jap6 min4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝一杯热牛奶可以帮助你入睡。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking a glass of warm milk can help you fall asleep.

english_meaning: to fall asleep, to go to sleep
explanation_mandarin: 开始睡觉，进入睡眠状态。
explanation_english: To begin to sleep, to enter a state of sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常好快就入睡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hou2 faai3 zau6 jap6 seoi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常很快就入睡。
examples.english_sentence: I usually fall asleep very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗杯熱牛奶會容易啲入睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 zo2 bui1 jit6 ngau5 naai5 wui5 jung4 ji6 di1 jap6 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝一杯热牛奶会更容易入睡。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking a glass of warm milk will make it easier to fall asleep.

english_meaning: entranced; captivated; mesmerized; engrossed; to be lost in thought; to be absorbed in something
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常专注，完全被吸引住。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely focused and completely captivated by something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇電視睇到好入神，叫佢都唔應機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 din6 si6 tai2 dou3 hou2 jap6 san4, giu3 keoi5 dou1 m4 ying3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看电视看得太入迷了，叫他都不理人。
examples.english_sentence: He was so engrossed in watching TV that he didn't respond when I called him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽音樂聽到入晒神，唔知我行咗入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 yam1 ngok6 teng1 dou3 jap6 saai3 san4, m4 zi1 ngo5 haang4 zo2 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听音乐听得入了神，不知道我走进来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so absorbed in listening to music that he didn't notice me coming in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友睇緊魔術表演，個個都睇到入晒神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2 gan2 mo1 seot6 biu2 yin2, go3 go3 dou1 tai2 dou3 jap6 saai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们正在看魔术表演，个个都看得入了迷。
examples.english_sentence: The children are watching a magic show, and everyone is captivated.

english_meaning: to deposit a check/cheque
explanation_mandarin: 将支票存入银行账户。
explanation_english: To deposit a cheque/check into a bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去銀行入票呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 jap6 piu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去银行存支票啊。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the bank to deposit a cheque tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔記得咗入票，搞到張支票過咗期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 jap6 piu3, gaau2 dou3 zoeng1 zhi1 piu3 gwo3 zo2 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忘记存支票了，导致这张支票过期了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to deposit the cheque, which resulted in it expiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺櫃員機入票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 jap6 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在ATM存支票。
examples.english_sentence: You can deposit the cheque at the ATM.

english_meaning: to enter autumn; to be entering autumn; the start of autumn
explanation_mandarin: 指秋季开始，天气逐渐转凉。
explanation_english: Refers to the beginning of autumn, when the weather gradually becomes cooler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入秋之後天氣開始涼爽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 cau1 zi1 hau6 tin1 hei3 hoi1 chi2 loeng4 song2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 进入秋季之后天气开始凉爽了。
examples.english_sentence: After entering autumn, the weather starts to become cool and pleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入秋嘅時候，啲樹葉會開始變色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 cau1 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 syu6 jip6 wui2 hoi1 chi2 bin3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 进入秋季的时候，树叶会开始变色。
examples.english_sentence: When autumn arrives, the leaves will start to change color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年入秋入得早過往年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 jap6 cau1 jap6 dak1 zou2 gwo3 wong5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年入秋比往年早。
examples.english_sentence: This year, autumn has come earlier than in previous years.

mandarin_meaning: 提起诉讼, 提出诉状
english_meaning: to file a lawsuit, to lodge a complaint (officially with a court)
explanation_mandarin: 指向法院提交正式的诉讼请求或控诉。
explanation_english: To formally file a lawsuit or lodge a complaint with a court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定入稟告間公司違反合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jap6 bam2 gou3 gaan1 gung1 si1 wai4 faan2 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定提起诉讼控告那家公司违反合同。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to file a lawsuit against the company for breach of contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果證據充足，我哋會入稟申請禁制令。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 geoi3 cung1 zuk1, ngo5 dei6 wui5 jap6 bam2 san1 ching2 gam3 zai3 ling6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果证据充足，我们会提起诉讼申请禁令。
examples.english_sentence: If there is sufficient evidence, we will file a lawsuit to apply for an injunction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為噪音問題，入稟投訴個鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 cou1 jam1 man6 tai4, jap6 bam2 tau4 sou3 go3 lin4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为噪音问题，向法院投诉了邻居。
examples.english_sentence: He filed a lawsuit to complain about his neighbor due to noise issues.

english_meaning: To be shortlisted; to be selected; to make the list
explanation_mandarin: 指被列入名单，通常用于形容在众多候选人中被选中或被录用。
explanation_english: Refers to being shortlisted or selected from a group of candidates, typically used to describe being chosen or hired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔，今次實入笭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 zai2, gam1 ci3 sat1 jap6 ling4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，这次肯定能被选上。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart, he'll definitely be shortlisted this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾輪面試，佢終於入咗笭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 leon4 min6 si3, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jap6 zo2 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几轮面试，他终于被选上了。
examples.english_sentence: After several rounds of interviews, he was finally selected.

english_meaning: to become a citizen (of a country); to naturalize
explanation_mandarin: 取得某国国籍。
explanation_english: To acquire the citizenship of a country; to naturalize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋全家都入咗美國籍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cyun4 gaa1 dou1 jap6 zo2 mei5 gwok3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家都入了美国籍。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family became American citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考慮緊入唔入英國籍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 leoi6 gan2 jap6 m4 jap6 ying1 gwok3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在考虑要不要入英国籍。
examples.english_sentence: He is considering whether or not to become a British citizen.

english_meaning: To fall into a trap; to be tricked; to be fooled; to be caught in a scheme.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻落入圈套或陷阱，被人欺骗或控制。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning to fall into a trap or snare, to be deceived or controlled by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，好易就俾人入籠嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, hou2 ji6 zau6 bei2 jan4 jap6 lung4 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么笨，很容易就被人骗的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, it's easy for people to trick him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢啊，小心俾佢入籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, siu2 sam1 bei2 keoi5 jap6 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别相信他，小心被他骗了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, be careful of being tricked by him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲騙徒成日諗埋啲橋去入人籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pin3 tou4 sing4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 kiu2 heoi3 jap6 jan4 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些骗子总是想些办法去骗人。
examples.english_sentence: Those scammers are always thinking of ways to trick people.

english_meaning: to submit an application; to file paperwork; to lodge an application
explanation_mandarin: 指向相关机构提交正式的申请文件或表格。
explanation_english: To submit official application documents or forms to the relevant institution or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去入境處入紙申請簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 jau5 ging2 cyu3 jap6 zi2 san1 cing2 can1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去入境处递交申请签证的文件。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the Immigration Department tomorrow to submit my visa application.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你入咗紙未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jap6 zo2 zi2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你递交申请了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you submitted the application yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入紙申請公屋，希望可以快啲上樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zi2 san1 cing2 gung1 uk1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 soeng5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提交了公屋申请，希望可以快点搬上去。
examples.english_sentence: He has submitted an application for public housing, hoping to get a flat soon.

synonyms: 遞交申請 (dai6 gaau1 san1 cing2)

english_meaning: to convict; to find guilty; conviction
explanation_mandarin: 指在法律程序中，根据证据判定某人有罪。
explanation_english: To officially declare someone guilty of a crime in a legal process, based on evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾法官入罪，要坐監五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 faat3 gun1 jap6 zeoi6, jiu3 co5 gaam1 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被法官判刑，要坐牢五年。
examples.english_sentence: He was convicted by the judge and will be imprisoned for five years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果證據唔夠，好難入罪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 geoi3 m4 gau3, hou2 naan4 jap6 zeoi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果证据不足，很难定罪的。
examples.english_sentence: If the evidence is insufficient, it's difficult to secure a conviction.

english_meaning: entering tone (in Chinese phonology)
explanation_mandarin: 汉语音韵学中的一种声调类型，以辅音收尾，发音短促。
explanation_english: A type of tone in Chinese phonology that ends with a consonant and is pronounced abruptly. Characterized by ending in -p, -t, or -k in Middle Chinese and some modern dialects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多廣東話嘅人都唔識分入聲字啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 jan4 dou1 m4 sik1 fan1 jap6 seng1 zi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多说粤语的人都不懂得分辨入声字了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many Cantonese speakers don't know how to distinguish entering tone characters.

english_meaning: to start a job, to take up a post, to join a company
explanation_mandarin: 开始工作；正式就任某个职位。
explanation_english: To begin working in a new job or to officially take up a post in a company or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月一號入職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jat1 hou6 jap6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月一号入职。
examples.english_sentence: I will start my job on the first of next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功入職咗一間大公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 jap6 zik1 zo2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功入职了一家大公司。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully joined a big company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入職前要簽合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 zik1 cin4 jiu3 cim1 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入职前要签合同。
examples.english_sentence: You need to sign a contract before starting the job.

mandarin_meaning: 深刻; 透彻; 深入
english_meaning: penetrating; incisive; deep; hitting home; to the point; impactful; heartfelt
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：形容描述或感受深刻、透彻。动词：表示深刻地影响或感动。
explanation_english: Adjective: Describing a feeling or description as penetrating, incisive, or deep. Verb: Indicating a deep impact or moving effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢好入肉，令我反思咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 hou2 jap6 juk6, ling6 ngo5 faan2 si1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很深刻，让我反思了很多。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was very penetrating, making me reflect a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好入肉，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 hou2 jap6 juk6, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很深入人心，看得我都眼眶湿润了。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very touching, it brought tears to my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌聲好入肉，唱到我心坎裡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 seng1 hou2 jap6 juk6, coeng3 dou3 ngo5 sam1 ham3 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌声很动听，唱到我的心坎里。
examples.english_sentence: His singing is very heartfelt, it resonates with me deeply.

english_meaning: to buy shares, to invest
explanation_mandarin: 指投资购买公司或企业的股份。
explanation_english: To invest in a company by buying shares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想入股你間公司，睇下有無機會賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jap6 gu2 nei5 gaan1 gung1 si1, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 gei1 wui2 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想入股你的公司，看看有没有机会赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy shares in your company to see if there's a chance to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋幾個朋友夾錢入股開咗間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5 gaap3 cin2 jap6 gu2 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们几个朋友合伙入股开了一家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: Those friends invested together to open a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋入股嘅話，我哋可以有權參與公司嘅決策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 jap6 gu2 ge3 waa2, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jau5 kuen4 caam1 jyu5 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们入股的话，我们可以有权参与公司的决策。
examples.english_sentence: If we buy shares, we can have the right to participate in the company's decision-making.

english_meaning: to be included; to be counted; to be involved
explanation_mandarin: 指将某人或某事列入其中，或者算作一份，有时也指牵涉其中。
explanation_english: Refers to including someone or something in a group, counting it as part of something, or sometimes being involved or implicated in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅賄賂案，佢都入咗葯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 wai2 lou6 on3, keoi5 dou1 jap6 zo2 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的贿赂案，他也牵涉进去了。
examples.english_sentence: He's also involved in this bribery case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計埋佢，總共入咗十幾人葯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 maai4 keoi5, zung2 gung1 jap6 zo2 sap6 gei2 jan4 joek6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算上他，总共已经有十几人被列入其中了。
examples.english_sentence: Counting him, more than ten people have been included.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢完全冇入葯，唔好屈佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jap6 joek6, m4 hou2 wat1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事他完全没有涉及，不要冤枉他了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't involved in this matter at all, don't accuse him wrongly.

english_meaning: To be taken into account; To be considered; To matter
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事或某人被纳入考虑范围，或者具有重要意义，值得重视。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone being taken into consideration or being important and worthy of attention. Often used to indicate whether something will be taken seriously or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅意見我會入藥嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 ngo5 wui5 jap6 joek6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的意见我会考虑的。
examples.english_sentence: I will take your opinion into consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢根本唔入藥嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gan1 bun2 m4 jap6 joek6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话根本不重要。
examples.english_sentence: What he said doesn't matter at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事老闆冇入藥，所以搞唔成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 lou5 baan2 mou5 jap6 joek6, so2 ji5 gaau2 m4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板没有重视这件事，所以没有成功。
examples.english_sentence: The boss didn't take this matter seriously, so it didn't work out.

english_meaning: to enter a trade/profession; to join the industry
explanation_mandarin: 进入某个行业或职业。
explanation_english: To enter a particular trade, profession or industry; to join the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋入行好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jap6 hong4 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们入行很久了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been in the industry for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解想入行做醫生啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 soeng2 jap6 hong4 zou6 ji1 sang1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么想入行当医生啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why do you want to become a doctor?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家入行做IT好難搵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 jap6 hong4 zou6 ai1 ti1 hou2 naan4 wan2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在入行做IT很难找到工作。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to find work in the IT industry nowadays.

english_meaning: to enroll in (a school); to be admitted to study
explanation_mandarin: 指被学校录取并开始学习。
explanation_english: Refers to being admitted to a school and beginning studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年九月會入讀小學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 gau2 jyut6 wui5 jap6 duk6 siu2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年九月会入学小学。
examples.english_sentence: He will enroll in primary school this September.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔成功入讀咗間名校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 sing4 gung1 jap6 duk6 zo2 gaan1 ming4 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子成功入学了一所名校。
examples.english_sentence: My son successfully enrolled in a prestigious school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力，希望可以入讀大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jap6 duk6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力，希望可以入学大学。
examples.english_sentence: He is working hard, hoping to be admitted to university.

english_meaning: to stock up, to purchase inventory, to buy goods (for resale)
explanation_mandarin: 指商家为了销售而购买商品，补充库存。
explanation_english: Refers to a merchant purchasing goods to sell and replenish inventory. Commonly used in business contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要入多啲貨，因為就嚟過年，預計生意會好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jap6 do1 di1 fo3, jan1 wai6 zau6 lai4 gwo3 nin4, jyu6 gai3 sang1 ji3 wui5 ho2 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得多进点货，因为快过年了，预计生意会很好。
examples.english_sentence: We need to stock up more, because Chinese New Year is coming soon, and we expect business to be good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲菜好平，快啲入貨啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 coi3 hou2 peng4, faai3 di1 jap6 fo3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的蔬菜很便宜，快点进货吧！
examples.english_sentence: The vegetables are very cheap lately, buy some stock now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啱啱入咗批新貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 zo2 bat1 seon1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司刚刚进了一批新货。
examples.english_sentence: The company just received a new batch of goods.

english_meaning: to marry into and live with the bride's family
explanation_mandarin: 指男子结婚后住在女方家里，成为女方家庭的成员。
explanation_english: Refers to a man marrying into and living with the bride's family, becoming a member of her family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企得返個女，所以想搵個男人入贅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 dak1 faan1 go3 neoi2, so2 ji5 soeng2 wan2 go3 naam4 jan2 jap6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家里只剩下一个女儿，所以想找个男人入赘。
examples.english_sentence: There's only a daughter left in their family, so they want to find a man to marry into the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家社會唔興入贅呢啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 se5 wui2 m4 hing1 jap6 zeoi6 ni1 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会不流行入赘这种事了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, marrying into the family is not a common thing.

english_meaning: to be selected; to be chosen
explanation_mandarin: 被挑选出来；成功入围。
explanation_english: To be selected or chosen, usually from a larger pool of candidates or options.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗歌唱比賽，最後成功入選決賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3, zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 jap6 syun2 kyut3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了歌唱比赛，最后成功入选决赛。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in the singing competition and was finally selected for the finals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲入選咗康城影展嘅競賽單元。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 jap6 syun2 zo2 hong1 sing4 jing2 zin2 ge3 ging6 coi3 daan1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影入选了戛纳电影节的竞赛单元。
examples.english_sentence: This film was selected for the competition section of the Cannes Film Festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅設計入選咗比賽嘅最後階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cit3 gai3 jap6 syun2 zo2 bei2 coi3 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计入选了比赛的最后阶段。
examples.english_sentence: His design was selected for the final stage of the competition.

english_meaning: inside, within
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某个范围或空间内部。
explanation_english: Indicates the interior of a certain range or space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋入邊好靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jap6 bin1 hou2 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子里面很安静。
examples.english_sentence: It's very quiet inside the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個袋入邊有啲嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 doi2 jap6 bin1 jau5 di1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 袋子里有一些吃的。
examples.english_sentence: There's some food inside the bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入邊唔准講粗口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 bin1 m4 zeon2 gong2 cou1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里面不准说脏话。
examples.english_sentence: Swearing is not allowed inside the company.

english_meaning: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
explanation_mandarin: 到一个地方，就按照那个地方的风俗习惯行事。
explanation_english: To follow the customs of a place when you live or travel there; When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去到外國，入鄉隨俗好緊要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 dou3 ngoi6 gwok3, jap6 hoeng1 ceoi4 zuk6 hou2 gan2 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到了国外，入乡随俗很重要。
examples.english_sentence: When you go to a foreign country, it's important to do as the locals do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去印度旅行，都應該入鄉隨俗，試下著紗麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jan3 dou6 leoi5 hang4, dou1 jing1 goi1 jap6 hoeng1 ceoi4 zuk6, si3 haa5 zoek3 saa1 lai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去印度旅行，都应该入乡随俗，试一下穿纱丽。
examples.english_sentence: When we travel to India, we should follow the local customs and try wearing a sari.

english_meaning: To deposit coins; to save small amounts of money
explanation_mandarin: 将零钱存入银行或其他地方。通常指存入小额的硬币。
explanation_english: To deposit coins into a bank or other place. Usually refers to depositing small amounts of change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都入啲銀仔落個豬仔錢罌度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jap6 di1 ngan4 zai2 lok6 go3 zyu1 zai2 cin2 aang1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都存一些硬币到我的小猪储蓄罐里。
examples.english_sentence: I deposit some coins into my piggy bank every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日攞啲散紙去銀行入銀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lo2 di1 saan2 zi2 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 jap6 ngan4 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常拿一些零钱去银行存硬币。
examples.english_sentence: He often takes some loose change to the bank to deposit coins.

english_meaning: to deposit money
explanation_mandarin: 把钱存入银行账户或其他地方。
explanation_english: To deposit money into a bank account or other location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想入啲錢落我個銀行戶口度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jap6 di1 cin2 lok6 ngo5 go3 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想存一些钱到我的银行账户里。
examples.english_sentence: I want to deposit some money into my bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今個月入咗幾多錢落戶口啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 go3 jyut6 jap6 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2 lok6 wu6 hau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个月存了多少钱到户口啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money have you deposited into your account this month?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗現金去銀行入錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 jin6 gam1 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 jap6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了现金去银行存钱。
examples.english_sentence: He took cash to the bank to deposit money.

english_meaning: To start the meter (usually referring to a taxi)
explanation_mandarin: 指出租车司机开始使用计价器计算车费。
explanation_english: Refers to a taxi driver starting the meter to calculate the fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，去機場，入錶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, heoi3 gei1 coeng4, jap6 biu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，去机场，打表吧。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, to the airport, please start the meter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一上車就叫司機入錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 soeng5 ce1 zau6 giu3 si1 gei1 jap6 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一上车就叫司机打表。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got in the car, he told the driver to start the meter.

english_meaning: to appear in a camera shot; to be on camera; to get into the picture
explanation_mandarin: 进入相机或摄像机的取景范围。
explanation_english: To be visible in a photograph or video; to appear in a camera's frame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思呀，我唔小心入咗你鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 jap6 zo2 nei5 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我不小心进入你的镜头了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I accidentally got into your shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意喺人哋影相嗰陣時突然間入鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 jan4 dei6 ying2 soeng2 go2 zan6 si4 dat6 jin4 gaan1 jap6 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢在别人拍照的时候突然间进入镜头。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to suddenly get into other people's photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部攝影機嘅角度唔好，有啲嘢冇入鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 se3 ying2 gei1 ge3 gok3 dou6 m4 hou2, jau5 di1 je5 mou5 jap6 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摄像机的角度不好，有些东西没进入镜头。
examples.english_sentence: The camera angle isn't good, some things didn't get into the shot.

english_meaning: to enter a door/gate; to begin studying; to marry into (a family)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 进入门内。2. 开始学习。3. 女子结婚，成为男方家庭的成员。
explanation_english: 1. To enter a door or gate. 2. To begin studying something. 3. (Of a woman) To marry into a family; to become a member of the husband's family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗彈琴冇幾耐，啱啱入門咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 taan4 kam4 mou5 gei2 noi6, aam1 aam1 jap6 mun4 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学钢琴没多久，刚入门而已。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been learning piano for long, he's just a beginner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年入門，做咗李太啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 jap6 mun4, zou6 zo2 lei5 taai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今年结婚，成为李太太了。
examples.english_sentence: She got married this year and became Mrs. Lee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你入門嘅時候記得敲門呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jap6 mun4 ge3 si4 hau6 gei3 dak1 haau1 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你进门的时候记得敲门啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to knock on the door when you enter.

synonyms: 開始學習 (hoi1 chi2 hok6 zaap6)

english_meaning: to enter a station (through the turnstile/gate); to pass through a barrier (literal or figurative); to join a race or competition
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“进入闸门”。通常指进入地铁站、火车站等交通枢纽的检票口，通过闸机进入候车区域。 也可比喻加入某个竞赛或竞争。
explanation_english: Literally means "enter the gate". It usually refers to entering the ticket gate of a transportation hub such as a subway station or train station, and passing through the turnstile to enter the waiting area. It can also be used metaphorically to join a race or competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，要快啲入閘搭地鐵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, jiu3 faai3 di1 jap6 zaap3 daap3 dei6 tit3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，要快点进站坐地铁了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, I need to get through the gate quickly and take the subway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢準備咗咁耐，終於可以入閘參加比賽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 jap6 zaap3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他准备了这么久，终于可以参加比赛了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been preparing for so long, and he can finally enter the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功入閘，首先要通過面試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1 jap6 zaap3, sau2 sin1 jiu3 tung1 gwo3 min6 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要想成功进入，首先要通过面试。
examples.english_sentence: To successfully get in, you must first pass the interview.

english_meaning: to be hospitalized, to be admitted to hospital
explanation_mandarin: 进入医院接受治疗。
explanation_english: To be admitted to a hospital for treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日發燒，依家入院檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 faat3 siu1, ji1 gaa1 jap6 jyun2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天发烧，现在住院检查。
examples.english_sentence: He had a fever yesterday and is now admitted to the hospital for examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆跌親，要入院做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 dit3 can1, jiu3 jap6 jyun2 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶摔倒了，需要住院做手术。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma fell and needs to be hospitalized for surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢要入院觀察幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 gun1 caat3 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他需要住院观察几天。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to be hospitalized for a few days for observation.

english_meaning: to refuel (a vehicle); to fill up with gasoline
explanation_mandarin: 指给汽车、摩托车等交通工具添加汽油。
explanation_english: To refill the fuel tank of a vehicle, typically with gasoline. Literally translates to 'enter electricity oil'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車冇油喇，要入電油至得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4 laa3, jiu3 jap6 din6 jau4 zi3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车没油了，得去加油了。
examples.english_sentence: The car is out of gas, we need to refuel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋入咗電油先，陣間去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jap6 zo2 din6 jau4 sin1, zan6 gaan1 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先加个油，一会儿去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Let's get some gas first, then we'll go eat.

english_meaning: To be admitted to a mental hospital (literally: to enter Castle Peak)
explanation_mandarin: 青山是香港一间著名的精神病院，所以“入青山”指被送进青山医院，也就是被送进精神病院的意思。多用于开玩笑或讽刺。
explanation_english: "Castle Peak" (青山) is a famous mental hospital in Hong Kong. Therefore, "入青山" (jap6 cing1 saan1) refers to being admitted to Castle Peak Hospital, meaning being admitted to a mental hospital. It's often used jokingly or sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再咁癲落去，遲早入青山㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gam2 din1 lok6 heoi3, ci4 zou2 jap6 cing1 saan1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再这么疯下去，迟早要进精神病院的！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep acting this crazy, you'll end up in a mental hospital sooner or later!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試壓力太大，差啲入青山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6, caa1 di1 jap6 cing1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试压力太大，差点进了精神病院。
examples.english_sentence: He was under so much pressure from exams that he almost ended up in a mental hospital.

synonyms: 睇精神科醫生 (tai2 zing1 san4 fo1 ji1 sang1 - see a psychiatrist)

english_meaning: inside, in
explanation_mandarin: 指在某物体的内部空间。
explanation_english: Refers to the internal space of something; inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺個櫃桶入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 go3 gwai6 tong2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书在抽屉里面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is in the drawer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋入面好靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jap6 min6 hou2 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子里面很安静。
examples.english_sentence: It's very quiet inside the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇吓個盒入面有啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 go3 hap6 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看盒子里面有些什么。
examples.english_sentence: Take a look at what's inside the box.

english_meaning: to be used in cooking, to be included as an ingredient in a dish
explanation_mandarin: 指把某种食材或调料加入到菜肴中进行烹饪。
explanation_english: Refers to using a specific ingredient or seasoning in cooking to create a dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種香草好適合入饌，可以提升菜嘅香味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 hoeng1 cou2 hou2 sik1 hap6 jap6 cyun5, ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 coi3 ge3 hoeng1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种香草很适合入菜，可以提升菜肴的香味。
examples.english_sentence: This herb is very suitable for use in cooking; it can enhance the aroma of the dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢啲菇唔可以入饌，有毒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 di1 gu1 m4 ho2 ji5 jap6 cyun5, jau5 duk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这些蘑菇不能入菜，有毒的。
examples.english_sentence: He said that these mushrooms cannot be used in cooking because they are poisonous.

english_meaning: nightfall; dusk
explanation_mandarin: 指天色渐渐变黑，接近夜晚的时候。
explanation_english: Refers to the time when the sky gradually darkens, approaching night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入黑之後，街上面嘅人就少咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 hak1 zi1 hau6, gaai1 soeng6 min6 ge3 jan4 zau6 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天黑之后，街上的人就少了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After nightfall, there are much fewer people on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋入黑先返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jap6 hak1 sin1 faan1 dou2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们天黑才回到家。
examples.english_sentence: We didn't get home until nightfall.

english_meaning: To be lucky, to go smoothly, to be on a roll
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发展顺利，运气好。 类似于“走运”、“顺风顺水”的意思。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things are going smoothly and one is having good luck. Similar to 'being on a roll' or 'having good fortune'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排入龍呀，做乜都咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 jap6 lung4 aa3, zou6 mat1 dou1 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很走运，做什么都很顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He's been on a roll lately, everything he does goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗職之後，就好似入咗龍咁，乜都掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 jik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 ci5 jap6 zo2 lung4 gam2, mat1 dou1 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职之后，好像走运了一样，什么都行。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he got promoted, it's like he's been on a lucky streak, everything works out.

english_meaning: inside, inner, within
explanation_mandarin: 指空间或范围的内部。
explanation_english: Refers to the interior of a space or range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋入邊好黑，入面有啲啲聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jap6 bin1 hou2 hak1, jap6 min6 jau5 di1 di1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子里面很黑，里面有一些声音。
examples.english_sentence: It's very dark inside the house, and there are some sounds inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部消息話下個月會加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 siu1 sik1 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司内部消息说下个月会加薪。
examples.english_sentence: Internal company news says that salaries will be increased next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢係我哋嘅內部秘密，唔可以同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 noi6 bou6 bei3 mat6, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲的是我们的内部秘密，不可以告诉别人。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is our internal secret, and we cannot tell anyone.

english_meaning: internal strife; civil war; infighting; internal disorder
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或组织内部发生的混乱或战争状态，通常涉及到不同派系或团体之间的争斗。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of chaos or war within a country or organization, usually involving conflict between different factions or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司最近內亂得好犀利，好多人走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 noi6 lyun6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, hou2 do1 jan4 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司最近内乱得很厉害，很多人都走了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has had severe internal strife recently, and many people have left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個國家因為內亂，經濟崩潰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gwok3 gaa1 jan1 wai6 noi6 lyun6, ging1 zai3 bang1 kui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个国家因为内乱，经济崩溃。
examples.english_sentence: The country's economy collapsed due to the civil war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋家庭因為爭產而搞到內亂，好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 ting4 jan1 wai6 zaang1 caan2 ji4 gaau2 dou3 noi6 lyun6, hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的家庭因为争夺财产而导致内乱，很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is in internal turmoil due to a dispute over inheritance, it's very pitiful.

english_meaning: inside; inner side
explanation_mandarin: 指内部的一侧，与外侧相对。
explanation_english: Refers to the inner side, as opposed to the outer side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行喺行人路嘅內側安全啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 hai2 hang4 yan4 lou6 ge3 noi6 caak1 on1 cyun4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走在人行道的内侧更安全。
examples.english_sentence: It's safer to walk on the inner side of the pavement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個袋嘅內側有個暗格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 doi2 ge3 noi6 caak1 yau5 go3 am3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包的内侧有一个暗格。
examples.english_sentence: There's a hidden pocket on the inside of this bag.

english_meaning: internal injury; emotional distress; unspoken grief
explanation_mandarin: 指身体内部受伤，表面看不出来；也指精神上受到打击，受到伤害但没有表现出来。
explanation_english: Refers to an internal injury that is not visible on the surface; also refers to emotional distress, where one is hurt but doesn't show it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀老細鬧完之後好似有啲內傷咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 noi6 soeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后好像有点内伤。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be a little emotionally hurt after being scolded by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完套戲，我好似有啲內傷，好sad呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 tou3 hei3, ngo5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 noi6 soeng1, hou2 sad aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完这部电影，我感觉有点内伤，好难过啊。
examples.english_sentence: After watching this movie, I feel a little emotionally hurt; I'm so sad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁在意人哋講嘅嘢啦，唔好畀佢哋搞到你內傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zoi6 ji3 yan4 dei6 gong2 ge3 ye5 laa1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gaau2 dou3 nei5 noi6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么在意别人说的话了，不要让他们伤害到你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't care so much about what other people say; don't let them hurt you.

english_meaning: pigeon-toed, in-toeing
explanation_mandarin: 形容走路时脚尖朝内。
explanation_english: Describing someone whose toes point inwards when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路內八嘅，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 noi6 baat3 ge3, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路内八字，很可爱的。
examples.english_sentence: He walks pigeon-toed, it's so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我個仔有啲內八，要做物理治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 go3 zai2 jau5 di1 noi6 baat3, jiu3 zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我儿子有点内八字，要做物理治疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my son is a little pigeon-toed and needs physiotherapy.

english_meaning: internal bleeding
explanation_mandarin: 指身体内部器官或组织因外伤或疾病引起的出血。
explanation_english: Bleeding that occurs inside the body, often due to injury or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車之後，醫生檢查話佢有內出血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6, yi1 sang1 gim2 cha4 waa6 keoi5 jau5 noi6 cheut1 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞车之后，医生检查说他有内出血。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, the doctor examined him and said he had internal bleeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得唔舒服，而且懷疑有內出血，就要即刻睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6, yi4 che2 waai4 yi4 jau5 noi6 cheut1 hyut3, zau6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 tai2 yi1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得不舒服，而且怀疑有内出血，就要立刻看医生。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel unwell and suspect internal bleeding, you should see a doctor immediately.

english_meaning: endocrine, internal secretion
explanation_mandarin: 指人体内某些腺体（如甲状腺、肾上腺等）分泌的激素，这些激素直接进入血液循环，对身体的生理功能起调节作用。
explanation_english: Refers to the hormones secreted by certain glands (such as the thyroid gland, adrenal glands, etc.) in the human body. These hormones directly enter the bloodstream and regulate the body's physiological functions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近內分泌失調，搞到皮膚好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 noi6 fan1 bei3 sat1 tiu4, gaau2 dou3 pei4 fu1 hou2 chaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近内分泌失调，导致皮肤很差。
examples.english_sentence: Her endocrine system is unbalanced recently, which makes her skin very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壓力太大會影響內分泌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6 wui5 ying2 heong2 noi6 fan1 bei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 压力太大影响内分泌。
examples.english_sentence: Too much stress can affect your endocrine system.

english_meaning: Internal strength, inner cultivation, fundamental skills; (figuratively) underlying strength or foundation
explanation_mandarin: 原指武术中的一种修炼方法，通过锻炼呼吸和意念来增强内在力量。也比喻指内在的实力或基础。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a method of cultivation in martial arts, enhancing internal strength through breathing and mental focus. Figuratively, it refers to inner strength, underlying foundation, or fundamental skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗好多嘢，但係內功唔夠深，所以仲要繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, daan6 hai6 noi6 gung1 m4 gau3 sam1, so2 ji5 zung6 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了很多东西，但是内功不够深厚，所以还要继续努力。
examples.english_sentence: He has learned a lot, but his fundamental skills aren't strong enough, so he needs to continue working hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搞好間公司，最緊要係打好內功，先可以應付到市場嘅挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaau2 hou2 gaan1 gung1 si1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 daa2 hou2 noi6 gung1, sin1 ho2 ji5 ying3 fu6 dou3 si5 cheung4 ge3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要搞好这家公司，最重要的是打好基础，才可以应付市场的挑战。
examples.english_sentence: To manage this company well, the most important thing is to build a solid foundation, so we can cope with market challenges.

english_meaning: internal affairs; housework; domestic affairs; internal matters
explanation_mandarin: 指组织内部的事务，或家庭中的家务事。
explanation_english: Refers to internal affairs of an organization or household chores within a family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責處理公司嘅內務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu3 zaak3 cyu5 lei5 gung1 si1 ge3 noi6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责处理公司的内部事务。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for handling the company's internal affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚之後，佢就專心打理屋企嘅內務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 zyun1 sam1 daa2 lei5 uk1 kei2 ge3 noi6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚之后，她就专心打理家里的家务。
examples.english_sentence: After getting married, she focused on managing the housework.

synonyms: 內部事務 (noi6 bou6 si6 mou6)

english_meaning: internalize, internalization
explanation_mandarin: 指将外界的观念、价值观、行为模式等转化为自身的一部分，使其成为内在的信仰和行为准则。
explanation_english: To internalize something means to incorporate external values, beliefs, or behaviors into one's own psyche, making them a part of one's own belief system and behavioral patterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將老師教嘅嘢內化咗，變成咗自己嘅學習方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 lou5 si1 gaau3 ge3 je5 noi6 faa3 zo2, bin3 sing4 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 hok6 zaap6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把老师教的东西内化了，变成了自己的学习方法。
examples.english_sentence: He internalized what the teacher taught and it became his own learning method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候受到好多負面影響，好多價值觀都內化咗，好難改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sau6 dou3 ho2 do1 fu6 min6 ying2 hoeng2, ho2 do1 gaa3 zik6 gun1 dou1 noi6 faa3 zo2, ho2 naan4 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候受到很多负面影响，很多价值观都内化了，很难改变。
examples.english_sentence: He was negatively influenced a lot as a child and many values were internalized, making them difficult to change.

english_meaning: introverted
explanation_mandarin: 性格比较安静，不爱说话，喜欢独处。
explanation_english: Having a personality characterized by a focus on one's own thoughts and feelings, rather than on outside things; reserved or shy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好內向，唔係咁鍾意同人哋傾偈嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 noi6 hoeng3, m4 hai6 gam2 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 dei6 king1 gai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很内向，不太喜欢和别人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very introverted person and doesn't really like chatting with people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我比較內向，大個咗就好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 bei2 gaau3 noi6 hoeng3, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我比较内向，长大后就好多了。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I was more introverted, but it's gotten better as I've grown up.

english_meaning: internal strife; infighting; internal conflict
explanation_mandarin: 指内部争斗，冲突。
explanation_english: Refers to internal conflict, strife, or infighting within a group, organization, or team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日內哄，啲員工都做到冇曬心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 noi6 hung3, di1 jyun4 gung1 dou1 zou6 dou3 mou5 saai3 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是内讧，员工们都做得没心思了。
examples.english_sentence: There's constant infighting in this company, and the employees are losing motivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺呢個時候內哄，我哋應該團結一致先啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ni1 go3 si4 hau6 noi6 hung3, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 tyun4 git3 jat1 zai3 sin1 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这个时候内讧，我们应该团结一致才对。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have infighting at this time, we should be united.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟為咗家產內哄咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 wai6 zo2 gaa1 caan2 noi6 hung3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟为了家产内讧了很久。
examples.english_sentence: The two brothers have been fighting internally over the family fortune for a long time.

english_meaning: intrinsic, inherent, inner, internal
explanation_mandarin: 指事物本身所固有的，内在的性质或特征。
explanation_english: Referring to the inherent, inner qualities or characteristics of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅內在美比佢嘅外表更吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 noi6 zoi6 mei5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 ngoi6 biu2 gang3 kap1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的内在美比她的外表更吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: Her inner beauty is more attractive than her appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件嘢嘅內在價值好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 je5 ge3 noi6 zoi6 gaa3 zik6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件东西的内在价值很高。
examples.english_sentence: The intrinsic value of this thing is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重自己嘅內在修養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 noi6 zoi6 sau1 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很注重自己的内在修养。
examples.english_sentence: She pays a lot of attention to her inner cultivation.

english_meaning: Inner beauty, inner qualities
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的内在品质，例如善良、智慧、真诚等，而非外貌。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's inner qualities such as kindness, intelligence, and sincerity, rather than their physical appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外表唔重要，最緊要係有內在美呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 biu2 m4 zung6 jiu3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 jau5 noi6 zoi6 mei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外表不重要，最重要的是有内在美啊。
examples.english_sentence: Appearance is not important, the most important thing is to have inner beauty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然唔係好靚，但係佢嘅內在美深深吸引住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 hou2 leng3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 noi6 zoi6 mei5 sam1 sam1 kap1 yan5 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她虽然不是很漂亮，但是她的内在美深深吸引住我。
examples.english_sentence: Although she is not very beautiful, her inner beauty deeply attracts me.

english_meaning: Mainland China
explanation_mandarin: 指中国大陆地区，通常相对于香港、澳门和台湾而言。
explanation_english: Refers to mainland China, usually in contrast to Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月会回内地探亲。
examples.english_sentence: We will go back to mainland China to visit relatives next month.

examples.jyutping_sentence: yut6 lai4 yut6 do1 hoeng1 gong2 yan4 heoi3 noi6 dei6 faat3 zin2.

examples.english_sentence: More and more Hong Kong people are going to mainland China for development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 內地嘅生活節奏好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: noi6 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6 zit3 zau3 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 内地的生活节奏很快。
examples.english_sentence: The pace of life in mainland China is very fast.

english_meaning: inner wall; internal surface
explanation_mandarin: 指物体的内部墙面或表面。
explanation_english: Refers to the inner wall or surface of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個水煲用耐咗，內壁好多水垢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 seoi2 bo1 yung6 noi6 zo2, noi6 bik1 hou2 do1 seoi2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个水壶用了很久，内壁有很多水垢。
examples.english_sentence: This kettle has been used for a long time, and there's a lot of limescale on the inner wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要清潔下條喉嘅內壁，先可以確保水質乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 cing1 git3 haa5 tiu4 hau4 ge3 noi6 bik1, sin1 ho2 ji5 kok3 bou2 seoi2 zat1 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要清洁一下管道的内壁，才可以确保水质干净。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clean the inner wall of the pipe to ensure the water quality is clean.

english_meaning: inside and outside; internal and external
explanation_mandarin: 指内部和外部；里面和外面。也可引申为内幕和外表。
explanation_english: Refers to the inside and outside, or the internal and external aspects of something. Can also be extended to mean the inside story versus the outward appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢間公司嘅內外都好熟悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 noi6 ngoi6 dou1 hou2 suk6 sik1.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 noi6 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要了解清楚事情的内外。
examples.english_sentence: We need to understand the ins and outs of the matter.

english_meaning: traitor within, mole, inside man
explanation_mandarin: 指隐藏在内部，暗中为敌方效力的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is secretly working for the enemy from within an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司有內奸，啲計劃成日俾對手知道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 noi6 gaan1, di1 gai3 waak6 sing4 jat6 bei2 deoi3 sau2 zi1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司有内奸，计划总是被对手知道。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has a mole, and their plans are always known by their competitors.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 hai6 noi6 gaan1, keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 zung1 sing4.

examples.english_sentence: I don't believe he's a mole, he's always been very loyal.

english_meaning: my wife (humble)

examples.english_sentence: This is my wife, Miss Li.

english_meaning: prearranged; predetermined; settled internally; fixed beforehand; rigged
explanation_mandarin: 指事先决定好，内部已经确定，通常指不正当的手段。
explanation_english: Refers to something being prearranged or predetermined, usually through underhanded or unfair means. It implies that a decision or outcome has been fixed internally before any formal process takes place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今次比賽冠軍已經內定咗俾佢個仔。

examples.english_sentence: I heard the champion of this competition has already been prearranged for his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲升職位好似全部都內定晒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 sing1 zik1 wai2 hou2 ci5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 noi6 ding6 saai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的升职好像全部都内定好了。
examples.english_sentence: It seems that all the promotions in this company have already been prearranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗咁多啦，可能人哋係靠實力，唔係內定㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 gam3 do1 laa1, ho2 nang4 yan4 dei6 hai6 kaau3 sat6 lik6, m4 hai6 noi6 ding6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想那么多了，可能人家是靠实力，不是内定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't overthink it, maybe they relied on their abilities, it's not prearranged.

mandarin_meaning: 家裡人; 內人; 自己人
english_meaning: Family members; Wife (humble); One of us; Inside (the company/organization)

explanation_english: Refers to family members, wife (humble), or someone from one's own group/company; insider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我嘅內家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 noi6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的家人。
examples.english_sentence: These are my family members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我內家唔舒服，我要早啲返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 noi6 gaa1 m4 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 jiu3 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我妻子不舒服，我要早点回家。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，佢係內家嚟嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，他是自己人来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, he's one of us.

english_meaning: content
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所包含的实质性的东西。
explanation_english: The substance or essential part of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅內容好有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 noi6 yung6 hou2 yau5 cheoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的内容很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: The content of this book is very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告嘅內容非常詳細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 noi6 yung6 fei1 seong4 cheung4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告内容非常详细。
examples.english_sentence: The content of his report is very detailed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔太同意佢講嘢嘅內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 taai3 tung1 yi3 keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 noi6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太同意他说话的内容。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really agree with the content of what he said.

english_meaning: Content farm
explanation_mandarin: 指通过大量复制、粘贴、伪原创等手段，快速生成大量低质量内容，以吸引点击量和流量的网站或平台。
explanation_english: Refers to a website or platform that rapidly generates a large amount of low-quality content through copying, pasting, pseudo-original creation, etc., in order to attract clicks and traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網上面好多內容農場，啲資訊都唔知堅唔堅。

examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of content farms on the internet nowadays, and you don't even know if the information is true or not.

english_meaning: to ejaculate inside (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指性行为中，男性在女性体内射精。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a male ejaculating inside a female during sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋做嗰陣有冇內射㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 zou6 go2 zan6 jau5 mou5 noi6 se6 gaa3?

english_meaning: inside story, inside information, behind the scenes, the ropes
explanation_mandarin: 指不公开的、内部的秘密或情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a non-public, internal secret or situation; the inside story behind something.

examples.english_sentence: We don't know the inside story of this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似知好多內幕咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zi1 hou2 do1 noi6 muk6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像知道很多内幕似的。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to know a lot of inside information.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我告诉你这家公司的内幕吧。

english_meaning: insider trading
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握未公开的内幕信息的人利用这些信息进行证券交易的行为。
explanation_english: The illegal practice of trading on the stock exchange to one's own advantage through having access to confidential information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人告內幕交易，真係唔抵得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gou3 noi6 muk6 gaau1 yik6, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人告发内幕交易，真是不值得啊。
examples.english_sentence: He was sued for insider trading, it's really unfortunate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅高層涉嫌內幕交易，而家俾廉政公署調查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gou1 cang4 sip3 jim4 noi6 muk6 gaau1 yik6, ji4 gaa1 bei2 lim4 zing3 gung1 syu2 diu6 caa4 gan2.
