explanation_english: A courtroom in the past, referring to the main hall of a yamen (government office).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅戲入面成日都會見到啲人喺公堂度審案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 hei3 jip6 mui6 min6 seng4 jat6 dou1 wui gin3 dou2 di1 jan4 hai2 gung1 tong4 dou6 sam2 ngon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的戏里经常能看到人们在公堂上审案。
examples.english_sentence: In old dramas, you often see people being tried in the court of law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人告咗，聽日要上公堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gou3 zo2, ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 gung1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人告了，明天要上公堂。
examples.english_sentence: He was sued and has to go to court tomorrow.

english_meaning: communiqué, official bulletin, announcement
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或机构就某一重要事项发表的正式公告或声明。
explanation_english: An official announcement or statement issued by a government or organization regarding an important matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府發表咗一份關於經濟發展嘅公報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 faat3 biu2 zo2 jat1 fan6 gwaan1 jyu1 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 ge3 gung1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府发表了一份关于经济发展的公报。
examples.english_sentence: The government issued a communiqué regarding economic development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺新聞度睇到聯合國嘅公報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 san1 man4 dou6 tai2 dou2 lyun4 hap6 gwok3 ge3 gung1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在新闻里看到了联合国的公报。
examples.english_sentence: We saw the United Nations' communiqué in the news.

english_meaning: to use one's public position to settle personal scores; to abuse one's power for personal vengeance
explanation_mandarin: 指假借公家的名义来达到报私仇的目的。
explanation_english: To use one's public office or position to settle personal grievances; to seek revenge under the guise of acting in the public interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明係公報私仇，想借啲意整走我哋部門啲人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 gung1 bou3 si1 cau4, soeng2 ze3 di1 yi3 zing2 zau2 ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4 di1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明了是公报私仇，想借此机会整走我们部门的人。
examples.english_sentence: It's clear he's using his position to get revenge, trying to take the opportunity to get rid of people in our department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你可以公報私仇，我會向上頭投訴你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 ho2 ji5 gung1 bou3 si1 cau4, ngo5 wui5 hoeng3 soeng6 tau4 tau4 sou3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为你可以公报私仇，我会向上级投诉你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can use your position to get revenge, I will complain about you to the superiors.

english_meaning: public cemetery; municipal cemetery
explanation_mandarin: 公共墓地，由政府或公共机构管理的墓地。
explanation_english: A public cemetery managed by the government or a public institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企人將佢葬喺公墓度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 jan4 zoeng1 keoi5 zong3 hai2 gung1 mou6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的家人把他葬在公墓里。
examples.english_sentence: His family buried him in a public cemetery.

english_meaning: Deed of Mutual Covenant (DMC)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港的大厦公契，是业主之间签订的具有法律效力的文件，规定了物业的管理、使用、维护以及业主之间的权利和义务。
explanation_english: Refers to the Deed of Mutual Covenant (DMC) in Hong Kong, which is a legally binding document signed between property owners, stipulating the management, usage, maintenance of the property, and the rights and obligations of the owners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓之前一定要睇清楚份公契，費事第日有爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 fan6 gung1 kai3, fai3 si6 dai6 jat6 jau5 zaang1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房之前一定要看清楚大厦公契，免得将来发生纠纷。
examples.english_sentence: You must carefully read the Deed of Mutual Covenant before buying a flat, to avoid disputes in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅管理費係根據公契嘅規定嚟釐定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 gun2 lei5 fai3 hai6 gan1 geoi3 gung1 kai3 ge3 kwai1 ding6 lai4 lei4 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的管理费是根据大厦公契的规定来确定的。
examples.english_sentence: The management fee here is determined according to the regulations of the Deed of Mutual Covenant.

english_meaning: state-run prostitute; government-licensed prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府经营或发牌照的妓女。
explanation_english: Refers to a prostitute who is either employed by or licensed by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前有啲地方有公娼制度，就係政府批准妓院營業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 jau5 gung1 cheung1 zai3 dou6, zau6 hai6 zing3 fu2 pui1 zeon2 gei6 jyun2 jing4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有些地方有公娼制度，就是政府批准妓院营业。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, some places had a system of state-run prostitution, where the government approved brothels to operate.

english_meaning: Young master; son of a wealthy or influential family
explanation_mandarin: 旧时称呼富贵人家的儿子；也用于戏称年轻男子。
explanation_english: Traditionally refers to the son of a wealthy or influential family; can also be used playfully to address or refer to a young man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係李生嘅公子，梗係唔憂做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lei5 sang1 ge3 gung1 zi2, gang2 hai6 m4 yau1 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是李先生的公子，当然不用愁工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He's Mr. Li's son, of course he doesn't have to worry about finding a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，公子，你搞錯咗啦，呢度唔係停車場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, gung1 zi2, nei5 gaau2 co3 zo2 laa3, ni1 dou6 m4 hai6 ting4 che1 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，小伙子，你搞错了，这里不是停车场。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, young man, you've got it wrong, this isn't a parking lot.

english_meaning: rich young master, spoiled brat, pampered son
explanation_mandarin: 指富家子弟，通常带有贬义，形容挥霍无度、不务正业的年轻人。
explanation_english: Refers to a son from a wealthy family, usually with a negative connotation, describing a young man who is extravagant, idle, and doesn't engage in productive work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都係咁樣使錢，真係一個公子哥兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2 joeng2 sai2 cin2, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 gung1 zi2 go1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都这样花钱，真是一个公子哥儿。
examples.english_sentence: He spends money like this every day, he's really a rich young master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔做嘢，淨係識得靠屋企，典型嘅公子哥兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zou6 je5, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 kaau3 uk1 kei2, din2 jing4 ge3 gung1 zi2 go1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不工作，只知道靠家里，典型的公子哥儿。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't work, he only knows how to rely on his family, a typical spoiled brat.

english_meaning: Public Security Bureau; police (in mainland China)
explanation_mandarin: 中国大陆负责治安、户籍、交通管理等的警察机构。
explanation_english: The Public Security Bureau in mainland China, responsible for public order, household registration, traffic management, etc. Also refers to police officers in mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿哥喺大陸做公安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 go1 hai2 daai6 luk6 zou6 gung1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哥哥在大陆做公安。
examples.english_sentence: His older brother works as a police officer in mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大陸嘅公安权力好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 luk6 ge3 gung1 on1 kyueng4 lik6 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大陆的公安权力很大。
examples.english_sentence: The police (Public Security Bureau) in mainland China have a lot of power.

english_meaning: public; belonging to the public; government-owned
explanation_mandarin: 指属于公众的，公有的，政府的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that belongs to the public, is publicly owned, or belongs to the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅廁所係公家嘅，所以要保持清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 ci3 so2 hai6 gung1 gaa1 ge3, so2 ji5 jiu3 bou2 ci4 ging1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的厕所是公用的，所以要保持清洁。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet here is public, so it's important to keep it clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公家醫院做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 gaa1 ji1 jyun2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公立医院工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a public hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦係公家嘅，大家都可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 hai6 gung1 gaa1 ge3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ho2 ji5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑是公用的，大家都可以用。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is public, everyone can use it.

english_meaning: apartment, flat
explanation_mandarin: 一种集合住宅，通常由多间独立的房间组成，可供出租或出售。
explanation_english: A self-contained housing unit that is part of a larger building, typically rented or owned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋住喺一個細公寓度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 jat1 go3 sai3 gung1 jyu6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们住在一个小公寓里。
examples.english_sentence: We live in a small apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅公寓通常都好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 jyu6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的公寓通常都很贵。
examples.english_sentence: Apartments in Hong Kong are usually very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想買個新公寓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 maai5 go3 san1 gung1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想买一个新的公寓。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to buy a new apartment.

mandarin_meaning: 公开审判; 公开批判
english_meaning: public trial; public criticism; show trial; trial by media
explanation_mandarin: 指公开审判或公开批判某人，通常带有舆论压力或政治目的。
explanation_english: Refers to a public trial or public criticism of someone, often with public pressure or political motives. It can also refer to a situation where someone is judged and condemned by the media or the public without due process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人喺網上公審，搞到身敗名裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng5 gung1 sam2, gaau2 dou3 san1 baai6 ming4 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在网上被人公开审判，搞得身败名裂。
examples.english_sentence: He was publicly criticized online, leading to his ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢根本就係傳媒嘅公審，未審先判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 cyun4 mui4 ge3 gung1 sam2, mei6 sam2 sin1 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事根本就是媒体的公开审判，未审先判。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is essentially a trial by the media, judging before the trial even begins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲鬥爭會搞公審大會，批鬥啲人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 dau3 zaang1 wui2 gaau2 gung1 sam2 daai6 wui2, pai1 dau3 di1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的斗争会搞公开审判大会，批判那些人。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, struggles would involve public trial rallies to criticize people.

english_meaning: meter (unit of length)
explanation_mandarin: 长度单位，等于一百厘米。
explanation_english: A unit of length in the metric system, equal to one hundred centimeters. Also spelled 'metre'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個泳池有五十公尺長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wing6 ci4 jau5 ng5 sap6 gung1 cek3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游泳池有五十米长。
examples.english_sentence: This swimming pool is fifty meters long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我身高一米七，即係一百七十公分，或者一百七十公尺咁高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 gou1 jat1 mai5 cat1, zik1 hai6 jat1 baak3 cat1 sap6 gung1 fan1, waak6 ze2 jat1 baak3 cat1 sap6 gung1 cek3 gam3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我身高一米七，也就是一百七十公分，或者说一百七十厘米那么高。
examples.english_sentence: I am 1.7 meters tall, which is 170 centimeters, or you could say 170 metres.

english_meaning: Public housing (in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府为低收入居民提供的廉价出租房屋。
explanation_english: Low-rent housing provided by the Hong Kong government for low-income residents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一家人排咗好耐隊先至申請到間公屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 paai4 zo2 hou2 noi6 deoi2 sin1 zi3 san1 cing2 dou2 gaan1 gung1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一家人排了很久的队才申请到一套公租房。
examples.english_sentence: Our family queued for a long time before we were able to apply for a public housing flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人嘅目標都係買到自己嘅樓，唔使再住公屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 muk6 biu1 dou1 hai6 maai5 dou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 lau2, m4 sai2 zoi3 zyu6 gung1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港人的目标都是买到自己的房子，不用再住公租房。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong people's goal is to buy their own apartment so they don't have to live in public housing anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 公共房屋富裕住户；富有公屋住户
english_meaning: Wealthy public housing tenant; Affluent public housing household
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在公共房屋（香港廉租房）中，但收入或资产远超政府规定的上限，本应迁出公屋，却仍然居住在公屋中的住户。
explanation_english: Refers to tenants living in public housing (government subsidized housing in Hong Kong) whose income or assets significantly exceed the government's established limits, and who should theoretically move out of public housing, but continue to reside there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該嚴厲打擊啲公屋富戶，等佢哋騰返啲資源俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 yim4 lai6 daa2 gik1 di1 gung1 uk1 fu3 wu6, dang2 keoi5 dei6 tang4 faan1 di1 zi1 yuen4 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该严厉打击那些公共房屋富裕住户，让他们腾出一些资源给有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: The government should severely crack down on wealthy public housing tenants, so that they can free up resources for those in need.

english_meaning: Public housing affluent tenant; a wealthy tenant living in public housing
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在公共房屋（公屋）但收入或资产超出政府规定的标准的住户。
explanation_english: Refers to tenants living in public housing (provided by the government) whose income or assets exceed the government's established criteria for public housing eligibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該嚴厲打擊公屋富戶，將資源留俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 yim4 lai6 daa2 gik1 gung1 uk1 fu3 wu6, jeung1 ji1 yuen4 lau4 bei2 jau5 seoi1 yiu3 ge3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该严厉打击公屋富户，把资源留给有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: The government should severely crack down on public housing affluent tenants and reserve the resources for those in need.

english_meaning: Wealthy public housing tenant; Public housing tenant exceeding income and asset limits
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在香港公共房屋（公屋）但收入或资产超过政府规定上限的住户。
explanation_english: Refers to tenants living in public housing (subsidized housing) in Hong Kong whose income or assets exceed the limits set by the government. These tenants are often perceived as having an unfair advantage, as they are benefiting from subsidized housing despite being wealthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺公屋但係揸靚車，肯定係公屋富户啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jyu5 hai2 gung1 uk1 daan6 hai6 zaa1 leng1 che1, hak1 ding6 hai6 gung1 uk1 fu3 wu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在公屋但是开好车，肯定是公屋富裕户了。
examples.english_sentence: They live in public housing but drive a fancy car, they must be wealthy public housing tenants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該加強抽查，唔可以俾咁多公屋富戶佔用公共資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 gaa1 keung4 chau1 cha4, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 gam3 do1 gung1 uk1 fu3 wu6 zim3 yung6 gung1 gung1 zi1 yuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该加强抽查，不能让这么多公屋富裕户占用公共资源。
examples.english_sentence: The government should strengthen inspections and not allow so many wealthy public housing tenants to occupy public resources.

synonyms: 富户 (fu3 wu6, general term for wealthy household)

english_meaning: to announce, to promulgate, to make public
explanation_mandarin: 正式地向公众宣告或宣布。
explanation_english: To officially announce or declare to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府公布咗新嘅防疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gung1 bou3 zo2 san1 ge3 fong4 jik6 mok6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府公布了新的防疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government has announced new epidemic prevention measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司聽日會公布業績報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ting1 jat6 wui2 gung1 bou3 yip6 zik1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司明天会公布业绩报告。
examples.english_sentence: The company will announce the earnings report tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉結果正式公布咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2 zeng3 sik1 gung1 bou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举结果正式公布了。
examples.english_sentence: The election results have been officially announced.

english_meaning: public funds; government funds; public money; taxpayer's money
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府或公共机构掌控的资金，来源于税收或其他公共收入。
explanation_english: Refers to funds controlled by the government or public institutions, derived from taxes or other public revenue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要小心咁使用公帑，唔好浪費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gam2 si2 yung6 gung1 tong2, m4 hou2 long6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该小心使用公款，不要浪费。
examples.english_sentence: We should be careful in using public funds and not waste them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅經費都係嚟自公帑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 ging1 fai3 dou1 hai6 lai4 zi6 gung1 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的经费都来自公款。
examples.english_sentence: The funding for this project all comes from public funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民有權監督政府點樣使用公帑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 jau5 kwan4 gaam1 duk1 zing3 fu2 dim2 joeng2 si2 yung6 gung1 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民有权监督政府如何使用公款。
examples.english_sentence: The public has the right to monitor how the government uses public funds.

english_meaning: fair; just; equitable; impartial
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情公正合理，不偏袒任何一方。
explanation_english: Describes something that is fair, just, and impartial, without showing favoritism to any particular side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個比賽一定要公平公正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gung1 ping4 gung1 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛一定要公平公正。
examples.english_sentence: This competition must be fair and just.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得咁樣分嘢唔係好公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gam2 joeng2 fan1 je5 m4 hai6 hou2 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这样分东西不是很公平。
examples.english_sentence: I don't think it's very fair to divide things like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法律面前，人人平等，先至公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 leot6 min6 cin4, jan4 jan4 ping4 dang2, sin1 zai3 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法律面前，人人平等，这才公平。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is equal before the law, only then is it fair.

mandarin_meaning: 公平贸易 (gōng píng mào yì)
english_meaning: Fair Trade
explanation_mandarin: 一种旨在帮助发展中国家生产者的贸易模式，确保他们获得公平的价格和更好的劳动条件。
explanation_english: A trading partnership based on dialogue, transparency, and respect, that seeks greater equity in international trade. It contributes to sustainable development by offering better trading conditions to, and securing the rights of, marginalized producers and workers in developing countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該支持公平貿易，幫吓發展中國家啲農民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zi1 chi4 gung1 ping4 mau6 yik6, bong1 haa5 faat3 zin2 zung1 gwok3 gaa1 di1 nung4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该支持公平贸易，帮助发展中国家的农民。
examples.english_sentence: We should support fair trade to help farmers in developing countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司所有嘅咖啡豆都係公平貿易產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 so2 jau5 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dau2 dou1 hai6 gung1 ping4 mau6 yik6 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的所有咖啡豆都是公平贸易产品。
examples.english_sentence: All the coffee beans in this company are fair trade products.

english_meaning: business trip, to be on official business
explanation_mandarin: 为了工作而出差。
explanation_english: To go on a business trip for work; to be on official business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜要去上海公幹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 jiu3 heoi3 soeng6 hoi2 gung1 gon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期要去上海出差。
examples.english_sentence: He's going to Shanghai on a business trip next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今個月公幹咗兩個星期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 gung1 gon3 zo2 loeng5 go3 sing1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这个月出差了两个星期。
examples.english_sentence: I've been on a business trip for two weeks this month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次公幹嘅主要目的係乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 gung1 gon3 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 muk6 dik1 hai6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这次出差的主要目的是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What is the main purpose of your business trip this time?

mandarin_meaning: 公共厕所，(贬义)比喻谁都可以用的东西或地方
english_meaning: public toilet; (derogatory) something or somewhere that everyone uses/abuses
explanation_mandarin: 本意是公共厕所。在粤语中，常被用作贬义，比喻一个可以随便让人使用或利用的东西或地方。可以指一个物品被很多人用过导致很脏，也可以指某人或某地谁都可以利用或占便宜。
explanation_english: Literally means 'public toilet.' In Cantonese, it is often used derogatorily to describe something or somewhere that anyone can use or take advantage of. It can refer to an item that has been used by many people, making it dirty, or to a person or place that anyone can exploit or benefit from.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個Project俾咁多人搞過，而家好似個公廁咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 Project bei2 gam3 do1 jan4 gaau2 gwo3, ji4 gaa1 hou2 ci5 go3 gung1 ci3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目被这么多人弄过，现在好像个公共厕所一样。
examples.english_sentence: This project has been messed with by so many people; it's like a public toilet now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁cheap，成日想喺人哋度攞著數，簡直當人哋係公廁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 cheap1, seng4 jat6 soeng2 hai2 jan4 dei6 dou6 lo2 zoek3 sou3, gaan2 zik6 dong3 jan4 dei6 hai6 gung1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很小气，总是想在别人那里占便宜，简直把别人当成公共厕所。
examples.english_sentence: That person is so stingy and always wants to take advantage of others; they treat people like public toilets.

english_meaning: formula; equation
explanation_mandarin: 表示特定关系的固定形式或规则。
explanation_english: A set of rules or principles, usually expressed in mathematical symbols, that describe a relationship between quantities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數嘅公式好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 ge3 gung1 sik1 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个算式的公式很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The formula for this calculation is very complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用錯咗條公式，所以計錯咗答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 co3 zo2 tiu4 gung1 sik1, so2 ji5 gai3 co3 zo2 daap3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用错了公式，所以算错了答案。
examples.english_sentence: He used the wrong formula, so he calculated the wrong answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇乜嘢成功嘅公式，最緊要係努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 mat1 je5 sing4 gung1 ge3 gung1 sik1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有什么成功的公式，最重要的是努力。
examples.english_sentence: There's no formula for success; the most important thing is to work hard.

english_meaning: formulaic, to formularize, to become standardized, to do something in a routine way
explanation_mandarin: 指事物过于程式化，缺乏创意和个性。
explanation_english: Refers to something becoming too formulaic, lacking creativity and individuality; to standardize or routinize something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲電視劇劇情好公式化，睇到悶晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 din6 si6 kek6 ching4 hou2 gung1 sik1 faa3, tai2 dou3 mun6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的电视剧剧情太公式化了，看得都腻了。
examples.english_sentence: The plots of their TV dramas are too formulaic, it's boring to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁公式化啦，試下用啲新方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gung1 sik1 faa3 laa1, si3 haa5 yung6 di1 san1 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么公式化了，试着用一些新方法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so formulaic, try using some new methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅運作模式已經公式化咗，好難改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wan6 jok3 mou4 sik1 ji5 ging1 gung1 sik1 faa3 zo2, hou2 naan4 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的运作模式已经公式化了，很难改变。
examples.english_sentence: The operating model of this company has become formulaic, it's hard to change.

english_meaning: public morality; civic virtue
explanation_mandarin: 指社会公认的，人们在公共生活中应当遵守的道德规范。
explanation_english: Public morality refers to the moral principles and standards that are generally accepted in society and that people should observe in public life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冇公德心，成日亂咁掉垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mou5 gung1 dak1 sam1, seng4 jat6 lyun6 gam2 diu1 laap6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们没有公德心，总是乱扔垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: They have no civic virtue and always litter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保持公德，人人有責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 ci4 gung1 dak1, jan4 jan4 jau5 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保持公德，人人有责。
examples.english_sentence: Maintaining public morality is everyone's responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得嘢咁唔負責任，真係冇乜公德心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 je5 gam3 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam4, zan1 hai6 mou5 mat1 gung1 dak1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事这么不负责任，真没什么公德心。
examples.english_sentence: He's so irresponsible at work, he really has no public spirit.

english_meaning: Public-spiritedness; sense of public morality; civic-mindedness
explanation_mandarin: 指维护社会公共利益和社会公德的道德意识和行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the moral consciousness and behavior of maintaining public interests and social morality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人好冇公德心，喺公園度亂拋垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 mou5 gung1 dak1 sam1, hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 lyun6 paau1 laap1 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很没有公德心，在公园里乱扔垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: This person has no public spirit; they litter in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁後生就有咁嘅公德心，真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 jau5 gam3 ge3 gung1 dak1 sam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么年轻就有这样的公德心，真是很难得。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to see such public-spiritedness in people so young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要培養小朋友嘅公德心，等佢哋知道要愛護環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 pui4 joeng5 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 gung1 dak1 sam1, dang2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 dou3 jiu3 oi3 wu6 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要培养小朋友的公德心，让他们知道要爱护环境。
examples.english_sentence: We need to cultivate a sense of public spirit in children so they know to protect the environment.

english_meaning: public outrage; popular indignation
explanation_mandarin: 公众的愤怒，普遍的愤慨。
explanation_english: The anger of the public; widespread indignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅決定引起咗社會嘅公憤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 hei2 yan1 zo2 se5 wui2 ge3 gung1 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的决定引起了社会的公愤。
examples.english_sentence: The government's decision caused public outrage in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為簡直係挑戰公憤，唔可以原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 gaan2 zik6 hai6 tiu1 zin3 gung1 fan5, m4 ho2 ji5 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为简直是在挑战公愤，不可原谅。
examples.english_sentence: His behaviour is simply challenging public outrage and is unforgivable.

english_meaning: Public office; Guildhall; Association hall (often for people from the same hometown)
explanation_mandarin: 指旧时的公共机关，也指同乡会等组织的会所。
explanation_english: Refers to a former public office or a meeting hall for organizations like hometown associations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公所成日搞啲社區活動，好受街坊歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 so2 seng4 jat6 gaau2 di1 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6, hou2 sau6 gaai1 fong1 waan1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公所经常搞一些社区活动，很受街坊欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Their association hall often organizes community activities, which are very popular with the neighbors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人嚟香港，好多都會去番自己鄉下嘅公所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 do1 dou1 wui5 heoi3 faan1 zi6 gei2 hoeng1 haa2 ge3 gung1 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人来香港，很多都会去回自己家乡的同乡会。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many people coming to Hong Kong would go back to their hometown association.

english_meaning: referendum, plebiscite
explanation_mandarin: 公民投票，指就某一重大议题或政策，由全体符合资格的公民直接投票决定。
explanation_english: A referendum or plebiscite, where eligible citizens directly vote on a specific important issue or policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府打算就呢個議題搞公投。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 daa2 syun3 zau6 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 gaau2 gung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府打算就这个问题进行公民投票。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to hold a referendum on this issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 究竟應唔應該進行公投呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 ging2 ying1 m4 ying1 goi1 zeon3 hang4 gung1 tau4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到底应不应该进行公民投票呢？
examples.english_sentence: Should we hold a referendum?

english_meaning: Public Assistance; Social Welfare
explanation_mandarin: 指政府提供的社会福利金，通常给予经济困难的人或家庭。
explanation_english: Refers to public assistance or social welfare, which is financial aid provided by the government to individuals or families in financial need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業之後就申請咗公援嚟維持生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 san1 ching2 zo2 gung1 wun4 lai4 wai4 chi4 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业之后就申请了社会福利金来维持生活。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he applied for public assistance to support himself.

english_meaning: Catholicism; Catholic
explanation_mandarin: 指天主教。是“公教会”的简称。
explanation_english: Refers to Catholicism. It is a shortened form of "公教会" (Gōngjiàohuì).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間公教學校返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gung1 gaau3 hok6 haau6 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一所天主教学校上学。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to a Catholic school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企人大部分都係公教徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 hai6 gung1 gaau3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的家人大部分都是天主教徒。
examples.english_sentence: Most of my family members are Catholics.

english_meaning: public enemy; common enemy
explanation_mandarin: 指公众的敌人，大家都反对的对象。
explanation_english: Refers to a public enemy, an object of opposition from everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咁多衰嘢，簡直係成個社會嘅公敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 seng4 go3 se5 wui2 ge3 gung1 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了那么多坏事，简直是整个社会的公敌。
examples.english_sentence: He did so many bad things, he's practically a public enemy of the whole society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔團結，我哋會俾佢哋變成公敵㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 tyun4 git3, ngo5 dei6 wui5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 bin3 sing4 gung1 dik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不团结，我们会被他们变成公敌的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't unite, we will be made public enemies by them.

english_meaning: public funds; company account; official expenses; company's money; business account
explanation_mandarin: 指公家的钱，或公司、机构等用来支付公务费用的钱。也指公司、机构的账目，尤其是指报销用的账目。
explanation_english: Refers to public money or the money used by companies or organizations to pay for official expenses. It can also refer to the accounts of a company or organization, especially accounts for reimbursement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食飯嘅錢，可以用公數報銷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 ge3 cin2, ho2 ji5 yung6 gung1 sou3 bou3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃饭的钱，可以用公款报销。
examples.english_sentence: The money for our meal can be reimbursed through the company account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁隨便用公數啦，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceoi4 bin2 yung6 gung1 sou3 laa1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么随便用公款，要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use company money so casually, you need to be more careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅公數好混亂，可能有人貪污。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gung1 sou3 hou2 wan6 lyun6, ho2 nang4 jau5 jan4 taam1 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的公账很混乱，可能有人贪污。
examples.english_sentence: The company's accounts are very chaotic, someone might be embezzling.

english_meaning: official document; official correspondence
explanation_mandarin: 指机关、团体等处理公务时使用的文件。
explanation_english: Official documents or correspondence used by government agencies, organizations, etc., for conducting official business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到好多份關於新政策嘅公文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou3 hou2 do1 fan6 gwaan1 jyu1 san1 zing3 caak3 ge3 gung1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到了很多份关于新政策的公文。
examples.english_sentence: We received many official documents about the new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專門負責處理部門嘅公文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 mun4 fu6 zaak3 cyu2 lei5 bou6 mun4 ge3 gung1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门负责处理部门的公文。
examples.english_sentence: He is specially responsible for handling the department's official documents.

english_meaning: kilogram
explanation_mandarin: 公制重量单位，等于1000克。
explanation_english: A metric unit of mass equal to 1000 grams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個西瓜有五公斤咁重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai1 gwaa1 jau5 ng5 gung1 gan1 gam3 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个西瓜有五公斤那么重。
examples.english_sentence: This watermelon weighs five kilograms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買兩公斤蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 gung1 gan1 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买两公斤苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy two kilograms of apples.

english_meaning: public screening, general release (of a film)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影正式在电影院等场所公开放映。
explanation_english: Refers to the formal public screening of a film in cinemas or other venues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲下個禮拜就公映喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 gung1 jeng2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影下个星期就要公映了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie will be released next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去睇首日公映啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 sau2 jat6 gung1 jeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去看首映吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go watch the premiere tomorrow!

english_meaning: Gregorian calendar; Western calendar; Common Era (CE)
explanation_mandarin: 指国际通用的阳历，即格里历。
explanation_english: Refers to the internationally used solar calendar, also known as the Gregorian calendar or Western calendar. It's the calendar most widely used in the world today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用公曆計日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yung6 gung1 lik6 gai3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用公历计算日期。
examples.english_sentence: We use the Gregorian calendar to calculate the date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅聖誕節係公曆十二月二十五號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 sing3 daan3 zit3 hai6 gung1 lik6 sap6 ji6 jyut6 ji6 sap6 ng5 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的圣诞节是公历十二月二十五号。
examples.english_sentence: This year's Christmas is on December 25th according to the Gregorian calendar.

english_meaning: Trade union, guild, association
explanation_mandarin: 由同一行业的劳动者组成的组织，旨在维护成员的权益和改善工作条件。
explanation_english: An organization of workers in the same trade or occupation, formed to protect their rights and improve their working conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想成立一個教師公會嚟保障自己嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 sing4 laap6 jat1 go3 gaau3 si1 gung1 wui2 lai4 bou2 zoeng3 zi6 gei2 ge3 kuen4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想成立一个教师工会来保障自己的权益。
examples.english_sentence: They want to set up a teachers' union to protect their rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加入公會可以得到更多保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaap3 jap6 gung1 wui2 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 gang3 do1 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加入工会可以得到更多保障。
examples.english_sentence: Joining a trade union can provide more protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅員工都係公會會員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wun4 gung1 dou1 hai6 gung1 wui2 wui2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的员工都是工会会员。
examples.english_sentence: The employees of this company are all union members.

english_meaning: public; collectively owned; state-owned
explanation_mandarin: 属于公众或集体的，而非私人的。
explanation_english: Belonging to the public or a collective, rather than being privately owned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間泳池係公有嘅，人人都可以嚟游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 wing6 ci4 hai6 gung1 jau5 ge3, jan4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 lai4 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游泳池是公共的，每个人都可以来游泳。
examples.english_sentence: This swimming pool is public, everyone can come to swim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公有土地應該用喺對大眾有利嘅用途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jau5 to2 dei6 ying1 goi1 yung6 hai2 deoi3 daai6 zung3 jau5 lei6 ge3 yung6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公共土地应该用在对大众有利的用途。
examples.english_sentence: Public land should be used for purposes that benefit the public.

english_meaning: Public Domain
explanation_mandarin: 指不受版权、专利或商标法保护的作品、信息或知识，公众可以自由使用。
explanation_english: Refers to works, information, or knowledge that are not protected by copyright, patent, or trademark law and can be freely used by the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌已經過咗版權期，入咗公有領域，大家可以免費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 baan2 kyueng4 kei4, jap6 zo2 gung1 jau5 ling5 wik6, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌已经过了版权期，进入了公共领域，大家可以免费使用。
examples.english_sentence: This song's copyright has expired and it has entered the public domain, so everyone can use it for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用咗啲公有領域嘅圖片嚟設計個網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 zo2 di1 gung1 jau5 ling5 wik6 ge3 tou4 pin3 lai4 sai3 gai3 go3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用了一些公共领域的图片来设计这个网站。
examples.english_sentence: They used some public domain images to design the website.

english_meaning: Public power, authority of the state
explanation_mandarin: 指国家机关及其工作人员行使的权力，例如立法权、行政权、司法权等。
explanation_english: Refers to the power exercised by state organs and their personnel, such as legislative, executive, and judicial power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該小心使用公權力，保障市民嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 siu2 sam1 si2 yung6 gung1 kuen4 lik6, bou2 zoeng3 si5 man4 ge3 kuen4 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该小心使用公权力，保障市民的权益。
examples.english_sentence: The government should use public power carefully to protect the rights and interests of citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 濫用公權力係一種嚴重嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laam6 yung6 gung1 kuen4 lik6 hai6 jat1 zung2 yim4 zung6 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滥用公权力是一种严重的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: Abuse of public power is a serious crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民有權監督公權力嘅運用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 jau5 kuen4 gaam1 duk1 gung1 kuen4 lik6 ge3 wan6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民有权监督公权力的运用。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens have the right to supervise the exercise of public power.

english_meaning: public funds; government funds
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或公共机构所拥有的资金。
explanation_english: Money belonging to the government or a public institution; public funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋涉嫌濫用公款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sip3 jim4 laam6 yung6 gung1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们涉嫌滥用公款。
examples.english_sentence: They are suspected of misusing public funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅資金主要嚟自公款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 zi1 gam1 zyu2 jiu3 lai4 zi6 gung1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的资金主要来自公款。
examples.english_sentence: The funding for this project mainly comes from public funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保公款用得其所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 gung1 fun2 yung6 dak1 kei4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保公款用得其所。
examples.english_sentence: We must ensure that public funds are used properly.

english_meaning: fair, just, impartial, equitable
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情公平合理，没有偏袒。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or person being fair, just, and impartial, without showing favoritism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官判案一定要公正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 pun3 on3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gung1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官判案一定要公正。
examples.english_sentence: A judge must be fair in adjudicating cases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要爭取一個公正嘅社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaang1 ceoi2 jat1 go3 gung1 zing3 ge3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要争取一个公正的社会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strive for a just society.

english_meaning: surveyor's office, inspection company
explanation_mandarin: 从事检验、鉴定等业务的公司或机构。
explanation_english: A company or organization engaged in inspection, appraisal, and other related services, often related to goods being traded or transported. It can also refer to companies that deal with insurance claims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵公正行嚟驗下啲貨，睇下有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 gung1 zing3 hong4 lai4 jim6 haa5 di1 fo3, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找一家公证行来检验一下货物，看看有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a surveyor's office to inspect the goods and see if there are any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間船公司叫咗公正行嚟評估一下損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 syun4 gung1 si1 giu3 zo2 gung1 zing3 hong4 lai4 ping4 gu2 jat1 haa5 sun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家船运公司叫了公证行来评估一下损失。
examples.english_sentence: The shipping company called a surveyor's office to assess the loss.

cantonese: 公死有肉食，婆死有肉食
jyutping: gung1 sei2 jau5 juk6 sik6, po4 sei2 jau5 juk6 sik6
english_meaning: Whether grandpa or grandma dies, there will be meat to eat (someone will benefit no matter what happens).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻无论发生什么情况，总有人能从中获利。含贬义，指望他人不幸来获得好处。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone will benefit regardless of the outcome, often at the expense of others. It has a negative connotation, implying that someone is hoping for misfortune to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住上位，無論發生咩事都好，佢都係諗住點樣可以攞著數，真係「公死有肉食，婆死有肉食」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zoek3 soeng5 wai2, mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 hou2, keoi5 dou1 hai6 lam2 zoek3 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 lo2 zoek3 syu3, zan1 hai6 "gung1 sei2 jau5 juk6 sik6, po4 sei2 jau5 juk6 sik6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着上位，无论发生什么事，他都想着怎么能占便宜，真是“死了都有东西吃”。
examples.english_sentence: He is always thinking about climbing the ladder. No matter what happens, he is always thinking about how to take advantage. He's really just thinking "whether grandpa or grandma dies, there will be meat to eat."

english_meaning: citizen
explanation_mandarin: 指具有某国国籍，享有该国法律规定的权利和义务的人。
explanation_english: A citizen is a person recognized under the custom or law as a legal member of a sovereign state or belonging to a nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅每個公民都有投票權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 mui5 go3 gung1 man4 dou1 jau5 tau4 piu3 kyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的每个公民都有投票权。
examples.english_sentence: Every citizen in Hong Kong has the right to vote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅公民義務包括遵守法律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 man4 yi6 mou6 baau1 kwut3 zeon1 sau2 faat3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的公民义务包括遵守法律。
examples.english_sentence: Our civic duties include obeying the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱攞到美國公民身份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lo2 dou2 mei5 gwok3 gung1 man4 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚获得了美国公民身份。
examples.english_sentence: He just obtained American citizenship.

english_meaning: civil society
explanation_mandarin: 指介于个人、家庭和国家之间的社会领域，由各种志愿组织、社团、非营利机构等组成，旨在促进公民参与、监督政府、表达诉求。
explanation_english: Civil society refers to the sphere of social life that is separate from the state, the market, and the family. It encompasses a wide range of voluntary associations, organizations, and institutions that operate to promote citizen participation, hold the government accountable, and express their demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅公民社會喺近年嚟面對唔少挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 man4 se5 wui2 hai2 gan6 nin4 lai4 min6 deoi3 m4 siu2 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的公民社会近年来面临不少挑战。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's civil society has faced many challenges in recent years.

english_meaning: public vote, referendum, to decide by public vote
explanation_mandarin: 通过公开投票的方式来决定。既可以指行为（公决），也可以指结果（公决的结果）。
explanation_english: To decide something by public vote; a referendum; the outcome of a public vote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搞一次公決去決定係咪要起呢個新商場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau2 jat1 ci3 gung1 kyut3 heoi3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 mai6 jiu3 hei2 ni1 go3 san1 soeng1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要举行一次公决来决定是否要建这个新商场。
examples.english_sentence: We need to hold a referendum to decide whether to build this new shopping mall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定就呢個議題進行公決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 zau6 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 zeon3 hang4 gung1 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定就这个议题进行公决。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to hold a public vote on this issue.

english_meaning: international waters, the high seas
explanation_mandarin: 指不受任何国家管辖的海洋区域，任何人都可以自由使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the area of the sea that is not under the jurisdiction of any country and can be used freely by anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲漁船通常去公海度捉魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 yu4 syun4 tung1 soeng4 heoi3 gung1 hoi2 dou6 zuk1 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 渔船通常去公海捕鱼。
examples.english_sentence: Fishing boats usually go to international waters to catch fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公海唔屬於任何一個國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hoi2 m4 suk6 jyu1 jam6 ho2 jat1 go3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公海不属于任何一个国家。
examples.english_sentence: International waters do not belong to any single country.

english_meaning: Public beta test, open beta
explanation_mandarin: 指软件或游戏等在正式发布前，向公众开放测试的版本，以便收集用户反馈并进行改进。
explanation_english: Refers to a version of software or a game that is released to the public for testing before its official release. The purpose is to gather user feedback and make improvements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻遊戲嘅公測反應好好，好多人都話好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 jau4 hei3 ge3 gung1 cak1 faan2 jing3 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款游戏的公开测试反响很好，很多人都说好玩。
examples.english_sentence: The public beta test for this game has received very good feedback. Many people say it's fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司下個月會搞個新app嘅公測。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 gaau2 go3 san1 app ge3 gung1 cak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司下个月会举办一个新app的公开测试。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will hold a public beta test for a new app next month.

english_meaning: public performance, to stage a show
explanation_mandarin: 公开演出；在公众面前表演（戏剧、音乐会等）。
explanation_english: A public performance; to stage a show, typically referring to a play, concert, or other performance art.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋學校有公演啊，你嚟唔嚟睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 jau5 gung1 jin2 aa3, nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们学校有公演，你来不来看？
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow our school has a public performance, are you coming to watch?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇公演咗好多次，好受歡迎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 gung1 jin2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3, hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧公演了很多次，很受欢迎的。
examples.english_sentence: This play has been performed publicly many times, it's very popular.

english_meaning: openly; publicly; brazenly
explanation_mandarin: 指不加掩饰地，在公开场合进行。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something openly and without concealment, in a public setting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然公然喺課室瞓覺，真係大膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 gung1 jin4 hai2 fo3 sat1 fan3 gaau3, zan1 hai6 daai6 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然公然在教室睡觉，真是大胆。
examples.english_sentence: He actually slept in the classroom openly, that's really audacious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公然喺街頭打交，俾警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 jin4 hai2 gaai1 tau4 daa2 gaau1, bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公然在街头打架，被警察抓走了。
examples.english_sentence: They fought openly on the street and were arrested by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司公然違反勞工法例，剝削員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gung1 jin4 wai4 faan2 lou4 gung1 faat3 lai6, bok1 seot3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司公然违反劳动法例，剥削员工。
examples.english_sentence: This company openly violates labor laws and exploits its employees.

english_meaning: publicly operated; state-owned; public
explanation_mandarin: 由政府或公共机构经营的。
explanation_english: Operated by the government or a public institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅公共房屋大部分都係公營嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 gung1 fong4 uk1 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 hai6 gung1 jing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的公共房屋大部分都是公营的。
examples.english_sentence: Most of the public housing in Hong Kong is publicly operated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間係公營醫院，收費相對比較平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hai6 gung1 jing4 ji1 jyun2, sau1 fai3 soeng1 deoi3 bei2 gaau3 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家是公营医院，收费相对比较便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This is a public hospital, the fees are relatively cheaper.

english_meaning: Public institution; Public organization; Public sector body
explanation_mandarin: 由政府资助或管理的机构。
explanation_english: An organization or institution funded and/or managed by the government; a part of the public sector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間公營機構做嘢，福利幾好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gung1 jing4 gei1 kau3 zou6 je5, fuk1 lei6 gei2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家公营机构工作，福利很好。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a public institution, and the benefits are quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅港鐵都算係一間公營機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gong2 tit3 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 jing4 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的港铁也算是一家公营机构。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's MTR can be considered a public institution.

english_meaning: duke
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲贵族爵位，等级在亲王之下，侯爵之上。
explanation_english: A European noble rank, below a prince and above a marquis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個公爵嘅後人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 gung1 zoek3 ge3 hau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公爵的后人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a descendant of a duke.

english_meaning: bull
explanation_mandarin: 指未阉割的雄性牛。
explanation_english: An uncastrated male bovine animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻公牛好大隻，好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 gung1 ngau4 hou2 daai6 zek3, hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只公牛很大，很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: That bull is very big and imposing.

english_meaning: public property; public facilities
explanation_mandarin: 公共所有的物品；公共设施。
explanation_english: Property owned by the public or a community; public facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅公物唔好亂咁破壞啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 gung1 mat6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 po3 waai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的公共物品不要乱破坏啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't vandalize the public property here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士站都係公物嚟㗎，要好好保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zaam6 dou1 hai6 gung1 mat6 lai4 gaa3, jiu3 hou2 hou2 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公交车站也是公共财产，要好好保护。
examples.english_sentence: Bus stops are also public property, so we should protect them well.

english_meaning: axiom, self-evident truth; principle
explanation_mandarin: 指不证自明的道理，或是被普遍接受的原则。
explanation_english: A self-evident truth or principle that requires no proof; a universally accepted principle or rule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自由同平等係基本嘅公理嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jau4 tung4 ping4 dang2 hai6 gei1 bun2 ge3 gung1 lei5 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自由和平等是基本公理。
examples.english_sentence: Freedom and equality are basic axioms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺數學上，我哋用公理去推導其他定理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sou3 hok6 soeng6, ngo5 dei6 yung6 gung1 lei5 heoi3 teoi1 dou6 kei4 taa1 ding6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在数学上，我们用公理去推导其他定理。
examples.english_sentence: In mathematics, we use axioms to deduce other theorems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會公理需要大家一齊維護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 gung1 lei5 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 ga1 jat1 cai4 wai4 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会公理需要大家一起维护。
examples.english_sentence: Social principles need to be upheld by everyone.

english_meaning: public; for public use; common
explanation_mandarin: 供大家共同使用的；公共的。
explanation_english: For public use; shared by everyone; common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廁所係公用嘅，所以要保持清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci3 so2 hai6 gung1 yung6 ge3, so2 ji5 jiu3 bou2 chi4 ching1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厕所是公用的，所以要保持清洁。
examples.english_sentence: This toilet is for public use, so we need to keep it clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有個公用廚房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 gung1 yung6 chu4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有一个公用厨房。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has a common kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有部公用電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 bou6 gung1 yung6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有一部公用电话。
examples.english_sentence: There is a public phone here.

english_meaning: public welfare; public good; charity
explanation_mandarin: 为公众利益而从事的活动或事业。
explanation_english: Activities or undertakings carried out for the benefit of the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該多啲做公益，幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 zou6 gung1 jik1, bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多做公益，帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more public welfare work to help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司好注重企業公益責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 kei5 jip6 gung1 jik1 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很注重企业公益责任。
examples.english_sentence: This company pays great attention to corporate social responsibility.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同已经做了公证，不用担心了。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 办理移民需要提交公证文件。

english_meaning: Notary Public Office
explanation_mandarin: 提供公证服务的机构，通常用于证明文件的真实性，如签名、合同等。
explanation_english: An office or organization that provides notary public services, typically used to authenticate documents such as signatures and contracts.

examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the notary public office to notarize a property deed.

english_meaning: generally acknowledged; universally recognized; publicly recognized
explanation_mandarin: 普遍承认的，大家一致认可的。
explanation_english: Something that is generally accepted, universally recognized, or publicly acknowledged by everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公認嘅靚女嚟㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是公认的美女。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心係公認好食嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心是公认好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant is generally acknowledged to be delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技係公認一流嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin2 gei6 hai6 gung1 yan6 yat1 lau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技是公认一流的。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills are universally recognized as first-class.

cantonese: 公說公有理，婆說婆有理
jyutping: gung1 syut3 gung1 jau5 lei5, po4 syut3 po4 jau5 lei5
mandarin_meaning: 公有公的道理，婆有婆的道理
english_meaning: Each side has their own reasons/arguments; There are two sides to every story.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻双方各执一词，各有各的理由，难以判断谁对谁错。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where both sides of an argument have their own valid points and reasons, making it difficult to determine who is right or wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗啲錢嘈交，公說公有理，婆說婆有理，我都唔知幫邊個好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai4 zo2 di1 cin2 cou4 gaau1, gung1 syut3 gung1 jau5 lei5, po4 syut3 po4 jau5 lei5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 bong1 bin1 go3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了钱吵架，公说公有理，婆说婆有理，我都不知道帮谁好。
examples.english_sentence: They're arguing over money. Each side has their own reasons, I don't know who to side with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事公說公有理，婆說婆有理，最好就係大家坐低傾掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gung1 syut3 gung1 jau5 lei5, po4 syut3 po4 jau5 lei5, zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 king1 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事公说公有理，婆说婆有理，最好就是大家坐下来好好谈谈。
examples.english_sentence: Each side has their own reasons for this matter, the best thing to do is for everyone to sit down and talk it out.

cantonese: 公説公有理，婆説婆有理
jyutping: gung1 syut3 gung1 jau5 lei5, po4 syut3 po4 jau5 lei5
mandarin_meaning: 公说公有理，婆说婆有理
english_meaning: Every side has its own justification; There are two sides to every story.
explanation_mandarin: 指双方各执一词，都有各自的道理。通常用于描述争论不休的情况，难以判断谁对谁错。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where two parties in a dispute each have their own seemingly valid arguments. It suggests that both sides have their own reasons and justifications, making it difficult to determine which side is correct. Often used when there is a lack of clear evidence or when different perspectives are equally plausible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為啲錢嘈交，公説公有理，婆説婆有理，真係唔知信邊個好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 di1 cin2 cou4 gaau1, gung1 syut3 gung1 jau5 lei5, po4 syut3 po4 jau5 lei5, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 seon3 bin1 go3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为钱吵架，公说公有理，婆说婆有理，真不知道该相信谁好。
examples.english_sentence: They are arguing about money, each having their own justifications. It's hard to know who to believe.

mandarin_meaning: 公开与有共同爱好的人分享
english_meaning: To share with those of similar interests; to make public for the enjoyment of like-minded people.
explanation_mandarin: 把自己的爱好、兴趣或收藏品公开，与有相同兴趣的人一同分享和欣赏。
explanation_english: To share one's hobbies, interests, or collections with people who have similar interests; to make something available for the enjoyment of others who share a common passion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺網上公諸同好，一齊分享我哋嘅攝影作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 gung1 zyu1 tung4 hou3, jat1 cai4 fan1 hoeng2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sip3 ying2 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在网上分享，一起分享我们的摄影作品。
examples.english_sentence: We share online, sharing our photography works together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將佢嘅珍藏郵票公諸同好，喺博物館搞咗個展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 zan1 cong4 jau4 piu3 gung1 zyu1 tung4 hou3, hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 gaau2 zo2 go3 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将他的珍藏邮票公开与有共同爱好的人分享，在博物馆举办了一个展览。
examples.english_sentence: He shared his treasured stamps with like-minded people and held an exhibition in the museum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅老闆好慷慨，將佢嘅獨家秘方公諸同好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hong2 koi3, zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 duk6 gaa1 bei3 fong1 gung1 zyu1 tung4 hou3.

examples.english_sentence: The owner of this restaurant is very generous and shared his exclusive secret recipe.

mandarin_meaning: 公之于众; 公布于世

explanation_english: To reveal information or a matter to the general public; to make something known to the world.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定将这件事公之于众，让大家知道真相。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to make the matter public so that everyone would know the truth.

examples.english_sentence: This report will be released to the public at tomorrow's press conference.

english_meaning: notarization, notarize
explanation_mandarin: 法律上指由公证机关证明法律行为、有法律意义的事实和文书的真实性和合法性。
explanation_english: To notarize; notarization. The legal act of authenticating a document by a notary public.

examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the law firm to notarize a document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約需要經過公證先至生效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 seoi1 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 gung1 zing3 sin1 zi3 sang1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同需要经过公证才能生效。
examples.english_sentence: This contract needs to be notarized before it becomes effective.

english_meaning: Notary Public office; Notarization office
explanation_mandarin: 办理公证事务的机构。
explanation_english: An organization that handles notarization services, verifying documents and signatures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要去公證行搞份樓契嘅公證。

examples.english_sentence: I need to go to a Notary Public office to notarize a property deed.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 wan2 gaan1 seon3 jyu6 hou2 ge3 gung1 zing3 hong4 bong1 nei5 gaau2 ji4 man4 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好找一家信誉好的公证行帮你办理移民文件。
examples.english_sentence: You should find a reputable Notary Public office to help you with your immigration documents.

english_meaning: at public expense; publicly funded; government-funded
explanation_mandarin: 指由公共财政支付的费用。
explanation_english: Refers to expenses paid for by public funds or at government expense.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个研究项目是公费资助的。
examples.english_sentence: This research project is funded by public money.

english_meaning: highway, road
explanation_mandarin: 连接城市或地区之间的宽阔、平坦的道路，通常用于长途交通。
explanation_english: A wide, paved road connecting cities or regions, typically used for long-distance travel.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条公路很堵车，可能要迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: The highway is very congested, we might be late.

english_meaning: revolution (astronomy)
explanation_mandarin: 天文学术语，指一个天体绕另一个天体作周期性运动，例如地球绕太阳公转。
explanation_english: In astronomy, the orbital movement of one celestial body around another, for example, the Earth's revolution around the Sun.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习更多关于行星公转的知识。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn more about the revolution of planets.

english_meaning: fair; just; reasonable; impartial

explanation_english: Describes something that is fair, just, and reasonable, conforming to the principles of impartiality.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 pun3 gyut3 dou1 syun3 gung1 dou6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細對我哋都好公道，有升職機會一定會考慮我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 dou1 hou2 gung1 dou6, jau5 sing1 jik1 gei1 wui5 jat1 ding6 wui5 hau2 leoi6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板对我们都很公正，有升职机会一定会考虑我们。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is fair to us; he will definitely consider us when there are promotion opportunities.

english_meaning: Fair person, arbitrator, mediator
explanation_mandarin: 指为人公正，能主持公道，调解纠纷的人。通常是德高望重的长者或有威望的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is fair, can uphold justice, and mediate disputes. Usually an elder or a person with prestige who is respected.

examples.english_sentence: It's right to find him as the mediator, he is the fairest person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁複雜，都係搵個公道伯嚟傾掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, dou1 hai6 wan2 go3 gung1 dou6 baak3 lai4 king1 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么复杂，还是找个公正人士来谈妥它吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated, let's find a fair person to settle it.

english_meaning: Fairness cup; Justice cup; a cup that spills if filled too much
explanation_mandarin: 一种特殊的杯子，如果倒入的液体超过某个限制，杯子里的液体就会全部漏掉，寓意适可而止，公平公正。
explanation_english: A special kind of cup that empties completely if the liquid poured into it exceeds a certain limit. It symbolizes moderation and fairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個就係公道杯，倒得太多會漏哂出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 gung1 dou6 bui1, dou3 dak1 taai3 do1 wui5 lau6 saai3 chut1 lai4 gaa3.

examples.english_sentence: This is a fairness cup, if you pour in too much, it will all spill out.

jyutping: gung1 dou6 zi6 zoi6 jan4 sam1
english_meaning: Justice resides in people's hearts; public opinion is the best judge.
explanation_mandarin: 指公正的评价存在于人们的心中，群众的眼睛是雪亮的。
explanation_english: This idiom means that true justice and fairness are reflected in the hearts and minds of the people. It implies that public opinion is a reliable indicator of what is right and wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅真相，公道自在人心，唔使我哋多講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2, gung1 dou6 zi6 zoi6 jan4 sam1, m4 sai2 ngo5 dei6 do1 gong2 laa1.

english_meaning: kilometer
explanation_mandarin: 公制长度单位，一公里等于一千米。
explanation_english: A unit of length in the metric system, equal to one thousand meters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個公園嘅跑步徑有三公里咁長。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天骑自行车骑五公里。
examples.english_sentence: I cycle five kilometers every day.

english_meaning: public; open; to make public; to announce publicly

examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府公开招标，邀请各界参与。
examples.english_sentence: The government issued a public tender, inviting participation from all sectors.

english_meaning: Open letter
explanation_mandarin: 指不直接寄给收信人，而是公开给公众阅读的信件，通常在报纸、杂志或网上发表。
explanation_english: A letter intended for wide circulation and public reading, often published in newspapers, magazines, or online.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 tai2 dou2 go2 fung1 gung1 hoi1 seon3, hei2 jan5 zo2 ho2 do1 to2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人在网上看到了那封公开信，引起了很多讨论。
examples.english_sentence: Many people saw that open letter online, which sparked a lot of discussion.

mandarin_meaning: 公开处刑; 公开示众
english_meaning: Public execution; public shaming; being publicly humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 指在公开场合进行处刑，引申指在公众面前被羞辱，颜面尽失。
explanation_english: Literally means 'public execution'. Figuratively refers to being publicly shamed or humiliated, losing face in front of others. Often used when someone is caught doing something embarrassing or wrong and is exposed publicly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺網上俾人公開處刑，因為佢講大話俾人踢爆咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 bei2 jan4 gung1 hoi1 cyu2 ying4, yan1 wai6 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在网上被公开处刑，因为他撒谎被揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He was publicly shamed online because his lie was exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細喺會議上面公開處刑個員工，真係好冇面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 gung1 hoi1 cyu2 ying4 go3 yun4 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板在会议上公开处刑那个员工，真的很没面子。
examples.english_sentence: The boss publicly shamed the employee in the meeting, it was really humiliating.

english_meaning: Public execution
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共场所执行死刑，以示警戒。
explanation_english: Refers to the execution of a death sentence in a public place, usually as a deterrent or to make an example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代好多國家都有公開處決嘅制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 gung1 hoi1 cyu2 kyut3 ge3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代很多国家都有公开处决的制度。
examples.english_sentence: Many countries in ancient times had the system of public execution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被判死刑，而且係公開處決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 pun3 si2 ying4, yi4 ce2 hai6 gung1 hoi1 cyu2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被判处死刑，而且是公开处决。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to death, and it was a public execution.

english_meaning: Public examination, standardized test
explanation_mandarin: 指由官方或大型机构组织的、具有一定规模和影响力的考试，例如香港的中学文凭考试（DSE）。
explanation_english: Refers to a standardized test or public examination organized by official or large institutions, carrying significant weight and influence, such as the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination (DSE).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚟緊要考公開試，壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai4 gan2 jiu3 haau2 gung1 hoi1 si5, aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接下来要考公开考试，压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: He has a public examination coming up, he's under a lot of pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考公開試嘅成績對升大學好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gung1 hoi1 si5 ge3 sing4 jik1 deoi3 sing1 daai6 hok6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考公开考试的成绩对上大学很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The results of the public examination are very important for entering university.

english_meaning: Public Relations (PR)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个组织机构为改善与社会公众的关系、促进公众对其认识和理解，而采取的各种宣传和沟通活动。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice of managing and disseminating information from an individual or organization to the public in order to affect their perception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間大公司度做公關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 dou6 zou6 gung1 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家大公司做公关。
examples.english_sentence: He works in public relations at a big company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅公關做得唔好，搞到好多人鬧佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gung1 gwaan1 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 naau6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的公关做得不好，导致很多人批评他们。
examples.english_sentence: The company's PR is not good, leading many people to criticize them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做好公關可以提升公司嘅形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hou2 gung1 gwaan1 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 gung1 si1 ge3 hing3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做好公关可以提升公司的形象。
examples.english_sentence: Good public relations can enhance the company's image.

english_meaning: Public Relations Disaster, PR disaster
explanation_mandarin: 指在公关活动或事件中，由于处理不当或其他原因，导致公众形象受损、信任度下降的严重情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a serious situation in public relations activities or events where mishandling or other factors lead to damage to public image and a decline in trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司處理今次事件嘅手法簡直係公關災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 cyu5 lei5 gam1 ci3 si6 gin2 ge3 sau2 faat3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 gung1 gwaan1 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司处理这次事件的方式简直是公关灾难。
examples.english_sentence: The way their company handled this incident is simply a PR disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細嘅失言導致咗一場公關災難，公司形象一落千丈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ge3 sat1 jin4 dou6 zi3 zo2 jat1 coeng4 gung1 gwaan1 zoi1 naan6, gung1 si1 jing2 zoeng6 jat1 lok6 cin1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板的失言导致了一场公关灾难，公司形象一落千丈。
examples.english_sentence: The boss's gaffe led to a PR disaster, and the company's image plummeted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗避免公關災難，我哋要小心謹慎噉處理任何嘅負面新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bei6 min5 gung1 gwaan1 zoi1 naan6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gan2 san6 gam2 cyu5 lei5 jam6 ho4 ge3 fu6 min6 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了避免公关灾难，我们要小心谨慎地处理任何的负面新闻。
examples.english_sentence: In order to avoid a PR disaster, we need to carefully and cautiously handle any negative news.

synonyms: 形象危機 (jing2 zoeng6 ngai4 gei1)

english_meaning: Public hospital
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府资助和管理的医院，提供医疗服务给大众。
explanation_english: Refers to a hospital that is funded and managed by the government, providing medical services to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發燒發到好犀利，所以屋企人即刻送咗佢去公院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 siu1 faat3 dou3 hou2 sai1 lei6, so2 ji5 uk1 kei2 jan4 zik1 hak1 sung3 zo2 keoi5 heoi3 gung1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发烧得很厉害，所以家人立刻送他去了公立医院。
examples.english_sentence: He had a very high fever, so his family immediately sent him to a public hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公院啲醫生護士真係好辛苦，成日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun2 di1 yi1 sang1 wu6 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公立医院的医生护士真的很辛苦，经常都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: The doctors and nurses in public hospitals are really hardworking, they often have to work overtime.

english_meaning: rooster
explanation_mandarin: 雄性的鸡。
explanation_english: A male chicken, rooster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早聽到隻公雞啼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 teng1 dou2 zek3 gung1 gai1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上听到一只公鸡啼叫。
examples.english_sentence: I heard a rooster crowing in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻公雞好惡，成日啄人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 gung1 gai1 hou2 ok3, seng4 jat6 doek3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只公鸡很凶，总是啄人。
examples.english_sentence: That rooster is very aggressive and pecks people all the time.

english_meaning: hectare
explanation_mandarin: 面积单位，等于一万平方米。
explanation_english: A unit of area equal to 10,000 square meters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個農場大約有五十公頃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 nung4 coeng4 daai6 joek3 jau5 ng5 sap6 gung1 king2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个农场大约有五十公顷。
examples.english_sentence: That farm is about fifty hectares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃將五十公頃土地改造成公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 zoeng1 ng5 sap6 gung1 king2 tou2 dei6 goi2 zou6 sing4 gung1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划将五十公顷土地改造成公园。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to convert fifty hectares of land into a park.

english_meaning: Beginning, start, initiation; to take the lead, to initiate
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的开端、开头，或者带头做某事的人。也可以指工程、计划等的初期阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the beginning or start of something; someone who takes the lead or initiates something. Can also refer to the initial stages of a project or plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅公頭好重要，如果開始做得唔好，之後就好難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 gung1 tau4 hou2 zung6 jiu3, jyu4 gwo2 hoi1 chi2 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2, ji1 hau6 jau6 hou2 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的开头很重要，如果开始做得不好，之后就很难搞。
examples.english_sentence: The beginning of this project is very important. If it doesn't start well, it will be difficult to manage later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係公頭做嘢嘅，好有責任心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gung1 tau4 zou6 je5 ge3, hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是带头做事的，很有责任心。
examples.english_sentence: He always takes the lead in doing things, he is very responsible.

english_meaning: leisure time after work; after hours; spare time (after work)
explanation_mandarin: 工作结束后的空闲时间。
explanation_english: Time free from work or official duties; leisure time after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我公餘嘅時候鍾意睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gung1 jyu4 ge3 si4 hau6 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我工作之余喜欢看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I like to watch movies in my spare time after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公餘都會做義工，好有愛心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 jyu4 dou1 wui5 zou6 ji6 gung1, hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作之余都会做义工，很有爱心。
examples.english_sentence: He does volunteer work in his spare time after work, he is very caring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公餘時間，我哋可以一齊去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyu4 si4 gaan3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作之余，我们可以一起去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: In our leisure time after work, we can go hiking together.

english_meaning: Recreational venue after work/school; place for leisure activities
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或学习之余，人们可以进行娱乐、休闲活动的场所。
explanation_english: Refers to a place where people can engage in entertainment and leisure activities after work or school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，我哋成日去公餘場打波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gung1 jyu4 coeng4 daa2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我们经常去业余活动场所打球。
examples.english_sentence: After work, we often go to the recreational venue to play ball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公餘場設備好完善，好多人鍾意嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 jyu4 coeng4 sat1 bei6 hou2 jyun4 sin6, hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家业余活动场所设施很完善，很多人喜欢来。
examples.english_sentence: This recreational venue has very complete facilities, and many people like to come.

mandarin_meaning: 公馆; 大楼; 洋房
english_meaning: Mansion; villa; consulate; residence (of a government official or wealthy person)
explanation_mandarin: （1）指官署或富人住所。亦指外国在某国设立的领事机构。（2）台湾指台北捷运公馆站附近一带的地区名。
explanation_english: (1) Refers to the residence of a government official or a wealthy person; also refers to the consular office established by a foreign country in another country. (2) In Taiwan, it refers to the area near Gongguan Station on the Taipei Metro.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公館勁豪華㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 gun2 ging6 hou4 waa4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公馆非常豪华。
examples.english_sentence: His mansion is extremely luxurious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺公館嗰頭食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gung1 gun2 go2 tau4 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去公馆那边吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have dinner around Gongguan (in Taiwan).

english_meaning: rooster, cock
explanation_mandarin: 雄性的鸡。
explanation_english: A male chicken; rooster; cock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企養咗好多公鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei1 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家养了很多公鸡。
examples.english_sentence: We keep a lot of roosters at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝朝早我都聽到公鷄啼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 ziu1 zou2 ngo5 dou1 teng1 dou2 gung1 gai1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天早上我都能听到公鸡打鸣。
examples.english_sentence: Every morning I hear the rooster crow.

english_meaning: six
explanation_mandarin: 数字六。在粤语口语中，也常与其他字结合使用，例如表示顺利的“六六大顺”。
explanation_english: The number six. In Cantonese colloquial speech, it is often used in combination with other characters, such as "luk6 luk6 daai6 seon6" which means everything goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年六歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 luk6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年六岁。
examples.english_sentence: I am six years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞咗六十分，啱啱合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 lo2 zo2 luk6 sap6 fan1, ngaam1 ngaam1 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了六十分，刚好及格。
examples.english_sentence: He got sixty marks in the exam, just passing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你六六大順，事事順利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 luk6 luk6 daai6 seon6, si6 si6 seon6 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你六六大顺，事事顺利！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you all the best, everything goes smoothly!

english_meaning: to cheat at gambling; to swindle
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博中作弊，使用不正当的手段来欺骗对方，从而赢得赌局。也引申为欺骗、诈骗。
explanation_english: Refers to cheating in gambling, using dishonest means to deceive the opponent and win the game. It also extends to mean cheating and defrauding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺麻雀枱度六九，抵佢冇朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 maa4 zoek3 toi2 dou6 luk6 gau2, dai2 keoi5 mou5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在麻将桌上作弊，活该他没朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always cheats at the mahjong table, no wonder he has no friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住六九我呀，我睇穿曬你嘅把戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 luk6 gau2 ngo5 aa3, ngo5 tai2 cyun1 saai3 nei5 ge3 baa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想骗我，我看穿了你的伎俩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about swindling me, I see through your tricks.

english_meaning: Mark Six Lottery
explanation_mandarin: 香港一种由香港赛马会发行的彩票游戏。参加者从1至49个号码中选择六个号码，如果与开奖号码相符，即可获得不同等级的奖金。
explanation_english: A lottery game operated by the Hong Kong Jockey Club. Participants select six numbers from 1 to 49. Prizes are awarded to those who match the winning numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都會買六合彩，希望有日會中頭獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 wui5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2, hei1 mong6 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 zung3 tau4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个星期都会买六合彩，希望有一天会中头奖。
examples.english_sentence: I buy Mark Six every week, hoping to win the first prize someday.

english_meaning: June Fourth Incident, Tiananmen Square Massacre
explanation_mandarin: 指1989年6月4日发生在北京天安门广场的事件，中国政府对学生和市民的示威活动进行武力镇压。
explanation_english: Refers to the events that took place on June 4, 1989, in Tiananmen Square in Beijing, where the Chinese government used military force to suppress demonstrations by students and citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港每年都會有人搞遊行悼念六四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 jau5 jan4 gaau2 jau4 hang4 dou6 nim6 luk6 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港每年都会有人组织游行来悼念六四。
examples.english_sentence: Every year in Hong Kong, people organize marches to commemorate the June Fourth Incident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 六四係一段好慘痛嘅歷史。
