examples.jyutping_sentence: luk6 sei3 hai6 jat1 dyun6 hou2 caam2 tung3 ge3 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 六四是一段很惨痛的历史。
examples.english_sentence: June Fourth is a very tragic part of history.

english_meaning: A chaotic situation with everyone vying for power and position; a free-for-all; political infighting.
explanation_mandarin: 源于古代戏曲。指秦始皇统一六国后，对六国贵族进行分封，但实际上各怀鬼胎，互相争斗，局面混乱。比喻各方势力为争夺利益而相互争斗，局面混乱不堪。
explanation_english: Originates from traditional Chinese opera. It refers to the chaotic situation after the Qin Dynasty unified the six warring states, where the nobles of the former states were nominally enfeoffed but in reality, were plotting and fighting amongst themselves. It is used to describe a situation where various factions are competing for power and benefits, resulting in chaos and disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司重組之後，啲高層好似六國大封相咁，個個都想爭上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cung4 zou2 zi1 hau6, di1 gou1 cang4 hou2 ci5 luk6 gwok3 daai6 fung1 soeng3 gam2, go3 go3 dou1 soeng2 zaang1 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司重组之后，那些高层就像六国大封相一样，每个人都想争夺更高的位置。
examples.english_sentence: After the company's restructuring, the senior management is like a "luk gwok daai fung soeng" situation, with everyone trying to climb the corporate ladder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉結果出咗之後，各黨派開始咗六國大封相，傾緊點樣分位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2 ceot1 zo2 zi1 hau6, gok3 dong2 paai3 hoi1 ci2 zo2 luk6 gwok3 daai6 fung1 soeng3, king1 gan2 dim2 joeng2 fan1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举结果出来后，各党派开始了六国大封相，正在商量如何分配职位。
examples.english_sentence: After the election results were released, the various political parties started a "luk gwok daai fung soeng", discussing how to allocate positions.

synonyms: 爭權奪利 (zaang1 kuen4 dyut6 lei6)
烏煙瘴氣 (wu1 jin1 zoeng3 hei3)

english_meaning: Divination; fortune-telling; specifically refers to a method of divination using the sexagenary cycle and Five Elements
explanation_mandarin: 六壬是中国传统术数之一，是一种古代占卜术，利用天干地支、五行等原理进行推算，以预测吉凶祸福。
explanation_english: Liu Ren (六壬) is a traditional Chinese divination method. It's an ancient art of divination that uses the sexagenary cycle, Five Elements (Wu Xing), and other principles to calculate and predict good fortune, misfortune, and other events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢識得啲六壬嘢，好鬼準㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 sik1 dak1 di1 luk6 jam4 je5, hou2 gwai2 zeon2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他懂一些六壬的，非常准的！
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he knows some Liu Ren divination; it's very accurate!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信唔信六壬嗰啲嘢㗎？我覺得好玄喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 m4 seon3 luk6 jam4 go2 di1 je5 gaa3? ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hyun4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信六壬那些东西吗？我觉得很神秘啊。
examples.english_sentence: Do you believe in that Liu Ren stuff? I think it's very mysterious.

english_meaning: Six Categories of Chinese Characters
explanation_mandarin: 指汉字构造的六种方法。分别为象形、指事、会意、形声、转注、假借。
explanation_english: Refers to the six categories of Chinese character formation: Pictographs, Ideographs, Associative Compounds, Phono-Semantic Compounds, Derivative Cognates, and Borrowed Characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學中文要了解六書嘅原理，先可以更好地理解每個字嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zung1 man4 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 luk6 syu1 ge3 jyun4 lei5, sin1 ho2 ji5 gang3 hou2 dei6 lei5 gaai2 mui5 go3 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习中文要了解六书的原理，才可以更好地理解每个字的意思。
examples.english_sentence: To learn Chinese, you need to understand the principles of the Six Categories of Characters to better understand the meaning of each character.

english_meaning: June
explanation_mandarin: 阳历的第六个月份。
explanation_english: The sixth month of the Gregorian calendar, June.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋六月畢業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 luk6 jyut6 bat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们六月毕业。
examples.english_sentence: We graduate in June.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年六月天氣好熱啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 luk6 jyut6 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年六月天气真热啊！
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so hot this June!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 六月嘅香港真係好焗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: luk6 jyut6 ge3 Hoeng1 Gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 六月的香港真的很闷热。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong in June is really humid and stuffy.

english_meaning: Snow falling in June; an unjust grievance; a gross injustice.
explanation_mandarin: 农历六月不可能下霜。比喻有冤狱，比喻极其冤屈，也用来形容极不寻常的事。
explanation_english: Literally, snow falling in June, an impossible occurrence. It is used as a metaphor for a great injustice or grievance, suggesting that something fundamentally wrong has happened. It also describes extraordinary and unusual events, usually with negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人誣告，坐咗十年冤獄，真係六月飛霜呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 mou1 gou3, co5 zo2 sap6 nin4 jyun1 juk6, zan1 hai6 luk6 jyut6 fei1 soeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬告，坐了十年冤狱，真是六月飞霜啊！
examples.english_sentence: He was falsely accused and spent ten years in prison. It's a real injustice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣嘅判決，根本就係六月飛霜，完全冇公義可言！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 ge3 pun3 kyut3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 luk6 jyut6 fei1 soeng1, wun4 cyun4 mou5 gung1 ji6 ho2 jin4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样的判决，根本就是六月飞霜，完全没有公义可言！
examples.english_sentence: Such a verdict is a complete miscarriage of justice; there is no justice at all!

english_meaning: Free from worldly desires; pure of heart; to have a clear conscience
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，指眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意六种感觉器官摆脱尘世的欲望和烦恼，达到清净无为的境界。也用来形容人没有私心杂念，思想纯洁。
explanation_english: Buddhist term referring to being free from the six roots of perception (eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind) and thus free from worldly desires and afflictions, reaching a state of purity and non-action. It is also used to describe someone who has no selfish or ulterior motives and whose thoughts are pure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗職之後，去咗廟度住，話想六根清淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, heoi3 zo2 miu2 dou6 zyu6, waa6 soeng2 luk6 gan1 cing1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后，去了庙里住，说想六根清净。
examples.english_sentence: After quitting his job, he went to live in a temple, saying he wanted to be free from worldly desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係想放鬆吓，六根清淨咁過幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 fong3 sung1 haa5, luk6 gan1 cing1 zing6 gam2 gwo3 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想放松一下，清心寡欲地过几天。
examples.english_sentence: I just want to relax and spend a few days free from worldly desires.

english_meaning: Six Win Bonus (a type of horse racing bet)
explanation_mandarin: 香港赛马会的一种投注方式，需连续猜中指定六场赛事的冠军马匹。奖金通常非常高，但中奖概率极低。
explanation_english: A type of horse racing bet offered by the Hong Kong Jockey Club. It requires correctly predicting the winning horse in six designated races consecutively. The payout is typically very high, but the odds of winning are extremely low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日買六環彩，但係次次都輸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 maai5 luk6 waan4 coi2, daan6 hai6 ci3 ci3 dou1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是买六环彩，但是每次都输。
examples.english_sentence: He always buys Six Win Bonus, but he loses every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中六環彩嘅機會好渺茫，唔好抱太大期望啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 luk6 waan4 coi2 ge3 gei1 wui2 hou2 miu5 mong4, m4 hou2 pou5 taai3 daai6 kei3 mong6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中六环彩的机会很渺茫，不要抱太大期望啦。
examples.english_sentence: The chances of winning Six Win Bonus are very slim, don't have too high expectations.

mandarin_meaning: 六神无主 (liù shén wú zhǔ)
english_meaning: at one's wit's end; beside oneself; completely disoriented and helpless
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常惊慌害怕，以至于心神不定，不知如何是好。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme panic or fear, resulting in disorientation and a loss of control over one's senses and actions. The 'six gods' refers to the gods believed to govern various aspects of a person's life in traditional Chinese belief, and being 'without a master' signifies a complete loss of composure and direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考完試知道自己肥佬，即刻六神無主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 fei4 lou2, zik1 hak1 luk6 san4 mou4 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考完试知道自己不及格，立刻六神无主。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, when he found out he failed, he was immediately at his wit's end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到阿婆過身嘅消息，佢成個人六神無主咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 aa3 po4 gwo3 san1 ge3 siu1 sik1, keoi5 sing4 go3 jan4 luk6 san4 mou4 zyu2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到奶奶去世的消息，他整个人六神无主似的。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his grandmother's passing, he was completely beside himself.

mandarin_meaning: 人多嘴雜，難以保守秘密
english_meaning: Too many people involved, secrets are hard to keep; Loose lips sink ships
explanation_mandarin: 形容參與討論的人太多，容易洩漏秘密或計劃。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where too many people are involved in a discussion, making it difficult to keep secrets or plans confidential. It implies that the more people who know something, the higher the chance of it being revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁機密，唔好俾咁多人知，六耳不同謀呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 gei1 mat6, m4 hou2 bei2 gam3 do1 jan4 zi1, luk6 ji5 bat1 tung4 mau4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么机密，不要让太多人知道，人多嘴杂。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so confidential, don't let too many people know, loose lips sink ships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅計劃要小心啲，六耳不同謀，唔好咁快同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, luk6 ji5 bat1 tung4 mau4, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划要小心点，人多嘴杂，不要这么快跟人说。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be careful with our plan, secrets are hard to keep with too many people involved, don't tell others so soon.

english_meaning: Six Arts (in ancient China: rites, music, archery, charioteering, calligraphy, and arithmetic)
explanation_mandarin: 古代中国贵族教育的六项基本技能，包括礼（礼节）、乐（音乐）、射（射箭）、御（驾车）、书（书法）、数（算术）。
explanation_english: The Six Arts were a set of core subjects taught to aristocratic students in ancient China. They included Rites (禮), Music (樂), Archery (射), Charioteering (御), Calligraphy (書), and Arithmetic (數).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅貴族要識哂六藝㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi5 cin4 ge3 gwai3 zuk6 yiu3 sik1晒 luk6 ngai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的贵族都要会六艺的。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, nobles were required to master all Six Arts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對六藝嘅認識唔係好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 luk6 ngai6 ge3 ying6 sik1 m4 hai6 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对六艺的认识不是很深。
examples.english_sentence: My understanding of the Six Arts is not very deep.

mandarin_meaning: 不认亲人；形容人不讲情义，翻脸不认人
english_meaning: Disowning one's relatives; to be so obsessed (with something) that one ignores or abandons one's family; to betray one's family
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常自私自利，为了达到自己的目的，连亲人都不顾。指为了某种利益或目标，完全不顾及亲情或道义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely selfish and only cares about achieving their own goals, even to the point of neglecting or betraying their family. It implies a complete disregard for familial bonds or moral principles in pursuit of personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到六親不認，連阿媽都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 luk6 can1 bat1 jing6, lin4 aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌到六亲不认，连妈妈都不理。
examples.english_sentence: He's so addicted to gambling that he disowns his relatives, he doesn't even care about his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗上位，佢可以六親不認，乜嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 soeng5 wai2, keoi5 ho2 ji5 luk6 can1 bat1 jing6, mat1 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了上位，他可以六亲不认，什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: To get promoted, he can betray his family, he's capable of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢發咗達之後，就變得六親不認，好少同屋企人聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6, zau6 bin3 dak1 luk6 can1 bat1 jing6, hou2 siu2 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他发了财之后，就变得六亲不认，很少和家里人联络。
examples.english_sentence: Since he became rich, he has become estranged from his family and rarely contacts them.

mandarin_meaning: 内六角扳手; 六角扳手
english_meaning: Hex key; Allen wrench
explanation_mandarin: 一种头部为内六角形的扳手，用于拧紧或松开内六角螺钉。
explanation_english: A tool with a hexagonal cross-section used to drive bolts and screws that have a hexagonal socket in the head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我攞支六角匙嚟，我想擰實啲螺絲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 lo2 zi1 luk6 gok3 ci4 lai4, ngo5 soeng2 ning1 sat6 di1 lo4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我拿个内六角扳手来，我想把螺丝拧紧。
examples.english_sentence: Hand me an Allen wrench, I want to tighten the screws.

english_meaning: hexagon
explanation_mandarin: 一种有六条边和六个角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A polygon with six sides and six angles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個蜂巢啲窿係六角形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 fung1 caau4 di1 lung1 hai6 luk6 gok3 jing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蜂巢的孔是六边形的。
examples.english_sentence: The cells in the honeycomb are hexagonal.

english_meaning: The Six Realms of Rebirth, samsara
explanation_mandarin: 佛教术语，指众生轮回转世的六个去处，包括天道、人道、阿修罗道、畜生道、饿鬼道、地狱道。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term referring to the six realms of rebirth in samsara: the realms of gods (devas), humans, asuras (demigods), animals, hungry ghosts (pretas), and hell beings. It signifies the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth influenced by karma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋信人生死之後會進入六道輪迴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seon3 jan4 sang1 sei2 zi1 hau6 wui5 zeon3 jap6 luk6 dou6 leon4 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们相信人死后会进入六道轮回。
examples.english_sentence: They believe that after death, people enter the Six Realms of Rebirth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做好事積功德，希望下世可以脫離六道輪迴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hou2 si6 zik1 gung1 dak1, hei1 mong6 haa6 sai3 ho2 ji5 tyut3 lei4 luk6 dou6 leon4 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做好事积累功德，希望下辈子可以脱离六道轮回。
examples.english_sentence: Do good deeds to accumulate merit, hoping to escape the Six Realms of Rebirth in the next life.

english_meaning: Exclamatory particle; used at the end of a sentence to express a feeling or emotion.
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，用于句末，表示感叹、疑问等语气。常见于比较口语化的表达中。
explanation_english: An exclamatory particle used at the end of a sentence to express a feeling or emotion. Commonly used in colloquial expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咩兮？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 me1 hai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞什么啊？/ 怎么回事？
examples.english_sentence: What's going on?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做乜咁鬼嘈兮？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 mat1 gam3 gwai2 cou4 hai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 干嘛这么吵啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so noisy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜咁愁眉苦臉兮？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 gam3 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5 hai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么愁眉苦脸的？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you looking so gloomy?

english_meaning: together, common, to share
explanation_mandarin: 表示一起，共同，或者分享。
explanation_english: Indicates being together, commonality, or sharing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共進晚餐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung6 zeon3 maan5 caan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起吃晚饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们的共识。
examples.english_sentence: This is our consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 共用呢個洗手間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung6 yung6 ni1 go3 sai2 sau2 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 共用这个洗手间。
examples.english_sentence: Share this restroom.

english_meaning: to work together, to collaborate
explanation_mandarin: 一起工作，共同处理事务。
explanation_english: To work together, to collaborate or handle affairs together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共事咗五年，好有默契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung6 si6 zo2 ng5 nin4, hou2 jau5 mak6 kai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们共事了五年，很有默契。
examples.english_sentence: We have worked together for five years and have a great understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個唔啱傾，好難共事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 m4 ngaam1 king1, hou2 naan4 gung6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人合不来，很难共事。
examples.english_sentence: Those two don't get along, it's hard for them to work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好期待同你共事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 tung4 nei5 gung6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很期待和你共事。
examples.english_sentence: I am really looking forward to working with you.

english_meaning: to share, to enjoy together, sharing (economy)
explanation_mandarin: 共同享有；一起分享。近年来也指共享经济模式。
explanation_english: To share; to enjoy together. In recent years, it also refers to the sharing economy model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊共享呢個美好嘅時光啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gung1 hoeng2 ni1 go3 mei5 hou2 ge3 si4 gwong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起共享这美好的时光吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's share this wonderful time together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 共享單車喺香港都幾流行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hoeng2 daan1 ce1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 gei2 lau4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 共享单车在香港也挺流行的。
examples.english_sentence: Bike sharing is quite popular in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: Sharing economy
explanation_mandarin: 一种经济模式，通过互联网平台将闲置资源（如房屋、车辆、技能等）进行有偿共享，提高资源利用率。
explanation_english: An economic model where assets or services are shared between private individuals, either for free or for a fee, typically by means of the Internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家共享經濟好興，好多人都用App租車或者租Airbnb。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gung1 hoeng2 ging1 zai3 hou2 hing1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 yung6 App zo1 ce1 waak6 ze2 zo1 Airbnb.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在共享经济很流行，很多人都用App租车或者租Airbnb。
examples.english_sentence: The sharing economy is very popular now. Many people use apps to rent cars or Airbnb.

english_meaning: to combine or merge into one, to bring together disparate elements into a unified whole, melting pot
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把不同的事物或人才集合在一起，发挥综合效用。
explanation_english: An idiom that metaphorically means to bring together different things or talented people to create a combined or integrated effect. It implies combining diverse elements to achieve a unified or synergistic result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司將唔同領域嘅人才共冶一爐，希望可以創造出新嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 m4 tung4 ling5 wik6 ge3 jan4 coi4 gung6 je5 jat1 lou4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 chong3 zou6 chut1 san1 ge3 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司将不同领域的人才融合在一起，希望可以创造出新的产品。
examples.english_sentence: This company is bringing together talents from different fields, hoping to create new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲將動作、喜劇同愛情元素共冶一爐，好受觀眾歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cheut1 hei3 zoeng1 dung6 zok3, hei2 kek6 tung4 oi3 ching4 jyun4 sou3 gung6 je5 jat1 lou4, hou2 sau6 gun1 zung3 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏将动作、喜剧和爱情元素融合在一起，很受观众欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This movie combines action, comedy, and romance elements, and is very popular with the audience.

english_meaning: to encourage each other; to work together and encourage each other to improve
explanation_mandarin: 共同努力，互相鼓励，使一起进步。
explanation_english: To encourage each other and work together to improve and make progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一齊努力，互相共勉，爭取更好嘅成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 nu5 lik6, wu6 soeng1 gung6 min5, zaang1 ceoi2 gang3 hou2 ge3 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一起努力，互相勉励，争取更好的成绩。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard together and encourage each other to strive for better results.

synonyms: 互相鼓勵 (wu6 soeng1 gu2 lai6)

english_meaning: together, jointly, common, jointly
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个个体或事物一起、共同地做某事，或具有共同的性质或特征。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more individuals or things doing something together, or possessing common characteristics or properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊共同努力完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gung1 tung4 nu5 lik6 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起共同努力完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Let's work together to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有共同嘅興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 gung1 tung4 ge3 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有共同的兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: We have common interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港同深圳共同發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 tung4 sam1 zan3 gung1 tung4 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港和深圳共同发展。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong and Shenzhen are developing together.

english_meaning: to advance or retreat together; to stand or fall together; to share the same fate
explanation_mandarin: 形容一起行动，共进共退，同甘共苦，一致对外。通常指在困难或重要时刻，团结一致，采取共同行动。
explanation_english: Describes acting together, advancing and retreating together, sharing joys and sorrows, and uniting against external forces. It usually refers to uniting and taking joint action in difficult or important moments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋團隊精神就係共同進退，有乜嘢困難都一齊面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tyun4 dui2 zing1 san4 zau6 hai6 gung1 tung4 zeon3 teoi3, jau5 mat1 je5 kwan3 naan4 dou1 jat1 cai4 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们团队精神就是同甘共苦，有什么困难都一起面对。
examples.english_sentence: Our team spirit is to stand or fall together, facing any difficulties together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個艱難時刻，我哋要同公司共同進退。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 gaan1 naan4 si4 hak1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 gung1 si1 gung1 tung4 zeon3 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个艰难时刻，我们要和公司共进退。
examples.english_sentence: In this difficult moment, we must stand or fall together with the company.

english_meaning: community; collective; common entity
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有共同利益、目标或特征的群体或组织。
explanation_english: Refers to a group or organization with shared interests, goals, or characteristics; a community or collective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要建立一個更和諧嘅社會共同體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin3 lap6 jat1 go3 gang3 wo4 haai4 ge3 se5 wui2 gung1 tung4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要建立一个更和谐的社会共同体。
examples.english_sentence: We need to build a more harmonious social community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 全球都係命運共同體，大家應該互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kyun4 kau4 dou1 hai6 ming6 wan6 gung1 tung4 tai2, daai6 gaa1 ying1 goi1 wu6 soeng1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 全球都是命运共同体，大家应该互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: The whole world is a community with a shared future, so we should help each other.

english_meaning: republic
explanation_mandarin: 指国家元首不是世袭的，而是由选举产生的国家形式。
explanation_english: A state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中華人民共和國係一個社會主義國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 waa4 yan4 man4 gung6 wo4 gwok3 hai6 jat1 go3 se5 wui2 zyu2 ji6 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中华人民共和国是一个社会主义国家。
examples.english_sentence: The People's Republic of China is a socialist country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法國都係一個共和國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gwok3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 gung6 wo4 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法国也是一个共和国。
examples.english_sentence: France is also a republic.

english_meaning: Republican Party
explanation_mandarin: 指美国的共和党。
explanation_english: Refers to the Republican Party of the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企人個個都支持共和黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei1 jan4 go3 go3 dou1 zi1 chi4 gung6 wo4 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家人每个人都支持共和党。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone in their family supports the Republican Party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得共和黨嘅政策點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 gung6 wo4 dong2 ge3 zing3 caak3 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得共和党的政策怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think about the Republican Party's policies?

english_meaning: together; jointly; collectively; altogether
explanation_mandarin: 表示一同、一起做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something together or jointly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共埋夾錢買份禮物俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung2 maai4 gaap3 cin2 maai5 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起凑钱买份礼物给他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's pool our money together and buy him a gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋共埋傾掂咗點樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung2 maai4 king1 dim6 zo2 dim2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一起商量好了怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: They discussed and agreed on how to do it together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋共埋將啲嘢搬上去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gung2 maai4 zoeng1 di1 je5 bun1 soeng5 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起把东西搬上去？
examples.english_sentence: How about we move the stuff upstairs together?

english_meaning: coexistence, to coexist
explanation_mandarin: 共同存在；同时存在。
explanation_english: To exist together; coexistence. To exist at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學識點樣同病毒共存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 dim2 yeung2 tung4 bing6 duk6 gung6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学会如何与病毒共存。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn how to coexist with the virus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺一個多元社會，唔同嘅文化應該互相尊重，和平共存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jat1 go3 do1 jyun4 se5 wui2, m4 tung4 ge3 man4 faa3 ying1 goi1 wu6 seung1 zyun1 zung6, wo4 ping4 gung6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一个多元社会，不同的文化应该互相尊重，和平共存。
examples.english_sentence: In a diverse society, different cultures should respect each other and coexist peacefully.

english_meaning: Go to the market together
explanation_mandarin: 一起去市场购买东西。
explanation_english: To go to the market together to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日共市買餸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 gung6 si5 maai5 sung3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天一起去市场买菜吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the market together to buy groceries tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日同啲鄰居共市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 lin4 geoi1 gung6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常和邻居一起去市场。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often goes to the market with her neighbors.

english_meaning: to share joys and sorrows, to go through thick and thin together
explanation_mandarin: 指共同承担困难和不幸，也指共同享受幸福。
explanation_english: To share both good times and bad times; to go through difficulties and hardships together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩兄弟，一向都係共患難嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6, jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hai6 gung6 waan6 naan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两兄弟，一直都是同甘共苦的。
examples.english_sentence: We two brothers have always shared joys and sorrows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經過咁多困難，真係共患難嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, zan1 hai6 gung6 waan6 naan6 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经历了这么多困难，真是同甘共苦的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: They have been through so many difficulties, they are truly friends who have shared joys and sorrows.

english_meaning: resonance
explanation_mandarin: 指物理学上的一种现象，当外力驱动频率接近或等于一个系统的固有频率时，系统振幅显著增大的现象。也比喻情感或意见等方面的一致。
explanation_english: In physics, resonance is the phenomenon of increased amplitude that occurs when the frequency of a periodically applied force is equal or close to the natural frequency of the system on which it acts. Figuratively, it refers to a feeling of agreement or shared emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅諗法有共振，好容易達成共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3 jau5 gung6 zan3, hou2 jung4 ji6 daat6 sing4 gung1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的想法有共振，很容易达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: Our thoughts are in resonance, so it's easy to reach a consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個音樂會嘅低音共振得好勁，搞到我心跳加速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jam1 ngok6 wui2 ge3 dai1 jam1 gung6 zan3 dak1 hou2 ging6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sam1 tiu3 gaak3 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个音乐会的低音共振得很厉害，弄得我心跳加速。
examples.english_sentence: The bass at this concert resonates so strongly that it made my heart race.

english_meaning: at the same time; simultaneously
explanation_mandarin: 表示几件事情在同一时间发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that several things happen at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共時開始做呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung6 si4 hoi1 chi2 zou6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们同时开始做这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We started working on this project at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩架車共時撞埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leong5 gaa3 che1 gung6 si4 zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两辆车同时撞到了一起。
examples.english_sentence: The two cars crashed together at the same time.

english_meaning: To possess jointly; to have in common; jointly owned; shared
explanation_mandarin: 指共同擁有，一起擁有某事物。
explanation_english: Refers to possessing something jointly, or having something in common with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共有呢間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 jau5 ni1 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们共有这间房子。
examples.english_sentence: We own this house jointly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對呢件事有個共有嘅信念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 go3 gung1 jau5 ge3 seon3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对这件事有一个共同的信念。
examples.english_sentence: We have a shared belief about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋嘅共有財產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 jau5 coi4 saan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们的共有财产。
examples.english_sentence: This is our jointly owned property.

english_meaning: co-governance; joint administration; shared governance
explanation_mandarin: 共同治理，即由多方共同参与管理和治理。
explanation_english: Co-governance refers to the joint administration and governance by multiple parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以同政府一齊共治呢個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 tung4 zing3 fu2 yat1 cai4 gung6 zi6 ni1 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以和政府一起共同治理这个城市。
examples.english_sentence: We hope to co-govern this city with the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校提倡學生、老師同埋家長共治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 tai4 coeng3 hok6 sang1, lou5 si1 tung4 maai4 gaa1 zoeng2 gung6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校提倡学生、老师和家长共同管理。
examples.english_sentence: This school advocates for co-governance by students, teachers, and parents.

english_meaning: to overcome difficulties together, to weather the storm together
explanation_mandarin: 一起度过艰难的时期。指共同面对困难，克服挑战。
explanation_english: To overcome a difficult period together; to weather hardships as a group. It implies shared responsibility and mutual support during tough times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，我哋要共渡時艱啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gung6 dou6 si4 gaan1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，我们要共度时艰啊！
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, we need to overcome these difficulties together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望大家可以互相支持，共渡時艱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 wu6 soeng1 zi1 chi4, gung6 dou6 si4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望大家可以互相支持，共度时艰。
examples.english_sentence: Hope everyone can support each other and overcome the difficulties together.

synonyms: 同舟共濟 (tung4 zau1 gung6 zai3)

english_meaning: Communism
explanation_mandarin: 一种政治意识形态和经济理论，主张消灭私有制，建立一个集体所有制和按需分配的社会。
explanation_english: A political ideology and economic theory advocating a classless society in which property is publicly owned and each person works and is paid according to their abilities and needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候受到共產主義嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sau6 dou3 gung2 caan2 zyu2 ji3 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候受到了共产主义的影响。
examples.english_sentence: He was influenced by communism when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 共產主義喺二十世紀對世界政治產生咗巨大嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung2 caan2 zyu2 ji3 hai2 ji6 sap6 sai3 gei2 deoi3 sai3 gaai3 zing3 zi6 chan2 sang1 zo2 geoi6 daai6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 共产主义在二十世纪对世界政治产生了巨大的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Communism had a huge impact on world politics in the 20th century.

english_meaning: Communist Party
explanation_mandarin: 指共产主义政党，特指中国的中国共产党。
explanation_english: Refers to a communist political party, especially the Communist Party of China (CPC).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔都唔鍾意共產黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 gung6 caan2 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人都很不喜欢共产党。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people dislike the Communist Party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前係英國殖民地，唔係行共產黨嗰套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 hai6 ying1 gwok3 zik6 man4 dei6, m4 hai6 hang4 gung6 caan2 dong2 go2 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前是英国殖民地，不是实行共产党那一套。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to be a British colony, it didn't follow the Communist Party's system.

english_meaning: to share, common use
explanation_mandarin: 一起使用，共同使用。
explanation_english: To use something jointly; to share something in common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房係我哋共用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung6 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房间是我们共用的。
examples.english_sentence: This room is shared by us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部打印機係成間公司共用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 daa2 jan3 gei1 hai6 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 gung6 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台打印机是整个公司共用的。
examples.english_sentence: This printer is for common use throughout the whole company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所係公眾共用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 hai6 gung1 zung3 gung6 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所是公众共用的。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is for public use.

english_meaning: to gather together, to reunite
explanation_mandarin: 共同聚集，聚在一起。
explanation_english: To gather together; to reunite; to come together in a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一家人好耐冇共聚喇，不如聽日一齊食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 hou2 noi6 mou5 gung6 zeoi6 laa3, bat1 jyu4 ting1 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一家人很久没有聚在一起了，不如明天一起吃饭？
examples.english_sentence: Our family hasn't gathered together in a long time, how about we eat together tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望今年可以同朋友共聚聖誕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 tung4 pang4 jau5 gung6 zeoi6 sing3 daan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望今年可以和朋友们一起过圣诞节。
examples.english_sentence: Hope to gather with friends for Christmas this year.

english_meaning: to enjoy family happiness; to enjoy the bliss of family reunion
explanation_mandarin: 指一家人团聚在一起，享受家庭的幸福和快乐。
explanation_english: Refers to the joy and happiness experienced when a family is reunited and spends time together, emphasizing the warmth and familial love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋一家人最緊要就係共聚天倫樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 zau6 hai6 gung6 zeoi6 tin1 leon4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们一家人最重要的就是共享天伦之乐。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, the most important thing for our family is to enjoy family happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退休之後，佢就想多啲時間同屋企人共聚天倫樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 soeng2 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 gung6 zeoi6 tin1 leon4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退休之后，他就想多花时间和家人共享天伦之乐。
examples.english_sentence: After retirement, he wants to spend more time with his family to enjoy family happiness.

synonyms: 闔家歡樂 (hap6 gaa1 fun1 lok6)

english_meaning: to coexist, to live together, to get along
explanation_mandarin: 共同相处，一起生活或工作。
explanation_english: To live or work together in harmony; to coexist peacefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學識點樣同唔同嘅人共處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng6 tung4 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 gung6 cyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学会如何与不同的人共处。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn how to coexist with different people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺狹窄嘅環境下，大家要互相體諒，先可以共處得好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 haap6 zaak3 ge3 waan4 ging2 haa6, daai6 ga1 jiu3 wu6 seung1 tai2 loeng6, sin1 ho2 ji5 gung6 cyu2 dak1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在狭窄的环境下，大家要互相体谅，才可以相处得更好。
examples.english_sentence: In a cramped environment, everyone needs to be considerate of each other to get along better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算意見唔同，都要學識和平共處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 ji3 gin3 m4 tung4, dou1 jiu3 hok6 sik1 wo4 ping4 gung6 cyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使意见不同，也要学会和平共处。
examples.english_sentence: Even if we have different opinions, we need to learn to coexist peacefully.

synonyms: 相處融洽 (soeng1 cyu2 jung4 hap3)

english_meaning: inclusion; integration; harmonious coexistence
explanation_mandarin: 指不同背景、文化、群体的人们互相尊重、理解和接纳，共同生活和发展。
explanation_english: Refers to the mutual respect, understanding, and acceptance between people from different backgrounds, cultures, and groups, living and developing together harmoniously. It encompasses the idea of including everyone regardless of their differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要創造一個共融嘅社會，俾唔同嘅人都可以平等參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 chong3 zou6 jat1 go3 gung6 jung4 ge3 se5 wui2, bei2 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 ping4 dang2 chaam1 yu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要创造一个融合的社会，让不同的人都可以平等参与。
examples.english_sentence: We need to create an inclusive society so that people from different backgrounds can participate equally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校應該推動共融教育，照顧唔同學習需要嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jing1 goi1 tui1 dung6 gung6 jung4 gaau3 yuk6, jiu3 gu3 m4 tung4 hok6 zaap6 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校应该推动融合教育，照顾不同学习需要的学生。
examples.english_sentence: Schools should promote inclusive education to cater for students with different learning needs.

english_meaning: to participate together in a charitable act; to jointly contribute to a good cause
explanation_mandarin: 一起参与做好事，贡献力量。
explanation_english: To participate together in a good deed; to contribute one's efforts towards a charitable cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以共襄善舉，幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gung6 soeng1 sin6 geoi2, bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以共同参与善举，帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We hope we can participate together in this charitable act and help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多市民都願意共襄善舉，捐錢俾慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 si5 man4 dou1 jyun6 ji3 gung6 soeng1 sin6 geoi2, gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多市民都愿意共同参与善举，捐钱给慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: Many citizens are willing to participate in this charitable act and donate money to charity organizations.

english_meaning: total, sum up to
explanation_mandarin: 加起来一共有多少；总计。
explanation_english: To calculate the total; to add up to a sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月共計用咗五千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 gung6 gai3 yung6 zo2 ng5 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月总共用了五千块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This month I spent a total of five thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋共計有十個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung6 gai3 jau5 sap6 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们总共有十个人。
examples.english_sentence: There are ten of us in total.

english_meaning: to tie the knot, to get married
explanation_mandarin: 指男女结为夫妻，比喻婚姻的美好和圆满。
explanation_english: Refers to a man and woman getting married, symbolizing a happy and fulfilling marriage. It's a formal and somewhat literary expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗十年拖，終於都共諧連理啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 sap6 nin4 to1, zung1 jyu1 dou1 gung6 haai4 lin4 lei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了十年恋爱，终于喜结连理了。
examples.english_sentence: They dated for ten years and finally tied the knot.

synonyms: 拉埋天窗 (laai1 maai4 tin1 cung1)

english_meaning: consensus, common understanding
explanation_mandarin: 共同的认识或意见。
explanation_english: A general agreement or accord; collective opinion or belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾咗好耐，終於達到共識啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 daat6 dou3 gung1 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈了很久，终于达成共识了。
examples.english_sentence: We talked for a long time and finally reached a consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，首先要喺大家之間建立共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, sau2 sin1 jiu3 hai2 daai6 gaa1 zi1 gaan1 gin3 lap6 gung1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，首先要在大家之间建立共识。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we first need to build a consensus among everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對件事嘅睇法完全唔同，好難有共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4, hou2 naan4 jau5 gung1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对这件事的看法完全不同，很难有共识。
examples.english_sentence: Their views on this matter are completely different, it's hard to reach a consensus.

english_meaning: To share weal and woe; to share a common burden; to pull together in difficult times
explanation_mandarin: 比喻共同承担艰巨的任务或共同经历困苦。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to share a common burden or responsibility, especially in times of difficulty or hardship. It implies working together to overcome challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次公司有危機，大家要共負一軛，一齊努力先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gung1 si1 jau5 ngai4 gei1, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 gung6 fu6 jat1 aak3, jat1 cai4 nu5 lik6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次公司有危机，大家要同舟共济，一起努力才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: The company is facing a crisis this time. Everyone needs to share the burden and work hard together.

mandarin_meaning: 共赴国难 (gòng fù guó nàn)
english_meaning: Share the national crisis; face national calamities together; be willing to sacrifice for the nation
explanation_mandarin: 指共同承担国家危难，愿意为国家牺牲。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to jointly shouldering national crises and being willing to sacrifice for the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺國家有危難嘅時候，我哋要共赴國難，保衛家園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gwok3 gaa1 jau5 ngai4 naan6 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gung6 fu6 gwok3 naan6, bou2 wai6 gaa1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在国家有危难的时候，我们要共赴国难，保卫家园。
examples.english_sentence: When the country is in crisis, we must share the national crisis and defend our homeland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋抱住共赴國難嘅決心，加入咗抗敵嘅隊伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 pou5 zyu6 gung6 fu6 gwok3 naan6 ge3 kyut3 sam1, gaa1 jap6 zo2 kong3 dik6 ge3 deoi6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抱着共赴国难的决心，加入了抗敌的队伍。
examples.english_sentence: They joined the anti-enemy ranks with the determination to share the national crisis.

english_meaning: To engage in sexual intercourse, to make love (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻男女发生性关系。巫山指巫山神女与楚襄王相遇的地方，后引申为男女欢爱之地。是一种比较文雅和含蓄的说法。
explanation_english: A euphemism for engaging in sexual intercourse. It originates from the legend of the goddess of Mount Wu meeting with King Xiang of Chu. Mount Wu metaphorically refers to a place of love and romance between a man and a woman. It's a relatively refined and indirect way of expressing the act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個拍拖冇幾耐就共赴巫山喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 paak3 to1 mou5 gei2 noi6 zau6 gung6 fu6 mou1 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个谈恋爱没多久就发生性关系了。
examples.english_sentence: They engaged in sexual intercourse not long after they started dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔係應該要尊重女性嘅意願，而唔係迫佢同你共赴巫山咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hai6 jing1 goi1 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 neoi5 sing3 ge3 ji3 jyun6, ji4 m4 hai6 bik1 keoi5 tung4 nei5 gung6 fu6 mou1 saan1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该尊重女性的意愿，而不是强迫她和你发生性关系吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shouldn't we respect a woman's wishes, instead of forcing her to have sex with you?

english_meaning: common, shared, in common
explanation_mandarin: 指共同拥有或具备的特征、性质等。
explanation_english: Refers to a characteristic, quality, etc., that is commonly owned or possessed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個課程有好多共通點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 fo3 ching4 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 tung1 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个课程有很多共同点。
examples.english_sentence: These two courses have many points in common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對音樂嘅喜好有好多共通之處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 jam1 ngok6 ge3 hei2 hou3 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 tung1 zi1 chu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对音乐的喜好有很多共通之处。
examples.english_sentence: We have many things in common when it comes to our taste in music.

english_meaning: resonance, sympathetic response
explanation_mandarin: 指一种情感或观点与他人产生共振，彼此产生强烈的认同感。
explanation_english: The quality of evoking a strong emotional or sympathetic response from others; resonance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲引起咗好多觀眾嘅共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 jin5 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 gun1 zung3 ge3 gung2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影引起了很多观众的共鸣。
examples.english_sentence: This movie resonated with a lot of audience members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅遭遇令我好有共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi1 ling6 ngo5 hou2 jau5 gung2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的遭遇让我很有共鸣。
examples.english_sentence: His experience really resonated with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔覺得佢嘅講法有咩共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 gong2 faat3 jau5 me1 gung2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不觉得他的说法有什么共鸣。
examples.english_sentence: I don't feel any resonance with what he's saying.

mandarin_meaning: 关闭, 关门, 关系
english_meaning: to close, to shut, to turn off, to concern, relationship, barrier
explanation_mandarin: 1. 使门、窗等合拢。 2. 停止运作或供应。 3. 牵涉；有关系。4. 关卡；关隘。 5.姓。
explanation_english: 1. To close; to shut (a door, window, etc.). 2. To turn off; to stop operating (a machine, light, etc.). 3. To concern; to involve. 4. A barrier; a checkpoint. 5. (Surname)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 关埋度门佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 maai4 dou6 mun4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把门关上吧。
examples.english_sentence: Close the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 请你关咗个电视佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 gwaan1 zo2 go3 din6 si6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你把电视关掉。
examples.english_sentence: Please turn off the TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事同我无关嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 mou4 gwaan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事和我没有关系。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has nothing to do with me.

english_meaning: happy, excited, interested; to flourish, to prosper
explanation_mandarin: 表示高兴、兴奋或对某事物感兴趣；也表示兴旺、兴盛。
explanation_english: Expresses happiness, excitement, or interest in something; also expresses flourishing or prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我听日去旅行啊，好兴呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 aa3, hou2 hing3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去旅行，好高兴啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, I'm so excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢对呢件事好兴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 hing3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你盘生意越做越兴隆啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 pun4 seng1 ji3 yut6 zou6 yut6 hing1 lung4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你的生意越做越兴旺！
examples.english_sentence: Hope your business will become more and more prosperous!

english_meaning: pursuer; backup option (romantic sense); someone who is used for attention or favors but without reciprocation
explanation_mandarin: 指女性身边对她有好感并积极追求，但关系并未确定，常被当作情感备胎或工具人使用的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who actively pursues a woman romantically but is not in a committed relationship with her. Often used to describe someone who is used for attention, favors, or emotional support without any reciprocation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身邊好多兵，日日氹佢開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 bin1 hou2 do1 bing1, jat6 jat6 tam5 keoi5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她身边有很多追求者，每天哄她开心。
examples.english_sentence: She has many pursuers around her, trying to make her happy every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做人哋嘅兵啦，醒下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 bing1 laa1, sing2 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再做别人的备胎了，清醒一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone else's backup option, wake up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好利用佢哋嘅好意，唔好當人哋係兵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei6 jung6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hou2 ji3, m4 hou2 dong3 jan4 dei6 hai6 bing1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要利用他们的好意，不要把别人当备胎。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take advantage of their kindness, don't treat them like backup options.

mandarin_meaning: 兵不厌诈 (bīng bù yàn zhà)
english_meaning: All warfare is based on deception; deception is permissible in war.
explanation_mandarin: 原指用兵作战可以不择手段欺骗敌人。后泛指为了达到目的，可以使用欺骗的手段。出自《韩非子·难一》。
explanation_english: Originally meaning that any means of deception can be used in warfare to deceive the enemy. It now generally refers to using deceptive means to achieve a goal. Originates from Han Feizi's 'Nan Yi'. Essentially, 'all's fair in love and war'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上面，「兵不厭詐」係好平常嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6 min6, "bing1 bat1 jim3 zaa3" hai6 hou2 ping4 soeng4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，“兵不厌诈”是很平常的事。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, 'all warfare is based on deception' is a very common occurrence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏呢場比賽，佢哋用咗好多花臣，真係兵不厭詐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 jeng4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, keoi5 dei6 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1 san1, zan1 hai6 bing1 bat1 jim3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场比赛，他们用了很多花招，真是兵不厌诈。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win this game, they used a lot of tricks, truly 'all warfare is based on deception'.

english_meaning: Without firing a shot; without bloodshed; bloodless victory
explanation_mandarin: 形容不用一兵一卒或未流血就取得了胜利。比喻不动声色地轻易取得胜利。
explanation_english: Describes achieving victory without fighting or bloodshed. It is a metaphor for easily achieving victory without making a sound or causing a disturbance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅談判技巧好叻，兵不血刃就解決咗個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 taam4 paan3 gei6 haau2 hou2 lek1, bing1 bat1 hyut3 jan6 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的谈判技巧很高超，兵不血刃地就解决了这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: Their negotiation skills were excellent, and they resolved the problem without any bloodshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用佢嘅魅力，兵不血刃咁贏咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 keoi5 ge3 mei6 lik6, bing1 bat1 hyut3 jan6 gam2 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用他的魅力，兵不血刃地赢了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He used his charm to win the competition without any bloodshed.

english_meaning: to divide into two groups; to split up into two groups and proceed in different directions
explanation_mandarin: 指军队分成两支队伍，分别行动。也比喻办事分成两组进行。
explanation_english: Refers to splitting an army into two groups to act separately. Also used figuratively to describe dividing a task into two groups to proceed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兵分兩路，你負責聯絡供應商，我負責見客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bing1 fan1 loeng5 lou6, nei5 fu3 zaak3 lyun4 lok3 gung1 jing3 soeng1, ngo5 fu3 zaak3 gin3 hak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们兵分两路，你负责联系供应商，我负责见客户。
examples.english_sentence: We'll split up into two groups. You're responsible for contacting suppliers, and I'm responsible for meeting with clients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵到佢，我哋兵分兩路咁搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 dou2 keoi5, ngo5 dei6 bing1 fan1 loeng5 lou6 gam2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找到他，我们兵分两路去找。
examples.english_sentence: In order to find him, we split up into two groups to look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗加快進度，決定兵分兩路處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gaai2 faai3 zeon3 dou6, kyut3 ding6 bing1 fan1 loeng5 lou6 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了加快进度，他们决定兵分两路处理。
examples.english_sentence: In order to speed up the progress, they decided to divide the work and proceed in two groups.

english_meaning: military strength; armed forces; troop strength
explanation_mandarin: 指军队的力量，包括人数、装备等。
explanation_english: Refers to the strength of the military, including the number of personnel and equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兵力不足，好難打贏呢場仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bing1 lik6 bat1 zuk1, hou2 naan4 daa2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的兵力不足，很难打赢这场仗。
examples.english_sentence: Our troop strength is insufficient, it's hard to win this battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋調動咗大量兵力去邊境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 diu6 dung6 zo2 daai6 loeng6 bing1 lik6 heoi3 bin1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们调动了大量兵力去边境。
examples.english_sentence: They mobilized a large number of troops to the border.

english_meaning: weapon; arms
explanation_mandarin: 用于战斗或防御的器械。
explanation_english: An instrument used for fighting or defense; a weapon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館收藏咗好多古代兵器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 sau1 cong4 zo2 hou2 do1 gu2 doi6 bing1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家博物馆收藏了很多古代兵器。
examples.english_sentence: This museum has collected many ancient weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個兵器專家，對各種武器都好熟悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 bing1 hei3 zhun1 ga1, deoi3 gok3 zung2 mou5 hei3 dou1 hou2 suk6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位兵器专家，对各种武器都很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: He is a weapons expert and is very familiar with all kinds of weapons.

english_meaning: A large group of pursuers (usually referring to male suitors)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻围绕着某个女性的大批追求者，通常带有贬义色彩，暗示追求者众多且行动统一。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of pursuers surrounding a woman, often with a negative connotation, implying a large number of pursuers acting in a unified manner. It's used figuratively, likening the pursuers to an army.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁靚女，梗係有一大班兵團啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 leng3 neoi5, gang2 hai6 jau5 jat1 daai6 baan1 bing1 tyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么漂亮，肯定有一大群追求者。
examples.english_sentence: She's so beautiful, she definitely has a large group of pursuers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日見到佢身邊圍住一班兵團，真係好誇張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 gin3 dou2 keoi5 san1 bin1 wai4 zyu6 jat1 baan1 bing1 tyun4, zan1 hai6 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经常看到她身边围着一群追求者，真的很夸张。
examples.english_sentence: I always see a group of pursuers surrounding her, it's really exaggerated.

english_meaning: arsenal; arms factory
explanation_mandarin: 指制造武器弹药的工厂，也用于比喻提供某种资源或人才的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a factory that manufactures weapons and ammunition. It's also used metaphorically to describe a place that provides resources or talent for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司根本就係個創意兵工廠，不停咁出新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 go3 chuang3 yi3 bing1 gung1 chong2, bat1 ting4 gam2 chut1 san1 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司简直就是一个创意兵工厂，不停地推出新产品。
examples.english_sentence: This company is practically an innovation arsenal, constantly launching new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋球隊嘅青訓系統好勁，簡直係球星兵工廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kau4 deoi2 ge3 ching1 fan3 hai6 tung2 hou2 ging6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 kau4 sing1 bing1 gung1 chong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们球队的青训系统很厉害，简直就是球星的军工厂。
examples.english_sentence: Their team's youth training system is very strong, it's practically an arsenal of football stars.

english_meaning: military service; conscription
explanation_mandarin: 指公民依照法律规定，必须参加军队服役的义务。
explanation_english: Obligatory military service required of citizens by law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱夠秤，要抽兵役㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 gau3 cing3, jiu3 cau1 bing1 jik6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚满年龄，要抽兵役了。
examples.english_sentence: He just turned the right age and has to be drafted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前唔使服兵役嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 m4 sai2 fuk6 bing1 jik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前不用服兵役的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong didn't used to require military service.

english_meaning: to come to blows; to meet in battle; to resort to arms; armed conflict
explanation_mandarin: 指动用武力，以战争方式解决问题。形容双方关系恶劣，发生冲突。
explanation_english: Refers to resorting to military force to resolve problems, typically through warfare. Describes a situation where the relationship between two parties is extremely poor and results in conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為啲錢嘅問題，差啲兵戎相見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 di1 cin2 ge3 man6 tai4, caa1 di1 bing1 jung4 soeng1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为钱的问题，差点兵戎相见。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them almost came to blows because of money issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔可以和平解決，恐怕最後都係要兵戎相見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 ho2 ji5 wo4 ping4 gaai2 kyut3, hung2 paa3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 bing1 jung4 soeng1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不能和平解决，恐怕最后还是要兵戎相见。
examples.english_sentence: If it cannot be resolved peacefully, I'm afraid that in the end, they will have to resort to arms.

english_meaning: To suffer a crushing defeat; to collapse like a landslide (after a military defeat); to crumble catastrophically.
explanation_mandarin: 形容军队战败后，像山倒塌一样，溃不成军。比喻事情彻底失败，局势无法挽回。
explanation_english: Describes a catastrophic defeat, where an army crumbles and collapses like a landslide. Figuratively, it means a complete failure where the situation is beyond redemption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場波佢哋輸到兵敗如山倒，畀對手炒咗十幾分！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 bo1 keoi5 dei6 syu1 dou3 bing1 baai6 jyu4 saan1 dou2, bei2 deoi3 sau2 caau2 zo2 sap6 gei2 fan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那场比赛他们输得兵败如山倒，被对手狂胜了十几分！
examples.english_sentence: In that game, they suffered a crushing defeat, losing by more than ten points to their opponents!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司管理不善，搞到兵敗如山倒，執咗笠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 bat1 sin6, gaau2 dou3 bing1 baai6 jyu4 saan1 dou2, zap1 zo2 lap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司管理不善，导致兵败如山倒，倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company was poorly managed, leading to a catastrophic collapse, and it went bankrupt.

english_meaning: military strategy; art of war; tactics
explanation_mandarin: 原指军事战略和战术，也比喻做事的方法或策略。
explanation_english: Originally refers to military strategy and tactics. It can also be used metaphorically to refer to methods or strategies for doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好有兵法，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 bing1 faat3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很有策略，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's very strategic in his work, he wins every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅成功，靠嘅就係佢哋嘅兵法運用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1, kaau3 ge3 zau6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bing1 faat3 wan6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的成功，靠的就是他们的兵法运用。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this project relies on their application of strategy.

english_meaning: source of recruits; manpower pool
explanation_mandarin: 指军队招募士兵的来源，也泛指某一行业或团体的人力来源。
explanation_english: Refers to the source of recruits for the military. More broadly, it can refer to the manpower pool for a particular industry or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔唔肯當兵，所以兵源越來越少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 m4 hang2 dong1 bing1, so2 ji5 bing1 jyun4 yut6 lai4 yut6 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人不愿意当兵，所以兵员越来越少。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people are unwilling to serve in the military, so the source of recruits is getting smaller and smaller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: IT行業競爭激烈，各間公司都爭奪緊兵源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: IT hang4 jip6 ging6 zang1 gik1 lit6, gok3 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 zaang1 dyut6 gan2 bing1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: IT行业竞争激烈，各家公司都在争夺人才。
examples.english_sentence: The IT industry is highly competitive, and companies are all competing for talent.

english_meaning: barracks, military camp
explanation_mandarin: 军队驻扎和训练的地方。
explanation_english: A building or set of buildings for lodging soldiers, especially during peacetime; a military camp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺兵營入邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 bing1 jing4 jap6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在兵营里面。
examples.english_sentence: They live inside the barracks.

english_meaning: The enemy forces are at the gates; imminent danger; facing imminent threat or crisis.
explanation_mandarin: 指敌方军队已经到达城墙之下，形容形势非常危急，面临迫在眉睫的威胁或危机。
explanation_english: This idiom literally means "the enemy forces are at the city gates." It describes a situation where an immediate threat or crisis is looming, and one is in imminent danger or facing an impending disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅財政狀況已經兵臨城下，如果再冇新資金注入，好快就會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 zong6 fong3 ji5 ging1 bing1 lam4 sing4 haa6, jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 mou5 san1 zi1 gam1 zhu3 jap6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui3 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的财政状况已经岌岌可危，如果再没有新的资金注入，很快就会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The company's financial situation is on the brink of collapse. If there isn't new funding soon, it will go bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就快到，但係我仲未開始溫書，真係兵臨城下喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 zau6 faai3 dou3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 zung6 mei6 hoi1 chi2 wan1 syu1, zan1 hai6 bing1 lam4 sing4 haa6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试马上就要到了，但是我还没开始复习，真是迫在眉睫了！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming soon, but I haven't started studying yet. The situation is really critical!

synonyms: 岌岌可危 (gip1 gip1 ho2 ngai4)

mandarin_meaning: 兵荒马乱 (bīng huāng mǎ luàn)
english_meaning: utter chaos; the chaos of war; a state of utter confusion and disorder
explanation_mandarin: 形容战争时期社会秩序混乱，也形容社会上动荡不安的局面。
explanation_english: Describes a state of chaos and disorder, especially during wartime, or any situation characterized by great turmoil and confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搬屋嗰陣時，成間屋兵荒馬亂咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun1 uk1 go2 zan6 si4, seng4 gaan1 uk1 bing1 fong1 maa5 lyun6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搬家的时候，整个房子乱七八糟的。
examples.english_sentence: When they moved house, the whole house was in utter chaos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，搞到好多公司都兵荒馬亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 bing1 fong1 maa5 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，搞得很多公司都非常混乱。
examples.english_sentence: The poor economy has caused a lot of companies to be in a state of chaos.

synonyms: 亂七八糟 (lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1)
雞毛鴨血 (gai1 mou4 aap3 hyut3)

mandarin_meaning: 负责人; 主管; 首领
english_meaning: Head; leader; boss; person in charge
explanation_mandarin: 指一个团队、组织或公司的负责人或主管。
explanation_english: Refers to the head, leader, boss, or person in charge of a team, organization, or company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅兵頭好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 bing1 tau4 hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的负责人很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss of their company is very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問下兵頭點樣做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 haa5 bing1 tau4 dim2 joeng2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问一下负责人怎么做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Ask the person in charge how to do it.

english_meaning: public place; common ground; a place where everyone can go
explanation_mandarin: 指公众场所，例如公园、广场等，大家都可以去的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a public place like a park or plaza, a place where everyone is welcome to go. The literal translation is 'General's Garden'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家咁夜，兵頭花園都冇乜人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gam3 je6, bing1 tau4 faa1 jyun4 dou1 mou5 mat1 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这么晚了，公共场所都没什么人了。
examples.english_sentence: It's so late now, there aren't many people in public places anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺兵頭花園嗰度跳舞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 bing1 tau4 faa1 jyun4 go2 dou6 tiu3 mou5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在公共场所跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: They often dance in the public place.

synonyms: 公眾地方 (gung1 zung3 dei6 fong1)

mandarin_meaning: 人手; 勞動力; 兵力; 軍隊
english_meaning: manpower; workforce; troops; military force
explanation_mandarin: 指人力、物力或軍隊。可以指實際的軍隊，也可以泛指做某件事情所需要的人手或資源。
explanation_english: Refers to manpower, resources, or troops. It can refer to actual military forces, or more generally, the manpower or resources needed to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂呢個project 要好多兵馬先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 ni1 go3 project jiu3 hou2 do1 bing1 maa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成这个项目需要很多人手才行。
examples.english_sentence: It takes a lot of manpower to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司調咗好多兵馬去支援新嘅業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 diu6 zo2 hou2 do1 bing1 maa5 heoi3 zi1 wun4 san1 ge3 ye6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司调动了很多人力去支持新的业务。
examples.english_sentence: The company has transferred a lot of manpower to support the new business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要出兵馬清路障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 bing1 maa5 cing1 lou6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要派人清除路障。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow we need to send people to clear the roadblocks.

english_meaning: Terracotta Army
explanation_mandarin: 指秦始皇陵墓中发现的大量陶俑，形象为士兵和战马。
explanation_english: Refers to the collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first Emperor of China. It is a form of funerary art buried with the emperor in 210–209 BCE, with the purpose of protecting the emperor in his afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜去西安睇兵馬俑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 sai1 on1 tai2 bing1 maa5 yung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个礼拜去西安看兵马俑。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Xi'an to see the Terracotta Army next week.

mandarin_meaning: 他/她/它/他们/她们/它们; 那个; 它的
english_meaning: he/she/it/they; that; his/her/its
explanation_mandarin: 文言用法，通常在书面语中使用，指代第三人称或事物，相当于普通话的“他/她/它/他们/她们/它们”，或指示代词“那个”及其所有格。
explanation_english: Literary usage, typically used in written Chinese, referring to the third person or thing, equivalent to "he/she/it/they" in Mandarin, or the demonstrative pronoun "that" and its possessive form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔鍾意其生活方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 zung1 ji3 kei4 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不喜欢他们的生活方式。
examples.english_sentence: They don't like their lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其貌不揚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 maau6 bat1 joeng4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其貌不扬 (形容外貌不出众)
examples.english_sentence: Plain looking; not prepossessing in appearance.

english_meaning: one of them; one of which; one of the...
explanation_mandarin: 表示在多个事物中选择一个。
explanation_english: Indicates selecting one out of multiple things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有三個仔，其一喺美國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 saam1 go3 zai2, kei4 jat1 hai2 mei5 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有三个儿子，其中一个在美国读书。
examples.english_sentence: I have three sons, one of them is studying in the US.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書有好多故事，其一我特別鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 hou2 do1 gu3 si6, kei4 jat1 ngo5 dak6 bit6 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书有很多故事，其中一个我特别喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: This book has many stories, one of which I especially like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有好多問題，其一係資金唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4, kei4 jat1 hai6 zi1 gam1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划有很多问题，其中一个是资金不足。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has many problems, one of which is insufficient funding.

english_meaning: among (which, them, etc.); in (that, it, etc.); of which; wherein
explanation_mandarin: 表示在一群人或事物裡面。
explanation_english: Indicates being part of a group of people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班有三十個人，其中十個係女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 jau5 saam1 sap6 go3 jan4, kei4 zung1 sap6 go3 hai6 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们班有三十个人，其中十个是女生。
examples.english_sentence: There are thirty people in our class, among them ten are girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗好多生果，其中我最鍾意食蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 sang1 gwo2, kei4 zung1 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了很多水果，其中我最喜欢吃苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lot of fruits, among them I like apples the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去過好多國家，其中佢最鍾意日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 gwo3 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1, kei4 zung1 keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去过很多国家，其中他最喜欢日本。
examples.english_sentence: He has been to many countries, among them he likes Japan the most.

english_meaning: other, the others, else
explanation_mandarin: 指除了当前所提及的事物以外的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to things other than the ones currently being mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲有其他意見冇呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 ji3 gin3 mou5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还有其他意见吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any other opinions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗佢之外，其他人都同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 keoi5 zi1 ngoi6, kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 tung3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了他之外，其他人都同意。
examples.english_sentence: Apart from him, everyone else agrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有冇其他選擇呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 syun2 zaak6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 还有没有其他选择啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are there any other options?

english_meaning: to have a reason; to have a cause; there's a reason for it
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的发生或出现有其内在的原因或来源。
explanation_english: Indicates that the occurrence or appearance of something has its inherent reasons or sources. It implies that something didn't happen randomly, but rather has a logical or historical basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，其來有自㗎，好多因素影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, kei4 loi4 jau5 zi6 gaa3, hou2 do1 jyun4 sou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房价这么贵，是有原因的，有很多因素影响。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's housing prices are so expensive, there's a reason for it, many factors are influencing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳咁受歡迎，其來有自，啲嘢食真係好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4, kei4 loi4 jau5 zi6, di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么受欢迎，是有原因的，食物真的很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is so popular, there's a reason for it, the food is really delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，攞獎其來有自啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, lo2 zoeng2 kei4 loi4 jau5 zi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，获奖是有原因的啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's so hardworking, it's only natural that he won an award.

mandarin_meaning: 形容非常团结，力量强大，无坚不摧。
english_meaning: So united that their strength can break metal; Describes a team or group with strong unity and power, able to overcome any obstacle.
explanation_mandarin: 形容团结一致，力量非常大，就像能切断金属一样。比喻只要人们团结一心，就能克服任何困难。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a group of people who are so united in purpose and effort that their collective strength becomes immense, capable of overcoming even the most difficult challenges, metaphorically cutting through metal. It emphasizes the power of unity and teamwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司上下一心，其利斷金，一定可以渡過呢個難關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 soeng6 haa6 jat1 sam1, kei4 lei6 dyun3 gam1, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 dou6 gwo3 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司上下一心，其利断金，一定可以度过这个难关。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is united as one, with strength that can break metal, and we will definitely overcome this difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要大家肯合作，其利斷金，冇嘢搞唔掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 hang2 hap6 zok3, kei4 lei6 dyun3 gam1, mou5 je5 gaau2 m4 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要大家肯合作，其利断金，没有什么解决不了的。
examples.english_sentence: As long as everyone is willing to cooperate, with strength that can break metal, there is nothing that cannot be solved.

synonyms: 同心協力 (tung4 sam1 hip3 lik6)
眾志成城 (zung3 zi3 sing4 sing4)

english_meaning: other, the rest, else
explanation_mandarin: 指除了已经提到的人或事物之外的。
explanation_english: Refers to things or people other than those already mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇其它問題想問啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还有没有其他问题想问啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any other questions you want to ask?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗呢個之外，仲有其它選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 ni1 go3 zi1 ngoi6, zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了这个之外，还有其他的选择。
examples.english_sentence: Besides this one, there are other options.

english_meaning: actually, in fact, as a matter of fact
explanation_mandarin: 表示事實情況與先前所說或所想不同，用於引出與前文相反或補充的資訊。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or adds to what has been said or thought previously. It indicates that the actual situation is different from what was expected or believed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為佢好窮，其實佢好有錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hou2 kung4, kei4 sat6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他很穷，其实他很有钱的。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he was poor, but actually, he's very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實，我唔係好想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其实，我不是很想去。
examples.english_sentence: Actually, I don't really want to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表面好開心，但其實佢有好多嘢收埋喺心入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 min6 hou2 hoi1 sam1, daan6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表面上很高兴，但其实他有很多事藏在心里。
examples.english_sentence: He seems happy on the surface, but actually he has a lot of things hidden in his heart.

english_meaning: afterwards, thereafter, later
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间顺序在后的意思，相当于“之后”、“后来”。
explanation_english: Indicates a later time sequence; equivalent to "afterwards" or "thereafter".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食完飯，其後就去咗睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6, kei4 hau6 zau6 heoi3 zo2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃完饭，之后就去看电影了。
examples.english_sentence: After we finished eating, we went to see a movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭職其後，一直都冇搵到工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zik1 kei4 hau6, jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 wan2 dou2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后，一直都没找到工作。
examples.english_sentence: After he resigned, he hasn't found a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗獎，其後接受咗傳媒訪問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 zoeng2, kei4 hau6 zip3 sau6 zo2 cyun4 mui4 fong2 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得了奖，之后接受了媒体采访。
examples.english_sentence: He won the award, and afterwards he was interviewed by the media.

mandarin_meaning: 居心叵测，用心险恶，罪该万死
english_meaning: His/Her/Their intentions are evil and deserve to be punished; their motives are reprehensible and worthy of condemnation.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某些人内心险恶，动机不纯，罪恶深重，应该受到惩罚。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone whose intentions are malicious, whose motives are impure, and whose actions are so wicked that they deserve to be punished severely. It suggests a profound moral deficiency and a deliberate intent to harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，明眼人都睇得出其心可誅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, ming4 ngaan5 jan4 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 kei4 sam1 ho2 zyu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，明眼人都能看出其心可诛。
examples.english_sentence: The way he did that, anyone can see that his intentions are evil and deserve to be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅幕後黑手其心可誅，一定要將佢繩之於法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 mok6 hau6 hak1 sau2 kei4 sam1 ho2 zyu1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 sing4 zi1 jyu1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的幕后黑手其心可诛，一定要将他绳之以法。
examples.english_sentence: The mastermind behind this incident has evil intentions and deserves to be punished; we must bring them to justice.

english_meaning: Boundless joy; endless fun; infinite pleasure
explanation_mandarin: 形容快乐没有穷尽。形容非常快乐。
explanation_english: Describes happiness without end; infinite joy.  Used to describe a state of extreme happiness and enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同啲朋友一齊去旅行，真係其樂無窮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 kei4 lok6 mou4 kung4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和朋友一起去旅行，真是其乐无穷啊！
examples.english_sentence: Traveling with friends is truly boundless joy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇波嘅時候，見到自己支持嘅球隊贏波，其樂無窮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 bo1 ge3 si4 hau6, gin3 dou2 zi6 gei2 zi1 ci4 ge3 kau4 deoi2 wing4 bo1, kei4 lok6 mou4 kung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看球的时候，看到自己支持的球队赢了，其乐无穷。
examples.english_sentence: Watching the game, seeing the team I support win is endless fun.

english_meaning: secondly, next, secondary
explanation_mandarin: 表示順序或重要性排在第二位，接著是。
explanation_english: Indicates something is secondary in order or importance; next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 首先你要搞清楚件事嘅目的，其次先至諗點樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 sin1 jiu3 gaau2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 muk6 dik1, ci3 ci3 sin1 zi3 nam2 dim2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 首先你要搞清楚这件事的目的，其次才想怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: First, you need to understand the purpose of this matter, and secondly, think about how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方案有兩個好處，首先係可以慳錢，其次係可以提高效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 jau5 loeng5 go3 hou2 cyu3, sau2 sin1 hai6 ho2 ji5 haan1 cin2, ci3 ci3 hai6 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 haau2 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方案有两个好处，首先是可以省钱，其次是可以提高效率。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has two benefits. Firstly, it can save money, and secondly, it can improve efficiency.

english_meaning: unattractive appearance; plain-looking; not prepossessing
explanation_mandarin: 形容外貌不出众，不吸引人。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose appearance is not outstanding or attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然其貌不揚，但係好有才華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 kei4 maau6 bat1 joeng4, daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 choi4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他长相不出众，但是很有才华。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is plain-looking, he is very talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇人其貌不揚，好多時候佢哋都好有內涵㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 jan4 kei4 maau6 bat1 joeng4, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 jau5 noi6 haam4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看别人长相不出众，很多时候他们都很有内涵的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just judge people by their unattractive appearance, often they are very insightful.

synonyms: 唔靚仔 (m4 leng3 zai2) / 唔靚女 (m4 leng3 neoi5)

mandarin_meaning: 自身不正, 以身作则的反面
