english_meaning: If one is not upright oneself, one cannot set others upright; failure to lead by example; hypocrisy.
explanation_mandarin: 指自身行为不端正，就不能端正别人。多用于批评那些自身不正，却要求别人做到的人，带贬义。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone who is not upright themselves cannot correct others. It's often used to criticize those who have flaws but expect others to be perfect. It has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自己成日遲到，但係又鬧人哋唔準時，真係其身不正！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 gei2 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, daan6 hai6 jau6 naau6 jan4 dei6 m4 zeon2 si4, zan1 hai6 kei4 san1 bat1 zing3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自己总是迟到，但是又骂别人不准时，真是自身不正！
examples.english_sentence: He himself is always late, but he scolds others for not being punctual. It's really a case of 'if one is not upright oneself...'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日叫我哋唔好貪污，但係佢自己就成日攞公司啲錢去賭，真係其身不正，點服佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 taam1 wu1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zau6 sing4 jat6 lo2 gung1 si1 di1 cin2 heoi3 dou2, zan1 hai6 kei4 san1 bat1 zing3, dim2 fuk6 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是叫我们不要贪污，但是他自己总是拿公司的钱去赌，真是自身不正，怎么服他啊？
examples.english_sentence: The boss always tells us not to be corrupt, but he himself always takes company money to gamble. It's a clear case of 'if one is not upright oneself...' How can we respect him?

english_meaning: during that time; in the course of; meanwhile
explanation_mandarin: 指某一段时间之内。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time within which something happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀書其間，做過好多唔同嘅兼職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 syu1 kei4 gaan1, zou6 gwo3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 gim1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我读书期间，做过很多不同的兼职。
examples.english_sentence: During my studies, I did many different part-time jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住院其間，我哋成日去探佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 jyun2 kei4 gaan1, ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 taam3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住院期间，我们经常去看他。
examples.english_sentence: While he was hospitalized, we visited him often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議其間唔好傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui5 ji5 kei4 gaan1 m4 hou2 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议期间不要聊天。
examples.english_sentence: Don't chat during the meeting.

synonyms: 喺...嘅時候 (hai2 ... ge3 si4 hau6)

english_meaning: the rest; the remainder; other
explanation_mandarin: 指剩下的、其他的。
explanation_english: Refers to what remains, the other parts or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋五個人去，佢哋兩個喺屋企，其餘嘅就出咗去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ng5 go3 jan4 heoi3, keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 uk1 kei2, kei4 jyu4 ge3 zau6 ceot1 zo2 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们五个人去，他们两个在家，其余的就出去玩了。
examples.english_sentence: Five of us are going, two of them are at home, and the rest went out to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗佢，其餘嘅人都同意呢個方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 keoi5, kei4 jyu4 ge3 jan4 dou1 tung3 ji3 ni1 go3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了他，其余的人都同意这个方案。
examples.english_sentence: Except for him, everyone else agrees with this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經搞掂晒啲嘢，其餘嘅你幫手執手尾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5, kei4 jyu4 ge3 nei5 bong1 sau2 zap1 sau2 mei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经处理完所有事情了，剩下的你帮忙收尾吧。
examples.english_sentence: I've already finished everything, please help tidy up the rest.

english_meaning: to have, to possess, to be equipped with; tool, utensil
explanation_mandarin: 表示具备、具有某种特性或能力；也指工具、器物。
explanation_english: Indicates having or possessing a certain characteristic or ability; also refers to tools or utensils.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢具備領導才能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi6 bei6 ling5 dou6 coi4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他具备领导才能。
examples.english_sentence: He possesses leadership skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一種好有用嘅工具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 jau5 jung6 ge3 gung1 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个非常有用的工具。
examples.english_sentence: This is a very useful tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要準備好所有嘅用具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2 so2 jau5 ge3 jung6 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要准备好所有的用具。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prepare all the utensils.

english_meaning: to possess; to have; to be equipped with
explanation_mandarin: 拥有，具有。
explanation_english: To have, possess, or be equipped with certain qualities, skills, or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢具備晒所有成功嘅條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi6 bei6 saai3 so2 jau5 sing4 gung1 ge3 tiu4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他具备了所有成功的条件。
examples.english_sentence: He possesses all the conditions for success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成為一個好嘅醫生，你需要具備專業知識同埋同情心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 ji1 sang1, nei5 seoi1 jiu3 geoi6 bei6 zyun1 jip6 zi1 sik1 tung4 mai4 tung4 cing4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成为一个好医生，你需要具备专业知识和同情心。
examples.english_sentence: To be a good doctor, you need to possess professional knowledge and compassion.

english_meaning: to have; to possess; to be equipped with
explanation_mandarin: 表示拥有、具备某种性质、能力或特征。
explanation_english: Indicates the possession of certain properties, abilities, or characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車具有自動駕駛嘅功能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 geoi6 jau5 zi6 dung6 gaa3 si2 ge3 gung1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车具有自动驾驶的功能。
examples.english_sentence: This car has the function of autonomous driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢具有豐富嘅經驗，一定可以勝任呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi6 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 ging1 jim6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 sing3 jam6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他具有丰富的经验，一定可以胜任这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He has rich experience and will definitely be able to handle this job.

english_meaning: concrete; specific; definite
explanation_mandarin: 指事物是实在的、明确的、细致的，而不是抽象的、模糊的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is real, clear, detailed, rather than abstract or vague. It means concrete, specific or definite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以講得具體啲呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 dak1 geoi6 tai2 di1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以说得更具体一点吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you be more specific?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要有一個具體嘅計劃先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jau5 jat1 go3 geoi6 tai2 ge3 gai3 waak6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要有一个具体的计划才行。
examples.english_sentence: We need to have a concrete plan first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆想聽下你嘅具體建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 ge3 geoi6 tai2 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板想听听你的具体建议。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants to hear your specific suggestions.

english_meaning: to pawn; to mortgage; to borrow against collateral
explanation_mandarin: 指将物品抵押给他人，以换取金钱；也指借贷。
explanation_english: To pawn or mortgage something; to borrow money by providing something as collateral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇錢使，唯有將隻錶攞去典咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 cin2 sai2, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 zek3 biu1 lo2 heoi3 din2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没钱用，只能把这块手表拿去典当了。
examples.english_sentence: I have no money to spend, so I have to pawn this watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將間屋典咗去銀行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 din2 zo2 heoi3 ngan4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把房子抵押给银行了。
examples.english_sentence: He mortgaged his house to the bank.

english_meaning: typical; representative; classic; model; typical example
explanation_mandarin: 指具有代表性的，可以作为榜样的事物或者人。也指某种事物或者人的普遍特征。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone that is representative and can serve as a model. It also refers to the common characteristics of something or someone; a typical example or model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個典型嘅香港後生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 din2 hing4 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 hau6 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个典型的香港年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a typical Hong Kong young man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一個典型嘅貪污案例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 din2 hing4 ge3 taam1 wu1 on3 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个典型的贪污案例。
examples.english_sentence: This is a typical corruption case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好典型，一啲都唔出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 din2 hing4, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很典型，一点都不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is typical, not surprising at all.

english_meaning: to dawdle; to waste time; to drag one's feet
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事拖拖拉拉，磨蹭，浪费时间。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow, procrastinates, and wastes time in doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再典床典蓆啦，快啲做完佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 din2 cong4 din2 cek3 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再磨蹭了，快点做完它吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop dawdling and finish it quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會個陣佢哋典床典蓆，講埋啲無謂嘢，搞到好晏先完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 zan6 keoi5 dei6 din2 cong4 din2 cek3, gong2 maai4 di1 mou4 wai6 je5, gaau2 dou3 hou2 aan3 sin1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候他们拖拖拉拉，说些没用的话，搞得很晚才结束。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, they were dawdling and saying irrelevant things, which caused the meeting to end very late.

english_meaning: to make the bed; to tidy up; to prepare (a place for someone to sleep)
explanation_mandarin: 指整理床铺，收拾好睡觉的地方，也泛指收拾、整理。
explanation_english: Refers to tidying up the bed and preparing a place to sleep; also generally means to tidy up or organize things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我典床典蓆，等陣表哥嚟瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 din2 cong4 din2 sik1, dang2 zan6 biu2 go1 lai4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我铺床叠被，等一下表哥来睡。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me to make the bed so my cousin can sleep here later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫手典床典蓆啦，今晚有朋友嚟借宿一宵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 sau2 din2 cong4 din2 sik1 laa1, gam1 maan1 jau5 pang4 jau5 lai4 ze3 suk1 jat1 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮个忙铺床叠被吧，今晚有朋友来借宿一晚。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me prepare the bed; a friend is coming to stay overnight tonight.

english_meaning: allusion; literary quotation; origin of a story or saying
explanation_mandarin: 指古代典籍中出现的故事或词语的来源，常用于文学或口语中，使表达更具文化底蕴。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin of a story or word from ancient books, often used in literature or spoken language to make the expression more culturally rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意用典故嚟寫文章，啲嘢就變得好有味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 yung6 din2 gu3 lai4 se2 man4 zoeng1, di1 je5 zau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 jau5 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢用典故来写文章，文章就变得很有韵味。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅目標係要兼而有之，既要提高效率，又要降低成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 jiu3 gim1 ji4 jau5 zi1, gei3 jiu3 tai4 gou1 haau6 leot6, jau6 jiu3 gong3 dai1 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的目标是要两者兼备，既要提高效率，又要降低成本。
examples.english_sentence: The goal of this plan is to have both, to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

english_meaning: part-time job; to work part-time
explanation_mandarin: 指在主要工作之外，另外从事一份工作。
explanation_english: A part-time job refers to work done in addition to one's primary job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返緊全職，又做緊份兼職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 gan2 cyun4 zik1, jau6 zou6 gan2 fan6 gim1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在做全职工作，又在做一份兼职。
examples.english_sentence: He is working full-time and also has a part-time job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想搵份兼職幫補下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 wan2 fan6 gim1 zik1 bong1 bou2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想找一份兼职来补贴一下？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to find a part-time job to supplement your income?

english_meaning: part-time study, studying part-time
explanation_mandarin: 一边工作一边读书，通常指在职人士在工作之余参加课程学习。
explanation_english: To study part-time while working. Usually refers to working adults who attend courses or programs while still employed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家兼讀緊一個碩士課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gim1 duk6 gan2 jat1 go3 sek6 si6 fo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在正在兼读一个硕士课程。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently studying a master's program part-time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多在職人士都會選擇兼讀嚟提升自己嘅學歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 zoi6 jik1 jan4 si6 dou1 wui2 syun2 zaak6 gim1 duk6 lai4 tai4 sing1 zi6 gei2 ge3 hok6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多在职人士都会选择兼读来提升自己的学历。
examples.english_sentence: Many working adults choose to study part-time to improve their education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兼讀課程嘅時間比較彈性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gim1 duk6 fo3 ching4 ge3 si4 gaan3 bei2 gaau3 taan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兼读课程的时间比较弹性。
examples.english_sentence: The time for part-time courses is more flexible.

english_meaning: to moonlight; to hold down two jobs; to work a second job
explanation_mandarin: 同时做两份工作，通常是为了增加收入。指正职之外又做一份兼职。
explanation_english: To hold two jobs simultaneously, often to supplement one's income. It refers to having a part-time job in addition to a full-time job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工唔夠使，要兼開一份夜班看更先夠養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 m4 gau3 sai2, jiu3 gim1 hoi1 jat1 fan6 je6 baan1 hon1 gang1 sin1 gau3 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作收入不够花，需要兼职一份夜班保安才能养家。
examples.english_sentence: His job doesn't pay enough, he needs to moonlight as a night watchman to support his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲嘢咁貴，好多人都逼住要兼開多份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bik1 zyu6 jiu3 gim1 hoi1 do1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在东西这么贵，很多人都被迫要兼职多一份工作。
examples.english_sentence: Things are so expensive nowadays that many people are forced to take on a second job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣時為咗儲錢結婚，兼開咗兩份工，真係好捱得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 gwo2 zan6 si4 wai6 zo2 chyu5 chin2 git3 fan1, gim1 hoi1 zo2 loeng5 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaai4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候为了存钱结婚，兼职了两份工作，真的很能吃苦。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he worked two jobs to save money for his wedding. He was really hardworking.

english_meaning: to attend to two or more things; to balance; to take care of
explanation_mandarin: 同时照顾到两个或多个方面。
explanation_english: To take care of or attend to two or more things at the same time; to balance different aspects or responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要返工又要湊仔，好難兼顧得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu3 faan1 gung1 jau6 jiu3 cau3 zai2, hou2 naan4 gim1 gu3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她既要工作又要照顾孩子，很难全部兼顾。
examples.english_sentence: She has to work and take care of her child, it's hard to attend to everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺學業同埋課外活動之間攞到平衡，真係要好好兼顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 hok6 jip6 tung4 maai4 fo3 ngoi6 wut6 dung6 zi1 gaan1 lo2 dou2 ping4 hang4, zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 gim1 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要在学业和课外活动之间取得平衡，真的要好好兼顾。
examples.english_sentence: To achieve balance between studies and extracurricular activities, you really need to manage your time carefully.

english_meaning: to hope; to expect; to wish
explanation_mandarin: 希望，期望。
explanation_english: To hope; to expect; to wish for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冀望佢可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kei3 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他能够成功。
examples.english_sentence: I hope he can succeed.

english_meaning: to hope; to expect; hope; expectation
explanation_mandarin: 希望，期盼。通常指对未来事物的美好期待。
explanation_english: To hope, to expect. Usually refers to a good expectation for future events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冀望你哋將來可以成為社會嘅棟樑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kei3 mong6 nei5 dei6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 sing4 wai4 se5 wui2 ge3 dung3 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们期望你们将来可以成为社会的栋梁。
examples.english_sentence: We hope that you can become pillars of society in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家長對仔女嘅冀望好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zoeng2 deoi3 zai2 neoi5 ge3 kei3 mong6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家长对子女的期望很大。
examples.english_sentence: Parents have great expectations for their children.

english_meaning: inside, inner, internal, within
explanation_mandarin: 表示内部或里面的位置。
explanation_english: Indicates the inner part or location inside something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋入面好暗，快啲入去内。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jap6 min6 hou2 am3, faai3 di1 jap6 heoi3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里面很暗，快点进去里面。
examples.english_sentence: The room is dark inside. Hurry and go inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺屋企内搞個派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 uk1 kei2 noi6 gaau2 go3 paai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在家里面办个派对。
examples.english_sentence: We're having a party inside the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司内部規定好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 kwai1 ding6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司内部规定很多。
examples.english_sentence: There are many internal regulations in the company.

english_meaning: One
explanation_mandarin: 数字“一”的口语化说法，常用于计数或表示单个的事物。
explanation_english: A colloquial way to say 'one' (the number 1), often used for counting or referring to a single item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 円個橙
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 caang2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个橙子
examples.english_sentence: One orange

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有円蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 jat1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一块钱。
examples.english_sentence: I have one dollar.

english_meaning: not have; haven't; hasn't; without
explanation_mandarin: 表示不存在、没有、缺乏。
explanation_english: Indicates non-existence, lack of, or not having something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇錢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 cin2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没钱啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have no money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天没上班。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't go to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇問題！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 man6 tai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没问题！
examples.english_sentence: No problem!

english_meaning: Lacking enthusiasm, passion, or dedication; half-hearted; without care or sincerity.
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏热忱、不用心、做事敷衍了事、不认真对待。
explanation_english: Refers to lacking enthusiasm or passion, doing things perfunctorily, not taking things seriously. It implies a lack of care and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢真係好冇heart，求求其其交貨就算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 haat1, kau4 kau4 keoi4 keoi4 gaau1 fo3 zau6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作真的很不用心，随便交货就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He's really lacking enthusiasm in his work; he just submits whatever he can.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲服務員好冇heart，叫極都唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 fuk6 mou4 yun4 hou2 mou5 haat1, giu3 gik1 dou1 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务员很不热情，叫很久都不来。
examples.english_sentence: The waiters in this restaurant are very inattentive; they don't come even when you call them repeatedly.

english_meaning: not in the mood, not feeling it
explanation_mandarin: 指没有情绪，没有兴致，不想做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of emotion or enthusiasm; not feeling like doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我冇mood返工，好想瞓覺呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 mou5 muut1 faan1 gung1, hou2 soeng2 fan3 gaau3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我没心情上班，好想睡觉啊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not in the mood to work today, I really want to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日俾老細鬧完，而家都冇mood食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4, ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5 muut1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天被老板骂完，现在都没心情吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by the boss yesterday, and now he's not in the mood to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，但我仲係冇mood溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si5, daan6 ngo5 zung6 hai6 mou5 muut1 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，但我还是没心情复习。
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, but I'm still not in the mood to study.

english_meaning: pointless; irrelevant; without a point; nonsensical
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事物、说话、行为等没有重点、没有意义，或是不切题，没有关联。
explanation_english: Describes something, such as a statement, action, or behavior, as being pointless, meaningless, irrelevant, or lacking a clear and understandable point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講咁多嘢，都冇point嘅，不如直接講重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 je5, dou1 mou5 point1 ge3, bat1 jyu4 zik6 zip3 gong2 zung1 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说了这么多，都没有重点，不如直接说重点吧。
examples.english_sentence: You've said so much, but it's all pointless. Why don't you just get to the point?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個建議好似冇乜point，我哋唔應該考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gin3 ji5 hou2 ci5 mou5 mat1 point1, ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 haau2 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个建议好像没什么意义，我们不应该考虑。
examples.english_sentence: This suggestion seems pointless. We shouldn't consider it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講埋啲冇point嘅嘢啦，浪費時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 maai4 di1 mou5 point1 ge3 je5 laa1, long6 fai3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再说那些没有意义的话了，浪费时间。
examples.english_sentence: Stop saying such pointless things, it's a waste of time.

mandarin_meaning: 没有发言权; 不算数; 没有决定权
english_meaning: To have no say; to have no influence; not to count; to be ignored; to be powerless to affect a decision.
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有发言权，意见不被重视，无法影响或改变结果。指某人在某事上没有决定权或影响力，其意见不被采纳。
explanation_english: Indicates having no right to speak, having one's opinion disregarded, and being unable to influence or change the outcome. It refers to someone having no decision-making power or influence in a matter, and their opinion is not adopted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢件事上面，我根本冇say。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 soeng6 min6, ngo5 gan1 bun2 mou5 sei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这件事上，我根本没有发言权。
examples.english_sentence: I have absolutely no say in this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆講咗算，我哋啲意見冇say嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gong2 zo2 syun3, ngo5 dei6 di1 ji3 gin3 mou5 sei1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说了算，我们的意见不算数。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has the final say, our opinions don't count.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔係老細，點會有say呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hai6 lou5 sai3, dim2 wui5 jau5 sei1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不是老板，怎么会有发言权呢？
examples.english_sentence: You're not the boss, how would you have any say?

synonyms: 冇得話事 (mou5 dak1 waa6 si6)

mandarin_meaning: 没主见, 没魄力, 懦弱
english_meaning: Lacking backbone; spineless; lacking initiative; indecisive; weak-willed
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人没有主见，优柔寡断，缺乏魄力，容易受他人影响。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is indecisive, lacks initiative, is easily influenced by others, and generally lacks backbone or willpower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係冇下巴，成日都俾人㩒住嚟打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zan1 hai6 mou5 haa5 baa1, seng4 jat6 dou1 bei2 jan4 gam6 zyu6 lai4 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是没主见，总是被人欺负。
examples.english_sentence: He's really spineless; he's always getting bullied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢咁冇下巴，點可以擔大旗啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 gam3 mou5 haa5 baa1, dim2 ho2 ji5 daam1 daai6 kei4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事这么没魄力，怎么能承担重任啊？
examples.english_sentence: How can you take on big responsibilities when you're so indecisive in your work?

mandarin_meaning: 没下巴 / 指缺乏果断性
english_meaning: literally: no chin; figuratively: lacking decisiveness, spineless, lacking courage
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指没有下巴。引申义是指一个人缺乏决断力，胆小怕事，没有魄力。
explanation_english: Literally means 'no chin'. Figuratively, it describes someone who lacks decisiveness, is spineless, timid, and lacks courage or backbone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁冇下扒，梗係唔敢同老細講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 mou5 haa5 baa1, gang2 hai6 m4 gam2 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么没主见，肯定不敢跟老板说了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so spineless, he definitely wouldn't dare to tell the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔可以咁冇下扒，要有自己嘅主見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 mou5 haa5 baa1, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 zyu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不能这么没有主见，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be so spineless in life; you need to have your own opinions.

english_meaning: not much; nothing much; not a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度不高，或数量不多。有时也表示无所谓，不重要。
explanation_english: Indicates a small degree or quantity. Sometimes also indicates that something is not important or doesn't matter much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日都冇乜嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 dou1 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天也没什么事做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much to do today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使擔心，都冇乜大不了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, dou1 mou5 mat1 daai6 bat1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用担心，没什么大不了的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry, it's not a big deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇乜人嚟喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 mou5 mat1 jan4 lai4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚好像没什么人来。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like not many people are coming tonight.

english_meaning: Without much conversation, not much to say
explanation_mandarin: 形容话很少，没有什么好说的。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is not much conversation or not much to say to each other. It implies a lack of communication or a strained relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個鬧交之後，冇乜兩句，好似唔想同對方講嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 naau6 gaau1 zi1 hau6, mou5 mat1 loeng5 geoi3, hou2 ci5 m4 soeng2 tung4 deoi3 fong1 gong2 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个吵架之后，没什么话好说，好像不想和对方说话一样。
examples.english_sentence: After their argument, they didn't have much to say to each other, as if they didn't want to talk to one another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從阿明搬走之後，我哋同佢都冇乜兩句，好少聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 aa3 ming4 bun1 zau2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dou1 mou5 mat1 loeng5 geoi3, hou2 siu2 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从阿明搬走之后，我们和他也没什么话好说，很少联系。
examples.english_sentence: Since Ah Ming moved away, we haven't had much to say to him, and we rarely keep in touch.

english_meaning: nothing much; not much; it's nothing
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有特别的事情或情况；一种客气的回答，表示事情不重要。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that there is nothing special or significant. It can be a polite reply to inquiries, suggesting that the matter is not important or worth dwelling on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做緊乜嘢啊？ 冇乜嘢啫，睇下電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3? mou5 mat1 je5 ze1, tai2 haa5 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在做什么啊？没什么，看看电视。
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing? Nothing much, just watching TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先聽到你喺度鬧，發生咩事啊？ 冇乜嘢，只係同細佬嘈兩句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 teng1 dou2 nei5 hai2 dou6 naau6, faat3 sang1 me1 si6 aa3? mou5 mat1 je5, zi2 hai6 tung4 sai3 lou2 caau2 loeng5 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才听到你在吵，发生什么事了？没什么，只是和弟弟吵了几句。
examples.english_sentence: I heard you arguing earlier, what happened? It's nothing, just had a small argument with my younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你塊面咁紅，冇乜嘢啊嘛？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 min6 gam3 hung4, mou5 mat1 je5 aa3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你脸这么红，没事吧？
examples.english_sentence: Your face is so red, are you alright?

english_meaning: not very useful; not much use; of little use
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物没有很大的用途或价值，作用不大。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not very useful, valuable, or effective; of limited use or benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部舊電腦都冇乜大用啦，換部新嘅好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 dou1 mou5 mat1 daai6 jung6 laa1, wun6 bou6 san1 ge3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑也没什么大用了，换一台新的比较好。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer isn't very useful anymore; it's better to get a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗰個方法都冇乜大用，試吓第二個啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go2 go3 fong1 faat3 dou1 mou5 mat1 daai6 jung6, si3 haa5 dai6 ji6 go3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的那个方法没有太大用处，试一下第二个吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your method isn't very effective, try another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊衫我都冇乜大用，不如捐咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 saam1 ngo5 dou1 mou5 mat1 daai6 jung6, bat1 jyu4 gyun1 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧衣服我都没什么大用了，不如捐了吧。
examples.english_sentence: These old clothes aren't much use to me anymore, I might as well donate them.

synonyms: 唔係好掂 (m4 hai6 hou2 dim6)
唔係好使得 (m4 hai6 hou2 sai2 dak1)

english_meaning: almost the same; not much difference; virtually
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，指差不多一样，没有太大差别。
explanation_english: Indicates degree, meaning almost the same, not much difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅設計冇乜滯，都係抄襲人哋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat3 gai3 mou5 mat1 zai6, dou1 hai6 caau1 sik6 jan4 dei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的两个设计差不多一样，都是抄袭别人的。
examples.english_sentence: Their two designs are almost the same, both are plagiarized from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間餐廳啲嘢食冇乜滯，都係咁難食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 mou5 mat1 zai6, dou1 hai6 gam3 naan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两间餐厅的食物没什么差别，都一样难吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in these two restaurants is virtually the same, both are equally bad.

english_meaning: not much, not really
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度不高，不太怎么样，或者不常见，不经常。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not much, not really, or not often, not frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近冇乜點出街喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 mou5 mat1 dim2 ceot1 gaai1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近好像不太出门啊。
examples.english_sentence: You haven't been going out much lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇乜點返學，成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 mat1 dim2 faan1 hok6, seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太上学，经常生病。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't go to school much; he's always sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇乜點睇電視嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 mat1 dim2 tai2 din6 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太看电视的。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really watch TV.

mandarin_meaning: 一无可取；一无是处; 不像样
english_meaning: hopeless; beyond redemption; incorrigible; terrible; useless; good-for-nothing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物非常糟糕，没有任何优点或希望。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as being terrible, with no redeeming qualities or hope for improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人冇料又唔肯學嘢，真係冇了賴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 mou5 liu2 jau6 m4 hang2 hok6 je5, zan1 hai6 mou5 liu5 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人没能力又不肯学习，真是没救了。
examples.english_sentence: He's incompetent and unwilling to learn; he's hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲拍到冇了賴，完全唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 paak3 dou3 mou5 liu5 laai6, jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影拍得一塌糊涂，完全不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is terribly made; I have no idea what it's about.

english_meaning: it's okay; it's nothing; no problem; alright
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有问题、没关系、不要紧。也可以用来回应别人的道歉，表示接受。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no problem, it's okay, or it doesn't matter. It can also be used to respond to someone's apology, indicating acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親冇事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 mou5 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒了没事儿吧？
examples.english_sentence: Are you okay after falling?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔緊要，冇事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gan2 jiu3, mou5 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没关系，没事儿的。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay, it's nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撞到你，唔好意思啊！冇事冇事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong6 dou2 nei5, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3! mou5 si6 mou5 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 撞到你了，不好意思啊！没事没事！
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into you, sorry! It's okay, it's okay!

english_meaning: nothing's the matter; without any reason; for no particular reason; just because
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有发生什么事情，或者没有任何特别的缘由和目的。
explanation_english: Indicates that nothing has happened, or there is no particular reason or purpose. Often used to describe doing something without a specific motive or cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇事冇幹走咗去邊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 si6 mou5 gon3 zau2 zo2 heoi3 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你没事儿跑到哪里去了？
examples.english_sentence: Where did you go for no reason?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇事冇幹就發脾氣，真係唔知佢搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 si6 mou5 gon3 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没事就发脾气，真不知道他在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He throws a temper tantrum for no reason. I really don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇事冇幹諗起以前嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 si6 mou5 gon3 lam2 hei2 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没事儿就想起以前的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I was just thinking about things from the past for no reason.

jyutping: mou5 si6 ceot1 gaai1 siu2 po3 coi4
english_meaning: If nothing important comes up, stay home to avoid losing money.
explanation_mandarin: 表示没事的时候最好待在家里，减少不必要的开销，避免意外花费或被骗。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that if there's no compelling reason to go out, it's better to stay home to avoid unnecessary expenses, unexpected spending, or being scammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近經濟唔好，冇事出街少破財啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, mou5 si6 ceot1 gaai1 siu2 po3 coi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，没事少出门，免得破财啊。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been good lately, so if nothing important comes up, stay home to avoid losing money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨，又冇嘢要做，不如留喺屋企啦，冇事出街少破財嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, jau6 mou5 je5 jiu3 zou6, bat1 jyu4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1, mou5 si6 ceot1 gaai1 siu2 po3 coi4 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨，又没什么事要做，不如待在家里吧，没事少出门，免得破财嘛。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining tomorrow and there's nothing to do, so let's just stay home. If nothing important comes up, stay home to avoid losing money.

english_meaning: No deal, no way, not a chance, not going to happen
explanation_mandarin: 表示不同意或拒绝，没有谈判的余地，事情不可能发生。
explanation_english: Expresses disagreement, refusal, or that something is not going to happen. There is no room for negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想我幫你做埋曬啲嘢？冇交易！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zou6 maai4 saai3 di1 je5? mou5 gaau1 ji6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想让我帮你做完所有的事？没门儿！
examples.english_sentence: You want me to do all your work for you? No way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要加人工五成，老細話冇交易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 jan4 gung1 ng5 sing4, lou5 sai3 waa6 mou5 gaau1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要加薪百分之五十，老板说没得谈。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted a 50% pay raise, the boss said no deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔做功課就合格？冇交易㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3 zau6 hap6 gaak3? mou5 gaau1 ji6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不做作业就及格？不可能的！
examples.english_sentence: You want to pass without doing your homework? Not a chance!

english_meaning: nobody, no one, there isn't anyone
explanation_mandarin: 表示不存在任何人。否定有人。
explanation_english: Indicates the absence of any person; no one exists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚間餐廳冇人幫襯呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 mou5 jan4 bong1 can3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚这家餐厅没有人光顾啊。
examples.english_sentence: There's nobody dining at this restaurant tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街咁晏都冇人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 gam3 aan3 dou1 mou5 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街这么晚了都没有人。
examples.english_sentence: There's nobody on this street so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗好多次電話都冇人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 din6 waa2 dou1 mou5 jan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了好多次电话都没人接。
examples.english_sentence: I've called many times but nobody answers the phone.

english_meaning: having nothing and nobody; utterly destitute; penniless and alone; devoid of everything
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常贫穷，什么都没有，也没有任何依靠。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme poverty, lacking everything and having no one to rely on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸晒，而家冇人冇物，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1晒, ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 mou5 mat6, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输光了，现在一无所有，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his money gambling, now he has nothing and nobody, it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過場大火，佢哋一家冇人冇物，乜都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 coeng4 daai6 fo2, keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 mou5 jan4 mou5 mat6, mat1 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历一场大火，他们一家一无所有，什么都没了。
examples.english_sentence: After the big fire, the whole family was left with nothing and nobody, they lost everything.

mandarin_meaning: 孤立无援, 毫无关系
english_meaning: To have no connections, to be isolated and without support, to have no influence or contacts.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人在社会上缺乏人脉关系，没有任何依靠和支持。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks connections and relationships in society, having no support or reliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱嚟香港，冇人冇脈，搵嘢做都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, mou5 jan4 mou5 mak6, wan2 je5 zou6 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚来香港，人生地不熟，找工作也很难。
examples.english_sentence: He just arrived in Hong Kong, he has no connections, so finding a job is very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會，冇人冇脈，好難出頭㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2, mou5 jan4 mou5 mak6, hou2 naan4 ceot1 tau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会，没有关系很难出人头地的。
examples.english_sentence: In this society, it's hard to make a name for yourself without connections.

english_meaning: unique; one-of-a-kind; exceptional; rare
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人非常特别，是独一无二，别人都没有的。强调其稀有性和独特性。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is very special, unique, and one-of-a-kind, something that no one else has. Emphasizes its rarity and uniqueness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份設計圖真係冇人有嘅，好創新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 sai3 gai3 tou4 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 jau5 ge3, hou2 cou3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计图真的很独特，非常创新。
examples.english_sentence: His design is truly unique and very innovative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式真係冇人有，喺其他地方食唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 jau5, hai2 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1 sik6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜式真的很特别，在其他地方吃不到。
examples.english_sentence: The dishes in this restaurant are really unique; you can't find them anywhere else.

english_meaning: no chance for revenge; unable to get revenge; never get even
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有机会或者能力去报复，通常指对方过于强大或者已经消失，导致无法进行报复行为。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no chance or ability to take revenge, usually because the other party is too powerful or has disappeared, making revenge impossible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗去外國，我哋想報仇都冇仇報啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3, ngo5 dei6 soeng2 bou3 sau4 dou1 mou5 sau4 bou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬到国外去了，我们想报仇也没机会报仇了。
examples.english_sentence: He moved abroad, there's no way we can get revenge even if we wanted to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有權勢，就算俾佢欺負，你都冇仇報嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 kuen4 sai3, zau6 syun3 bei2 keoi5 hei1 fu2, nei5 dou1 mou5 sau4 bou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有权势，就算被他欺负了，你也无法报仇的。
examples.english_sentence: He has so much power, even if he bullies you, you won't be able to get revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事過咗咁耐，算數啦，都冇仇報咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gwo3 zo2 gam3 noi6, syun3 sou3 laa1, dou1 mou5 sau4 bou3 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情过了这么久，算了吧，也报不了仇了。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so long, let it go, there's no chance for revenge anymore.

english_meaning: to have no share; to be excluded; to be left out
explanation_mandarin: 指没有参与的资格或者没有分配到的那一份。
explanation_english: Refers to not having the qualification to participate or not receiving a share of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次分紅我冇份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 fan1 hung4 ngo5 mou5 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次分红我没有份儿。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have a share in the bonus this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去旅行冇預我，我冇份去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 mou5 jyu6 ngo5, ngo5 mou5 fan6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去旅行没有算上我，我没份去。
examples.english_sentence: They didn't include me in their trip, I wasn't part of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個秘密，你係外人，冇份知㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei3 mat6, nei5 hai6 ngoi6 jan4, mou5 fan6 zi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个秘密，你是外人，没资格知道的。
examples.english_sentence: This is a secret, you're an outsider, you're not entitled to know.

english_meaning: Don't need your help; I don't need you to fix it
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要对方的帮助，带有轻微的拒绝和不信任的意味。
explanation_english: It means that one doesn't need someone's help, often implying a slight rejection or distrust of that person's abilities or intentions to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦我自己搞得掂，冇你修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6, mou5 nei5 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑我自己能搞定，不需要你帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I can handle this computer myself, I don't need your help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我整緊嘢，冇你修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 zing2 gan2 je5, mou5 nei5 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我在弄东西，不需要你帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm doing something, I don't need your help.

synonyms: 唔使你幫 (m4 sai2 nei5 bong1)

english_meaning: I don't have as much patience as you (do); I don't have your patience.
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己没有对方那么好的脾气或者耐心，通常用于抱怨或者略带责备的语气。
explanation_english: Expressing that one does not have as much patience as the person being addressed. It is often used in a complaining or slightly reproachful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你慢慢同佢解釋啦，我冇你咁好氣，唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maan6 maan6 tung4 keoi5 gaai2 sik1 laa1, ngo5 mou5 nei5 gam3 hou2 hei3, m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你慢慢和他解释吧，我没有你那么好的耐心，没空。
examples.english_sentence: You slowly explain it to him. I don't have your patience; I don't have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友扭計真係好煩，我冇你咁好氣湊佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 nau2 gai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4, ngo5 mou5 nei5 gam3 hou2 hei3 cou3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩闹脾气真的很烦，我没有你那么好的耐心照顾他们。
examples.english_sentence: Children throwing tantrums are really annoying. I don't have your patience looking after them.

synonyms: 冇咁好脾氣 (mou5 gam3 hou2 pei4 hei3)
冇咁多耐性 (mou5 gam3 do1 noi6 sing3)

english_meaning: Can't do without him/her; irreplaceable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物非常重要，不可或缺，离开他/她/它就无法完成某事或达到某个目标。
explanation_english: Expresses that someone or something is crucial, essential, and irreplaceable; without them, a task cannot be completed or a goal cannot be achieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司冇佢符㗎，佢好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 keoi5 fu4 gaa3, keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司没有他不行，他很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: The company can't do without him, he's very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project 冇你符㗎，得你搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project mou5 nei5 fu4 gaa3, dak1 nei5 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目没有你不行啊，只有你能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: This project can't do without you, only you can handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隊波冇佢符，佢係入波嘅關鍵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi2 bo1 mou5 keoi5 fu4, keoi5 hai6 jap6 bo1 ge3 gwaan1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的队伍没有他不行，他是进球的关键。
examples.english_sentence: Our team can't do without him, he's the key to scoring goals.

synonyms: 唔少得佢 (m4 siu2 dak1 keoi5)

english_meaning: for no reason, without cause, inexplicably
explanation_mandarin: 没有原因，没有来由。
explanation_english: Without any apparent reason or cause; inexplicably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇來由發脾氣，真係唔知佢搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 loi4 jau4 faat3 pei4 hei3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他无缘无故地发脾气，真不知道他在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He flared up for no reason, I really don't know what's wrong with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好冇來由咁鬧人啦，咁樣唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mou5 loi4 jau4 gam2 naau6 jan4 laa1, gam2 joeng2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要无缘无故地骂人，这样不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold people for no reason, it's not good to do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇來由唔覆我短訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 loi4 jau4 m4 fuk1 ngo5 dyun2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他无缘无故不回我短信。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't reply to my text messages for no reason.

english_meaning: no chance; no way; hopeless; impossible
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有机会，事情没有希望成功。通常用于描述某个事情没有可能性，或者某个人没有机会。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no chance or hope for something to succeed. It's commonly used to describe a situation where something is impossible or someone has no opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁多嘢唔識，睇嚟都冇修咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 do1 je5 m4 sik1, tai2 lai4 dou1 mou5 sau1 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么多东西不会，看来都没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know so much in this exam, it seems like there's no chance of passing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格咁差，想追到條女，冇修啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 gam3 caa1, soeng2 zeoi1 dou2 tiu4 neoi2, mou5 sau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格这么差，想追到那个女孩，没戏啦。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is so bad. If he wants to get with that girl, there's no way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗咁耐都未整好，應該冇修要換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mei6 zing2 hou2, jing1 goi1 mou5 sau1 jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑坏了这么久都没修好，应该没戏了，要换新的了。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been broken for so long and hasn't been fixed. It's probably hopeless, we need to replace it with a new one.

english_meaning: Slovenly, messy, unkempt
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不整洁，不修边幅，穿着邋遢。也指地方脏乱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is untidy, unkempt, and slovenly in appearance. Can also refer to a place that is dirty and messy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都冇傝𠎷咁嘅样。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 dap1 dip1 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是邋邋遢遢的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks so slovenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 间房咁冇傝𠎷，执执佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 mou5 dap1 dip1, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么邋遢，收拾一下吧！
examples.english_sentence: The room is so messy, tidy it up!

english_meaning: to lack a sense of propriety; to be tactless; to be inconsiderate; to be clueless (about social norms)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不识大体，说话或做事不得体，不顾及场合或别人的感受。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks a sense of proportion or social awareness; someone who says or does things inappropriately, without considering the occasion or other people's feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都冇分寸，好容易得罪人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 mou5 fan1 cyun3, hou2 jung4 ji6 dak1 zeoi6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是没分寸，很容易得罪人的。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks tactlessly and easily offends people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以講嘢有分寸啲呀？人哋都唔開心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 je5 jau5 fan1 cyun3 di1 aa3? jan4 dei6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话能不能有点分寸啊？人家都不开心了。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please be a bit more considerate when you speak? People are already upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔冇分寸，唔識睇場合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 mou5 fan1 cyun3, m4 sik1 tai2 ho2 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子没分寸，不懂得看场合。
examples.english_sentence: Children lack a sense of propriety and don't know how to read the situation.

english_meaning: didn't arrive; not here; not present; not reaching a certain point
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有到达，没有达到某个程度，或者某人不在场。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone/something didn't arrive, didn't reach a certain level or extent, or someone is not present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日冇到學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 mou5 dou3 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没到学校。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come to school yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工都冇到兩萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 dou1 mou5 dou3 loeng5 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资都没到两万元。
examples.english_sentence: His salary doesn't even reach 20,000 dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日開會，佢冇到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hoi1 wui2, keoi5 mou5 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天开会，他没到。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't present at the meeting yesterday.

english_meaning: Even if there's no achievement, there's still effort involved.
explanation_mandarin: 即使没有做出什么功绩，也付出了辛勤的劳动。表示即使结果不尽如人意，也应该肯定付出。
explanation_english: Even if someone hasn't achieved great success or produced impressive results, they've still put in effort and should be recognized for their work. It acknowledges the value of effort regardless of the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然今次考試唔合格，但佢咁勤力溫書，冇功都有勞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3, daan6 keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6 wan1 syu1, mou5 gung1 dou1 jau5 lou4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然这次考试没及格，但是他这么努力学习，没有功劳也有苦劳。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he failed the exam this time, he studied so hard, so even if he didn't succeed, he still put in the effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事最後都係失敗咗，但係同事都好盡力去做，冇功都有勞，都值得讚賞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 zo2, daan6 hai6 tung4 si6 dou1 hou2 zeon6 lik6 geoi2 zou6, mou5 gung1 dou1 jau5 lou4, dou1 zik6 dak1 zaan3 soeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情最后还是失败了，但是同事们都很努力去做，没有功劳也有苦劳，都值得赞赏。
examples.english_sentence: The matter ultimately failed, but the colleagues did their best, so even if they didn't succeed, they still put in the effort and deserve praise.

english_meaning: not in the mood, have no interest, lack of enthusiasm
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人没有兴致，提不起精神，缺乏做事情的兴趣或动力。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not in the mood, lacks energy, and has no interest or motivation to do things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，我冇厘心機做任何嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 mou5 lei4 sam1 gei1 zou6 jam6 ho2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试之后，我没什么心思做任何事情。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, I'm not in the mood to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似冇厘心機返工，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 mou5 lei4 sam1 gei1 faan1 gung1, seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像没什么心思上班，总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't seem to be in the mood for work, he's always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨，我冇厘心機出去街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 mou5 lei4 sam1 gei1 cheot1 heoi3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨，我没什么心思出去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, I'm not in the mood to go out.

mandarin_meaning: 毫无关联; 不着边际
english_meaning: irrelevant; nonsensical; having no connection; rambling
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或做事毫无关联，不着边际，令人摸不着头脑。
explanation_english: Describes speech or actions that are irrelevant, nonsensical, or lacking a clear connection, leaving people confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢都冇厘搭霎，我完全唔知你想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 ye5 dou1 mou5 lei4 daap3 sap3, ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西都毫无关联，我完全不知道你想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is completely irrelevant, I have no idea what you're trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都冇厘搭霎，聽佢講嘢真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ye5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 lei4 daap3 sap3, teng1 keoi5 gong2 ye5 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是毫无关联，听他说话真的很累。
examples.english_sentence: He often speaks nonsensically, it's really exhausting to listen to him.

english_meaning: not serious, frivolous, lacking proper behavior, not respectable
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事或说话不认真，不严肃，行为举止轻浮。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious in their actions or words, acts frivolously, and lacks proper behavior. It implies a lack of respectability or seriousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日都冇厘正經，講嘢又唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 lei4 zing3 ging1, gong2 je5 jau6 m4 ho2 kao3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人整天都不正经，说话又不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He is never serious and his words are not reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁冇厘正經，點搞得掂啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 mou5 lei4 zing3 ging1, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么不正经，怎么能完成啊？
examples.english_sentence: How can you get it done when you are so unserious in your work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日咁冇厘正經啦，認真啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 gam3 mou5 lei4 zing3 ging1 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是这么不正经，认真一点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be so frivolous, be more serious!

english_meaning: listless, dispirited, lacking vitality, without energy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人精神不振，没有活力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is lacking in energy and vitality, appearing dispirited and without enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日病咗，今日返工都冇厘神氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 beng6 zo2, gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 dou1 mou5 lei4 san4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天生病了，今天上班也没精打采的。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick yesterday, and he's still listless at work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，佢成個人都冇厘神氣，好似放咗電咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 mou5 lei4 san4 hei3, hou2 ci5 fong3 zo2 din6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试之后，他整个人都没精打采的，好像放了电一样。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, he's been so listless, like he's been drained of energy.

english_meaning: listless; spiritless; lacking energy; lacking enthusiasm; not energetic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人缺乏精神，提不起劲，没有活力。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks energy, enthusiasm, or motivation. They seem tired and uninterested in things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日好似冇厘精神咁，係咪唔舒服啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 mou5 lei4 zing1 san4 gam2, hai6 mai6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天好像没精打采的，是不是不舒服啊？
examples.english_sentence: You seem listless today, are you not feeling well?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考完，佢成個人都冇厘精神，想休息吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 jyun4, keoi5 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 mou5 lei4 zing1 san4, soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试，他整个人都没精打采的，想休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: After the exams, he was completely listless and wanted to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢冇厘精神，老闆都唔鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 mou5 lei4 zing1 san4, lou5 baan2 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作没精打采的，老板都不喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He's spiritless at work, and the boss doesn't like it.

english_meaning: Full of loopholes; wide open; undefended
explanation_mandarin: 形容防御措施极其薄弱，到处都是漏洞，很容易被攻破。
explanation_english: Describes a defensive system or situation that is extremely weak and full of loopholes, making it very vulnerable to being breached or exploited.  Literally, it means 'chicken coop without a lid'.  A chicken coop without a lid is easily accessed by predators.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅保安系統冇厴雞籠噉，好容易俾人入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 bou2 on1 hai6 tung2 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4 gam2, hou2 jung4 yi6 bei2 jan4 jap6 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的保安系统漏洞百出，很容易被人入侵。
examples.english_sentence: This company's security system is full of loopholes, making it easy to be hacked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個防守戰術冇厴雞籠，實輸梗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 fong4 sau2 zin3 seot6 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4, sat1 syu1 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的防守战术漏洞百出，肯定会输。
examples.english_sentence: Their defensive tactics are wide open; they're bound to lose.

mandarin_meaning: 没有盖子的鸡笼；比喻说话没有遮拦，什么都说出来
english_meaning: Chicken coop without a lid; figuratively, someone who spills the beans, is indiscreet, or cannot keep a secret.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“没有盖子的鸡笼”。鸡笼没有盖子，里面的东西很容易暴露出来。比喻人说话没有遮拦，什么秘密都说出来，不能保守秘密。
explanation_english: Literally, it means "chicken coop without a lid". Without a lid, the contents of the coop are easily exposed. Figuratively, it describes a person who cannot keep a secret and reveals everything, is indiscreet, or spills the beans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條友真係冇厴鷄籠，乜都同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 jau5 zan1 hai6 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4-2, mat1 dou1 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个人真是大嘴巴，什么都和别人说。
examples.english_sentence: You're such a blabbermouth, you tell everyone everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講秘密呀，佢係冇厴鷄籠嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 bei3 mat6 aa3, keoi5 hai6 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4-2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要告诉他秘密啊，他是个大嘴巴。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell him any secrets, he's a blabbermouth.

english_meaning: untrustworthy; unreliable; one's word cannot be trusted; to go back on one's word
explanation_mandarin: 指说话不算数，不讲信用，答应别人的事情没有做到。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who doesn't keep their word, is untrustworthy, and doesn't fulfill promises made to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都話會幫手，但係次次都冇口齒，下次唔好再信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 waa6 wui5 bong1 sau2, daan6 hai6 ci3 ci3 dou1 mou5 hau2 ci2, haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 seon3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都说会帮忙，但是每次都说话不算数，下次不要再相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he'll help, but he never keeps his word. Don't trust him next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人最緊要講信用，如果唔係就會俾人話冇口齒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 gong2 seon3 jung6, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 mou5 hau2 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人最重要的是讲信用，不然会被人说说话不算数。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in life is to be trustworthy, otherwise people will say you are unreliable.

english_meaning: incomparable; having no basis for comparison
explanation_mandarin: 没有可以比较的性质。指两个或多个事物之间不存在共同点或相似之处，无法进行比较。
explanation_english: Incomparable; lacking any common ground or similar attributes between two or more things, making comparison impossible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅天賦冇可比性，一個係天才，一個係普通人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 tin1 fu3 mou5 ho2 bei2 sing3, jat1 go3 hai6 tin1 coi4, jat1 go3 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的天赋没有可比性，一个是个天才，一个是个普通人。
examples.english_sentence: There's no basis for comparison between their talents. One is a genius, and the other is an average person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將蘋果同橙比，根本就冇可比性㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 ping4 gwo2 tung4 caang2 bei2, gan1 bun2 zau6 mou5 ho2 bei2 sing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将苹果和橘子比，根本就没有可比性。
examples.english_sentence: Comparing apples and oranges, there's simply no basis for comparison.

synonyms: 無法比較 (mou4 faat3 bei2 gaau3)
不能相提并论 (bat1 nang4 soeng1 tai4 bing6 leon4)

jyutping: mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 zai2 coeng3
english_meaning: There's no way; It's not going to happen; Forget about it
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情绝对不可能发生或实现，带有拒绝的语气。比喻希望落空或愿望无法实现。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the impossibility of something happening or being achieved. It carries a tone of refusal and implies that hope is lost or the desired outcome is unattainable. Literally translates to 'There's no such song to sing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔做嘢都攞到錢？冇呢支歌仔唱㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 zou6 je5 dou1 lo2 dou2 cin2? mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 zai2 coeng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不工作就能拿到钱？ 没门儿！
examples.english_sentence: You want to get money without working? Forget about it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔愛你，你仲想同佢結婚？冇呢支歌仔唱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 oi3 nei5, nei5 zung6 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 git3 fan1? mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 zai2 coeng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她都不爱你，你还想和她结婚？不可能的。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't even love you, you still want to marry her? It's not going to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔努力，就想攞第一名？冇呢支歌仔唱㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 nou5 lik6, zau6 soeng2 lo2 dai6 jat1 ming4? mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 zai2 coeng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不努力，就想拿第一名？没门儿！
examples.english_sentence: You want to get first place without any effort? There's no way!

jyutping: mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 coeng3 laa3
mandarin_meaning: 没戏了; 不可能了; 没希望了
english_meaning: There's no hope; it's not going to happen; it's over; that's it
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情已经没有希望，无法实现，或者情况已经无可挽回。
explanation_english: Expresses that there is no hope for something, it is impossible to achieve, or the situation is beyond recovery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬咗，冇呢支歌唱喇，下次再努力啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2 zo2, mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 coeng3 laa3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格了，没戏了，下次再努力吧。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam, there's no hope now, try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約傾唔成，睇嚟冇呢支歌唱喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 king1 m4 sing4, tai2 lai4 mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 coeng3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同没谈成，看来没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: The contract couldn't be negotiated, it seems there's no hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊電腦壞咗，整都整唔返，冇呢支歌唱喇，買過部新嘅算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, zing2 dou1 zing2 m4 faan1, mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 coeng3 laa3, maai5 gwo3 bou6 san1 ge3 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑坏了，修也修不好了，没戏了，买个新的算了。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer is broken and can't be repaired, there's no hope, let's just buy a new one.

english_meaning: lifeless; to lose one's life; to be dead; to be extremely tired/exhausted; extremely (in degree)
explanation_mandarin: 本义是指失去生命，死亡。引申为非常疲惫，筋疲力尽。也可表示程度极深，相当于“非常”、“极其”。
explanation_english: Literally means to lose one's life or to be dead. Figuratively, it can mean to be extremely tired, exhausted, or drained. It can also indicate a very high degree, similar to "extremely" or "very".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢做到冇命咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 zou6 dou3 mou5 meng6 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作做得快没命了。
examples.english_sentence: He worked so hard he almost died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日行街行到我冇命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 haang4 gaai1 haang4 dou3 ngo5 mou5 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天逛街逛得我快没命了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm exhausted from shopping today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辣到我冇命呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: laat6 dou3 ngo5 mou5 meng6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辣死我了！
examples.english_sentence: It's so spicy, it's killing me!

english_meaning: You can't pay back a life; cannot be compensated with life
explanation_mandarin: 指失去的生命是无法用任何东西来补偿的，表示事情非常严重，后果非常严重，无法挽回。
explanation_english: Refers to the fact that a lost life cannot be compensated with anything. Indicates that something is very serious, with severe and irreversible consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做遲早會出事，到時就真係冇命賠㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6, dou3 si4 zau6 zan1 hai6 mou5 ming6 pui4 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样下去迟早会出事，到时候就真的无法偿还性命了！
examples.english_sentence: If you continue like this, something bad will happen sooner or later. Then you really won't be able to pay back a life!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸車唔可以飲酒，一旦發生意外，冇命賠㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 ce1 m4 ho2 ji5 jam2 zau2, jat1 daan3 faat3 sang1 ji3 ngoi6, mou5 ming6 pui4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车不可以喝酒，一旦发生意外，没命赔偿的！
examples.english_sentence: You can't drink and drive. If an accident happens, you can't compensate with a life!

cantonese: 冇咁大個頭就唔好戴咁大頂帽
jyutping: mou5 gam3 daai6 go3 tau4 zau6 m4 hou2 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou6
mandarin_meaning: 没有那么大的头就不要戴那么大的帽子
english_meaning: Don't wear a hat that's too big for your head; Don't bite off more than you can chew; Don't try to do more than you are capable of.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻能力不足，不要承担超出自己能力范围的事情。意思是说没有那么大的能力就不要承担过重的责任或者做超出自己能力范围的事情。
explanation_english: This idiom is a metaphor meaning that you shouldn't take on responsibilities or tasks that are beyond your capabilities. It's like saying 'Don't bite off more than you can chew'. It emphasizes the importance of knowing your limitations and not overreaching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，但係又想做經理，真係冇咁大個頭就唔好戴咁大頂帽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 soeng2 zou6 ging1 lei5, zan1 hai6 mou5 gam3 daai6 go3 tau4 zau6 m4 hou2 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，但是又想当经理，真是没有那么大的头就不要戴那么大的帽子。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he wants to be a manager, he's really trying to wear a hat that's too big for his head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都未做過呢啲嘢，唔好應承得咁快，冇咁大個頭就唔好戴咁大頂帽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 mei6 zou6 gwo3 ni1 di1 je5, m4 hou2 ying3 sing4 dak1 gam3 faai3, mou5 gam3 daai6 go3 tau4 zau6 m4 hou2 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都没做过这些事，不要答应得这么快，没有那么大的头就不要戴那么大的帽子了。
examples.english_sentence: You haven't done these things before, don't agree so quickly, don't bite off more than you can chew.

synonyms: 量力而為 (loeng6 lik6 ji4 wai4)

cantonese: 冇咁大個頭，唔好戴咁大頂帽
jyutping: mou5 gam3 daai6 go3 tau4, m4 hou2 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou2
mandarin_meaning: 没有那么大的能力，就不要承担那么大的责任
english_meaning: Don't wear a hat that's too big for your head; don't bite off more than you can chew; don't overextend yourself.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人没有那么大的能力或资格，就不要承担超出自己能力范围的责任或做超出自己能力范围的事情。
explanation_english: This idiom means that one should not take on responsibilities or try to do things that are beyond their capabilities or qualifications. It's a warning against overconfidence and overcommitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，就想做經理，真係冇咁大個頭，唔好戴咁大頂帽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, zau6 soeng2 zou6 ging1 lei5, zan1 hai6 mou5 gam3 daai6 go3 tau4, m4 hou2 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，就想当经理，真是没有那么大的能力，就不要承担那么大的责任了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything and wants to be a manager. He really shouldn't bite off more than he can chew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你連份工都未做熟，就諗住升職，唔好咁快戴咁大頂帽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lin4 fan6 gung1 dou1 mei6 zou6 suk6, zau6 lam2 zyu6 sing1 zik1, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 daai3 gam3 daai6 ding2 mou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你连这份工作都还没做熟练，就想着升职，不要这么快承担那么大的责任。
examples.english_sentence: You haven't even mastered this job yet, and you're already thinking about a promotion. Don't wear a hat that's too big too soon.

synonyms: 量力而为 (loeng4 lik6 ji4 wai4 - do what you are capable of doing)
唔好眼高手低 (m4 hou2 ngaan5 gou1 sau2 dai1 - don't be high-eyed and low-handed; don't be overly ambitious and lack practical skills)

jyutping: mou5 gam3 daai6 zek3 gap3 naa5 ceoi4 gaai1 tiu3
mandarin_meaning: 没有那么大的癞蛤蟆随便在街上跳；天下没有白吃的午餐
english_meaning: There aren't such big toads hopping around on the street; there's no such thing as a free lunch.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是不会有那么大的蛤蟆在街上乱跳。比喻天下没有白吃的午餐，不要期望天上掉馅饼，指不劳而获的事情是不可能发生的。
explanation_english: Literally: There aren't such big toads hopping around on the street. Figuratively: There's no such thing as a free lunch; don't expect something for nothing. It implies that getting something without effort is impossible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔使做就有錢收？冇咁大隻蛤乸隨街跳啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 sai2 zou6 zau6 jau5 cin2 sau1? mou5 gam3 daai6 zek3 gap3 naa5 ceoi4 gaai1 tiu3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想要不用工作就有钱拿？天下没有白吃的午餐！
examples.english_sentence: You want to get paid without working? There's no such thing as a free lunch!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪諗住買六合彩會中頭獎，冇咁大隻蛤乸隨街跳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 lam2 zyu2 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 wui5 zung3 tau4 zoeng2, mou5 gam3 daai6 zek3 gap3 naa5 ceoi4 gaai1 tiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着买彩票会中头奖，哪有那么好的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that you'll win the jackpot buying lottery tickets. There's no such thing as free lunch.

mandarin_meaning: 没那么好的事; 没有那么便宜的事; 没有那么容易的事
english_meaning: It's not that easy; It's not going to be that simple; It's not as good as it sounds; There's a catch
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情并非像表面看起来那么容易或美好，通常暗示存在隐藏的困难或条件。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things are not as easy or good as they appear on the surface, often implying hidden difficulties or conditions. It suggests skepticism about an overly optimistic assessment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估佢真係會咁好死，送層樓俾你咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 keoi5 zan1 hai6 wui5 gam3 hou2 sei2, sung3 cung4 lau2 bei2 nei5 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为他真的会那么好心，送一套房子给你吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think he's really going to be that generous and give you an apartment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話考試一定合格，我諗都冇咁好死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 haau2 si5 jat1 ding6 hap6 gaak3, ngo5 lam2 dou1 mou5 gam3 hou2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说考试一定及格，我觉得没有那么容易。
examples.english_sentence: He says he'll definitely pass the exam, but I don't think it's going to be that easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日升職加人工？冇咁好死呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 sing1 zik1 gaa1 jan4 gung1? mou5 gam3 hou2 sei2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天升职加薪？没有那么好的事吧！
examples.english_sentence: Promoted and get a raise tomorrow? It's not going to be that easy!

english_meaning: not in a good mood; lacking patience; not being so tolerant; losing patience
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事感到不耐烦，心情不好，没有好脸色。
explanation_english: Expresses impatience or irritation with someone or something, indicating a lack of tolerance or a bad mood. It suggests one is not being very friendly or patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再咁樣搞落去，我就冇咁好氣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 gaau2 lok6 heoi3, ngo5 zau6 mou5 gam3 hou2 hei3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再这样下去，我就没什么好气了。
examples.english_sentence: If you continue like this, I won't be so patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，我對佢都冇咁好氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 dou1 mou5 gam3 hou2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，我对他也变得不耐烦了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, so I'm not very patient with him anymore.

english_meaning: not so angry; less angry
explanation_mandarin: 表示不再那么生气，愤怒程度有所减轻。
explanation_english: Indicates a decrease in anger, meaning no longer as angry as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先仲好嬲，而家冇咁嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 zung6 hou2 nau1, ji4 gaa1 mou5 gam3 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才还很生气，现在没那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: I was very angry just now, but I'm not so angry anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 解釋完之後，佢冇咁嬲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai2 sik1 jyun4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 mou5 gam3 nau1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 解释完之后，他没那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: After the explanation, he's not so angry anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完你咁講，我冇咁嬲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 nei5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 mou5 gam3 nau1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完你这么说，我没那么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing what you said, I'm less angry.

english_meaning: lost, gone, missing, disappeared
explanation_mandarin: 表示失去，消失，不存在。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is lost, gone, missing, or no longer exists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本書唔見咗，唔知喺邊度冇咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 syu1 m4 gin3 zo2, m4 zi1 hai2 bin1 dou6 mou5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的书不见了，不知道在哪里丢了。
examples.english_sentence: My book is missing. I don't know where it got lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工冇咗，要搵過份新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 mou5 zo2, jiu3 wan2 gwo3 fan6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他丢了工作，要找一份新的。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his job and needs to find a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢唔見咗，唔知係咪俾人偷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 m4 gin3 zo2, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不见了，不知道是不是被人偷了。
examples.english_sentence: The money is missing. I wonder if someone stole it.

mandarin_meaning: 算了；事情过去了；当没发生过
english_meaning: Forget about it; It's over; Let it go; Consider it done/resolved
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事已经结束，或者被放弃不再追究，可以理解为“算了”、“没事了”、“事情解决了”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is over, forgotten, or resolved. It can be used to dismiss a matter, or to assure someone that a problem has been taken care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使再擔心啦，冇咗件事喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zoi3 daam1 sam1 laa1, mou5 zo2 gin6 si6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用再担心了，事情已经过去了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about it anymore, it's over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔追究，即係冇咗件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 zeoi1 gau3, zik1 hai6 mou5 zo2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说不再追究，那就是算了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he won't pursue it, so it's forgotten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你搞掂佢，冇咗件事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, mou5 zo2 gin6 si6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你搞定它，事情就解决了。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take care of it for you, consider it done.

english_meaning: not very useful; of little use; not of much use
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物没有什么大的用处，价值不高。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not very useful or valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊電腦冇咩大用喇，不如掉咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau6 din6 nou5 mou5 me1 daai6 jung6 laa3, bat1 jyu4 diu6 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑没什么大用了，不如扔了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer is not very useful anymore, let's just throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅建議聽落好似冇咩大用，不過都係多謝佢嘅一番心意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5 ting1 lok6 hou2 ci5 mou5 me1 daai6 jung6, bat1 gwo3 dou1 hai6 do1 ze6 keoi5 ge3 jat1 faan1 sam1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的建议听起来好像没什么大用，不过还是谢谢他的一番心意。
examples.english_sentence: His suggestion doesn't seem very useful, but I still appreciate his effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲免費贈品，雖然話免費，但係其實都冇咩大用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 min5 fai3 zang6 ban2, seoi1 jin4 waa6 min5 fai3, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 dou1 mou5 me1 daai6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些免费赠品，虽然说是免费的，但其实都没什么大用。
examples.english_sentence: These freebies, although they're free, are actually not very useful.

synonyms: 唔係好掂 (m4 hai6 hou2 dim6)
唔係好使得 (m4 hai6 hou2 sai2 dak1)

english_meaning: Lack of manners; bad character; poor taste; classless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人缺乏道德修养、素质低下，或者行为粗鲁、没有礼貌。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks good manners, has poor character, or behaves rudely and without consideration for others. Implies a lack of class or sophistication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公眾場合大聲講電話，真係冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 zung3 coeng4 hap6 daai6 seng1 gong2 din6 waa2, zan1 hai6 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公共场合大声讲电话，真没品。
examples.english_sentence: He was talking loudly on the phone in public, it's really bad manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同啲冇品嘅人交往，會影響自己嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 di1 mou5 ban2 ge3 jan4 gaau1 wong6, wui5 ying2 hoeng2 zi6 gei2 ge3 seng1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和没品的人交往，会影响自己的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: Don't associate with people who lack manners, it will affect your own reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着衫啲taste好冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 di1 te1si3 hou2 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的穿着品味很差。
examples.english_sentence: His taste in clothing is very poor/classless.

english_meaning: No problem; Not a problem; It's okay; Sure; You're welcome
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意、没关系、没问题、可以接受等意思。
explanation_english: Indicates agreement, no problem, it's okay, acceptable, etc. A common and versatile phrase used to express assent or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我拎住呢袋嘢啊？冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 zyu6 ni1 doi6 je5 aa3? mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我拿着这个袋子吗？没问题。
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me hold this bag? No problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日晏啲到得唔得啊？ 冇問題，你話幾點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 aan3 di1 dou3 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3? mou5 man6 tai4, nei5 waa6 gei2 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天晚点到可以吗？没问题，你说几点？
examples.english_sentence: Is it okay to arrive a bit later tomorrow? No problem, what time are you thinking?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該曬！ 冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3! mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你！不客气。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you! You're welcome/No problem.

english_meaning: There's nothing good to eat; There's nothing worth eating
explanation_mandarin: 形容没有好的或令人满意的食物可以吃。表达对食物质量的不满或失望。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is no good or satisfying food to eat. It expresses dissatisfaction or disappointment with the quality of food available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳真係冇啖好食，下次都唔嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zan1 hai6 mou5 daam6 hou2 sik6, haa6 ci3 dou1 m4 lai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅真的没什么好吃的，下次都不来了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant really has nothing good to eat. I won't come here next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間間鋪頭都執笠，成條街都冇啖好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 dou1 zap1 lap1, seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 mou5 daam6 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每家店铺都倒闭了，整条街都没什么好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Every shop is closing down. There's nothing worth eating on the whole street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病咗之後，咩嘢都冇啖好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, me1 je5 dou1 mou5 daam6 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生病之后，什么东西都觉得不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: After getting sick, everything tastes bad (there's nothing good to eat).

english_meaning: Totally unrelated, completely irrelevant, not connected at all
explanation_mandarin: 形容两件事物之间没有任何关系或关联，完全不相干。
explanation_english: Describes that there is no relationship or connection between two things, completely irrelevant. It emphasizes the total lack of connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事同你冇啦冇掕，你唔使理咁多嘅。
