examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 tung4 nei5 mou5 laa1 mou5 lang3, nei5 m4 sai2 lei5 gam3 do1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事和你毫无关系，你不用管这么多。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is completely unrelated to you, you don't need to worry about it so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅意見冇啦冇掕，傾落去都冇意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3 mou5 laa1 mou5 lang3, king1 lok6 heoi3 dou1 mou5 yi3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的意见毫无关系，再谈下去也没意思。
examples.english_sentence: Our opinions are completely unrelated, there's no point in continuing the discussion.

mandarin_meaning: 没关系；没关联；无关紧要
english_meaning: irrelevant; not related; not connected; doesn't matter; none of your business
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或事情没有关联，不重要，或者表示不用理会，无关紧要。
explanation_english: Describes something that is irrelevant, not related, unimportant, or expresses that it doesn't matter and should be ignored. It can also convey 'none of your business' depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢同呢件事冇啦掕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 tung4 ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 laa1 ling1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的和这件事没关系。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is not related to this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問咁多做咩啫？冇啦掕啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 gam3 do1 zou6 me1 ze1? mou5 laa1 ling1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问这么多干什么？没关系啦！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you asking so much? It's none of your business!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫到冇啦掕咁，都唔知想表達啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 mou5 laa1 ling1 gam3, dou1 m4 zi1 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得乱七八糟，都不知道想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written irrelevantly; I don't even know what it's trying to express.

english_meaning: to have no hobbies; lacking hobbies
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人没有任何特别的兴趣或爱好。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who does not have any particular interests or hobbies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己冇嗜好，日日都係屋企瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 si3 hou3, jat1 jat1 dou1 hai6 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己没有爱好，每天都在家睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: He says he has no hobbies and just sleeps at home every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢冇嗜好，生活好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 mou5 si3 hou3, sang1 wut6 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他没有爱好，生活很闷。
examples.english_sentence: I think he has no hobbies, and his life is boring.

jyutping: mou5 go2 joeng2 zing2 go2 joeng2
english_meaning: To create trouble where there is none; to make a fuss over nothing; to add trouble on top of no trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指本来没事，却故意制造事端；本无事端，却自找麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately creating problems where there are none; looking for trouble when there is none to begin with. Often implies meddling or being overly concerned with something insignificant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都搞掂晒啲嘢啦，仲要點搞啊？咪鬼冇嗰樣整嗰樣啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5 laa1, zung6 jiu3 dim2 gaau2 aa3? mai5 gwai2 mou5 go2 joeng2 zing2 go2 joeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都已经把事情都做完了，还要怎么做啊？别没事找事了！
examples.english_sentence: You've already finished everything, what else do you want to do? Don't go looking for trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日冇嗰樣整嗰樣，搞到大家都好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mou5 go2 joeng2 zing2 go2 joeng2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常没事找事，搞得大家都很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He always creates trouble where there is none, making things difficult for everyone.

english_meaning: nothing, it's nothing, it's okay, no problem
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有东西，或者用于回应别人的道歉或感谢，表示“没关系”。
explanation_english: Literally means 'nothing'. It is often used as a response to an apology or expression of gratitude, meaning 'it's nothing', 'it's okay', or 'no problem'. It can also mean 'there's nothing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，撞到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, zong6 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，撞到你了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I bumped into you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇嘢，我冇事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 je5, ngo5 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没事，我没事。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay, I'm alright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日做緊乜嘢啊？冇嘢做啊，喺屋企hea緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3? mou5 je5 zou6 aa3, hai2 uk1 kei2 hea1 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天在做什么啊？没什么事做，在家闲待着。
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing today? Nothing much, just chilling at home.

english_meaning: nothing to say; no comment; speechless
explanation_mandarin: 表示无话可说，可能是因为事情已经很明显，或者不想进一步讨论。
explanation_english: Expresses that there is nothing more to say, often indicating that the matter is obvious, the speaker doesn't want to discuss it further, or that the speaker is speechless due to surprise or disagreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做錯咗咁多嘢，我真係冇嘢好講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 co3 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 je5 hou2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做了这么多错事，我真的没什么好说的。
examples.english_sentence: You've done so many wrong things, I really have nothing to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢攞冠軍，我興奮到冇嘢好講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou3 keoi5 lo2 gwun3 gwan1, ngo5 hing3 fan5 dou3 mou5 je5 hou2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他得了冠军，我兴奋得说不出话来。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him win the championship, I was so excited that I was speechless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣對我，我都冇嘢好講㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 mou5 je5 hou2 gong2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样对我，我也没有什么好说的了。
examples.english_sentence: After you treat me like this, I have nothing more to say.

mandarin_meaning: 无事生非, 没事找事
english_meaning: To stir up trouble for no reason; to make trouble out of nothing; to be a troublemaker.
explanation_mandarin: 指没事找事，无缘无故地制造麻烦或事端。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who makes trouble for no reason, creates problems or incidents without any cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都冇嚟搭霎，搞到成間公司都雞犬不寧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 lai4 daap3 sap3, gaau2 dou3 seng4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 gai1 hyun2 bat1 ning4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是无事生非，搞得整个公司都鸡犬不宁。
examples.english_sentence: He always stirs up trouble, making the whole company chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好冇嚟搭霎啦，我哋都夠忙㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mou5 lai4 daap3 sap3 laa1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 gau3 mong4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要无事生非了，我们都够忙的了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make trouble for no reason, we are already busy enough.

mandarin_meaning: 没精打采; 提不起精神
english_meaning: listless; spiritless; dispirited; lethargic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人没有精神，提不起劲头。形容精神状态不佳。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is lacking energy and enthusiasm. Used to describe a poor mental or physical state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日做乜嘢咁冇嚟神氣啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 mou5 lai4 san4 hei3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天怎么这么没精打采的？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so listless today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後，成個人都冇晒嚟神氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 mou5 saai3 lai4 san4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病之后，整个人都提不起精神。
examples.english_sentence: After he got sick, he lost all his spirit.

mandarin_meaning: 没有立足之地; 无容身之处
english_meaning: nowhere to stand; no place to stand; no foothold; no standing; untenable; no room to manoeuvre
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“没有地方站立”。比喻没有立足之地，没有容身之处，形容处境艰难或情况非常糟糕。
explanation_english: Literal meaning is "no place to stand." Figuratively, it means having no foothold, no place to belong or a situation where one is in a very difficult or precarious position. It suggests a lack of support, opportunity, or acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟咁差，好多細公司都冇埞企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 sai3 gung1 si1 dou1 mou5 dei6 kei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济这么差，很多小公司都没有立足之地了。
examples.english_sentence: With the economy so bad, many small companies have no place to stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司得罪晒啲人，而家冇埞企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 dak1 zeoi2 saai3 di1 jan4, ji4 gaa1 mou5 dei6 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司得罪了所有人，现在没有容身之处。
examples.english_sentence: He offended everyone in the company, and now he has nowhere to stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我唔努力啲，喺呢個行業就真係冇埞企㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 m4 nou5 lik6 di1, hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 zau6 zan1 hai6 mou5 dei6 kei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我不更加努力，在这个行业就真的没有立足之地了。
examples.english_sentence: If I don't work harder, I really won't have a foothold in this industry.

english_meaning: not bad; no harm; nothing wrong; it's okay; it's fine
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有什么坏处或问题，可以接受，或者还可以的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no harm or problem, it is acceptable, or it is okay. Can be used as an adjective to describe something as 'not bad' or as an adverb to indicate that something is 'fine' or 'okay'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試下都冇壞嘅，最多咪失敗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 haa5 dou1 mou5 waai6 ge3, zeoi3 do1 mai6 sat1 baai6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试一下也没什么坏处，最多就是失败嘛。
examples.english_sentence: There's no harm in trying, at worst we'll just fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得呢個方法點樣？ 冇壞喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 dim2 joeng2? mou5 waai6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得这个方法怎么样？ 不错啊。
examples.english_sentence: What do you think of this method? Not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢肯幫手，咁咪冇壞囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 hang2 bong1 sau2, gam2 mai6 mou5 waai6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他肯帮忙，那就没坏处了。
examples.english_sentence: If he's willing to help, then there's no harm done.

english_meaning: lacking respect for elders or superiors; not knowing one's place; disrespectful; without any sense of hierarchy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人没有礼貌，不尊重长辈或上级，不分尊卑。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks respect for elders or superiors, doesn't understand hierarchy or proper social etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣同老細講嘢，真係冇大冇細！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 mou5 daai6 mou5 sai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样跟老板说话，真是没大没小！
examples.english_sentence: Speaking to your boss like that is really disrespectful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔而家真係冇大冇細，同阿爺阿嫲都咁大聲講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 mou5 daai6 mou5 sai3, tung4 aa3 je4 aa3 maa4 dou1 gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的小孩子真是没大没小，跟爷爷奶奶都这么大声说话。
examples.english_sentence: Kids these days really have no respect for elders, speaking so loudly to their grandparents.

synonyms: 唔識尊重 (m4 sik1 zyun1 zung6)
目無尊長 (muk6 mou4 zyun1 zoeng2)

english_meaning: To be struck by lightning; to be punished by heaven; to deserve divine retribution.
explanation_mandarin: 指作恶多端的人，最终会受到天谴，不得好死。是一种诅咒，表示对某人行为的极端厌恶。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who has committed many evil deeds and will eventually be punished by heaven. It is a curse, expressing extreme disgust for someone's actions. It implies that the person deserves to be punished by a higher power or fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣呃人錢，遲早冇天收！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 joeng2 aak1 jan4 cin2, ci4 zou2 mou5 tin1 sau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样骗人钱，迟早会遭天谴的！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep scamming people like this, you'll be struck by lightning sooner or later!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咁多壞事，真係冇天收！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gam3 do1 waai6 si6, zan1 hai6 mou5 tin1 sau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，真是会遭天谴的！
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things, he really deserves to be punished by heaven!

mandarin_meaning: 没有天理; 不讲道理;无法无天
english_meaning: unreasonable; outrageous; preposterous; devoid of conscience; behaving lawlessly
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事极其不合理，不讲道理，令人无法接受。带有强烈的负面情绪，表示对某件事或人的行为非常不满。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as extremely unreasonable, outrageous, and unacceptable. It carries a strong negative emotion, expressing great dissatisfaction with a particular event or person's behavior. It implies a lack of moral compass or any regard for fairness or justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣屈人，真係冇天裝！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 wat1 jan4, zan1 hai6 mou5 tin1 zong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样冤枉人，真是没有天理！
examples.english_sentence: The way he's framing people is outrageous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日拖糧，簡直冇天裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 to1 loeng4, gaan2 zik6 mou5 tin1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司经常拖欠工资，简直是无法无天。
examples.english_sentence: That company is always delaying salary payments; it's simply preposterous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做埋啲咁冇天裝嘅事，小心有報應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 maai4 di1 gam2 mou5 tin1 zong1 ge3 si6, siu2 sam1 jau5 bou3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做了那些不讲道理的事情，小心有报应。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful of karma, doing such unreasonable things.

jyutping: mou5 tin1 zong1 mou5 dei6 zong3
english_meaning: To die without a burial place; to be utterly ruined; to suffer a terrible fate with no one to bury you.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人作恶多端，死后也不会有人收尸埋葬，下场极其悲惨。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has committed so many evil deeds that after death, no one will claim their body for burial. It implies a terrible end and complete ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，遲早會搞到冇天裝冇地葬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, ci4 zou2 wui5 gaau2 dou3 mou5 tin1 zong1 mou5 dei6 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，迟早会落得死无葬身之地。
examples.english_sentence: He's so awful that sooner or later he'll end up dying without a burial place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再咁樣做落去，第日實冇天裝冇地葬㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 zou6 lok6 heoi3, dai6 jat6 sat1 mou5 tin1 zong1 mou5 dei6 zong3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再这样下去，将来一定会死无葬身之地！
examples.english_sentence: If you continue like this, you'll definitely end up dying without a burial place one day!

jyutping: mou5 tin1 zong1 mou5 dei6 zoi3
english_meaning: Unpardonable; atrocious; so wicked that heaven and earth cannot tolerate it; beyond all redemption
explanation_mandarin: 形容罪恶深重，天地都无法容纳。
explanation_english: Describes an act or a person's behavior as so heinous or wicked that it cannot be tolerated by heaven and earth, signifying a transgression beyond redemption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅嘢真係冇天裝冇地載，點可以原諒佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 mou5 tin1 zong1 mou5 dei6 zoi3, dim2 ho2 ji5 jyun4 loeng6 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情简直是罪大恶极，怎么可以原谅他呢？
examples.english_sentence: What he did is truly unpardonable. How can we forgive him?

synonyms: 罪大惡極 (zeoi6 daai6 ok3 gik6)

english_meaning: Impossible; No way; Highly unlikely
explanation_mandarin: 表示可能性极低，几乎不可能发生的事情。
explanation_english: Expresses a very low probability or something that is almost impossible to happen. Used to indicate disbelief or strong doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試次次都唔溫書，今次想攞A？冇奶油啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 ci3 ci3 dou1 m4 wan1 syu1, gam1 ci3 soeng2 lo2 ei1? mou5 naai5 jau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次考试都不复习，这次想拿A？不可能吧！
examples.english_sentence: He never studies for exams, and he wants to get an A this time? No way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雪？ 冇奶油啊，香港好少落雪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 syut3? mou5 naai5 jau4 aa3, hoeng1 gong2 hou2 siu2 lok6 syut3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雪？不可能吧，香港很少下雪的。
examples.english_sentence: Snowing tomorrow? No way, it rarely snows in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: Impatient; annoyed; in a bad mood (often expressed in tone or manner)
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情不好，态度不耐烦、不友善。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being in a bad mood and behaving impatiently or unfriendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問親佢嘢，佢都冇好氣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 cin1 keoi5 je5, keoi5 dou1 mou5 hou2 hei3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你每次问他问题，他都没好气的。
examples.english_sentence: Every time you ask him something, he's impatient and annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕住出門口，你唔好咁多嘢講啦，冇好氣㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 ceot1 mun4 hau2, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 je5 gong2 laa1, mou5 hou2 hei3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶着出门，你别说那么多，我很烦躁！
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a rush to leave. Don't talk so much, I'm getting impatient!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔知點解冇好氣，你小心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 mou5 hou2 hei3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不知道为什么没好气，你小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: He's in a bad mood today for some reason, be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 站不稳; 没有主见; 犹豫不决
english_meaning: Unstable; unsteady; indecisive; lacking a firm stand; wavering
explanation_mandarin: 形容人站立不稳，也比喻人没有主见，立场不坚定，犹豫不决。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is physically unstable or unsteady. Figuratively, it describes someone who is indecisive, lacking a firm stand, or wavering in their opinions or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人冇定企，成日變嚟變去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 mou5 ding6 kei5, sing4 jat6 bin3 lai4 bin3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人没有主见，总是变来变去。
examples.english_sentence: He is an indecisive person, always changing his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗咁多酒，你都冇定企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 zo2 gam3 do1 zau2, nei5 dou1 mou5 ding6 kei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了这么多酒，你都站不稳了吧。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking so much alcohol, you can't even stand straight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺投資方面，唔可以咁冇定企，要做好功課先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 tau4 zi1 fong1 min6, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 mou5 ding6 kei5, jiu3 zou2 hou2 gung1 fo3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在投资方面，不可以这么犹豫不决，要先做好功课。
examples.english_sentence: When it comes to investment, you can't be so indecisive, you need to do your homework first.

english_meaning: unstable; fickle; lacking perseverance; unreliable; flighty
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人缺乏耐心和恒心，容易改变主意或兴趣，做事不稳重。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks patience and perseverance, is easily swayed or changes interests frequently, and is generally unreliable and not serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好冇定性，做嘢成日轉嚟轉去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 mou5 ding6 sing3, zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 zyun2 lai4 zyun2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很不稳重，做事总是变来变去。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very fickle person, always changing his mind when doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁冇定性，點可以托付重任俾你啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 mou5 ding6 sing3, dim2 ho2 ji5 tok3 fu6 cung5 jam6 bei2 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不定性，怎么可以把重任托付给你呢？
examples.english_sentence: How can we entrust you with important responsibilities when you are so unreliable?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候好冇定性，大個咗就定性好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 mou5 ding6 sing3, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 ding6 sing3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候很不稳重，长大后就稳重多了。
examples.english_sentence: He was very flighty when he was young, but he is much more settled now that he's grown up.

synonyms: 三分鐘熱度 (saam1 fan1 zung1 jit6 dou6)

mandarin_meaning: 不一定; 说不准; 没准
english_meaning: not sure; uncertain; cannot be determined; unpredictable
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定，不能确定地说某个事情一定会发生或一定是这样。通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Indicates uncertainty; cannot be definitively said that something will happen or is necessarily the case. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會唔會落雨？冇定準㗎，睇天氣報告啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 lok6 jyu5? mou5 ding6 zeon2 gaa3, tai2 tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会不会下雨？说不准，看天气预报吧。
examples.english_sentence: Will it rain tomorrow? It's not certain, check the weather forecast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會唔會嚟？冇定準，佢成日都咁鬼隨便嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 lei4? mou5 ding6 zeon2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 gwai2 ceoi4 bin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会不会来？说不准，他总是这么随便的。
examples.english_sentence: Will he come? It's uncertain, he's always so casual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽邊個贏？冇定準㗎，人人都有機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 bin1 go3 wing4? mou5 ding6 zeon2 gaa3, jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛谁会赢？说不准，每个人都有机会。
examples.english_sentence: Who will win this competition? It's uncertain, everyone has a chance.

english_meaning: harmless, innocuous
explanation_mandarin: 没有害处，不会造成危害。
explanation_english: Without harm; not causing damage or danger; harmless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥膏冇害嘅，搽喺傷口度冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 gou1 mou5 hoi6 ge3, caa1 hai2 soeng1 hau2 dou6 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个药膏是无害的，涂在伤口上没问题。
examples.english_sentence: This ointment is harmless; it's okay to apply it on the wound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲色素都係天然嘅，對身體冇害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sik1 sou3 dou1 hai6 tin1 jin4 ge3, deoi3 san1 tai2 mou5 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些色素都是天然的，对身体没有害处。
examples.english_sentence: These colorings are all natural and harmless to the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢雖然唔好聽，但係都冇害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 seoi1 jin4 m4 hou2 teng1, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的东西虽然不好听，但是也没有害处。
examples.english_sentence: What he said may not be pleasant to hear, but it's not harmful.

english_meaning: ill-mannered; badly brought up; lacking upbringing; no manners
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏家庭教育，行为举止没有礼貌或不合规矩。
explanation_english: Refers to a lack of proper upbringing or family education, resulting in impolite or inappropriate behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公共場所大聲講嘢，真係冇家教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 gung1 coeng4 so2 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 mou5 gaa1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公共场所大声说话，真没家教。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks loudly in public places, he really has no manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣對長輩講嘢，真係冇家教㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 zoeng2 bui3 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 mou5 gaa1 gaau3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样对长辈说话，真没家教啊！
examples.english_sentence: The way you talk to elders is really ill-mannered!

mandarin_meaning: 半途而废, 有始无终
english_meaning: To start something but not finish it; to start something with a bang but quickly lose interest; a flash in the pan.
explanation_mandarin: 烧猪本来有尾巴，但“冇尾烧猪”指烧猪没有尾巴。比喻做事有头无尾，虎头蛇尾。
explanation_english: Literally, 'a roast pig without a tail'. A roast pig is typically roasted whole with its tail. This idiom describes someone who starts something enthusiastically but quickly loses interest and doesn't finish it. It signifies lacking perseverance and failing to complete a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學嘢成日都冇尾燒豬，學咗幾日就唔想學啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 mei5 siu1 zyu1, hok6 zo2 gei2 jat6 zau6 m4 soeng2 hok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学东西总是半途而废，学了几天就不想学了。
examples.english_sentence: He always starts things with enthusiasm but never finishes them. He learns something for a few days and then doesn't want to learn anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃搞咗一陣就冇聲氣，真係冇尾燒豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gaau2 zo2 jat1 zan6 zau6 mou5 seng1 hei3, zan1 hai6 mou5 mei5 siu1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划搞了一阵子就没消息了，真是半途而废。
examples.english_sentence: This project was started and then there was no more news about it. It really started with a bang and ended with a whimper.

synonyms: 虎頭蛇尾 (fu2 tau4 se4 mei5)

cantonese: 冇尾燒豬 - 唔慌好事
jyutping: mou5 mei5 siu1 zyu1 -- m4 fong1 hou2 si6
mandarin_meaning: 不会有好事情发生；来者不善
english_meaning: Something bad is definitely going to happen; something is fishy; not a good sign
explanation_mandarin: “冇尾烧猪”指没有尾巴的烤乳猪。在传统祭祀仪式中，烤乳猪必须是完整的，有头有尾。如果烤乳猪没有尾巴，说明事情不顺利，可能发生不好的事情。因此，用这句话来形容事情的预兆不好，肯定会有坏事发生。
explanation_english: "Mou mei siu zyu" refers to a roasted piglet without a tail. In traditional sacrificial rituals, the roasted piglet must be complete, with both head and tail. If the roasted piglet is missing a tail, it indicates that things are not going smoothly and something bad might happen. Therefore, this phrase is used to describe a bad omen, suggesting that something bad is definitely going to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁鬼鼠，冇尾燒豬，唔慌好事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 gwai2 syu2, mou5 mei5 siu1 zyu1, m4 fong1 hou2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们鬼鬼祟祟的，肯定没好事。
examples.english_sentence: They're being so sneaky, it's definitely not a good sign; something bad is going to happen.

synonyms: 凶多吉少 (hung1 do1 gat1 siu2)

mandarin_meaning: 断了线的风筝，一去不复返
english_meaning: A kite without a string; gone forever; never to return; unreliable; irresponsible (person).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一去不回，失去了控制的事物或人。也形容不负责任，到处乱跑，不着家的人。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to something or someone that has gone and will not return, or something that has lost control. It can also describe an irresponsible person who wanders around and doesn't stay home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗之後就冇再返嚟，真係好似冇尾飛砣咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6 zau6 mou5 zoi3 faan1 lai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 mou5 mei5 fei1 to4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了之后就再也没有回来，真像是断了线的风筝。
examples.english_sentence: He left and never came back, just like a kite without a string.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做個冇尾飛砣，成日唔返屋企！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 go3 mou5 mei5 fei1 to4, seng4 jat6 m4 faan1 uk1 kei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做一个断了线的风筝，总是整天不回家！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be like a kite without a string, always away from home!

synonyms: 斷線風箏 (dyun3 sin3 fung1 zang1)

mandarin_meaning: 没有尾巴的陀螺; 失控; 失去控制
english_meaning: Spinning top without a tail; out of control; uncontrollable; going haywire
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“没有尾巴的陀螺”。陀螺没有了尾巴（轴），旋转时就会失去平衡，无法控制。引申指人或事物失去控制，不受约束。
explanation_english: Literally means "spinning top without a tail." A spinning top without its tail (axis) loses balance and becomes uncontrollable. Figuratively, it refers to a person or thing that is out of control and unrestrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲醉酒就變成冇尾飛陀，周圍搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zau6 bin3 sing4 mou5 mei5 fei1 to4, zau1 wai4 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝醉酒就变得像失控的陀螺，到处惹事。
examples.english_sentence: Once he's drunk, he becomes like a spinning top without a tail, causing trouble everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從阿頭走咗之後，成間公司好似冇尾飛陀噉，亂晒龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 aa3 tau4 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 mou5 mei5 fei1 to4 gam2, lyun6晒 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从老板走了之后，整个公司好像失控的陀螺一样，乱成一团。
examples.english_sentence: Since the boss left, the whole company is like a spinning top without a tail, in complete chaos.

english_meaning: Seldom; rarely; unlikely
explanation_mandarin: 表示发生的频率很低，或者可能性不大。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens very infrequently or is unlikely to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，冇幾何會主動做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, mou5 gei2 ho4 wui5 zyu2 dung6 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，很少会主动做事情的。
examples.english_sentence: He is so lazy, it's unlikely that he will take the initiative to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冇幾何見到佢返工遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mou5 gei2 ho4 gin3 dou2 keoi5 faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很少看到他上班迟到。
examples.english_sentence: We rarely see him late for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，佢哋冇幾何會加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, keoi5 dei6 mou5 gei2 ho4 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，他们不大可能会加薪。
examples.english_sentence: With the economy being so bad, they are unlikely to raise salaries.

english_meaning: rarely, seldom, hardly ever
explanation_mandarin: 表示发生的频率很低，不常发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens very infrequently, not often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁忙，冇幾可會同我哋食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 mong4, mou5 gei2 ho2 wui5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么忙，很少会和我们吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He's so busy, he rarely eats with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，冇幾可會睇電視㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2, mou5 gei2 ho2 wui5 tai2 din6 si6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，很少会看电视的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people rarely watch TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冇幾可去尖沙咀行街㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mou5 gei2 ho2 heoi3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 haang4 gaai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很少去尖沙咀逛街。
examples.english_sentence: We rarely go shopping in Tsim Sha Tsui.

english_meaning: not much; not many; little
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很少，不多。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity or amount; not much, not many.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我身上冇幾多錢咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 soeng6 mou5 gei2 do1 cin2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我身上没多少钱。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much money on me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企冇幾多人住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 mou5 gei2 do1 jan4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家没多少人住。
examples.english_sentence: Not many people live in his house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度冇幾多車位，好難泊車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 mou5 gei2 do1 ce1 wai2, hou2 naan4 paak3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里没有多少停车位，很难停车。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many parking spaces here, it's hard to park.

english_meaning: not long, soon, in a little while
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间很短，很快就会发生。
explanation_english: Indicates a short amount of time; something will happen soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住冇幾耐就會走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 mou5 gei2 noi6 zau6 wui5 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想着过不了多久就会走了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking I'll leave soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冇幾耐就到嘅啦，你等陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mou5 gei2 noi6 zau6 dou3 ge3 laa1, nei5 dang2 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很快就到了，你等一下。
examples.english_sentence: They'll be here soon, wait a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲冇幾耐就開始，我哋入去坐低啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 mou5 gei2 noi6 zau6 hoi1 ci2, ngo5 dei6 jap6 heoi3 co5 dai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影很快就要开始了，我们进去坐下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The movie will start soon, let's go in and sit down.

mandarin_meaning: 没有回旋的余地; 没有转机; 无法改变
english_meaning: no room for maneuver; no turning back; no chance of change; irreversible; set in stone
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情已经到了无法挽回的地步，没有任何改变或商量的余地。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is no possibility of changing the outcome; it's irreversible or there's no room for negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細決定咗嘅嘢，基本上冇彎轉㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 kyut3 ding6 zo2 ge3 je5, gei1 bun2 soeng6 mou5 waan1 zyun3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板决定的事情，基本上是没有转圜余地的。
examples.english_sentence: What the boss has decided is basically irreversible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅虧損咁大，間公司真係冇彎轉喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 kwai1 syun2 gam3 daai6, gaan1 gung1 si1 zan1 hai6 mou5 waan1 zyun3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的亏损这么大，这家公司真的是没有转机了。
examples.english_sentence: The losses are so huge this time, there's really no turning back for this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車撞到咁爛，冇彎轉要劏車喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 zong6 dou3 gam3 laan6, mou5 waan1 zyun3 jiu3 tong1 ce1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车撞得这么烂，没有转圜余地，要报废了。
examples.english_sentence: The car is so badly damaged, there's no turning back, it needs to be scrapped.

english_meaning: Nowhere to be seen, disappeared, vanished
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不见了踪影，消失得无影无踪。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that has disappeared without a trace, nowhere to be found. Can also mean unreliable or untrustworthy if referring to a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵咗佢成日都冇影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 zo2 keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 jeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找了他一天都不见人影。
examples.english_sentence: I've been looking for him all day, but he's nowhere to be seen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都講一套做一套，冇影嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 jat1 tou3 zou6 jat1 tou3, mou5 jeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一套做一套，不靠谱。
examples.english_sentence: He always says one thing and does another, he's unreliable.

english_meaning: cannot; unable to; not allowed; no way
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有办法，不可能，不允许，或者不被允许。 指的是没有资格或者条件去做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no way, it's impossible, not allowed, or not permissible. Refers to lacking the qualifications or conditions to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我冇得去睇戲，因為要溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 mou5 dak1 heoi3 tai2 hei3, jan1 wai6 jiu3 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我没法去看电影，因为要复习功课。
examples.english_sentence: I can't go to the movies tonight because I have to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度冇得停車㗎，警察會抄牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 mou5 dak1 ting4 ce1 gaa3, ging2 caat3 wui5 caau1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里不能停车，警察会开罚单。
examples.english_sentence: You can't park here, the police will give you a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都咁大個，冇得咁任性㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gam3 daai6 go3, mou5 dak1 gam3 jam6 sing3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么大了，不能这么任性了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so old now, you can't be so willful anymore.

english_meaning: no chance of winning; no way to compete; unbeatable; a lost cause
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有获胜的机会，或者形容某事某人实力强大，无法与之竞争。
explanation_english: Indicates there is no chance of winning, or describes something or someone as so powerful that they are unbeatable and impossible to compete with. Often used to express resignation or futility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有錢，我哋冇得fight㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 cin2, ngo5 dei6 mou5 dak1 fai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么有钱，我们没法跟他比的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so rich, there's no way we can compete with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對手咁勁，今次我哋真係冇得fight。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 sau2 gam3 ging6, gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 fai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对手这么厉害，这次我们真的没法竞争了。

examples.english_sentence: The service at this hotel is impeccable, the staff are very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現真係冇得彈，攞咗第一名。

examples.english_sentence: His performance was truly flawless, he got first place.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都走了这么久，没有办法挽回了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been gone for so long, there's no turning back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦跌咗落水，徹底壞咗，冇得扳啦。

explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is beyond saving or repair; it's too late to do anything about it; there's no turning back.

explanation_mandarin: 没有选择的余地，表示被迫接受某种情况。
explanation_english: To have no choice; to be in a situation where there is no alternative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次經濟唔好，好多公司都裁員，我哋冇得揀，唯有努力啲做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 coi4 jyun4, ngo5 dei6 mou5 dak1 gaan2, wai4 jau5 nu5 lik6 di1 zou6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔合格就要重考，冇得揀㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 m4 gok3 hap6 zau6 jiu3 cung4 haau2, mou5 dak1 gaan2 gaa3.

explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或情况已经糟糕到无法挽救、无法改变的地步。

explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is no chance of losing; a guaranteed win or success. Usually used to describe situations or events where one is very confident of winning.

examples.english_sentence: His singing is unbeatable; many people praise him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話嘅性能真係冇得頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 ge3 sing3 nang4 zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这新款手机的性能真是顶呱呱。
examples.english_sentence: The performance of this new phone is absolutely top-notch.

english_meaning: no choice; no alternative; can't be helped; nothing can be done

examples.english_sentence: I didn't mean to, I'll be more careful next time.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那样说话可能不是故意的，你不要太在意了。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我刚才不小心撞到你。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I accidentally bumped into you just now.

english_meaning: not in the mood; not feeling up to it; unmotivated; lack of interest
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏兴趣或动力，没有心情去做某事。
explanation_english: Describes a state of lacking interest, motivation, or enthusiasm to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇心機做嘢，不如早啲收工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 sam1 gei1 zou6 je5, bat1 jyu4 zou2 di1 sau1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没心情工作，不如早点下班吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not in the mood to work today, why don't we leave work earlier?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似冇心機咁，唔知發生咩事呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 mou5 sam1 gei1 gam2, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像没什么心思，不知道发生什么事了？
examples.english_sentence: He seems unmotivated lately, I wonder what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就嚟到喇，唔可以再冇心機溫書喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 zau6 lai4 dou3 laa3, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 mou5 sam1 gei1 wan1 syu1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试就要到了，不能再没心思复习了！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming soon, we can't be unmotivated to study anymore!

synonyms: 提唔起勁 (tai4 m4 hei2 ging3)

english_meaning: heartless; ungrateful; inconsiderate
explanation_mandarin: 形容人没有良心，忘恩负义，不顾别人的感受。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is heartless, ungrateful, inconsiderate, or lacking empathy. It suggests a lack of conscience or concern for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫咗你咁多，你仲咁樣對佢，真係冇心肝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1, nei5 zung6 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 keoi5, zan1 hai6 mou5 sam1 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮了你这么多，你还这样对他，真是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: He helped you so much, and you still treat him like this; you're really heartless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁冇心肝啦，佢都喊曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 sam1 gon1 laa1, keoi5 dou1 haam3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么没良心啦，她都哭啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so heartless, she's already crying.

synonyms: 狼心狗肺 (long4 sam1 gau2 fai3)

english_meaning: Not in the mood; unwilling to do something; not in the heart/mind to do something; not intending to care about something.
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有心情或不愿意做某事。指没有心思去承载或接受某件事情，多用于表示消极或不情愿的态度。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of motivation or willingness to do something. It implies not being in the right frame of mind to undertake or accept something, often conveying a negative or reluctant attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似冇心裝載咁，乜嘢都唔想做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 mou5 sam1 zong1 zoi3 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像没什么心情，什么都不想做。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be in a bad mood today, and doesn't want to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好勉強佢啦，佢而家冇心裝載聽你講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 min5 koeng5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 mou5 sam1 zong1 zoi3 ting1 nei5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要勉强他了，他现在没心思听你说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him; he's not in the mood to listen to you right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個計劃冇心裝載，唔想參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 mou5 sam1 zong1 zoi3, m4 soeng2 caam1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个计划没兴趣，不想参与。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not interested in this plan; I don't want to participate.

english_meaning: no room for compromise; no consideration for feelings; to show no mercy; to be unforgiving
explanation_mandarin: 形容不讲人情，不留情面，毫不妥协的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is no room for leniency or compromise, and feelings are not taken into consideration. It implies a strict or ruthless approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次你犯咗咁大嘅錯，老細都冇情講，一定炒你魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nei5 faan6 zo2 gam3 daai6 ge3 co3, lou5 sai3 dou1 mou5 cing4 gong2, jat1 ding6 caau2 nei5 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次你犯了这么大的错误，老板都不会讲情面，肯定会炒你鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: This time you made such a big mistake, the boss will show no mercy and will definitely fire you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上面，好多時都係冇情講㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6 min6, hou2 do1 si4 dou1 hai6 mou5 cing4 gong2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上面，很多时候都是不讲情面的。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, most of the time there's no room for sentiment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢再唔交租，我哋都冇情講，唯有告佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zoi3 m4 gaau1 zou1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou5 cing4 gong2, wai4 jau5 gou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他再不交租，我们也没法讲情面了，只好告他。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't pay the rent again, we can't be lenient anymore and have to sue him.

english_meaning: not in the mood; not in the zone; not feeling it; lacking enthusiasm or energy
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人精神状态不佳，提不起劲，没有兴致或状态。
explanation_english: Describes a person's state of mind where they lack energy, enthusiasm, or motivation. They are not in the right mindset or feeling up to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇乜嘢做，成個人都冇態咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 mou5 taai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没什么事做，整个人都不在状态。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much to do today; I'm just not feeling it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日先至通宵咗，今日返工梗係冇態啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 sin1 zi3 tung1 siu1 zo2, gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 gang2 hai6 mou5 taai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天才熬夜了，今天上班肯定没状态。
examples.english_sentence: He stayed up all night yesterday, so he's definitely not in the zone at work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我今日真係冇態，唔想出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 mou5 taai3, m4 soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今天真的没状态，不想出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, I'm really not in the mood today; I don't want to go out and play.

english_meaning: No hope; no chance; all is lost; no more opportunities
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情没有希望，没有成功的机会，或者没有后续的发展。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning there's no hope or chance of success or further development of something. Figuratively, it implies that the situation is hopeless or finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我準備得唔夠，睇嚟都冇戲睇喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 zyun2 bei6 dak1 m4 gau3, tai2 lai4 dou1 mou5 hei3 tai2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我准备得不够，看来都没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't prepare well enough for this exam, it looks like there's no hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧交鬧到咁僵，睇嚟呢段關係都冇戲睇咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 naau6 dou3 gam3 goeng1, tai2 lai4 ni1 dyun6 gwaan1 hai6 dou1 mou5 hei3 tai2 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架吵得这么僵，看来这段关系都没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: They argued so bitterly, it seems there's no hope for this relationship.

english_meaning: doesn't matter; doesn't care; it's alright; no problem; whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示不在乎，不介意，没有意见。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference, lack of concern, or a lack of preference. Indicates that something is acceptable or not a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想食咩啊？我冇所謂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1 aa3? ngo5 mou5 so2 wai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想吃什么啊？我无所谓的。
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to eat? I don't mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你遲到我都冇所謂，但係下次唔好再遲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ci4 dou3 ngo5 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6, daan6 hai6 haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你迟到我都无所谓，但是下次不要再迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind that you're late, but don't be late again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個方案都得，我冇所謂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 fong1 on3 dou1 dak1, ngo5 mou5 so2 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪个方案都可以，我无所谓。
examples.english_sentence: Any option is fine, I don't mind.

english_meaning: no way; unable to handle; can't deal with it; beyond my capabilities
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人能力不足，无法处理某事；或指不可能实现，没有办法。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is unable to handle something due to lack of ability or resources; or indicates something is impossible or there is no way to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我真係冇手，你搵第二個幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 sau2, nei5 wan2 dai6 ji6 go3 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我真的没办法，你找别人帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: I really can't handle this matter. You should find someone else to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多嘢要做，我一個人點搞得掂呀？真係冇手！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 je5 jiu3 zou6, ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3? zan1 hai6 mou5 sau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有这么多事情要做，我一个人怎么能处理好？真是没办法！
examples.english_sentence: There are so many things to do, how can I handle it alone? There's no way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅性格，我真係冇手同佢溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 sing3 gaak3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 sau2 tung4 keoi5 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样的性格，我真的没法跟他沟通。
examples.english_sentence: With his personality, I really can't communicate with him.

english_meaning: Leaving a mess; leaving things unfinished; not cleaning up after oneself; lacking follow-through; irresponsible.
explanation_mandarin: 指做事没有善后，留下未完成的事情，或者没有清理干净。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving things unfinished or not cleaned up after doing something. It implies a lack of responsibility in completing tasks and taking care of loose ends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都冇手尾，搞到我要幫佢執手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 mou5 sau2 mei1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 zap1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是没头没尾，导致我要帮他收拾烂摊子。
examples.english_sentence: He always leaves a mess when he works, so I have to clean up after him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁冇手尾㗎，用完啲嘢要放返原位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 mou5 sau2 mei1 gaa3, jung6 jyun4 di1 je5 jiu3 fong3 faan1 jyun4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这么不负责任，用完东西要放回原位。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be so irresponsible; put things back where they belong after using them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲project好多時都冇手尾，搞到客人都好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 project ho2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 mou5 sau2 mei1, gaau2 dou3 haak3 jan4 dou1 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的项目很多时候都没有收尾，导致客人都很不满意。
examples.english_sentence: Many of this company's projects are left unfinished, leading to customer dissatisfaction.

synonyms: 唔負責任 (m4 fu6 zaak3 jam3)

english_meaning: incompetent, useless, unskilled, no good
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人能力不足，不行，没有真本事。 “把炮” 在这里指技能、实力。
explanation_english: Describes someone as incompetent, useless, or lacking real skill. "把炮" here refers to skill or ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁hea，真係冇把炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 hea1, zan1 hai6 mou5 baa2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么懒散，真是没本事。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy at work, he's really incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇佢咁寸，其實佢冇把炮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 gam3 cyun3, kei4 sat6 keoi5 mou5 baa2 paau3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别看他这么嚣张，其实他没本事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at him being so arrogant, he's actually useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波佢都入唔到，真係冇把炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 keoi5 dou1 jap6 m4 dou2, zan1 hai6 mou5 baa2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球他都进不了，真是不行。
examples.english_sentence: He can't even score this goal, he's really no good.

english_meaning: owing nothing, all debts settled, no strings attached
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事干脆利落，没有任何拖延或欠款。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything is settled, there are no outstanding debts, and obligations are fulfilled promptly and completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間已經冇拖冇欠，唔好再嚟搵我喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ji5 ging1 mou5 to1 mou5 him3, m4 hou2 zoi3 lai4 wan2 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间已经不拖不欠，不要再来找我了。
examples.english_sentence: We are even now, so don't come looking for me again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次你幫咗我咁多，我一定會盡快還錢俾你，做到冇拖冇欠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nei5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zeon6 faai3 waan4 cin2 bei2 nei5, zou6 dou3 mou5 to1 mou5 him3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次你帮了我这么多，我一定会尽快还钱给你，做到不拖不欠。
examples.english_sentence: You've helped me so much this time, I will definitely pay you back as soon as possible, so there's no debt between us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做嘢嘅原則係冇拖冇欠，唔鍾意欠人情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 je5 ge3 jyun1 zak1 hai6 mou5 to1 mou5 him3, m4 zung1 ji3 him3 jan4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做事的原则是不拖不欠，不喜欢欠人情。
examples.english_sentence: My principle in doing things is to be prompt and avoid owing favors to others.

english_meaning: No problem; doesn't matter; whatever; indifferent
explanation_mandarin: 表示不在乎、无所谓、没关系。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference, doesn't matter, or no problem. It indicates a lack of strong opinion or concern about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想點樣都得，我冇拘論㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 dim2 joeng2 dou1 dak1, ngo5 mou5 keoi1 leon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想怎么样都可以，我无所谓。
examples.english_sentence: You can do whatever you want, I don't mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲啲開始都冇拘論，反正我哋都唔趕時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 di1 hoi1 ci2 dou1 mou5 keoi1 leon6, faan2 zing2 ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 gaan2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚点开始也没关系，反正我们都不赶时间。
examples.english_sentence: Starting later is no problem, anyway we're not in a hurry.

english_meaning: completely clean, spotless; completely unrelated, having nothing to do with
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常干净，没有污垢；或形容与某事毫无关系，不牵涉其中。
explanation_english: Describes something as being extremely clean, without any dirt or grime; or describes someone as being completely unrelated to something, not involved at all. It can also describe a person's record being clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間冇挐冇掕，你唔好亂咁講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 mou5 naa1 mou5 laang3, nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间清清白白，你不要乱说。
examples.english_sentence: They have nothing to do with each other, don't talk nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋抹到冇挐冇掕，真係好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 mut3 dou3 mou5 naa1 mou5 laang3, zan1 hai6 hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间擦得非常干净，真的很干净。
examples.english_sentence: The house is wiped completely clean, it's really clean.

synonyms: 乾乾淨淨 (gon1 gon1 zing6 zing6)

english_meaning: unrelated; irrelevant; having nothing to do with something; no connection
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或人之间没有任何联系或关系。
explanation_english: Describes something that is unrelated, irrelevant, or has no connection to something else. It implies a lack of association or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事同我冇挐掕㗎，你唔好搵我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 mou5 naa4 lang3 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 wan2 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事和我没有关系，你不要找我了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has nothing to do with me, please don't bother me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個人嘅背景冇挐掕，所以好難理解對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 ge3 bui3 ging2 mou5 naa4 lang3, so2 ji5 hou2 naan4 lei5 gaai2 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的背景没有关系，所以很难理解对方。
examples.english_sentence: The backgrounds of these two people are unrelated, so it's hard for them to understand each other.

english_meaning: Without support or backing; without any reliance; having no one to depend on.
explanation_mandarin: 形容没有任何依靠，孤立无援。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone has no one to rely on or depend on for support; isolated and helpless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆喺香港冇親冇戚，真係冇挨冇憑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 mou5 can1 mou5 cik1, zan1 hai6 mou5 aai1 mou5 pang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻在香港没有亲戚，真是无依无靠。
examples.english_sentence: The couple has no relatives in Hong Kong, they truly have no one to rely on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 初嚟埗到，乜都唔識，覺得自己好似冇挨冇憑咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co1 lai4 bou6 dou3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 mou5 aai1 mou5 pang4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚来这里，什么都不懂，觉得自己好像无依无靠一样。
examples.english_sentence: Newly arrived, not knowing anything, I feel like I have no one to rely on.

synonyms: 孤立無援 (gu1 lap6 mou4 wun4)
孤苦伶仃 (gu1 fu2 ling4 ding1)

english_meaning: open as a chicken coop without a cover; wide open; without defenses; unguarded
explanation_mandarin: 形容门户大开，毫无防备，容易被入侵或利用。也比喻管理松散，容易出问题。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is wide open, without any safeguards or defenses, making it vulnerable to intrusion or exploitation. It can also describe a poorly managed situation where problems are likely to occur.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖頭日頭都冇掩雞籠咁，啲賊咪鍾意嚟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 jat6 tau3 dou1 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4 gam2, di1 caak6 mai1 zung1 ji3 lai4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家商店白天都像敞开的鸡笼一样，小偷肯定喜欢来。
examples.english_sentence: That shop is as open as a chicken coop during the day; of course, thieves would like to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間公司管理得咁鬆散，咪好似冇掩雞籠，乜嘢都走失晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 dak1 gam3 sung1 saan2, mai1 hou2 ci5 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4, mat1 je5 dou1 zau2 sat1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你公司管理得这么松散，就像敞开的鸡笼，什么都丢光了。
examples.english_sentence: Your company is so poorly managed; it's like a chicken coop without a cover, everything's getting lost.

cantonese: 冇掩雞籠 - 自出自入
jyutping: mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4 zi6 zi6 ceot1 jap6
english_meaning: An open chicken coop – free to come and go as one pleases; wide open, no restrictions, freely accessible.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻地方或场所没有防守，可以自由出入。也形容管理松散，任人随便。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a place or situation that is completely unguarded and easily accessible to anyone. It can also refer to lax management where people can do as they please without restriction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好似冇掩雞籠噉，啲員工成日遲到早退。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4 gam2, di1 wun4 gung1 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zou2 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司就像没盖的鸡笼一样，员工经常迟到早退。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like an open chicken coop, the employees are always late or leave early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從經理走咗之後，辦公室就冇掩雞籠，亂晒龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 ging1 lei5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, baan6 gung1 sat1 zau6 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4, lyun6 saai3 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从经理走了之后，办公室就像没盖的鸡笼一样，一片混乱。
examples.english_sentence: Since the manager left, the office has been like an open chicken coop; it's a complete mess.

english_meaning: like a chicken coop without a lid; wide open; full of holes; having many loopholes
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物疏漏很多，毫无遮掩，容易被人利用。
explanation_english: Describes something that is full of loopholes, completely exposed, and easily exploited. It's like a chicken coop without a lid, meaning the chickens can easily escape or predators can easily get in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃真係冇掩鷄籠，漏洞百出，一實行就出事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 mou5 jim2 gai1 lung4, lau6 dung6 baak3 ceot1, jat1 sat6 hang4 zau6 ceot1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划简直漏洞百出，一实施就要出事。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is like a chicken coop without a lid, full of holes, and it will definitely lead to problems once implemented.

english_meaning: not certain; uncertain; unsure; no confidence
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有把握，没有信心，不确定的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates a state of being uncertain, lacking confidence, or not having a firm grasp on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢次考試冇揸拿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 ci3 haau2 si5 mou5 zaa1 naa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这次考试没把握。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not confident about this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份計劃書都未搞掂，所以對個project都冇揸拿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gai3 waak6 syu1 dou1 mei6 gaau2 dim6, so2 ji5 deoi3 go3 project dou1 mou5 zaa1 naa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的企划书都还没完成，所以对这个项目也没把握。
examples.english_sentence: His proposal isn't finished yet, so he's not confident about the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，對前景真係冇揸拿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, deoi3 cin4 ging2 zan1 hai6 mou5 zaa1 naa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，对前景真的没把握。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now, I really have no confidence in the future.

english_meaning: incomprehensible; nonsensical; without rhyme or reason; doesn't make sense; illogical
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或行为没有条理，前言不搭后语，让人无法理解。
explanation_english: Describes speech or behavior that is disorganized, illogical, and difficult to understand; lacking coherence or reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢冇搭霎，我完全唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 daap3 saap3, ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话没头没脑的，我完全不知道他想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: What he's saying is incomprehensible. I have no idea what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁冇搭霎啦，講清楚啲好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 daap3 saap3 laa1, gong2 cing1 co2 di1 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么没头没脑了，说清楚一点好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nonsensical, can you explain it more clearly?

english_meaning: no hope; not going to happen; not working out
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情没有希望，无法成功或实现。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has no hope, will not succeed or materialize. Often used in situations where an attempt has failed or is unlikely to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我溫都冇溫過，實冇收啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 wan1 dou1 mou5 wan1 gwo3, sat6 mou5 sau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我都没复习过，肯定没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't even review for the exam this time, it's definitely not going to work out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢追咗佢咁耐，都冇收，放棄算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi1 zo2 keoi5 gam3 noi6, dou1 mou5 sau1, fong3 hei3 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他追了她这么久，都没戏，放弃算了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been pursuing her for so long, but it's not working out, he should just give up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊電腦已經壞咗好耐，整都冇收㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 ji5 ging1 waai6 zo2 hou2 noi6, zing2 dou1 mou5 sau1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑已经坏了很久，修也没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer has been broken for a long time, there's no point in trying to fix it.

english_meaning: ineffective; invalid; useless; not working
explanation_mandarin: 指没有效果，不起作用，失效。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is ineffective, does not work, or has become invalid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張飛已經過咗期，冇效㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 fei1 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 kei4, mou5 haau6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张票已经过期了，没用了。
examples.english_sentence: This ticket has expired, it's no longer valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗藥都冇效，都仲係咁唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 yoek6 dou1 mou5 haau6, dou1 zung1 hai6 gam3 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了药也没用，还是这么不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Even after taking medicine, it's not working, I'm still feeling unwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，整極都冇效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, zing2 gik1 dou1 mou5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，怎么修都没用。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken, no matter how much I try to fix it, it's no use.

english_meaning: doesn't matter; it's alright; never mind; of no consequence
explanation_mandarin: 表示不在乎，无关紧要，不用放在心上。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is unimportant, doesn't matter, or shouldn't be taken seriously. It can also express indifference or acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意嘅話，咪唔去囉，冇數為嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 waa2, mai6 m4 heoi3 lo1, mou5 sou3 wai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不喜欢的话，就不去呗，没关系的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't like it, then don't go. It doesn't matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯幫手，冇數為，我哋自己搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2, mou5 sou3 wai4, ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯帮忙，没关系，我们自己搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: He's not willing to help, never mind, we'll handle it ourselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到幾分鐘，冇數為啦，入去先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 gei2 fan1 zung1, mou5 sou3 wai4 laa1, jap6 heoi3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到几分钟，没关系啦，先进去吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's only a few minutes late, it's alright, let's go in first.

english_meaning: hopeless; no chance; a lost cause; not going to happen
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情没有成功的希望，可能性非常低。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or endeavor that has little to no chance of success; considered a lost cause. It signifies hopelessness or impossibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試乜都冇溫，今次冇數爲㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 mat1 dou1 mou5 wan1, gam1 ci3 mou5 sou3 wai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试什么都没复习，这次没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't revise anything for the exam, there's no chance he'll pass this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司都蝕咗咁多錢，睇嚟冇數爲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 sit3 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, tai2 lai4 mou5 sou3 wai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经亏损这么多钱，看来没戏了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already lost so much money, it looks like it's a lost cause.

english_meaning: incompetent, unskilled, lacking ability, lacking substance
explanation_mandarin: 指某人没有实际能力或本事，华而不实。
explanation_english: Describes someone lacking real ability, skills, or substance; often used to imply someone is boastful or overconfident but actually incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到自己好叻咁，點知做起嘢嚟先發覺佢冇料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 gam2, dim2 zi1 zou6 hei2 je5 lai4 sin1 faat3 gok3 keoi5 mou5 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己很厉害，结果做起事来才发现他没本事。
examples.english_sentence: He talked a big game, but when he actually started working, we realized he was incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢好勁，其實佢都係得個樣，冇料嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hou2 ging6, kei4 sat6 keoi5 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 joeng2, mou5 liu2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为他很厉害，其实他只是外表看起来厉害，没有真本事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think he's amazing; he's just got the look, he's actually useless.

english_meaning: incompetent; useless; not capable; overestimated
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人没有真才实学，能力不足，让人失望。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks real ability or skills, and is therefore disappointing. Usually has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為佢好叻，點知咁冇料到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hou2 lek1, dim2 zi1 gam3 mou5 liu2 dou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他很厉害，没想到这么没本事。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he was very capable, but it turns out he's so incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢講到天花龍鳳，其實佢都係冇料到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 gong2 dou3 tin1 faa1 lung4 fung6, kei4 sat6 keoi5 dou1 hai6 mou5 liu2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他说得天花乱坠，其实他还是没本事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his eloquent words; he's actually useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃咁失敗，都係因為負責嘅人太冇料到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gam3 sat1 baai6, dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 fu6 zaak3 ge3 jan4 taai3 mou5 liu2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划这么失败，都是因为负责人太没本事。
examples.english_sentence: This plan failed so badly because the person in charge was so incompetent.

english_meaning: To feign competence, to act like you know what you're doing when you don't, to pretend to be capable
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人实际上没有真才实学，却装作很有能力的样子，欺骗他人。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks genuine skills or knowledge but pretends to be very capable, deceiving others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明乜都唔識，但係成日都冇料扮四條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 sing4 jat6 dou1 mou5 liu2 baan6 sei3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明什么都不懂，但是整天都装作很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't know anything, but he pretends to be competent all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺老闆面前冇料扮四條，俾佢發現就弊傢伙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 mou5 liu2 baan6 sei3 tiu4, bei2 keoi5 faat3 hin3 zau6 bai6 gaa1 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在老板面前没本事装作很厉害，被他发现就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to know what you're doing in front of the boss, it'll be bad if he finds out.

english_meaning: sometimes; occasionally; once in a while
explanation_mandarin: 表示不经常，偶而发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens infrequently or occasionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇時都會去飲咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 si4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 yam2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有时会去喝咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: I sometimes go to drink coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇時會遲到，但係大部分時間都好準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 si4 wui5 ci4 dou3, daan6 hai6 daai6 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan3 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有时会迟到，但是大部分时间都很准时。
examples.english_sentence: He is sometimes late, but he's usually on time.

english_meaning: all the time, constantly, without a moment's pause
explanation_mandarin: 表示一直不停地，没有间断的时候。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that happens constantly, without any breaks or pauses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打機，冇時冇候咁打，真係唔知佢做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 gei1, mou5 si4 mou5 hau6 gam2 daa2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在玩游戏，无时无刻都在玩，真不知道他在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always playing video games, playing all the time, I really don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲學生哥，冇時冇候都撳住部手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hok6 sang1 go1, mou5 si4 mou5 hau6 dou1 gam6 zyu6 bou6 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的学生，无时无刻都拿着手机。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, students are holding their phones all the time.

english_meaning: unpredictable; uncertain; having no fixed time or schedule; erratic
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间或安排不确定，没有固定的规律或模式。
explanation_english: Describes something that is unpredictable in terms of time or schedule, lacking a fixed routine or pattern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工冇時定，有時要返通宵，有時又可以放成個禮拜假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 mou5 si4 ding6, jau5 si4 jiu3 faan1 tung1 siu1, jau5 si4 jau6 ho2 ji5 fong3 sing4 go3 lai5 baai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作时间不定时，有时候要上通宵班，有时候又可以放一个礼拜的假。
examples.english_sentence: His job has unpredictable hours. Sometimes he has to work overnight, and sometimes he can have a whole week off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排天氣冇時定，一時落雨一時曬，真係唔知點著衫好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 tin1 hei3 mou5 si4 ding6, jat1 si4 lok6 jyu5 jat1 si4 saai3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 zoek3 saam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气很不稳定，一会儿下雨一会儿晴天，真不知道怎么穿衣服好。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been so unpredictable lately. It's raining one minute and sunny the next. I really don't know what to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢个人冇時定，唔知佢幾時會出现。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 mou5 si4 ding6, m4 zi1 keoi5 gei2 si4 wui5 ceot1 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人时间不定，不知道他什么时候会出现。
examples.english_sentence: That person is unpredictable; I don't know when they'll show up.

english_meaning: No time; don't have time; haven't got time
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有空余的时间去做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of free time to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇時間同你出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 si4 gaan3 tung4 nei5 cheut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没时间和你们出去。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have time to go out with you today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我真係冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我真的没时间。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I really don't have time.

synonyms: 得閒 (dak1 haan4, meaning free time)
冇空 (mou5 hung1, meaning no spare time)

mandarin_meaning: 束手无策; 黔驴技穷
english_meaning: Out of ideas; at one's wit's end; all out of options; no more solutions
explanation_mandarin: 指没有办法了，没有任何解决问题的方法。形容已经到了山穷水尽的地步。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one has run out of ideas or solutions, and there are no more options available to solve a problem. It signifies reaching a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係冇晒符啦，點諗都諗唔到辦法解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 mou5 saai3 fu4 laa1, dim2 nim2 dou1 nim2 m4 dou2 baan6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次是真的束手无策了，怎么想都想不出解决办法。
examples.english_sentence: This time we're really out of ideas. No matter how I think, I can't come up with a solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路都好有信心，點知到最後都係冇晒符。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1, dim2 zi1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 mou5 saai3 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都很有信心，谁知道到最后还是黔驴技穷。
examples.english_sentence: He was always very confident, but who knew that in the end he would be out of ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 完全没辙, 毫无办法
english_meaning: Completely out of options, have no way out, at a dead end
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有任何办法，所有方法都尝试过了却都失败了。形容事情到了无法解决的地步。
explanation_english: Indicates that there are no options left and all attempts have failed. Describes a situation where things have reached a point where they cannot be resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，我真係冇晒行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 saai3 hang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，我真的完全没辙了。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on this exam, I really have no way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠，我哋冇晒行，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1, ngo5 dei6 mou5 saai3 hang4, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，我们完全没辙了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, we're completely out of options, I don't know what to do.

synonyms: 束手無策 (suk1 sau2 mou4 caak3)

english_meaning: expressionless, blank face, devoid of emotion
explanation_mandarin: 指脸上没有任何表情，通常表示冷漠、无动于衷或麻木。
explanation_english: Describes a face that shows no emotion whatsoever. It usually indicates indifference, apathy, or numbness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽完消息之後，冇晒表情，唔知佢諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jyun4 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, mou5 saai3 biu2 ching4, m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听完消息之后，面无表情，不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he was expressionless, I don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好cool，成日都冇晒表情噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 hou2 cool, seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 saai3 biu2 ching4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很酷，总是面无表情的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very cool person, always with a blank face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢输咗比赛，但係冇晒表情，好似唔care咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 bei2 coi3, daan6 hai6 mou5 saai3 biu2 ching4, hou2 ci5 m4 care gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了比赛，但是面无表情，好像不在乎似的。
examples.english_sentence: He lost the competition, but he was expressionless, as if he didn't care.

mandarin_meaning: 没有希望; 没有前途
english_meaning: hopeless; bleak outlook; no future prospects
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况非常糟糕，看不到任何希望或好的结果。通常用来形容事业、感情或某种情况的前景黯淡。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is no hope for improvement or a positive outcome. Often used to describe a bleak future for a career, relationship, or general situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，好多行業都冇景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 hang4 jip6 dou1 mou5 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，很多行业都没有希望。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now; many industries have no prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日嘈交，睇嚟呢段感情都冇景咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, tai2 lai4 ni1 dyun6 gam2 cing4 dou1 mou5 ging2 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个经常吵架，看来这段感情都没希望了。
examples.english_sentence: They argue all the time, looks like this relationship is hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果再唔努力，你份工就冇景㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 m4 nou5 lik6, nei5 fan6 gung1 zau6 mou5 ging2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再不努力，你的工作就没有前途了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, your job has no future.

english_meaning: Not afraid; Fearless; No worries
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有任何畏惧，无所顾虑，即使遇到困难也不害怕。是一种比较口语化的表达。
explanation_english: Indicates that one has no fear or concern, and is not afraid even when faced with difficulties. It's a colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚考試，冇有怕！我準備好曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 haau2 si3, mou5 jau5 paa3! ngo5 zyun2 bei6 hou2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚考试，不用怕！我已经准备好了。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's exam, no worries! I'm all prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使驚，有我喺度，冇有怕!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 geng1, jau5 ngo5 hai2 dou6, mou5 jau5 paa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用害怕，有我在，不用怕！
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be scared, I'm here, no worries!

english_meaning: That's right; Correct; Absolutely; No doubt
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定、赞同或确认，相当于普通话的“没错”、“对”、“绝对”。
explanation_english: Expresses affirmation, agreement, or confirmation. Similar to "that's right", "correct", "absolutely", or "no doubt". It's used to strongly agree with something or confirm its accuracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅冇有錯，我親眼見到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 mou5 jau5 co3, ngo5 can1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的没错，我亲眼看到的。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is absolutely right. I saw it with my own eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做冇有錯㗎，繼續努力啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mou5 jau5 co3 gaa3, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做没错的，继续努力吧！
examples.english_sentence: You're doing it right. Keep up the good work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一定會贏，冇有錯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 wing4, mou5 jau5 co3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一定会赢，没错！
examples.english_sentence: He will definitely win, no doubt!

english_meaning: to have no friends; friendless
explanation_mandarin: 指没有朋友，缺乏社交关系。
explanation_english: Describes the state of having no friends or lacking social relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好古怪，成日都自己一個，所以冇朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gu2 gwaai3, seng4 jat6 dou1 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3, so2 ji5 mou5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很古怪，总是自己一个人，所以没有朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very strange person, always by himself, so he has no friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢搬走之後，我就冇朋友陪我行街喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 bun1 zau2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 mou5 pang4 jau5 pui4 ngo5 haang4 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他搬走之后，我就没有朋友陪我逛街了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he moved away, I have no friends to go shopping with.

english_meaning: heartless; unconscionable; unscrupulous
explanation_mandarin: 指人缺乏良心，做事不讲道德，不顾他人感受。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks conscience, acts immorally, and disregards the feelings of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗賺錢，乜都做得出，真係冇本心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zaan6 cin2, mat1 dou1 zo6 dak1 ceot1, zan1 hai6 mou5 bun2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了赚钱，什么都做得出来，真是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: He would do anything to make money; he's really heartless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆炒咗佢咁多同事，簡直係冇本心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 caau2 zo2 keoi5 gam3 do1 tung4 si6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 mou5 bun2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板炒掉了他这么多同事，简直是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired so many of his colleagues, it's simply unconscionable.

synonyms: 狼心狗肺 (long4 sam1 gau2 fai3)

english_meaning: lacking foundation; without a basic knowledge; not having a solid background
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏基本的知识、经验或技能，没有扎实的基础。
explanation_english: Refers to lacking basic knowledge, experience, or skills; not having a solid foundation. Can also imply lacking a proper background or upbringing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾個月就話自己識曬，其實佢根本冇根底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 saai3, kei4 sat6 keoi5 gan1 bun2 mou5 gan1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几个月就说自己全会了，其实他根本没有基础。
examples.english_sentence: He studied for a few months and said he knows everything, but in reality, he has no foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目好難，冇根底嘅人好難做到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hou2 naan4, mou5 gan1 dai2 ge3 jan4 hou2 naan4 zou6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很难，没有基础的人很难做到。
examples.english_sentence: This project is difficult; it's hard for someone without a foundation to accomplish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢方面冇根底，要從頭學起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 fong1 min6 mou5 gan1 dai2, jiu3 cung4 tau4 hok6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这方面没有基础，要从头学起。
examples.english_sentence: He has no foundation in this area and needs to start learning from scratch.

mandarin_meaning: 没有根基; 没有依靠
english_meaning: Without roots; without a foundation; lacking support; having no backing
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物没有根基，没有依靠，缺乏支持或背景。 比喻没有稳固的基础。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as having no roots, no support, lacking backing or foundation. It's a metaphor for lacking a solid foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司冇根蔸，好難升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 mou5 gan1 dau1, hou2 naan4 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司没有根基，很难升职。
examples.english_sentence: He has no backing in the company, it's difficult for him to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新計劃冇根蔸，好難成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 gai3 waak6 mou5 gan1 dau1, hou2 naan4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新计划没有根基，很难成功。
examples.english_sentence: This new plan has no foundation; it will be difficult to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係好似冇根蔸咁，睇唔到將來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 mou5 gan1 dau1 gam2, tai2 m4 dou3 zoeng1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的关系好像没有根基一样，看不到将来。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship seems to have no foundation, you can't see a future for it.

english_meaning: No chance; unlikely to happen
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有机会，不太可能发生。通常指事情成功的可能性很低。
