examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 hap6 jok3, fan1 fan1 chung1 wui5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 ham6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不合作，很可能被他们彻底消灭。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't cooperate, we might get wiped out by them.

english_meaning: all, everything, the whole lot
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，所有的东西或者人。通常带有不耐烦或者轻蔑的语气。
explanation_english: Refers to all, everything, or the whole lot of people or things. Often carries a tone of impatience or disdain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冚斗攞晒啲錢走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ham6 dau2 lo2 saai3 di1 cin2 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的钱都拿走了，跑路了。
examples.english_sentence: He took all the money and ran away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋冚斗都係廢物！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 ham6 dau2 dou1 hai6 fai3 mat6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们全部都是废物！
examples.english_sentence: You are all useless!

english_meaning: to give up, to fail, to throw in the towel, to surrender
explanation_mandarin: 原意是降下旗帜，表示投降。引申为停止、放弃、失败等。
explanation_english: Originally, it means to lower the flag, indicating surrender. By extension, it means to stop, give up, or fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕咗咁多錢，都頂唔順要冚旗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit3 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, dou1 ding2 m4 seon6 jiu3 ham6 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司亏损了这么多钱，都撑不住要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost so much money that it couldn't hold on and had to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅計劃遇到好多困難，最後都冚旗收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 jyu6 dou6 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 ham6 kei4 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的计划遇到了很多困难，最后都失败了。
examples.english_sentence: Their plan encountered many difficulties and ultimately ended in failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易就冚旗呀，試多一次先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 yung4 yi6 zau6 ham6 kei4 aa3, si3 do1 jat1 ci3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易就放弃，再试一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so easily, try one more time.

english_meaning: to cover with a cotton quilt; to bury (a problem); to cover up (a scandal)
explanation_mandarin: 本义是盖棉被。引申义为掩盖、遮掩不好的事情，比如丑闻、问题等，使之不被发现。
explanation_english: Literally means to cover with a cotton quilt. Figuratively, it means to cover up or conceal something bad, such as a scandal or a problem, so that it is not discovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想冚棉胎，唔想俾人知佢做錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ham6 min4 tai1, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 keoi5 zou6 co3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掩盖过去，不想让人知道他做错了事。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to cover up the past and doesn't want people to know that he did something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成日冚棉胎，唔肯面對問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 ham6 min4 tai1, m4 hang2 min6 deoi3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是掩盖问题，不愿意面对。
examples.english_sentence: This company always covers up problems and is unwilling to face them.

english_meaning: to close down (a business); to cease operations
explanation_mandarin: 指店铺或公司停止营业，通常指倒闭。也可以指结束某一活动或行动。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop or company ceasing operations, usually due to closure. It can also refer to ending an activity or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳做得唔好，好快就會冚檔㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 ham6 dong3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅做得不好，很快就会倒闭的。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is not doing well, it will close down very soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司因為財政問題，所以要冚檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 coi4 zing3 man6 tai4, so2 ji5 jiu3 ham6 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司因为财政问题，所以要倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is closing down due to financial problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢個project做到咁上下不如冚檔算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 go3 project zou6 dou3 gam3 seung5 haa6 bat1 jyu4 ham6 dong3 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个项目做到差不多就这样结束算了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's just call it quits on this project, since we've gotten this far.

english_meaning: to cover with a blanket
explanation_mandarin: 用毯子或被子盖住身体。
explanation_english: To cover oneself with a blanket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍呀，快啲冚氈瞓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 aa3, faai3 di1 ham6 zin1 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷啊，快点盖被子睡吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold, hurry and cover yourself with a blanket and sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，要冚氈抖下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, jiu3 ham6 zin1 tau2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，要盖被子休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: He is sick, he needs to cover himself with a blanket and rest.

english_meaning: To shut down, to close down, to go bust, to finish
explanation_mandarin: 指店铺倒闭、公司破产、或者计划失败、项目终止。引申为彻底完蛋、结束的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a business closing down, a company going bankrupt, or a plan failing and a project terminating. By extension, it means to be completely finished or to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭蝕咗咁多錢，好快就會冚波㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 sit6 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 ham6 bo1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺亏损这么多钱，很快就要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is losing so much money, it will shut down very soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力啲，呢個計劃就會冚波㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nou5 lik6 di1, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 wui5 ham6 bo1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力一点，这个计划就要失败了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work harder, this plan will fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係冚波啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 ham6 bo1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真是完蛋了！
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly in this exam, I'm finished!

mandarin_meaning: 全家死光 / 彻底完蛋
english_meaning: May your whole family die; May you be completely destroyed; May you all be wiped out
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语骂人话，诅咒对方全家死光或者彻底完蛋。
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese curse that wishes death upon the recipient's entire family or their complete and utter destruction. It's considered extremely offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再搞事，我冚球剷你全家！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 si6, ngo5 ham6 kau4 caan2 nei5 cyun4 gaa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再闹事，我就诅咒你全家死光！
examples.english_sentence: If you cause trouble again, I'll curse your whole family to die!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做埋啲咁嘅嘢，遲早冚球剷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, ci4 zou2 ham6 kau4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这些事情，迟早会彻底完蛋。
examples.english_sentence: Doing these kinds of things, you'll be completely destroyed sooner or later.

english_meaning: May your whole family die; Drop dead (with extreme prejudice)
explanation_mandarin: 非常恶毒的诅咒，表示希望对方全家都遭遇不幸而死亡。
explanation_english: An extremely vicious and offensive curse, wishing death and misfortune upon the entirety of someone's family. It's one of the strongest insults in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔收聲，我詛咒你冚球鏟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 sau1 seng1, ngo5 zo23 zuk1 nei5 ham6 kau4 caan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不闭嘴，我诅咒你全家死光！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't shut up, I curse your whole family to die!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁衰，真係想佢冚球鏟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 seoi1, zan1 hai6 soeng2 keoi5 ham6 kau4 caan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话这么过分，真想他死全家！
examples.english_sentence: He speaks so terribly, I really wish his whole family would die!

english_meaning: All; entirely; completely; to cover (a container)
explanation_mandarin: 冚盅在粤语中可以表示“全部”、“统统”、“所有”的意思。也指用盖子盖住（容器等）。
explanation_english: "Ham6 zung1" in Cantonese can mean "all", "entirely", or "completely". It can also refer to the action of covering something with a lid (a container, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲餸冚盅食晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sung3 ham6 zung1 sik6 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把菜全部吃完。
examples.english_sentence: Eat all the dishes completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冚盅都唔贊成噉做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ham6 zung1 dou1 m4 zaan3 sing4 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们全部都不赞成这样做。
examples.english_sentence: None of us agree to do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冚盅住晒啲碗碟佢，唔好比啲塵埃入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ham6 zung1 zyu6 saai3 di1 wun2 dip2 keoi5, m4 hou2 bei2 di1 can4 oi1 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把碗碟全部盖住，不要让灰尘进去。
examples.english_sentence: Cover all the dishes so that dust doesn't get in.

english_meaning: to raid a hideout/den; to bust a joint
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或犯罪团伙彻底捣毁对方的窝点或据点，一般指非法场所。
explanation_english: Refers to the police or a criminal gang completely raiding the other party's hideout or stronghold, usually referring to illegal places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬琴晚冚咗個賭竇，拉咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 kam4 ngaan5 ham6 zo2 go3 dou2 dau3, laai1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察昨晚捣毁了一个赌场窝点，抓了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The police raided a gambling den last night and arrested many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺嗰度搞搞震，遲早畀人冚竇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 go2 dou6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ci4 zou2 bei2 jan4 ham6 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是在那里搞事，迟早会被人捣毁窝点。
examples.english_sentence: They are always causing trouble there, sooner or later their hideout will be raided.

english_meaning: all; everything; the whole lot
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，所有。通常帶有輕微的負面或不耐煩的語氣。
explanation_english: Refers to all or everything. Often carries a slightly negative or impatient tone. Can also mean 'to cover' in a literal sense, but here we focus on its use as a pronoun meaning 'all'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冚蓋食晒佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ham6 goi3 sik6 saai3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你全部都吃完了？
examples.english_sentence: Did you eat all of it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冚蓋都係假嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ham6 goi3 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 全部都是假的！
examples.english_sentence: It's all fake!

english_meaning: to cover with a blanket; to tuck in
explanation_mandarin: 用被子覆盖身体，通常指睡觉时盖被子。
explanation_english: To cover the body with a blanket, usually when sleeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你凍唔凍啊？要唔要冚被啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dung3 m4 dung3 aa3? jiu3 m4 jiu3 ham6 bei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你冷不冷啊？要不要盖被子啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you cold? Do you need a blanket?

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB 仔瞓覺要幫佢冚被，唔係好易凍親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi4 bi1 zai2 fan3 gaau3 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 ham6 bei6, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 dung3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小宝宝睡觉要帮他盖被子，不然很容易着凉。
examples.english_sentence: You need to cover a baby with a blanket when they sleep, otherwise they can easily catch a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓覺之前記得冚被啊，夜晚可能會凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 gaau3 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 ham6 bei6 aa3, je6 maan1 ho2 nang4 wui5 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡觉之前记得盖被子啊，晚上可能会冷。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to cover yourself with a blanket before you sleep, it might be cold tonight.

english_meaning: all; the whole lot; everything
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部、整个。通常用于口语，带有夸张或略微负面的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates 'all' or 'the whole'. Usually used in spoken Cantonese, often with an exaggerating or slightly negative tone. Implies a complete sweep or involvement of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冚轉人都走晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ham6 zyun3 dou1 jau5 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全部人都走了。
examples.english_sentence: All of them have left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冚轉家當都擺晒喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ham6 zyun3 gaa1 dong3 dou1 baai2 saai3 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我所有的家当都放在这里了。
examples.english_sentence: All my belongings are placed here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試冚轉人都肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ham6 zyun3 jan4 dou1 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试全部人都没及格。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone failed the exam this time.

english_meaning: oversleep, sleep in
explanation_mandarin: 指睡眠时间超过了预定的时间，导致迟到或错过重要事情。
explanation_english: To oversleep; to sleep past the intended waking time, usually resulting in lateness or missing something important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我今朝冚過頭瞓咗，所以遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gam1 ziu1 ham6 gwo3 tau4 fan3 zo2, so2 ji5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今天早上睡过头了，所以迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I overslept this morning, so I was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要早起身，唔好冚過頭瞓呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 hei2 san1, m4 hou2 ham6 gwo3 tau4 fan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要早起，别睡过头了！
examples.english_sentence: You need to get up early tomorrow, don't oversleep!

english_meaning: all, everything, the whole lot, completely
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，所有，一个也不剩。形容词性时表示完全，彻底。
explanation_english: Refers to all, everything, nothing left out. When used as an adjective, it means complete, thorough, or utter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冚𠾴唥都走晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ham6 baan6 laang6 dou1 zau2晒laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全部都走了。
examples.english_sentence: They've all left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲垃圾冚𠾴唥掟晒落樓下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 laap1 saap3 ham6 baan6 laang6 deng3晒lok6 lau2 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把所有的垃圾全部扔到楼下。
examples.english_sentence: I threw all the garbage downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我冚𠾴唥唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ham6 baan6 laang6 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我全部都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to do any of it in this exam.

english_meaning: champion; first place; to crown; to be the best
explanation_mandarin: 指竞赛或评比中获得第一名的人或队伍；也指加冠，戴帽子；引申为最好的。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or team that wins first place in a competition or evaluation; also refers to crowning, putting on a hat; by extension, it means the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今年攞到世界盃嘅冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 nin4 lo2 dou2 sai3 gaai3 bui1 ge3 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今年获得了世界杯的冠军。
examples.english_sentence: They won the World Cup this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅叉燒飯，我覺得佢係全港嘅冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 caa1 siu1 faan6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hai6 cyun4 gong2 ge3 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这家餐厅的叉烧饭是全香港最好的。
examples.english_sentence: I think this restaurant's barbecued pork rice is the best in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢加冕成為咗香港小姐嘅冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa1 min5 sing4 wai4 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 siu2 ze2 ge3 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她加冕成为了香港小姐的冠军。
examples.english_sentence: She was crowned as the champion of Miss Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to put on; to add; to bestow; to crown
explanation_mandarin: 表示将某种称号、名称、责任等加在某人或某事物之上。
explanation_english: To put something on (e.g., a crown, a name); to add something (e.g., a label, a responsibility) to someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人冠上「模範市民」嘅稱號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gun3 soeng5 "mou4 faan6 si5 man4" ge3 cing1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冠以“模范市民”的称号。
examples.english_sentence: He was bestowed with the title of "Model Citizen."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便將啲標籤冠上喺人哋身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 zoeng1 di1 biu1 cim1 gun3 soeng5 hai2 jan4 dei6 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便把标签加在别人身上。
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually label people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽嘅冠軍會被冠上花環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 ge3 gun3 gwan1 wui5 bei2 gun3 soeng5 faa1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛的冠军会被戴上花环。
examples.english_sentence: The champion of the competition will be crowned with a garland.

english_meaning: to crown with; to give the title of; to bestow upon
explanation_mandarin: 指给某人或某事物加上某种名称、称号或荣誉等。
explanation_english: To give someone or something a certain name, title, or honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人冠以「慈善家」嘅稱號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gwaan3 ji5 "ci4 sin6 gaa1" ge3 cing1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冠以“慈善家”的称号。
examples.english_sentence: He was given the title of "philanthropist".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目被冠以「創新科技」嘅名義推出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 bei2 gwaan3 ji5 "cong3 san1 fo1 gei6" ge3 ming4 ngai6 tui1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目被冠以“创新科技”的名义推出。
examples.english_sentence: This project was launched under the name of "innovative technology".

english_meaning: crown, regalia; (figurative) ostentatious, high-sounding (but often empty)
explanation_mandarin: 原指帝王的帽子，引申为虚饰，表面上的好听的言辞或行为。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a crown worn by emperors. Figuratively, it refers to ostentation, high-sounding words or actions that are often empty or insincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲嘢全部都係冠冕堂皇，根本冇實際行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gun1 min5 tong4 wong4, gan1 bun2 mou5 sat6 zai3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话全部都是冠冕堂皇的，根本没有实际行动。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he says is high-sounding but there is no real action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲冠冕嘅理由，我聽得太多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gun1 min5 ge3 lei5 jau2, ngo5 teng1 dak1 taai3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些冠冕堂皇的理由，我听得太多了。
examples.english_sentence: I've heard too many of these high-sounding reasons.

english_meaning: high-sounding; ostentatious; grand-sounding but hollow
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面上堂皇体面，实际上虚伪空洞。
explanation_english: Describing something that appears grand and impressive on the surface but is actually superficial, insincere, and often deceptive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢冠冕堂皇，但係實際上咩都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gun1 min5 tong4 wong4, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeoi3 seoi5 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话冠冕堂皇，但实际上什么都做不到。
examples.english_sentence: What he says sounds grand and impressive, but in reality, he can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫到冠冕堂皇，但係冇乜實際內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 gun1 min5 tong4 wong4, daan6 hai6 mou5 mat1 sat6 zai3 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得冠冕堂皇，但是没有什么实际内容。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written in a grand-sounding manner, but there's not much substance to it.

synonyms: 華而不實 (waa4 ji4 bat1 sat6)
虛有其表 (heoi1 jau5 kei4 biu2)

english_meaning: to name (something, e.g., a program or event) after a sponsor; naming rights
explanation_mandarin: 指在商业活动中，赞助商出资赞助某一项目，并获得该项目的命名权，从而将赞助商的品牌或名称加在该项目名称之前。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a sponsor providing financial support to a project (e.g., a television program, a sporting event) in exchange for the right to have their brand or name incorporated into the name of the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目俾銀行冠名贊助咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 bei2 ngan4 hong4 gun3 ming4 zaan3 zo6 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目被银行冠名赞助了。
examples.english_sentence: This program is sponsored by a bank through naming rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用咗好多錢去冠名贊助個運動會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 heoi3 gun3 ming4 zaan3 zo6 go3 wan6 dung6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们花了很多钱去冠名赞助这个运动会。
examples.english_sentence: They spent a lot of money to be the naming sponsor of the sports event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽嘅冠名權值好多錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 gun3 ming4 kuen4 zik6 hou2 do1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛的冠名权值很多钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The naming rights for this competition are worth a lot of money.

english_meaning: coronary heart disease; coronary artery disease (CAD)
explanation_mandarin: 指供应心脏血液的冠状动脉发生粥样硬化，导致血管狭窄或阻塞，使心肌缺血缺氧而引起的心脏病。
explanation_english: A type of heart disease caused by plaque buildup in the coronary arteries, which supply blood to the heart muscle, leading to reduced blood flow and potential heart damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為有冠心病，所以要定期覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 jau5 gun1 sam1 beng6, so2 ji5 jiu3 ding6 kei4 fuk1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为有冠心病，所以要定期复诊。
examples.english_sentence: Because he has coronary heart disease, he needs to go for regular check-ups.

english_meaning: Coronavirus
explanation_mandarin: 一种病毒，其特征是病毒粒子表面有冠状突起。
explanation_english: A type of virus characterized by a crown-like appearance on the surface of the viral particles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時冠狀病毒好犀利，大家都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 gun3 zong6 beng6 duk6 hou2 sai1 lei6, daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时候冠状病毒非常厉害，大家都非常害怕。
examples.english_sentence: Back then, the coronavirus was very severe, and everyone was very scared.

mandarin_meaning: 独一无二，位居第一，超群
english_meaning: unrivalled, unsurpassed, pre-eminent, to be the best; to be unmatched
explanation_mandarin: 形容在某个方面达到了最高的水平，没有能与之相比的。
explanation_english: Describes something that has reached the highest level in a certain aspect, with nothing comparable to it. It means unparalleled, unsurpassed, or pre-eminent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫功喺呢個年代可以話係冠絕全港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 gung1 hai2 ni1 go3 nin4 doi6 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 gun3 jyut6 cyun4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画功在这个年代可以说是冠绝全香港。
examples.english_sentence: His painting skills can be said to be unrivaled in Hong Kong in this era.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅燒鵝，味道真係冠絕一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 siu1 ngo2, mei6 dou6 zan1 hai6 gun3 jyut6 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的烧鹅，味道真是独一无二。
examples.english_sentence: The roasted goose in this restaurant, the taste is truly unsurpassed.

english_meaning: Surpassing all others, unmatched, preeminent
explanation_mandarin: 形容才华、技艺、成就等超越众人，无人能及。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose talent, skill, or achievement surpasses all others, unmatched and without peer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌藝真係冠絕羣倫，冇人可以同佢比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 ngai6 zan1 hai6 gun3 zyut6 kwan4 leon4, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌艺真是无与伦比，没人可以和他比。
examples.english_sentence: His singing skills are truly unmatched, no one can compare to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅飲食文化冠絕羣倫，世界各地嘅嘢食都喺度搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jam2 sik6 man4 faa3 gun3 zyut6 kwan4 leon4, sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 je5 sik6 dou1 hai2 dou6 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的饮食文化无与伦比，世界各地的食物都可以在这里找到。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's food culture is unsurpassed; you can find food from all over the world here.

english_meaning: to surpass all others; to be unparalleled; to stand out from the crowd; to be preeminent
explanation_mandarin: 形容才能或成就远远超过同辈或同类。
explanation_english: Describes talent or achievement that far surpasses one's peers or others of the same kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺音樂方面嘅天賦，真係冠絕群倫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 fong1 min6 ge3 tin1 fu3, zan1 hai6 gun3 zyut6 kwan4 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在音乐方面的天赋，真是出类拔萃。
examples.english_sentence: His musical talent is truly unparalleled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺今屆嘅比賽入面，佢嘅表現冠絕群倫，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam1 gaai3 ge3 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 gun3 zyut6 kwan4 leon4, lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在今届的比赛里，他的表现鹤立鸡群，拿了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: In this year's competition, his performance surpassed all others and he won the championship.

mandarin_meaning: 冠蓋雲集 (guān gài yún jí)
english_meaning: A gathering of high-ranking officials and dignitaries; a distinguished assembly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容許多達官顯貴聚集在一起的盛況。冠：指官帽；蓋：指車蓋，古代官員乘坐的車輛上有車蓋。
explanation_english: Describes a grand occasion where many high-ranking officials and dignitaries are gathered together. '冠' (guan) refers to an official's hat; '蓋' (gai) refers to the canopy of a carriage, which was used by officials in ancient times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅慈善晚宴，冠蓋雲集，好多商界名人都有嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 ci4 sin6 maan5 jin3, gun3 goi3 wan4 zaap6, hou2 do1 soeng1 gaai3 ming4 jan4 dou1 jau5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的慈善晚宴，冠蓋雲集，很多商界名人都来了。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's charity gala is a gathering of dignitaries; many business celebrities have come.

english_meaning: Champion; First place; Winner
explanation_mandarin: 指竞赛或比赛中的第一名。
explanation_english: The person or team that wins a competition or contest; first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波攞咗冠軍，真係好勁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的球队获得了冠军，真的很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: Their team won the championship, they are really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽，我哋目標係攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 muk6 biu1 hai6 lo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛，我们的目标是获得冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Our goal for this competition is to win the championship.

english_meaning: grave; tomb; mound
explanation_mandarin: 指坟墓，通常指比较大的坟墓。
explanation_english: Refers to a grave or tomb, usually a large or prominent one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個山上面有好多先人嘅冢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 saan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 sin1 jan4 ge3 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座山上有很多先人的坟墓。
examples.english_sentence: There are many ancestral graves on that mountain.

english_meaning: wronged; unjustly treated; wronged; a raw deal; unfair
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公正的待遇或指控，无辜受累。
explanation_english: Refers to being treated unfairly, wrongly accused, or unjustly blamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人屈，真係好冤㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wat1, zan1 hai6 hou2 jyun1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人诬陷，真是很冤枉啊！
examples.english_sentence: He was framed; it's such a raw deal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣判佢，佢咪好冤囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 pun3 keoi5, keoi5 mai1 hou2 jyun1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样判他，他不就很冤枉吗？
examples.english_sentence: Sentencing him like that, wouldn't he be very wronged?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢好冤枉，成件事根本唔關佢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 jyun1 wong2, seng4 gin6 si6 gan1 bun2 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他很冤枉，整件事根本不关他的事。
examples.english_sentence: I think he's being wronged; the whole thing has nothing to do with him.

english_meaning: enmity, grudge, feud, grievance, wrong
explanation_mandarin: 指因受委屈或损害而产生的怨恨；积怨。
explanation_english: A feeling of resentment or bitterness resulting from a perceived wrong or injury; a grudge or feud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家人之間有好深嘅冤仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 jan4 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 sam1 ge3 jyun1 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家人之间有很深的仇恨。
examples.english_sentence: There is a deep feud between their two families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化解冤仇並唔係一件容易嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 gaai2 jyun1 sau4 bing6 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 jung4 ji6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化解仇恨不是一件容易的事。
examples.english_sentence: Resolving a grudge is not an easy task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該結下任何冤仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 git3 haa6 jam6 ho4 jyun1 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该结下任何仇恨。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't make any enemies.

english_meaning: to feel wronged, to be aggrieved, to harbor resentment
explanation_mandarin: 指心中感到冤屈，感到委屈而耿耿于怀。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling wronged or aggrieved in one's heart, harboring resentment and dwelling on the unfairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己冤住，所以一直唔肯收貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 wun1 zyu6, so2 ji5 jat1 zik6 m4 hang2 sau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己很委屈，所以一直不肯接受。
examples.english_sentence: He feels wronged, so he refuses to accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好冤住啦，解釋清楚咪冇事囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wun1 zyu6 laa1, gaai2 sik1 cing1 co2 mai1 mou5 si6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别感到委屈了，解释清楚就没事了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't feel wronged, explain clearly and everything will be alright.

jyutping: jyun1 jyun1 soeng1 bou3 ho4 si4 liu5
mandarin_meaning: 冤冤相报何时了 (yuān yuān xiāng bào hé shí le)
english_meaning: When will retribution cease?
explanation_mandarin: 意思是冤冤相报，没完没了，什么时候才能结束呢？ 形容仇恨不能解决问题，只会使仇恨延续下去。
explanation_english: This idiom means that revenge only begets more revenge, creating a never-ending cycle. It asks, when will this cycle of vengeance end? It suggests that hatred and revenge are not solutions and only perpetuate conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個唔好再嘈啦，冤冤相報何時了啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 m4 hou2 zoi3 cou4 laa1, jyun1 jyun1 soeng1 bou3 ho4 si4 liu5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个别再吵了，冤冤相报何时了啊？
examples.english_sentence: You two stop arguing, when will the cycle of revenge end?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得應該放低仇恨，唔係冤冤相報何時了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ying1 goi1 fong3 dai1 cau4 han3, m4 hai6 jyun1 jyun1 soeng1 bou3 ho4 si4 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得应该放下仇恨，不然冤冤相报何时了。
examples.english_sentence: I think we should let go of the hatred, otherwise the cycle of revenge will never end.

synonyms: 以牙還牙 (ji5 ngaa4 waan4 ngaa4) - not a true synonym as it advocates revenge, but represents the opposite of the idiom's intended meaning.

english_meaning: greatly wronged; terribly wronged; to be unjustly accused
explanation_mandarin: 表示受到极大的委屈或冤枉，程度比一般的“委屈”更深。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of being greatly wronged or unjustly accused, with a deeper degree of injustice than a general feeling of being 'wronged'. It emphasizes the severity of the unfairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人屈佢偷嘢，真係冤厲啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wat1 keoi5 tau1 je5, zan1 hai6 jyun1 lai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冤枉偷东西，真是太冤枉了！
examples.english_sentence: He was wrongly accused of stealing something, it's such a terrible injustice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我明明無做過，但係老細話我搞砸咗個project，真係冤厲到喊都無謂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ming4 ming4 mou5 zou6 gwo3, daan6 hai6 lou5 sai3 waa6 ngo5 gaau2 zaat3 zo2 go3 project, zan1 hai6 jyun1 lai6 dou3 haam3 dou1 mou5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明明没有做过，但是老板说我搞砸了那个项目，真是委屈得哭都没用。
examples.english_sentence: I clearly didn't do anything, but the boss said I ruined the project. It's such an injustice that it's not even worth crying about.

mandarin_meaning: 委屈的样子; 冤枉相
english_meaning: looking aggrieved; having a wronged expression; acting hard done by
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人一脸委屈，好像受到了冤枉的样子。带有责备对方装可怜的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone looking aggrieved, as if they have been wronged. Often used to imply that the person is putting on an act of being pitiful or hard done by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好冤口冤面啦，今次真係你錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jyun1 hau2 jyun1 min6 laa1, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 nei5 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别装委屈了，这次真的是你错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look so aggrieved, it's really your fault this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度冤口冤面，冇人會可憐你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 jyun1 hau2 jyun1 min6, mou5 jan4 wui5 ho2 lin4 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里装可怜，没人会同情你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act all wronged here, nobody will pity you.

english_meaning: What an injustice! I've been wronged!
explanation_mandarin: 表示极度冤屈和委屈的情感，带有强烈的无奈和抱怨。
explanation_english: Expresses extreme injustice and grievances, carrying a strong sense of helplessness and complaint. It's used when someone feels they have been treated very unfairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇偷佢啲錢，點解屈我呀？冤哉枉也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 tau1 keoi5 di1 cin2, dim2 gaai2 wat1 ngo5 aa3? jyun1 zoi1 wong2 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没偷他的钱，为什么冤枉我呀？冤枉啊！
examples.english_sentence: I didn't steal his money, why are you framing me? What an injustice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明唔係我做嘅，你哋都話係我，冤哉枉也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 m4 hai6 ngo5 zou6 ge3, nei5 dei6 dou1 waa6 hai6 ngo5, jyun1 zoi1 wong2 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明不是我做的，你们都说是我的，冤枉啊！
examples.english_sentence: It clearly wasn't me who did it, but you all say it was me. What an injustice!

english_meaning: sucker, chump, patsy, someone who gets ripped off; a fool who pays too much
explanation_mandarin: 指容易被骗或被宰的人，花冤枉钱的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is easily cheated or ripped off, someone who spends money unnecessarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，唔好做人哋嘅冤大頭啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 jyun1 daai6 tau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨了，不要做别人的冤大头啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't be someone else's sucker!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭啲嘢咁貴，唔想做冤大頭就唔好幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, m4 soeng2 zou6 jyun1 daai6 tau4 zau6 m4 hou2 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的东西这么贵，不想当冤大头就不要光顾。
examples.english_sentence: The things in this shop are so expensive, don't be a sucker and don't patronize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部壞咗嘅手機，真係做咗個冤大頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 waai6 zo2 ge3 sau2 gei1, zan1 hai6 zou6 zo2 go3 jyun1 daai6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一部坏了的手机，真是当了个冤大头。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a broken phone, he really got ripped off.

english_meaning: lover (often implying a relationship with arguments and affection); nemesis; adversary; darling
explanation_mandarin: 指既是爱人，又是冤对，关系复杂的情侣或夫妻；也指对手或敌人，带有戏谑或亲昵的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a lover who is also an antagonist, implying a complex relationship with both affection and arguments; can also refer to a nemesis or adversary, often with a playful or affectionate tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個成日嘈交，真係一對冤家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 leong5 go3 sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, zan1 hai6 jat1 deoi3 jyun1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个人总是吵架，真是一对冤家。
examples.english_sentence: You two are always arguing, you're really a couple of lovers who are also adversaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢喺生意上係冤家，但係私底下都幾friend。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai2 sang1 ji3 soeng6 hai6 jyun1 gaa1, daan6 hai6 si1 dai2 haa6 dou1 gei2 friend.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他在生意上是冤家，但是私底下还挺朋友的。
examples.english_sentence: We are adversaries in business, but we're quite friendly in private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冤家，你又搞咩搞到咁晏返啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun1 gaa1, nei5 jau6 gaau2 me1 gaau2 dou3 gam3 aan3 faan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冤家，你又在搞什么搞到这么晚才回来啊？
examples.english_sentence: Darling, what were you doing that made you come home so late?

english_meaning: Enemies meet on a narrow road; Fate brings enemies together; It's a small world (when you meet someone you dislike)
explanation_mandarin: 指仇人或不愿意见到的人在狭窄的地方相遇，形容命中注定要碰面，躲也躲不掉。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where enemies or people you dislike are destined to meet in a small or limited space. It suggests that the encounter is unavoidable due to fate or circumstance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解我咁唔好彩，去到邊都撞到佢，真係冤家路窄！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 ngo5 gam3 m4 hou2 coi2, heoi3 dou3 bin1 dou1 zong6 dou3 keoi5, zan1 hai6 jyun1 gaa1 lou6 zaak3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为什么我这么倒霉，去哪里都碰到他，真是冤家路窄！
examples.english_sentence: Why am I so unlucky? I keep bumping into him everywhere I go. It's really a small world (when you meet someone you dislike)!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢喺公司反咗面，點知轉工又喺隔離team，真係冤家路窄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 faan2 zo2 min6, dim2 zi1 zyun2 gung1 jau6 hai2 gaak3 lei4 team1, zan1 hai6 jyun1 gaa1 lou6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他在公司闹翻了，没想到换工作又在隔壁团队，真是冤家路窄。
examples.english_sentence: I fell out with him at the company, and unexpectedly we ended up in the team next door after I changed jobs. It's really enemies meeting on a narrow road.

english_meaning: wronged, injustice, grievance; to feel wronged; unjust
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公平的待遇，蒙受冤枉。形容受到委屈，感到冤枉。
explanation_english: Refers to being treated unfairly or suffering injustice. Describes feeling wronged or aggrieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己好冤屈，因為佢冇做過啲嘢都要孭鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 jyun1 wat1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 di1 je5 dou1 jiu3 be1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己很冤枉，因为他没做过的事情也要背黑锅。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very wronged because he had to take the blame for things he didn't even do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁冤屈人啦，你都冇證據！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jyun1 wat1 jan4 laa1, nei5 dou1 mou5 zing3 geoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么冤枉人，你都没有证据！
examples.english_sentence: Don't accuse people so unfairly, you don't even have evidence!

english_meaning: utterly terrible; a complete mess; chaotic and undesirable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情、情况或物品非常糟糕，混乱不堪，让人感到厌恶。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes something, a situation, or an object that is extremely bad, messy, and undesirable, causing disgust or annoyance. It has a negative connotation. It suggests a state of complete disarray and unpleasantness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房畀佢搞到冤崩爛臭，真係唔知點執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou3 jyun1 bang1 laan6 cau3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间被他弄得乱七八糟，真不知道怎么收拾。
examples.english_sentence: He made the room a complete mess, I really don't know how to clean it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢搞到冤崩爛臭，不如重新嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 gaau2 dou3 jyun1 bang1 laan6 cau3, bat1 jyu4 cung4 san1 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事弄得非常糟糕，不如重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has turned into a complete disaster, we might as well start over.

english_meaning: grievance; injustice; wrongful accusation; unjust case
explanation_mandarin: 指受到冤屈，蒙受冤枉的事情或情况。
explanation_english: A situation where someone has been wronged or unjustly accused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己有冤情，所以決定上訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 jau5 jyun1 cing4, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 soeng5 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己有冤情，所以决定上诉。
examples.english_sentence: He felt he had a grievance, so he decided to appeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單案嘅調查揭露咗好多冤情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 on3 ge3 diu6 ca4 kit3 lou6 zo2 hou2 do1 jyun1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件案件的调查揭露了很多冤情。
examples.english_sentence: The investigation of this case revealed many injustices.

english_meaning: unjust; unfair; unreasonable; to feel wronged; to be wronged
explanation_mandarin: 形容感到委屈、冤枉，或者指事情不合理、不公平。
explanation_english: Describes feeling wronged, treated unfairly, or refers to something that is unreasonable or unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得畀老細鬧得好冤戾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 dak1 hou2 jyun1 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得被老板骂得很冤枉。
examples.english_sentence: He feels that he was scolded by the boss unfairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁冤戾，梗係要投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 jyun1 lai6, gang2 hai6 jiu3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么不公平，当然要投诉。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so unfair, of course, we have to complain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁冤戾啦，講清楚咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jyun1 lai6 laa1, gong2 cing1 co2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么不讲理了，说清楚不就行了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unreasonable, just explain it clearly.

jyutping: yuen1 yau5 tau4 jaai3 yau5 zyu2
mandarin_meaning: 冤有头，债有主 (yuān yǒu tóu, zhài yǒu zhǔ)
english_meaning: Every wrong has a perpetrator, every debt has a debtor; hold the right person accountable.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻凡事都有原因和责任人，应该找当事人负责。
explanation_english: This idiom means that every wrongdoing has someone responsible, and every debt has someone who owes it. You should seek redress from the person actually responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞錯，冤有頭債有主，你搵返個呃你錢嘅人啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 co3, yuen1 yau5 tau4 jaai3 yau5 zyu2, nei5 wan2 faan1 go3 aak1 nei5 chin2 ge3 yan4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要搞错了，冤有头债有主，你去找骗你钱的人吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't get the wrong person. Every wrong has a perpetrator, find the person who scammed you out of your money!

english_meaning: wrongfully accused; unjustly treated; injustice; a wrong
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公正的对待或指控；指事情不符合事实，使人受到委屈。
explanation_english: To be wrongly accused or treated; to suffer an injustice; something that is not in accordance with the truth and causes someone to feel wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔係偷嘢嘅，唔好咁冤枉自己啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hai6 tau1 je5 ge3, m4 hou2 gam3 jyun1 wong2 zi6 gei2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又没有偷东西，不要这样冤枉自己啦！
examples.english_sentence: You didn't steal anything, don't accuse yourself wrongly like that!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得好冤枉，明明唔係我做嘅，但係佢哋都話係我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 jyun1 wong2, ming4 ming4 m4 hai6 ngo5 zou6 ge3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 waa6 hai6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得很冤枉，明明不是我做的，但是他们都说是我的。
examples.english_sentence: I feel so wronged, it clearly wasn't me who did it, but they all say it was me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官判佢有罪，但係佢係無辜嘅，真係好冤枉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 pun3 keoi5 jau5 zeoi6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai6 mou4 gu1 ge3, zan1 hai6 hou2 jyun1 wong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官判他有罪，但是他是无辜的，真是太冤枉了。
examples.english_sentence: The judge sentenced him guilty, but he is innocent, it's truly an injustice.

jyutping: jyun1 wong2 loi4 wan1 jik6 heoi3
english_meaning: To be wrongly accused, and then the misfortune disappears; to have misfortune come upon one unjustly, only for it to then disappear
explanation_mandarin: 形容无辜受罪，但灾难最终得以解除。表示坏运气或恶名来得不公正，但最终会消失。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is wrongly accused or suffers misfortune unjustly, but the misfortune eventually disappears. It implies that the bad luck or ill repute arrived unfairly but will eventually fade away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇做過，俾人屈佢偷嘢，真係冤枉來瘟疫去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 zou6 gwo3, bei2 jan4 wat1 keoi5 tau1 je5, zan1 hai6 jyun1 wong2 loi4 wan1 jik6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没做过，被人冤枉偷东西，真是无辜遭罪，灾祸消散。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly didn't do it, but he was wrongly accused of stealing something. It's a case of misfortune unjustly befalling him and then disappearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員炒咗佢，好似冤枉來瘟疫去咁，之後佢搵到份更好嘅工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 caau2 zo2 keoi5, hou2 ci5 jyun1 wong2 loi4 wan1 jik6 heoi3 gam2, zi1 hau6 keoi5 wan2 dou2 fan6 gang3 hou2 ge3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁员炒了他，好像无辜受罪后灾祸消散一样，之后他找到一份更好的工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company laid him off, but it was like misfortune unjustly befalling him and then disappearing, because he found a better job afterwards.

jyutping: jyun1 wong2 lai4 wan1 jik6 heoi3
mandarin_meaning: 冤屈招来灾祸，指无端受冤，事事不顺。
english_meaning: Misfortune invites disaster; unjustly accused leading to a string of bad luck/problems.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人无辜受到冤屈，导致一系列倒霉的事情发生，好像瘟疫一样接踵而来。形容运气很差，祸不单行。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone is wrongly accused or treated unfairly, which then leads to a series of unfortunate or disastrous events, like a plague following one after another. It describes extreme bad luck and misfortune compounding upon misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明今個月真係冤枉嚟瘟疫去，先俾人炒魷，之後又俾人呃錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 gam1 go3 jyut6 zan1 hai6 jyun1 wong2 lai4 wan1 jik6 heoi3, sin1 bei2 jan4 caau2 yau4, zi1 hau6 jau6 bei2 jan4 aak1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明这个月真是冤屈招来灾祸，先是被炒鱿鱼，之后又被人骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming has really had misfortune inviting disaster this month. First, he was fired, and then he was scammed out of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢失業之後，就冤枉嚟瘟疫去，連屋企都火燭埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, zau6 jyun1 wong2 lai4 wan1 jik6 heoi3, lin4 uk1 kei2 dou1 fo2 zuk1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他失业之后，就冤屈招来灾祸，连家里都着火了。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he lost his job, he's been experiencing misfortune inviting disaster. Even his house caught fire.

mandarin_meaning: 冤枉路, 冤枉道, 白走一趟
english_meaning: unnecessary journey, detour, to take the long way around, to do something in vain, to waste effort
explanation_mandarin: 不必要的路程；白费功夫的途径。
explanation_english: An unnecessary journey or detour; a route or method that wastes effort and time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行錯咗路，兜咗好多冤枉路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 co3 zo2 lou6, dau1 zo2 hou2 do1 jyun1 wong2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走错路了，绕了很多冤枉路。
examples.english_sentence: We took the wrong road and ended up taking a lot of unnecessary detours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再兜冤枉路，你直接話我知點做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 dau1 jyun1 wong2 lou6, nei5 zik6 zip3 waa6 ngo5 zi1 dim2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再走冤枉路，你直接告诉我怎么做吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to waste my time anymore, just tell me directly how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學嘢唔好怕行冤枉路，從錯誤中學習先至重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 je5 m4 hou2 paa3 haang4 jyun1 wong2 lou6, cung4 co3 ng6 zung1 hok6 zaai2 sin1 zi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习不要害怕走冤枉路，从错误中学习才重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid to take unnecessary detours when learning; learning from mistakes is what's important.

english_meaning: wrongful case; miscarriage of justice
explanation_mandarin: 指被错误判决的案件，通常指无辜的人被判刑或处决。
explanation_english: A wrongful case; a case of miscarriage of justice, usually referring to a situation where an innocent person is wrongly convicted or executed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑自己老豆係一宗冤案嘅受害者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 zi6 gei2 lou5 dau2 hai6 jat1 zung1 jyun1 on3 ge3 sau6 hoi6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他怀疑他爸爸是一宗冤案的受害者。
examples.english_sentence: He suspects that his father is a victim of a miscarriage of justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單冤案引起咗社會廣泛關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 jyun1 on3 ging2 hei2 zo2 se5 wui2 gwong2 faan3 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件冤案引起了社会广泛关注。
examples.english_sentence: This wrongful case has aroused widespread public concern.

english_meaning: resentment; bitterness; feeling wronged; a feeling of being unfairly treated
explanation_mandarin: 指心中积压的委屈、怨恨之气，通常是因为感到受到了不公正的待遇。
explanation_english: Refers to the feeling of resentment and bitterness accumulated in one's heart, usually because one feels unfairly treated. It implies a lingering feeling of being wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，一路都好大冤氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 daai6 jyun1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，一直都很有怨气。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he's been full of resentment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多冤氣啦，過去嘅事就由佢過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 jyun1 hei3 laa1, gwo3 heoi3 ge3 si6 zau6 jau4 keoi5 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么多的怨气了，过去的事情就让它过去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so resentful, let the past be the past.

english_meaning: wrongful imprisonment; unjust sentence
explanation_mandarin: 指无辜的人被错误地判刑监禁。
explanation_english: Refers to the imprisonment of an innocent person due to a wrongful conviction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人屈咗，坐咗十年冤獄，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wat1 zo2, co5 zo2 sap6 nin4 jyun1 juk6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人陷害了，坐了十年冤狱，真可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He was framed and spent ten years in wrongful imprisonment; it's truly pitiful.

mandarin_meaning: 冤枉; 蒙受不白之冤
english_meaning: unjustly accused; wrongfully treated; unfairly blamed; framed
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公正的待遇，被冤枉。
explanation_english: Describes being treated unfairly or unjustly, often involving false accusations or blame. Implies a strong sense of grievance and being wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇做過，但係都俾人屈，真係冤臭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 zou6 gwo3, daan6 hai6 dou1 bei2 jan4 wat1, zan1 hai6 jyun1 cau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没做过，但是还是被人冤枉了，真是冤枉。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly didn't do it, but he was still framed. It's truly unjust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁冤臭，一定要幫佢澄清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 jyun1 cau3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 cing1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么冤枉，一定要帮他澄清。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so unjust, we must help him clear his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁冤臭人，要講證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 jyun1 cau3 jan4, jiu3 gong2 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱冤枉人，要讲证据。
examples.english_sentence: Don't accuse people unjustly. Provide evidence.

english_meaning: wronged spirit, vengeful ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指含冤而死的鬼魂，带有强烈的怨气。
explanation_english: Refers to a ghost who died unjustly, filled with strong resentment and seeking revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢死得咁慘，實變成冤鬼翻嚟報仇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei2 dak1 gam3 caam2, sat1 bin3 sing4 jyun1 gwai2 faan1 lai4 bou3 cau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他死得这么惨，肯定会变成冤魂回来报仇的。
examples.english_sentence: He died so tragically, he will definitely become a vengeful ghost and come back for revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話嗰度有冤鬼出沒，所以冇人敢去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 go2 dou6 jau5 jyun1 gwai2 ceot1 mut6, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 gam2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说那里有冤魂出没，所以没人敢去。
examples.english_sentence: People say there are vengeful ghosts haunting that place, so no one dares to go.

english_meaning: wronged spirit, vengeful ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指含冤而死的鬼魂，通常带有怨气和报复心理。
explanation_english: Refers to a ghost who died unjustly, often harboring resentment and a desire for revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話呢度成日都有冤魂出現，搞到人心惶惶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 ni1 dou6 sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 jyun1 wan4 ceot1 hin3, gaau2 dou3 jan4 sam1 wong4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说这里经常有冤魂出现，搞得人心惶惶。
examples.english_sentence: They say that wronged spirits often appear here, causing fear and panic among people.

english_meaning: Restless souls of the wronged; Unavenged spirits; The wronged dead never find peace.
explanation_mandarin: 指含冤而死的人的灵魂无法安息，带有强烈的愤恨和不甘的情绪。形容冤情深重，难以平复。
explanation_english: Refers to the souls of those who died unjustly being unable to find peace, carrying strong resentment and unwillingness. It describes a deep sense of injustice that is difficult to appease. It suggests the consequences of injustice persist even after death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢哋死咗咁耐，啲冤魂都仲係不息，希望可以沉冤得雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 keoi5 dei6 si2 zo2 gam3 noi6, di1 jyun1 wan4 dou1 zung1 hai6 bat1 sik1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 cam4 jyun1 dak1 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使他们死了这么久，那些冤魂仍然无法安息，希望可以洗清冤屈。
examples.english_sentence: Even though they died so long ago, the restless souls of the wronged still haven't found peace, hoping their grievance can be redressed.

english_meaning: unappeased spirit; lingering ghost; the spirit of the wronged won't leave; haunted by the past
explanation_mandarin: 形容含冤而死的人的灵魂不肯离去，也用来比喻一些事物或问题持续存在，难以解决或忘记。
explanation_english: Describes the spirit of someone who died unjustly refusing to leave. It is also used to describe things or problems that persist and are difficult to resolve or forget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事都過咗咁耐，你都仲好似冤魂不散咁，唔肯放過自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dou1 gwo3 zo2 gam3 noi6, nei5 dou1 zung6 hou2 ci5 jyun1 wan4 bat1 saan3 gam2, m4 hang2 fong3 gwo3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事都过去这么久了，你还像冤魂不散一样，不肯放过自己。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so long since that happened, but you're still like an unappeased spirit, unwilling to let go of yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲謠言好似冤魂不散咁，永遠都解釋唔清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jiu4 jin4 hou2 ci5 jyun1 wan4 bat1 saan3 gam2, wing5 jyun5 dou1 gaai2 sik1 m4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些谣言好像冤魂不散一样，永远都解释不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Those rumors are like unappeased spirits, they can never be completely explained away.

english_meaning: dark, obscure, the afterlife, to die
explanation_mandarin: 形容昏暗、幽暗，也指人死后的世界。在粤语中，常出现在一些固定搭配的词语中。
explanation_english: Describes darkness or obscurity. Also refers to the world after death. In Cantonese, it often appears in fixed expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冥錢係燒畀先人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming5 cin2 hai6 siu1 bei2 sin1 yan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冥币是烧给去世的人的。
examples.english_sentence: Hell money is burned for the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲嘅劇情冥到好恐怖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 ming5 dou3 hou2 hung2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的情节阴暗到很恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is so dark and terrifying.

english_meaning: in the dark, mysteriously, secretly, fatefully, seemingly predestined
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情的发生或发展难以预测，带有神秘或命运安排的意味。
explanation_english: Describes the occurrence or development of events that are difficult to predict, often implying a sense of mystery or fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得冥冥中好似有人幫緊我咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ming4 ming4 zung1 hou2 ci5 jau5 jan4 bong1 gan2 ngo5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得冥冥之中好像有人在帮我。
examples.english_sentence: I feel like someone is helping me secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅相遇好似係冥冥中注定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 soeng1 jyu6 hou2 ci5 hai6 ming4 ming4 zung1 zyu3 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的相遇好像是冥冥之中注定的。
examples.english_sentence: Our meeting seems to be predestined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工好似冥冥中安排咗俾佢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hou2 ci5 ming4 ming4 zung1 on1 paai4 zo2 bei2 keoi5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作好像是冥冥之中安排给他的。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like his job was fatefully arranged for him.

english_meaning: in the dark, in the unknown; mysteriously; as if predestined
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生的原因或力量是神秘的、不可知的，带有宿命论的意味。通常指事情的发生并非偶然，而是有某种无法解释的力量在背后推动。
explanation_english: Refers to a mysterious, unknowable cause or force behind an event, often with a sense of destiny or fate. It suggests that the occurrence is not accidental, but driven by some inexplicable power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗呢件事冥冥之中好似注定咗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 ni1 gin6 si6 ming5 ming5 zi1 zung1 hou2 ci5 zyu3 ding6 zo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这件事冥冥之中好像是注定好了的。
examples.english_sentence: I think this matter seems predestined in a mysterious way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅相遇，冥冥之中就好似有安排咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 soeng1 jyu6, ming5 ming5 zi1 zung1 zau6 hou2 ci5 jau5 on1 paai4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的相遇，冥冥之中就好像是被安排好了一样。
examples.english_sentence: Their encounter seemed to be arranged somehow, mysteriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 或者呢一切都係冥冥之中嘅安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waak6 ze2 ni1 jat1 cai3 dou1 hai6 ming5 ming5 zi1 zung1 ge3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 或许这一切都是冥冥之中的安排。
examples.english_sentence: Perhaps all of this is a mysterious arrangement.

synonyms: 命中注定 (ming6 zung1 zyu3 ding6)

english_meaning: Death anniversary (birthday celebration for the deceased)
explanation_mandarin: 指已故之人的忌辰，即逝世后的生日，人们会举行祭祀活动来纪念。
explanation_english: Refers to the anniversary of a deceased person's birth. It's a day for remembrance and offering sacrifices to the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係爺爺嘅冥壽，我哋要去拜山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 je4 je4 ge3 ming4 sau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是爷爷的冥诞，我们要去扫墓。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Grandpa's death anniversary, we need to visit his grave.

english_meaning: Ghost marriage; spirit marriage
explanation_mandarin: 一種傳統習俗，指為已故的人舉行婚禮。通常是為未婚去世的男女舉行，目的是讓他們在陰間也能得到伴侶。
explanation_english: A traditional custom of arranging a marriage for deceased individuals. Usually performed for unmarried men and women who have passed away, with the intention of providing them with a companion in the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋屋企幫個仔搞咗場冥婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 bong1 go3 zai2 gaau2 zo2 coeng4 ming5 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们家给儿子办了一场冥婚。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that their family arranged a ghost marriage for their son.

english_meaning: Hell money; joss paper money
explanation_mandarin: 祭祀时烧给死者的纸钱，也称为阴司钱、纸钱。
explanation_english: Hell money or joss paper money is paper that resembles legal currency but is designed to be burned as an offering to ancestors or deities. It's believed to provide the deceased with wealth in the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嘅時候，好多人會燒冥幣俾祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 siu1 ming4 bai6 bei2 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，很多人会烧冥币给祖先。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, many people burn hell money for their ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔會亂咁燒冥幣，覺得好嘥錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 wui5 lyun6 gam2 siu1 ming4 bai6, gok3 dak1 hou2 saai1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他不会乱烧冥币，觉得很浪费钱。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't burn hell money randomly, feeling it's a waste of money.

english_meaning: Underworld, Hades, realm of the dead
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后灵魂所去的地方，也叫阴间、地府。
explanation_english: Refers to the place where a person's soul goes after death, also known as the underworld or the realm of the dead. It's often associated with traditional Chinese beliefs about the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講人死咗之後會去冥府報到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 jan4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui5 heoi3 ming5 fu2 bou3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说人死后会去阴间报道。
examples.english_sentence: It's said that after death, people go to the underworld to report in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講到冥府嘅嘢，好似去過咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 dou3 ming5 fu2 ge3 je5, hou2 ci5 heoi3 gwo3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是谈论关于阴间的事情，好像去过一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's always talking about the underworld, as if he's been there before.

english_meaning: meditation, to meditate
explanation_mandarin: 通过集中精神或心灵，达到精神上的平静或启迪。
explanation_english: The practice of training your mind to focus and redirect your thoughts, often to achieve a mentally clear and emotionally calm state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都會用十分鐘冥想，幫助自己放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 yung6 sap6 fan1 zung1 ming5 soeng2, bong1 zo6 zi6 gei2 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都会用十分钟冥想，帮助自己放松。
examples.english_sentence: I meditate for ten minutes every day to help myself relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話冥想可以減輕壓力，改善睡眠質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ming5 soeng2 ho2 ji5 gaam2 hing1 aat3 lik6, gai2 sin6 seoi6 min4 zat1 so3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说冥想可以减轻压力，改善睡眠质量。
examples.english_sentence: He said meditation can reduce stress and improve sleep quality.

english_meaning: Pluto
explanation_mandarin: 太阳系曾经的第九大行星，现为矮行星。
explanation_english: The former ninth planet of the Solar System, now classified as a dwarf planet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲書話冥王星係太陽系嘅行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 syu1 waa6 ming5 wong4 sing1 hai6 taai3 joeng4 hai6 ge3 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前书上说冥王星是太阳系的行星。
examples.english_sentence: Books used to say that Pluto was a planet in the Solar System.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文學家將冥王星重新分類做矮行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 zoeng1 ming5 wong4 sing1 cung4 san1 fan1 leoi6 zou6 ai2 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文学家将冥王星重新分类为矮行星。
examples.english_sentence: Astronomers reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet.

english_meaning: To communicate with the dead, paranormal communication, spiritualism
explanation_mandarin: 指与阴间沟通，通常指通过某些仪式或媒介与死者交流。也泛指通灵。
explanation_english: Refers to communicating with the deceased, usually through rituals or mediums. Generally refers to spiritualism or psychic ability to contact the spirit world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己識得冥通，可以同死咗嘅親人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 ming4 tung1, ho2 ji5 tung4 sei2 zo2 ge3 can1 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己懂得阴通，可以和去世的亲人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He says he knows how to communicate with the dead and can chat with deceased relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信嗰啲冥通嘅嘢，好多都係呃人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 go2 di1 ming4 tung1 ge3 ye5, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 aak1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信那些阴通的事情，很多都是骗人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe those spiritual communication things; many are scams.

english_meaning: joss paper; spirit money; paper offerings for the deceased
explanation_mandarin: 指祭祀亡灵时焚烧的纸钱，通常印有类似货币的图案，象征给死者在阴间使用的钱财。
explanation_english: Joss paper, also known as spirit money or ghost money, are paper offerings burned for the deceased. They are usually printed with patterns resembling currency and symbolize money for the deceased to use in the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嘅時候，好多人都會去掃墓燒冥鏹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 sou3 mou6 siu1 ming4 koeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，很多人都会去扫墓烧纸钱。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, many people go to sweep the tombs and burn joss paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆叮囑我哋要買多啲冥鏹俾過身嘅爺爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po4 ding1 zuk1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 do1 di1 ming4 koeng5 bei2 gwo3 san1 ge3 je4 je4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶嘱咐我们要买多一些纸钱给过世的爷爷。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma instructed us to buy more joss paper for our deceased grandfather.

english_meaning: obstinate and impervious to reason; stubbornly obtuse; incorrigibly stupid; hopelessly stubborn
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚昧顽固，不通情理。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is ignorant, stubborn, and unreasonable, not amenable to reason or persuasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都講咗咁多次，佢都仲係唔聽，真係冥頑不靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, keoi5 dou1 zung6 hai6 m4 teng1, zan1 hai6 ming4 waan4 bat1 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都说了这么多次，他还是不听，真是冥顽不灵。
examples.english_sentence: You've told him so many times, but he still doesn't listen, he's truly obstinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲老人家好固執，有啲嘢佢哋覺得啱就啱，你講咩都無用，真係冥頑不靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 hou2 gu3 zap1, jau5 di1 je5 keoi5 dei6 gok3 dak1 aam1 zau6 aam1, nei5 gong2 me1 dou1 mou5 jung6, zan1 hai6 ming4 waan4 bat1 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些老人家很固执，有些事情他们觉得对就对，你说什么都没用，真是冥顽不灵。
examples.english_sentence: These old people are very stubborn, if they think something is right, it's right.  It's useless no matter what you say, they are truly incorrigible.

mandarin_meaning: 倒塌; 陷入情网; 感到高兴
english_meaning: to collapse; to fall in love (with); to be delighted; to be charmed
explanation_mandarin: 动词：倾倒、塌下来。形容词：形容人感到非常高兴、快乐，或形容人坠入爱河。
explanation_english: Verb: to collapse, to fall down. Adjective: Used to describe someone feeling very happy or pleased; also used to describe someone falling in love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋就嚟冧喇，快啲走！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zau6 lai4 lam1 laa3, faai3 di1 zau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子快要倒塌了，快点走！
examples.english_sentence: The house is about to collapse, hurry up and leave!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾佢嘅甜言蜜語冧到暈晒浪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5 lam1 dou3 wan4 saai3 long6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被他的甜言蜜语哄得晕头转向。
examples.english_sentence: She was charmed and completely head over heels by his sweet talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢讚我叻，我即刻冧晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 zaan3 ngo5 lek1, ngo5 zik1 hak1 lam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他称赞我厉害，我立刻开心极了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him praise me for being capable, I was instantly delighted.

english_meaning: To financially exploit men; to scam/trick men for money (typically by women); gold digger (behavior)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性通过欺骗或利用感情来获取男性的金钱利益。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman deceiving or exploiting a man's feelings to gain financial benefits from him. Usually has a negative connotation; describes the actions of a 'gold digger'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登去識啲有錢佬，擺明係想冧公頭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 dang3 heoi3 sik1 di1 jau5 cin2 lou2, baai2 ming4 hai6 soeng2 lam1 gung1 tau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她故意去认识那些有钱人，明显是想骗他们的钱。
examples.english_sentence: She deliberately goes to meet those rich men, obviously wanting to scam them for their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易信人，小心俾人冧公頭呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 yi6 seon3 jan4, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 lam1 gung1 tau4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么容易相信别人，小心被人骗钱啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, be careful of being scammed for money.

english_meaning: to sweet-talk, to flatter, to win someone over, to get on someone's good side
explanation_mandarin: 通过甜言蜜语或者行动来讨好某人，使其对自己产生好感。
explanation_english: To please or win over someone by sweet-talking or flattering them; to get on someone's good side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣冧掂老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 lam1 dim6 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在想怎么讨好老板。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to sweet-talk the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為用幾句好聽嘅說話就可以冧到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 yung6 gei2 geoi3 hou2 teng1 ge3 syut3 waa2 zau6 ho2 ji5 lam1 dou2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为用几句好听的话就可以哄到我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can win me over with a few sweet words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得冧女仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 lam1 neoi5 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会哄女孩子。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at sweet-talking girls.

english_meaning: to woo a woman; to sweet-talk a woman; to try to win a woman's affections
explanation_mandarin: 指男性用甜言蜜语或者其他方式来追求、讨好女性，以期获得她的欢心或爱情。
explanation_english: Refers to a man using sweet words or other methods to pursue and please a woman, hoping to win her favor or love. It implies actively trying to attract a woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住點樣冧女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 lam1 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天想着怎么追求女人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to woo women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日淨係識得用錢嚟冧女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 yung6 cin2 lai4 lam1 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是只懂得用钱来讨好女人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always just try to win women over with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多心思去冧佢女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 sam1 si1 heoi3 lam1 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多心思去讨好他的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He put a lot of effort into wooing his girlfriend.

english_meaning: Dizzy, dumbfounded, at a loss, bewildered, disoriented
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为突然的打击或意外情况而感到头晕，不知所措，像丢了魂一样。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being dizzy, disoriented, and dumbfounded due to a sudden shock, unexpected situation, or something overwhelming.  It implies being at a loss for what to do or think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然之間俾人炒咗，搞到佢冧宮頭，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 zi1 gaan1 bei2 jan4 caau2 zo2, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 lam4 gung1 tau4, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然之间被炒鱿鱼了，搞得他晕头转向，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: He was suddenly fired, leaving him completely dumbfounded and unsure what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到中咗六合彩，佢即刻冧宮頭，企都企唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, keoi5 zik1 hak1 lam4 gung1 tau4, kei5 dou1 kei5 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到中了彩票，他立刻晕头转向，站都站不稳。
examples.english_sentence: Upon hearing that he won the lottery, he was immediately so bewildered that he couldn't even stand straight.

english_meaning: idiot, fool, blockhead, moron
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，不聪明。 带有轻微的责备或玩笑的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone as foolish, stupid, or not very bright. It carries a slightly critical or playful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩咁蠢㗎，成個冧寶頭咁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 gam3 ceon2 gaa3, seng4 go3 lam1 bou2 tau4 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨啊，像个傻瓜一样！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so stupid, like a complete idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日話人冧寶頭啦，你都唔好得去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 seng4 jat6 waa6 jan4 lam1 bou2 tau4 laa1, nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 dak1 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是说别人是笨蛋，你也好不到哪里去。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always call people idiots, you're not much better yourself.

english_meaning: number; to number (something)
explanation_mandarin: 指数字，通常指号码，有时也用作动词，表示给…编号。
explanation_english: Refers to a number, usually a numerical code or identification number. Can also be used as a verb meaning 'to number' or 'to assign a number'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅電話冧巴係幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 din6 waa2 lam1 baa4 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的电话号码是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's your phone number?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張單上面有冧巴，你可以去 counter 攞嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 daan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 lam1 baa4, nei5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 counter lo2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 单据上面有号码，你可以去柜台取东西。
examples.english_sentence: There's a number on the receipt, you can go to the counter to pick up your item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要幫啲文件冧巴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 di1 man4 gin2 lam1 baa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要给这些文件编号。
examples.english_sentence: We need to number these documents.

english_meaning: Number tag; Number worn by participants in a race or game; Badge or placard bearing a number.
explanation_mandarin: 指带有号码的牌子，常用于比赛或其他活动中，参赛者或参与者佩戴以作识别。
explanation_english: A number tag, often used in races or other events, worn by participants for identification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗馬拉松，攞咗個冧巴温。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 maa5 laai1 sung3, lo2 zo2 go3 lam1 baa1 wan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了马拉松，拿到一个号码牌。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in the marathon and got a number tag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得比賽前攞返個冧巴溫啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 bei2 coi3 cin4 lo2 faan1 go3 lam1 baa1 wan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得比赛前拿回号码牌啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take back your number tag before the competition.

english_meaning: Number one, the best, top-notch
explanation_mandarin: “冧巴溫”是英文“Number One”的音译，意思是第一名，最好的，顶尖的。常用于赞扬某人或某事物非常优秀。
explanation_english: "Lam baa wan" is a transliteration of the English phrase "Number One". It means the first place, the best, or top-notch. It is often used to praise someone or something for being excellent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考到冧巴溫，真係好叻仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dou3 lam1 baa1 wan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了第一名，真的很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got number one in the exam, he's really great!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心係香港冧巴溫㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 lam1 baa1 wan1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心是香港第一的！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dim sum is the best in Hong Kong!

english_meaning: number one; the best; champion
explanation_mandarin: 源自英文“Number One”，指第一名，最好的事物或人。用于表示赞赏和肯定。
explanation_english: Derived from the English phrase "Number One," it refers to the first place, the best thing, or person. Used to express admiration and affirmation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞咗冧巴溫，真係好叻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 zo2 lam1 baa1 wan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了第一名，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got number one in the exam, he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅燒鵝喺香港都算係冧巴溫㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 siu1 ngo2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 syun3 hai6 lam1 baa1 wan1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的烧鹅在香港也算是最好的了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's roasted goose is considered the best in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 股市崩盘, 形容受打击后情绪低落
english_meaning: Market crash (stock market), Feeling dejected; feeling down; demoralized
explanation_mandarin: 原指股市崩盘，引申为形容某人或事物受到打击后，情况变得很糟糕或情绪低落。也可以形容感情方面受到重大打击，例如失恋。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a stock market crash, it's extended to describe a situation or a person's state becoming very bad or feeling down after a setback. It can also be used to describe a major emotional blow, such as a breakup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市跌到冧市噉，好多人輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 dit3 dou3 lam1 si5 gam2, hou2 do1 jan4 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市跌到像崩盘一样，很多人都输光了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed, and many people lost all their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾條女飛咗，成個人冧晒市噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 tiu4 neoi2 fei1 zo2, seng4 go3 jan4 lam1 saai3 si5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被女朋友甩了，整个人像崩溃了一样。
examples.english_sentence: He got dumped by his girlfriend, and he's completely demoralized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係覺得自己冧市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 lam1 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真的觉得我自己崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam this time, I really feel devastated.

english_meaning: Number
explanation_mandarin: 指数字或编号。
explanation_english: Refers to a number or a code.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗我個電話冧把。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ngo5 go3 din6 waa2 lam3 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘了我的电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot my phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅身份證冧把係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 san1 fan6 zing3 lam3 baa1 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的身份证号码是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What is your ID card number?

english_meaning: Silly; idiotic; foolish
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事非常傻，愚蠢。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being very silly, idiotic, or foolish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁冧森，唔好信佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 lam1 sam1, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话这么傻，别相信他。
examples.english_sentence: What he's saying is so silly, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個諗法好冧森，根本行唔通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lam2 faat3 hou2 lam1 sam1, gan1 bun2 hang4 m4 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个想法很傻，根本行不通。
examples.english_sentence: This idea is very silly, it won't work at all.

mandarin_meaning: 建筑物倒塌, 坍塌; 比喻倒台，垮掉
english_meaning: Building collapse; to collapse (figuratively, like a business or relationship); to fall down
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是建筑物倒塌。引申义是指机构、组织、关系等崩溃、倒台。也可用作形容一个人情绪崩溃。
explanation_english: Literally means a building collapsing. Figuratively, it refers to the collapse of an institution, organization, relationship, etc. It can also be used to describe someone having an emotional breakdown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊樓太舊，驚佢會冧樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 lau2 taai3 gau6, geng1 keoi5 wui5 lam1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋旧楼太旧了，担心它会倒塌。
examples.english_sentence: This old building is too old, I'm worried it might collapse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司財政出現問題，好快會冧樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 coi4 zing3 ceot1 hin1 man6 tai4, hou2 faai3 wui5 lam1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财政出现问题，很快就会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The company is having financial problems, it will collapse soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咁多壓力壓到冧樓咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 gam3 do1 aat3 lik6 aat3 dou3 lam1 lau2 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被这么多压力压得都快崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been under so much pressure that he's about to have a breakdown.

mandarin_meaning: 倒闭, 关门, 垮台
english_meaning: to collapse, to go out of business, to fail (business), to break down
explanation_mandarin: 指生意失败，倒闭，店铺关门，也可引申为关系破裂、计划失败等。
explanation_english: Refers to a business failure, closing down, or a shop shutting down. It can also be extended to mean a relationship breaking down or a plan failing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司經營唔善，搞到執笠冧檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 jing4 m4 sin6, gaau2 dou3 zaap1 lap1 lam3 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司经营不善，导致倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: His company was poorly managed, leading to its collapse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多小店都捱唔住，頂唔順要冧檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 siu2 dim3 dou1 ngaai4 m4 zyu6, ding2 m4 seon6 jiu3 lam3 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多小店都熬不住，撑不下去要倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the poor economy, many small shops can't survive and are collapsing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋再唔努力啲，呢個project 好快會冧檔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 m4 nu5 lik6 di1, ni1 go3 project hou2 faai3 wui5 lam3 dong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们再不努力一些，这个项目很快就会失败的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work harder, this project will fail soon.

english_meaning: Love song, sentimental song
explanation_mandarin: 指旋律优美、歌词表达爱意或浪漫情感的歌曲，常用于表达爱慕、思念等情感。
explanation_english: Refers to a song with a beautiful melody and lyrics that express love or romantic feelings. Often used to convey affection, longing, or other romantic sentiments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都聽啲冧歌，好似好掛住邊個噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 teng1 di1 lam1 go1, hou2 ci5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 bin1 go3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在听情歌，好像很想念谁似的。
examples.english_sentence: He listens to love songs all the time, like he's missing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻碟好多都係冧歌，啱曬情侶聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 dip2 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 lam1 go1, ngaam1 saai3 cing4 leoi5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张专辑里有很多情歌，非常适合情侣听。
examples.english_sentence: This album has many love songs, perfect for couples to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅結婚舞會用咗好多經典嘅冧歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 git3 fan1 mou5 wui2 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 ging1 din2 ge3 lam1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的婚礼舞会用了许多经典的情歌。
examples.english_sentence: We used many classic love songs for our wedding dance party.

mandarin_meaning: 变速箱坏了；垮台；出问题
english_meaning: broken gearbox; metaphorically, to collapse, break down, fail (especially in a system or plan)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是汽车的变速箱坏了。引申为某事彻底失败，计划或系统崩溃、出现严重问题。
explanation_english: Literally means a broken gearbox in a car. Metaphorically, it refers to a complete failure, a collapse of a plan or system, or a severe problem occurring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲財政冧咗波箱，好快執笠㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 coi4 zing3 lam1 zo2 bo1 soeng1, hou2 faai3 zap1 laap1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司的财政已经垮台了，很快就要倒闭了。
