examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 cing1 co2 bun2 syu1 ge3 faan4 lai6 sin1, gam2 zau6 zi1 dim2 joeng2 jung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先看清楚这本书的凡例，这样就知道怎么用了。
examples.english_sentence: Read the explanatory notes of this book carefully first, then you will know how to use it.

english_meaning: whenever, every time, as long as, any
explanation_mandarin: 表示条件，只要是，任何，每次。
explanation_english: Used to express a condition. It means 'as long as', 'whenever', 'every time', or 'any'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡係你鍾意嘅，我都會支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 hai6 nei5 zung1 ji3 ge3, ngo5 dou1 wui5 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是你喜欢的，我都会支持。
examples.english_sentence: Anything you like, I will support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡係落雨，條路就好塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 hai6 lok6 jyu5, tiu4 lou6 zau6 hou2 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次下雨，这条路就会很堵车。
examples.english_sentence: Every time it rains, this road gets very congested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡係會員都有折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 hai6 wui2 yun4 dou1 jau5 zit3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是会员都有折扣。
examples.english_sentence: Any member gets a discount.

english_meaning: the mortal world, the mundane world, the world of mortals
explanation_mandarin: 指充满世俗烦恼和欲望的现实世界，相对于理想或宗教中的超脱境界。
explanation_english: Refers to the real world filled with worldly troubles and desires, as opposed to the transcendental realm of ideals or religion.  It emphasizes the ordinary, often imperfect, and sometimes disappointing nature of human existence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢厭倦咗凡塵俗世嘅紛擾，決定出家修行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yim3 gyun6 zo2 faan4 chan4 suk6 sai3 ge3 fan1 jiu2, kyut3 ding6 chut1 ga1 sau1 hang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他厌倦了尘世的纷扰，决定出家修行。
examples.english_sentence: He was tired of the turmoil of the mortal world and decided to become a monk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都想擺脫凡塵俗世嘅束縛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 baai2 tyut3 faan4 chan4 suk6 sai3 ge3 chuk1 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都想摆脱尘世的束缚。
examples.english_sentence: Many people want to escape the shackles of the mundane world.

english_meaning: Vaseline, petroleum jelly
explanation_mandarin: 一种矿物油提炼的胶状物质，用作润滑剂和保护剂。
explanation_english: A translucent, yellowish or white, semi-solid mixture of hydrocarbons obtained from petroleum, used as a lubricant and protective coating, especially in medicinal and cosmetic preparations; petroleum jelly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天嗰陣，我嘅手好乾，要搽啲凡士林先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 go2 zan6, ngo5 ge3 sau2 hou2 gon1, jiu3 caa1 di1 faan4 si6 lam4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天的时候，我的手很干，要擦点凡士林才行。
examples.english_sentence: In winter, my hands are very dry, I need to apply some Vaseline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用凡士林搽嘴唇，所以嘴唇好潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 yung6 faan4 si6 lam4 caa1 zeoi2 seon4, so2 ji5 zeoi2 seon4 hou2 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是用凡士林擦嘴唇，所以嘴唇很润。
examples.english_sentence: She always applies Vaseline to her lips, so her lips are very moisturized.

english_meaning: ordinary people, common mortals, the common herd
explanation_mandarin: 指平庸的人，没有特殊才能或成就的人。
explanation_english: Refers to ordinary people who lack special talents or achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係凡夫俗子啫，邊有咁大嘅本事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 faan4 fu1 suk6 zi2 ze1, bin1 jau5 gam3 daai6 ge3 bun2 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是凡人而已，哪有那么大的本事啊？
examples.english_sentence: We are just ordinary people, how could we have such great ability?

english_meaning: all; every; any; whenever
explanation_mandarin: 表示总括，相当于“所有”、“任何”、“只要是”。
explanation_english: Indicates generality, equivalent to "all", "every", "any", "whenever". It introduces a general condition or category.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡是喺呢間餐廳食嘢嘅客，都可以免費攞甜品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 si6 hai2 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 je5 ge3 haak3, dou1 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 lo2 tim4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是在这家餐厅吃饭的客人，都可以免费拿甜品。
examples.english_sentence: All customers who eat at this restaurant can get free dessert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡是唔合格嘅功課，都要重做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 si6 m4 hap6 gaak3 ge3 gung1 fo3, dou1 jiu3 cung4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是不合格的作业，都要重做。
examples.english_sentence: Any homework that doesn't meet the standard needs to be redone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凡是星期日，佢都會去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 si6 sing1 kei4 jat6, keoi5 dou1 wui5 heoi3 jam2 chaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凡是星期日，他都会去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: Every Sunday, he goes to yum cha (drink tea).

english_meaning: all relatives; every relative
explanation_mandarin: 指所有的亲戚。
explanation_english: Refers to all relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，凡親都會返嚟拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, faan4 can1 dou1 wui5 faan1 lai4 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，所有的亲戚都会回来拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, all the relatives come back to pay respects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好錫啲凡親，成日探佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sek3 di1 faan4 can1, seng4 jat6 taam3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱所有的亲戚，经常去看望他们。
examples.english_sentence: He loves all his relatives and visits them often.

english_meaning: the mortal world; the human world; the mundane world
explanation_mandarin: 指人类居住的世俗世界，与神仙或超自然领域相对。
explanation_english: Refers to the mortal world inhabited by humans, as opposed to the realm of gods or the supernatural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲神仙落咗凡間體驗生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san4 sin1 lok6 zo2 faan4 gaan1 tai2 jim6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 神仙下凡体验生活。
examples.english_sentence: The gods descended to the mortal world to experience life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想脫離凡間嘅煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 tyut3 lei4 faan4 gaan1 ge3 faan4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想脱离人间的烦恼。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to escape the troubles of the mortal world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺凡間，我哋都要努力生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 faan4 gaan1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 nu5 lik6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在人间，我们都要努力生活。
examples.english_sentence: In the mortal world, we all have to work hard to live.

english_meaning: Calm, stillness (of the sea or air); lull
explanation_mandarin: 指风平浪静的状态，多指海洋或湖泊表面平静无风。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of calm, often describing the still and windless surface of the sea or a lake. It implies a lack of turbulence or movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日個海好凪呀，啱曬去釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 go3 hoi2 hou2 aa3 aa3 aa3 aa3, ngaam1 saai3 heoi3 diu3 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天海面很平静啊，非常适合去钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: The sea is very calm today, perfect for fishing.

mandarin_meaning: 依靠, 凭借, 根据
english_meaning: to rely on, to depend on, on the basis of, according to, evidence
explanation_mandarin: 依靠；根据；证据
explanation_english: To rely on; to depend on; on the basis of; according to; evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凭咩你觉得佢会帮我啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: pang4 me1 nei5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 wui5 bong1 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你凭什么觉得他会帮我啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why do you think he will help me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我凭我嘅努力得到呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 ngo5 ge3 nou5 lik6 dak1 dou3 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我凭借我的努力得到了这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: I got this job through my hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好凭感觉嚟做决定，要睇清楚啲数据。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 pang4 gam2 gok3 lai4 zou6 kyut3 ding6, jiu3 tai2 cing1 chu2 di1 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要凭感觉来做决定，要看清楚一些数据。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions based on feelings, look at the data more clearly.

english_meaning: Female phoenix
explanation_mandarin: 凤凰，古代传说中的鸟王，雌性称为凰，雄性称为凤。
explanation_english: The female phoenix, a mythical bird of great beauty and power in ancient Chinese mythology. It is the female counterpart to the male phoenix (鳳).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳說入面，鳳凰係吉祥嘅象徵，而凰就代表雌性嘅鳳凰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 syut3 jap6 min6, fung6 wong4 hai6 gat1 cheung4 ge3 seung3 jing1, yi4 wong4 jau6 doi6 biu2 ci1 sing3 ge3 fung6 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传说中，凤凰是吉祥的象征，而凰就代表雌性的凤凰。
examples.english_sentence: In legends, the phoenix is a symbol of good fortune, and the female phoenix (凰) represents the female phoenix.

english_meaning: Triumphant, victory, a triumphant return
explanation_mandarin: 形容获得胜利，凯旋归来。也指胜利的喜悦。
explanation_english: Describes achieving victory and returning in triumph. Also refers to the joy of victory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋團隊終於凱旋而歸啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tyun4 doi2 zung1 jyu1 hoi2 syun4 ji4 gwai1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的团队终于凯旋归来了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team has finally returned triumphantly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢地凱歌高奏，庆祝胜利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi2 go1 gou1 zau3, hing3 zuk1 sing3 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们高唱凯歌，庆祝胜利。
examples.english_sentence: They sing songs of triumph, celebrating their victory.

english_meaning: sucker, easy mark, chump, someone easily taken advantage of financially
explanation_mandarin: 指容易被骗取钱财的人，通常指对感情或金钱付出很多，但没有得到相应回报的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is easily swindled or taken advantage of financially. It usually refers to someone who invests a lot of emotion or money but doesn't receive a corresponding return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條仔擺明當佢係凱子咋，成日問佢攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 zai2 baai2 ming4 dong3 keoi5 hai6 hoi2 zi2 zaa3, seng4 jat6 man6 keoi5 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友明显把她当冤大头，整天问她要钱。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend is obviously treating her like a sucker, always asking her for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，唔好做凱子俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 hoi2 zi2 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨了，别当冤大头让人骗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't be a sucker and get cheated.

english_meaning: Caesar salad
explanation_mandarin: 一种沙拉，通常包含罗马生菜、面包丁、帕尔马干酪和凯撒酱。
explanation_english: A salad typically consisting of romaine lettuce, croutons, Parmesan cheese, and Caesar dressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食份凱撒沙律做午餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 fan6 hoi2 saa1 saa1 leot2 zou6 ng5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一份凯撒沙拉做午餐。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a Caesar salad for lunch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅凱撒沙律好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 hoi2 saa1 saa1 leot2 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的凯撒沙拉很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The Caesar salad in this restaurant is delicious.

english_meaning: triumphant return; to return in triumph
explanation_mandarin: 指战胜归来；比喻取得胜利后返回。
explanation_english: Refers to a triumphant return after a victory; figuratively, to return after achieving success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打贏咗場波，凱旋返嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bo1, hoi2 syun4 faan1 lai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们赢了那场比赛，凯旋归来了！
examples.english_sentence: They won the game and returned in triumph!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次項目成功，團隊凱旋而歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 hong6 muk6 sing4 gung1, tyun4 deoi2 hoi2 syun4 ji4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次项目成功，团队凯旋而归。
examples.english_sentence: The team returned in triumph after the success of this project.

synonyms: 得勝而歸 (dak1 sing3 ji4 gwai1)

english_meaning: to return in triumph; to return victoriously
explanation_mandarin: 指战胜敌人或完成任务后，光荣地归来。
explanation_english: Refers to returning gloriously after defeating the enemy or completing a mission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋足球隊喺世界盃攞咗冠軍，凱旋而歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 kau4 deoi2 hai2 sai3 gaai3 bui1 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1, hoi2 syun4 ji4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的足球队在世界杯拿了冠军，凯旋而归。
examples.english_sentence: Our football team won the World Cup and returned in triumph.

english_meaning: stool; bench; chair
explanation_mandarin: 一种没有靠背的坐具。
explanation_english: A seat, typically without a back or arms, used for sitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞張凳嚟坐下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 zoeng1 dang3 lai4 co5 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿张凳子来坐一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Grab a stool and sit down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張凳爛咗，要換過張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang3 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 gwo3 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 椅子坏了，要换一张。
examples.english_sentence: The chair is broken, we need to replace it.

english_meaning: small stool
explanation_mandarin: 指小型的凳子。
explanation_english: Refers to a small stool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔坐喺張凳仔度食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 co5 hai2 zoeng1 dang3 zai2 dou6 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子坐在小凳子上吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: The child is sitting on a small stool to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張凳仔好矮，唔啱你坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 dang3 zai2 hou2 ai2, m4 ngaam1 nei5 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小凳子很矮，不适合你坐。
examples.english_sentence: This small stool is very short, it's not suitable for you to sit on.

english_meaning: backing; support; someone to rely on; leverage
explanation_mandarin: 比喻可以依靠的人或事物，作为支持或后盾。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that can be relied upon as support or backing; leverage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有凳憑，所以做嘢先咁大胆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 dang3 pang4, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 sin1 gam3 daai6 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司很有靠山，所以做事才这么大胆。
examples.english_sentence: He has strong backing in the company, that's why he's so bold in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做係咪有咩凳憑呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 hai6 mai1 jau5 me1 dang3 pang4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做是不是有什么靠山啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any backing for doing things this way?

english_meaning: stepping stool, foothold, backing, support (often in a figurative sense)
explanation_mandarin: （1）垫脚的东西，例如小板凳。(2) 比喻背后支持的力量或人。
explanation_english: (1) A footstool or something used to elevate oneself. (2) Figuratively, backing, support, or someone who provides assistance, often secretly or indirectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我企上去張凳腳度攞啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kei5 soeng5 heoi3 zoeng1 dang3 goek3 dou6 lo2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我站到凳子上拿东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm standing on the stool to get something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職嘅背後，聽講有好多人做佢嘅凳腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 ge3 bui3 hau6, ting1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 zou6 keoi5 ge3 dang3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说他升职的背后，有很多人在暗中支持他。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that there were many people backing him up in secret for his promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將人哋當做你嘅凳腳，咁樣唔好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 jan4 dei6 dong3 zou6 nei5 ge3 dang3 goek3, gam2 joeng2 m4 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把别人当做你的垫脚石，这样做不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use others as stepping stones, that's not good.

english_meaning: Sitting improperly, unstable, or fidgety on a chair; unable to sit still.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人坐着的时候身体不稳，或者坐姿不正，像要从凳子上掉下来一样。也指坐立不安，动来动去。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is sitting unstably or improperly, as if about to fall off the chair. Also describes someone restless and fidgeting while sitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度凳𩩍啦，睇到我都眼花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 dang3 dau2 laa1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 ngaan5 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里坐立不安了，看得我眼花。
examples.english_sentence: Stop fidgeting here, it's making me dizzy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔喺度凳𩩍，好似有嘢唔舒服噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hai2 dou6 dang3 dau2, hou2 ci5 jau5 je5 m4 syu1 fuk6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩子在那里坐立不安，好像有什么不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is fidgeting, it seems like he is uncomfortable.

english_meaning: fierce; ferocious; stern; severe; to scold fiercely
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度或行为非常严厉、凶恶。也可作动词，表示严厉地责骂。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude or behavior that is very stern, fierce, or ferocious. Can also be used as a verb, meaning to scold fiercely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老豆好凶㗎，成日鬧佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 dau2 hou2 hung1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 naau6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸很凶的，总是骂他。
examples.english_sentence: His father is very fierce and scolds him all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個阿Sir好凶，成日鬧學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 aa3 sir1 hou2 hung1, seng4 jat6 naau6 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老师很凶，总是骂学生。
examples.english_sentence: That teacher is very strict and always scolds the students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁凶啦，慢慢講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hung1 laa1, maan6 maan6 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么凶，慢慢说不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so fierce, just speak slowly, okay?

english_meaning: ominous sign; bad omen; portent of evil
explanation_mandarin: 不祥的预兆，预示着不幸的事情将要发生。
explanation_english: An ominous sign or indication that something bad or unfortunate is going to happen; a portent of evil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 烏鴉喺屋企門口叫，好似係啲凶兆咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 giu3, hou2 ci5 hai6 di1 hung1 siu6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乌鸦在家门口叫，好像是不好的预兆啊。
examples.english_sentence: A crow is cawing at the front door, it seems like a bad omen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到咁多死魚，我覺得唔係一個好嘅凶兆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 sei2 yu2, ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 hung1 siu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这么多死鱼，我觉得不是一个好的凶兆。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing so many dead fish, I don't think it's a good omen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連續跌親幾次，覺得係凶兆，於是去咗拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 zuk6 dit3 can1 gei2 ci3, gok3 dak1 hai6 hung1 siu6, yu1 si6 heoi3 zo2 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连续摔倒几次，觉得是不好的预兆，于是去拜神了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell several times in a row and felt it was a bad omen, so he went to worship the gods.

english_meaning: weapon; lethal weapon
explanation_mandarin: 指能够造成伤害甚至死亡的器具。
explanation_english: Refers to an object or tool that can cause injury or death; a weapon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺現場搵到凶器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou2 hung1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在现场找到了凶器。
examples.english_sentence: The police found the weapon at the scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用把刀做凶器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 baa2 dou1 zou6 hung1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用刀做凶器。
examples.english_sentence: He used a knife as a weapon.

mandarin_meaning: 凶多吉少 (xiōng duō jí shǎo)
english_meaning: More bad luck than good; the odds are against one; little chance of success
explanation_mandarin: 指情形很不乐观，凶险的情况多，吉祥的情况少。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where the outlook is very bleak, with more danger than hope for good fortune or success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人行入深山，咁耐都冇消息，恐怕凶多吉少咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 jap6 sam1 saan1, gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 siu1 sik1, kung2 paa3 hung1 do1 gat1 siu2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人走进深山，这么久都没有消息，恐怕凶多吉少了。
examples.english_sentence: He went into the deep mountains alone, and there's been no news for so long. I'm afraid the odds are against him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機引擎壞咗，情況凶多吉少，希望有機師可以安全降落啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 jing1 ching5 waai6 zo2, ching4 fong3 hung1 do1 gat1 siu2, hei1 mong6 jau5 gei1 si1 ho2 ji5 on1 cyun4 gong3 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机引擎坏了，情况凶多吉少，希望有机师可以安全降落。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane engine failed. The situation looks bleak. Hopefully the pilot can land safely.

synonyms: 危在旦夕 (ngai4 zoi6 daan3 sik1)

english_meaning: haunted house; stigmatized property (due to a violent death)
explanation_mandarin: 指房屋内曾发生过非自然死亡事件，如自杀、凶杀等，导致房屋价值大跌且难以出售的房屋。
explanation_english: Refers to a property where a violent or unnatural death has occurred, such as suicide or murder. This stigma significantly lowers the property's value and makes it difficult to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多凶宅都好平，但係我唔敢住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 hung1 zaak6 dou1 hou2 peng4, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 gam2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多凶宅都很便宜，但是我不敢住。
examples.english_sentence: There are many haunted houses in Hong Kong that are very cheap, but I don't dare to live in one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓之前一定要查清楚係唔係凶宅，唔係就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2 hai6 m4 hai6 hung1 zaak6, m4 hai6 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房之前一定要查清楚是不是凶宅，不然就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Before buying a property, you must check carefully whether it's a haunted house, otherwise it'll be troublesome.

english_meaning: fierce; ferocious; vicious; menacing
explanation_mandarin: 形容样子或行为非常凶狠、可怕。
explanation_english: Describing someone or something that is fierce, ferocious, or vicious in appearance or behavior; menacing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好凶惡，唔敢行埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 hung1 ok3, m4 gam2 haang4 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子很凶恶，不敢走过去。
examples.english_sentence: He looks so fierce that I don't dare to go near him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻狗好凶惡，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau2 hou2 hung1 ok3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只狗很凶恶，要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: This dog is very fierce, be careful.

english_meaning: cruel, brutal, ruthless, savage
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或行为非常残忍，毫无人性。
explanation_english: Describes a person or action that is extremely cruel, brutal, or ruthless, lacking humanity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲手段好凶殘㗎，咩都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 sau2 dyun6 hou2 hung1 caan4 gaa3, me1 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的手段很凶残，什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: Their methods are very cruel; they're capable of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套戲啲情節太凶殘，我唔敢睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hei3 di1 cing4 zit3 taai3 hung1 caan4, ngo5 m4 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影的情节太凶残了，我不敢看。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of that movie is too brutal; I don't dare to watch it.

mandarin_meaning: 凶神恶煞 (xiōng shén è shà)
english_meaning: fierce and malicious deities; fierce-looking and evil people; menacing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人面目凶恶，非常可怕。
explanation_english: Describes someone's appearance as fierce and evil, very frightening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人凶神惡煞咁樣，我驚咗佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hung1 san4 ok3 saat3 gam2 joeng2, ngo5 geng1 zo2 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人凶神恶煞的样子，我害怕他。
examples.english_sentence: That person looks so fierce, I'm scared of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲黑社會成日扮到凶神惡煞咁，想嚇親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hak1 se6 wui2 sing4 jat6 baan6 dou3 hung1 san4 ok3 saat3 gam2, soeng2 haak3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些黑社会经常打扮得凶神恶煞，想吓唬人。
examples.english_sentence: Those gangsters often dress up looking fierce to scare people.

synonyms: 惡形惡相 (ok3 ying4 ok3 soeng3)

english_meaning: dangerous, perilous, treacherous
explanation_mandarin: 形容情况非常危险，容易发生意外或造成伤害。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is very dangerous, likely to cause accidents or harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅山路好凶險，行嗰陣要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 saan1 lou6 hou2 hung1 him2, haang4 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的山路很危险，走的时候要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain road here is very dangerous, so be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個海面咁大浪，出海好凶險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hoi2 min6 gam3 daai6 long6, ceot1 hoi2 hou2 hung1 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海面浪这么大，出海很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: The sea is so rough, it's dangerous to go out to sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種工作環境好凶險，一定要做足安全措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 gung1 zok3 waan4 ging2 hou2 hung1 him2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 on1 cyun4 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种工作环境很危险，一定要做好安全措施。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of working environment is very dangerous, so you must take adequate safety measures.

mandarin_meaning: 突出; 冒犯; 糟糕
english_meaning: to protrude; to stick out; to offend; to be bad (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 基本意思是突出。在口语中，也可以表示冒犯，或者形容事情很糟糕。
explanation_english: The basic meaning is to protrude. In colloquial Cantonese, it can also mean to offend or to describe something as bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲骨凸晒出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gwat1 dat6 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骨头都突出来了。
examples.english_sentence: The bones are all sticking out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講嘢好凸㗎，得罪人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5 hou2 dat6 gaa3, dak1 zeoi6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说话很冒犯，会得罪人的。
examples.english_sentence: The way you're talking is very offensive, you'll offend people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試真係凸晒，肯定唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 zan1 hai6 dat6 saai3, hang2 ding6 m4 hap1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试真的很糟糕，肯定不及格。
examples.english_sentence: This exam was really bad, I'll definitely fail.

english_meaning: protruding, prominent, outstanding
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面向外突出，或者指能力、成绩等方面特别显著。
explanation_english: Describes something that protrudes outwards or is prominent physically. Can also refer to something that is outstanding or remarkable in terms of ability or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現好凸出，所以俾老闆賞識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 hou2 dat6 ceot1, so2 ji5 bei2 lou5 baan2 soeng2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现很突出，所以被老板赏识。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was outstanding, so he was appreciated by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計嘅最大特色係佢嘅凸出嘅線條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat3 gai3 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 te4 sik1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 dat6 ceot1 ge3 sin3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计的最大特点是它突出的线条。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest feature of this design is its protruding lines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫凸出咗佢嘅身材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 dat6 ceot1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 san1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服突出了她的身材。
examples.english_sentence: This dress accentuates her figure.

mandarin_meaning: 突出显示文字；排版错误
english_meaning: Emphasized text; Typographical error; Literal meaning: protruding character
explanation_mandarin: “凸字” 可以指突出显示的文字，例如粗体字。 也指因为排版错误而突兀地出现的文字或错误。
explanation_english: "凸字" can refer to emphasized text, such as bold text. It can also refer to text that appears out of place or an error due to a typographical error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告好多凸字，要改返好先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 hou2 do1 dat6 zi6, jiu3 goi2 faan1 hou2 sin1 dak1.

examples.english_sentence: There are many typographical errors in this report, it needs to be corrected before it's submitted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字喺份文件度凸咗出嚟，係咪格式出錯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 hai2 fan6 man4 gin2 dou6 dat6 zo2 ceot1 lai4, hai6 mai6 gaak3 sik1 ceot1 co3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字在这份文件中显得很突出，是不是格式出错了？
examples.english_sentence: This word stands out in the document, is the formatting wrong?

english_meaning: To stare; bulging eyes; bug-eyed
explanation_mandarin: 动词：指瞪大眼睛看。形容词：形容眼球突出。
explanation_english: Verb: To stare with wide eyes. Adjective: Describing eyes that are bulging or protruding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁凸眼望住人啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dat6 ngaan5 mong5 zyu6 jan4 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么瞪着人看，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stare at people like that, it's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到凸晒眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 dat6 saai3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得眼睛都突出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared his eyes popped out.

english_meaning: talking back; arguing back; being defiant; being disobedient
explanation_mandarin: 指顶撞长辈或权威人士，不听劝告，犟嘴。
explanation_english: Refers to talking back to elders or authority figures, refusing to listen to advice, and being defiant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日同阿媽凸腸頭啦，佢都係為你好啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tung4 a3 maa1 dat6 coeng2 tau4 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 wai6 nei5 hou2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是跟妈妈顶嘴，她也是为你好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always talk back to your mother, she's just doing it for your own good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路唔可以凸腸頭，要聽大人話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 m4 ho2 ji5 dat6 coeng2 tau4, jiu3 teng1 daai6 jan4 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不可以顶嘴，要听大人的话。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't talk back; they should listen to adults.

english_meaning: to protrude; to bulge; to stick out; to rise; prominence
explanation_mandarin: 指向外突出或隆起。
explanation_english: To protrude, bulge, or rise from a surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波撻咗落地，有啲地方凸起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 taat1 zo2 lok6 dei6, jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 dat6 hei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球掉在地上，有些地方突起来了。
examples.english_sentence: The ball fell on the ground, and some parts of it are sticking out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫嘅膊頭位有啲凸起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 ge3 bok3 tau4 wai2 jau5 di1 dat6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他衣服的肩膀部位有点鼓起来。
examples.english_sentence: The shoulder part of his shirt bulges a bit.

english_meaning: convex lens
explanation_mandarin: 一种中间厚、边缘薄的透镜，能够会聚光线。
explanation_english: A lens that is thicker in the middle than at the edges and that bends light rays inward, causing them to converge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用凸透鏡嚟睇啲好細嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 dat6 tau3 geng3 lai4 tai2 di1 hou2 sai3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用凸透镜来看一些很小的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He uses a convex lens to look at very small things.

english_meaning: Prominent forehead; Bulging forehead; High forehead
explanation_mandarin: 指额头向前突出，比较宽大的额头。
explanation_english: Refers to a forehead that protrudes forward and is relatively broad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個凸額好明顯，一睇就認得出佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 dat6 ngaak2 hou2 ming5 hin2, jat1 tai2 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的额头很明显，一看就能认出他。
examples.english_sentence: His prominent forehead is very obvious, you can recognize him at a glance.

english_meaning: to highlight, to emphasize, to bring out, to stand out
explanation_mandarin: 使原本不明显的事物变得明显；强调；突出。
explanation_english: To make something noticeable or prominent; to emphasize or highlight something that was previously less obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計嘅重點係凸顯佢嘅線條美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 ge3 zung6 dim2 hai6 dat6 hin2 keoi5 ge3 sin3 tiu4 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计的重点是突出它的线条美。
examples.english_sentence: The focus of this design is to highlight the beauty of its lines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事凸顯咗政府嘅無能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 dat6 hin2 zo2 zing3 fu2 ge3 mou4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事突出了政府的无能。
examples.english_sentence: This incident highlights the incompetence of the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講凸顯咗佢對呢個議題嘅深入理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 dat6 hin2 zo2 keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 ge3 sam1 jap6 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲突出了他对这个议题的深入理解。
examples.english_sentence: His speech highlighted his in-depth understanding of this issue.

mandarin_meaning: 亮点；重点；突出的地方;（非正式）乳头凸起
english_meaning: Highlight; key point; prominent feature; (informal) nipple outline (visible through clothing)
explanation_mandarin: 原指突出的点，后来引申为重点、亮点。也指衣服下显现出的乳头凸起，带有些许性暗示，通常指女性。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a protruding point, it later extends to mean a highlight or key point. It can also refer to the outline of nipples visible through clothing, often referring to women, and carrying a slight sexual connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個報告嘅凸點係佢嘅數據分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou3 gou3 ge3 dat6 dim2 hai6 keoi5 ge3 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的亮点在于他的数据分析。
examples.english_sentence: The highlight of this report is his data analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗件好薄嘅衫，搞到好明顯見到凸點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hou2 bok6 ge3 saam1, gaau2 dou3 hou2 ming4 hin2 gin3 dou2 dat6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一件很薄的衣服，搞得很明显能看到乳头凸起。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a very thin shirt, making her nipple outline very visible.

english_meaning: dented, concave, hollow, recessed
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面不平，向内陷落的状态。
explanation_english: Describing a surface that is not flat and is indented or recessed inward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞到凹咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou3 aap3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞凹了。
examples.english_sentence: The car got dented from the crash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個碗邊凹咗一忽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 wun2 bin1 aap3 zo2 jat1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碗的边缘凹进去了一块。
examples.english_sentence: The edge of the bowl has a dent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對眼眶好凹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngaan5 kwaang3 hou2 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼眶很凹陷。
examples.english_sentence: His eye sockets are very hollow.

english_meaning: bumpy; uneven; rough
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面不平坦，有高有低。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is not smooth, having bumps and depressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路凹凸不平，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 au3 dat6 bat1 ping4, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路凹凸不平，走路要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The road is bumpy, be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊牆凹凸咗，要搵人嚟整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 cheung4 au3 dat6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 yan4 lai4 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙面凹凸不平了，需要找人来修理。
examples.english_sentence: The wall is uneven, we need to find someone to fix it.

english_meaning: uneven, bumpy, rugged
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面不平滑，有高有低。
explanation_english: Describing a surface that is not smooth, with highs and lows; uneven or bumpy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路凹凸不平，行嗰陣要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 aau3 dat6 bat1 ping4, haang4 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路凹凸不平，走路的时候要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The road is uneven, be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊牆油漆油得凹凸不平，好肉酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 cheung4 jau4 chat1 jau4 dak1 aau3 dat6 bat1 ping4, hou2 yuk1 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这面墙油漆刷得凹凸不平，很难看。
examples.english_sentence: The paint on this wall is uneven, it looks ugly.

mandarin_meaning: 玲珑有致, 曲线玲珑, 有曲线美
english_meaning: Curvaceous, shapely, well-proportioned (referring to a woman's figure)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性身材曲线明显，该凸的凸，该凹的凹，比例匀称，具有美感。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's figure with noticeable curves in the right places, well-proportioned, and aesthetically pleasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身材真係凹凸有致，好多人讚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 coi4 zan1 hai6 aau1 dat6 jau5 zi3, hou2 do1 jan4 zaan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的身材真是凹凸有致，很多人称赞她。
examples.english_sentence: Her figure is truly curvaceous; many people praise her.

english_meaning: concave lens
explanation_mandarin: 一种中间薄，边缘厚的透镜，能使光线发散。
explanation_english: A lens that is thinner in the center and thicker at the edges, causing light rays to diverge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇嘢有啲矇，可能要配返副凹透鏡嘅眼鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 je5 jau5 di1 mung4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 pui3 faan1 fu3 aau1 tau3 geng3 ge3 ngaan5 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看东西有点模糊，可能要配一副凹透镜的眼镜。
examples.english_sentence: My vision is a bit blurry, I might need to get glasses with concave lenses.

english_meaning: sunken; dented; depressed
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面向内塌陷，低于周围表面。
explanation_english: Describing a surface that is sunken or depressed below the surrounding area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞到個頭凹陷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou3 go3 tau4 aau3 ham6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞了，车头凹陷了。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed, and the front of the car is dented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢眼眶凹陷，睇起嚟好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan5 kwaang3 aau3 ham6, tai2 hei2 lai4 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眼眶凹陷，看起来很疲惫。
examples.english_sentence: His eye sockets are sunken, he looks very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊鐵板凹陷咗，唔可以再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 tit3 baan2 aau3 ham6 zo2, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块铁板凹陷了，不能再用了。
examples.english_sentence: This metal sheet is dented and can't be used anymore.

english_meaning: to go out; to come out; to exit; to happen; to occur; to produce; to publish
explanation_mandarin: 表示从里面到外面，或从无到有，或发生，或生产等。
explanation_english: Indicates moving from inside to outside, from nothing to something, occurrence, or production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要出街啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 gaai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要出门。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going out tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書幾時出㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 gei2 si4 ceot1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书什么时候出版的？
examples.english_sentence: When was this book published?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出咗咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 zo2 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生什么事了？
examples.english_sentence: What happened?

english_meaning: to cheat
explanation_mandarin: 指在考试、比赛或游戏中以不正当的手段获取优势。
explanation_english: To cheat, especially in an exam, game, or competition; to use unfair or dishonest methods to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣出cheat俾老師捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 go2 zan6 ceot1 ci1 bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候作弊被老师抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught cheating by the teacher during the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好出cheat呀，要靠自己嘅實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceot1 ci1 aa3, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要作弊，要靠自己的实力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat; rely on your own abilities.

english_meaning: to get out of the single state; to find a partner; to start dating someone exclusively
explanation_mandarin: 指结束单身状态，开始恋爱。
explanation_english: Refers to getting out of the single state and starting a romantic relationship. 'Pool' is borrowed from the English word 'pool' and implies being in a 'pool' of singles. '出' means 'to exit'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似出咗pool，成日見佢同條女一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 ceot1 zo2 pool, seng4 jat6 gin3 keoi5 tung4 tiu4 neoi2 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像脱单了，经常看到他和女朋友在一起。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have gotten out of the single state recently. I often see him with his girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你啊，終於出pool啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 aa3, zung1 jyu1 ceot1 pool laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你啊，终于脱单啦！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations! You finally got out of the single state!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想出pool呀，但係都冇人鍾意我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ceot1 pool aa3, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 jan4 zung1 ji3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想脱单啊，但是都没人喜欢我。
examples.english_sentence: I want to get out of the single state, but nobody likes me.

english_meaning: To perform (on stage); to appear (in public); to gig
explanation_mandarin: 指在舞台上表演，或在公众场合露面。通常用于演艺人员。
explanation_english: Refers to performing on stage or appearing in public, usually used for performers and artists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚喺紅館出show啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 hai2 hung4 gun2 ceot1 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚在香港体育馆演出啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's performing at the Hong Kong Coliseum tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋要喺婚禮上面出show。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 ceot1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们要在婚礼上表演。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to perform at the wedding tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋出show嘅時候，成日都爆場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceot1 sau2 ge3 si4 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 baau3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们演出的时候，经常都爆满。
examples.english_sentence: Their shows are always sold out.

english_meaning: to contribute a bit of effort, to do one's bit, to lend a hand
explanation_mandarin: 尽自己一份力量，帮助完成某件事。
explanation_english: To contribute one's share of effort to help complete something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個個都出一分力，件事就好快搞掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 ceot1 jat1 fan6 lik6, gin6 si6 zau6 hou2 faai3 gaau2 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每个人都出一份力，这件事很快就能完成了。
examples.english_sentence: If we all do our bit, this thing will be finished quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都想為慈善出一分力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 soeng2 wai6 ci4 sin6 ceot1 jat1 fan6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他也想为慈善事业贡献一份力量。
examples.english_sentence: He also wants to contribute to charity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我唔識好多嘢，但都想出一分力幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 m4 sik1 hou2 do1 je5, daan6 dou1 soeng2 ceot1 jat1 fan6 lik6 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我不太懂很多东西，但还是想尽一份力帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Although I don't know a lot, I still want to contribute a bit and help.

english_meaning: to be born; birth
explanation_mandarin: 指人或动物从母体中生出来。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a person or animal being born from its mother's womb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港出世嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 sai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是在香港出生的。
examples.english_sentence: I was born in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱出咗世冇幾耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 sai3 mou5 gei2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚出生没多久。
examples.english_sentence: He was just born not long ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻小狗尋日先至出世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 siu2 gau2 cam4 jat6 sin1 zi3 ceot1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只小狗昨天才出生。
examples.english_sentence: This puppy was just born yesterday.

english_meaning: birth certificate
explanation_mandarin: 官方颁发的，证明一个人出生信息的法律文件。
explanation_english: An official document issued to certify the birth of a person, containing information such as the date and place of birth, and the names of the parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得帶埋你嘅出世紙去搞身份證啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 nei5 ge3 ceot1 sai3 zi2 heoi3 gaau2 san1 fan2 zing3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得带上你的出生证明去办理身份证啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your birth certificate to apply for an identity card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想申請護照，但係唔見咗張出世紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 san1 cing2 wu6 ziu3, daan6 hai6 m4 gin3 zo2 zoeng1 ceot1 sai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想申请护照，但是弄丢了出生证明。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to apply for a passport, but he lost his birth certificate.

english_meaning: Unexpected, exceeding expectations, surprising
explanation_mandarin: 超出预料之外。表示事情的结果与之前的预期不同，令人感到惊讶。
explanation_english: Exceeding expectations; happening in an unexpected way. It indicates that the outcome of something is different from what was previously expected, causing surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然攞到第一名，真係出乎意料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 lo2 dou2 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 ceot1 fu4 ji3 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然获得了第一名，真是出乎意料。
examples.english_sentence: He actually got first place, that's really unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅發展出乎意料噉順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 faat3 zin2 ceot1 fu4 ji3 liu6 gam2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情的发展出乎意料的顺利。
examples.english_sentence: The development of the matter went unexpectedly smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績出乎我意料之外咁差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 sing1 jik1 ceot1 fu4 ngo5 ji3 liu6 zi1 ngoi6 gam3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩出乎我意料之外地差。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this exam are unexpectedly bad.

english_meaning: unexpected; beyond expectation; contrary to expectation
explanation_mandarin: 超出原先的预料。
explanation_english: Exceeding what was originally expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅發展真係出乎預料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 faat3 zin2 zan1 hai6 ceot1 fu4 jyu6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情的发展真是出乎意料。
examples.english_sentence: The development of the matter is truly unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅反應出乎我預料，我以為佢會好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 faan2 jing3 ceot1 fu4 ngo5 jyu6 liu2, ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 wui5 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的反应出乎我的意料，我以为他会很生气。
examples.english_sentence: His reaction was beyond my expectation; I thought he would be very angry.

mandarin_meaning: 出事了; 完蛋了; 搞砸了
english_meaning: In trouble; something went wrong; messed up; ruined
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情办砸了，出了问题，情况糟糕。
explanation_english: Indicates that something went wrong, a problem occurred, or the situation is bad. It often implies a negative consequence or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係出了哥喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 ceot1 zo2 go1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真是完蛋了！
examples.english_sentence: This exam was so bad, I'm really in trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，出了哥，啲嘢未backup啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, ceot1 zo2 go1, di1 je5 mei6 backup aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，完蛋了，东西还没备份啊！
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke down, I'm screwed, and I haven't backed up my stuff!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔記得帶護照，今次真係出了哥啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 wu6 ziu3, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 ceot1 zo2 go1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忘记带护照，这次真的完蛋了！
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my passport, I'm really screwed this time!

english_meaning: to have an accident; to have a mishap; to go wrong; something bad happens; to be in trouble
explanation_mandarin: 发生意外或不幸的事情；出现问题或麻烦。
explanation_english: To experience an accident, mishap, or negative event. It implies something undesirable or problematic has occurred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日揸車出事，入咗醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 zaa1 ce1 ceot1 si6, jap6 zo2 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天开车出了事故，住院了。
examples.english_sentence: He had a car accident yesterday and was hospitalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果啲機器出事，我哋就要停工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 di1 gei1 hei3 ceot1 si6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 ting4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果机器出问题，我们就要停工。
examples.english_sentence: If the machines break down, we will have to stop working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好小心啲，唔好出事啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 ceot1 si6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好小心点，别出事啊！
examples.english_sentence: You better be careful, don't have an accident!

english_meaning: unexpected; surprising; beyond expectation
explanation_mandarin: 超出人们的预料，意想不到。
explanation_english: Exceeding people's expectations; unexpected; something that is surprising or not predicted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功真係出人意料，之前佢成績都唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 zan1 hai6 ceot1 jan4 ji3 liu6, zi1 cin4 keoi5 sing4 jik1 dou1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功真是出乎意料，之前他的成绩都不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: His success is really unexpected, his grades weren't that good before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個結果都幾出人意料，冇諗過佢會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 dou1 gei2 ceot1 jan4 ji3 liu6, mou5 nam2 gwo3 keoi5 wui5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个结果也挺出人意料的，没想到他会赢。
examples.english_sentence: This result is quite surprising, I didn't expect him to win.

english_meaning: unexpected, surprising, exceeding expectations
explanation_mandarin: 超出人们预料，意想不到。
explanation_english: To exceed one's expectations; to be surprising; to be unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現真係出人意表，冇諗到佢可以做得咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin6 zan1 hai6 ceot1 jan4 ji3 biu2, mou5 nim2 dou3 keoi5 ho2 ji5 zou6 dak1 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现真是出乎意料，没想到他可以做得这么好。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was truly unexpected; I didn't think he could do so well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個結局都幾出人意表，估唔到會咁樣完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 git3 guk6 dou1 gei2 ceot1 jan4 ji3 biu2, gu2 m4 dou3 wui5 gam2 joeng2 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个结局挺出乎意料的，没想到会这样结束。
examples.english_sentence: The ending was quite surprising; I didn't expect it to end like that.

english_meaning: to rise above others, to distinguish oneself, to make a name for oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指超越一般人，取得显著的成就，在社会上获得较高的地位和名声。
explanation_english: To rise above the common crowd, to achieve significant success, and to gain a high social status and reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力讀書，希望將來可以出人頭地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力读书，希望将来可以出人头地。
examples.english_sentence: He studies very hard, hoping to distinguish himself in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個競爭激烈嘅社會，要出人頭地唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ging6 zang1 gik1 lit6 ge3 se5 wui2, jiu3 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个竞争激烈的社会，要出人头地不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: In this competitive society, it's not easy to make a name for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經過多年嘅努力，終於喺商界出人頭地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, zung1 jyu1 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经过多年的努力，终于在商界出人头地。
examples.english_sentence: After years of hard work, he finally distinguished himself in the business world.

english_meaning: to enter government service; to become an official
explanation_mandarin: 指开始担任官职，进入政府部门工作。
explanation_english: Refers to beginning to hold an official position, entering the government department to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完大學就出仕做政府工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 daai6 hok6 zau6 ceot1 si5 zou6 zing3 fu2 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大学毕业后就入仕做政府工作了。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating from university, he entered government service and started working for the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人想出仕，好多都要考科舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 jan4 soeng2 ceot1 si5, hou2 do1 dou1 jiu3 haau2 fo1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人想做官，很多都要参加科举考试。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many people who wanted to enter government service had to take the imperial examination.

english_meaning: to assume office, to take up a post, to be appointed to
explanation_mandarin: 担任某种职务或职位。
explanation_english: To assume a certain office or post; to be appointed to a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月會出任新嘅CEO。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 ceot1 jam6 san1 ge3 si1 ou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月将会担任新的首席执行官。
examples.english_sentence: He will assume the position of the new CEO next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出任呢個職位之後，公司嘅業績好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 jam6 ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 zi1 hau6, gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 zik1 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他担任这个职位之后，公司的业绩好了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After he took up this position, the company's performance improved significantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢曾經出任過好多唔同嘅政府部門嘅要職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cang4 ging1 ceot1 jam6 gwo3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zing3 fu2 bo6 mun4 ge3 jiu3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他曾经担任过很多不同的政府部门的重要职位。
examples.english_sentence: He has held important positions in many different government departments.

english_meaning: to stand out, to be unconventional, to be attention-grabbing, to be outrageous
explanation_mandarin: 指行为或言论与众不同，超出常规，引人注目，有时带有贬义，指为了引起注意而不择手段。
explanation_english: Refers to behavior or speech that is different from the norm, stands out, and attracts attention. Sometimes has a negative connotation, meaning to resort to any means to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗上位，乜嘢出位嘅嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 soeng5 wai2, mat1 je5 ceot1 wai2 ge3 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了上位，他什么出格的事情都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get promoted, he's capable of doing anything outrageous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁出位啦，會畀人話嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 wai2 laa1, wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么出格了，会被人说的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unconventional, people will talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着得好出位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 ceot1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得很出格。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing something very attention-grabbing today.

english_meaning: to go on a diplomatic mission
explanation_mandarin: 奉命到外国办理外交事务。
explanation_english: To go on a diplomatic mission; to be sent on a mission to a foreign country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾政府委派咗出使去英國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zing3 fu2 wai2 pai3 zo2 ceot1 sai2 heoi3 ying1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被政府委派去英国出使。
examples.english_sentence: He was appointed by the government to go on a diplomatic mission to the UK.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代好多使者都要出使唔同嘅國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ho2 do1 sai2 ze2 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 sai2 m4 tung4 ge3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代很多使者都要出使不同的国家。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, many envoys had to go on diplomatic missions to different countries.

english_meaning: to come out; to emerge; to appear; (after a verb, indicates outward movement or appearance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示从里面到外面，或者从隐蔽到显露。放在动词后面，表示动作的结果或方向是向外出现。
explanation_english: Indicates movement from inside to outside or from hidden to visible. Used after a verb to indicate the result or direction of an action is outward or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於肯出嚟見我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hang2 cheut1 lai4 gin3 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于肯出来见我了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally agreed to come out and see me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫洗完未乾，攞出嚟曬下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 sai2 jyun4 mei6 gon1, lo2 cheut1 lai4 saai3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服洗完了还没干，拿出来晒一下先。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes are washed but not dry yet, let's take them out to dry in the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗唔到點解決，不如大家一齊諗下，睇下有咩計仔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 m4 dou3 dim2 gaai2 kyut3, bat1 jyu4 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nam2 haa5, tai2 haa5 jau5 me1 gai3 zai2 cheut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想不出怎么解决，不如大家一起想一下，看看有什么办法出来。
examples.english_sentence: If we can't think of a solution, let's think together and see if any ideas come out.

english_meaning: outside
explanation_mandarin: 指外面，相对于里面的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to the outside, the area external to an enclosed space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺出便等我，我好快出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ceot1 bin6 dang2 ngo5, ngo5 hou2 faai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你 在 外面 等 我，我 很快 出来。
examples.english_sentence: You wait for me outside, I'll be out soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出便好凍，記得着多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 bin6 hou2 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外面 很 冷，记得 多 穿 件 衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold outside, remember to wear an extra layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好企喺出便，入嚟先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 ceot1 bin6, jap6 lai4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要 站 在 外面，先进来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand outside, come in first.

english_meaning: to make an offer; to bid; to quote a price
explanation_mandarin: 指提出价格，尤指在拍卖或竞标中。
explanation_english: To offer a price, especially in an auction or competitive bidding situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個個都想出價買呢間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 soeng2 ceot1 gaa3 maai5 ni1 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每个人都想出价买这间房子。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone wants to make an offer to buy this house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住出幾多價去投標呢個項目？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 zyu6 ceot1 gei2 do1 gaa3 heoi3 tau4 biu1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算出多少价格去投标这个项目？
examples.english_sentence: How much do you plan to bid for this project?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司出嘅價已經係最高㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceot1 ge3 gaa3 ji5 ging1 hai6 zeoi3 gou1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司出的价格已经是最高的了。
examples.english_sentence: The price offered by our company is already the highest.

english_meaning: to go in and out; to enter and exit; receipts and disbursements; discrepancy
explanation_mandarin: 1. 进出：表示从里面到外面，或者从外面到里面。2. 收支：指收入和支出的情况。3. 差别：指存在的不同或差异。
explanation_english: 1. To go in and out, to enter and exit: indicates the act of moving from inside to outside, or from outside to inside. 2. Receipts and disbursements: refers to the income and expenditure situation. 3. Discrepancy: a difference or inconsistency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都喺呢度出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 hai2 ni1 dou6 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在这里进出。
examples.english_sentence: He goes in and out of here every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢间公司嘅出入賬目要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ceot1 jap6 zoeng3 muk6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的收支账目要查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The company's accounts of receipts and disbursements need to be thoroughly investigated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢同我所知嘅有出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 tung4 ngo5 so2 zi1 ge3 jau5 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的和我所知道的有出入。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is different from what I know.

english_meaning: exit and entrance; port
explanation_mandarin: 指出入的地方，也指进出口贸易。
explanation_english: Refers to a place for entering and exiting, or import and export trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係商場嘅主要出入口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 soeng1 coeng4 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 ceot1 jap6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是商场的主要出入口。
examples.english_sentence: This is the main entrance and exit of the mall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個自由港，出入口貿易好發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 zi6 jau4 gong2, ceot1 jap6 hau2 mau6 jik6 hou2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个自由港，进出口贸易非常发达。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a free port with very developed import and export trade.

english_meaning: import and export company
explanation_mandarin: 指专门从事进出口贸易的公司。
explanation_english: Refers to a company that specializes in import and export trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺一間出入口公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 ceot1 jap6 hau2 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在一家进出口公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: I work at an import and export company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間出入口公司專門做歐洲生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ceot1 jap6 hau2 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 au1 zau1 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家进出口公司专门做欧洲的生意。
examples.english_sentence: This import and export company specializes in European business.

english_meaning: immigration; entry and exit; border control
explanation_mandarin: 指进出一个国家或地区的边境。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of entering and exiting a country or region's border, usually involving immigration and customs procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出入境嘅時候記得帶埋你嘅護照呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 jap6 geng2 ge3 si4 hau6 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 nei5 ge3 wu6 ziu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出入境的时候记得带上你的护照啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your passport when going through immigration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港出入境管制相對寬鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 jap6 geng2 gun2 zai3 soeng1 deoi3 fun1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港出入境管制相对宽松。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's immigration control is relatively relaxed.

english_meaning: Safe travels; Wishing you safety in all your comings and goings.
explanation_mandarin: 祝福语，祝愿人们外出和回家都平安顺利。
explanation_english: A blessing wishing someone safety in their travels, both when leaving and returning home. It's commonly used when someone is going on a trip or leaving a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，出入平安！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, ceot1 jap6 ping4 on1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，出入平安！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year, safe travels!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋去旅行，你記住幫我哋講句出入平安啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, nei5 gei3 zyu6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gong2 geoi3 ceot1 jap6 ping4 on1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们去旅行，你记得帮我们说一句出入平安啊。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a trip tomorrow, remember to wish us safe travels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出入平安，身體健康!
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 jap6 ping4 on1, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出入平安，身体健康！
examples.english_sentence: Safe travels and good health!

english_meaning: to charge to the company; to expense
explanation_mandarin: 指将个人花费报销为公费，通常是指在工作中产生的费用，例如餐费、交通费等，由公司承担。
explanation_english: To charge personal expenses to the company, typically work-related expenses such as meals or transportation, which are then covered by the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食飯我出公數，大家唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 faan6 ngo5 ceot1 gung1 sou3, daai6 gaa1 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃饭我报公账，大家不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: I'll expense tonight's dinner, so everyone don't be shy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出公數去旅行，真係爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 gung1 sou3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常报公账去旅行，真爽。
examples.english_sentence: He often expenses his trips to the company, how great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得拎返單據，可以出公數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 ling1 faan1 daan1 geoi3, ho2 ji5 ceot1 gung1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拿回单据，可以报公账。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take back the receipts, so you can expense it.

english_meaning: to dispatch troops; to send troops; to go to war
explanation_mandarin: 派遣军队作战；发动战争。
explanation_english: To dispatch troops for battle; to send an army to war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對方唔肯退讓，我哋就要出兵喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 fong1 m4 hang2 teoi3 joeng6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 ceot1 bing1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果对方不肯让步，我们就要出兵了。
examples.english_sentence: If the other side refuses to concede, we will have to send troops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗爭奪資源，決定出兵打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 zaang1 duk6 zi1 jyun4, kyut3 ding6 ceot1 bing1 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了争夺资源，决定出兵打仗。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to send troops to war in order to compete for resources.

english_meaning: unexpectedly; by surprise; catching someone off guard
explanation_mandarin: 趁人不备时行动。也指事情的发生出人意料。
explanation_english: To do something when someone is unprepared; to catch someone off guard. It can also refer to something happening unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出其不意咁衝過嚟，嚇到我彈開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 kei4 bat1 ji3 gam2 cung1 gwo3 lai4, haak3 dou3 ngo5 taan4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出其不意地冲过来，吓得我弹开了。
examples.english_sentence: He rushed over unexpectedly, scaring me so much I jumped back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要出其不意，先可以打敗佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceot1 kei4 bat1 ji3, sin1 ho2 ji5 daa2 baai6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要出其不意，才可以打败他们。
examples.english_sentence: We need to catch them off guard in order to defeat them.

english_meaning: to be released from prison
explanation_mandarin: 指从监狱释放出来。
explanation_english: Refers to being released from prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐咗十年監，聽日終於出冊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 zo2 sap6 nin4 gaam1, ting1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 caak3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐了十年牢，明天终于要出狱了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in prison for ten years, and he's finally being released tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話等大佬出冊之後，就會搞返大佢哋個社團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 dang2 daai6 lou2 ceot1 caak3 zi1 hau6, zau6 wui5 gaau2 faan1 daai6 keoi5 dei6 go3 se5 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说等大哥出狱之后，就会重振他们的社团。
examples.english_sentence: He said that after the big boss is released from prison, he will rebuild their triad.

mandarin_meaning: （文件或记录）完成登记，正式生效；（人）脱离（某个团体或关系）
english_meaning: (of documents or records) to be officially registered, take effect; (of a person) to be released (from a group or relationship); to graduate (from a program).
explanation_mandarin: 本义指文件或记录正式登记完成，开始生效。引申指从某个关系、团体中脱离出来，或者完成某个阶段的学习或工作。
explanation_english: The original meaning refers to a document or record being officially registered and taking effect. By extension, it means to be released from a relationship or group, or to complete a stage of study or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份文件聽日就出冊，正式生效啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 man4 gin2 ting1 jat6 zau6 ceot1 caak3, zing3 sik1 sang1 haau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件明天就完成登记，正式生效了。
examples.english_sentence: This document will be officially registered and take effect tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完個課程終於出冊喇，可以開始搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 go3 fo3 ching4 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 caak3 laa3, ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读完这个课程终于毕业了，可以开始找工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally graduated from the course and can start looking for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋離婚之後，佢就正式出冊，回復單身啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lei4 fan1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 zing3 sik1 ceot1 caak3, wui4 fuk1 daan1 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们离婚之后，他就正式脱离婚姻关系，恢复单身了。
examples.english_sentence: After their divorce, he was officially free from the marriage and became single again.

synonyms: 完成手續 (jyun4 sing4 sau2 zuk6)

english_meaning: to exert effort; to put in effort; to help out; to contribute
explanation_mandarin: 指尽力、尽心去做某事，帮助别人解决问题。
explanation_english: To exert effort; to put in effort to do something; to help someone out; to contribute to a task or cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project好重要，大家要出力啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project hou2 zung6 jiu3, daai6 ga1 jiu3 cheut1 lik6 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目很重要，大家要努力一些才行。
examples.english_sentence: This project is very important, everyone needs to put in more effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡力出力幫你搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 cheut1 lik6 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽力帮你搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: I will do my best to help you sort it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫手出力，我請你飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 sau2 cheut1 lik6, ngo5 cheng2 nei5 yam2 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我出力，我请你喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: If you help me out, I'll buy you a drink.

english_meaning: to dispatch; to set out; to mobilize; to take action
explanation_mandarin: 调动人员或力量去做事。通常指大规模的行动。
explanation_english: To dispatch or mobilize personnel or resources for a specific task, usually referring to a large-scale operation or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察出動咗好多人去處理呢單案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 ceot1 dung6 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 ni1 daan1 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察出动了很多人去处理这宗案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police dispatched a lot of people to handle this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員出動救火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 ceot1 dung6 gau3 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员出动救火。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters were dispatched to put out the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗捉個賊，佢哋出動曬所有嘅人手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zuk1 go3 caak6, keoi5 dei6 ceot1 dung6 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 jan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了抓那个贼，他们出动了所有的人手。
examples.english_sentence: In order to catch the thief, they mobilized all available manpower.

english_meaning: to attend work; attendance
explanation_mandarin: 指出席工作或劳动。既可以作动词，表示出席；也可以作名词，表示出席的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to attending work or labour. It can be used as a verb to mean 'to attend', or as a noun to refer to the state of attendance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日冇出勤，唔知咩事呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 ceot1 kan4, m4 zi1 dim2 si6 ne1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天没有出勤，不知道怎么回事呢。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't attend work today, I wonder what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅出勤紀錄好差喎，要小心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 ceot1 kan4 gei3 luk6 hou2 caa1 wo3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的出勤记录很差哦，要小心一点啦。
examples.english_sentence: Your attendance record is very poor, you need to be careful.

synonyms: [返工 (faan1 gung1) - to go to work]

english_meaning: to cheat (in gambling or other games)
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博或游戏中作弊，使用欺骗手段获取不正当利益。
explanation_english: To cheat, usually in gambling or games, by using deceptive methods to gain an unfair advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀成日出千，冇人想同佢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 sing4 jat6 ceot1 cin1, mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将总是作弊，没人想跟他玩。
examples.english_sentence: He always cheats at mahjong, no one wants to play with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好出千啊，俾人捉到就好肉酸㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ceot1 cin1 aa3, bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 hou2 juk6 saan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要作弊啊，被抓到就很丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat, it's very embarrassing if you get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試出千係唔啱嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 ceot1 cin1 hai6 m4 ngaam1 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试作弊是不对的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Cheating on exams is wrong.

english_meaning: to set a test paper; to prepare an exam
explanation_mandarin: 指出题目，编制试卷。
explanation_english: To prepare or set an exam paper, typically by a teacher or educator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要出卷，搞到我頭都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 gyun2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要出考卷，弄得我头都疼了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to set an exam paper tomorrow, it's giving me a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋老細成日出卷考佢哋啲伙記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 ceot1 gyun2 haau2 keoi5 dei6 di1 fo2 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的老板经常出题考他们的员工。
examples.english_sentence: Their boss often sets tests for their employees.

english_meaning: to go out; to exit; to leave
explanation_mandarin: 表示离开某个地方，向外移动。
explanation_english: To go out, to exit, to leave a place and move outwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想出去行下街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 haang4 haa5 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想出去逛逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go out for a walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出唔出去啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 m4 ceot1 heoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出不出去啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you going out or not?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經出去咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 ceot1 heoi3 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经出去了。
examples.english_sentence: He has already gone out.

english_meaning: exit, to speak, to say something (often negative or inappropriate), to export
explanation_mandarin: 名词：出去的口；动词：说出（话），通常指不恰当或负面的话语；出口货物
explanation_english: Noun: an exit; Verb: to speak, usually refers to saying inappropriate or negative things; exporting goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地鐵站有兩個出口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 jau5 loeng5 go3 cheut1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地铁站有两个出口。
examples.english_sentence: This subway station has two exits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢唔好咁冇口德，出口傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 hau2 dak1, cheut1 hau2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话不要那么没口德，出口伤人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak so poorly, your words hurt people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多嘢都係靠出口㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 kaau3 cheut1 hau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多东西都是靠出口的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong relies heavily on exports.

english_meaning: to wound someone with words; to say hurtful things; to be verbally abusive
explanation_mandarin: 说话不注意，说出的话伤害了别人。指说话刻薄，伤人感情。
explanation_english: To say hurtful things to someone, often without thinking. It implies being verbally abusive or insensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁出口傷人啦，人哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cheut1 hau2 soeng1 jan4 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么口出伤人，别人会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so verbally abusive, people will be unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出口傷人，所以無乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cheut1 hau2 soeng1 jan4, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是口出伤人，所以没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always says hurtful things, so he doesn't have many friends.

english_meaning: exporter
explanation_mandarin: 指从事出口贸易的商人或公司。
explanation_english: A merchant or company that engages in export trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司係一間大型嘅出口商，主要做電子產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 jat1 gaan3 daai6 hing4 ge3 ceot1 hau2 soeng1, zyu2 jiu3 zou6 din6 zi2 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司是一家大型的出口商，主要做电子产品。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is a large exporter, mainly dealing with electronic products.

english_meaning: to speak eloquently, to have a ready flow of words, to be a gifted speaker
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话很有文采，下笔成文，文思敏捷，才华横溢。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks and writes eloquently and quickly, with a rich vocabulary and impressive talent. It implies an effortless ability to produce well-formed sentences and paragraphs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自細就鍾意睇書，所以依家出口成文，寫嘢好有文采。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 sai3 zau6 zung1 yi3 tai2 syu1, so2 yi5 ji1 gaa1 cheut1 hau2 sing4 man4, se2 je5 hou2 jau5 man4 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就喜欢读书，所以现在出口成章，写东西很有文采。
examples.english_sentence: He loved reading since he was little, so now he speaks eloquently and writes with great style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口才好好，每次開會都出口成文，講嘢好有說服力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 coi4 hou2 hou2, mui5 ci3 hoi1 wui2 dou1 cheut1 hau2 sing4 man4, gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 syut3 fuk1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口才很好，每次开会都出口成章，说话很有说服力。
examples.english_sentence: He has a great speaking ability; he always speaks eloquently in meetings, and his words are very persuasive.

english_meaning: to use smooth talk; to use persuasive words; to talk one's way out of a situation; silver-tongued
explanation_mandarin: 指运用花言巧语、巧舌如簧来说服他人，或用一些动听的语言来逃避困境或推卸责任。
explanation_english: Refers to using eloquent and persuasive language to convince others, or using sweet words to escape a difficult situation or shirk responsibility. Often implies a degree of insincerity or manipulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出口術氹啲女仔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 hau2 seot6 tam5 di1 neoi5 zai2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是用花言巧语哄女孩子开心。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses smooth talk to make girls happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢，佢最叻就係出口術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 zeoi3 lek1 zau6 hai6 ceot1 hau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他最擅长的就是耍嘴皮子。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, his forte is smooth talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出口術幫公司傾掂咗單大生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 hau2 seot6 bong1 gung1 si1 king1 dim6 zo2 daan1 daai6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用花言巧语帮公司谈妥了一笔大生意。
examples.english_sentence: He used his persuasive words to close a big deal for the company.

synonyms: 花言巧語 (faa1 jin4 kiu2 jyu5)

english_meaning: to play tricks, to cheat, to deceive, to scam
explanation_mandarin: 指使用不正当的手段或伎俩欺骗他人，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to using unfair means or tricks to deceive others, usually with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出古惑，冇人信佢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 gu2 waak6, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍花招，没人相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always playing tricks, nobody trusts him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好出古惑呃人錢啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceot1 gu2 waak6 aak1 jan4 cin2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要耍花招骗别人的钱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play tricks to swindle other people's money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽要公平，唔准出古惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 jiu3 gung1 ping4, m4 zeon2 ceot1 gu2 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛要公平，不准作弊。
examples.english_sentence: The competition should be fair, no cheating allowed.

english_meaning: famous, well-known, renowned
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物很有名气，广为人知。
explanation_english: To be famous or well-known; to have a good reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好出名嘅歌星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 go1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有名的歌星。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 can1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant is very famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想出名，所以乜都肯做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ceot1 ming4, so2 ji5 mat1 dou1 hang2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想出名，所以什么都愿意做。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be famous, so he's willing to do anything.

english_meaning: Product; Output; Production quality; Craftsmanship
explanation_mandarin: 指生产出来的东西；也指制作的质量或水平。
explanation_english: Refers to the product manufactured; also refers to the quality or level of craftsmanship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅出品幾好㗎，你可以試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ceot1 ban2 gei2 hou2 gaa3, nei5 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的出品很好，你可以试一下。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is quite good, you can try it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影嘅出品認真，值得睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 ge3 ceot1 ban2 jing6 zan1, zik1 dak1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的制作认真，值得看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is well-produced and worth watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲設計出品好有水準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 cit3 gai3 ceot1 ban2 hou2 jau5 seoi2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计作品很有水平。
examples.english_sentence: His design works are of a very high standard.

mandarin_meaning: 出品人; 制片人 (电影)
