english_meaning: Producer (film, television, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 负责电影、电视等作品的投资、策划和制作的个人或公司。相当于制片人。
explanation_english: The person or company responsible for investing, planning, and producing a film, television program, or other creative work. Equivalent to a producer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅出品人好有眼光，揀咗個好劇本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 ceot1 ban2 jan4 hou2 jau5 ngaan5 gwong1, gaan2 zo2 go3 hou2 kek6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的出品人很有眼光，选了一个好剧本。
examples.english_sentence: The producer of this movie has a good eye and chose a good script.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一間大型電影公司嘅出品人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 gaan1 daai6 jing4 din6 jing2 gung1 si1 ge3 ceot1 ban2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一家大型电影公司的出品人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the producer of a large film company.

english_meaning: to sell; to offer for sale
explanation_mandarin: 卖出去；将商品或所有权转让给他人。
explanation_english: To offer something for sale; to transfer ownership of goods or property to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋打算出售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 daa2 syun3 ceot1 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打算把这间房子出售。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to sell this house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司出售咗佢哋嘅專利權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ceot1 sau6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zyun1 lei6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司出售了他们的专利权。
examples.english_sentence: This company sold their patent rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度出售好多紀念品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ceot1 sau6 hou2 do1 gei2 nim6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里出售很多纪念品。
examples.english_sentence: Many souvenirs are sold here.

english_meaning: to have a problem; to go wrong; to have issues
explanation_mandarin: 表示发生问题，出现故障或错误。
explanation_english: Indicates that a problem has occurred, something has gone wrong, or there's a fault or error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦成日出問題，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sing4 jat6 ceot1 man6 tai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑总是出问题，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is always having problems, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車行行吓突然間出問題，搞到我遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 haang4 haang4 haa5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 ceot1 man6 tai4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车开着开着突然出问题，搞得我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: The car suddenly had a problem while driving, causing me to be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果份報告出問題，我哋就要重新做過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ceot1 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 cung4 san1 zou6 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果报告出了问题，我们就要重新做过了。
examples.english_sentence: If there are problems with the report, we will have to redo it.

english_meaning: to hold a funeral procession; to hold a funeral
explanation_mandarin: 指举行殡葬仪式，将遗体从家中或殡仪馆运送到墓地或火葬场。
explanation_english: To hold a funeral procession, moving the deceased's body from the home or funeral parlor to the burial site or crematorium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日要出喪，記得去送佢最後一程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 song3, gei3 dak1 heoi3 sung3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天要出殡，记得去送他最后一程。
examples.english_sentence: They are holding the funeral procession tomorrow, remember to go and see him off on his final journey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個村嘅人都會嚟幫手出喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 go3 cyun1 ge3 jan4 dou1 wui5 lai4 bong1 sau2 ceot1 song3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个村子的人都会来帮忙举办葬礼。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone in the village will come to help with the funeral procession.

english_meaning: Something went wrong; an incident occurred; trouble arose
explanation_mandarin: 指发生意外、事故、问题等不好的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to the occurrence of an unexpected incident, accident, problem, or other undesirable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先架巴士喺隧道入面出嘢，搞到塞晒車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 seoi6 dou6 jap6 min6 ceot1 je5, gaau2 dou3 sak1晒 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那辆巴士在隧道里出事了，导致全部塞车。
examples.english_sentence: The bus had an incident in the tunnel just now, causing a traffic jam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞咁多嘢，萬一出嘢就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5, maan6 jat1 ceot1 je5 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搞这么多事情，万一出事就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around with so many things, it will be troublesome if something goes wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果部電腦再出嘢，我就要換過部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 bou6 din6 nou5 zoi3 ceot1 je5, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 wun6 gwo3 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这台电脑再出问题，我就要换一台新的。
examples.english_sentence: If this computer malfunctions again, I'll have to replace it with a new one.

english_meaning: to come out, to appear, to emerge
explanation_mandarin: 从里面到外面，出现，显现。
explanation_english: To move from inside to outside, to appear, to emerge. It can also mean 'to come out' in the sense of becoming public or participating in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出嚟食飯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 lai4 sik6 faan6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出来吃饭啦！
examples.english_sentence: Come out to eat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於出嚟認錯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 lai4 jing6 co3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于出来认错了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally came out and admitted his mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個秘密唔知幾時會出嚟呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei3 mat6 m4 zi1 gei2 si4 wui5 ceot1 lai4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个秘密不知道什么时候会暴露出来呢？
examples.english_sentence: I wonder when this secret will come out?

english_meaning: To work (outside the home); to be out working; to enter the workforce; to be out in the world making a living
explanation_mandarin: 指离开学校或家庭，开始工作赚钱。有时也指进入社会，特别是从事一些自由职业或非正规行业。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving school or home and starting to work for money. Sometimes it also refers to entering society, especially engaging in freelance or informal industries. It often carries the connotation of being independent and resourceful in finding ways to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完大學就出嚟撈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 daai6 hok6 zau6 ceot1 lai4 lou1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大学毕业就出来工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He started working after graduating from university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多人都出嚟撈散工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ceot1 lai4 lou1 saan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都出来打零工。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, and many people are out doing odd jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇讀幾多書，好早就出嚟撈世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 duk6 gei2 do1 syu1, hou2 zou2 zau6 ceot1 lai4 lou1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没读多少书，很早就出来社会打拼了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't study much and started working in society very early.

english_meaning: to be involved in the underworld; to be 'out there' in the world, often implying dealing with hardships and challenges
explanation_mandarin: 指涉足社会，经历各种磨练和挑战。通常带有在社会上混，尤其是在不那么光彩的领域打拼的意思。有时也指承担责任。
explanation_english: This phrase generally refers to being involved in society, facing various trials and challenges. It often implies being involved in the less savory aspects of life, especially those associated with the underworld or demanding situations. Sometimes, it also implies taking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出嚟行，預咗要還㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 lei4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出来混，迟早要还的。
examples.english_sentence: If you're involved in this, you're bound to pay the price sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嘅時候出嚟行，乜嘢場面都見過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 ge3 si4 hau6 ceot1 lei4 haang4, mat1 je5 caang4 min6 dou1 gin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就在外面闯荡，什么场面都见过。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he was out there in the world, he's seen all sorts of situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你決定出嚟行，就要為自己嘅決定負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 kyut3 ding6 ceot1 lei4 haang4, zau6 jiu3 wai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你决定出来混，就要为自己的决定负责。
examples.english_sentence: Now that you've decided to be involved in this, you have to take responsibility for your decisions.

jyutping: ceot1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4
mandarin_meaning: 出来混，迟早要还 (chū lái hùn, chí zǎo yào huán)
english_meaning: What goes around comes around; You have to pay the price for your actions; If you play the game, you have to accept the consequences.
explanation_mandarin: 指做了坏事或承担风险，最终要付出代价。意味着做了任何事都要承担相应的后果，逃避不了。
explanation_english: This idiom implies that if you do something wrong or take risks, you will eventually have to pay the price. It means that whatever you do, you have to bear the corresponding consequences, and there is no escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠呃人搵錢，但係出嚟行，預咗要還，而家俾人拉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 aak1 jan4 wan2 cin2, daan6 hai6 ceot1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠骗人赚钱，但是出来混，迟早要还，现在被人抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He made money by scamming people, but what goes around comes around, and now he's been arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣搞人，出嚟行，預咗要還㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gaau2 jan4, ceot1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样害人，出来混，迟早要还的。
examples.english_sentence: If you mess with people like this, you have to pay the price eventually.

synonyms: 種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆 (zung2 gwaa1 dak1 gwaa1, zung2 dau6 dak1 dau6 dau2)
惡有惡報 (ok3 jau5 ok3 bou3)

english_meaning: to go abroad; to leave the country
explanation_mandarin: 离开自己的国家到别的国家去。
explanation_english: To leave one's own country and go to another country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢計劃明年出國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gai3 waak6 ming4 nin4 ceot1 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他计划明年出国读书。
examples.english_sentence: He plans to study abroad next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥已經出咗國幾年啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 ji5 ging1 ceot1 zo2 gwok3 gei2 nin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥已经出国几年了。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother has been abroad for several years already.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人移民出國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ji4 man4 ceot1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港人移民出国。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong people are emigrating abroad.

mandarin_meaning: 出土; 重见天日 (比喻重新出现或被发现)
english_meaning: excavated; unearthed; reappeared; come to light (after being forgotten)
explanation_mandarin: 指从地下挖掘出来，也比喻被人遗忘或消失的事物重新出现或被发现。
explanation_english: Literally means to be excavated from the ground. Figuratively, it refers to something that has been forgotten or disappeared reappearing or being discovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考古學家喺嗰度出土咗好多古物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gu2 hok6 gaa1 hai2 go2 dou6 ceot1 tou2 zo2 hou2 do1 gu2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考古学家在那里出土了很多文物。
examples.english_sentence: Archaeologists excavated many artifacts there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻舊歌最近喺網上出土，好多人都話好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau6 go1 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 ceot1 tou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首老歌最近在网上被重新发现，很多人都说很好听。
examples.english_sentence: This old song recently resurfaced online, and many people say it's good.

english_meaning: To exert every last bit of strength; to put in all one's effort; to give it one's all.
explanation_mandarin: 指使出全身力气，用尽所有的精力。形容非常努力，拼尽全力。
explanation_english: This phrase describes the act of exerting every single bit of strength or energy one possesses. It implies putting in maximum effort and giving it one's all, comparable to a baby using all its strength to suckle milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我出埋飲奶力都要攞個好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ceot1 maai4 jam2 naai5 lik6 dou1 jiu3 lo2 go3 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我使出吃奶的力气也要取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: I will give it my all in this exam; I will exert every last bit of strength to get a good grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出埋飲奶力都舉唔起嗰個啞鈴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 maai4 jam2 naai5 lik6 dou1 geoi2 m4 hei2 go2 go3 aa2 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他使出吃奶的力气都举不起那个哑铃。
examples.english_sentence: He tried with all his might but still couldn't lift that dumbbell.

english_meaning: To go into the city; to go downtown
explanation_mandarin: 指离开自己居住地（通常是郊区或农村）到城市里去。
explanation_english: To go into the city, often from a more rural or suburban area. Implies leaving one's current location to travel to the urban center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚出城睇戲，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 ceot1 sing4 tai2 hei3, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚进城看电影，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: How about we go into the city tonight to watch a movie?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日出城買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ceot1 sing4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常进城买东西。
examples.english_sentence: They often go into the city to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 住喺呢度，要出城先有戲院睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu6 hai2 ni1 dou6, jiu3 ceot1 sing4 sin1 jau5 hei3 yun2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 住在这里，要进城才有电影院看。
examples.english_sentence: Living here, you need to go into the city to find a cinema.

english_meaning: to go abroad; to go on a business trip; to leave town; to travel (usually for business)
explanation_mandarin: 指离开所在城市或地区，通常指到外地或国外出差或旅行。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving one's current city or region, usually to go abroad or to another region for a business trip or travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜要出埠開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 ceot1 bou6 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期要出差开会。
examples.english_sentence: He has to go on a business trip next week to attend a meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日出埠去日本啊，你要唔要我幫你買手信？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ceot1 bou6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 aa3, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 maai5 sau2 seon3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要到日本去，你要不要我帮你买纪念品？
examples.english_sentence: I'm travelling to Japan tomorrow, do you want me to buy you some souvenirs?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都出埠，好少喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 bou6, hou2 siu2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常出差，很少在香港。
examples.english_sentence: He is often traveling and rarely in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to appear on stage; to come on the scene; to play (a role); to be present
explanation_mandarin: 原本指在舞台上表演，现在也指在某个场合出现、亮相，或者参与某个活动。
explanation_english: Originally referred to performing on a stage. Now it also means to appear on the scene, make an appearance, or participate in an activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚會喺演唱會出場唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 wui5 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ceot1 coeng4 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚会在演唱会上出场唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He will appear on stage and sing at the concert tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個主角出場嘅時候，全場觀眾都歡呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zyu2 gok3 ceot1 coeng4 ge3 si4 hau6, cyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 dou1 fun1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主角出场的时候，全场观众都欢呼。
examples.english_sentence: When the main character appeared on stage, the entire audience cheered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨出場之前，仲好緊張咁深呼吸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 ceot1 coeng4 zi1 cin4, zung6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 gam2 sam1 fu1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在出场之前，还很紧张地深呼吸。
examples.english_sentence: He took a deep breath nervously before going on stage.

english_meaning: to leave a country (through customs); emigration
explanation_mandarin: 离开一个国家或地区，通过海关检查。
explanation_english: To leave a country or territory, usually through customs and immigration control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要出境去日本旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 ging2 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要出境去日本旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm leaving the country tomorrow to travel to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺邊度出境㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 ceot1 ging2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你从哪里出境的？
examples.english_sentence: Where did you leave the country from?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出境手續好簡單㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 ging2 sau2 zuk6 hou2 gaan2 daan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出境手续很简单。
examples.english_sentence: The departure procedures are very simple.

english_meaning: to go out; to leave home; to be away from home
explanation_mandarin: 指离开家或所在地，到外面去。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving home or a place of residence to go outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都要出外做嘢，好少時間可以留喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 ngoi6 zou6 je5, hou2 siu2 si4 gaan3 ho2 ji5 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常要外出工作，很少时间可以待在家里。
examples.english_sentence: He often has to go out to work and has very little time to stay at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出外靠朋友，你要小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 ngoi6 kaau3 pang4 jau5, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门靠朋友，你要小心点啊。
examples.english_sentence: You rely on friends when you are away from home, you should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，大家都唔應該隨便出外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 kei4 gaan1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 ceoi4 bin2 ceot1 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，大家都不应该随便外出。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, everyone shouldn't go out casually.

english_meaning: to go out at night (for leisure, shopping, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指晚上出去逛街、玩乐等活动。通常指非工作目的的夜间外出。
explanation_english: Refers to going out at night for leisure, shopping, entertainment, etc. It usually implies going out at night for non-work-related purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋一齊出去出夜街啦，好耐冇去過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 heoi3 ceot1 je6 gaai1 laa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 heoi3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们一起出去逛夜街吧，好久没去过了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out tonight! It's been a long time since we went out at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生仔成日出夜街，唔瞓覺嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 ceot1 je6 gaai1, m4 fan3 gaau3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人整天晚上出去逛街，不睡觉的。
examples.english_sentence: Young people these days always go out at night and don't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出夜街要注意安全啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 je6 gaai1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 on1 cyun4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上出去逛街要注意安全啊！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when going out at night!

english_meaning: unexpected; surprising; extraordinary
explanation_mandarin: 超出一般预料，令人感到惊讶或不同寻常。
explanation_english: Exceeding expectations; causing surprise or being extraordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試竟然攞到A，真係出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ging2 jin4 lo2 dou2 ei1, zan1 hai6 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试竟然考了A，真是出乎意料。
examples.english_sentence: He actually got an A on this exam; it's really surprising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物咁好食，真係出奇地平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 gam3 hou2 sik6, zan1 hai6 ceot1 kei4 dei6 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物这么好吃，真是出奇地便宜。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so delicious, it's surprisingly cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然咁早返工，真係出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 gam3 zou2 faan1 gung1, zan1 hai6 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然这么早去上班，真是令人惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: He actually went to work so early, it's surprising.

english_meaning: to win by surprise; to gain an advantage by unexpected moves; to outwit by doing something unconventional
explanation_mandarin: 指用出人意料的方法或计谋来取得胜利。
explanation_english: To achieve victory by using unexpected methods or strategies. It implies surprising or outsmarting the opponent to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋出奇制勝，最後贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceot1 kei4 zai3 sing3, zeoi3 hau6 wing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们出奇制胜，最后赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: They won the game in the end by using an unexpected strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新產品嘅成功，係因為佢哋出奇制勝嘅市場策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 sing4 gung1, hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ceot1 kei4 zai3 sing3 ge3 si5 coeng4 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新产品的成功，是因为他们出奇制胜的市场策略。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this new product is due to their unconventional marketing strategy.

synonyms: 另闢蹊徑 (ling6 pik1 hei1 ging3)
別出心裁 (bit6 ceot1 sam1 coi4)

english_meaning: to get married (of a woman); to marry out
explanation_mandarin: 指女子结婚，离开娘家。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman getting married and leaving her maiden home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個女下個月就出嫁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 neoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 ceot1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的女儿下个月就要出嫁了。
examples.english_sentence: My daughter is getting married next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出嫁嗰日著得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 gaa3 go2 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她出嫁那天穿得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She looked very beautiful on her wedding day.

english_meaning: to become a monk or nun; to leave the secular world
explanation_mandarin: 指离开世俗家庭，到寺庙或道观中修行。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving one's secular family to practice religious discipline in a temple or monastery, typically becoming a Buddhist monk or nun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇破紅塵，決定出家做和尚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 po3 hung4 can4, kyut3 ding6 ceot1 gaa1 zou6 wo4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看破红尘，决定出家当和尚。
examples.english_sentence: He saw through the vanity of the world and decided to become a monk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿婆信佛信到出家埋添呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 po4 seon3 fat6 seon3 dou3 ceot1 gaa1 maai4 tim1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他奶奶信佛信到出家了！
examples.english_sentence: His grandmother is so devoted to Buddhism that she became a nun!

english_meaning: Buddhist monk or nun; member of a monastic order
explanation_mandarin: 指离开世俗家庭，皈依佛门，成为僧侣或尼姑的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has left their secular family and become a monk or nun in Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣已經想做個出家人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 soeng2 zou6 go3 ceot1 gaa1 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小时候就想当一个出家人了。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to be a monk since he was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟入面有好多出家人喺度誦經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 ceot1 gaa1 jan4 hai2 dou6 zung6 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺庙里有很多出家人在诵经。
examples.english_sentence: There are many monks chanting scriptures in the temple.

jyutping: ceot1 siu2 geoi3 seng1 dong3 bong1 mong4
english_meaning: Saying less is helping
explanation_mandarin: 指在某种情况下，保持沉默或减少发言反而能起到帮助作用，避免添乱或造成不必要的麻烦。
explanation_english: This idiom means that in certain situations, being silent or saying less is actually more helpful. It suggests that refraining from speaking can prevent unnecessary trouble or complications and is therefore a form of assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁複雜，你都係出少句聲當幫忙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, nei5 dou1 hai6 ceot1 siu2 geoi3 seng1 dong3 bong1 mong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么复杂，你还是少说一句就当帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated, you should just say less and consider it as helping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都唔識，最好都係出少句聲當幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 m4 sik1, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 ceot1 siu2 geoi3 seng1 dong3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，最好还是少说一句就当帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, it's best if he just keeps quiet and considers it as helping.

english_meaning: out; eliminated; knocked out; to be out of the game
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛或竞争中被淘汰。
explanation_english: Refers to being eliminated from a game, competition, or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺第一輪已經出局啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dai6 jat1 leon4 ji5 ging1 ceot1 guk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在第一轮就已经出局了。
examples.english_sentence: They were eliminated in the first round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔努力，好快會出局㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 nou5 lik6, hou2 faai3 wui5 ceot1 guk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不努力，很快就会被淘汰的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work hard, you'll be eliminated soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司競爭好大，唔跟上進度好易出局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging6 zang1 hou2 daai6, m4 gan1 soeng5 zeon3 dou6 hou2 ji6 ceot1 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司竞争很大，不跟上进度很容易被淘汰。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a lot of competition, and it's easy to be eliminated if you don't keep up.

english_meaning: to come out of retirement, to make a comeback (after a period of inactivity)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻隐退或辞职的人重新出来工作或活动。多用于有一定声望或资历的人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who has retired or resigned to return to work or activity. Often used for people with a certain reputation or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講李生退休咗幾年，依家又出山幫佢個仔手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 lei5 sang1 teoi3休zo2 gei2 nin4, ji1 gaa1 jau6 ceot1 saan1 bong1 keoi5 go3 zai2 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说李先生退休几年了，现在又重新出山帮他儿子忙了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard Mr. Li retired a few years ago, but now he's making a comeback to help his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前病咗好耐，而家身體好返，準備出山拍戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji4 gaa1 san1 tai2 hou2 faan1, zyun2 bei6 ceot1 saan1 paak3 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前病了很久，现在身体好起来了，准备复出拍戏了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a long time before, but now he's recovered and is preparing to make a comeback and film a movie.

english_meaning: to go on inspection tour; to go on patrol; to go out for a leisurely walk/stroll (often implying a sense of superiority or authority)
explanation_mandarin: 原指皇帝或高级官员到地方巡视。现在也常用来指有一定地位或权力的人外出视察或游玩，带有一定的戏谑意味。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the emperor or high-ranking officials going on inspection tours in different regions. Now, it is often used to describe people with a certain status or power going out for inspection or leisure, often with a playful or slightly mocking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日落嚟出巡，睇吓我哋做嘢有冇偷懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 lok6 lai4 ceot1 ceon4, tai2 haa5 ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 jau5 mou5 tau1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板经常下来巡视，看看我们工作有没有偷懒。
examples.english_sentence: The boss often comes down to inspect and see if we're slacking off at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着到咁靚，好似出巡咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 gam3 leng3, hou2 ci5 ceot1 ceon4 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿得这么漂亮，好像去巡视一样。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so nicely, as if she's going on an inspection tour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，我去街市出巡，買啲餸返屋企煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 ceot1 ceon4, maai5 di1 sung3 faan1 uk1 kei2 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我去菜市场逛一逛，买些菜回家做饭。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I'm going to stroll through the market to buy some groceries to cook dinner at home.

english_meaning: business trip
explanation_mandarin: 因公到外地办事。
explanation_english: to go on a business trip; business trip

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去上海出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 jiu3 heoi3 soeng6 hoi2 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期要去上海出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Shanghai on a business trip next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常要出差，好少時間喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 soeng4 jiu3 ceot1 caai1, hou2 siu2 si4 gaan3 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常要出差，很少时间在家。
examples.english_sentence: He often has to go on business trips, and has very little time at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次出差嘅費用全部公司負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ceot1 caai1 ge3 fai3 jung6 cyun4 bou6 gung1 si1 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次出差的费用全部公司负责。
examples.english_sentence: The company is responsible for all expenses of this business trip.

english_meaning: to dispatch troops; to send out an army; to embark on a task; to set out
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队出征，现在也指开始做某事，或接受任务开始行动。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the dispatching of troops for battle. Now it also refers to embarking on a task, setting out on a journey, or starting to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司終於決定出師，發展新市場喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 ceot1 si1, faat3 zin2 san1 si5 coeng4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司终于决定开始行动，发展新市场了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has finally decided to embark on the task of developing a new market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋準備好曬，聽日就正式出師喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 saai3, ting1 jat6 zau6 zing3 sik1 ceot1 si1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们准备好了，明天就正式开始行动了！
examples.english_sentence: We are all prepared, we will officially set out tomorrow!

english_meaning: to have an inauspicious start; to suffer a setback at the beginning
explanation_mandarin: 指出兵或做事一开始就不顺利。形容事情一开始就遭遇挫折。
explanation_english: Describes an inauspicious start to a military expedition or any undertaking. It indicates experiencing setbacks or difficulties from the very beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project出師不利，希望之後會順利啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 pro1 zek3 ceot1 si1 bat1 lei6, hei1 mong6 zi1 hau6 wui5 seon6 lei6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目出师不利，希望之后会顺利一些。
examples.english_sentence: This project had an inauspicious start. Hopefully, it will be smoother afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次創業就出師不利，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 cong3 jip6 zau6 ceot1 si1 bat1 lei6, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次创业就出师不利，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: His first business venture had an inauspicious start and he lost a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 出师有名 (chū shī yǒu míng)
english_meaning: to have a justifiable reason for military action; to have a legitimate reason for doing something
explanation_mandarin: 指出兵有正当理由；引申为做某事有正当理由。
explanation_english: Originally referring to military action, this idiom means to have a justifiable or legitimate reason for taking an action, especially one that might be controversial. It implies that the action is morally or legally justifiable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁做都係出師有名啫，佢之前已經違反咗合約條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam2 zou6 dou1 hai6 ceot1 si1 jau5 ming4 ze1, keoi5 zi1 cin4 ji5 ging1 wai4 faan2 zo2 hap6 joek3 tiu4款.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这样做也是出师有名，他之前已经违反了合同条款。
examples.english_sentence: Our actions are justifiable; he already violated the terms of the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢炒咗個員工，但係佢出師有名，因為個員工長期表現差劣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 caau2 zo2 go3 wun4 gung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ceot1 si1 jau5 ming4, jan1 wai6 go3 wun4 gung1 coeng4 kei4 biu2 hin3 caa1 lyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他炒掉了那个员工，但是他出师有名，因为那个员工长期表现差劲。
examples.english_sentence: Although he fired the employee, he had a legitimate reason because the employee's performance had been consistently poor.

synonyms: 理所當然 (lei5 so2 dong1 jin4)

english_meaning: to attend; to be present
explanation_mandarin: 指参加某个会议、活动等。
explanation_english: To be present at; to attend (a meeting, event, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要出席個會議呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 sik6 go3 wui5 ji5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要出席一个会议。
examples.english_sentence: I need to attend a meeting tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為病咗，冇辦法出席今晚嘅派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 beng6 zo2, mou5 baan6 faat3 ceot1 sik6 gam1 maan1 ge3 paai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为生病了，没办法出席今晚的派对。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't attend the party tonight because he was sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都出席咗個開幕典禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ceot1 sik6 zo2 go3 hoi1 muk6 din2 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都出席了开幕典礼。
examples.english_sentence: Many people attended the opening ceremony.

english_meaning: next year
explanation_mandarin: 指即将到来的下一年。
explanation_english: Refers to the upcoming next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出年諗住去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceot1 nin4 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年打算去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to travel next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出年嘅經濟應該會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 nin4 ge3 ging1 zai3 ying1 goi1 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明年的经济应该会好一点。
examples.english_sentence: The economy should be better next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出年就畢業喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 nin4 zau6 bat1 jip6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明年就毕业了。
examples.english_sentence: He will graduate next year.

english_meaning: to appear in court
explanation_mandarin: 指到法庭上出庭，通常是为了作证或者参与诉讼。
explanation_english: To appear in court, usually to testify or participate in legal proceedings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日要出庭作證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 ting4 zok3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天要出庭作证。
examples.english_sentence: He has to appear in court tomorrow to testify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢係案件嘅關鍵證人，所以一定要出庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 on3 gin2 ge3 gwaan1 gin6 zing3 jan4, so2 ji5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ceot1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他是案件的关键证人，所以一定要出庭。
examples.english_sentence: Because he is a key witness in the case, he must appear in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔出庭，可能會被法庭罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 ceot1 ting4, ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 faat3 ting4 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不出庭，可能会被法庭罚款。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't appear in court, you may be fined by the court.

english_meaning: to leave the factory; to be released from factory; (slang) to be a virgin
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是离开工厂。在俚语中，用来形容女性还是处女。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to leave the factory'. In slang, it's used to describe a female virgin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車啱啱出廠，仲好新淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 che1 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 chong2, jung4 hou2 san1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车刚出厂，还很新。
examples.english_sentence: This car just left the factory, it's still very new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢仲係出廠貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jung4 hai6 ceot1 chong2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她还是处女。
examples.english_sentence: She says she's still a virgin.

english_meaning: to go on an expedition; to set out on a campaign; (figuratively) to attack online; to troll; to go out on a mission
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队出兵征战。近年来在网络语境中，指网络用户大规模地攻击（通常是负面评论）特定的目标，如某个网站、社交媒体账号或个人。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to an army going to war. In recent years, in the online context, it refers to a large-scale attack (usually with negative comments) by internet users on a specific target, such as a website, social media account, or individual. It can also refer to going out on a specific mission or task, but less common than the internet use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋又組織人去人哋個page度出征喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau6 zou2 zik1 jan4 heoi3 jan4 dei6 go3 page dou6 ceot1 zing1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们又组织人去别人的页面上出征了。
examples.english_sentence: They are organizing people to go to the other person's page to attack them online again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅project，我哋要出征啦，一定要成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 project, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceot1 zing1 laa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目，我们要出征了，一定要成功。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, we're going to go all out; we must succeed.

jyutping: ceot1 dak1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4
mandarin_meaning: 出来混，迟早要还 (chū lái hùn, chí zǎo yào huán)
english_meaning: What goes around, comes around; If you play the game, you have to accept the consequences; Every action has its reaction.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是做了坏事，迟早会受到报应；凡事都有代价，做了就要承担后果。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if you do something wrong, you will eventually have to pay the price for it. It implies that every action has a consequence, and you must be prepared to face the music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好醒，成日呃人錢，但係出得嚟行，預咗要還，而家咪俾人拉咗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 seng2, seng4 jat6 aak1 yan4 chin2, daan6 hai6 ceot1 dak1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4, yi4 ga1 mai1 bei2 yan4 laai1 zo2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很聪明，总是骗别人的钱，但是出来混，迟早要还的，现在不是被人抓了吗。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he was clever, always cheating people out of their money, but what goes around comes around, and now he's been arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你偷嘢梗係唔啱㗎啦，出得嚟行，預咗要還，唔好諗住可以咁易甩身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tau1 je5 gang2 hai6 m4 ngaam1 gaa3 laa1, ceot1 dak1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4, m4 hou2 lam2 zeoi2 ho2 ji5 gam2 ji6 syut1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你偷东西肯定是不对的，出来混，迟早要还的，不要以为可以这么容易脱身。
examples.english_sentence: Stealing is definitely wrong. What goes around comes around, so don't think you can get away with it so easily.

synonyms: 善有善报，恶有恶报 (sin6 jau5 sin6 bou3, ok3 jau5 ok3 bou3)

jyutping: ceot1 dak1 ting1 tong4, jap6 dak1 cyu4 fong2
mandarin_meaning: 上得了厅堂，下得了厨房
english_meaning: Can present herself elegantly in public and can cook well at home; a woman who is capable and versatile.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子既能优雅地出现在重要场合，又能在家操持家务、烹饪美食。指女性内外兼修，能力出众。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is able to present herself elegantly in formal or important occasions, and also capable of managing household chores and cooking delicious meals at home. It implies that a woman is well-rounded, capable both socially and domestically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係出得廳堂，入得廚房，娶到佢嘅男人真係好幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 ceot1 dak1 ting1 tong4, jap6 dak1 cyu4 fong2, cheui2 dou2 keoi5 ge3 naam4 jan2 zan1 hai6 hou2 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是上得了厅堂，下得了厨房，娶到她的男人真是太幸福了。
examples.english_sentence: She is truly someone who can present herself elegantly in public and cook well at home. The man who marries her is really blessed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲人成日話要搵個出得廳堂，入得廚房嘅老婆，但係又有幾多男人可以咁要求自己？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 sing4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 wan2 go3 ceot1 dak1 ting1 tong4, jap6 dak1 cyu4 fong2 ge3 lou5 po2, daan6 hai6 jau6 gei2 do1 naam4 jan2 ho2 ji5 gam2 jiu1 kau4 zi6 gei2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人总是说要找一个上得了厅堂，下得了厨房的老婆，但是又有多少男人可以这样要求自己？
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people always say they want to find a wife who can present herself elegantly in public and cook well at home, but how many men can demand that of themselves?

mandarin_meaning: 可以示人; 可以拿出手
english_meaning: Presentable; Acceptable to be shown in public; Good enough to be seen by others
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物達到可以被公開展示的程度，通常指外觀或質量方面。
explanation_english: Describes something that has reached a level where it is acceptable to be shown publicly. Usually refers to appearance or quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫咁殘舊，都唔出得街㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gam3 caan4 gau6, dou1 m4 ceot1 dak1 gaai1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服这么旧，都不能穿出门了。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is so old and worn out, it's not presentable enough to wear outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課做得咁求其，都唔出得街俾人睇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 gam3 kau4 gei2, dou1 m4 ceot1 dak1 gaai1 bei2 jan4 tai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功课做得这么马虎，都不好意思拿给别人看。
examples.english_sentence: His homework is done so carelessly, it's not good enough to show to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計仲有好多問題，未出得街住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat3 gai3 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4, mei6 ceot1 dak1 gaai1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计还有很多问题，还不能公开展示。
examples.english_sentence: This design still has many problems, it's not ready to be presented yet.

english_meaning: to go to the toilet, to relieve oneself (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 一种比较文雅或者含蓄的说法，指去厕所排泄。
explanation_english: A polite and euphemistic way of saying 'to go to the toilet' or 'to relieve oneself'. It's a somewhat old-fashioned term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我要出去出恭一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 jiu3 ceot1 heoi3 ceot1 gung1 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我要去上厕所一下。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I need to go to the toilet for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日都叫人哋去出恭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 dou1 giu3 jan4 dei6 heoi3 ceot1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是叫别人去上厕所。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always tells people to go to the toilet (using this term).

english_meaning: to go to the toilet; to relieve oneself
explanation_mandarin: 一种委婉说法，指上厕所，使用于比较正式或文雅的场合。
explanation_english: A euphemism for going to the toilet, used in more formal or polite settings. Literally: 'to go out respectfully, to come in respectfully'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我想出恭入敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 soeng2 ceot1 gung1 jap6 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我想去一下洗手间。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'd like to go to the restroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗出恭入敬，你等佢陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ceot1 gung1 jap6 ging3, nei5 dang2 keoi5 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去洗手间了，你等他一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: He's gone to the restroom, wait for him a moment.

synonyms: 去洗手間 (heoi3 sai2 sau2 gaan1)

english_meaning: promising; having prospects; ability to succeed; ambition; progress
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人有前途、有发展；或者指某人的能力、成就。
explanation_english: Describes someone as promising, having good prospects for development; or refers to someone's ability or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有出息，將來一定會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 ceot1 sik1, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有出息，将来一定会成功。
examples.english_sentence: He is very promising and will definitely succeed in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁懶，一啲出息都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laan5, jat1 dik1 ceot1 sik1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么懒，一点出息都没有。
examples.english_sentence: You are so lazy, you have no prospects at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望個仔大個咗可以有啲出息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 go3 zai2 daai6 go3 zo2 ho2 ji5 jau5 di1 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望儿子长大后能有点出息。
examples.english_sentence: I hope my son will be promising when he grows up.

english_meaning: to go to war; to participate in a competition/contest; to fight
explanation_mandarin: 指参与战争，比赛或其他竞争性活动。
explanation_english: Refers to participating in a war, competition, or other competitive activity. It signifies going into battle or engaging in a contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋隊波要出戰決賽啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 jiu3 ceot1 zin3 kyut3 coi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们的球队要参加决赛了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team will be participating in the final tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司準備出戰市場，同對手競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 zin3 si5 coeng4, tung4 deoi3 sau2 ging6 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司准备进入市场，和对手竞争。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is preparing to enter the market and compete with rivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場仗，我哋一定要出戰，唔可以退縮。

explanation_english: Refers to the experience of being distracted or pulled out of the immersion while watching a performance (movie, play, etc.). This can be due to various reasons like unrealistic plot points, poor acting, or unexpected events that break the audience's suspension of disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲特效假到我即刻出戲。

english_meaning: to take action; to make a move; to offer help; to spend money; to strike (a blow); to sell

explanation_english: Indicates taking action, making a move, offering help, spending money, or selling something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋終於出手解決呢個問題。

examples.english_sentence: He hit someone, so it serves him right to be arrested.

english_meaning: to make a move; to launch an attack; to put forward a plan; to deploy a strategy
explanation_mandarin: 指采取行动、策略、计划等，通常是为了应对某种情况或达成某种目的。可以指实际的行动，也可以指策略上的部署。
explanation_english: Refers to taking action, deploying a strategy, or putting forward a plan, often in response to a situation or to achieve a specific goal. It can refer to a physical action or a strategic maneuver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又出新招，睇嚟想贏梗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 ceot1 san1 ziu1, tai2 lai4 soeng2 jeng4 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又出了新招，看来想赢定了。

examples.english_sentence: The opponent made a move too quickly, we couldn't react in time.

examples.english_sentence: The boss has made a move to lay off employees, causing widespread anxiety.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself, to embarrass oneself, to make a spectacle of oneself

explanation_english: Refers to behaving inappropriately or making a fool of oneself in public or important occasions, causing embarrassment or shame.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1, ging2 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1晒 di1 go1 ci4, zan1 hai6 ceot1 saai3 naa1 zaa1.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺咁多人面前出拿渣啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 ceot1 naa1 zaa1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这么多人面前出丑啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't embarrass yourself in front of so many people!

english_meaning: to attack; to strike; to launch an attack; to go on the offensive
explanation_mandarin: 指采取行动，主动进攻。可以是军事上的进攻，也可以用于其他方面，例如商业竞争或辩论等。
explanation_english: To launch an attack or offensive; to take proactive action, often in a competitive or combative situation. Can refer to military actions, business competitions, debates, etc.

examples.english_sentence: Their company is preparing to launch an attack next month, launching a new product.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyu2 dung6 ceot1 gik1, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 coeng2 zo2 go3 si5 coeng4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁強嘅對手，我哋都要諗清楚點樣出擊先至可以贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 koeng4 ge3 deoi3 sau2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 dim2 joeng2 ceot1 gik1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么强的对手，我们都要想清楚怎么样出击才可以赢。
examples.english_sentence: Facing such a strong opponent, we need to think carefully about how to attack in order to win.

mandarin_meaning: 由于, 出自, 处于

examples.english_sentence: Due to safety concerns, we decided to cancel tonight's event.

mandarin_meaning: 私下交易; 暗箱操作

explanation_mandarin: 指股票或其他金融产品在非公开市场进行交易，或者指暗箱操作，进行不正当的交易或活动。

examples.english_sentence: This transaction might be the result of shady dealings.

explanation_english: Refers to using unfair, underhanded, or unethical tactics to achieve a goal, often implying a hidden or unexpected move.

explanation_mandarin: 指公开承认自己的性取向或性别认同，通常指同性恋者或跨性别者向他人公开自己的身份。
explanation_english: To come out of the closet, revealing one's sexual orientation or gender identity, usually referring to a homosexual or transgender person publicly disclosing their identity to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都出咗櫃，好勇敢呀！

examples.english_sentence: They both came out of the closet, so brave!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住今年嘅同志遊行出櫃。

examples.english_sentence: They are holding the funeral procession tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺過咗身，屋企人準備緊幫佢出殯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1, uk1 kei5 jan4 zyun2 bei6 gan2 bong1 keoi5 ceot1 ban3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷去世了，家人准备着帮他出殡。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa has passed away, and the family is preparing to hold a funeral procession for him.

english_meaning: to vent one's anger; to take it out on someone; to let off steam
explanation_mandarin: 将心中的不满、愤怒等情绪发泄出来，通常会针对比自己弱小或无关的人或事物。
explanation_english: To vent one's anger or frustration, often by directing it towards someone weaker or unrelated to the cause of the anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司受氣，返到屋企就喺啲仔女身上出氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 sau6 hei3, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 hai2 di1 zai2 neoi5 san1 soeng6 ceot1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在公司受气，回到家就在孩子身上出气。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets frustrated at work and takes it out on his children when he gets home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我身上出氣啦，唔關我事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 san1 soeng6 ceot1 hei3 laa1, m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我身上出气了，不关我的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it out on me, it's not my fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打波係一個好好嘅出氣方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 bo1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 ceot1 hei3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打球是一个很好的出气方法。
examples.english_sentence: Playing sports is a great way to let off steam.

english_meaning: punching bag; whipping boy; scapegoat
explanation_mandarin: 比喻可以随意发泄怒气的人或事物。
explanation_english: A person or thing on whom someone vents their anger or frustration; a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日當我係出氣袋啦，我都有感受㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dong3 ngo5 hai6 ceot1 hei3 doi2 laa1, ngo5 dou1 jau5 gam2 sau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是把我当出气筒，我也有感受的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always treat me like a punching bag, I have feelings too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司成日俾老細當出氣袋咁鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 bei2 lou5 sai3 dong3 ceot1 hei3 doi2 gam2 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司经常被老板当出气筒一样骂。
examples.english_sentence: He's often scolded by the boss as a scapegoat in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以將啲負面情緒發洩喺其他人身上，唔好當人哋係出氣袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 di1 fu6 min6 ching4 seoi5 faat3 se3 hai2 kei4 taa1 jan4 san1 soeng6, m4 hou2 dong3 jan4 dei6 hai6 ceot1 hei3 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能把负面情绪发泄在别人身上，不要把别人当出气筒。
examples.english_sentence: You can't vent your negative emotions on others, don't treat people like punching bags.

mandarin_meaning: 渗水; 漏水; （游泳）浮出水面; 露馅; 被发现; 显露
english_meaning: to leak; to seep water; to surface (in swimming); to come to light; to be exposed; to betray
explanation_mandarin: 指物体渗出水来，或者从水中浮出来，也指事情败露，真相显现。
explanation_english: Refers to water leaking from an object, or surfacing from water. It can also mean that something is exposed or the truth comes to light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條水管出水，要搵人嚟整啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 seoi2 gun2 ceot1 seoi2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 zing2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水管漏水了，要找人来修理了。
examples.english_sentence: The water pipe is leaking, we need to find someone to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅陰謀終於出水喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jam1 mau4 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 seoi2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的阴谋终于败露了。
examples.english_sentence: Their conspiracy has finally been exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 游水游到出水，要抖下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 seoi2 jau4 dou3 ceot1 seoi2, jiu3 dau2 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游泳游到露出水面，要休息一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: Swimming until surfacing, need to rest for a while.

mandarin_meaning: 收据; 单据; 凭证
english_meaning: Receipt; Proof of purchase; Documentary evidence of payment
explanation_mandarin: 指购物或接受服务后取得的收据或单据，作为付款证明。
explanation_english: Refers to a receipt or document obtained after purchasing goods or services, serving as proof of payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得攞返張出水紙呀，到時可以claim錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 ceot1 seoi2 zi2 aa3, dou3 si4 ho2 ji5 claim cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得拿回那张收据，到时候可以报销。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to get the receipt back, you can claim the money later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇出水紙，公司唔會俾你報銷㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 ceot1 seoi2 zi2, gung1 si1 m4 wui5 bei2 nei5 bou3 siu1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有收据，公司不会给你报销的。
examples.english_sentence: Without a receipt, the company won't reimburse you.

english_meaning: to sweat; to perspire
explanation_mandarin: 指身体通过皮肤排出汗液。
explanation_english: To excrete perspiration through the skin; to sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完運動之後，我出晒汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 ceot1 saai3 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完运动之后，我全身都出汗了。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising, I'm sweating all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緊張嘅時候，我手心會出汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan2 zoeng1 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 sau2 sam1 wui5 ceot1 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紧张的时候，我的手心会出汗。
examples.english_sentence: When I'm nervous, my palms sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，行幾步路都出汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6, haang4 gei2 bou6 lou6 dou1 ceot1 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么热，走几步路都出汗。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot, I sweat after walking just a few steps.

english_meaning: to haunt, to appear and disappear, to frequent
explanation_mandarin: 指（人或动物）经常出现或隐没在某个地方。
explanation_english: To appear and disappear frequently in a certain place, often implying a lurking presence or regular visits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講呢排有隻野豬喺嗰頭出沒，大家小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ni1 paai2 jau5 zek3 je5 zyu1 hai2 go2 tau4 ceot1 mut6, daai6 gaa1 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说最近有只野猪在那一带出没，大家小心点。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that a wild boar has been haunting that area recently. Everyone, be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧出沒，一定唔係咩好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jiu1 baa1 ceot1 mut6, jat1 ding6 m4 hai6 me1 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在酒吧出没，一定不是什么好人。
examples.english_sentence: He frequents bars all the time, he must not be a good person.

english_meaning: To clash with the Tai Sui (Grand Duke Jupiter); to offend the Tai Sui; to have bad luck due to astrological influences associated with one's zodiac animal and the year.
explanation_mandarin: 指出生年份的地支与当年的地支相冲，导致运势不佳，容易遇到不顺利的事情。是香港民间信仰中一种认为会带来厄运的说法，与生肖和流年有关。
explanation_english: Refers to the clash between the Earthly Branch of one's birth year and the Earthly Branch of the current year in Chinese astrology. It is believed to bring bad luck and challenges. It is a folk belief in Hong Kong related to the Chinese zodiac and the year's ruling animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我出沖，咩都唔敢搞咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 ceot1 cung1, me1 dou1 m4 gam2 gaau2 gam2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我犯太岁，什么都不敢弄太多事情。
examples.english_sentence: This year I'm clashing with the Tai Sui, so I don't dare to get involved in too many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話今年佢出沖，所以去咗拜太歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gam1 nin4 keoi5 ceot1 cung1, so2 ji5 heoi3 zo2 baai3 taai3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他今年犯太岁，所以去拜太岁了。
examples.english_sentence: He said that he's clashing with the Tai Sui this year, so he went to worship Tai Sui.

english_meaning: to appear and disappear; to haunt; to frequent
explanation_mandarin: 指时而出现，时而消失；经常出现。
explanation_english: To appear and disappear intermittently; to frequent a place, implying that one is often seen there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧出沒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jau5 baa1 cheut1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在酒吧出没。
examples.english_sentence: He frequents the bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 传闻呢度有鬼出没。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 man4 ni1 dou6 jau5 gwai2 cheut1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传说这里有鬼出没。
examples.english_sentence: Rumor has it that ghosts haunt this place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋通常夜晚先至出沒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 je6 maan1 sin1 zi3 cheut1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们通常晚上才出没。
examples.english_sentence: They usually appear at night.

english_meaning: to produce oil; to secrete oil; to get oily
explanation_mandarin: 指皮肤分泌油脂，变得油腻；或指食物经过烹饪后渗出油分。
explanation_english: Refers to the secretion of oil from the skin, making it oily; or refers to food releasing oil after being cooked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我塊面好快就出油，搞到成日都要吸油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faai3 min6 hou2 faai3 zau6 ceot1 jau4, gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 kap1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的脸很快就出油，搞得我经常都要吸油。
examples.english_sentence: My face gets oily very quickly, so I have to use blotting paper all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個炸雞髀炸到出晒油，唔敢食咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaa3 gai1 bei2 zaa3 dou3 ceot1晒 jau4, m4 gam2 sik6 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个炸鸡腿炸得都出油了，不敢吃这么多。
examples.english_sentence: This fried chicken drumstick is so oily, I don't dare to eat too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣熱，個人好易出油出汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jit6, go3 jan4 hou2 ji6 ceot1 jau4 ceot1 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气热，人很容易出油出汗。
examples.english_sentence: When the weather is hot, it's easy for people to get oily and sweaty.

mandarin_meaning: 发送信息; 发布消息; 出击
english_meaning: send a message; publish information; launch an attack (figuratively); to stir things up (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指球类运动中发出球。现在多指发送信息，发布消息，或在网络社群中发起话题、引发讨论，有煽动或制造舆论的效果。有时也指主动出击。
explanation_english: Originally referring to sending a ball out in ball games. Now, it generally refers to sending a message, publishing information, or initiating a topic in online communities to spark discussion, often with the effect of instigating or creating public opinion. It can also mean taking the initiative to strike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上出波，搞到成班人鬧交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 ceot1 bo1, gaau2 dou3 seng4 baan1 jan4 naau6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在网上发布消息，搞得一群人吵架。
examples.english_sentence: He's always stirring things up online, causing a group of people to argue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備出波，宣傳佢哋嘅新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 bo1, syun1 cyun4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司准备发布消息，宣传他们的新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company is preparing to launch a campaign to promote their new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要主動出波，唔可以俾對手搶先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyu2 dung6 ceot1 bo1, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 deoi3 sau2 coeng2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须主动出击，不能让对手抢先。
examples.english_sentence: We must take the initiative and not let our opponents get ahead.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself; to be humiliated; to embarrass oneself; to make a spectacle of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 做出令人尴尬、丢脸的行为。
explanation_english: To behave in a way that is embarrassing or humiliating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唔小心跌親，真係出晒洋相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng5 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 ceot1晒joeng4 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在台上不小心跌倒了，真是在众人面前出丑。
examples.english_sentence: He/She accidentally fell on stage, really making a fool of himself/herself in front of everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講喇，再講就出洋相㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3, zoi3 gong2 zau6 ceot1 joeng4 soeng3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再说了，再说就要出丑了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say any more, or you'll embarrass yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次佢喺個party到飲醉酒，出晒洋相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 keoi5 hai2 go3 party dou3 yam2 zeoi3 zau2, ceot1晒joeng4 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次他在派对上喝醉了酒，出了大丑。
examples.english_sentence: Last time he got drunk at the party and really made a fool of himself.

english_meaning: to go to sea; to go offshore; (figuratively) to go abroad (for business, expansion, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是到海上，也常用于比喻公司或企业走向海外市场，进行海外扩张。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to go to sea'. Figuratively, it refers to a company or enterprise expanding into overseas markets, going global.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司打算今年出海，開拓歐洲市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gam1 nin4 ceot1 hoi2, hoi1 tok3 au1 zau1 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司打算今年出海，开拓欧洲市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to go abroad this year and explore the European market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港公司都出海發展，搵更多機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 gung1 si1 dou1 ceot1 hoi2 faat3 zin2, wan2 gang3 do1 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港公司都出海发展，寻找更多机会。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong companies are going abroad to develop and find more opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人出海釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ceot1 hoi2 diu3 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人出海钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: His family went out to sea to fish.

synonyms: 拓展海外市場 (tok3 zin2 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4)
走向國際 (zau2 hoeng3 gwok3 zai3)

english_meaning: Going to sea is one-third life (or luck)
explanation_mandarin: 形容出海的危险性极高，生命安全很难保障。三分命指生命完全掌握在自己手中只有三分，其余七分要靠天意、运气和其他因素。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the high risk involved in going to sea. It implies that one's life is not entirely in their own hands; only one-third is controlled by the individual, while the remaining two-thirds depend on fate, luck, and other external factors. It highlights the unpredictable and perilous nature of seafaring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲漁民真係好艱苦，成日聽佢哋講「出海三分命」，真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jyu4 man4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaan1 fu2, seng4 jat6 teng1 keoi5 dei6 gong2 "ceot1 hoi2 saam1 fan1 ming6", zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的渔民真的很辛苦，经常听他们说“出海三分运气”，真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: Fishermen in the past really had it tough. I often heard them say, "Going to sea is one-third life (or luck)", it really wasn't easy.

english_meaning: estuary, river mouth (leading to the sea)
explanation_mandarin: 河流、江河等流入大海的地方；入海口。
explanation_english: The place where a river or other body of water flows into the sea; estuary; river mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 珠江嘅出海口好闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu1 gong1 ge3 ceot1 hoi2 hau2 hou2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 珠江的出海口很宽。
examples.english_sentence: The estuary of the Pearl River is very wide.

jyutping: ceot1 wu1 nai4 ji4 bat1 jim5
english_meaning: To emerge from the mud unsullied; rising above one's squalid environment; remaining pure despite being surrounded by corruption.
explanation_mandarin: 出自周敦颐《爱莲说》。比喻一个人身处污浊的环境，却能保持纯洁的品格，不与世俗同流合污。
explanation_english: This idiom originates from Zhou Dunyi's "On the Love of Lotus." It is a metaphor for a person who maintains their purity and integrity, refusing to be corrupted by the immoral environment they are in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺咁複雜嘅環境下，仍然保持住正直嘅性格，真係出淤泥而不染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 waan4 ging2 haa6, jing4 jin4 bo2 ci4 zyu6 zing3 zik6 ge3 sing3 gaak3, zan1 hai6 ceot1 wu1 nai4 ji4 bat1 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这么复杂的环境下，仍然保持着正直的性格，真是出淤泥而不染。
examples.english_sentence: In such a complex environment, he still maintains his upright character, truly emerging from the mud unsullied.

english_meaning: to get angry, to lose one's temper
explanation_mandarin: 指发脾气，生气，失去控制。
explanation_english: To become angry, to lose one's temper, to get mad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再激我喇，我好快會出火㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gik1 ngo5 laa3, ngo5 hou2 faai3 wui5 ceot1 fo2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再激我了，我很快就会发火的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke me anymore, I'll get angry very soon!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一俾人話就出火，真係冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bei2 jan4 waa6 zau6 ceot1 fo2, zan1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一被人说就发火，真是没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He gets angry whenever someone says something about him, there's really no way to deal with it.

english_meaning: to emit smoke; to be fuming; to be very angry
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是冒出烟雾。比喻非常生气，气得头顶冒烟。
explanation_english: Literally means to emit smoke. Figuratively, it means to be extremely angry, so angry that smoke seems to be coming out of one's head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽見到我考試肥佬，嬲到出煙啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, nau1 dou3 ceot1 jin1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈看到我考试不及格，气得冒烟了！
examples.english_sentence: My mom was fuming when she saw that I failed the exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧到出煙，睇嚟佢都就嚟辭職㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 dou3 ceot1 jin1, tai2 lai4 keoi5 dou1 zau6 lai4 ci4 zik1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂得快要冒烟了，看来他要辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by his boss until he was fuming, it seems he's about to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器過熱出煙，睇嚟要整整佢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 gwo3 jit6 ceot1 jin1, tai2 lai4 jiu3 zing2 zing2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器过热冒烟，看来要修理一下了。

examples.english_sentence: The son is so naughty, it's really like newly forged iron - it must be hammered, otherwise he will be spoiled in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家樓價升得咁快，真係出爐鐵——唔打唔得，再唔買驚遲啲買唔起。

jyutping: ceot1 dik1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4
english_meaning: What goes around comes around.
explanation_mandarin: 指做了坏事或欠了别人的人情债，迟早是要付出代价的。强调因果报应，做了不好的事情总会承担相应的后果。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if you do something wrong or owe someone a favor, you will eventually have to pay the price. It emphasizes karma and that bad deeds will ultimately lead to negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呃咗咁多人錢，出的嚟行，預咗要還㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 jan4 cin2, ceot1 dik1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗了这么多人钱，出来混，迟早要还的啦。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated so many people out of their money; what goes around comes around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家咁對人，第時出的嚟行，預咗要還，唔好後悔啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 deoi3 jan4, dai6 si4 ceot1 dik1 lai4 haang4, jyu6 zo2 jiu3 waan4, m4 hou2 hau6 fui3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在这样对别人，以后出来混，迟早要还的，不要后悔啊。
examples.english_sentence: If you treat people like this now, what goes around comes around later. Don't regret it.

synonyms: 種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆 (zung3 gwaa1 dak1 gwaa1, zung3 dau6 dak1 dau6)

english_meaning: to use every trick in the book; to exhaust all means; to pull out all the stops
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用尽了各种方法、手段或本领。形容为了达到某个目的，竭尽全力，想方设法。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to using all possible methods, tricks, or skills to achieve a goal. It describes exhausting all resources and trying every approach to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏呢場比賽，我哋出盡八寶，諗晒所有策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 ceot1 zeon6 baat3 bou2, lam2 saai3 so2 jau5 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场比赛，我们使出了浑身解数，想尽了所有策略。
examples.english_sentence: To win this game, we used every trick in the book and thought of all possible strategies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想追到個女仔，出盡八寶，送花又送禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zeoi1 dou2 go3 neoi5 zai2, ceot1 zeon6 baat3 bou2, sung3 faa1 jau6 sung3 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想追到那个女孩，使出了浑身解数，送花又送礼物。
examples.english_sentence: He used every trick in the book to woo that girl, sending flowers and gifts.

english_meaning: to exhaust all tricks and resources; to pull out all the stops
explanation_mandarin: 用尽所有方法、手段和技巧，为了达到某个目的。
explanation_english: To use all available methods, tricks, and resources to achieve a goal; to leave no stone unturned; to pull out all the stops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏呢場比賽，佢哋出盡法寶，咩招都用埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, keoi5 dei6 ceot1 zeon6 faat3 bou2, me1 ziu1 dou1 yung6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场比赛，他们使出了浑身解数，什么招都用了。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win this competition, they pulled out all the stops and used every trick in the book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想氹返女朋友，出盡法寶都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tam5 faan1 neoi5 pang4 jau5, ceot1 zeon6 faat3 bou2 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想哄回女朋友，使尽了浑身解数都没搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to win back his girlfriend, but even after pulling out all the stops, he couldn't fix things.

english_meaning: outstanding, prominent, remarkable
explanation_mandarin: 超出一般，比其他人或事物更为优秀。
explanation_english: Standing out from the crowd; being noticeably superior or exceptional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅音樂天賦真係出眾，好少人可以同佢比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 tin1 fu3 zan1 hai6 ceot1 zung3, hou2 siu2 jan4 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的音乐天赋真的很出众，很少人可以和他比。
examples.english_sentence: His musical talent is truly outstanding; few can compare to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務態度非常出眾，值得一讚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 taai3 dou6 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 zung3, zik6 dak1 jat1 zaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务态度非常出众，值得一赞。
examples.english_sentence: The service attitude of this restaurant is very outstanding; it's worth praising.

english_meaning: to release a record/album; to go on sale (of a music album)
explanation_mandarin: 指音乐人或歌手发行新的音乐专辑。碟，指的是唱片。
explanation_english: Refers to a musician or singer releasing a new music album. 'Dip2' (碟) refers to a record or album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月出碟，好期待啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 ceot1 dip2, hou2 kei5 doi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月要出专辑了，好期待啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's releasing an album next month, I'm so excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個歌手出道五年都未出碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 go1 sau2 ceot1 dou6 ng5 nin4 dou1 mei6 ceot1 dip2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个歌手出道五年都还没有出专辑。
examples.english_sentence: This singer has been in the industry for five years and still hasn't released an album.

synonyms: 推出專輯 (teoi1 ceot1 zyun1 cap1)

english_meaning: to show; to produce; to present (for inspection)
explanation_mandarin: 拿出并展示。
explanation_english: To take out and display something, usually for inspection or verification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請出示你嘅身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 ceot1 si6 nei5 ge3 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请出示你的身份证。
examples.english_sentence: Please show your ID card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺關口被要求出示護照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gwaan1 hau2 bei6 jiu1 kau4 ceot1 si6 wu6 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在关口被要求出示护照。
examples.english_sentence: He was asked to show his passport at the border.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔出示有效嘅車票，我哋就要罰你錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 ceot1 si6 jau5 haau6 ge3 ce1 piu3, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 fat6 nei5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不出示有效的车票，我们就要罚你钱。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't show a valid ticket, we will have to fine you.

english_meaning: to be in a trance, to be engrossed in one's thoughts, to be lost in thought
explanation_mandarin: 精神集中在某事物上，以至好像失去了知觉。
explanation_english: To be so engrossed in one's thoughts or in something that one becomes unaware of one's surroundings; to be in a trance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽歌聽到出曬神，我叫佢幾聲都冇反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 go1 ting1 dou3 ceot1 saai3 san4, ngo5 giu3 keoi5 gei2 seng1 dou1 mou5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听歌听得出神了，我叫了他好几声都没反应。
examples.english_sentence: He was so engrossed in listening to the song that he didn't react even when I called him a few times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢望住個海出神，唔知諗緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong6 zyu6 go3 hoi2 ceot1 san4, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他望着大海出神，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was staring at the sea, lost in thought; I wonder what he's thinking about.

mandarin_meaning: 出神入化 (chū shén rù huà)
english_meaning: to reach a superlative state; to attain perfection; masterful; sublime; extraordinary
explanation_mandarin: 形容技艺达到高超精妙的境界。
explanation_english: Describes a skill or technique that has reached an extremely high and exquisite level, bordering on perfection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫功真係出神入化，每幅畫都好似有生命咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 gung1 zan1 hai6 ceot1 san4 jap6 faa3, mui5 fuk1 waa2 dou1 hou2 ci5 jau5 sang1 ming6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画功真是出神入化，每幅画都好像有生命一样。
examples.english_sentence: His painting skills are truly masterful; every painting seems to have a life of its own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位廚師嘅刀功已經去到出神入化嘅境界，可以將豆腐雕到好似花咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 ceoi4 si1 ge3 dou1 gung1 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 ceot1 san4 jap6 faa3 ge3 ging2 gaai3, ho2 ji5 zoeng1 dau6 fu6 diu1 dou3 hou2 ci5 faa1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位厨师的刀功已经达到了出神入化的境界，可以将豆腐雕得像花一样。
examples.english_sentence: This chef's knife skills have reached a sublime level; he can carve tofu to look like flowers.

synonyms: 爐火純青 (lou4 fo2 seon4 cing1)
登峰造極 (dang1 fung1 zou6 gik6)

english_meaning: to rent out, to let
explanation_mandarin: 把自己的东西（如房屋、汽车等）租给别人使用。
explanation_english: To make something available to others in return for payment (e.g., a house, a car).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋想出租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 soeng2 cheot1 zu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想把房子出租。
examples.english_sentence: We want to rent out our house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多的士出租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 dik1 si2 cheot1 zu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多出租车。
examples.english_sentence: There are many taxis for hire here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想出租佢架車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 cheot1 zu1 keoi5 gaa3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想出租他的车。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to rent out his car.

mandarin_meaning: 出笼; 公布; 推出
english_meaning: Out of the steamer (literal); released; launched; announced; available (after production/waiting)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指蒸笼里的东西拿出来。引申为公布，推出，发布，上市等，表示经过一段时间的准备后，事物或消息公开或可以使用。
explanation_english: Literally refers to taking something out of a steamer basket. Figuratively, it means to be released, launched, announced, or available (e.g., after production or a waiting period). It indicates that after a period of preparation, something (a product, information, etc.) is made public or accessible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新產品聽日就出籠喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 caan2 pan2 ting1 jat6 zau6 ceot1 lung4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些新产品明天就要上市了。
examples.english_sentence: These new products will be launched tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲等到頸都長，終於出籠喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 dang2 dou3 geng2 dou1 coeng4, zung1 jyu1 ceot1 lung4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影等了很久，终于上映了。
examples.english_sentence: We've been waiting so long for this movie; it's finally released!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅新政策終於出籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的新政策终于公布了。
examples.english_sentence: The government's new policy has finally been announced.

mandarin_meaning: 出狱了; 发布了; 出来了
english_meaning: Out of prison; released (e.g., information, product); out of the cage; finally emerged
explanation_mandarin: 原指囚犯从监狱释放出来。引申为：信息、产品等的发布；人或物从封闭空间出来；最终出现，可以被大众看到了。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a prisoner being released from prison. By extension, it means: the release of information or products; a person or thing coming out of an enclosed space; finally emerging and being visible to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐完監出籠liu，諗住重新做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 jyun4 gaam1 ceot1 lung4 liu5, nam2 zyu6 cung4 san1 zou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐完牢出狱了，打算重新做人。
examples.english_sentence: He's out of prison after serving his sentence and plans to start a new life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻新電話出籠liu，好多人都去搶購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 san1 din6 waa2 ceot1 lung4 liu5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 heoi3 coeng2 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款新手机发布了，很多人都去抢购。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone has been released, and many people are rushing to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 困咗喺屋企咁耐，終於可以出籠liu，出去行下喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwan3 zo2 hai2 uk1 kei2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 lung4 liu5, ceot1 heoi3 hang4 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被困在家里这么久，终于可以出来了，出去走走吧！
examples.english_sentence: After being cooped up at home for so long, I can finally get out, let's go for a walk!

synonyms: 放監 fong3 gaam1 (release from prison)

english_meaning: to act flirtatiously; to show off; to try to attract attention
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性（有时也指男性）打扮得花枝招展，故意吸引异性注意，带有轻佻、卖弄的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a woman (sometimes also a man) who is dressed up attractively and deliberately tries to attract the attention of the opposite sex, often with a connotation of being flirtatious or showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到咁性感，擺明就係出籠撩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 gam3 sing3 gam2, baai2 ming4 zau6 hai6 ceot1 lung4 liu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得这么性感，摆明就是卖弄风骚啊。
examples.english_sentence: She dressed so sexily today, she's obviously trying to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁出籠撩啦，影響人哋做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 lung4 liu1 laa1, jing2 hoeng2 jan4 dei6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么卖弄风骚了，影响别人工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so flirtatious, you're distracting people from their work.

english_meaning: Fresh out of the steamer/oven; newly released; hot off the press
explanation_mandarin: 指刚刚从蒸笼里拿出来的，形容事物非常新鲜、刚出现或刚完成。
explanation_english: Refers to something freshly steamed or baked, used to describe something that is very new, recently released, or just completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個包啱啱出籠溜，好熱呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baau1 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lung4 liu1, hou2 jit6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包刚出炉，很烫！
examples.english_sentence: This bun is fresh out of the oven, it's very hot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲啱啱出籠溜，好多人排隊睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lung4 liu1, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影刚上映，很多人排队看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is newly released, a lot of people are queuing to watch it.

synonyms: 新鮮出爐 (san1 sin1 ceot1 lou4)

english_meaning: to get paid, to receive salary
explanation_mandarin: 指收到工资。员工从雇主那里获得报酬。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving a salary. It means an employee gets paid by their employer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日出糧呀，請你食飯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ceot1 loeng4 aa3, ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天发工资了，请你吃饭！
examples.english_sentence: I'm getting paid tomorrow, I'll treat you to dinner!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工幾時出糧㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 gei2 si4 ceot1 loeng4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份工作什么时候发工资？
examples.english_sentence: When does he get paid at his job?
