examples.cantonese_sentence: 出糧日係我一個月最開心嘅一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 loeng4 jat6 hai6 ngo5 jat1 go3 jyut6 zeoi3 hoi1 sam1 ge3 jat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发工资日是我一个月最开心的一天。
examples.english_sentence: Payday is the happiest day of the month for me.

english_meaning: cashier; accounting clerk; to receive and pay out money
explanation_mandarin: 负责收款和付款的人员；也指收取和支付款项的工作。
explanation_english: A person responsible for receiving and paying out money; also refers to the work of receiving and paying out money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺銀行做緊出納。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 zou6 gan2 ceot1 naap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在银行做着出纳员。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as a cashier in the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司請咗個新嘅出納。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 ceot1 naap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司请了一个新的出纳。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired a new cashier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你負責出納，一定要小心啲處理啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fu6 zaak3 ceot1 naap6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 cyu2 lei5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你负责出纳，一定要小心地处理这些钱。
examples.english_sentence: You are responsible for the cashier duties, you must be careful handling the money.

english_meaning: cashier, treasurer, accountant
explanation_mandarin: 负责管理现金收支、银行存款和账务的人员。
explanation_english: A person who is responsible for managing cash receipts and disbursements, bank deposits, and accounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺銀行做緊出納員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 zou6 gan2 ceot1 naap6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在银行做着出纳员。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as a cashier in the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司請咗個新嘅出納員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 ceot1 naap6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司请了一个新的出纳员。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired a new cashier.

english_meaning: To qualify (in a competition); to advance to the next round; to emerge
explanation_mandarin: 在比赛中，通过预赛或小组赛，进入下一阶段的比赛，或获得晋级资格。 也可指脱颖而出。
explanation_english: In competitions, it means to qualify and advance to the next stage of a competition, typically after preliminary rounds or group stages. It can also metaphorically mean to stand out or emerge successfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波終於出線喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 sin3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的球队终于出线了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team finally qualified!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番努力，佢終於喺選美比賽入面成功出線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hai2 syun2 mei5 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 sing4 gung1 ceot1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番努力，她终于在选美比赛中成功出线。
examples.english_sentence: After a lot of effort, she finally qualified in the beauty pageant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑住出色嘅表現，成功喺眾多候選人之中出線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pang4 zyu6 ceot1 sik1 ge3 biu2 jin6, sing4 gung1 hai2 zung3 do1 hau6 syun2 jan4 zi1 zung1 ceot1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她凭借出色的表现，成功在众多候选人之中出线。
examples.english_sentence: She successfully emerged from many candidates due to her outstanding performance.

synonyms: 脫穎而出 (tyut3 wing6 oi4 ceot1)

english_meaning: vacancy; to have a vacancy
explanation_mandarin: 指职位或位置出现空缺，通常因为人员离职、调动或其他原因。
explanation_english: Refers to a position or vacancy becoming available, usually due to someone leaving, being transferred, or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經理個位出缺，好多人都想爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lei5 go3 wai2 ceot1 kyut3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 zaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司经理的位置空缺了，很多人都想竞争。
examples.english_sentence: The company manager's position is vacant, and many people want to compete for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢退休，所以而家有個教席出缺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 keoi5 teoi3 yau1, so2 ji5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 go3 gaau3 sik6 ceot1 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他退休，所以现在有一个教职空缺。
examples.english_sentence: Because he retired, there is now a teaching position vacancy.

english_meaning: to cheat (in gambling or other games); to pull a fast one
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博或其他游戏中作弊，使用不正当手段欺骗他人。
explanation_english: Refers to cheating in gambling or other games by using dishonest methods to deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀成日出老千，所以冇人想同佢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 sing4 jat6 ceot1 lou5 cin1, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将总是作弊，所以没人想和他玩。
examples.english_sentence: He always cheats when playing mahjong, so no one wants to play with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為可以出老千呃到我，我睇穿你喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 lou5 cin1 ngaak1 dou3 ngo5, ngo5 tai2 cyun1 nei5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为可以作弊骗到我，我看穿你了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can cheat me, I see right through you!

mandarin_meaning: 出声; 发声; 说话
english_meaning: to speak; to make a sound; to say something; to voice an opinion; to complain
explanation_mandarin: 发出声音；说话；表达意见；也可以指抱怨。
explanation_english: To speak; to make a sound; to voice an opinion; to say something. It can also mean to complain or protest something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩唔滿意嘅，就出聲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 ge3, zau6 ceot1 seng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么不满意的，就说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any dissatisfaction, please speak up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度出聲投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 ceot1 seng1 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: He always complains here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔出聲，我就當你同意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 ceot1 seng1, ngo5 zau6 dong3 nei5 tung3 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不出声，我就当你同意了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't say anything, I'll assume you agree.

english_meaning: to originate from; to come from; to be derived from
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物、作品等的来源或出处。
explanation_english: Indicates the source or origin of a thing, work, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅靈感出自佢嘅個人經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 ling4 gam2 ceot1 zi6 keoi5 ge3 go3 jan4 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的灵感来自于他的个人经历。
examples.english_sentence: The inspiration for this book comes from his personal experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故事出自一個古老嘅傳說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 si6 ceot1 zi6 jat1 go3 gu2 lou5 ge3 cyun4 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事出自一个古老的传说。
examples.english_sentence: This story originates from an ancient legend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功出自不懈嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 ceot1 zi6 bat1 haai6 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功源于不懈的努力。
examples.english_sentence: His success stems from tireless effort.

english_meaning: outstanding, remarkable, excellent
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物表现非常优秀，超出一般水平。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that performs exceptionally well, exceeding the average level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試成績好出色喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 sing4 zik1 hou2 ceot1 sik1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试成绩很出色啊！
examples.english_sentence: His exam results are outstanding this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影拍得好出色，值得推薦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 paak3 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1, zik6 dak1 tui1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影拍得很出色，值得推荐。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is excellently made and worth recommending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現非常出色，超出咗我哋嘅預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 sik1, ceot1 co3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyu6 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现非常出色，超出了我们的预期。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is very outstanding, exceeding our expectations.

english_meaning: to serve dishes (in a restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 餐馆里把菜端上桌子给顾客。 动词，指餐馆的厨房做好菜后，服务员将菜端给顾客。
explanation_english: To serve dishes to customers in a restaurant. It refers to the action of waiters serving dishes to customers after the kitchen prepares them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿姐，唔該快啲出菜呀，我哋等好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je1, m4 goi1 faai3 di1 ceot1 coi3 aa3, ngo5 dei6 dang2 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员，请快点上菜，我们等很久了。
examples.english_sentence: Waitress, please serve the dishes quickly, we have been waiting for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房已經出緊菜喇，唔使急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 ji5 ging1 ceot1 gan2 coi3 laa3, m4 sai2 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房已经在上菜了，不用着急。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen is already serving dishes, no need to rush.

mandarin_meaning: 出处; 来源; 根据
english_meaning: source; origin; provenance; grounds; where something comes from
explanation_mandarin: 指出事物起源或依据的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to the place or origin from which something comes or the basis for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你篇文章嘅出處喺邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 pin1 zoeng1 ge3 ceot1 cyu3 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这篇文章的出处在哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the source of your article?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個謠言嘅出處已經無從稽考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jiu4 jin4 ge3 ceot1 cyu3 ji5 ging1 mou4 cung4 kai1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个谣言的出处已经无从查考。
examples.english_sentence: The origin of this rumor is now untraceable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢冇出處，信唔過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 mou5 ceot1 cyu3, seon3 m4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话没有根据，不可信。
examples.english_sentence: What he said has no source, so it's untrustworthy.

jyutping: ceot1 cyu3 bat1 jyu4 zeoi6 cyu3
english_meaning: It's better to be together than to be apart; distance makes the heart grow fonder.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻朋友、家人等分隔两地，不如相聚在一起。强调团聚的重要性，胜过独自在其他地方生活或发展。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the idea that it's better to be together with loved ones (friends, family, etc.) than to be separated by distance. It emphasizes the importance of togetherness and that being together is more valuable than pursuing individual opportunities or lives elsewhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥移民咗去加拿大，但係佢成日都話出處不如聚處，好掛住我哋一家人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 a3 go1 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 ceot1 cyu3 bat1 jyu4 zeoi6 cyu3, hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥移民去了加拿大，但他总是说远不如相聚在一起，很想念我们一家人。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother immigrated to Canada, but he always says that it's better to be together, and he misses our family very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然份工人工高啲，但係要離開屋企人，真係出處不如聚處，都係唔做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 di1, daan6 hai6 jiu3 lei4 hoi1 uk1 kei2 jan4, zan1 hai6 ceot1 cyu3 bat1 jyu4 zeoi6 cyu3, dou1 si6 m4 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这份工作工资高一些，但是要离开家人，真是远不如相聚在一起，还是不做了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Although the job pays higher, having to leave my family, it's really better to be together, so I won't take it.

mandarin_meaning: 耍花招; 耍手段; 搞鬼
english_meaning: To play tricks; to deceive; to be sneaky; to pull a fast one
explanation_mandarin: 指使用不正当的手段或方法来欺骗、蒙骗他人，或做一些不为人知的鬼祟行为。
explanation_english: Refers to using improper means or methods to deceive or trick others, or to engage in sneaky, underhanded behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都出蠱惑，真係唔可以信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 gu2 waak6, zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍花招，真的不能相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always playing tricks, you really can't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為我唔知你出蠱惑，我睇穿曬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 ceot1 gu2 waak6, ngo5 tai2 cyun1 saai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为我不知道你搞鬼，我全部看穿了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I don't know you're being sneaky, I see right through you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成日出蠱惑呃人錢，小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 ceot1 gu2 waak6 aak1 jan4 cin2, siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是耍花招骗人钱，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: This company is always pulling a fast one to cheat people out of money, be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 大出血 / 花大钱 / 亏损
english_meaning: to bleed / to lose a lot of money / to pay a heavy price
explanation_mandarin: 原本指流血过多。 在粤语中，常引申为花费大量金钱，或是遭受重大损失。多用于形容因某事花费巨大，超出预期。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to bleed'. In Cantonese, it often refers to losing a lot of money or paying a heavy price, often unexpectedly or unwillingly. It signifies a significant financial loss or expenditure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次裝修屋企真係出血啊，使咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zong1 sau1 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 cheut1 hyut3 aa3, sai2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次装修房子真是大出血啊，花了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Renovating the house this time was a real bleed; it cost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕到出血，就嚟執笠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 dou3 cheut1 hyut3, zau6 lai4 zap1 laap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司亏损得很厉害，快要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is bleeding money; it's about to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗買呢部限量版嘅模型，我真係出血出血出血啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 maai5 ni1 bou6 haan6 loeng6 baan2 ge3 mou4 jing2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 cheut1 hyut3 cheut1 hyut3 cheut1 hyut3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了买这个限量版的模型，我真是大出血啊！
examples.english_sentence: In order to buy this limited edition model, I really had to bleed a lot!

synonyms: 使好多錢 (sai2 hou2 do1 cin2)
損手爛腳 (syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3)

mandarin_meaning: 亏损点; 容易花钱的地方
english_meaning: Point of loss; money pit; place where money is easily spent
explanation_mandarin: 指容易造成亏损的地方或事物；容易让人花钱的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a place, activity, or item that easily leads to financial loss or where money is easily spent. It implies something drains your finances or encourages spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買名牌手袋真係一個出血位嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi2 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 ceot1 hyut3 wai2 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买名牌手提包真是一个亏损点啊！
examples.english_sentence: Buying designer handbags is really a money pit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 養車係一個好大嘅出血位，你要諗清楚啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joeng5 ce1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 ceot1 hyut3 wai2, nei5 jiu3 lam2 cing1 co2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 养车是一个很大的亏损点，你要想清楚啊。
examples.english_sentence: Owning a car is a big money pit, you need to think carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲演唱會嘅周邊產品先至係真嘅出血位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 zau1 bin1 caan2 ban2 sin1 ze3 hai6 zan1 ge3 ceot1 hyut3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的周边产品才是真正的花钱的地方。
examples.english_sentence: The merchandise at the concert is the real money pit.

english_meaning: outstanding, distinguished, prominent
explanation_mandarin: 超出一般人，特别优秀。
explanation_english: Surpassing others in talent, ability, or appearance; exceptionally good or remarkable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺唱歌方面好出衆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 coeng3 go1 fong1 min6 hou2 ceot1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在唱歌方面很出众。
examples.english_sentence: He is outstanding in singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績喺班入面好出衆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 hai2 baan1 jap6 min6 hou2 ceot1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩在班里很出众。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are outstanding in the class.

english_meaning: to cheat, to use underhanded tactics, to pull a fast one
explanation_mandarin: 指在游戏、考试或竞争中采取不正当手段，以获取优势或胜利。
explanation_english: Refers to using unfair or dishonest tactics in a game, exam, competition, or any situation to gain an advantage or win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試出術，俾老師發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 ceot1 seot6, bei2 lou5 si1 faat3 yin6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊，被老师发现了。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated on the exam and was caught by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打麻雀唔好出術啊，咁樣就冇意思啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 maa4 zoek3 m4 hou2 ceot1 seot6 aa3, gam2 joeng2 zau6 mou5 yi3 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻将不要作弊啊，这样就没有意思了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat while playing mahjong, it makes it meaningless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出術，所以冇人鍾意同佢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 seot6, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 zung1 yi3 tung4 keoi5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍手段，所以没人喜欢和他玩。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses underhanded tactics, so no one likes to play with him.

english_meaning: to go out, to go outdoors, to go to the streets, to go out shopping/socializing
explanation_mandarin: 指离开家或建筑物，到街上或户外活动。可以指出门办事，逛街，社交活动等。
explanation_english: To leave one's home or building and go out to the street or outdoors. It can refer to going out for errands, shopping, social activities, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚出去食飯，出街輕鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6, ceot1 gaai1 hing1 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚出去吃饭，出门轻松一下。
examples.english_sentence: We're going out for dinner tonight, going out to relax a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨，唔想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨，不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, I don't want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出街，唔喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 gaai1, m4 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天出门，不在家。
examples.english_sentence: He is always going out and not at home.

english_meaning: to rush out, to burst out, to make a sudden move (often aggressive or impulsive)
explanation_mandarin: 形容突然冲出去的行为，带有一定的爆发性和冲动性。多指情绪激动时，或为了达到某个目的而采取的快速行动。
explanation_english: Describes the act of rushing out suddenly, often with an explosive or impulsive nature. It often refers to a quick action taken when emotionally agitated or to achieve a specific goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到出衝，差啲打人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 ceot1 cung1, caa1 di1 daa2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得要冲出去，差点打人。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he was about to rush out and hit someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到偶像，啲粉絲即刻出衝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 oi2 zoeng6, di1 fan2 si1 zik1 hak1 ceot1 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 见到偶像，粉丝们立刻冲了上去。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing their idol, the fans immediately rushed forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動出衝，諗清楚先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6 ceot1 cung1, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么冲动地冲出去，想清楚再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush out impulsively like that, think it through first.

english_meaning: to speak; to utter words; to say something
explanation_mandarin: 说出话来；发表意见。
explanation_english: To speak; to utter words or express opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常出言傷人，所以冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 seong4 ceot1 jin4 soeng1 jan4, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常说话伤人，所以没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He often says hurtful things, so he doesn't have many friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，你唔好隨便出言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, nei5 m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 ceot1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，你不要随便说话。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, don't just say anything carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出言就引起好多爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 jin4 zau6 ging2 hei2 hou2 do1 zaang1 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一说话就引起很多争议。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he spoke, it caused a lot of controversy.

english_meaning: to speak rudely; to say something disrespectful; to be discourteous in speech
explanation_mandarin: 说话不谦虚，没有礼貌。形容说话傲慢，冒犯别人。
explanation_english: To speak impolitely and without respect. Describes speech that is arrogant and offensive to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢可唔可以唔好咁出言不遜啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 jin4 bat1 seon3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话能不能不要这么出言不逊啊？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please not be so rude in your speech?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對住老闆出言不遜，真係唔想撈喇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 zyu6 lou5 baan2 ceot1 jin4 bat1 seon3, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 lou1 laa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对着老板出言不逊，是真的不想干了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is he really not wanting to work anymore, being so rude to the boss like that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時衝動，對住阿媽出言不遜，之後即刻後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6, deoi3 zyu6 aa3 maa1 ceot1 jin4 bat1 seon3, zi1 hau6 zik1 hak1 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时冲动，对着妈妈出言不逊，之后立刻后悔。
examples.english_sentence: In a moment of impulse, he spoke rudely to his mother and immediately regretted it afterwards.

synonyms: 口出狂言 (hau2 ceot1 kwong4 jin4)

english_meaning: to visit (a foreign country); to go abroad on a diplomatic mission
explanation_mandarin: 指为了外交、考察等目的到国外访问。
explanation_english: To visit a foreign country for diplomatic, research, or other purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月總統會出訪歐洲幾個國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 zung2 tung2 wui5 ceot1 fong2 au1 zau1 gei2 go3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月总统会出访欧洲几个国家。
examples.english_sentence: The president will visit several European countries next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備出訪日本，促進兩地嘅文化交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 fong2 jat6 bun2, cuk1 zeon3 loeng5 dei6 ge3 man4 faa3 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备出访日本，促进两地的文化交流。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing to visit Japan to promote cultural exchange between the two regions.

english_meaning: bad idea, poor suggestion, stupid plan
explanation_mandarin: 指很差的计划或主意，通常带有嘲讽的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a bad idea or plan, often used sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗條橋都係出設㗎，唔好信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naam2 tiu4 kiu2 dou1 hai6 ceot1 sat1 gaa3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想出的主意都是馊主意，别相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: The ideas he comes up with are all bad ideas, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再出設喇，次次都累死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 sat1 laa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 leoi6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再出馊主意了，每次都害死人。
examples.english_sentence: Stop coming up with bad ideas, they always kill people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個出設邊個諗出嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ceot1 sat1 bin1 go3 naam2 ceot1 lei4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个馊主意是谁想出来的？
examples.english_sentence: Who came up with this bad idea?

english_meaning: house call (by a doctor)
explanation_mandarin: 医生到病人家中进行诊疗。
explanation_english: When a doctor visits a patient's home to provide medical consultation and treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆唔舒服，所以要醫生出診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 jiu3 ji1 sang1 ceot1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶不舒服，所以需要医生出诊。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma isn't feeling well, so she needs the doctor to make a house call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家好少醫生會出診㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 ji1 sang1 wui5 ceot1 can2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少医生会出诊了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few doctors make house calls anymore.

english_meaning: to offer advice and suggestions; to contribute ideas; to brainstorm
explanation_mandarin: 指为解决问题或完成目标而提出主意或建议。
explanation_english: To offer plans and suggestions; to come up with strategies or ideas to help solve a problem or achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司遇到問題，大家都應該出謀獻策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jyu6 dou3 man6 tai4, daai6 ga1 dou1 jing1 goi1 ceot1 mau4 hin3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司遇到问题，大家都应该出谋划策。
examples.english_sentence: When the company encounters problems, everyone should offer advice and suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要你出謀獻策，幫手解決呢個難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 ceot1 mau4 hin3 caak3, bong1 sau2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要你出谋划策，帮忙解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need you to offer suggestions and help solve this problem.

english_meaning: to transfer (ownership); to sell (rights, property); to assign
explanation_mandarin: 将自己的所有权或权利转移给他人。
explanation_english: To transfer ownership or rights to another party, typically by selling or assigning them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想出讓佢間舖頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ceot1 joeng6 keoi5 gaan1 pou3 tau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想转让他的店铺。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to sell his shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個專利權已經出讓咗俾另一間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyun1 lei6 kuen4 ji5 ging1 ceot1 joeng6 zo2 bei2 ling6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项专利权已经转让给了另一家公司。
examples.english_sentence: This patent right has already been assigned to another company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定出讓手上嘅股份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 ceot1 joeng6 sau2 soeng6 ge3 gu2 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定转让手上的股份。
examples.english_sentence: We decided to transfer the shares we hold.

english_meaning: to cheat (in an exam)
explanation_mandarin: 考试时使用不正当手段获取答案，作弊。
explanation_english: To cheat in an examination by using unfair or dishonest methods to get answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嘅時候出貓，俾老師捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 ge3 si4 hau6 ceot1 maau1, bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候作弊，被老师抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated during the exam and got caught by the teacher.

english_meaning: Cheat sheet, someone who cheats (especially in an exam); cheater
explanation_mandarin: 指作弊时使用的小抄，或指作弊的人，尤指考试作弊。
explanation_english: Refers to a cheat sheet used during cheating, or a person who cheats, especially in an exam. Can also refer to a literal cheat sheet itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做咁多出貓仔呀，靠自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gam3 do1 ceot1 maau1 zai2 aa3, kaau3 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要作弊太多啊，靠自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat so much, rely on yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣，畀人發現佢藏咗張出貓仔喺袖入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 go2 zan6, bei2 jan4 faat3 hin3 keoi5 cong4 zo2 zoeng1 ceot1 maau1 zai2 hai2 zau6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候，被人发现他藏了一张小抄在袖子里面。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, he was discovered to have hidden a cheat sheet in his sleeve.

english_meaning: to ship goods; to deliver goods; to sell off (stocks or assets)
explanation_mandarin: 指出售或运送货物。在股票或投资领域也指卖出资产。
explanation_english: Refers to selling or delivering goods. In the stock market or investment field, it also means selling off assets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廠今日出咗好多貨去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 cong2 gam1 jat6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 fo3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂今天发了很多货去美国。
examples.english_sentence: This factory shipped a lot of goods to the US today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得個價錢唔錯，所以趁高出貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 go3 gaa3 cin4 m4 co3, so2 ji5 can3 gou1 ceot1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得价格不错，所以趁高价卖出了。
examples.english_sentence: He thought the price was good, so he sold off his assets at a high price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲口罩已經出曬貨，唔使再等喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hau2 zaau3 ji5 ging1 ceot1 saai3 fo3, m4 sai2 zoi3 dang2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些口罩已经全部发货了，不用再等了。
examples.english_sentence: All the masks have been shipped out, no need to wait any longer.

english_meaning: to provide capital; to invest; to fund
explanation_mandarin: 提供资金，进行投资。
explanation_english: To provide capital or money for a project or business; to invest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司計劃出資搞個新嘅創業項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 gai3 waak6 ceot1 zi1 gaau2 go3 san1 ge3 cong3 jip6 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司计划出资搞一个新的创业项目。
examples.english_sentence: Their company plans to invest in a new startup project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多投資者都願意出資支持呢間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 tau4 zi1 ze2 dou1 jyun6 ji3 ceot1 zi1 zi1 chi4 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多投资者都愿意出资支持这家公司。
examples.english_sentence: Many investors are willing to provide capital to support this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個慈善機構需要更多人出資捐款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 jan4 ceot1 zi1 gyun1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个慈善机构需要更多人出资捐款。
examples.english_sentence: This charity needs more people to invest and donate.

english_meaning: to betray; to sell out
explanation_mandarin: 背叛；为了利益而背弃朋友、国家或信仰。
explanation_english: To betray; to sell someone or something out for personal gain or advantage. Often used in the context of betraying a friend, a country, or a belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗錢出賣咗佢嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 cin2 cheut1 maai6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了钱出卖了他的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed his friend for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以出賣公司嘅機密資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 cheut1 maai6 gung1 si1 ge3 gei1 mat6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能出卖公司的机密资料。
examples.english_sentence: You must not betray the company's confidential information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢哋出賣咗我哋嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 cheut1 maai6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他们背叛了我们的信任。
examples.english_sentence: I feel they have betrayed our trust.

english_meaning: to participate in a competition; to compete
explanation_mandarin: 指参加体育比赛或其他类型的竞赛。
explanation_english: Refers to participating in a sports competition or other type of contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜會代表學校出賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 wui5 doi6 biu2 hok6 haau6 ceot1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期会代表学校参加比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He will represent the school in the competition next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次出賽嘅對手好強勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 ceot1 coi3 ge3 deoi3 sau2 hou2 koeng4 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这次参赛的对手很强劲。
examples.english_sentence: Your opponent in this competition is very strong.

english_meaning: to run away from home; to elope; to leave abruptly
explanation_mandarin: 指离家出走，通常是因为与家人或伴侣发生矛盾。
explanation_english: Refers to running away from home, usually due to conflicts with family members or a partner. It can also refer to eloping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同屋企人鬧交，一怒之下出走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 uk1 kei5 jan4 naau6 gaau1, jat1 nou6 zi1 haa6 ceot1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跟家人吵架，一气之下离家出走了。
examples.english_sentence: He argued with his family and ran away from home in a fit of anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個決定出走去外國結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 kyut3 ding6 ceot1 zau2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个决定私奔去国外结婚。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them decided to elope and get married abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住出走可以解決問題，最緊要係溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ceot1 zau2 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着离家出走可以解决问题，最重要的是沟通。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think running away will solve the problem, the most important thing is communication.

synonyms: 離家出走 (lei4 gaa1 ceot1 zau2)

english_meaning: way out, outlet, prospects, a way to make a living
explanation_mandarin: 指出摆脱困境或达到目的的途径，也可以指谋生的方法或前途。
explanation_english: A way out of a difficult situation; a way to make a living; prospects or opportunities for advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家經濟咁差，好難搵出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 naan4 wan2 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，很难找到出路。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now, it's hard to find a way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀多啲書，將來先有出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 do1 di1 syu1, zoeng1 loi4 sin1 jau5 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多读点书，将来才有出路。
examples.english_sentence: Study more, and you'll have better prospects in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗緊點樣為自己搵條出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 gan2 dim2 joeng2 wai4 zi6 gei2 wan2 tiu4 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在想怎样为自己找一条出路。
examples.english_sentence: He's thinking about how to find a way out for himself.

english_meaning: background; origin; family background; social status
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的家庭背景、社会地位或职业起点。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's family background, social status, or professional origin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身好，所以好多嘢都易啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 san1 hou2, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 ji6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身好，所以很多事情都容易些。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a good background, so many things are easier for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小佢，佢雖然出身普通，但係好有能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 seoi1 jin4 ceot1 san1 pou2 tung1, daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，他虽然出身普通，但是很有能力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, although he comes from a common background, he is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅出身影響咗佢嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ceot1 san1 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的出身影响了他的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: His background has influenced his values.

mandarin_meaning: 出动车辆 / 初次载客 (出租车)
english_meaning: To dispatch a vehicle; to start driving (a taxi for the first time of the day); to be dispatched to a scene (emergency services vehicles)
explanation_mandarin: （1）指调度车辆出发，例如消防车、救护车等。（2）特指出租车开始接载乘客营运，通常指一天中第一次载客。
explanation_english: (1) To dispatch a vehicle, such as a fire engine, ambulance, etc. (2) Specifically refers to a taxi starting to pick up passengers for business, usually referring to the first passenger of the day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防局收到警報，即刻出車去救火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 guk6 sau1 dou3 ging2 bou3, zik1 hak1 ceot1 ce1 heoi3 gau3 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防局收到警报，立刻出车去救火。
examples.english_sentence: The fire station received an alarm and immediately dispatched vehicles to put out the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日出車頭一個客就遇到個大豪客，好彩!
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ceot1 ce1 tau4 jat1 go3 haak3 zau6 jyu6 dou3 go3 daai6 hou4 haak3, hou2 coi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天出车第一个客人就遇到一个大款，真幸运!
examples.english_sentence: I met a big spender as my first passenger today, lucky me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋架救護車啱啱出咗車，應該係去處理交通意外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa3 gau3 wu6 ce1 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 ce1, jing1 goi1 hai6 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的救护车刚刚出车了，应该是去处理交通事故。
examples.english_sentence: Their ambulance just left, it should be going to deal with a traffic accident.

english_meaning: to cheat on (one's spouse or partner); to have an affair; to derail (literally or figuratively); to deviate from the norm
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛婚姻或感情关系，与配偶或伴侣以外的人发生性关系或发展亲密关系。也可指列车脱离轨道，或行为偏离常规。
explanation_english: Refers to betraying a marital or romantic relationship by engaging in sexual or intimate relations with someone other than one's spouse or partner. It can also refer to a train leaving the rails (derailing) or behavior deviating from the norm or expected course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老公出軌，佢好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 gung1 ceot1 gwai2, keoi5 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她老公出轨了，她很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: Her husband cheated on her, she is very sad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架火車出軌，好多人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fo2 ce1 ceot1 gwai2, hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火车出轨了，很多人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The train derailed, many people were injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做就出咗軌啦，唔符合公司嘅規定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zau6 ceot1 zo2 gwai2 laa1, m4 fu4 hap6 gung1 si1 ge3 kwai1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做就越轨了，不符合公司的规定。
examples.english_sentence: What you are doing is deviating from the norm, it does not comply with the company's regulations.

english_meaning: to vent, to get something off one's chest, to breathe a sigh of relief after something unpleasant
explanation_mandarin: 指受到委屈或压抑后，通过某种方式发泄出来，从而感到轻松。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of venting frustration or suppression to alleviate negative feelings and feel relieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老闆鬧完，放工去唱K 出返啖氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 baan2 naau6 jyun4, fong3 gung1 heoi3 coeng3 kei1 ceot1 faan1 daam6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被老板骂完，下班去唱K 出气吧。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, let's go to karaoke after work to vent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於考到牌，可以出返啖氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou3 paai4, ho2 ji5 ceot1 faan1 daam6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于考到执照了，可以松一口气了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally got his license, he can breathe a sigh of relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我忍咗佢好耐，今日終於可以出返啖氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan2 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6, gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 faan1 daam6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忍了他很久，今天终于可以出气了。
examples.english_sentence: I've tolerated him for a long time, today I can finally vent.

english_meaning: to debut, to start one's career (especially in entertainment)
explanation_mandarin: 指开始从事某种职业，尤指演艺事业。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of formally beginning a career, especially in the entertainment industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加完選秀節目之後就出道做歌手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 jyun4 syun2 sau3 zit3 muk6 zi1 hau6 zau6 ceot1 dou6 zou6 go1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加完选秀节目之后就出道当歌手了。
examples.english_sentence: After participating in the talent show, he debuted as a singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個組合下個月正式出道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 zou2 hap6 haa6 go3 jyut6 zeng3 sik1 ceot1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的组合下个月正式出道。
examples.english_sentence: Their group will officially debut next month.

english_meaning: to stand for election, to run for office
explanation_mandarin: 指参与选举，竞选某个职位。
explanation_english: To participate in an election, to run for a position in an election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定喺下屆立法會選舉出選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 hai2 haa6 gaai3 lap1 faat3 wui2 syun2 geoi2 ceot1 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定在下届立法会选举中参选。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to run in the next Legislative Council election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多市民都支持佢出選區議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 si5 man4 dou1 zi1 chi4 keoi5 ceot1 syun2 keoi1 ji5 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多市民都支持他参选区议员。
examples.english_sentence: Many citizens support him running for district councillor.

english_meaning: outside; out there
explanation_mandarin: 指某个区域的外部，相对于说话者或特定地点而言。
explanation_english: Refers to the outside of a certain area, relative to the speaker or a specific location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺出邊等緊你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ceot1 bin1 dang2 gan2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在外面等着你。
examples.english_sentence: He's waiting for you outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日出邊好熱啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ceot1 bin1 hou2 jit6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天外面很热啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot outside today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好企喺出邊，入嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 ceot1 bin1, jap6 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别站在外面，进来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand outside, come in.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself; to be embarrassed; to lose face; to disgrace oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指在公开场合或重要场合做出不体面、不得体的行为，导致自己丢脸或尴尬。
explanation_english: To make a fool of oneself or do something embarrassing in public or in an important situation, causing one to lose face or feel awkward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺台上唱歌走音，真係出哂醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 toi4 soeng5 coeng3 go1 zau2 jam1, zan1 hai6 ceot1 saai3 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在台上唱歌跑调了，真是丢尽了脸。
examples.english_sentence: I sang out of tune on stage just now, it was really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺外國人面前講啲唔識嘅英文，會出醜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 di1 m4 sik1 ge3 ying1 man4, wui5 ceot1 cau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在外国人面前说一些不认识的英文，会出丑的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak English you don't understand in front of foreigners, you'll embarrass yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 犯错; 失误; 搞砸
english_meaning: To make a mistake; to blunder; to screw up; to misfire
explanation_mandarin: 指因为疏忽或不小心而犯下错误，导致事情失败或出现问题。也指在言语或行动上出现不妥之处，令人尴尬或不快。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake due to negligence or carelessness, resulting in failure or problems. It can also refer to making an inappropriate statement or action that causes embarrassment or discomfort. Figuratively derived from a gun (銃) misfiring (出 - to exit/come out), implying an unexpected and undesirable outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先開會嗰陣我出咗銃，講錯咗個數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 ngo5 ceot1 zo2 cung1, gong2 co3 zo2 go3 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才开会的时候我犯错了，说错了一个数据。
examples.english_sentence: I made a mistake during the meeting just now and said the wrong data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我出咗銃，好多嘢都唔記得咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ceot1 zo2 cung1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我失误了，很多东西都不记得了。
examples.english_sentence: I screwed up this exam and forgot a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁緊張，就算出咗銃都唔緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, zau6 syun3 ceot1 zo2 cung1 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么紧张，就算犯错了也没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, it doesn't matter if you make a mistake.

english_meaning: to contribute money, to pay (towards something)
explanation_mandarin: 付出金钱；掏钱资助。
explanation_english: To contribute money; to pay or contribute money towards something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個慈善活動，我會出錢支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6, ngo5 wui5 ceot1 cin2 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的慈善活动，我会出钱支持。
examples.english_sentence: I will contribute money to support this charity event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋夾份出錢買份禮物送俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gaap3 fan6 ceot1 cin2 maai5 fan6 lai5 mat6 sung3 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们凑钱买份礼物送给他吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we chip in and buy him a gift?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司出錢贊助呢個比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceot1 cin2 zaan3 zhu6 ni1 go3 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司出钱赞助这个比赛。
examples.english_sentence: This company sponsors this competition by contributing money.

english_meaning: to make a mistake; to have errors; error; fault
explanation_mandarin: 指发生错误，产生偏差或不符合预期。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake, producing a deviation, or not meeting expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦成日出錯，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sing4 jat6 ceot1 co3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑经常出错，搞得我做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: This computer keeps making errors, making it impossible for me to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果份報告有出錯，你一定要同我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 ceot1 co3, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果报告有错误，你一定要告诉我。
examples.english_sentence: If there are any errors in the report, you must tell me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係數據輸入嗰陣出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 hai6 sou3 geoi3 syu1 jap6 go2 zan6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是数据输入的时候出错。
examples.english_sentence: It's possible that an error occurred during data entry.

english_meaning: To appear on camera; to be on screen; to be filmed
explanation_mandarin: 指出现在摄像机镜头前，通常指电视或电影拍摄。
explanation_english: To appear in front of a camera lens, typically in television or film production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次出鏡，好緊張噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 ceot1 geng3, hou2 gan2 zoeng1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次上镜，看起来很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: It was his first time appearing on camera, and he looked very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目好多人想出鏡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 hou2 do1 jan4 soeng2 ceot1 geng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都想在这个节目上镜。
examples.english_sentence: Many people want to appear on camera in this program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想喺電視出鏡，想做明星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 hai2 din6 si6 ceot1 geng3, soeng2 zou6 ming4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想在电视上露面，想当明星。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to appear on TV, wanting to become a celebrity.

english_meaning: to finish a shift; to clock out (from work); to get off work
explanation_mandarin: 指工作时间结束，可以下班离开工作岗位。多用于服务行业，如酒店、夜场等。
explanation_english: Refers to finishing a work shift and being able to leave the workplace. Often used in service industries, such as hotels and nightclubs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日出鐘晏，要OT到十點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ceot1 zung1 aan3, jiu3 OT dou3 sap6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天下班晚，要加班到十点。
examples.english_sentence: I finish my shift late today; I have to work overtime until 10 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做夜場，日日都凌晨先出鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 je6 coeng4, jat6 jat6 dou1 ling4 san4 sin1 ceot1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做夜场，每天都凌晨才下班。
examples.english_sentence: They work in nightclubs, finishing their shifts in the early hours every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我出鐘喇，下次再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ceot1 zung1 laa3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我要下班了，下次再聊。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm finishing my shift, let's chat next time.

english_meaning: to go out; to leave home; to depart
explanation_mandarin: 离开家或某地去往别处。
explanation_english: To leave home or a specific place to go somewhere else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要出門去旅行呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 mun4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要出门去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to leave home for a trip tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出門之前記得熄燈啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 mun4 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 sik1 dang1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出门之前记得关灯啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn off the lights before you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日出門去見工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceot1 mun4 heoi3 gin3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天出门去面试。
examples.english_sentence: He went out for a job interview today.

english_meaning: to go out (of the door/house/place)
explanation_mandarin: 离开家或某个地方，走出门口。
explanation_english: To leave a place, especially one's home, by going out of the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要出門口去旅行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 mun4 hau2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要出门去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going out tomorrow for a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出門口記住鎖門呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 zyu6 so2 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出门记住锁门啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱出咗門口，你遲咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 mun4 hau2, nei5 ci4 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚出门了，你来晚了。
examples.english_sentence: He just went out, you're late.

cantonese: 出門彎彎腰，回家有柴燒
jyutping: ceot1 mun4 waan1 waan1 jiu1, faan1 gaa1 jau5 caai4 siu1
english_meaning: If you are humble and respectful when you go out, you will reap rewards when you return home.
explanation_mandarin: 形容待人谦逊恭敬，在外行事低调，将来就能得到好的回报。
explanation_english: This saying emphasizes the importance of humility and respectfulness. It suggests that by being humble and polite when dealing with others, one will eventually receive positive returns and benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住啊，出門彎彎腰，回家有柴燒，對人好啲冇蝕底嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 aa3, ceot1 mun4 waan1 waan1 jiu1, faan1 gaa1 jau5 caai4 siu1, deoi3 jan4 hou2 di1 mou5 sit6 dai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要记住啊，出门低头，回家有收获，对别人好一点没有坏处的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember, if you are humble when you go out, you will have something to show for it when you come home. Being nice to people won't hurt you.

english_meaning: Every day is like a month when you're out.
explanation_mandarin: 形容出门在外感觉时间过得很快，每一天都像过了一个月一样。因为要面对各种各样的新鲜事物和挑战，所以感觉时间飞逝。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the feeling that time passes very quickly when you are travelling or away from home. It implies that the new experiences and challenges encountered make each day feel like a month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次去歐洲旅行，真係出門無六月，好快就過咗成個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 ceot1 mun4 mou4 luk6 jyut6, hou2 faai3 zau6 gwo3 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次去欧洲旅行，真是出门没六月，很快就过了一个月。
examples.english_sentence: This trip to Europe is really making time fly; a month has passed so quickly.

cantonese: 出門睇木棉，木棉知冷暖
jyutping: ceot1 mun4 tai2 muk6 min4, muk6 min4 zi1 laang5 nyun5
mandarin_meaning: 出门看木棉，木棉知冷暖
english_meaning: Go outside and look at the kapok tree; the kapok knows the cold and warmth.
explanation_mandarin: 这是一句俗语，意思是观察事物的发展变化，可以感知时节的变化。木棉花在春天开花，人们通过观察木棉花开的时间和状态来判断天气的冷暖，从而知道季节的更替。引申为通过观察某些事物，能够了解事物的变化和发展趋势。
explanation_english: This is a proverb that means observing the development and changes of things allows one to perceive the changing of seasons. Kapok flowers bloom in spring, and people observe the time and state of the kapok blossoms to judge the cold and warmth of the weather, thereby knowing the change of seasons. By extension, it means that by observing certain things, one can understand the changes and development trends of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俗語話齋：「出門睇木棉，木棉知冷暖」，只要留意身邊嘅嘢，就自然會知道發生咩事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 jyu5 waa6 zaai1: 「ceot1 mun4 tai2 muk6 min4, muk6 min4 zi1 laang5 nyun5」，zi2 jiu3 lau4 yi3 san1 bin1 ge3 je5, zau6 zi6 jin4 wui5 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 俗话说：「出门看木棉，木棉知冷暖」，只要留意身边的事，自然就会知道发生什么事了。
examples.english_sentence: As the proverb says, "Go outside and look at the kapok tree; the kapok knows the cold and warmth." As long as you pay attention to the things around you, you will naturally know what's happening.

english_meaning: to leave the gate; to start (a race, project, etc.); to get going; to set off
explanation_mandarin: 原指赛马从闸门出发，引申为开始、出发、起步。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a racehorse leaving the starting gate. By extension, it means to start, to set off, to get going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃已經出咗閘，冇得返轉頭㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 ji5 ging1 ceot1 zo2 zaap6, mou5 dak1 faan1 zyun2 tau4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划已经启动了，没法回头了。
examples.english_sentence: The plan has already started, there's no turning back now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司準備出閘上市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 zaap6 soeng5 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司准备上市。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is preparing to go public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業終於出咗閘，蒸蒸日上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip3 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 zo2 zaap6, zing1 zing1 jat6 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业终于起步了，蒸蒸日上。
examples.english_sentence: His career has finally taken off and is flourishing.

english_meaning: to be discharged from hospital
explanation_mandarin: 指病人结束住院治疗，离开医院。
explanation_english: To be released from a hospital after medical treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住咗成個月醫院，終於可以出院啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6 ji1 jyun2, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jyun2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住了整整一个月的医院，终于可以出院了。
examples.english_sentence: He stayed in the hospital for a whole month and can finally be discharged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話阿婆聽日可以出院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 aa3 po4 ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说奶奶明天可以出院。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said grandma can be discharged tomorrow.

english_meaning: always together as a couple; inseparable
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣或夫妻总是出双入对，形影不离。
explanation_english: Describes a couple who are always together, inseparable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個結婚之後，日日都出雙入對，真係羨慕死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat1 dou1 ceot1 soeng1 jap6 deoi3, zan1 hai6 sin6 mou6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个结婚之后，每天都出双入对，真是羡慕死人。
examples.english_sentence: After they got married, they are always together, it's really enviable.

mandarin_meaning: 外面, 出头, 露面
english_meaning: outside, in public, to come forward, to show one's face, (of money) to be used or spent
explanation_mandarin: 表示在外面，公开场合；也指出来解决问题，或者露面；有时也指钱财用出去，花掉。
explanation_english: Refers to being outside, in public; also refers to coming forward to resolve an issue or showing one's face; sometimes it means money being spent or used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企喺出面等我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 hai2 ceot1 min6 dang2 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站在外面等我吧。
examples.english_sentence: You wait for me outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩事我出面搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 si6 ngo5 ceot1 min6 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么事我出面搞定他。
examples.english_sentence: If there's anything, I'll handle it in public/come forward and deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次活動洗咗唔少錢出面啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 wut6 dung6 sai2 zo2 m4 siu2 cin2 ceot1 min6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动花了不少钱啊。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of money was spent for this activity.

english_meaning: to stand out; to rise above others; to achieve success; to get ahead; to become somebody
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会上取得成功，超越他人，有成就。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving success in society, surpassing others, and having accomplishments. It often implies overcoming difficulties to achieve a better position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想出頭，所以好努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 ceot1 tau4, so2 ji5 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想出人头地，所以很努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to make a name for himself, so he studies very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會出頭真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2 ceot1 tau4 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会出人头地真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not easy to get ahead in this society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捱咗咁多年，終於都出頭喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngai4 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, zung1 jyu1 dou1 ceot1 tau4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他熬了这么多年，终于出人头地了！
examples.english_sentence: After suffering for so many years, he has finally made a name for himself!

english_meaning: to set a question/problem; to set exam questions
explanation_mandarin: 指設定問題，尤指設定考試題目。
explanation_english: To set a question, especially for an exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，阿Sir 出啲題目好難㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, a3 sir1 ceot1 di1 tai4 muk6 hou2 naan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，老师出的题目很难的。
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, and the teacher sets very difficult questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我出幾條數學題目？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ceot1 gei2 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 muk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我出几道数学题吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me set a few math questions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅公開試出題方向好奇怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 gung1 hoi1 si3 ceot1 tai4 fong1 hoeng3 hou2 kei4 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的公开考试出题方向很奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: The question setting direction for this year's public exam is very strange.

english_meaning: outstanding; surpassing the rest; preeminent
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的品德、才能超出同类。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose moral character or talent surpasses others of the same kind; outstanding, excellent, preeminent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現出類拔萃，好快就升咗職啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 ceot1 leoi6 bat6 seoi5, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现出类拔萃，很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was outstanding, so he was promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校嘅學生個個都出類拔萃，前途無可限量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 hok6 sang1 go3 go3 dou1 ceot1 leoi6 bat6 seoi5, cin4 tou4 mou4 ho2 him6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校的学生个个都出类拔萃，前途无可限量。
examples.english_sentence: Every student in this school is outstanding, and their future is limitless.

synonyms: 鶴立雞群 (hok6 lap6 gai1 kwan4)

english_meaning: to show off, to seek attention, to try to be in the limelight
explanation_mandarin: 指为了引人注目而故意表现自己，炫耀自己的能力或优势。
explanation_english: To show off or try to attract attention, often by highlighting one's abilities or advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想喺老闆面前出風頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 ceot1 fung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想在老板面前出风头。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to show off in front of the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁出風頭啦，會俾人話你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 fung1 tau4 laa1, wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么爱出风头，会被人说的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off so much, people will talk about you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唱歌嗰陣，好想出風頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1 ge3 zan6, hou2 soeng2 ceot1 fung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上唱歌的时候，很想出风头。
examples.english_sentence: When he was singing on stage, he really wanted to show off.

english_meaning: to take action; to personally handle something; to step forward; to send someone to do something
explanation_mandarin: 亲自行动，或派人去做某事。
explanation_english: To personally take action or to send someone to handle a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁麻煩，都係要你出馬先得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 maa4 faan4, dou1 hai6 jiu3 nei5 ceot1 maa5 sin1 dak1 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么麻烦，还是要你亲自出马才能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so troublesome; we need you to personally handle it to be able to resolve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老細出馬搞掂晒啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 sai3 ceot1 maa5 gaau2 dim6晒啲問題。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的老板亲自出面解决了所有问题。
examples.english_sentence: His boss personally handled and resolved all the problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要阿哥出馬，就知件事有幾大鑊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 aa3 go1 ceot1 maa5, zau6 zi1 gin6 si6 jau5 gei2 daai6 wok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 需要哥哥亲自出面，就知道事情有多严重了。
examples.english_sentence: The fact that elder brother needs to step in personally shows how serious the matter is.

mandarin_meaning: 演出, 表演, 出场
english_meaning: to perform (on stage), to gig, to appear in a show
explanation_mandarin: 指艺人或表演者进行公开演出，通常带有商业性质或宣传目的。
explanation_english: Refers to an artist or performer giving a public performance, usually for commercial or promotional purposes. Often used in the context of music gigs, stage performances, or appearing in shows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜會喺紅館出騷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 wui5 hai2 hung4 gun2 ceot1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期会在香港体育馆演出。
examples.english_sentence: He will be performing at the Hong Kong Coliseum next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗宣傳新碟，佢要周圍出騷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 syun1 cyun4 san1 dip2, keoi5 jiu3 zau1 wai4 ceot1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了宣传新专辑，他要到处演出。
examples.english_sentence: To promote his new album, he has to perform everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去睇佢出騷啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 tai2 keoi5 ceot1 sou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去看他演出吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go see him perform tonight.

english_meaning: to betray; to sell out; to double-cross
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛原来的组织、团体或个人，投靠对方。
explanation_english: Refers to betraying one's original organization, group, or individual and siding with the other party; to sell out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗錢，出骨咗佢嘅兄弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 cin2, ceot1 gwat1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 hing1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了钱，背叛了他的兄弟。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed his brothers for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住出骨我哋，冇好結果㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ceot1 gwat1 ngo5 dei6, mou5 hou2 git3 gwo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着背叛我们，没有好结果的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about betraying us, there will be no good outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我絕對唔會出骨公司嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 ceot1 gwat1 gung1 si1 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我绝对不会出卖公司的利益。
examples.english_sentence: I will absolutely not betray the company's interests.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself; to embarrass oneself; to make a blunder; to make a faux pas
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共场合或他人面前做出不恰当的行为或说错话，导致尴尬或丢脸。
explanation_english: Refers to performing an inappropriate action or saying something wrong in public or in front of others, leading to embarrassment or shame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺老闆面前講錯嘢，真係出晒麻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, zan1 hai6 ceot1晒 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在老板面前说错话，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: I said the wrong thing in front of the boss earlier, I was so embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都出麻，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 maa4, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是出丑，别理他。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes a fool of himself, don't pay attention to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張，就算出麻都唔係世界末日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, zau6 syun3 ceot1 maa4 dou1 m4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么紧张，就算出丑也不是世界末日。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, even if you embarrass yourself, it's not the end of the world.

mandarin_meaning: 显摆, 出风头, 卖弄
english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt; to boast; to be ostentatious; to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人为了引人注目或显示自己的优越而故意炫耀、卖弄自己拥有的东西或能力。通常带有负面含义，表示这个人比较爱炫耀。
explanation_english: Refers to someone intentionally showing off or flaunting their possessions or abilities to attract attention or demonstrate their superiority. It usually has a negative connotation, indicating that the person likes to show off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺朋友圈出龍撩，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 pang4 jau5 hyun1 ceot1 lung4 liu1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在朋友圈显摆，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's showing off on his Moments every day, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗架新車，就成日出龍撩，好似驚人哋唔知咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 san1 ce1, zau6 seng4 jat6 ceot1 lung4 liu1, hou2 ci5 geng1 jan4 dei6 m4 zi1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了辆新车，就整天炫耀，好像怕别人不知道似的。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car and he's showing off all the time, as if he's afraid people won't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁出龍撩啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 lung4 liu1 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么显摆了，低调点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off so much, it's better to be low-key.

mandarin_meaning: 打击, 撞击, 攻击
english_meaning: to hit, to strike, to attack
explanation_mandarin: 撞击；打击；攻打。
explanation_english: To hit, strike, or attack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢击波击得好劲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik1 bo1 gik1 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球打得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He hits the ball very powerfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方击溃咗啲暴徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gik1 kui2 zo2 di1 bou6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方击溃了那些暴徒。
examples.english_sentence: The police defeated those rioters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事对佢嘅打击好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 daa2 gik1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事对他的打击很大。
examples.english_sentence: This event was a big blow to him.

english_meaning: to coax; to cajole; to sweet-talk; to flatter (especially to get someone to do something)
explanation_mandarin: 用好听的话或行动使人高兴，从而达到某种目的。
explanation_english: To please or persuade someone with kind words or actions in order to achieve a certain purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易俾佢凼到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 keoi5 tong3 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易被他哄到啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him coax you so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係識得凼啲女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 sik1 dak1 tong3 di1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只会哄女孩子。
examples.english_sentence: All he knows how to do is coax girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為凼兩句就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 tong3 loeng5 geoi3 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为哄几句就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that you can get away with just a few words of flattery.

mandarin_meaning: 小地方出人才；小池塘里养不出大鱼
english_meaning: A dragon immersed in Taipa (Macau); a great talent wasted in a small place.
explanation_mandarin: 凼仔是澳门的一个地方，蛟龙指有才能的人。比喻有才能的人身处一个没有发展前途的小地方，怀才不遇，无法施展自己的才华。
explanation_english: Taipa is a place in Macau. A dragon (蛟龍) represents a talented person. The idiom describes a talented person being stuck in a small, insignificant place, unable to fully utilize their abilities and potential; a case of wasted talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔，喺呢間細公司做嘢真係凼仔浸蛟龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 zai2, hai2 ni1 gaan1 sai3 gung1 si1 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 daam5 zai2 zam3 gaau1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明能干，在这家小公司工作真是屈才了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart and capable; working in this small company is really a waste of talent.

english_meaning: letter; official letter
explanation_mandarin: 正式的书信，尤指公文。
explanation_english: A formal letter, especially an official document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到律師函啦，要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou2 leot6 si1 haam4 laa1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到律师函了，要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: We received a lawyer's letter; we need to handle it carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府發咗份公函嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 faat3 zo2 fan6 gung1 haam4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府发了一份公函过来。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent an official letter.

english_meaning: letter, mail, correspondence, official document
explanation_mandarin: 正式的信件或公文。
explanation_english: A formal letter, mail, or official document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司寄咗封函件通知我哋加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gei3 zo2 fung1 haam4 gin2 tung1 zi1 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司寄了一封信通知我们加薪。
examples.english_sentence: The company sent a letter to inform us of the salary increase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到銀行寄嚟嘅函件，話我信用卡過期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 ngan4 hong4 gei3 lai4 ge3 haam4 gin2, waa6 ngo5 seon3 jung6 kaat1 gwo3 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了银行寄来的信件，说我的信用卡过期了。
examples.english_sentence: I received a letter from the bank saying my credit card has expired.

english_meaning: correspondence course; distance learning
explanation_mandarin: 通过书信、教材等进行远程教育的方式。
explanation_english: A method of education where students study at home and receive instruction and materials by mail or online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊個函授課程，學緊設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gan2 go3 haam4 sau6 fo3 ching4, hok6 gan2 sat3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在读一个函授课程，学习设计。
examples.english_sentence: He is taking a correspondence course, studying design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多大學都有提供函授學位課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi4 gaa1 hou2 do1 daai6 hok6 dou1 jau5 tai4 gung1 haam4 sau6 hok6 wai2 fo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多大学都有提供函授学位课程。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many universities offer distance learning degree programs.

english_meaning: function (mathematics)
explanation_mandarin: 数学术语，表示一种量随另一种量变化的对应关系。
explanation_english: In mathematics, a function is a relation between a set of inputs and a set of permissible outputs with the property that each input is related to exactly one output.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個函數好難計啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haam4 sou3 hou2 naan4 gai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个函数很难计算啊！
examples.english_sentence: This function is very difficult to calculate!

english_meaning: knife
explanation_mandarin: 一种切割工具，通常由金属制成，具有锋利的刀刃。
explanation_english: A cutting tool with a sharp blade, typically made of metal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把刀好鋒利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 dou1 hou2 fung1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把刀很锋利。
examples.english_sentence: This knife is very sharp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗把刀嚟切生果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 baa2 dou1 lai4 cit3 saang1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一把刀来切水果。
examples.english_sentence: He took a knife to cut the fruit.

english_meaning: small knife, pocket knife
explanation_mandarin: 小型的刀具，通常指方便携带的刀子，例如折叠刀。
explanation_english: A small knife, usually a pocket knife or a small utility knife that is easy to carry around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我袋入邊有把刀仔，方便削生果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 doi2 jap6 bin1 jau5 baa2 dou1 zai2, fong1 bin6 soek3 sang1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的口袋里有一把小刀，方便削水果。
examples.english_sentence: I have a small knife in my pocket, it's convenient for peeling fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日攞住把刀仔喺度玩，好牙煙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lo2 zyu6 baa2 dou1 zai2 hai2 dou6 waan2, hou2 ngaa4 jin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拿着一把小刀玩，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays with a small knife, it's very dangerous.

english_meaning: A small knife trying to saw a big tree; to try to achieve something far beyond one's capabilities; biting off more than you can chew.
explanation_mandarin: 用小刀锯大树。比喻以小的力量去对付强大的势力，结果往往是徒劳无功，或者形容人能力有限，却想做超出能力范围的事情。
explanation_english: This idiom literally means 'using a small knife to saw a big tree'. It is used to describe attempting something far beyond one's capabilities, or trying to achieve a task with insufficient resources or skills. It often implies that the attempt is likely to be unsuccessful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住一個人搞掂成個project，簡直係刀仔鋸大樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu2 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 dim6 sing4 go3 project, gaan2 zik6 hai6 dou1 zai2 geoi3 daai6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想一个人完成整个项目，简直是以小搏大。
examples.english_sentence: He intends to finish the whole project alone, which is definitely biting off more than he can chew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你得幾個人，就想挑戰間大公司，咪搞啦，刀仔鋸大樹啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak1 gei2 go3 jan4, zau6 soeng2 tiu1 zin3 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1, mai5 gaau2 laa1, dou1 zai2 geoi3 daai6 syu6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们只有几个人，就想挑战那家大公司，别闹了，这是以小搏大啊。
examples.english_sentence: You only have a few people and you want to challenge that big company? Don't be silly, that's just trying to achieve the impossible.

english_meaning: glare of swords and sabers, fierce fighting; a scene of bloodshed and violence; fierce rivalry and competition
explanation_mandarin: 形容激烈的打斗场面，也比喻激烈的竞争或斗争。
explanation_english: Describes a scene of fierce fighting, often involving swords and other weapons. It can also be used metaphorically to describe intense competition or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好多刀光劍影嘅場面，好刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 do1 dou1 gwong1 gim3 ying2 ge3 cheung4 min6, hou2 ci3 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影有很多刀光剑影的场面，很刺激。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has many scenes with a glare of swords and sabers, it's very exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場如戰場，間間公司都刀光劍影，爭生意爭得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seung1 cheung4 yu4 jin3 cheung4, gaan1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 dou1 gwong1 gim3 ying2, jaang1 saang1 yi3 jaang1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场如战场，每间公司都刀光剑影，竞争生意竞争得很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The marketplace is like a battlefield, every company is fiercely competitive, vying for business fiercely.

english_meaning: Knife-cut noodles
explanation_mandarin: 一种用刀削出来的面条，是中国北方地区的特色面食。
explanation_english: A type of noodles shaved from a block of dough with a knife. It is a specialty noodle dish from northern China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想試下嗰間餐廳嘅刀削麪，聽講好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dou1 soek3 min6, teng1 gong2 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想试试那家餐厅的刀削面，听说很好吃。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗刀削麪嘅湯底好濃郁，麵質又夠彈牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 dou1 soek3 min6 ge3 tong1 dai2 hou2 nung4 yuk1, min6 zat1 jau6 gau3 daan6 ngaa4.
