examples.english_sentence: I don't know the full story of this matter, so I don't dare to give random opinions.

english_meaning: front; ahead; in front
explanation_mandarin: 指前面的方向或位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the direction or position in front.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前方有意外，塞緊車啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 fong1 jau5 ji3 ngoi6, sak1 gan2 ce1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前方发生意外，堵车很严重。
examples.english_sentence: There's an accident ahead, and the traffic is very congested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向前方邁進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoeng3 cin4 fong1 maai6 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向前方迈进。
examples.english_sentence: We must move forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇清楚前方嘅路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 cing1 co2 cin4 fong1 ge3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看清楚前方的路。
examples.english_sentence: See the road ahead clearly.

english_meaning: the day before yesterday
explanation_mandarin: 指昨天之前的那一天。
explanation_english: Refers to the day before yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我前日已經同佢講咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin4 jat6 ji5 ging1 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前天已经跟他说过了。
examples.english_sentence: I already told him the day before yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前日落咗好大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 jat6 lok6 zo2 hou2 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前天下了很大的雨。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily the day before yesterday.

english_meaning: the night before last, two nights ago
explanation_mandarin: 指昨天的前一天晚上，即两天前的晚上。
explanation_english: Refers to the night before last night, i.e., the evening two days ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我前晚發咗個惡夢，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin4 maan5 faat3 zo2 go3 ok3 mung6, haak3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前天晚上做了个噩梦，吓死我了。
examples.english_sentence: I had a nightmare the night before last, it scared me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我前晚喺屋企睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin4 maan5 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前天晚上在家里看电视。
examples.english_sentence: I watched TV at home the night before last.

english_meaning: prospects, future (outlook), perspective
explanation_mandarin: 指未来的发展方向和可能性；比喻未来发展的前途和希望。
explanation_english: Refers to the future development direction and possibilities; a metaphor for the future prospects and hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅前景好好啊，值得投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 cin4 ging2 hou2 hou2 aa3, zik6 dak1 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的前景很好，值得投资。
examples.english_sentence: The prospects of this company are very good; it's worth investing in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得喺香港嘅前景唔樂觀，所以決定移民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 cin4 ging2 m4 lok6 gun1, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 ji4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得在香港的前景不乐观，所以决定移民。
examples.english_sentence: He feels that the prospects in Hong Kong are not optimistic, so he decided to immigrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對呢個項目嘅前景感到好興奮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 cin4 ging2 gam2 dou3 hou2 hing1 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对这个项目的前景感到很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: They are very excited about the prospects of this project.

english_meaning: previous dynasty; former dynasty; the previous reign
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的朝代。
explanation_english: Refers to a past dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋講嘅係前朝嘅嘢，我哋唔明㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gong2 ge3 hai6 cin4 ciu4 ge3 je5, ngo5 dei6 m4 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说的是前朝的事情，我们不明白的。
examples.english_sentence: They are talking about the matters of a previous dynasty, we don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個博物館入面有好多前朝嘅文物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 cin4 ciu4 ge3 man4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个博物馆里面有很多前朝的文物。
examples.english_sentence: There are many relics from a previous dynasty in this museum.

english_meaning: early stage, preliminary stage, initial phase
explanation_mandarin: 指事情發展的早期階段。
explanation_english: Refers to the early or initial stage of the development of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司前期投資咗好多錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cin4 kei4 tau4 zi1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司前期投资了很多钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The company invested a lot of money in the early stages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前期準備功夫要做足啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 kei4 zeon2 bei6 gung1 fu1 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前期的准备工作要做足一点。
examples.english_sentence: The preliminary preparations need to be done more thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃前期嘅進展都幾順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 cin4 kei4 ge3 zeon3 zin2 dou1 gei2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划前期的进展还算顺利。
examples.english_sentence: The progress of this project in the initial phase has been quite smooth.

mandarin_meaning: 前浪; 先辈; 老一代
english_meaning: The older generation; the previous generation; forerunners; those who came before
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先于时代出现或在某个领域里已经取得成就的前辈。通常指在某个领域有经验和影响力的人，有时也带有一定的戏谑意味，特指那些逐渐跟不上时代发展的人。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to the older generation or predecessors who appeared earlier in time or have already achieved success in a certain field. Usually refers to people with experience and influence in a particular area. Sometimes it has a slightly humorous connotation, especially referring to those who are gradually falling behind the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔成日話我哋啲前浪唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 sang1 zai2 sing4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 dei6 di1 cin4 long6 m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人总是说我们这些老一代不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: Young people always say that we, the older generation, don't know how to be flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前浪有前浪嘅經驗，後浪有後浪嘅創新，各有各嘅價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 long6 jau5 cin4 long6 ge3 ging1 jim6, hau6 long6 jau5 hau6 long6 ge3 cong3 san1, gok3 jau5 gok3 ge3 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老一代有老一代的经验，新一代有新一代的创新，各有各的价值。
examples.english_sentence: The older generation has the experience of the older generation, and the younger generation has the innovation of the younger generation, each has its own value.

english_meaning: unprecedented; unparalleled; never been done before in history
explanation_mandarin: 形容前所未有，历史上没有出现过的事情或人物。通常用来形容某件事情或某个人物的成就非常杰出，超越了以往的所有记录。
explanation_english: Describes something that is unprecedented and has never happened before in history. It is usually used to describe the achievement of something or someone that is outstanding and surpasses all previous records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅科研成果真係前無古人，後無來者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fo1 jin4 sing4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 cin4 mou4 gu2 jan4, hau6 mou4 loi4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的科研成果真是前无古人，后无来者。
examples.english_sentence: His scientific research achievements are truly unprecedented, and there may be no one to follow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影嘅票房紀錄，可以話係前無古人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 ge3 piu3 fong2 gei2 luk6, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 cin4 mou4 gu2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的票房纪录，可以说是前无古人啦。
examples.english_sentence: The box office record of this movie can be said to be unprecedented.

jyutping: cin4 mou4 gu2 jan4, hau6 mou4 loi4 ze2
english_meaning: Unprecedented; unique; unparalleled; never seen before and never to be seen again.
explanation_mandarin: 形容极其杰出，没有人能与之相比，空前绝后。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something extremely outstanding and unparalleled, either in the past or the future; unprecedented and likely to remain so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就真係前無古人，後無來者，冇人可以超越佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 zan1 hai6 cin4 mou4 gu2 jan4, hau6 mou4 loi4 ze2, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 ciu1 jyut6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就真是前无古人，后无来者，没有人可以超越他。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements are truly unprecedented; no one can surpass him.

english_meaning: previous life, former existence
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后转世之前的那一世，前世。
explanation_english: Refers to the life a person lived before their current reincarnation; a previous life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗我前生一定係一隻雀仔，所以而家咁鍾意周圍去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 ngo5 cin4 saang1 jat1 ding6 hai6 jat1 zek3 zoek3 zai2, so2 ji5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 zung1 jiu3 zau1 wai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得我的前世一定是一只小鸟，所以现在这么喜欢到处去。
examples.english_sentence: I think I must have been a bird in my previous life, that's why I love going around so much now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁好人，前生一定積咗好多陰德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hou2 jan4, cin4 saang1 jat1 ding6 zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 jam1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么好的人，前世一定积了很多阴德。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a good person, he must have accumulated a lot of good karma in his previous life.

english_meaning: foresight, forward-looking, prospective
explanation_mandarin: 指对未来有预见性，考虑长远发展。
explanation_english: Refers to having foresight and considering long-term development; looking to the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃好有前瞻性，可以幫我哋公司發展得更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 jau5 cin4 zim1 sing3, ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 faat3 zin2 dak1 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划很有前瞻性，可以帮助我们公司发展得更好。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very forward-looking and can help our company develop better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要用前瞻嘅眼光去睇未來嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 yung6 cin4 zim1 ge3 ngaan5 gwong1 heoi3 tai2 mei6 loi4 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要用前瞻的眼光去看未来的发展。
examples.english_sentence: We need to look at future development with a forward-looking perspective.

english_meaning: criminal record; previous conviction
explanation_mandarin: 指某人以前犯过罪，并被判刑的记录。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's criminal record, specifically previous convictions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有前科，搵工都難啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 cin4 fo1, wan2 gung1 dou1 naan4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有前科，找工作都难一些。
examples.english_sentence: He has a criminal record, making it harder to find a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人查到佢有前科，就覺得佢可疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan2 caa4 dou2 keoi5 jau5 cin4 fo1, zau6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ho2 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察查到他有前科，就觉得他可疑。
examples.english_sentence: The police found out he has a criminal record, so they think he's suspicious.

english_meaning: future; prospects
explanation_mandarin: 指未来的发展和前景。
explanation_english: Refers to the future development and prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你前程錦繡！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 cin4 cing4 gam2 sau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你前途似锦！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a bright future!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放棄咗份工，諗住自己創業，開創自己嘅前程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hei3 zo2 fan6 gung1, lam2 zyu2 zi6 gei2 cong1 jip6, hoi1 cong3 zi6 gei2 ge3 cin4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了工作，打算自己创业，开创自己的前途。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up his job, planning to start his own business and create his own future.

english_meaning: A bright future; a promising future; to have a brilliant future.
explanation_mandarin: 形容前途如锦绣般美好。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a future that is as beautiful and promising as a brocade (a rich, ornamental fabric). It expresses wishes for someone to have a successful and happy future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你畢業之後，前程似錦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, cin4 cing4 ci5 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你毕业之后，前程似锦！
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a bright future after graduation!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔，第日一定前程似錦啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 zai2, dai6 jat6 ding6 hai6 cin4 cing4 ci5 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，将来一定前程似锦。
examples.english_sentence: He is so smart, he will definitely have a bright future.

synonyms: 鵬程萬里 (pung4 cing4 maan6 lei5)

english_meaning: preamplifier
explanation_mandarin: 音响设备中，位于功率放大器之前的放大电路，用于增强信号的电压。
explanation_english: In audio equipment, a preamplifier (preamp) is an electronic amplifier that prepares a small electrical signal for further amplification or processing. It is typically placed before a power amplifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部前級嘅音質好好，配埋啲靚喇叭真係一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 cin4 kap1 ge3 yam1 zat1 hou2 hou2, pui3 maai4 di1 leng3 laa3 baa1 zan1 hai6 yat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款前置放大器的音质非常好，搭配上好的扬声器真是一流。
examples.english_sentence: The sound quality of this preamp is excellent; it's top-notch when paired with good speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想升級我嘅音響系統，你建議我換前級定後級好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sing1 kap1 ngo5 ge3 yam1 hoeng2 hai6 tung2, nei5 gin3 ji5 ngo5 wun6 cin4 kap1 ding6 hau6 kap1 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想升级我的音响系统，你建议我换前置放大器还是功率放大器好？
examples.english_sentence: I want to upgrade my audio system, do you suggest I replace the preamp or the power amp?

english_meaning: prefix
explanation_mandarin: 加在词语前面的部分，用来改变词语的意义。
explanation_english: A morpheme added before the root of a word to modify its meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「超」係一個好常用嘅前綴，好似「超人」咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 siu2 jung6 ge3 cin4 zeoi2, hou2 ci5 "ciu1 jan4" gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “超”是一个很常用的前缀，比如“超人”。
examples.english_sentence: "Super" is a commonly used prefix, like in "superman."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺個英文生字前面加個前綴去改變個意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 go3 jing1 man4 sang1 zi6 cin4 min6 gaa1 go3 cin4 zeoi2 heoi3 goi2 bin3 go3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在英文单词前面加个前缀来改变意思。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to add a prefix to the English word to change its meaning.

english_meaning: front line, frontline
explanation_mandarin: 指战争、冲突、事故等事件的最前方，也引申指工作或服务的第一线。
explanation_english: Refers to the foremost line in a war, conflict, accident, etc., or, by extension, the front line of work or service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生護士喺前線抗疫，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 wu6 si6 hai2 cin4 sin3 kong3 jik6, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生护士在前线抗疫，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors and nurses are fighting the epidemic on the front lines. It's very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺銷售前線，成日要見客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 siu1 sau6 cin4 sin3, seng4 jat6 jiu3 gin3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在销售前线，经常要见客户。
examples.english_sentence: They are on the sales front line and have to meet clients often.

english_meaning: preposition
explanation_mandarin: 表示名词、代词等与句中其他成分关系的词，通常位于名词、代词或名词性短语之前。
explanation_english: A word governing, and usually preceding, a noun or pronoun and expressing a relation to another word or element in the clause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「喺」呢個字係一個常用嘅前置詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 zi6 hai6 jat1 go3 seung4 yung6 ge3 cin4 zi3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “在” 这个字是一个常用的介词。
examples.english_sentence: "Hai2 (喺)" is a commonly used preposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識分邊啲係前置詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 fan1 bin1 di1 hai6 cin4 zi3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不认识哪些是介词。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know how to identify prepositions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學英文嘅時候，前置詞好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 ying1 man2 ge3 si4 hau6, cin4 zi3 ci4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学英语的时候，介词很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Prepositions are very important when learning English.

english_meaning: the former
explanation_mandarin: 指代前面提到的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the thing or person mentioned previously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有兩個仔，前者鍾意打波，後者鍾意睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 loeng5 go3 zai2, cin4 ze2 zung1 ji3 daa2 bo1, hau6 ze2 zung1 ji3 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有两个儿子，前者喜欢打球，后者喜欢看书。
examples.english_sentence: I have two sons, the former likes to play ball, the latter likes to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢兩個方案入面，我比較支持前者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 loeng5 go3 fong1 on3 jap6 min6, ngo5 bei2 gaau3 zi1 chi4 cin4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这两个方案里面，我比较支持前者。
examples.english_sentence: Among these two options, I prefer the former.

english_meaning: the moment before; just before; (lit.) front foot
explanation_mandarin: 指某个动作或事件发生的前一刻，时间间隔很短。
explanation_english: Refers to the moment just before an action or event occurs, with a very short time interval. Often implies something happened immediately before or after something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢前腳走，後腳就落雨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin4 goek3 zau2, hau6 goek3 zau6 lok6 jyu5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他前脚刚走，后脚就下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: He left the moment before it started raining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我前腳返到屋企，佢後腳就打電話嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin4 goek3 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, keoi5 hau6 goek3 zau6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前脚刚回到家，他后脚就打电话来了。
examples.english_sentence: I had just gotten home when he called.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你前腳應承，後腳就唔認數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin4 goek3 ying1 sing4, hau6 goek3 zau6 m4 ying6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你前脚答应，后脚就不认账。
examples.english_sentence: You agreed one moment and then went back on your word the next.

english_meaning: forearm
explanation_mandarin: 指从肘部到腕部的部分。
explanation_english: The part of the human arm extending from the elbow to the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，擦損咗前臂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, caat3 syun2 zo2 cin4 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒了，擦伤了前臂。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and scraped his forearm.

explanation_mandarin: 指在正式活动或表演前进行的预热或准备活动，旨在活跃气氛或让参与者进入状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a warm-up or preparatory activity before a formal event or performance, aimed at energizing the atmosphere or getting participants into the right state of mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚演唱會之前，有個DJ會嚟做前震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 zi1 cin4, jau5 go3 DJ wui2 lai4 zou6 cin4 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚演唱会之前，有个DJ会来做预热。
examples.english_sentence: Before tonight's concert, a DJ will come to do a warm-up set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搞個前震先，等大家投入啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau2 go3 cin4 zan3 sin1, dang2 daai6 gaa1 tau4 jap6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要搞一个预热，让大家更投入一些。
examples.english_sentence: We need to do a warm-up first to get everyone more involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司搞咗個前震活動，等大家認識下新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gaau2 zo2 go3 cin4 zan3 wut6 dung6, dang2 daai6 gaa1 jing6 sik1 haa5 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司搞了一个预热活动，让大家认识一下新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company organized a pre-launch event to let everyone get to know the new products.

english_meaning: front, in front, ahead
explanation_mandarin: 指方位在前方的位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the position at the front.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面好多人啊，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 hou2 do1 jan4 aa3, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面很多人啊，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: There are many people in front, I don't know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士站喺前面㗎，行多幾步就到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zaam6 hai2 cin4 min6 gaa3, haang4 do1 gei2 bou6 zau6 dou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公交车站就在前面，再走几步就到了。
examples.english_sentence: The bus stop is in front, just a few more steps and you'll be there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企喺我前面，遮住晒我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 cin4 min6, ze1 zyu6 saai3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站在我前面，完全挡住我了。
examples.english_sentence: You're standing in front of me, blocking me completely.

english_meaning: front; in front; ahead
explanation_mandarin: 指位置在更前方的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to the place in the front.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前頭有間餐廳，不如我哋去嗰度食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 tau4 jau5 gaan1 caan1 teng1, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 dou6 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面有一家餐厅，不如我们去那里吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's a restaurant ahead, why don't we go there to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺前頭塞住，行入啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 cin4 tau4 sak1 zyu6, haang4 jap6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在前面堵住，往里走一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't block the front, move in a little.

english_meaning: ex-wife
explanation_mandarin: 指前任妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's former wife; ex-wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺個仔面前講佢前頭婆嘅壞話，真係好冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 go3 zai2 min6 cin4 gong2 keoi5 cin4 tau4 po4 ge3 waai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在儿子面前说他前妻的坏话，真的很没品。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks badly about his ex-wife in front of his son. It's really tasteless.

english_meaning: to brake; brake
explanation_mandarin: 停止运作；制动。
explanation_english: To stop or slow down by applying a brake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然間剎車，搞到我嚇咗一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 saat3 che1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hak1 zo2 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然刹车，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He braked suddenly, which gave me a fright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嘅剎車系統壞咗，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 che1 ge3 saat3 che1 hai6 tung2 waai6 zo2, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的刹车系统坏了，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: The car's braking system is broken, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行車嗰陣要留意交通情況，唔好突然剎車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 che1 go2 zan6 jiu3 lau4 yi3 gaau1 tung1 ching4 kwong3, m4 hou2 dat6 jin4 saat3 che1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车的时候要注意交通情况，不要突然刹车。
examples.english_sentence: When driving, pay attention to traffic conditions and avoid sudden braking.

english_meaning: to brake; to stop (a vehicle); to put on the brakes; to curb; to check; to rein in
explanation_mandarin: 使车辆减速或停止运转。
explanation_english: To apply the brakes of a vehicle in order to slow down or stop. Can also be used metaphorically to describe stopping or slowing down a process or trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車太快，要剎車先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 taai3 faai3, jiu3 saat3 ce1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车太快了，得先刹车。
examples.english_sentence: The car is too fast, we have to brake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然之間轉咗軚，搞到我要急剎車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 zi1 gaan1 zyun2 zo2 taai5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jiu3 gap1 saat3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然转弯，害得我得急刹车。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly turned the wheel, causing me to brake suddenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該要剎車，唔好再起咁多樓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 jiu3 saat3 ce1, m4 hou2 zoi3 hei2 gam3 do1 lau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该刹车，别再建这么多楼了。
examples.english_sentence: The government should put on the brakes and stop building so many buildings.

english_meaning: instant, moment, split second
explanation_mandarin: 非常短暂的时间，瞬间。
explanation_english: A very short period of time, an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺剎那之間已經決定咗點樣做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saat3 naa5 zi1 gaan1 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zo2 dim2 joeng2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在一瞬间就已经决定了怎么做了。
examples.english_sentence: We decided what to do in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架車喺剎那間就撞埋嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 ce1 hai2 saat3 naa5 gaan1 zau6 zong6 maai4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆车在瞬间就撞上来了。
examples.english_sentence: That car crashed into us in an instant.

english_meaning: in a split second; in an instant; in the blink of an eye
explanation_mandarin: 极短的时间，表示事情发生得非常快。
explanation_english: A very short period of time, indicating that something happens very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剎那間就跑到終點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saat3 naap6 gaan1 zau6 paau2 dou3 zung1 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他瞬间就跑到终点了。
examples.english_sentence: He ran to the finish line in a split second.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 剎那間，成間屋嘅燈熄晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saat3 naap6 gaan1, seng4 gaan1 uk1 ge3 dang1 sik1晒。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瞬间，整间屋的灯都灭了。
examples.english_sentence: In an instant, all the lights in the whole house went out.

english_meaning: to chop; to mince; to slice; to shred
explanation_mandarin: 用刀或利器将东西切碎、剁碎。
explanation_english: To chop, mince, or slice something with a knife or sharp object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 剒啲薑蓉落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co3 di1 goeng1 jung4 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 切些姜末放进去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Chop some ginger paste and put it in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲菜剒到好碎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 coi3 co3 dou3 hou2 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把菜切得很碎。
examples.english_sentence: He chopped the vegetables very finely.

english_meaning: to hold one's breath; to suppress one's feelings; to stifle
explanation_mandarin: 指忍住呼吸，也指压抑情绪、情感，不敢表达或释放出来。
explanation_english: Literally means to hold one's breath. Figuratively, it means to suppress one's emotions, feelings, or opinions; to stifle oneself and not express what one truly feels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老闆面前剒住度氣，乜都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 cok3 zyu6 dou6 hei3, mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前憋着气，什么都不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: He's holding his breath in front of the boss, afraid to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好剒住度氣啦，有乜唔開心就講出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cok3 zyu6 dou6 hei3 laa1, jau5 mat1 m4 hoi1 sam1 zau6 gong2 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要憋着气了，有什么不开心就说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't suppress your feelings, say it out if you're unhappy about anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 潛水嗰陣要剒住度氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cim4 seoi2 go2 zan6 jiu3 cok3 zyu6 dou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 潜水的时候要憋着气。
examples.english_sentence: You have to hold your breath when diving.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself, to make a spectacle of oneself, to embarrass oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指做出令人感到尴尬或丢脸的行为，使自己或他人感到难堪。
explanation_english: Refers to behaving in a way that is embarrassing or shameful, causing oneself or others to feel awkward or humiliated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺咁多人面前剒樣啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 co3 joeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这么多人面前出丑啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't embarrass yourself in front of so many people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日喺台上唔小心跌親，真係剒晒樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hai2 toi4 soeng2 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 co3 saai3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在台上不小心摔倒了，真是丢尽了脸。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell on stage yesterday, it was truly embarrassing.

english_meaning: to tick; to check; to mark with a checkmark
explanation_mandarin: 用符号（通常是"✓"）表示同意、选中、完成等。
explanation_english: To mark with a checkmark (usually "✓") to indicate agreement, selection, completion, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將啱嘅答案剔返出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 ngaam1 ge3 daap3 aan3 tik1 faan1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把正确的答案勾出来。
examples.english_sentence: Tick the correct answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經喺張清單上面剔晒要買嘅嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hai2 zoeng1 cing1 daan1 soeng6 min6 tik1 saai3 jiu3 maai5 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经在清单上把要买的东西都勾选完了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already ticked off all the things to buy on the list.

english_meaning: to exclude, to remove, to eliminate, to single out (for removal)
explanation_mandarin: 从某个群体或列表中移除。
explanation_english: To remove or exclude something from a group, list, or consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為表現唔好俾公司剔出咗個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 biu2 hin3 m4 hou2 bei2 gung1 si1 tik1 ceot1 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为表现不好被公司从计划中剔除了。
examples.english_sentence: He was excluded from the project by the company because of his poor performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將啲唔合格嘅貨品剔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 m4 hap6 gaak3 ge3 fo3 ban2 tik1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把那些不合格的货品剔除出来。
examples.english_sentence: We need to remove the substandard goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份名單上面有啲人已經唔喺度做嘢，要將佢哋剔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 ming4 daan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 di1 jan4 ji5 ging1 m4 hai2 dou6 zou6 je5, jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 tik1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份名单上有些人已经不在公司工作了，要把他们剔除。
examples.english_sentence: Some people on this list no longer work here, we need to remove them.

english_meaning: within easy reach; handy; convenient
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品在容易拿到或方便使用的地方。
explanation_english: Describes something that is easily accessible or conveniently located.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支筆喺你剔手邊，攞嚟用啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 bat1 hai2 nei5 tik1 sau2 bin1, lo2 lai4 yung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 笔在你手边，拿来用吧。
examples.english_sentence: The pen is within your easy reach, take it and use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我慣咗將啲工具放喺剔手邊嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gwaan3 zo2 zoeng1 di1 gung1 geoi6 fong3 hai2 tik1 sau2 bin1 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我习惯把工具放在顺手的地方。
examples.english_sentence: I'm used to putting the tools in a convenient place.

english_meaning: to procrastinate, to dawdle, to dilly-dally, to drag one's feet
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事拖拉，效率低，磨蹭。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow and inefficient in completing tasks, dragging their feet and procrastinating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再咁剔撻啦，快啲做完佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gam3 tik1 taat3 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再这么拖拉了，快点做完它吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop procrastinating and finish it quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好剔撻，成日都拖到deadline先做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 tik1 taat3, sing4 jat6 dou1 to1 dou3 deadline sin1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很拖拉，总是拖到截止日期才做。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a procrastinator, he always waits until the deadline to do things.

english_meaning: Check mark; Tick mark
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定、确认或完成的符号，形状像一个斜钩。
explanation_english: A mark (✓) used to indicate agreement, completion, or correctness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麻煩你喺嗰個選項度打個剔號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 faan4 nei5 hai2 go2 go3 soeng2 syun2 dou6 daa2 go3 tik1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你那个选项上打个勾号。
examples.english_sentence: Please put a check mark on that option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺每份功課上面都打咗剔號，證明佢批改完啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mui5 fan6 gung1 fo3 soeng6 min6 dou1 daa2 zo2 tik1 hou6, zing3 ming4 keoi5 pai1 gaai2 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在每份作业上都打了对号，证明他批改完了。
examples.english_sentence: He put a check mark on every assignment, which means he finished marking them.

english_meaning: to eliminate; to remove; to reject
explanation_mandarin: 去除不需要的或不合适的。
explanation_english: To remove or eliminate something that is unwanted or unsuitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要剔除所有嘅錯誤數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tik1 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 co3 ng6 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要剔除所有的错误数据。
examples.english_sentence: We need to eliminate all the incorrect data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅名單上面剔除咗我嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ming4 daan1 soeng6 min6 tik1 ceoi4 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的名单上剔除了我的名字。
examples.english_sentence: My name was removed from their list.

english_meaning: to cut open, to dissect; to analyze deeply
explanation_mandarin: 把东西（通常是尸体或动物）切开。
explanation_english: To cut open something, usually a corpse or an animal, for examination or analysis; to dissect; by extension, to analyze something deeply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要剖開佢嘅肚嚟睇下有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu3 pau2 hoi1 keoi5 ge3 tou5 lai4 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生要剖开他的肚子看看有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor needs to cut open his abdomen to see if there's any problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要剖析呢件事嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 pau2 sik1 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 jyun4 yan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要剖析这件事的原因。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyze the cause of this matter.

english_meaning: to analyse, to dissect, to break down (for analysis)
explanation_mandarin: 仔细分析，把事物分解开来，以便了解其各个组成部分和相互关系。
explanation_english: To analyze carefully; to break down something into its component parts in order to understand them and their relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要剖析下件事嘅成因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 pau2 sik1 haa5 gin6 si6 ge3 sing4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要剖析一下这件事的成因。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyse the causes of this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告詳細剖析咗市場嘅現狀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 cheung4 sai3 pau2 sik1 zo2 si5 cheung4 ge3 yin6 chong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告详细剖析了市场的现状。
examples.english_sentence: This report provides a detailed analysis of the current market situation.

english_meaning: to lay bare one's heart; to confess; to reveal one's thoughts or feelings; to unburden oneself
explanation_mandarin: 坦率地表达自己的真实想法或感受，将内心的想法说出来。
explanation_english: To frankly express one's true thoughts or feelings, to speak out one's inner thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭上剖白咗佢嘅犯案動機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 pau2 baak6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 faan6 on3 dung6 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法庭上剖白了他的犯罪动机。
examples.english_sentence: He laid bare his motives for committing the crime in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鼓起勇氣同佢暗戀嘅對象剖白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu2 hei2 yung5 hei3 tung4 keoi5 am3 lyun2 ge3 deoi3 zoeng6 pau2 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她鼓起勇气向她暗恋的对象表白。
examples.english_sentence: She plucked up her courage and confessed her feelings to the person she had a crush on.

english_meaning: to disembowel, to commit seppuku (ritual suicide by disembowelment), to perform a caesarean section (historical meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为切开腹部。在古代，特指日本武士的切腹自杀。现在也可以指剖腹产（医学上更常用“剖腹生產”）。
explanation_english: Literally means to cut open the abdomen. Historically refers to seppuku, a ritual suicide by disembowelment practiced by Japanese samurai. Can also refer to a cesarean section (though "剖腹生產" is more commonly used in medical contexts).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺部戲入面要演一個剖腹自殺嘅武士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou6 hei3 jap6 min6 jiu3 yin2 jat1 go3 pau2 fuk1 zi6 saat3 ge3 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影里要演一个剖腹自杀的武士。
examples.english_sentence: He has to play a samurai who commits seppuku in the movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅剖腹產風險好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 pau2 fuk1 saan2 fung1 him2 hou2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的剖腹产风险很高。

english_meaning: cesarean section; C-section
explanation_mandarin: 通过手术切开腹部和子宫来分娩婴儿。
explanation_english: A surgical procedure in which a baby is delivered through an incision in the mother's abdomen and uterus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為胎位唔正，所以要剖腹生產。

examples.english_sentence: Because the baby was in an abnormal position, she needed to have a C-section.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家越來越多人揀剖腹生產，覺得冇咁痛。

examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, more and more people are choosing to have C-sections, feeling that it's less painful.

english_meaning: to cut open, to dissect, to split open
explanation_mandarin: 用刀或其他利器将物体切开。
explanation_english: To cut something open, often with a knife or sharp object; to dissect or split something open.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個西瓜剖開一半。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 sai1 gwaa1 pau2 hoi1 jat1 bun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把西瓜剖开一半。
examples.english_sentence: He cut the watermelon in half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要將隻青蛙剖開嚟做研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 yiu3 zoeng1 zek3 ceng1 waa1 pau2 hoi1 lai4 zou6 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生要将青蛙剖开来进行研究。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor needs to dissect the frog for research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好剖開個橙睇下入面有冇爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 pau2 hoi1 go3 caang2 tai2 haa5 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好把橙子切开看看里面有没有坏。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better cut open the orange and see if it's rotten inside.

english_meaning: just; recently; only just
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间不久以前。类似普通话的“刚刚”。
explanation_english: Indicates something happened a short time ago. Similar to the Mandarin word "刚刚".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱食完飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 sik6 jyun4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚吃完饭。
examples.english_sentence: I just finished eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剛到咗香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong1 dou3 zo2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚到了香港。
examples.english_sentence: He just arrived in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: just now, a moment ago, just, recently
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间很短，就在不久之前。也可作形容词，表示正好，恰好。
explanation_english: Indicates a short time ago, just a moment ago. It can also be used as an adjective meaning 'just right', 'exactly'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱食咗飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sik6 zo2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚吃了饭。
examples.english_sentence: I just ate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚走了。
examples.english_sentence: He just left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個尺寸啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 chi2 cyun3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个尺寸刚刚好。
examples.english_sentence: This size is just right.

mandarin_meaning: 刚好; 恰好; 碰巧
english_meaning: just now; just; exactly; precisely; happen to; coincidentally
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或程度的正好；也表示事情发生得巧合。作副词时，可以表示时间上的“刚刚”或程度上的“恰好”。作形容词时，表示“正合适”。
explanation_english: Indicates exactness in time or degree; also indicates a coincidence in events. As an adverb, it can mean 'just now' or 'exactly'. As an adjective, it means 'just right'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我剛啱落樓就撞到佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gong1 ngaam1 lok6 lau2 zau6 zong6 dou2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚下楼就碰到他了。
examples.english_sentence: I just came downstairs and bumped into him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啱啱好，唔會太大，又唔會太細，剛啱啱我著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2, m4 wui5 taai3 daai6, jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 sai3, gong1 ngaam1 ngaam1 ngo5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服正好，不会太大，也不会太小，正合我穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits perfectly, not too big, not too small, just right for me to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋剛啱諗住出去食飯，你要唔要一齊去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gong1 ngaam1 nam2 zyu6 cheut1 heoi3 sik6 faan6, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jat1 cai4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正打算出去吃饭，你要不要一起去？
examples.english_sentence: We were just thinking of going out for dinner, do you want to come with us?

english_meaning: just right, exactly, happen to, by chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间、数量、程度等恰到好处，不多也不少。也表示碰巧、正好。
explanation_english: Indicates that the time, quantity, or degree is just right, neither too much nor too little. Can also mean "happen to" or "by chance."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱出門口，就剛好撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 ceot1 mun4 hau2, zau6 gong1 hou2 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚出门，就正好碰到他。
examples.english_sentence: I just went out the door, and happened to run into him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅size對你嚟講，剛好啱著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 size deoi3 nei5 lei4 gong2, gong1 hou2 ngaam1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的尺寸对你来说，正好合适。
examples.english_sentence: The size of this shirt is just right for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我地去到嘅時候，剛好趕得切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 dou3 ge3 si4 hau2, gong1 hou2 gon2 dak1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们到达的时候，刚好赶得上。
examples.english_sentence: When we arrived, we made it just in time.

english_meaning: firm and unyielding; resolute; strong and unbending
explanation_mandarin: 形容性格坚定，不屈服。
explanation_english: Describing a personality that is firm, resolute, and unyielding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格好剛強，唔會輕易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 hou2 gong1 koeng4, m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很刚强，不会轻易放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very resolute personality, he won't give up easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺逆境入面表現得好剛強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jik6 ging2 jap6 min6 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 gong1 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在逆境中表现得很刚强。
examples.english_sentence: He showed great resilience in adversity.

english_meaning: obstinate and self-opinionated; stubbornly self-willed; unwilling to take advice
explanation_mandarin: 形容人固执己见，不接受别人的意见。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is stubborn, self-opinionated, and unwilling to accept advice from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好剛愎自用，根本聽唔入人哋嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 yan4 hou2 gong1 bik1 zi6 yung6, gan1 bun2 ting1 m4 yap6 yan4 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人非常刚愎自用，根本听不进去别人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very obstinate and self-opinionated person, he simply doesn't listen to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細咁剛愎自用，難怪公司嘅業績咁差。

examples.english_sentence: The boss is so obstinate and self-willed, no wonder the company's performance is so bad.

english_meaning: just now; a moment ago
explanation_mandarin: 指说话前不久的时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a short time before speaking.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在街上看到你了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw you on the street just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剛才打電話嚟，話遲啲嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong1 coi4 daa2 din6 waa2 lei4, waa6 ci4 di1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才打电话来说晚点来。
examples.english_sentence: He called just now saying he'll come later.

english_meaning: Congo (country)
explanation_mandarin: 非洲中部的一个国家，即刚果共和国（Republic of the Congo）或刚果民主共和国（Democratic Republic of the Congo）。通常指的是后者。
explanation_english: A country in Central Africa, referring to either the Republic of the Congo or the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Usually referring to the latter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗剛果做嘢。

examples.english_sentence: Do you know what the capital of Congo is?

english_meaning: resolute, firm, steadfast, unyielding
explanation_mandarin: 形容性格坚强、果断，意志坚定。
explanation_english: Describing someone's character as strong, decisive, and determined in will.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 gong1 ngai6, jyu6 dou2 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很刚毅，遇到困难都不会轻易放弃。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is very resolute; he will not easily give up even when encountering difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功，除咗努力之外，仲要有剛毅嘅決心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1, ceoi4 zo2 nou5 lik6 zi1 ngoi6, zung6 jiu3 jau5 gong1 ngai6 ge3 kyut3 sam1.

examples.english_sentence: To succeed, in addition to hard work, you also need a resolute determination.

explanation_english: To remove the outer layer, skin, or shell.

examples.english_sentence: Kids often like to run around naked.

english_meaning: to exploit; exploitation
explanation_mandarin: 指榨取别人的劳动成果，使对方受到损害。也指利用职权或优势压迫他人，获取不正当利益。
explanation_english: To exploit or take unfair advantage of someone, especially by taking their work or profit without giving them adequate compensation. It can also refer to using power or advantage to oppress others and obtain illegitimate benefits.

examples.english_sentence: They exploit the workers; the wages are low and the working hours are long.

examples.english_sentence: The exploitation at this company is very serious; many people want to leave.

examples.english_sentence: The government cannot deprive citizens of their freedom of speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅財產俾人剝奪晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 coi4 saan2 bei2 jan4 bok1 dyut6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的财产被人剥夺了。
examples.english_sentence: Their property was expropriated.

english_meaning: miser; skinflint; stingy person
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常吝啬，一毛不拔的人。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一隻剝皮牛，一蚊都唔捨得使。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个吝啬鬼，一分钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a miser; he can't bear to spend even a single dollar.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy. Do you want to be a skinflint?

english_meaning: to be a spectator; to watch from the sidelines; to be a passive observer
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在一旁观看，不参与其中，类似看热闹。常用在事情发生时，有些人只在旁边观看，不提供帮助。
explanation_english: A metaphor for watching from the sidelines without participating, like being a spectator. It's often used when things are happening and some people just watch without offering help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔好淨係識得剝花生，快啲嚟幫手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 bok1 faa1 sang1, faai3 di1 lai4 bong1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们不要只是在那里袖手旁观，快点来帮忙啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand there as spectators, come and help!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度剝花生，咩都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 bok1 faa1 sang1, me1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是站在旁边看热闹，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He's always just watching from the sidelines and doing nothing.

english_meaning: to peel off; to flake off; to come off in flakes
explanation_mandarin: 指物体表面一层层地脱落。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of a surface layer peeling off or flaking away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲油漆開始剝落，睇嚟要重新油過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jau4 cat1 hoi1 chi2 mok1 lok6, tai2 lai4 jiu1 cung4 san1 jau4 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 油漆开始剥落了，看来要重新油一遍了。
examples.english_sentence: The paint is starting to peel off; it looks like we need to repaint it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊面嘅死皮剝落，搽啲潤膚露會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 min6 ge3 sei2 pei4 mok1 lok6, caa1 di1 jeon6 fu1 lou6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脸上的死皮脱落，擦点润肤露会好一些。
examples.english_sentence: The dead skin on his face is peeling off; applying some moisturizer would be better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊樓外牆啲石屎剝落得好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 lau2 ngoi6 cheung4 di1 sek6 sai2 mok1 lok6 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧楼外墙的水泥剥落得很严重。
examples.english_sentence: The concrete on the exterior wall of the old building is peeling off quite badly.

english_meaning: to peel; to shell; to take off (clothes)
explanation_mandarin: 去掉外面的皮或壳；脱掉衣服。
explanation_english: To remove the outer skin or shell; to take off clothes.

examples.english_sentence: Help me peel an egg.

explanation_english: Refers to the portion of something that remains after a part has been used or taken.

examples.english_sentence: I can't finish it all; there's still a lot left.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要浪费东西，剩饭剩菜都要吃完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste things; you need to finish all the leftover rice and dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到咗年尾，公司仲剩好多budget未用。

examples.english_sentence: By the end of the year, the company still has a lot of budget left unused.

english_meaning: to remain, to be left over

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要剪輯條片，趕住出街。
