examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作用就是帮助处理文书工作。
examples.english_sentence: His function is to help with paperwork.

mandarin_meaning: 功绩, 功劳, 成就
english_meaning: meritorious service, achievement, accomplishment, credit
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作或事业上建立的功劳和成绩。
explanation_english: Refers to the meritorious service, achievements, and accomplishments made in work or career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司做咗咁多年，建立咗好多功績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, gin3 lap6 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司工作这么多年，建立了很多功绩。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in that company for so many years and has made many achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅成功，主要歸功於佢嘅功績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1, zyu2 jiu3 gwai1 gung1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的成功，主要归功于他的功绩。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this project is mainly attributed to his achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功績值得我哋所有人學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zik1 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 so2 jau5 jan4 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功绩值得我们所有人学习。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements are worth learning from for all of us.

english_meaning: function, feature, capability
explanation_mandarin: 事物所具有的用途或效能。
explanation_english: The function or capability of something; the specific purpose for which something is used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅功能幾好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 gung1 nang4 gei2 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话的功能挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has some good features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個App嘅主要功能係乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 App ge3 zyu2 jiu3 gung1 nang4 hai6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个App的主要功能是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What is the main function of this App?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器嘅功能好多，但係我唔識用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 ge3 gung1 nang4 hou2 do1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 sik1 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的功能很多，但是我不会用。
examples.english_sentence: This machine has a lot of functions, but I don't know how to use it.

english_meaning: Functional constituency
explanation_mandarin: 香港立法会选举中的一种选举方式，选民不是按地域划分的，而是按职业或特定团体划分的。
explanation_english: A type of electoral division in Hong Kong's Legislative Council elections where voters are drawn from functional constituencies representing various occupational groups or designated bodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 功能組別嘅選舉制度一直都備受爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 nang4 zou2 bit6 ge3 syun2 geoi2 zai3 dou6 jat1 zik6 dou1 bei6 sau6 zang1 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 功能组别的选举制度一直备受争议。
examples.english_sentence: The functional constituency electoral system has always been controversial.

english_meaning: meritorious official; person who has rendered outstanding service; one who has rendered great service
explanation_mandarin: 指为国家或事业立下大功的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who has made great contributions to a country or enterprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對公司嚟講，絕對係一個功臣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 lai4 gong2, zyut6 deoi3 hai6 jat1 go3 gung1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于公司来说，他绝对是一个功臣。
examples.english_sentence: As far as the company is concerned, he is definitely a meritorious person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫球隊贏咗咁多場波，真係球隊嘅功臣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 kau4 deui2 wing4 zo2 gam3 do1 coeng4 bo1, zan1 hai6 kau4 deui2 ge3 gung1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮助球队赢了这么多场比赛，真是球队的功臣。
examples.english_sentence: He helped the team win so many games, he is really a hero of the team.

mandarin_meaning: 功亏一篑 (gōng kuī yī kuì)
english_meaning: To fail within an inch of success; to fall short of success; to lose all one's previous effort at the last stage.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做事情只差最后一点没能完成，结果以前的努力都白费了。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where one's efforts are ruined at the last stage, right before achieving success, making all previous work futile.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyun2 bei6 zo2 gam3 noi6, jyu4 gwo2 zeoi3 hau6 zou6 m4 sing4, mai1 gung1 kwai1 jat1 gwai6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们准备了这么久，如果最后没成功，那不就功亏一篑了吗。
examples.english_sentence: We've been preparing for so long. If we don't succeed in the end, won't all our efforts be in vain?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差少少就搞掂，千祈唔好放棄，唔係就功虧一簣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 siu2 siu2 zau6 gaau2 dim6, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3, m4 hai6 zau6 gung1 kwai1 jat1 gwai6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 差一点就完成了，千万不要放弃，不然就功亏一篑了。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a little bit more to finish. Don't give up, or it will all be for nothing.

synonyms: 前功盡廢 (cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3)

english_meaning: homework, schoolwork, assignment; task, work
explanation_mandarin: 指学生为了巩固课堂知识而做的家庭作业；也指需要完成的任务或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to homework or schoolwork assigned to students to reinforce classroom learning; can also refer to tasks or work that needs to be completed.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 gung1 fo3 jiu3 zou6 aa3.

examples.english_sentence: I have a lot of homework to do today.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不喜欢做作业，整天想着玩。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like doing homework, he's always thinking about playing.

english_meaning: merits and demerits; achievements and mistakes
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或事物所做的贡献和错误，优点和缺点。
explanation_english: Refers to the merits and demerits, contributions and mistakes, advantages and disadvantages of a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要客觀咁衡量佢嘅功過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haak3 gun1 gam2 hang4 loeng4 keoi5 ge3 gung1 gwo3.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己的功劳，不提自己的过错。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然幫公司攞到單大生意，但係之前又犯咗啲錯，所以最後都係功過相抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 bong1 gung1 si1 lo2 dou2 daai6 daan1 seng1 ji3, daan6 hai6 zi1 cin4 jau6 faan6 zo2 di1 co3, so2 ji5 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 gung1 gwo3 soeng1 dai2.

examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ci4 dou3 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin6 hou2 hou2, git3 gwo2 gung1 gwo3 soeng1 dai2 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: Although he was late, his performance was very good, so in the end, the merits and demerits offset each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁叻，好快就會功高蓋主啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么出色，很快就会功高震主了。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想涨工资。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢加入咗間公司無耐。

examples.english_sentence: The price of apartments has increased so much that I can't afford to buy one!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 油價嘅加幅令到好多人唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 gaa3 ge3 gaa1 fuk1 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 油价的增长幅度让很多人不开心。
examples.english_sentence: The increase in fuel prices makes many people unhappy.

english_meaning: to add extra rice (to a meal); to increase the amount (of food, usually rice)
explanation_mandarin: 在吃饭的时候，要求增加饭的分量。通常指在茶餐厅或饭馆吃饭时要求多加一份米饭。
explanation_english: To request an additional portion of rice when eating. Commonly used in the context of dining in a cha chaan teng (Hong Kong-style cafe) or restaurant when asking for more rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，加底呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, gaa1 dai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，加一份饭！
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, add extra rice, please!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好肚餓，要加底先夠食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 tou5 ngo6, jiu3 gaa1 dai2 sin1 gau3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很饿，要加饭才够吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very hungry today, I need extra rice to have enough to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳加底要加錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gaa1 dai2 jiu3 gaa1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅加饭是要加钱的。
examples.english_sentence: At this restaurant, you have to pay extra for extra rice.

english_meaning: to strengthen; to reinforce; to enhance; to intensify
explanation_mandarin: 使变得更坚固、更有效。
explanation_english: To make something stronger, more effective, or more intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要加強保安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 bou2 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要加强保安。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strengthen security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該加強你嘅英文能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 goi1 gaa1 koeng4 nei5 ge3 jing1 man4 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该加强你的英语能力。
examples.english_sentence: You should enhance your English skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定加強對違規行為嘅懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 koeng4 deoi3 wai4 gwai1 hang4 wai4 ge3 cing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定加强对违规行为的惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to intensify the penalties for violations.

english_meaning: to accelerate; to speed up; to quicken
explanation_mandarin: 使速度或进度更快。
explanation_english: To increase the speed or pace of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要加快進度，先可以準時完成任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 faai3 zeon3 dou6, sin1 ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 waan4 sing4 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要加快进度，才可以准时完成任务。
examples.english_sentence: We need to speed up the progress in order to complete the task on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗應付考試，佢決定加快溫習嘅速度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ying3 fu6 haau2 si3, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 faai3 wan1 zaap6 ge3 suk1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了应付考试，他决定加快复习的速度。
examples.english_sentence: In order to prepare for the exam, he decided to speed up the pace of his revision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以加快啲手腳呀？我哋趕時間呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaa1 faai3 di1 sau2 goek3 aa3? ngo5 dei6 gon2 si4 gaan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以加快点手脚吗？我们赶时间啊！
examples.english_sentence: Can you hurry up a bit? We're in a hurry!

english_meaning: to raise interest rates; interest rate hike
explanation_mandarin: 提高利率。银行或金融机构上调贷款利率或存款利率。
explanation_english: To increase interest rates. Refers to a central bank or financial institution increasing the rate charged on loans or paid on deposits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國聯儲局又話可能加息，真係令人擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 lyun4 syu5 guk6 jau6 waa6 ho2 nang4 gaa1 sik1, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国联邦储备局又说可能加息，真让人担心。
examples.english_sentence: The Federal Reserve said they might raise interest rates again, it's really worrying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加息會影響樓市㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 sik1 wui5 ying2 hoeng2 lau4 si5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加息会影响房地产市场的。
examples.english_sentence: Raising interest rates will affect the housing market.

english_meaning: to put in extra effort, to give it your all, to step it up
explanation_mandarin: 尽力而为，更加努力。
explanation_english: To exert more effort, to work harder and try your best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就嚟喇，你要加把勁溫書啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zau6 lei4 laa3, nei5 jiu3 gaa1 baa2 ging6 wan1 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试快到了，你要加把劲复习啊！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming up soon, you need to put in extra effort to study!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差唔多搞掂喇，大家加把勁，快啲完成佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 m4 do1 gaau2 dim6 laa3, daai6 gaa1 gaa1 baa2 ging6, faai3 di1 waan4 sing4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 差不多完成了，大家加把劲，快点完成它。
examples.english_sentence: It's almost done, everyone step it up and finish it quickly.

english_meaning: to put in a word, to chime in, to help out (by offering advice or support), to add one's voice (to an opinion)
explanation_mandarin: 指在别人谈话的时候，插一句嘴；或者指在别人做事情的时候，给予口头上的支持或帮助。
explanation_english: Refers to interjecting in a conversation; or offering verbal support or assistance when others are doing something. It usually implies adding one's voice to support an opinion or helping through advice/encouragement rather than physical labor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拗緊交，你唔好加把口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aau3 gan2 gaau1, nei5 m4 hou2 gaa1 baa2 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在吵架，你最好不要插嘴了。
examples.english_sentence: They're arguing, you better not chime in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如你都加把口勸下佢啦，佢好固執㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 nei5 dou1 gaa1 baa2 hau2 hyun3 haa5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 gu3 zap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如你也劝劝他吧，他很固执的。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't you also put in a word and persuade him, he's very stubborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭話要裁員，不如我哋一齊加把口反對啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 waa6 jiu3 caai4 jyun4, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gaa1 baa2 hau2 faan2 deoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要裁员，不如我们一起反对吧。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he wants to lay off employees, why don't we all speak out against it together?

english_meaning: to chime in; to butt in; to interrupt (someone speaking)
explanation_mandarin: 指别人在说话或讨论时，强行加入谈话，打断别人。
explanation_english: Refers to interrupting someone who is speaking or having a discussion, forcibly joining the conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋傾緊嘢，唔好加把咀啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 king1 gan2 je5, m4 hou2 gaa1 baa2 zeoi2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们在谈事情，别插嘴了！
examples.english_sentence: You guys are talking, don't butt in!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，佢成日加把咀，搞到討論好難進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaa1 baa2 zeoi2, gaau2 dou3 tau2 leon6 hou2 naan4 zeon3 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他总是插嘴，搞得讨论很难进行。
examples.english_sentence: During meetings, he always chimes in, making it difficult for the discussion to proceed.

english_meaning: To interrupt; to chime in; to put in one's two cents; to be nosy; to meddle.
explanation_mandarin: 指在别人说话或讨论时插话，通常带有不请自来或多余的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to interrupting someone's conversation or discussion, often implying that the interruption is unsolicited or unnecessary. Can also imply being nosy or meddling in other people's affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋傾緊嘢，唔好加把嘴啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 king1 gan2 je5, m4 hou2 gaa1 baa2 zeoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们在聊天，不要插嘴了。
examples.english_sentence: You guys are talking, don't interrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事同你無關，你唔好加把嘴啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 tung4 nei5 mou4 gwaan1, nei5 m4 hou2 gaa1 baa2 zeoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事与你无关，你不要多嘴了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has nothing to do with you, don't meddle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最鍾意加把嘴，乜都想講幾句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 gaa1 baa2 zeoi2, mat1 dou1 soeng2 gong2 gei2 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最喜欢插嘴，什么都想说几句。
examples.english_sentence: He loves to chime in; he wants to say something about everything.

english_meaning: Canada
explanation_mandarin: 北美洲国家，即加拿大。
explanation_english: A country in North America, Canada.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候喺加拿大住過幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 zyu6 gwo3 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候在加拿大住过几年。
examples.english_sentence: I lived in Canada for a few years when I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家移民去咗加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 ji4 man4 heoi3 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家移民去了加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family immigrated to Canada.

english_meaning: blessing; consecration; to bless; to invoke divine power
explanation_mandarin: 原为佛教用语，指佛、菩萨等以慈悲心及愿力，注入力量于众生或物品，使其得到保护和加福。现也泛指得到某种形式的祝福或力量。
explanation_english: Originally a Buddhist term referring to the blessing or consecration by a Buddha or Bodhisattva, infusing power into beings or objects to protect and bring good fortune. Now it's also used more generally to mean receiving some form of blessing or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望師傅加持一下，保祐我考試順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 si1 fu2 gaa1 ci4 jat1 haa5, bou2 jau6 ngo5 haau2 si5 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望师傅加持一下，保佑我考试顺利。
examples.english_sentence: I hope the master will bless me so that I pass the exam smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個護身符經過高僧加持，據說好靈驗㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wu6 san1 fu4 ging1 gwo3 gou1 sang1 gaa1 ci4, geoi3 syut3 hou2 ling4 jim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个护身符经过高僧加持，据说很灵验。
examples.english_sentence: This amulet has been blessed by a high monk and is said to be very effective.

english_meaning: second mortgage, remortgage (to borrow more money)
explanation_mandarin: 将已经抵押的房产再次抵押以获得贷款。通常是因为需要更多资金，而首次抵押贷款的额度已经用完。
explanation_english: To take out a second mortgage on a property that is already mortgaged. This is usually done to borrow more money when the initial mortgage amount is insufficient or already used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想加按層樓嚟做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaa1 ngon3 cang4 lau2 lai4 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把房子二次抵押来做生意。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to take out a second mortgage on his apartment to start a business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都頂唔順要加按物業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6 jiu3 gaa1 ngon3 mat6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都承受不住需要二次抵押房产。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the poor economy, many people can't cope and need to remortgage their properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行對加按嘅審批都好嚴格㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 hong4 deoi3 gaa1 ngon3 ge3 sam2 pai1 dou1 hou2 jim4 gaak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行对于二次抵押的审批都很严格的。
examples.english_sentence: Banks are very strict with the approval of second mortgages.

english_meaning: to add charges, to lay additional charges
explanation_mandarin: 指在已经提出的指控之外，再增加其他的指控。
explanation_english: To add additional charges or indictments to those already filed against a defendant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為涉嫌詐騙，警方決定加控佢洗黑錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sip3 jim4 zaa3 pin3, ging2 fong1 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 hung3 keoi5 sai2 hak1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为涉嫌诈骗，警方决定加控他洗钱。
examples.english_sentence: Because he's suspected of fraud, the police decided to add a charge of money laundering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 被告已經俾人控告咗幾項罪名，檢察官仲想加控佢一項。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei6 gou3 ji5 ging1 bei2 jan4 hung3 gou3 zo2 gei2 hong6 zeoi6 ming4, gim2 caat3 gun1 zung6 soeng2 gaa1 hung3 keoi5 jat1 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被告已经被指控了几项罪名，检察官还想再加控他一项。
examples.english_sentence: The defendant has already been charged with several offences, and the prosecutor wants to add another charge.

english_meaning: to insert, to add in, to interject
explanation_mandarin: 在原本的事物中加入新的东西，通常是不期而至的，或者额外的。
explanation_english: To insert or add something into an existing thing, often unexpectedly or as an addition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋開會嘅時候，佢突然加插咗幾句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaa1 caap3 zo2 gei2 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们开会的时候，他突然插了几句话。
examples.english_sentence: When we were having a meeting, he suddenly interjected a few sentences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演喺劇入面加插咗一啲搞笑嘅情節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jik6 hai2 kek6 jap6 min6 gaa1 caap3 zo2 jat1 di1 gau2 siu3 ge3 cing4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 导演在剧里插入了一些搞笑的情节。
examples.english_sentence: The director added some humorous scenes to the drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日加插英文，好鬼扮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 gaa1 caap3 ying1 man4, hou2 gwai2 baan3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是夹杂英文，很装模作样。
examples.english_sentence: He always interjects English words when he speaks, which is very pretentious.

mandarin_meaning: 加额外的东西；添加不正当的内容
english_meaning: to add extra ingredients; to add something extra (often negative or illicit); to spice things up; to embellish; to adulterate
explanation_mandarin: 原指在食物中加入额外的配料，使其更加丰富或美味。 引申义指在原本的事物中加入额外的（通常是不正当的）内容，例如八卦新闻中添油加醋，或者在食品中非法添加成分。
explanation_english: Originally refers to adding extra ingredients to food to make it richer or more delicious. By extension, it means adding extra (usually negative or illicit) content to something original, such as embellishing gossip news or illegally adding ingredients to food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食成日加料，唔敢去食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 seng4 jat6 gaa1 liu2, m4 gam2 heoi3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的食物经常加料，不敢去吃。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant often adds extra ingredients to their food (usually in a bad way), I don't dare to eat there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲记者成日加料报道，根本唔可以信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gei2 ze2 seng4 jat6 gaa1 liu2 bou3 dou6, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些记者经常添油加醋地报道，根本不能相信。
examples.english_sentence: Those reporters often embellish their reports, you can't trust them at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好加料講咁多啦，我知咩事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaa1 liu2 gong2 gam3 do1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 me1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要添油加醋地说那么多了，我知道什么事了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't embellish the story so much, I know what happened.

english_meaning: overtime (in sports, work, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 在比赛或工作中，超过正常时间继续进行。
explanation_english: An extension of the normal playing time in a sports game or working hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場波打到加時先分到勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bo1 daa2 dou3 gaa1 si4 sin1 fan1 dou3 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场球赛打到加时才分出胜负。
examples.english_sentence: The game went into overtime before a winner was decided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要加時，冇得咁早收工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaa1 si4, mou5 dak1 gam3 zou2 sau1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要加班，不能那么早下班了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work overtime tomorrow, so I can't finish work so early.

english_meaning: add oil; to make an extra effort; to cheer on; to support
explanation_mandarin: 表示鼓励、支持或努力争取成功。原意为给机器添加燃料使其运转得更好，引申为给予精神上的鼓励和支持。
explanation_english: A term of encouragement, support, or striving for success. Originally meaning to add fuel to a machine to make it run better, it has been extended to mean providing spiritual encouragement and support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，加油啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, gaa1 jau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，加油啊！
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the exam, good luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊加油，搞掂呢個project！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gaa1 jau2, gaau2 dim6 ni1 go3 project!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起加油，完成这个项目！
examples.english_sentence: Let's work hard together to finish this project!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人，加油！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4, gaa1 jau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人，加油！
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people, add oil! (Keep fighting!)

english_meaning: gas station, petrol station, service station
explanation_mandarin: 提供燃料给汽车的场所。
explanation_english: A place that provides fuel for automobiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車冇油喇，不如去前面個加油站入油啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau2 laa3, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 cin4 min6 go3 gaa1 jau2 zaam6 jap6 jau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车没油了，不如去前面的加油站加油吧。
examples.english_sentence: The car is out of gas, let's go to the gas station ahead to fill up.

english_meaning: addition
explanation_mandarin: 数学中的加法运算。
explanation_english: The mathematical operation of addition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友學緊加法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 gan2 gaa1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友正在学习加法。
examples.english_sentence: The children are learning addition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數嘅答案係用加法計出嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 ge3 daap3 aan3 hai6 yung6 gaa1 faat3 gai3 chut1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题的答案是用加法算出来的。
examples.english_sentence: The answer to this question was calculated using addition.

english_meaning: To raise the stakes; to ante up; to increase a bet; to add more (money, effort, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 在赌博中增加赌注，也引申为增加投入、力度等。
explanation_english: Literally, to add to the bet in gambling. Figuratively, it means to increase investment, effort, or intensity in something.

examples.english_sentence: In order to catch up with the project, the boss asked us to put in more effort.

english_meaning: plus size; extra large (clothing)
explanation_mandarin: 指服装的加大尺码，通常用于形容胖人穿的衣服。
explanation_english: Refers to plus-size clothing, typically used to describe clothes worn by overweight people. Indicates larger sizes.

english_meaning: Catalonia
explanation_mandarin: 西班牙东北部的一个自治区。
explanation_english: An autonomous community in northeastern Spain.

examples.english_sentence: I really want to go to Catalonia to watch a football match.

mandarin_meaning: 加泰罗尼亚 (Jiā tài luó ní yà)
english_meaning: Catalonia

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加泰隆尼亞嘅首府係巴塞隆拿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 taai3 lung4 nei4 aa3 ge3 sau2 fu2 hai6 baa1 sai3 lung4 naa4.

examples.english_sentence: The capital of Catalonia is Barcelona.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年加泰隆尼亞一直想獨立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 nin4 gaa1 taai3 lung4 nei4 aa3 jat1 zik6 soeng2 duk6 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来加泰罗尼亚一直想要独立。(Jìnnián jiā tài luó ní yà yīzhí xiǎng yào dúlì.)
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, Catalonia has always wanted independence.

english_meaning: California bass, Largemouth bass
explanation_mandarin: 指一种原产于北美的淡水鱼，学名 Micropterus salmoides，常被用于食用。
explanation_english: Refers to a freshwater fish native to North America, scientifically known as Micropterus salmoides, commonly used for food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食清蒸加洲鱸好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 cing1 zing1 gaa1 zau1 lou4 hou2 m4 hou2?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅加洲鱸做得好入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 gaa1 zau1 lou4 zou6 dak1 hou2 jap6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的加州鲈鱼做得非常入味。
examples.english_sentence: The California bass at this restaurant is very flavorful.

english_meaning: to send reinforcements; to dispatch additional personnel; to add more
explanation_mandarin: 增加派遣人员或队伍。
explanation_english: To send more people or teams as reinforcements; to dispatch additional personnel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話要加派人手去處理呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 paai3 jan4 sau2 heoi3 cyu5 lei5 ni1 go3 project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方加派咗警力喺示威現場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gaa1 paai3 zo2 ging2 lik6 hai2 si3 wai1 jin6 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在示威现场加派了警力。
examples.english_sentence: The police sent more officers to the protest site.

english_meaning: to deepen, to reinforce, to intensify
explanation_mandarin: 使程度更深，更强烈。
explanation_english: To make something deeper, more intense, or stronger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令我哋之間嘅誤會加深咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 ng6 wui6 gaa1 sam1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事加深了我们之间的误会。
examples.english_sentence: This incident deepened the misunderstanding between us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅感情加深咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gam2 cing4 gaa1 sam1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的感情加深了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has deepened a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要加深對香港文化嘅認識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 sam1 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 man4 faa3 ge3 jing6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要加深对香港文化的认识。
examples.english_sentence: We need to deepen our understanding of Hong Kong culture.

english_meaning: to add; to increase; to replenish
explanation_mandarin: 增加，增添。
explanation_english: To add to something; to increase the amount or quantity of something; to replenish or resupply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋加添啲人手嚟搞呢個項目啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa1 tim1 di1 jan4 sau2 lai4 gaau2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: Let's add some manpower to work on this project.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 gaa1 tim1 di1 tong2 lok6 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以往咖啡里加点糖吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I add some sugar to the coffee?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想喺花園入面加添啲新嘅植物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 hai2 faa1 jyun2 jap6 min6 gaa1 tim1 di1 san1 ge3 zik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想在花园里添加一些新的植物。
examples.english_sentence: They want to add some new plants to the garden.

english_meaning: More or less; about; around; plus or minus
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概的数目，或者稍微的增加或减少。
explanation_english: Indicates an approximate amount, or a slight increase or decrease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個project預算大概一百萬加減。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 project jyu6 syun3 daai6 koi3 jat1 bak1 maan6 gaa1 gim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的项目预算大概一百万左右。
examples.english_sentence: Their project budget is about one million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買三四個橙加減。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 saam1 sei3 go3 caang2 gaa1 gim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算买三四个橙子左右。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to buy about three or four oranges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日氣溫二十度加減啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hei3 wan1 ji6 sap6 dou6 gaa1 gim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天气温二十度左右吧。
examples.english_sentence: Today's temperature is around 20 degrees Celsius.

english_meaning: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division; the four basic arithmetic operations
explanation_mandarin: 指数学中的加法、减法、乘法和除法四种基本运算。
explanation_english: Refers to the four basic arithmetic operations in mathematics: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友啱啱開始學加減乘除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 chi2 hok6 gaa1 gaam2 sing4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友刚刚开始学加减乘除。

examples.english_sentence: The addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of mathematics are all very important.

english_meaning: to heat up, to warm up

explanation_english: To increase the temperature of something; to make something warm or hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想加熱個飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gaa1 jit6 go3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把饭加热一下。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如加热点水来泡个杯面吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about heating up some water to make some instant noodles?

english_meaning: Heated tobacco product, heat-not-burn cigarette
explanation_mandarin: 一种不燃烧烟草，而是通过加热烟草产生含有尼古丁的气雾供人吸食的烟草产品。
explanation_english: A tobacco product that heats tobacco instead of burning it, producing a nicotine-containing aerosol for inhalation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔都興食加熱煙，話冇咁臭。

examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people are into heated tobacco products, saying it's not as smelly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加熱煙對身體嘅傷害都唔少㗎，唔好以為健康啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jit6 jin1 deoi3 san1 tai2 ge3 soeng1 hoi6 dou1 m4 siu2 gaa3, m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 gin6 hong1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加热烟对身体的伤害也不少，不要以为更健康。
examples.english_sentence: Heated tobacco products are still harmful to your health; don't think they're healthier.

english_meaning: to work overtime, to work extra shifts
explanation_mandarin: 在正常工作时间之外工作；为了完成任务而延长工作时间。
explanation_english: To work beyond regular working hours; to work extra time, often to complete a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要加班，冇得同你食飯喇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要加班，不能和你吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work overtime tonight, so I can't have dinner with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司好多嘢做，成日都要加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 hou2 do1 je5 zou6, sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司很多事情要做，经常都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a lot to do recently, so we often have to work overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想日日都加班，但係又唔夠人手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 jat6 jat6 dou1 gaa1 baan1, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 gau3 jan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想每天都加班，但是又不够人手。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to work overtime every day, but we don't have enough manpower.

english_meaning: to join, to affiliate with (e.g., a franchise)

examples.english_sentence: Which company do you think is better to franchise with?

explanation_mandarin: 原本是指監獄犯人因違規而增加刑期，現也用來比喻某事令人感到痛苦、無奈，被迫延長或加重負擔。
explanation_english: Originally refers to extending a prisoner's sentence due to misconduct. Now it's also used metaphorically to describe something causing pain or helplessness, forcing an extension or increased burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺監獄入面打交，結果俾人加監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaam1 juk6 jap6 min6 daa2 gaau1, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 gaa1 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在监狱里面打架，结果被人加刑了。
examples.english_sentence: He fought in prison and ended up having his sentence extended.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jat6 jat6 OT, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 gaa1 gaam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近每天都加班，真的好像加刑一样。
examples.english_sentence: Lately, I've been working overtime every day, it feels like serving extra time in prison.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为迟交功课，所以老师说要罚抄，简直是加刑。
examples.english_sentence: Because I submitted the homework late, the teacher said I have to copy it as punishment. It's practically like extra imprisonment.

english_meaning: to increase the stake; to up the ante; to increase investment; to add more (to something)

explanation_english: To increase the stakes in gambling or investment; to increase the amount of money or chips being bet. By extension, it also refers to increasing the degree of effort or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市跌咗咁多，你仲要加碼買？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gam3 do1, nei5 zung6 jiu3 gaa1 maa5 maai5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市跌了这么多，你还要加码买？
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has dropped so much, and you still want to increase your investment?

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 faan2 jing3 gam3 hou2, kyut3 ding6 gaa1 maa5 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见反应这么好，决定加大宣传力度。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the response was so good, he decided to increase the intensity of the promotion.

english_meaning: to increase rent, rent increase
explanation_mandarin: 动词：提高租金；名词：租金上涨
explanation_english: Verb: to increase the rent; Noun: rent increase.

examples.english_sentence: The property prices and the rent increases here are very exaggerated.

english_meaning: visa; endorse; countersign; sign

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问一下办理英国签证是否需要加签其他文件？
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask if I need to countersign other documents when applying for a UK visa?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約要老細加簽先有效嘅。

explanation_english: Refers to something smaller in size or quantity. Can refer to the size of an object or the reduction in scale or scope.
