examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 daai6 gin6 laa3, ngo5 soeng2 gaa1 sai3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服太大了，我想要小一码的。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too big; I want a smaller size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着開加大碼，但係瘦咗之後，就要着加細碼喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 hoi1 gaa1 daai6 maa5, daan6 hai6 sau3 zo2 zi1 hau6, zau6 jiu3 zoek3 gaa1 sai3 maa5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前穿加大码，但是瘦了之后，就要穿小一码的了。
examples.english_sentence: She used to wear a large size, but after losing weight, she has to wear a smaller size now.

english_meaning: to intensify, to accelerate, to step up, to tighten
explanation_mandarin: 表示加快速度，加强力度。
explanation_english: To increase speed, intensity, or effort; to accelerate or tighten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要加緊溫書，準備考試呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 gan2 wan1 syu1, zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要加紧复习，准备考试啊。
examples.english_sentence: We need to step up our studying to prepare for the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加緊打擊罪案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 gan2 daa2 gik1 zeoi6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加紧打击犯罪。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to intensify the crackdown on crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋加緊趕工，希望可以準時交貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 gan2 gon2 gung1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 gaau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们加紧赶工，希望可以准时交货。
examples.english_sentence: They are working harder to meet the delivery deadline.

english_meaning: to add a dish (to a meal); to give extra provisions (e.g., for an outing or a celebration); to add an extra task (often negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是增加菜肴。除了指真的增加菜的种类和数量之外，有时也指增加额外的任务或负担，带有一定的负面含义，通常是因为增加的任务是不受欢迎的。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to add a dish'. Besides referring to literally adding more dishes or increasing the quantity of food, it can also mean to add an extra task or burden, often with a negative connotation, usually because the added task is unwelcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋加菜，整多個咕嚕肉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 coi3, zing2 do1 go3 gu1 lou1 juk6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们加菜，多做一道咕咾肉！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're adding a dish, making an extra sweet and sour pork!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細又加菜，今次要我哋加班趕project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jau6 gaa1 coi3, gam1 ci3 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 baan1 gon2 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板又加菜了，这次要我们加班赶项目。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has added another dish, this time asking us to work overtime to rush the project.

english_meaning: to put up an awning; to set up a canopy; to cover with an awning
explanation_mandarin: 用篷布或帆布等遮盖起来，通常为了挡雨或遮阳。
explanation_english: To cover something with an awning, tarpaulin, or canvas, usually to protect it from rain or sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨，不如我哋加蓬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 pung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要下雨，不如我们搭个篷吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's going to rain tomorrow, why don't we put up an awning?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺街邊加蓬賣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 gaa1 pung4 maai6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街边搭篷卖东西。
examples.english_sentence: They're selling things on the street with an awning.

english_meaning: to get a pay raise, to increase salary
explanation_mandarin: 增加工资，提高薪水。
explanation_english: To receive an increase in one's salary or wages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今年可以加薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 gaa1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望今年可以加薪。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can get a pay raise this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得咁好，應該幫佢加薪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 gam3 hou2, ying1 goi1 bong1 keoi5 gaa1 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做得这么好，应该给他加薪了。
examples.english_sentence: He is doing such a good job; he should get a pay raise.

english_meaning: plus sign
explanation_mandarin: 数学符号，表示加法运算。
explanation_english: A mathematical symbol (+) indicating addition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數嘅答案係三加二嘅加號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 ge3 daap3 aan3 hai6 saam1 gaa1 ji6 ge3 gaa1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题的答案是三加二的加号。
examples.english_sentence: The answer to this math problem involves the plus sign between three and two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好唔記得寫加號呀，如果唔係就錯晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 se2 gaa1 hou6 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 co3 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要忘记写加号啊，不然就全错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't forget to write the plus sign, otherwise everything will be wrong.

english_meaning: to add; to install; to set up additionally
explanation_mandarin: 增加设置，额外设置。
explanation_english: To add something; to install something additionally; to set up or establish something extra.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要喺呢個地方加設多啲閉路電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 gaa1 cit3 do1 di1 bai3 lou6 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要在这个地方增设多一些闭路电视。
examples.english_sentence: We need to install more CCTV cameras in this area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定喺市中心加設幾個充電站俾電動車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1 gaa1 cit3 gei2 go3 cung1 din6 zaam6 bei2 din6 dung6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定在市中心增设几个充电站给电动车。
examples.english_sentence: The government has decided to add several charging stations in the city center for electric vehicles.

english_meaning: accelerate, speed up
explanation_mandarin: 加快速度；加速进行。
explanation_english: To increase speed; to accelerate progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車要加速先可以爬到上斜路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 jiu3 gaa3 suk1 sin1 ho2 ji5 paa4 dou3 soeng5 se3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车要加速才能爬上坡路。
examples.english_sentence: The car needs to accelerate to climb the slope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想加速工程嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gaa3 suk1 gung1 cing4 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想加速工程的进度。
examples.english_sentence: They want to accelerate the progress of the project.

english_meaning: Accelerator, speed-upper; someone who (often unintentionally) accelerates a negative process or outcome, particularly used in political contexts to refer to leaders whose actions hasten a country's decline or crisis.
explanation_mandarin: 指有意或无意地加速某个进程，通常用于政治语境，指加速国家衰败或危机的领导人或政策。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who intentionally or unintentionally accelerates a process, often used in a political context to describe leaders or policies that hasten a country's decline or crisis. The term often carries a negative connotation, implying incompetence or malicious intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話佢係加速師，搞到香港咁嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 hai6 gaa3 suk1 si1, gaau2 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人说他是加速师，把香港搞成这样。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say he's an accelerator, making Hong Kong like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少人都覺得佢嘅政策只會令件事變得更差，根本係加速師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 zing3 caak3 zi2 wui5 ling6 gin6 si6 bin3 dak1 gang3 caa1, gan1 bun2 hai6 gaa3 suk1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少人都觉得他的政策只会让事情变得更糟，根本是加速师。
examples.english_sentence: Many people feel that his policies will only make things worse, he's basically an accelerator.

english_meaning: acceleration
explanation_mandarin: 物理学概念，指单位时间内速度的变化率。
explanation_english: A physics concept referring to the rate of change of velocity over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嘅加速度好勁，起步好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ge3 gaa1 suk1 dou6 hou2 ging6, hei2 bou6 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的加速度很强，起步很快。
examples.english_sentence: This car has great acceleration and starts very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅生意加速度咁快，好快就會擴大市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 saang1 ji3 gaa1 suk1 dou6 gam3 faai3, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui3 kwok3 daai6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的生意加速度很快，很快就会扩大市场。
examples.english_sentence: Their business is accelerating rapidly; they will soon expand the market.

english_meaning: to aggravate; to worsen; to increase (severity)
explanation_mandarin: 使程度加深或增加，使变得更严重。
explanation_english: To make something heavier, more severe, or more intense; to worsen a situation or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只會加重佢嘅負擔啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zi2 wui5 gaa1 zung6 keoi5 ge3 fu6 daam1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做只会加重他的负担。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this will only increase his burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨加重咗水浸嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 gaa1 zung6 zo2 seoi2 zam3 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨加重了水浸的情况。
examples.english_sentence: The rain aggravated the flooding situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壓力過大會加重病情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aat3 lik6 gwo3 daai6 wui5 gaa1 zung6 bing6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 压力过大会加重病情。
examples.english_sentence: Too much stress can worsen the illness.

english_meaning: to add money; to charge more
explanation_mandarin: 增加费用; 额外收费。
explanation_english: To increase the price; to charge extra money. Often used when the original price is insufficient for the work involved, or when additional services are requested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋要你趕工，咁就要加錢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nei5 gon2 gung1, gam2 zau6 jiu3 gaa1 cin2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们需要你赶工，那就需要加钱了。
examples.english_sentence: If we need you to rush the job, then we'll have to pay extra.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲特別要求要加錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dak6 bit6 jiu1 kau4 jiu3 gaa1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些特殊要求是要加钱的。
examples.english_sentence: These special requests require extra charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話太遠，要加錢先肯送貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 taai3 jyun5, jiu3 gaa1 cin2 sin1 hang2 sung3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说太远了，要加钱才肯送货。
examples.english_sentence: He said it's too far, he'll only deliver if we pay extra.

english_meaning: to add time (to a session)
explanation_mandarin: 指增加预定的时间，通常用于服务行业，如按摩、卡拉OK等。
explanation_english: To add time to a scheduled session, commonly used in service industries such as massage parlors, karaoke, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唱得好開心，不如加鐘啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 coeng3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, bat1 jyu4 gaa1 zung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们唱得很开心，不如加时吧！
examples.english_sentence: We're having a great time singing, how about we add more time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得按摩唔夠，所以叫師傅加鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 on3 mo1 m4 gau3, so2 ji5 giu3 si1 fu2 gaa1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得按摩不够，所以叫师傅加时。
examples.english_sentence: He felt the massage wasn't enough, so he asked the masseur to add time.

english_meaning: add one; count me in; one more
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“加零点一”，比喻多加一个，通常用于人群中表示“算我一个，我也参加”的意思。
explanation_english: Literally means "add zero point one". Figuratively, it means "add one more", often used in a group to indicate "count me in, I'll join too".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去唱K啊，加零一！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 heoi3 coeng3 K aa3, gaa1 ling4 jat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去唱K啊，算我一个！
examples.english_sentence: We're going to karaoke tonight, count me in!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去打邊爐，加零一唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daa2 bin1 lou4, gaa1 ling4 jat1 m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去吃火锅，请加我一个。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to have hot pot, please include me.

english_meaning: to add a dish (to a meal)
explanation_mandarin: 指在原有菜肴的基础上，增加新的菜品，使餐食更加丰盛。
explanation_english: To add a dish to a meal; to increase the number of dishes served; to add an extra dish, often to make the meal more substantial or festive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋加餸啦，整多個咕嚕肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 sung3 laa1, zing2 do1 go3 gu1 lou1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们加菜吧，再做一个咕咾肉。
examples.english_sentence: Let's add a dish tonight, let's make sweet and sour pork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日煮飯都唔捨得加餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 zyu2 faan6 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 gaa1 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常做饭都不舍得加菜。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always cooks but is reluctant to add extra dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋通常會加餸慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 gaa1 sung3 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们通常会加菜庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we usually add dishes to celebrate.

english_meaning: To embellish a story, to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 在叙述事情时，为了使内容更吸引人或达到某种目的，有意地夸大或歪曲事实。
explanation_english: To embellish or exaggerate a story, often with the intent to make it more interesting or to achieve a specific effect. It implies adding details that are not entirely true to create a more dramatic or sensational narrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都加鹽加醋，你唔好咁信佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gaa1 jim4 gaa1 cou3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 seon3 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是添油加醋，你不要太相信他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He always embellishes his stories, don't trust him too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好加鹽加醋啦，如實講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaa1 jim4 gaa1 cou3 laa1, jyu4 sat6 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要添油加醋了，如实说就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't exaggerate, just tell the truth.

english_meaning: inferior; bad; of poor quality
explanation_mandarin: 形容品质差、等级低。贬义词。
explanation_english: Describes something of poor quality or low grade. A derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨嘅品質好劣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 ge3 pin2 chat1 hou2 lyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货物的质量很差。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of these goods is very poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好劣㗎，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 lyut3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 aak1 jan4 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人品很差，经常骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's a really bad person, always cheating people out of money.

english_meaning: my humble work; poor work; inferior work
explanation_mandarin: 谦称自己的作品。形容作品质量差。
explanation_english: A humble way of referring to one's own work, implying it is of inferior quality. Used as a self-deprecating term when presenting or referring to something one has created.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我嘅劣作，希望你唔好嫌棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 lyut6 zok3, hei1 mong6 nei5 m4 hou2 him4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的拙作，希望你不要嫌弃。
examples.english_sentence: This is my humble work, I hope you won't dislike it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，呢份報告只係我嘅劣作，好多地方仲要修改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 lyut6 zok3, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 zung6 jiu3 sau1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这份报告只是我的拙作，很多地方还要修改。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, this report is just my inferior work; many parts still need to be modified.

english_meaning: disadvantage, inferior position, weak spot
explanation_mandarin: 指在競爭或對抗中所處的不利地位或弱點。
explanation_english: Refers to a disadvantageous or weak position in competition or confrontation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家處於劣勢，一定要諗辦法反擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 cyu2 jyu1 lyut6 sai3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 faan2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在处于劣势，一定要想办法反击。
examples.english_sentence: We are currently at a disadvantage, we must find a way to counterattack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅劣勢係經驗唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lyut6 sai3 hai6 ging1 gim6 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的劣势是经验不足。
examples.english_sentence: Their disadvantage is that they lack experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判入面，千祈唔好暴露自己嘅劣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 pun3 yap6 min6, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 bou6 lou6 zi6 gei2 ge3 lyut6 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在谈判中，千万不要暴露自己的劣势。
examples.english_sentence: In negotiations, never expose your weaknesses.

jyutping: lyut6 bai6 keoi1 zuk6 leong4 bai6
english_meaning: Bad money drives out good money; Gresham's Law
explanation_mandarin: 指在货币流通领域，如果存在两种不同成色的货币，价值低的货币（劣币）会把价值高的货币（良币）从流通中排挤出去，最终导致良币退出流通。
explanation_english: Refers to the phenomenon in economics where 'bad money drives out good money'.  In other words, if there are two forms of commodity money in circulation, which are accepted by law as having similar face value, the more valuable commodity will gradually disappear from circulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲制度唔公平，搞到劣幣驅逐良幣，有能力嘅人都走晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 dai6 dou6 m4 gung1 ping4, gaau2 dou3 lyut6 bai6 keoi1 zuk6 leong4 bai6, jau5 nang4 lik6 ge3 dou1 zau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的制度不公平，搞得劣币驱逐良币，有能力的人都走了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's system is unfair, leading to bad money driving out good money, and all the capable people have left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 娛樂圈都係劣幣驅逐良幣，真正有實力嘅人反而冇出頭天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 lok6 hyun1 dou1 hai6 lyut6 bai6 keoi1 zuk6 leong4 bai6, zan1 zeng3 jau5 sat6 lik6 ge3 jan4 faan2 ji6 mok6 ceot1 tau4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 娱乐圈都是劣币驱逐良币，真正有实力的人反而没有出头之日。
examples.english_sentence: The entertainment industry is also a case of bad money driving out good money, and people with real talent often don't get a chance to shine.

english_meaning: inherent flaw, deeply ingrained defect, negative trait (often referring to cultural or societal problems)
explanation_mandarin: 指存在于群体（通常是社会或文化）中的一些难以改变的、负面的、根深蒂固的特性或行为习惯。
explanation_english: Refers to a deeply ingrained negative characteristic or behavioral pattern that is difficult to change, often attributed to a group of people (usually within a society or culture). It often carries a critical connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話香港人有種劣根性，就係鍾意貪小便宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 hoeng1 gong2 yan4 yau5 zung2 lyut6 gan1 sing3, zau6 hai6 zung1 yi3 taam1 siu2 bin6 yi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说香港人有一种劣根性，就是喜欢贪小便宜。
examples.english_sentence: They say that Hong Kong people have a certain inherent flaw, which is that they like to take advantage of small things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種劣根性要好耐先可以改到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 lyut6 gan1 sing3 yiu3 hou2 noi6 sin1 ho2 ji5 goi2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种劣根性要很久才可以改变。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of deeply ingrained flaw will take a long time to change.

english_meaning: a history of poor performance; a track record of failures; marred with flaws
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物有很多不良记录或缺点，表现非常糟糕。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something with a history of poor performance or numerous flaws, indicating a very bad track record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢劣績斑斑，點解仲可以升職㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lyut6 zik1 baan1 baan1, dim2 gaai2 zung6 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他劣迹斑斑，为什么还可以升职呢？
examples.english_sentence: He has a history of poor performance, how can he still be promoted?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司劣績斑斑，千祈唔好投資啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 lyut6 zik1 baan1 baan1, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 tau4 zi1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司劣迹斑斑，千万不要投资啊！
examples.english_sentence: This company has a terrible track record, definitely don't invest!

english_meaning: negative review, bad review, unfavorable comment
explanation_mandarin: 指负面的评价或评论，通常针对商品、服务或作品。
explanation_english: Refers to a negative evaluation or review, usually directed at a product, service, or work of art.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲收到好多劣評，搞到我唔想睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 lyut6 ping3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 soeng2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影收到了很多差评，搞得我不想看了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie received many negative reviews, making me not want to watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食好難食，網上好多劣評㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 naan4 sik6, mong5 soeng5 hou2 do1 lyut6 ping3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很难吃，网上有很多差评。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is terrible, there are many negative reviews online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告俾老細寫咗好多劣評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 bei2 lou5 sai3 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 lyut6 ping3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告被老板写了很多差评。
examples.english_sentence: His report received a lot of negative comments from the boss.

mandarin_meaning: 差评如潮; 恶评如潮
english_meaning: Overwhelmingly negative reviews; a flood of bad reviews; universally panned
explanation_mandarin: 形容大量的负面评价像潮水一样涌来，表示某事物或某人受到了广泛的批评。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is a massive influx of negative reviews or criticisms, suggesting something or someone is facing widespread condemnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲上映之後，劣評如潮，票房都好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 soeng5 jing2 zi1 hau6, lyut6 ping3 jyu4 ciu4, piu3 fong2 dou1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影上映后，差评如潮，票房也很差。
examples.english_sentence: After the movie was released, it received overwhelmingly negative reviews, and the box office was terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食又貴又唔好食，結果劣評如潮，執咗笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6, git3 gwo2 lyut6 ping3 jyu4 ciu4, zap1 zo2 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的食物又贵又不好吃，结果差评如潮，倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant's food was expensive and not tasty, resulting in a flood of bad reviews, and it closed down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新出嗰首歌劣評如潮，好多人都話難聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 ceot1 go2 sau2 go1 lyut6 ping3 jyu4 ciu4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 naan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他新出的那首歌差评如潮，很多人都说难听。
examples.english_sentence: His newly released song received a flood of bad reviews; many people said it was awful.

synonyms: 惡評如潮 (ok3 ping3 jyu4 ciu4)

mandarin_meaning: 劣质, 低劣, 质量差
english_meaning: inferior quality, low quality, shoddy, substandard
explanation_mandarin: 指质量低劣，不符合标准的产品或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to something of inferior or low quality, not meeting standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲劣質貨真係唔用得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lyut6 zat1 fo3 zan1 hai6 m4 yung6 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些劣质商品真的不能用啊。
examples.english_sentence: These shoddy goods are really unusable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好貪平買啲劣質嘅嘢呀，好快就會爛㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 taam1 peng4 maai5 di1 lyut6 zat1 ge3 je5 aa3, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui6 laan6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要贪便宜买劣质的东西啊，很快就会坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be greedy for cheap and buy inferior things, they will break quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司嘅產品質素好差，全部都係劣質貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 pin2 zat1 so3 hou2 chaa1, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 lyut6 zat1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的产品质量很差，全部都是劣质产品。
examples.english_sentence: The product quality of their company is very poor, all of them are substandard goods.

mandarin_meaning: 劣质食物; 难吃的食物
english_meaning: Low-quality food; bad food; disgusting food
explanation_mandarin: 指品质很差，味道难吃的食物。
explanation_english: Refers to food that is of very low quality and tastes bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食真係劣食嚟㗎，唔好去食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 lyut3 sik6 lai4 gaa3, m4 hou2 heoi3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的东西真是劣质食物，不要去吃了。
examples.english_sentence: The food at that restaurant is really bad, don't go there to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲劣食，狗都唔食啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lyut3 sik6, gau2 dou1 m4 sik6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些劣质食物，狗都不会吃！
examples.english_sentence: Even dogs wouldn't eat this terrible food!

synonyms: 垃圾食物 (laap6 saap3 sik6 mat6)
唔好食嘅嘢 (m4 hou2 sik6 ge3 je5)

english_meaning: to help, to assist, to aid
explanation_mandarin: 帮助，协助。
explanation_english: To help, assist, or aid someone in doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢需要人幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他需要人帮助。
examples.english_sentence: He needs someone to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 wu6 seong1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: We should help each other.

jyutping: zo6 jan4 wai4 faai3 lok6 zi1 bun2
english_meaning: It is a source of happiness to help others.
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人是快乐的根源。说明帮助别人会使自己感到快乐。
explanation_english: Helping others is the root of happiness. It explains that helping others makes one feel happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該要記住助人為快樂之本，盡力幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 zo6 jan4 wai4 faai3 lok6 zi1 bun2, zeon6 lik6 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该记住助人为快乐之本，尽力帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should remember that it is a source of happiness to help others, and do our best to help those in need.

jyutping: zo6 jan4 wai4 faai3 lok6 zi1 bun2
english_meaning: Helping others is the source of happiness.
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人是快乐的根源。 指帮助别人能给自己带来快乐。
explanation_english: Helping others is the foundation of happiness. It means that helping others brings joy to oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該多啲幫助有需要嘅人，助人爲快樂之本嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4, zo6 jan4 wai4 faai3 lok6 zi1 bun2 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多帮助需要帮助的人，助人为快乐之本嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We should help people in need more often, because helping others is the source of happiness.

mandarin_meaning: 助人者，人恒助之；帮助他人，也帮助自己
english_meaning: To help others is to help oneself; mutual benefit.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是帮助别人，实际上也是在帮助自己。强调互惠互利，相互扶持的道理。
explanation_english: This idiom means that helping others is also helping oneself. It emphasizes the principle of mutual benefit and mutual support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日都話助人自助，你幫人，人哋都會幫返你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zo6 jan4 zi6 zo6, nei5 bong1 jan4, jan4 dei6 dou1 wui2 bong1 faan1 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常说助人自助，你帮助别人，别人也会帮助你的。
examples.english_sentence: We often say 'to help others is to help oneself', if you help people, they will help you in return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做義工就係助人自助嘅好例子，你幫到有需要嘅人，同時自己都學到好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ji6 gung1 zau6 hai6 zo6 jan4 zi6 zo6 ge3 hou2 lai6 zi2, nei5 bong1 dou2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4, tung4 si4 zi6 gei2 dou1 hok6 dou2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做义工就是助人自助的好例子，你帮助到有需要的人，同时自己也学到很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: Volunteering is a good example of 'to help others is to help oneself', you help people in need, and you also learn a lot yourself.

english_meaning: Assistance; help; support; to aid
explanation_mandarin: 帮助的力量，也可以指给予帮助的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the force or power of assistance, or the act of providing help and support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅助力，我哋先可以咁快完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 zuk1 lik6, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 faai3 wun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的帮助，我们才能这么快完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to your assistance, we were able to complete this project so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你可以俾啲助力我，等我可以順利通過呢個考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 bei2 di1 zuk1 lik6 ngo5, dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 tung1 gwo3 ni1 go3 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你能给我一些帮助，让我可以顺利通过这次考试。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you can give me some help so I can pass this exam smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅助力對我嚟講好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zuk1 lik6 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的帮助对我来说很重要。
examples.english_sentence: His help is very important to me.

english_meaning: scholarship, grant, financial aid for students
explanation_mandarin: 为帮助学生完成学业而提供的资金援助。
explanation_english: Financial assistance provided to students to help them complete their studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞到政府嘅助學金，終於可以繼續讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 dou2 zing3 fu2 ge3 zo6 hok6 gam1, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到了政府的助学金，终于可以继续读书了。
examples.english_sentence: He received a government scholarship and can finally continue his studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多大學生都靠助學金嚟應付學費同生活費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 daai6 hok6 sang1 dou1 kaau3 zo6 hok6 gam1 lai4 ying3 fu6 hok6 fai3 tung4 sang1 wut6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多大学生都靠助学金来应付学费和生活费。
examples.english_sentence: Many university students rely on scholarships to cover their tuition and living expenses.

english_meaning: to facilitate; to help bring about; to assist in achieving
explanation_mandarin: 促使事情成功；帮助促成某事。
explanation_english: To facilitate or contribute to the success of something; to help bring something about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅支持助成咗呢個項目嘅成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi1 ci4 zo6 sing4 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的支持促成了这个项目的成功。
examples.english_sentence: His support facilitated the success of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以助成佢哋達成共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zo6 sing4 keoi5 dei6 daat6 sing4 gung1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以帮助他们达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: We hope to facilitate them reaching a consensus.

english_meaning: assistant, helper, aide
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人的人；协助完成工作的人。
explanation_english: A person who helps others; someone who assists in completing work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要個助手幫我搬啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 go3 zo6 sau2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要一个助手帮我搬一些东西。
examples.english_sentence: I need an assistant to help me move some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅得力助手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 dak1 lik6 zo6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的得力助手。
examples.english_sentence: He is my right-hand man.

english_meaning: assist (in sports, gaming, or metaphorical situations)
explanation_mandarin: 在体育比赛或游戏中，指协助队友得分的行为；也引申指在其他情境下，协助他人达成目标。
explanation_english: In sports or games, to assist a teammate in scoring. It can also be extended to mean assisting someone in achieving a goal in other situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日場波助攻咗三次，好勁啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 coeng4 bo1 zo6 gung1 zo2 saam1 ci3, hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天那场球助攻了三次，好厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He assisted three times in the game yesterday, he's so awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你喺背後助攻，我先可以成功搞掂呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 hai2 bui3 hau6 zo6 gung1, ngo5 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 gaau2 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你在背后助攻，我才可以成功搞定这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for assisting me behind the scenes, I was able to successfully handle this matter.

english_meaning: Teaching assistant
explanation_mandarin: 在大学或学院中，协助教授进行教学工作的人员。
explanation_english: A person who assists a professor with teaching duties in a university or college.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺大學做緊助教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 daai6 hok6 zou6 gan2 zo6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在大学里做助教。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as a teaching assistant at the university now.

english_meaning: Assistant
explanation_mandarin: 辅助他人处理事务的人员；助手。
explanation_english: A person who assists someone in their work; an assistant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅私人助理，幫我處理好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 si1 yan4 zo6 lei5, bong1 ngo5 cyu5 lei5 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的私人助理，帮我处理很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is my personal assistant and helps me with many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司請咗好多行政助理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 hang4 zing3 zo6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司聘请了很多行政助理。
examples.english_sentence: This company hired many administrative assistants.

english_meaning: midwife
explanation_mandarin: 经过专业训练，协助孕妇分娩的医护人员。
explanation_english: A healthcare professional trained to assist women during childbirth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我老婆有咗之後，我哋諗住搵個助產士喺屋企幫佢接生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou5 po2 jau5 zo2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 go3 zo6 caan2 si6 hai2 uk1 kei2 bong1 keoi5 zip3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我老婆怀孕之后，我们打算找个助产士在家里帮她接生。
examples.english_sentence: After my wife got pregnant, we were thinking of hiring a midwife to help her deliver the baby at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個經驗豐富嘅助產士，接生咗好多BB㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 ging1 gim6 fung1 fu3 ge3 zo6 caan2 si6, zip3 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 BB gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一位经验丰富的助产士，已经接生了很多宝宝了。
examples.english_sentence: She is an experienced midwife and has delivered many babies.

english_meaning: to aid and abet a tyrant; to assist the wicked in doing evil
explanation_mandarin: 比喻帮助坏人做坏事。
explanation_english: To assist the wicked in doing evil; to help a tyrant oppress the people. The idiom originates from the historical figure Zhou, the last emperor of the Shang Dynasty, who was a cruel and tyrannical ruler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再助紂為虐喇，唔好再幫佢呃人錢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zo6 zau6 wai4 ngok6 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 bong1 keoi5 aak1 jan4 cin2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再助纣为虐了，不要再帮他骗人钱了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't aid and abet him anymore, don't help him cheat people out of their money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知老細嘅做法唔啱，但係都仲要幫手，簡直係助紂為虐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 lou5 sai3 ge3 zou6 faat3 m4 ngaam1, daan6 hai6 dou1 zung1 jiu3 bong1 sau2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 zo6 zau6 wai4 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明知道老板的做法不对，但是还是要帮忙，简直是助纣为虐。
examples.english_sentence: He knows the boss's actions are wrong, but he still helps, it's simply aiding and abetting a tyrant.

synonyms: 為虎作倀 (wai4 fu2 zok3 coeng1)

english_meaning: to assist a tyrant in doing evil; to aid and abet evil-doers
explanation_mandarin: 比喻帮助坏人做坏事。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of assisting a wicked or tyrannical person in committing evil deeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再幫佢啦，你咁樣咪助紂爲虐囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 bong1 keoi5 laa1, nei5 gam2 joeng2 mai1 zo6 zau6 wai4 ngok6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再帮他了，你这样就是助纣为虐了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't help him anymore, you're just assisting a tyrant in doing evil.

english_meaning: hearing aid
explanation_mandarin: 一种帮助听力受损人士听到声音的电子设备。
explanation_english: An electronic device worn in or behind the ear that helps people with hearing loss to hear sounds more clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆戴咗助聽器之後，聽到嘢清楚好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 daai3 zo2 zo6 ting1 hei3 zi1 hau6, teng1 dou2 je5 cing1 co2 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶戴了助听器之后，听东西清楚多了。
examples.english_sentence: After Grandma put on her hearing aid, she could hear things much more clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗緊使唔使配返個助聽器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 gan2 sai2 m4 sai2 pui3 faan1 go3 zo6 ting1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在考虑是否要配一个助听器。
examples.english_sentence: He's thinking about whether he needs to get a hearing aid.

english_meaning: to add to the fun; to liven things up; to enliven a party
explanation_mandarin: 为了使气氛更热闹、更有趣而做一些事情。
explanation_english: To do something to add to the fun and make the atmosphere more lively, usually at a party or gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如玩遊戲助下興吖？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 waan2 jau4 hei3 zo6 haa5 hing3 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如玩游戏助助兴怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: How about we play a game to liven things up?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱咗首歌嚟助興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 zo2 sau2 go1 lai4 zo6 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱了首歌来助兴。
examples.english_sentence: He sang a song to add to the fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲啤酒都係用嚟助興啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 be1 zau2 dou1 hai6 yung6 lai4 zo6 hing3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些啤酒也只是用来助兴的。
examples.english_sentence: Those beers are just there to add to the atmosphere.

english_meaning: particle (grammar)
explanation_mandarin: 在语言中，助词是一种功能词，本身没有实在意义，主要用来辅助其他词语，表示某种语法关系或语气。
explanation_english: In grammar, a particle is a function word that does not have a lexical definition of its own and is used to indicate grammatical relationships or express a particular mood or tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東話有好多助詞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 waa2 jau5 hou2 do1 zo6 ci4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广东话有很多助词。
examples.english_sentence: Cantonese has a lot of particles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「嘅」、「㗎」、「喇」都係助詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ge3, gaa3, laa1 dou1 hai6 zo6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “的”、“啊”、“啦”都是助词。
examples.english_sentence: "嘅 (ge3)", "㗎 (gaa3)", and "喇 (laa1)" are all particles.

english_meaning: run-up, approach run (e.g., before a jump); to run up (before jumping)
explanation_mandarin: 指为了增加起跳或投掷的力度而进行的奔跑动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the running motion taken before a jump, throw, or similar action to increase momentum and power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢助跑完就跳咗過條河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zo6 paau2 jyun4 zau6 tiu3 zo2 gwo3 tiu4 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他助跑完就跳过了那条河。
examples.english_sentence: After the run-up, he jumped over the river.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢需要多啲助跑空間先可以跳得更遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jiu3 do1 di1 zo6 paau2 hung1 gaan1 sin1 ho2 ji5 tiu3 dak1 gang3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他需要更多的助跑空间才能跳得更远。
examples.english_sentence: He needs more run-up space to jump further.

english_meaning: to campaign for; to help with an election campaign; to stump for (a candidate)
explanation_mandarin: 帮助候选人进行选举活动，以争取选民支持。
explanation_english: To assist a candidate in their election campaign to gain voter support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢地成日幫候選人助選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 bong1 hau6 syun2 jan4 zo6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常帮助候选人助选。
examples.english_sentence: They often help candidates with their campaigns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅區議會選舉，好多人都出嚟幫唔同嘅候選人助選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 ku1 ji5 wui6 syun2 geoi2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ceot1 lai4 bong1 m4 tung4 ge3 hau6 syun2 jan4 zo6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的区议会选举，很多人都出来帮不同的候选人助选。
examples.english_sentence: For this year's District Council election, many people came out to campaign for different candidates.

english_meaning: to encourage; to foster; to promote; to abet
explanation_mandarin: 帮助增长，促使其发展。
explanation_english: To help to grow; to encourage the development of something, often something undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只會助長佢嘅壞習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zi2 wui5 zo6 zoeng2 keoi5 ge3 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做只会助长他的坏习惯。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way will only encourage his bad habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過度嘅宣傳可能會助長暴力行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 dou6 ge3 syun1 cyun4 ho2 nang4 wui5 zo6 zoeng2 bou6 lik6 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过度的宣传可能会助长暴力行为。
examples.english_sentence: Excessive publicity might encourage violent behavior.

english_meaning: to sponsor (a child, animal, etc.); to provide financial support for raising
explanation_mandarin: 指提供经济资助来抚养或照顾某人或动物，通常是指儿童或动物福利机构组织的活动。
explanation_english: To provide financial support to raise or care for someone or an animal, usually referring to activities organized by child or animal welfare organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一家人助養咗非洲嘅一個小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zo6 joeng5 zo2 fei1 zau1 ge3 jat1 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一家人资助抚养了一个非洲的小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Our family sponsors a child in Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺動物機構助養咗一隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dung6 mat6 gei1 kau3 zo6 joeng5 zo2 jat1 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在动物机构资助抚养了一只狗。
examples.english_sentence: She sponsors a dog at an animal welfare organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 助養兒童係一個好好嘅善舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 joeng5 ji4 tung4 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 sin6 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 资助抚养儿童是一个很好的善举。
examples.english_sentence: Sponsoring children is a very good act of charity.

english_meaning: To exert effort; to strive; to make an effort; strenuous
explanation_mandarin: 表示用力，尽力。相当于普通话的“使劲儿”、“努力”。
explanation_english: Indicates exerting effort, trying one's best. Equivalent to "shǐ jìnr" or "nǔlì" in Mandarin, meaning to make an effort or to strive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你努大力啲啦，就擰得開㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nou5 daai6 lik6 di1 laa1, zau6 ning1 dak1 hoi1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再使点劲儿，就能拧开了。
examples.english_sentence: Exert a bit more effort and you'll be able to unscrew it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努緊力想達到佢嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 gan2 lik6 soeng2 daat6 dou3 keoi5 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在努力实现他的目标。
examples.english_sentence: He is striving to achieve his goal.

english_meaning: to make an effort; to strive; to try hard; exertion
explanation_mandarin: 付出力量去做事；尽力。
explanation_english: To exert oneself; to strive; to make a strong effort to achieve something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要努力讀書，將來先有出息呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, zoeng1 loi4 sin1 jau5 ceot1 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要努力学习，将来才有出息啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to study hard so that you can have a successful future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力噉去改善自己嘅英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 heoi3 gai2 sin6 zi6 gei2 ge3 jing1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常努力地去提高自己的英文。
examples.english_sentence: He is trying very hard to improve his English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論做咩嘢都要努力嘗試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 zou6 me1 je5 dou1 jiu3 nou5 lik6 soeng4 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论做什么都要努力尝试。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what you do, you should try your best.

english_meaning: unremitting effort; persistent effort; tireless effort; never giving up
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常努力，毫不松懈。
explanation_english: Describes putting in a lot of effort without slacking off; persistent and tireless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力不懈，終於成功考入咗大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 lik6 bat1 hai6, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 haau2 jap6 zo2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力不懈，终于成功考入了大学。
examples.english_sentence: He worked tirelessly and finally succeeded in getting into university.

english_meaning: to rob, to plunder, to loot, robbery, calamity, disaster
explanation_mandarin: 使用暴力或威胁夺取财物；灾难，不幸的遭遇。
explanation_english: To take property by force or threat; robbery; a calamity or disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打劫銀行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 hip3 ngan4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抢劫银行。
examples.english_sentence: They robbed the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過上次嘅金融風暴，佢哋損失咗好多錢，真係一次劫數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 soeng5 ci3 ge3 gam1 jung4 fung1 bou6, keoi5 dei6 syun2 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 jat1 ci3 hip3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过上次的金融风暴，他们损失了很多钱，真是一次劫难。
examples.english_sentence: After the last financial crisis, they lost a lot of money, it was truly a disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想俾人打劫啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 daa2 hip3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想被人抢劫啊！
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be robbed!

english_meaning: robber, bandit, bandit
explanation_mandarin: 指进行抢劫犯罪活动的人。
explanation_english: A person who commits robbery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚銀行畀班劫匪打劫咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 ngaan5 ngan4 hong4 bei2 baan1 gip3 fei2 daa2 gip3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚银行被一群劫匪抢劫了。
examples.english_sentence: The bank was robbed by a group of robbers last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察捉咗個劫匪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2 go3 gip3 fei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓了一个劫匪。
examples.english_sentence: The police caught a robber.

english_meaning: rob the rich to help the poor
explanation_mandarin: 抢劫富人，救济穷人。比喻用不合法的手段获取财富，然后用来做好事或帮助别人。 也可指采取极端手段来实现社会公正。
explanation_english: To rob the rich to help the poor. It is often used to describe the action of acquiring wealth through illegal means and then using it to do good deeds or help others. It can also refer to taking extreme measures to achieve social justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話自己想做俠盜，劫富濟貧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 soeng2 zou6 hap6 dou6, hip3 fu3 zai3 pan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己想当侠盗，劫富济贫。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he wants to be a chivalrous thief who robs the rich to help the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人覺得政府應該劫富濟貧，縮窄貧富懸殊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 hip3 fu3 zai3 pan4, suk1 zaak3 pan4 fu3 hyun4 syu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人觉得政府应该劫富济贫，缩小贫富差距。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think that the government should rob the rich to help the poor in order to narrow the gap between the rich and the poor.

english_meaning: to hijack, to kidnap
explanation_mandarin: 使用暴力或威胁手段强行控制人或物，使其脱离原本的轨道或状态。
explanation_english: To seize control of a vehicle (such as an airplane) or person by force; to kidnap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋劫持咗架飛機，好危險呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hip3 ci4 zo2 gaa3 fei1 gei1, hou2 ngai4 him2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们劫持了一架飞机，很危险啊！
examples.english_sentence: They hijacked a plane, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恐怖分子劫持咗啲人質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung2 bou3 fan2 zi2 hip3 ci4 zo2 di1 jan4 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恐怖分子劫持了一些人质。
examples.english_sentence: Terrorists kidnapped some hostages.

english_meaning: to plunder; to loot; to pillage; to rob
explanation_mandarin: 指使用暴力手段抢夺他人的财物。
explanation_english: To forcibly take possessions from someone, typically using violence or threats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班賊仔入村劫掠，搶走好多財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 caak6 zai2 jap6 cyun1 hip3 loek6, coeng2 zau2 hou2 do1 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那伙强盗进村劫掠，抢走了很多财物。
examples.english_sentence: The bandits entered the village and looted, stealing a lot of property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋劫掠咗銀行，攞走晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hip3 loek6 zo2 ngan4 hong4, lo2 zau2 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抢劫了银行，拿走了所有的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They robbed the bank and took all the money.

english_meaning: robbery case, heist
explanation_mandarin: 指以暴力或威胁手段抢夺财物的案件。
explanation_english: Refers to a case of robbery or theft using violence or threats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日嗰單銀行劫案，警察仲調查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 go2 daan1 ngan4 hong4 gip3 ngon3, ging2 caat3 zung6 diu6 caa4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天那起银行抢劫案，警察还在调查。
examples.english_sentence: The bank robbery case yesterday is still under police investigation.

english_meaning: hijack a plane; plane hijacking
explanation_mandarin: 以武力或威胁手段夺取飞机的控制权。
explanation_english: To seize control of an aircraft by force or threat of force; the act of doing so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋企圖劫機，但係俾機上嘅安全人員制服咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kei5 tou4 hip3 gei1, daan6 hai6 bei2 gei1 soeng6 ge3 on1 cyun4 jan4 jyun4 zai3 fuk6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们企图劫机，但是被机上的安全人员制服了。
examples.english_sentence: They attempted to hijack the plane, but were subdued by the security personnel on board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 劫機係一種非常危險嘅犯罪行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hip3 gei1 hai6 jat1 zung2 fei1 soeng4 ngai4 him2 ge3 faan2 zeoi6 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劫机是一种非常危险的犯罪行为。
examples.english_sentence: Hijacking is a very dangerous criminal act.

english_meaning: to sexually assault; to rape
explanation_mandarin: 指用暴力或威胁手段进行性侵犯。
explanation_english: To sexually assault, typically involving force or coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢差啲畀人劫色，好彩最後走得甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 caa1 di1 bei2 jan4 hip3 sik1, hou2 coi2 zeoi3 hau6 zau2 dak1 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她差点被人强奸，幸好最后逃脱了。
examples.english_sentence: She said she was almost raped, but luckily she managed to escape in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個劫色犯終於俾警察捉到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hip3 sik1 faan2 zung1 jyu1 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个强奸犯终于被警察抓到了。
examples.english_sentence: The rapist was finally caught by the police.

english_meaning: to rob of both money and beauty (sexually assault)
explanation_mandarin: 指抢夺钱财，并进行性侵犯，形容犯罪行为恶劣。
explanation_english: Describes a criminal act involving the theft of money and property, along with sexual assault. It highlights the severity of the crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋入咗去打劫，仲要劫財劫色，真係冇人性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jap6 zo2 heoi3 daa2 gip3, zung6 jiu3 hip3 coi4 hip3 sik1, zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们进去抢劫，还要劫财劫色，真是没有人性。
examples.english_sentence: They went in to rob and then proceeded to rob of both money and beauty, it's truly inhumane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果遇到劫財劫色嘅情況，一定要保護自己，盡快報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jyu6 dou2 hip3 coi4 hip3 sik1 ge3 cing4 kwong3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2, zeon6 faai3 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果遇到劫财劫色的情况，一定要保护自己，尽快报警。
examples.english_sentence: If you encounter a situation of robbery and sexual assault, you must protect yourself and report to the police as soon as possible.

english_meaning: calamity, disaster, tribulation
explanation_mandarin: 指不幸的事情，灾祸，危难。
explanation_english: Refers to a misfortune, disaster, or tribulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人經歷咗場大劫難，好彩最後都平安無事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ging1 lik6 zo2 coeng4 daai6 gip3 naan6, hou2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 ping4 on1 mou4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人经历了一场大灾难，幸好最后都平安无事。
examples.english_sentence: The whole family went through a great calamity, luckily they were safe and sound in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次金融風暴對好多人嚟講都係一個劫難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 gam1 jung4 fung1 bou6 deoi3 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 gong2 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 gip3 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次金融风暴对很多人来说都是一个灾难。
examples.english_sentence: This financial crisis was a disaster for many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望香港可以捱過呢個劫難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 hoeng1 gong2 ho2 ji5 ngaai4 gwo3 ni1 go3 gip3 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望香港可以熬过这个劫难。
examples.english_sentence: I hope Hong Kong can get through this tribulation.

english_meaning: To toil; to labor; hardworking
explanation_mandarin: 形容辛勤劳苦的样子。多用于书面语。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being diligent and hardworking. Primarily used in written Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸成日劬勞噉做嘢，都係想我哋生活好啲啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa1 seng4 jat6 keoi4 lou4 gam2 zou6 je5, dou1 hai6 soeng2 ngo5 dei6 sang1 wut6 hou2 di1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸总是这么辛勤地工作，都是想我们生活好一点而已。
examples.english_sentence: Dad always works so hard, he just wants us to have a better life.

english_meaning: effective, efficacious
explanation_mandarin: 指具有产生预期效果的能力或特性；有效率，有作用。
explanation_english: Referring to the ability or characteristic of producing the desired effect; effective, efficacious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥好効㗎，你食咗就會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 hou2 haau2 gaa3, nei5 sik6 zo2 zau6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个药很有效，你吃了就会好一些。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is very effective; you'll feel better after taking it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做嘢好効率㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 haau2 leot2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们工作效率很高。
examples.english_sentence: They are very efficient at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔係咁効。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 hai6 gam3 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法不是那么有效。
examples.english_sentence: This method isn't that effective.

english_meaning: efficacy; effect; validity
explanation_mandarin: 效验，效能，有效作用。
explanation_english: Effectiveness, efficacy, or validity; the power to produce a desired result or effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥嘅効力好勁㗎，食完好快就好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 haau6 lik6 hou2 ging6 gaa3, sik6 jyun4 hou2 faai3 zau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药的效力很强，吃完很快就好。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is very effective, you'll get better quickly after taking it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約仲有冇効力㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 zung6 jau5 mou5 haau6 lik6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同还有效力吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this contract still valid?

english_meaning: impeach; to accuse, impeach (an official)
explanation_mandarin: 指古代官吏向上级揭发官员的罪状，请求罢免其职务。
explanation_english: In ancient times, it refers to an official reporting the crimes of another official to a superior and requesting his dismissal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污俾人劾咗落台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 bei2 jan4 haak6 zo2 lok6 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为贪污被人弹劾下台了。
examples.english_sentence: He was impeached and removed from office because of corruption.

mandarin_meaning: 势力; 气势; 状况; 样子
english_meaning: power; influence; momentum; trend; situation; appearance
explanation_mandarin: 指权力、影响力；也指事物发展变化的方向、趋势；还可以指某种状况或样子。
explanation_english: Refers to power, influence; also refers to the direction or trend of the development and changes of things; it can also refer to a certain situation or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有势㗎，唔好得罪佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 sai3 gaa3, m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有势力，不要得罪他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He is very powerful, don't offend him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 个市嘅升势好劲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si5 ge3 sing1 sai3 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市的上涨势头很猛。
examples.english_sentence: The market's rising momentum is strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢个势，似系想走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 go3 sai3, ci5 hai6 soeng2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他的样子，好像是想走。
examples.english_sentence: Judging by his appearance, he seems to want to leave.

mandarin_meaning: 强劲; 厉害; 很棒
english_meaning: strong; powerful; very; awesome; excellent; terrific
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量强大，程度高，或是赞赏某事物非常好，很棒。也可用作副词，表示程度很高。
explanation_english: Describes something strong, powerful, or of high degree. Can also be used to express admiration for something that is very good or awesome. Can also be used as an adverb meaning 'very'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱得好勁啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得非常棒啊！
examples.english_sentence: He sings really well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅引擎好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 jing5 ging6 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的引擎很强劲。
examples.english_sentence: This car's engine is very powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得勁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 ging6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得非常好。
examples.english_sentence: He did extremely well in this exam.

english_meaning: terrible; awful; extremely bad
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或情况非常糟糕，令人不愉快，超出一般差的程度。通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is extremely bad, awful, or terrible. It implies a situation or thing is much worse than just 'bad'. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日考試勁共，我乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 haau2 si3 ging6 gung6, ngo5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的考试太糟糕了，我什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: Today's exam was terrible, I couldn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食勁共，唔好去食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 ging6 gung6, m4 hou2 heoi3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物非常糟糕，不要去吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in that restaurant is terrible, don't go there.

english_meaning: Awesome thing; something amazing; something impressive
explanation_mandarin: 指非常厉害、了不起、令人印象深刻的东西或事情。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is very impressive, amazing, or outstanding. Can refer to a thing, skill, or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話真係勁嘢，影相又靚，速度又快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 ging6 je5, ying2 seung2 jau6 leng3, suk1 dou6 jau6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新手机真是厉害，拍照又好看，速度又快。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone is really awesome, the photos are beautiful and the speed is fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫嘅畫真係勁嘢，好有風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 ge3 waa2 zan1 hai6 ging6 je5, hou2 jau5 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画的画真厉害，很有风格。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings are really amazing, they have a great style.

mandarin_meaning: 厉害; 出众; 拔尖
english_meaning: Awesome; outstanding; excellent; very capable; lucky (in a draw or lottery)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物非常厉害、出色。 也可用于形容某人在抽奖或彩票中运气非常好。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as very awesome, outstanding, or excellent. Can also be used to describe someone who is very lucky in a draw or lottery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞滿分，真係勁抽!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 mun5 fan1, zan1 hai6 ging6 cau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了满分，真是厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got full marks in the exam, he's really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次抽獎我中咗頭獎，勁抽呀!
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 cau1 zoeng2 ngo5 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2, ging6 cau1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次抽奖我中了头奖，太走运了！
examples.english_sentence: I won the first prize in the lottery this time, so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好好食，個廚師好勁抽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 hou2 sik6, go3 ceoi4 si1 hou2 ging6 cau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃，那个厨师很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is very delicious, the chef is very good.

mandarin_meaning: 厉害; 坚强; 坚韧
english_meaning: awesome; impressive; tenacious; resilient; tough; determined; strong-willed
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人非常厉害、了不起，或者形容某事非常困难但仍能坚持下来。强调一种坚韧不拔、永不放弃的精神。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being very impressive, awesome, or resilient. It emphasizes a spirit of perseverance and never giving up, especially in the face of adversity or a difficult situation. Can also describe something particularly impressive or difficult to achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞咗第一名，真係勁揪！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 lo2 zo2 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 ging6 ciu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了第一名，真是厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam, he's really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然情況好差，但佢哋都冇放棄，真係好勁揪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 cing4 fong3 hou2 caa1, daan6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 mou5 fong3 hei3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然情况很糟糕，但他们都没有放弃，真的很坚韧。
examples.english_sentence: Although the situation was bad, they didn't give up, they're really resilient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程咁困難都可以完成，負責嘅團隊真係勁揪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 gam3 kwan3 naan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 wun4 sing4, fu6 zaak3 ge3 teoi1 deoi2 zan1 hai6 ging6 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程这么困难都可以完成，负责的团队真是厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This project was so difficult to complete, the team in charge is really impressive.

english_meaning: formidable opponent; strong rival
explanation_mandarin: 指实力很强的对手，不容易对付的敌人。
explanation_english: Refers to a very strong opponent or enemy who is not easy to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面遇到一個勁敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 jyu6 dou2 jat1 go3 ging6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中遇到了一个强劲的对手。
examples.english_sentence: He met a formidable opponent in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅最大勁敵就係隔籬嗰間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 ging6 dik6 zau6 hai6 gaak3 lei4 go2 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司最大的劲敌就是隔壁那家。
examples.english_sentence: This company's biggest rival is the one next door.

mandarin_meaning: 厉害的东西；劲爆的消息
english_meaning: amazing stuff; juicy news; explosive news; something impressive; something substantial
explanation_mandarin: 指很厉害、很劲爆、很有价值的东西或消息。可以用作名词，也可以形容某事物非常棒。
explanation_english: Refers to something impressive, exciting, or valuable. It can be used as a noun or to describe something as being very good or impressive. It can refer to both physical objects, news, or abstract concepts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日場演唱會有勁料爆呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 coeng3 jin2 wui2 jau5 ging3 liu2 baau3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的演唱会有劲爆的消息！
examples.english_sentence: There's going to be some explosive news at tomorrow's concert!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品真係勁料，功能又多又方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 zan1 hai6 ging3 liu2, gung1 nang4 jau6 do1 jau6 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品真是厉害，功能又多又方便。
examples.english_sentence: This product is really amazing, it has so many functions and it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表演真係勁料，觀眾反應好熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 ging3 liu2, gun1 zung3 faan2 jing3 hou2 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演真是厉害，观众反应很热烈。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was really impressive, the audience's reaction was very enthusiastic.

mandarin_meaning: 强劲的队伍; 精锐部队
english_meaning: strong team; elite force; powerful contingent
explanation_mandarin: 形容实力强大、作战能力强的队伍，通常用于体育比赛、军队等方面。
explanation_english: Describes a team or group that is very strong, with high combat capability, often used in sports competitions or military contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊波真係勁旅嚟㗎，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 bo1 zan1 hai6 ging6 leoi5 lai4 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支球队真是劲旅，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: This team is really a strong team, they win every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅公司喺呢個行業入面係勁旅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 si1 hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 jap6 min6 hai6 ging6 leoi5.

examples.english_sentence: Their company is a powerful force in this industry.

explanation_mandarin: 通常指节奏快、旋律动听、流行的歌曲。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意唱啲勁歌熱舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 coeng3 di1 ging3 go1 jit6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢唱那些劲歌热舞。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to sing energetic songs and dance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲勁歌都幾好聽喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 ging3 go1 dou1 gei2 hou2 teng1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的流行歌曲都挺好听的。
examples.english_sentence: The hit songs these days are quite good.

english_meaning: Awesome movie; Great film; Blockbuster
explanation_mandarin: 指非常精彩，值得观看的电影。
explanation_english: Refers to a movie that is very good, exciting, and worth watching; a blockbuster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係勁片嚟㗎，你一定要睇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 ging6 pin3 lai4 gaa3, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真的是一部很棒的电影，你一定要看！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is truly a great film, you definitely have to watch it!

english_meaning: cocky; arrogant; conceited
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常自大，自以为是，爱炫耀，令人讨厌。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very arrogant, conceited, and loves to show off, often in a way that is annoying or off-putting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度勁秋，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 ging6 cau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.

examples.english_sentence: He's always being cocky, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: Surpass; more powerful than; better than
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某方面超过或胜过对方。形容比…厉害，比…更好。
explanation_english: Indicates surpassing or excelling in a certain aspect. Describes being more powerful, better, or more impressive than someone or something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書勁過我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 ging6 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习比我好很多。
examples.english_sentence: He is much better at studying than me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話嘅功能勁過舊嗰部好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 ge3 gung1 nang4 ging6 gwo3 gau6 go2 bou6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新电话的功能比旧的那部好很多。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone's functions are much better than the old one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機勁過晒啲同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 ging6 gwo3 saai3 di1 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打游戏比所有的同学都厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He is better at playing video games than all of his classmates.

english_meaning: Angry, furious, pissed off
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常生气，怒火中烧的样子。在粤语中是比较粗俗的用法。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely angry, seething with rage. This is a relatively vulgar expression in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢激到我好勃呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik1 dou3 ngo5 hou2 but6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把我气得很生气！
examples.english_sentence: He made me so angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞到我咁勃，我會發癲㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 gam3 but6, ngo5 wui5 faat3 din1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹我这么生气，我会发疯的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make me this angry, I'll go crazy!

english_meaning: vigorous, vibrant, full of life; thriving, flourishing
explanation_mandarin: 形容生命力旺盛，充满活力，事业兴旺发达。
explanation_english: Describes something full of vitality, energetic, or prosperous and thriving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司而家發展得好勃勃呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 but6 but6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司现在发展得很兴旺啊。
examples.english_sentence: His company is now developing very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔精神勃勃，跑來跑去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 zing1 san4 but6 but6, paau2 loi4 paau2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们精神焕发，跑来跑去。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are full of energy, running around.

english_meaning: erection, to get an erection
explanation_mandarin: 指男性阴茎因性兴奋或其他原因而充血变硬的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of a male penis becoming engorged and hardened due to sexual arousal or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇到嗰啲性感相，即刻就勃起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 dou2 go2 di1 sing3 gam2 soeng3, zik1 hak1 zau6 but6 hei2 zo2.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 but6 hei2 gung1 nang4 zoeng3 ngoi6, tai2 zo2 hou2 noi6 ji1 sang1 dou1 mou5 hou2 zyun2.

examples.english_sentence: He has erectile dysfunction and hasn't improved even after seeing doctors for a long time.

english_meaning: brave, courageous, daring
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有胆量，敢于面对困难和危险。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is brave, has courage, and dares to face difficulties and dangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勇㗎，乜嘢都夠膽試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jung2 gaa3, mat1 je5 dou1 gau3 daam2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勇敢的，什么都敢尝试。
examples.english_sentence: He is very brave, he dares to try everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要勇於面對挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jung2 jyu1 min6 deoi3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要勇于面对挑战。
examples.english_sentence: As a person, you should be brave to face challenges.

english_meaning: brave warrior; courageous person; hero
explanation_mandarin: 勇敢的战士；有勇气的人；英雄。
explanation_english: A brave warrior; a courageous person; a hero. Often used to describe someone who faces adversity with bravery and determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺火場救咗好多人，真係一個勇士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo2 coeng4 gau3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 jung2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在火场救了很多人，真是一个勇士。
examples.english_sentence: He saved many people in the fire, he's truly a hero.

explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely tragic and touching, causing tears; can also refer to a storyline or performance that is excessively sentimental or melodramatic, often in a sarcastic way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情真係勒杜鵑，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 zan1 hai6 laak6 dou6 gyun1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.

examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is really heartbreaking, it made my eyes water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勒杜鵑啦，現實邊有咁多嘢㗎。

explanation_english: To obtain something from someone through force or threats; extortion; blackmail.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 laak6 sok3 aa3, jau5 si6 zau6 bou3 ging2.

examples.english_sentence: Don't let anyone blackmail you, report to the police if anything happens.

english_meaning: tighten one's belt
explanation_mandarin: 比喻节省开支，过节俭的生活。
explanation_english: To tighten one's belt; to economize; to live frugally. It implies reducing expenses and living more economically, usually due to financial hardship or anticipating future financial difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年經濟唔好，大家都要勒緊褲頭過日子啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 lak1 gan2 fu3 tau4 gwo3 jat1 zi2 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't doing well this year, everyone needs to tighten their belts and live frugally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸失業之後，我哋全家都要勒緊褲頭先得。

english_meaning: To move, to act, movement, action
explanation_mandarin: 表示移动、行动或开始活动；也可以作为名词，指动作或活动。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to move, to act, or to start an activity. As a noun, it refers to movement or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂動，我幫你影相啊。

english_meaning: at every turn; easily; frequently; to do (something) without thinking; to be prone to (doing something)

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dung6 bat1 dung6 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3, hou2 naan4 soeng1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他动不动就发脾气，很难相处。

explanation_mandarin: 指社会或政治上的骚动、混乱，通常伴随着暴力或不稳定。
explanation_english: Refers to social or political unrest, disorder, and chaos, usually accompanied by violence or instability.

examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 se5 wui2 dung6 lyun6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 geng1.

examples.english_sentence: After the country experienced a period of turmoil, the economy was severely affected.

english_meaning: touching; moving; heart-stirring

explanation_english: Describes something that is deeply moving and touches one's heartstrings.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 想要拍好武打片，找一个好的动作指导很重要。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to make a good martial arts movie, finding a good action choreographer is very important.

english_meaning: action movie
explanation_mandarin: 指以刺激的动作场面为主要内容的电影。

english_meaning: Mobilization capacity; ability to mobilize
explanation_mandarin: 指组织或机构调动人力、物力等资源的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to the capacity of an organization or institution to mobilize manpower, resources, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動土之前要拜神㗎，祈求平安大吉。
