examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病到郁都唔郁，更加唔好講話動彈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dou3 yuk1 dou1 m4 yuk1, gang3 gaa1 m4 hou2 gong2 waa6 dung6 taan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病得动都不能动，更不用说动弹了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so sick he can't even move, let alone stir.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓瞓到死咗咁，點搞都唔動彈嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 fan3 dou3 sei2 zo2 gam2, dim2 gaau2 dou1 m4 dung6 taan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只猫睡得像死了一样，怎么弄都不动弹。
examples.english_sentence: The cat is sleeping like it's dead; it won't budge no matter what you do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車壞咗，點推都唔動彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2, dim2 tui1 dou1 m4 dung6 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车坏了，怎么推都不动弹。
examples.english_sentence: The car is broken; it won't budge no matter how hard you push.

english_meaning: to be moved; to have one's heart stirred; to be tempted; to be attracted (to someone or something)
explanation_mandarin: 心里受到触动，产生好感或欲望。
explanation_english: To have one's heart stirred, to be attracted, or to develop a desire for something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇到佢咁慘，都忍唔住動心想幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2, dou1 jan2 m4住 dung6 sam1 soeng2 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到他这么可怜，都忍不住动心想帮他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how miserable he was, I couldn't help but feel moved to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我咁好，我開始對佢有啲動心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 gam3 hou2, ngo5 hoi1 chi2 deoi3 keoi5 jau5 di1 dung6 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我这么好，我开始对他有点动心了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so good to me, I'm starting to feel attracted to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嘅人工好高，我都幾動心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 gung1 hou2 gou1, ngo5 dou1 gei2 dung6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作的工资很高，我很动心。
examples.english_sentence: The salary for this job is very high, I'm quite tempted.

english_meaning: to get angry, to become enraged
explanation_mandarin: 指因为某事或某人而感到生气或发怒。
explanation_english: Refers to becoming angry or enraged due to something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易動怒啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 dung6 nou6 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易生气了，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get angry so easily, it's not good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日都動怒，搞到啲同事都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 dou1 dung6 nou6, gaau2 dou3 di1 tung4 si6 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是生气，搞得同事们都很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always getting angry, which makes all the colleagues scared.

english_meaning: to be moved (emotionally), to feel tender emotion, to be stirred (emotionally)
explanation_mandarin: 指感情受到触动，产生爱慕、感动等情绪。
explanation_english: To be emotionally moved or touched, often to the point of feeling love, compassion, or other tender emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢咁慘，我都忍唔住動情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou3 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 dung6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么惨，我都忍不住动情了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so miserable, I couldn't help but be moved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅故事好感人，令到好多觀眾都動情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 gu3 si6 hou2 gam2 jan4, ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 gun1 zung3 dou1 dung6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲的故事很感人，让很多观众都动情。
examples.english_sentence: The story he told was very touching, and it moved many viewers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅愛情故事好浪漫，聽到我都動情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 oi3 cing4 gu3 si6 hou2 long4 maan6, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 dung6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的爱情故事很浪漫，听得我都动情了。
examples.english_sentence: Their love story is so romantic, I was moved just listening to it.

english_meaning: dynamic, energetic, sense of dynamism
explanation_mandarin: 指富有活力，充满动力的感觉；也可用作形容词，形容事物充满活力。
explanation_english: Refers to a sense of dynamism, energy, and vitality. Can also be used as an adjective to describe something full of energy and vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻舞好有動感，睇到我都想跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 mou5 hou2 jau5 dung6 gam2, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 soeng2 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支舞很有动感，看得我都想跳。
examples.english_sentence: This dance is very dynamic, it makes me want to dance too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個設計好有動感，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sat3 gai3 hou2 jau5 dung6 gam2, hou2 kap1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计很有动感，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: His design is very dynamic and attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅線條好有動感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 sin3 tiu4 hou2 jau5 dung6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的线条很有动感。
examples.english_sentence: The lines of this car are very dynamic.

english_meaning: dynamic, trend, development, movement, update, activity
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展变化的状态、趋势或情况；也指动态的、变化的。
explanation_english: Refers to the state, trend, or situation of something developing or changing; can also refer to something dynamic or changing. Commonly used in modern contexts like social media, updates, or current trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想睇吓你Facebook嘅最新動態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tai2 haa5 nei5 Facebook ge3 zeoi3 san1 dung6 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想看看你Facebook的最新动态。
examples.english_sentence: I want to see your latest Facebook updates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個市場嘅經濟動態好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si5 coeng4 ge3 ging1 zai3 dung6 taai3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个市场的经济动态很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The economic trends of this market are very complex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅人事動態好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 si6 dung6 taai3 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的人事变动很大。
examples.english_sentence: There's been a lot of staff movement at this company.

english_meaning: to start work; to get to work; to take action; to hit (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 开始做某事；打人。
explanation_english: To start working or doing something; to take action. It can also mean to physically assault or hit someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就考試喇，你都唔動手溫書？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 haau2 si3 laa3, nei5 dou1 m4 dung6 sau2 wan1 syu1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要考试了，你都不开始复习？
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, and you still haven't started studying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好動手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dung6 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要动手啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't hit me! / Don't start a fight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋今日動手整咗個蛋糕佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 dung6 sau2 zing2 zo2 go3 daan6 gou1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们今天开始做蛋糕吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we get to work and make a cake today?

english_meaning: to waver; to falter; to shake; to undermine; to destabilize
explanation_mandarin: 表示发生摇动，或者指信念、决心等变得不坚定。
explanation_english: To shake or move; to become unstable; to waver or falter in one's beliefs, resolve, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅決心從來冇動搖過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kyut3 sam1 cung4 loi4 mou5 dung6 jiu4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的决心从来没有动摇过。
examples.english_sentence: His determination has never wavered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，搞到好多人嘅信心都動搖咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 seon3 sam1 dou1 dung6 jiu4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，导致很多人的信心都动摇了。
examples.english_sentence: The poor economy has shaken many people's confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令到佢喺公司嘅地位開始動搖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 dou3 keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 wai2 hoi1 chi2 dung6 jiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事让他在公司的地位开始动摇。
examples.english_sentence: This event has started to undermine his position in the company.

english_meaning: animals and plants; flora and fauna
explanation_mandarin: 动物和植物的总称。
explanation_english: A collective term for animals and plants; flora and fauna.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個公園有好多唔同種類嘅動植物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 jyun2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 dung6 z植物.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个公园有很多不同种类的动植物。
examples.english_sentence: This park has many different kinds of animals and plants.

english_meaning: motive, intention
explanation_mandarin: 指推动人采取某种行动的原因或意图。
explanation_english: The reason or intention that drives someone to take a particular action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢咁做嘅動機係乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gam2 zou6 ge3 dung6 gei1 hai6 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他这样做的动机是什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what his motive for doing that is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅動機好可疑，你要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 dung6 gei1 hou2 ho2 ji4, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的动机很可疑，你要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: His motives are very suspicious, you need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正喺度調查兇手嘅動機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 hai2 dou6 diu6 caa4 hung1 sau2 ge3 dung6 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在调查凶手的动机。
examples.english_sentence: The police are investigating the murderer's motive.

english_meaning: to resort to violence, to use force
explanation_mandarin: 指使用暴力、武力解决问题或争端。
explanation_english: To resort to physical violence; to use force, especially in a conflict or argument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動，有咩事都唔好動武啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, jau5 me1 si6 dou1 m4 hou2 dung6 mou5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么冲动，有什么事情都不要动武啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive; whatever happens, don't resort to violence!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察警告示威者唔好動武。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 ging2 gou3 si3 wai1 ze2 m4 hou2 dung6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察警告示威者不要动武。
examples.english_sentence: The police warned the protesters not to use violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家冷靜啲，用口解決，唔好動武啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 laang5 zing6 di1, jung6 hau2 gaai2 kyut3, m4 hou2 dung6 mou5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家冷静点，用口解决，不要动武啦。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone calm down, let's resolve it with words, don't resort to violence.

english_meaning: to get angry, to lose one's temper
explanation_mandarin: 指因某事而产生愤怒的情绪，生气，动怒。
explanation_english: To become angry or upset due to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易動氣啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 yi6 dung6 hei3 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易生气，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get angry so easily, it's not good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一聽到佢嘅名就動氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ting1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 ming4 zau6 dung6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一听到他的名字就生气。
examples.english_sentence: I get angry as soon as I hear his name.

english_meaning: anime and manga
explanation_mandarin: 指动画（animation）和漫画（manga）的总称，尤指日本的动画和漫画。
explanation_english: A general term referring to animation (anime) and comics (manga), especially Japanese animation and comics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇日本動漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jat6 bun2 dung6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢看日本动漫。
examples.english_sentence: I really like watching Japanese anime and manga.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅房間貼滿咗動漫海報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fong2 gaan1 tip3 mun5 zo2 dung6 maan6 hoi2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间贴满了动漫海报。
examples.english_sentence: His room is covered with anime and manga posters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年香港都出咗好多本地動漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 nin4 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 dung6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来香港也出了很多本地动漫。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, Hong Kong has also produced a lot of local anime and manga.

english_meaning: animal
explanation_mandarin: 有生命，能感觉和运动的有机体，区别于植物、矿物等。
explanation_english: A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熊貓係一種好得意嘅動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 maa1 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熊猫是一种很可爱的动物。
examples.english_sentence: Pandas are a very cute animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時好鍾意去動物園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 hou2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 dung6 mat6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢去动物园。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I really liked going to the zoo.

english_meaning: Zoo
explanation_mandarin: 饲养各种动物，供人观赏、研究的场所。
explanation_english: A place where animals are kept in enclosures for public exhibition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去動物園睇獅子老虎好唔好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 dung6 mat6 jyun2 tai2 si1 zi2 lou5 fu2 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去动物园看狮子老虎好不好啊？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to the zoo to see lions and tigers tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個動物園有好多唔同嘅動物，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 dung6 mat6 jyun2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 dung6 mat6, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个动物园有很多不同的动物，很有趣的。
examples.english_sentence: That zoo has many different animals, it's very interesting.

english_meaning: to use; to employ; to utilize; to draw on (resources); to mobilise
explanation_mandarin: 使用；调用；启用。
explanation_english: To make use of something, especially resources, funds, or personnel, often for a specific purpose or in a particular situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定動用後備資金去擴充業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 dung6 yung6 hau6 bei5 zi1 gam1 heoi3 kwok3 cung1 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定动用后备资金去扩张业务。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to use reserve funds to expand its business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁易動用你嘅儲蓄，留返嚟應急好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 dung6 yung6 nei5 ge3 chu5 cuk1, lau4 faan1 lei4 ying3 gap1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易动用你的储蓄，留下来应急好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use your savings so easily, it's better to save them for emergencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方動用咗大量人手去調查呢單案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 dung6 yung6 zo2 daai6 leong6 yan4 sau2 heoi3 diu6 cha4 ni1 daan1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方动用了大量人手去调查这单案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police mobilized a large number of personnel to investigate this case.

english_meaning: animation, cartoon
explanation_mandarin: 指通过连续播放一系列静态图像而产生的运动画面，也常指电视或电影中的卡通片。
explanation_english: A motion picture made from a series of drawings, computer graphics, or photographs of inanimate objects posed in a sequence to simulate movement. Often refers to cartoons on television or in movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意睇日本動畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jat6 bun2 dung6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢看日本动画。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I really liked watching Japanese animation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套動畫嘅畫風好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 dung6 waa2 ge3 waa2 fung1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部动画的画风很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The art style of this animation is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想將來可以製作自己嘅動畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 zai3 zok3 zi6 gei2 ge3 dung6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他梦想将来可以制作自己的动画。
examples.english_sentence: He dreams of being able to produce his own animations in the future.

english_meaning: unrest; turmoil; upheaval; instability; turbulence
explanation_mandarin: 指社会、政治、经济等领域不稳定，发生剧烈变化或骚乱。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of instability, turmoil, or upheaval in society, politics, the economy, etc., involving drastic changes or disturbances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年世界局勢好動盪，好多地方都打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 nin4 sai3 gaai3 guk6 sai3 hou2 dung6 tong6, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来世界局势非常动荡，很多地方都在打仗。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, the world situation has been very turbulent, and many places are at war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟動盪會影響到好多人嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gai3 dung6 tong6 wui5 ying2 hoeng2 dou3 hou2 do1 yan4 ge3 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济动荡会影响到很多人的生活。
examples.english_sentence: Economic turmoil will affect the lives of many people.

english_meaning: to get really angry, to lose one's temper
explanation_mandarin: 指真正生气，发怒。
explanation_english: Refers to genuinely getting angry and losing one's temper. It implies a level of anger that is more serious than just being annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再咁樣搞落去，阿頭實動眞火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 gaau2 lok6 heoi3, aa3 tau4 sat1 dung6 zan1 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再这样下去，老板肯定会发火的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep doing things like this, the boss will definitely lose his temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞佢啦，佢就嚟動眞火喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zau6 lai4 dung6 zan1 fo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他了，他快要发火了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with him, he's about to lose it.

english_meaning: To get really angry; to lose one's temper
explanation_mandarin: 指真的生气了，气到失去理智，控制不住自己的情绪。
explanation_english: Refers to becoming genuinely angry, to the point of losing one's reason and being unable to control one's emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就要動真火㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 ting1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 dung6 zan1 fo2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我真的要生气了！

english_meaning: to start writing; to put pen to paper

explanation_english: To begin writing; to start putting ideas down on paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗好耐都未動筆寫篇嘢。

english_meaning: to resort to violence, to use force, to get physical

explanation_english: Refers to resorting to violence or physical force to solve a problem or express anger.

examples.english_sentence: He likes to resort to violence whenever he gets angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講道理啦，唔好動粗，大家坐低慢慢傾。

examples.english_sentence: Let's be reasonable, don't get physical, let's sit down and talk it over.

english_meaning: Traffic flow, flow line, circulation route (in design, architecture, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指人在某个空间内的移动轨迹和路线，常用于设计、建筑等领域，强调人流的走向和分布。
explanation_english: Refers to the movement trajectory and route of people in a certain space, commonly used in design, architecture, etc., emphasizing the direction and distribution of pedestrian traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭嘅動線設計得唔好，搞到啲客好難行。

examples.english_sentence: The traffic flow design of this shop is poor, making it difficult for customers to move around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師要考慮埋觀眾嘅動線，確保大家可以順利咁睇完展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gai3 si1 jiu3 hau2 leoi6 maai4 gun1 zung2 ge3 dung6 sin3, kok3 bou2 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 gam2 tai2 jyun4 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 设计师要考虑到观众的行动路线，确保大家可以顺利地看完展览。
examples.english_sentence: The designer needs to consider the flow of visitors to ensure everyone can smoothly view the exhibition.

english_meaning: pleasant to hear; melodious; sweet-sounding
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音悦耳，好听。
explanation_english: Describing a sound that is pleasant to the ear and melodious.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很好听，我忍不住重播了很多次。
examples.english_sentence: This song is so pleasant to hear that I couldn't help but replay it many times.

english_meaning: kinetic energy
explanation_mandarin: 物体因运动而具有的能量。
explanation_english: The energy that an object possesses due to its motion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車加速嘅時候，佢嘅動能就會增加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ga1 suk1 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 ge3 dung6 nang4 zau6 wui5 zang1 gaa1.

examples.english_sentence: When a car accelerates, its kinetic energy increases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波嘅動能好大，所以撞擊力都好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 ge3 dung6 nang4 hou2 daai6, so2 ji5 zong6 gik1 lik6 dou1 hou2 ging6.

examples.english_sentence: This ball has a lot of kinetic energy, so the impact force is very strong.

english_meaning: artery
explanation_mandarin: 输送血液离开心脏的血管。
explanation_english: A blood vessel that conveys blood from the heart to any part of the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢條動脈塞咗，要做手術通返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 tiu4 dung6 mak6 sak1 zo2, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 tung1 faan1.

examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his artery is blocked and he needs surgery to clear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 高血壓對動脈嘅損害好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gou1 hyut3 aat3 deoi3 dung6 mak6 ge3 syun2 hoi6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高血压对动脉的损害很大。
examples.english_sentence: High blood pressure causes great damage to arteries.

english_meaning: Aneurysm
explanation_mandarin: 动脉血管壁的局部异常扩张，形状像瘤状突起。
explanation_english: An aneurysm is a localized, abnormal dilation of a blood vessel, usually an artery, resulting from a weakening of the vessel wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢檢查嘅時候發現咗腦部有個動脈瘤。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在检查的时候发现了脑部有个动脉瘤。
examples.english_sentence: During the examination, they discovered an aneurysm in his brain.

english_meaning: to use one's brains, to think, to rack one's brains, to use ingenuity
explanation_mandarin: 开动脑筋，想办法解决问题。
explanation_english: To use one's brain, think hard, or be resourceful in order to solve a problem or achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到問題要動腦筋諗吓點樣解決。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到问题要动脑筋想想怎样解决。
examples.english_sentence: When you encounter a problem, you need to use your brain and think about how to solve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得動腦筋搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 dung6 nou5 gan1 wan2 cin2.

examples.english_sentence: He's very good at using his brains to make money.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 hou2 naan4, jiu3 dung6 haa5 nou5 gan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道数学题很难，要动动脑筋才行。
examples.english_sentence: This math problem is difficult; you need to use your brain a bit to solve it.

english_meaning: Turbulent, unstable, unsettled
explanation_mandarin: 形容局势、社会、政治等不稳定，经常发生变动。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世界局勢持續動蕩，令到好多人都感到不安。

english_meaning: motion; to propose a motion

explanation_english: A formal proposal made in a meeting or assembly for discussion and voting. It can also be used as a verb, meaning to propose a motion.

english_meaning: to set off; to start a journey; to depart

explanation_english: To begin a journey; to set off; to start moving towards a destination.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 zau6 dung6 san1 heoi3 jat6 bun2 laa1.

english_meaning: easily; readily; at the slightest provocation; often

explanation_english: Indicates that a certain behavior occurs or a certain situation arises easily or frequently at the slightest provocation or circumstance.

examples.english_sentence: This computer often freezes; it's very troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲鬧佢啦，佢動輒就會喊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 naau6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dung6 zaak6 zau6 wui5 haam3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大声地骂他，他动不动就会哭的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him so loudly, he will cry easily.

mandarin_meaning: 动辄得咎 (dòng zhé dé jiù)
english_meaning: To be easily faulted; to be prone to making mistakes and being criticized; to be in a precarious situation where one is liable to err whatever one does.
explanation_mandarin: 指一举一动都容易犯错误，受到责难。形容处境困难，稍有不慎就会遭到责备。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one is easily faulted for any action or decision, constantly facing criticism and blame. It implies a difficult and precarious position where even minor mistakes can lead to severe consequences.

examples.english_sentence: Working in this company is really a situation where you're easily faulted; the boss is very strict.

examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6 jin4 hang4 geoi2 zi2 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hai6 zau6 hou2 jung4 ji6 dung6 zaak6 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治人物的言行举止都要小心，不然就很容易动辄得咎。
examples.english_sentence: Politicians' words and actions must be careful, otherwise it is very easy to be easily faulted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係好緊張，好似動輒得咎噉，乜都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, hou2 ci5 dung6 zaak6 dak1 gau3 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系很紧张，好像动辄得咎似的，什么都不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is very tense, as if they're in a situation where they're easily faulted, afraid to say anything.

english_meaning: momentum

explanation_english: In physics, momentum is the product of the mass and velocity of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嘅動量好大，所以好難停低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ge3 dung6 loeng6 hou2 daai6, so2 ji5 hou2 naan4 ting4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的动量很大，所以很难停下来。
examples.english_sentence: The car has a lot of momentum, so it's hard to stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 增加跑步嘅動量，可以跑得更快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zang1 gaa1 paau2 bou6 ge3 dung6 loeng6, ho2 ji5 paau2 dak1 gang3 faai3.

examples.english_sentence: Increasing your momentum while running can make you run faster.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要搞出这么大的动静，免得被人发现。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make such a big noise, lest you be discovered.

explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常惊险，使人内心受到极大的震撼。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個場車禍實在太動魄驚心，我到依家都仲未定過神嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 coeng4 ce1 wo6 sat6 zoi6 taai3 dung6 paak3 ging1 sam1, ngo5 dou3 ji1 gaa1 dou1 zung6 mei6 ding6 gwo3 san4 lai4.
