examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要勘察下個地盤先，睇下啱唔啱起樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 ham1 caat3 haa5 go3 dei6 pun4 sin1, tai2 haa5 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 hei2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要勘察一下那个地盘，看看是否适合盖楼。
examples.english_sentence: We need to survey that site first to see if it's suitable for building construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程隊會勘察山坡，確保安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 deoi2 wui5 ham1 caat3 saan1 po1, kok3 bou2 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程队会勘察山坡，确保安全。
examples.english_sentence: The engineering team will survey the hillside to ensure safety.

english_meaning: exploration, prospecting, surveying
explanation_mandarin: 为了寻找矿藏、石油等资源而进行的调查和探测。
explanation_english: To explore or prospect for mineral deposits, oil, etc.; to survey an area for resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋而家去緊南海勘探石油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 gan2 naam4 hoi2 ham3 taam3 sik6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们现在去南海勘探石油。
examples.english_sentence: They are now exploring for oil in the South China Sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個團隊負責勘探新嘅礦藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi2 fu3 zaak3 ham3 taam3 san1 ge3 kwong3 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个团队负责勘探新的矿藏。
examples.english_sentence: This team is responsible for exploring new mineral deposits.

english_meaning: Feng shui, geomancy
explanation_mandarin: 指观察地理环境来选择建筑物或墓地的位置，以求吉祥。
explanation_english: The Chinese art and science of placement and arrangement of space to achieve harmony with the environment. Also known as geomancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗個風水先生嚟勘輿，睇吓間屋嘅風水好唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cheng2 zo2 go3 fung1 seoi2 sin1 saang1 lai4 ham1 jyu4, tai2 haa5 gaan1 uk1 ge3 fung1 seoi2 hou2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了个风水先生来勘舆，看看房子的风水好不好。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a Feng Shui master to do Feng Shui and see if the house has good Feng Shui.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓之前最好請人勘輿，揀個好嘅方位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau2 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 cheng2 yan4 ham1 jyu4, gaan2 go3 hou2 ge3 fong1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖楼之前最好请人勘舆，选个好的方位。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to hire someone to do Feng Shui before building a house to choose a good location.

english_meaning: affairs; business; must; be sure to
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情、业务、职责等。也可以表示一定要做到。
explanation_english: Refers to matters, business, responsibilities, etc. It can also mean to be sure to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好忙，好多公務要處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 mong4, hou2 do1 gung1 mou6 jiu3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很忙，有很多公务要处理。
examples.english_sentence: He is very busy and has a lot of official business to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務必要準時到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 bit1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你务必要准时到。
examples.english_sentence: You must arrive on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅業務發展得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 mou6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的业务发展得很好。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business is developing very well.

english_meaning: must; be sure to; definitely; make sure
explanation_mandarin: 表示一定要做到或达到某种目的。强调必要性或确定性。
explanation_english: Indicates the necessity or certainty of achieving a specific goal. Emphasizes the importance of ensuring something happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務使準時到啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 sai2 zeon2 si4 dou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你务必准时到啊！
examples.english_sentence: You must be sure to arrive on time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，我務使要合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, ngo5 mou6 sai2 jiu3 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，我务必及格。
examples.english_sentence: For this exam, I definitely have to pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得鎖門啊，務使啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 so2 mun4 aa3, mou6 sai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得锁门啊，务必啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door, make sure you do!

english_meaning: pragmatic, practical, realistic
explanation_mandarin: 注重实际，不空想，不追求虚名。
explanation_english: Focusing on practical concerns and results; down-to-earth; realistic; concerned with what is achievable rather than abstract ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好務實㗎，唔會講埋啲冇謂嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 mou6 sat6 gaa3, m4 wui5 gong2 maai4 di1 mou5 wai6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很务实，不会说那些没用的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is very pragmatic in his work and doesn't talk nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃好務實，應該可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 mou6 sat6, ying1 goi1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划很务实，应该可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very practical and should be successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁理想主義啦，要務實啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lei5 soeng2 zyu2 ji3 laa1, jiu3 mou6 sat6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么理想主义了，要务实一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so idealistic, be more pragmatic.

english_meaning: must, be sure to, definitely
explanation_mandarin: 表示一定要做到，强调重要性和必要性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something must be done, emphasizing its importance and necessity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務必要準時到啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 bit1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 dou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你务必要准时到啊！
examples.english_sentence: You must be on time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我務必要完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou6 bit1 jiu3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我务必要完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: I definitely must complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務必要小心身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 bit1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你务必要小心身体。
examples.english_sentence: You must take care of your health.

english_meaning: strive to; make every effort to; be sure to; aim to
explanation_mandarin: 表示尽力达到某种目的，必须做到。
explanation_english: Indicates making every effort to achieve a certain goal; must be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋務求喺deadline之前交齊功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mou6 kau4 hai2 deadline zi1 cin4 gaau1 cai4 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们务必在截止日期之前交齐作业。
examples.english_sentence: We must be sure to submit all the homework before the deadline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次一定要成功，務求做到最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing4 gung1, mou6 kau4 zou6 dou3 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次一定要成功，力求做到最好。
examples.english_sentence: We must succeed this time, and strive to do our best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢務求考入大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou6 kau4 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他务求考入大学。
examples.english_sentence: He aims to get into university.

english_meaning: to farm, to engage in agriculture
explanation_mandarin: 从事农业生产活动。
explanation_english: To work as a farmer; to engage in agricultural activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人都係務農嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 dou1 hai6 mou6 nung4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家都是务农的。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family are farmers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好多後生都唔想務農啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 dou1 m4 soeng2 mou6 nung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人都不是很想务农了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people don't want to be farmers.

english_meaning: must, have to, be sure to
explanation_mandarin: 表示一定要，强调必须要做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates necessity or obligation; emphasizes that something must be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務須喺deadline前交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 seoi1 hai2 deadline cin4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你必须在截止日期前交作业。
examples.english_sentence: You must submit your homework before the deadline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你務須小心啲，呢條路好滑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou6 seoi1 siu2 sam1 di1, ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 waat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你务必要小心点，这条路很滑。
examples.english_sentence: You must be careful, this road is very slippery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日嘅會議你務須出席呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ge3 wui6 ji5 nei5 mou6 seoi1 ceot1 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的会议你务必出席啊。
examples.english_sentence: You must attend tomorrow's meeting.

english_meaning: merit; achievement; distinguished service
explanation_mandarin: 指在事业上的贡献和成就。
explanation_english: Refers to contributions and achievements in a career or undertaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢立咗唔少勛呀，升職係應份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lap6 zo2 m4 siu2 fan1 aa3, sing1 zik1 hai6 jing3 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他立了不少功勋，升职是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: He has achieved a lot of merits, so a promotion is deserved.

english_meaning: medal; decoration; order
explanation_mandarin: 表示功绩或荣誉的标志，通常是金属制成，佩戴在衣服上。
explanation_english: A badge of honor or merit, usually made of metal and worn on clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為喺奧運攞到金牌，所以得到政府頒發嘅勛章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 hai2 ou3 wan6 lo2 dou3 gam1 paai4, so2 ji5 dak1 dou3 zing3 fu2 baan1 faat3 ge3 fan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他在奥运会上获得了金牌，所以得到了政府颁发的勋章。
examples.english_sentence: Because he won a gold medal at the Olympics, he received a medal from the government.

english_meaning: Titles of Honour; Honours and Awards
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或机构颁发的荣誉称号和头衔，通常是对有杰出贡献或成就的人的表彰。
explanation_english: Refers to titles of honour and awards conferred by governments or institutions, usually in recognition of outstanding contributions or achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗好多勛銜，真係好叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 hou2 do1 fan1 haam4, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他获得了许多勋衔，真是很了不起。
examples.english_sentence: He received many titles of honour, he's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅授勛典禮頒咗好多個勛銜俾社會上有貢獻嘅人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 sau6 fan1 din2 lai5 baan1 zo2 hou2 do1 go3 fan1 haam4 bei2 se5 wui2 soeng5 jau5 gung3 hiun3 ge3 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的授勋典礼颁发了很多勋衔给对社会有贡献的人士。
examples.english_sentence: This year's honours presentation ceremony awarded many titles of honour to people who have contributed to society.

english_meaning: to win; to triumph; to be victorious; to excel; to surpass
explanation_mandarin: 指在竞争或对抗中取得优胜，战胜对手，或在某方面超过他人。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving victory in a competition or confrontation, defeating an opponent, or surpassing others in a particular aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波終於勝咗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deui2 bo1 zung1 jyu1 sing3 zo2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队终于赢了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team finally won!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑步勝過好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 bou6 sing3 gwo3 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑步比很多人都快。
examples.english_sentence: He runs faster than many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽我哋一定要勝！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sing3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们一定要赢！
examples.english_sentence: We must win this competition!

jyutping: sing3 bat1 giu1, baai6 bat1 neoi5
mandarin_meaning: 胜不骄，败不馁 (shèng bù jiāo, bài bù něi)
english_meaning: Don't be arrogant in victory, don't be discouraged in defeat.
explanation_mandarin: 即使胜利了也不骄傲自满，即使失败了也不灰心丧气。形容一种积极向上的心态，无论结果如何都能保持平常心和继续努力。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes maintaining a positive attitude: not becoming arrogant or complacent when winning, and not losing heart or becoming discouraged when losing. It emphasizes the importance of perseverance and humility regardless of the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽嘅輸贏唔係最重要，最緊要係做到勝不驕，敗不餒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 ge3 syu1 jeng4 m4 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zou6 dou3 sing3 bat1 giu1, baai6 bat1 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛的输赢不是最重要的，最重要的是做到胜不骄，败不馁。
examples.english_sentence: Winning or losing the competition isn't the most important thing; the most important thing is to be able to remain humble in victory and not be discouraged in defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都好努力，就算上次考試考得唔好，佢都勝不驕，敗不餒，繼續努力溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6, zau6 syun3 soeng6 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, keoi5 dou1 sing3 bat1 giu1, baai6 bat1 neoi5, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都很努力，就算上次考试考得不好，他也胜不骄，败不馁，继续努力复习。
examples.english_sentence: He's always been very hardworking. Even though he didn't do well on the last exam, he didn't become arrogant or discouraged, and continued to study hard.

english_meaning: to win by unfair means; an ignoble victory
explanation_mandarin: 指取得胜利，但手段不够光明正大，不够光荣。
explanation_english: Describes winning a victory, but through methods that are not honourable, fair, or sportsmanlike. The victory is considered tainted because of the means used to achieve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠出貓考到第一名，就算贏都係勝之不武啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 chut1 maau1 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zau6 syun3 wing4 dou1 hai6 sing3 zi1 bat1 mou5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠作弊考到第一名，就算赢也是胜之不武。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated to get first place, even if he won, it's still a victory by unfair means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我用大人嘅身份去欺負小朋友，就算贏咗都係勝之不武。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 yung6 dai6 jan4 ge3 san1 fan2 heoi3 hei1 fu2 siu2 pang4 jau5, zau6 syun3 wing4 zo2 dou1 hai6 sing3 zi1 bat1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我用大人的身份去欺负小朋友，就算赢了也是胜之不武。
examples.english_sentence: If I use my adult status to bully a child, even if I win, it's still an ignoble victory.

synonyms: 乘人之危 (sing4 yan4 zi1 ngai4)
以大欺小 (ji5 daai6 hei1 siu2)

english_meaning: competent; qualified; capable; to be equal to a task
explanation_mandarin: 指能够胜过或胜当某种职务或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to being capable of successfully performing a certain duty or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得我勝任呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 sing3 jam6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得我胜任这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: I think I am competent for this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅能力絕對可以勝任呢個職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 zeut6 deoi3 ho2 ji5 sing3 jam6 ni1 go3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的能力绝对可以胜任这个职位。
examples.english_sentence: His ability is definitely qualified for this position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得自己勝任做父母嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 sing3 jam6 zou6 fu6 mou5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得自己胜任做父母吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you are capable of being parents?

english_meaning: to win, to emerge victorious, to prevail
explanation_mandarin: 在竞争或比赛中获得胜利，超出其他竞争者。
explanation_english: To win or be victorious in a competition, surpassing other competitors; to prevail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺今次嘅比賽度勝出咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 dou6 sing3 ceot1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这次的比赛中胜出了。
examples.english_sentence: He won in this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成功勝出咗呢個項目嘅投標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 gung1 sing3 ceot1 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 tau4 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司成功胜出了这个项目的投标。
examples.english_sentence: This company successfully won the bid for this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過重重困難，我哋終於勝出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 cung4 cung4 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 sing3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过重重困难，我们终于胜出。
examples.english_sentence: After overcoming many difficulties, we finally prevailed.

english_meaning: victory, triumph
explanation_mandarin: 战胜对方，取得最终的成功。
explanation_english: The act of winning a battle, game, or competition; triumph or success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定會攞到最後嘅勝利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 lo2 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 sing3 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定会取得最后的胜利！
examples.english_sentence: We will definitely achieve the final victory!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾年嘅努力，佢終於獲得咗事業上嘅勝利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 wok6 dak1 zo2 si6 jip6 soeng6 ge3 sing3 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几年的努力，他终于获得了事业上的胜利。
examples.english_sentence: After several years of hard work, he finally achieved victory in his career.

mandarin_meaning: 赢家球迷 / 墙头草球迷
english_meaning: Bandwagon fan / Glory hunter
explanation_mandarin: 指只在某支队伍或个人表现出色、获得胜利时才支持他们的球迷。当队伍或个人表现不佳时，他们可能会转而支持其他表现更好的队伍或个人。含有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a fan who only supports a team or individual when they are successful or winning. When the team or individual performs poorly, they may switch their support to another team or individual who is performing better. This term is often used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明係勝利球迷嚟㗎，邊隊勁就撐邊隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 sing3 lei6 kiu4 mei4 lei4 gaa3, bin1 deoi2 ging6 zau6 caang1 bin1 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明就是个赢家球迷，哪队厉害就支持哪队。
examples.english_sentence: He's obviously a bandwagon fan, he supports whichever team is strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做勝利球迷啦，支持一隊波要一直支持落去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 sing3 lei6 kiu4 mei4 laa1, zi1 chi4 jat1 deoi2 bo1 jiu3 jat1 zik6 zi1 chi4 lok6 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做赢家球迷啦，支持一支球队要一直支持下去的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a glory hunter, you should support a team consistently.

english_meaning: to have full assurance of victory; to have victory within one's grasp
explanation_mandarin: 比喻很有把握取得胜利。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to be certain of success; to have complete confidence in winning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋準備得咁充足，今次比賽一定勝券在握啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 dak1 gam3 cung1 zuk1, gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 jat1 ding6 sing3 gyun3 zoi6 ak1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们准备得这么充分，这次比赛一定胜券在握了！
examples.english_sentence: We've prepared so thoroughly, we're sure to win this competition!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅實力咁強，攞冠軍簡直勝券在握。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat6 lik6 gam3 koeng4, lo2 gun1 gwan3 gaan2 zik6 sing3 gyun3 zoi6 ak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的实力这么强，拿冠军简直胜券在握。
examples.english_sentence: His strength is so strong that winning the championship is practically guaranteed.

synonyms: 穩操勝算 (wan2 cou1 sing3 syun3)

english_meaning: Brother Sing (a respectful way to address someone named Sing)
explanation_mandarin: “勝哥”是对姓名为“胜”或者名字中带有“胜”的人的一种亲切且尊敬的称呼，表示尊重和友好，通常用于非正式场合。
explanation_english: "Sing Gor" is a friendly and respectful way to address someone whose surname is Sing or whose given name contains "Sing." It expresses respect and friendliness and is usually used in informal situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，勝哥，好耐冇見，近排點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sing3 go1, hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, gan6 paai2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，胜哥，好久不见，最近怎么样啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Brother Sing, long time no see! How have you been lately?

synonyms: 先生 (sin1 saang1) - in a formal setting

english_meaning: The advantage lies in; The strength is in; Good thing about it is
explanation_mandarin: 表示优点、长处在于某个方面。
explanation_english: Indicates that the advantage or strength lies in a certain aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車勝在夠慳油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 sing3 zoi6 gau3 haan1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的优点在于够省油。
examples.english_sentence: The good thing about this car is that it's very fuel-efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢勝在夠勤力，所以先咁成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 zoi6 gau3 kan4 lik6, so2 ji5 sin1 gam2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的长处在于足够勤奋，所以才这么成功。
examples.english_sentence: His strength is that he is hard-working enough, that's why he's so successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳勝在價錢夠平，所以好多人幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing3 zoi6 gaa3 cin2 gau3 peng4, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的优势在于价格便宜，所以很多人光顾。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's advantage is its cheap price, so many people patronize it.

english_meaning: Scenic spot; place of interest; famous scenic spot
explanation_mandarin: 风景优美或具有历史意义的地方。
explanation_english: A place of outstanding scenic beauty or historical significance; a famous scenic spot; a place of interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多旅遊勝地，每年都吸引好多遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 leoi5 jau4 sing3 dei6, mui5 nin4 dou1 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 jau4 hak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多旅游胜地，每年都吸引很多游客。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many tourist attractions, attracting many tourists every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗日本嘅旅遊勝地旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 ge3 leoi5 jau4 sing3 dei6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了日本的旅游胜地旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They went to Japan's scenic spots for travelling.

english_meaning: winning situation; game-winning position; victory
explanation_mandarin: 指已经取得优势，胜利在望的局面。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where one has gained an advantage and victory is within sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經攞咗勝局，唔使咁擔心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 lo2 zo2 sing3 guk6, m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经占据胜局了，不用那么担心了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already secured a winning position, so there's no need to worry so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟呢場波我哋佔晒勝局喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 ni1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 zim3晒sing3 guk6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来这场球赛我们完全占据了胜局。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like we completely dominate this ball game.

english_meaning: countless, innumerable, beyond count
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，多到无法数清楚。
explanation_english: Describes a quantity that is so large that it is impossible to count; countless, innumerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式種類勝數，真係唔知揀邊樣好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 zung2 leoi6 sing3 sou3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 gaan2 bin1 joeng2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜式种类数不胜数，真不知道选哪个好。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has countless types of dishes, I really don't know which to choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次演唱會嘅飛好搶手，排隊嘅人勝數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 fei1 hou2 coeng2 sau2, paai4 deoi2 ge3 jan4 sing3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次演唱会的票很抢手，排队的人数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: The tickets for this concert are very popular, the number of people queuing is countless.

english_meaning: loofah, silk squash, sponge gourd
explanation_mandarin: 一种蔬菜，果实呈长条状，成熟后内部纤维发达，可以用来洗澡或刷碗。
explanation_english: A type of vegetable. The fruit is long and cylindrical. When ripe, the interior develops a fibrous network and can be used as a sponge for bathing or washing dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗條勝瓜煮晚餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 tiu4 sing3 gwaa1 zyu2 daan1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一条丝瓜做晚餐。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a loofah today to cook for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勝瓜炒蛋好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 gwaa1 caau2 daan2 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 丝瓜炒蛋很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: Stir-fried loofah with eggs is very delicious!

english_meaning: odds of winning; chance of success
explanation_mandarin: 获胜的可能性；成功的几率。
explanation_english: The probability of winning; the chance of success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋贏嘅勝算唔大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wing4 ge3 sing3 syun3 m4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们赢的胜算不大。
examples.english_sentence: Our chances of winning are not great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有信心，覺得自己勝算好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 sing3 syun3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有信心，觉得自己的胜算很高。
examples.english_sentence: He is very confident and thinks his chances of winning are very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過周詳嘅計劃，我哋嘅勝算增加咗唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 zau1 cheung4 ge3 gai3 waak6, ngo5 dei6 ge3 sing3 syun3 zeng1 ga1 zo2 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过周详的计划，我们的胜算增加了不少。
examples.english_sentence: After careful planning, our odds of winning have increased significantly.

jyutping: sing3 ze2 wai4 wong4, baai6 ze2 wai4 kau3
english_meaning: The winner is king, the loser is bandit; might makes right.
explanation_mandarin: 胜利的人就是王，失败的人就是强盗。形容在斗争中，胜利者拥有一切，失败者一无所有，也常指历史是由胜利者书写的。
explanation_english: The winner becomes the king, and the loser becomes the bandit. This idiom means that in a struggle, the winner takes all and the loser loses everything. It also often implies that history is written by the victors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界就係咁，勝者為王，敗者為寇，你輸咗就冇得怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zau6 hai6 gam2, sing3 ze2 wai4 wong4, baai6 ze2 wai4 kau3, nei5 syu1 zo2 zau6 mou5 dak1 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界就是这样，胜者为王，败者为寇，你输了就没得抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: That's just the way the world is, the winner is king, the loser is bandit. If you lose, you have nothing to complain about.

jyutping: sing3 ze2 wai4 wong4, baai6 ze2 wai4 kau3
english_meaning: The winner is king, the loser is bandit.
explanation_mandarin: 指在竞争中，胜利者会得到一切，而失败者则会被视为罪犯。强调结果的重要性。
explanation_english: This idiom means that in competition, the winner takes all and is justified, while the loser is condemned and treated as a criminal. It emphasizes the importance of victory regardless of the means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界就係咁㗎啦，勝者爲王，敗者爲寇，你唔贏就乜都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, sing3 ze2 wai4 wong4, baai6 ze2 wai4 kau3, nei5 m4 wing4 zau6 mat1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界就是这样的，胜者为王，败者为寇，你不赢就什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: That's just how the world is. The winner is king, the loser is bandit. If you don't win, you'll have nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上面，勝者爲王，敗者爲寇，競爭好激烈㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6 min6, sing3 ze2 wai4 wong4, baai6 ze2 wai4 kau3, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，胜者为王，败者为寇，竞争很激烈的。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, it's the winner takes all, and the competition is very fierce.

english_meaning: Pizza Hut (Hong Kong slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口语，将连锁快餐店必胜客的“胜”字提取出来，并加上后缀“记”来指代必胜客。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang, derived from the first character '勝' (sing3) of the Chinese name for Pizza Hut, combined with the suffix '記' (gei3) to refer to Pizza Hut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去勝記食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sing3 gei3 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去必胜客吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Pizza Hut for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日去勝記開生日會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 sing3 gei3 hoi1 saang1 jat6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去必胜客开生日会。
examples.english_sentence: I used to go to Pizza Hut for my birthday parties when I was a kid.

english_meaning: to win a lawsuit
explanation_mandarin: 在诉讼中获得胜利，法院判决对己方有利。
explanation_english: To win a case in court; to have a favorable judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打官司打咗好耐，終於都勝訴喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 gun1 si1 daa2 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 dou1 sing3 sou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打官司打了很久，终于都胜诉了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been in court for a long time, and they finally won the case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋嘅證據夠充分，我哋應該可以勝訴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zing3 geoi3 gau3 cung1 fan1, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 sing3 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们的证据足够充分，我们应该可以胜诉的。
examples.english_sentence: If our evidence is sufficient, we should be able to win the case.

english_meaning: victory and defeat; outcome; result; to win or lose
explanation_mandarin: 指输赢，结果。
explanation_english: Refers to winning and losing, the result or outcome of a competition or contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波嘅勝負好難講㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ge3 sing3 fu6 hou2 naan4 gong2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛的胜负很难说啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to say who will win this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁計較勝負啦，最緊要玩得開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gai3 giu3 sing3 fu6 laa1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 waan2 dak1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么计较胜负啦，最重要的是玩得开心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much about winning or losing, the most important thing is to have fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勝負乃兵家常事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 fu6 naai5 bing1 gaa1 soeng4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胜败乃兵家常事。
examples.english_sentence: Victory and defeat are common occurrences for soldiers.

english_meaning: labor; toil; exertion; fatigue; trouble; bother
explanation_mandarin: 表示辛苦，操劳，或者客套话，表示麻烦别人。
explanation_english: Indicates hard work, toil, or a polite expression indicating trouble or inconvenience caused to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該晒！真係勞你費心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3! zan1 hai6 lou4 nei5 fai3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太感谢了！真是有劳你费心了。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much! You've really gone to a lot of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗一日嘢，好勞呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 jat1 jat6 je5, hou2 lou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了一天活，好累啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm so tired after working all day!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，勞煩你幫我攞份文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, lou4 faan4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 fan6 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，麻烦你帮我拿份文件。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could you trouble yourself to get me the document?

english_meaning: handicraft, manual work, arts and crafts
explanation_mandarin: 指用手制作的东西，通常指比较简单的手工制品。
explanation_english: Refers to things made by hand, typically simple handcrafted items; also can refer to the activity of doing arts and crafts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意上勞作堂，整好多嘢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2 hou2 zung1 ji3 soeng5 lou4 zok3 tong4, zing2 hou2 do1 je5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢上劳作课，做很多东西玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I really liked going to arts and crafts class and making a lot of things to play with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友喺度做緊勞作，好開心咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 lou4 zok3, hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友们在做手工，看起来很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: The children are doing arts and crafts, they look very happy.

english_meaning: manual labour; physical labour
explanation_mandarin: 指需要付出较多体力的工作。
explanation_english: Refers to work that requires a significant amount of physical effort or exertion; manual labour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工都係勞力嘅，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 dou1 hai6 lou4 lik6 ge3, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作是体力劳动，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is all manual labour, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠勞力搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 lou4 lik6 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠体力劳动谋生。
examples.english_sentence: He makes a living through manual labour.

english_meaning: Rolex
explanation_mandarin: 瑞士著名手表品牌劳力士，通常也用来泛指昂贵的手表。
explanation_english: Rolex, a famous Swiss watch brand. It is also commonly used to refer to expensive watches in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻勞力士好貴㗎，要成十幾萬蚊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 lou4 lik6 si6 hou2 gwai3 gaa3, jiu3 seng4 sap6 gei2 maan6 man1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的劳力士很贵，要十几万块钱！
examples.english_sentence: His Rolex is very expensive, it costs over a hundred thousand dollars!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為戴住勞力士就叻晒，謙虛啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 daai3 zyu6 lou4 lik6 si6 zau6 lek3晒，him1 heoi1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为戴着劳力士就很了不起，谦虚一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're all that just because you're wearing a Rolex, be more humble.

english_meaning: to trouble (someone); to impose upon; to request assistance; labour; work
explanation_mandarin: 1. 动词：麻烦，烦劳。 2. 名词：体力劳动，工作。
explanation_english: 1. Verb: to trouble someone; to impose upon; used as a polite expression when asking for help or requesting something. 2. Noun: physical labour; work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，勞動你幫我拎啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, lou4 dung6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，麻烦你帮我拿些东西。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry to trouble you, but could you help me carry some things?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辛苦勞動咗一日，真係好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 fu2 lou4 dung6 zo2 jat1 jat6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辛苦劳动了一天，真的很累。
examples.english_sentence: After a hard day's work, I'm really tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該勞動你幫我check下個email。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 lou4 dung6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 check1 haa5 go3 email1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我查看一下那个邮件。
examples.english_sentence: Please trouble yourself to check that email for me.

english_meaning: labor force; manpower
explanation_mandarin: 指从事生产或提供服务的人口数量及能力。
explanation_english: The number of people available for and capable of work in a particular area or economy; manpower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅勞動力老化問題越來越嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lou4 dung6 lik6 lou5 faa3 man6 tai4 jyuet6 lai4 jyuet6 gim2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的劳动力老化问题越来越严重。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's aging workforce problem is becoming increasingly serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠需要大量勞動力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 loeng6 lou4 dung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂需要大量的劳动力。
examples.english_sentence: This factory needs a large labor force.

english_meaning: Labour Day, May Day
explanation_mandarin: 庆祝劳动者贡献的节日，通常在五月一日。
explanation_english: A holiday celebrated to acknowledge the contributions of labourers, typically on May 1st.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞動節放假，我哋去咗長洲玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 dung6 zit3 fong3 gaa3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 coeng4 zau1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳动节放假，我们去了长洲玩。
examples.english_sentence: We went to Cheung Chau for fun during the Labour Day holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你勞動節有咩計劃呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou4 dung6 zit3 jau5 me1 gai3 waak6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你劳动节有什么计划吗？
examples.english_sentence: What are your plans for Labour Day?

english_meaning: noisy, rowdy, disruptive, annoying, bothersome
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音嘈杂，令人烦扰；或形容人爱吵闹，制造麻烦。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as noisy, disruptive, or bothersome. It can refer to literal noise or to someone who creates trouble and causes annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路好勞嘈，搞到我冇得瞓晏覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 hou2 lou4 cou4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 mou5 dak1 fan3 aan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群小孩很吵闹，吵得我没法睡午觉。
examples.english_sentence: These kids are so noisy, they're preventing me from taking an afternoon nap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺圖書館咁勞嘈啦，會影響到其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 gam3 lou4 cou4 laa1, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在图书馆这么吵闹，会影响到其他人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so noisy in the library, you'll disturb other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢个人好勞嘈，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 lou4 cou4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很吵闹，整天惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very disruptive person, always causing trouble.

english_meaning: laborer, worker
explanation_mandarin: 指以体力或脑力从事劳动的人，通常指工人、体力劳动者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who engages in physical or mental labor, usually referring to workers or manual laborers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅勞工法例保障工人嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lou4 gung1 faat3 lai6 bou2 zoeng3 gung1 jan4 ge3 kuen4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的劳工法例保障工人的权益。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's labor laws protect the rights of workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係外地嚟嘅勞工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngoi6 dei6 lai4 ge3 lou4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是来自外地的劳工。
examples.english_sentence: They are laborers from foreign countries.

mandarin_meaning: 劳动节假日；法定劳动节假日
english_meaning: Labour Day holiday; statutory holiday for workers
explanation_mandarin: 指香港法例规定的、僱员有权享有的法定假日，通常在劳动节。
explanation_english: Refers to the statutory holidays in Hong Kong law that employees are entitled to, usually on Labour Day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司跟足勞工假放假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gan1 zuk1 lou4 gung1 gaa3 fong3 gaa3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司完全按照劳动节假日放假的。
examples.english_sentence: Our company gives holidays strictly according to the Labour Day holiday schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年勞工假你諗住去邊度玩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 lou4 gung1 gaa3 nei5 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年劳动节假期你打算去哪里玩啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where are you planning to go for the Labour Day holiday this year?

english_meaning: Labour Day holiday
explanation_mandarin: 指香港的劳动节假期，通常指五月一日。
explanation_english: Refers to the Labour Day holiday in Hong Kong, usually referring to May 1st.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅勞工假期你哋有咩計劃啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 lou4 gung1 gaa3 kei4 nei5 dei6 jau5 me1 gai3 waak6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的劳动节假期你们有什么计划吗？
examples.english_sentence: What plans do you have for the Labour Day holiday this year?

english_meaning: Labour Department
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区政府负责劳工事务的部门。
explanation_english: The Labour Department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, responsible for labour affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果俾老細無理解僱，你可以去勞工處投訴佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 bei2 lou5 sai3 mou4 lei5 gaai2 gu3, nei5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 lou4 gung1 cyu3 tau4 sou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果被老板无理解雇，你可以去劳工处投诉他。
examples.english_sentence: If you are unfairly dismissed by your boss, you can go to the Labour Department to complain about him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞工處提供就業輔導服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 gung1 cyu3 tai4 gung1 zau6 yip6 fu6 dou6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳工处提供就业辅导服务。
examples.english_sentence: The Labour Department provides employment counseling services.

english_meaning: to make a big fuss; to go to a lot of trouble; to make a mountain out of a molehill
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了小事而动用很多人力物力，大张旗鼓。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a lot of resources (manpower, materials) are used for a trivial matter, making a big deal out of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淨係跌咗少少嘢啫，唔使勞師動眾搵嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing6 hai6 dit3 zo2 siu2 siu2 je5 ze1, m4 sai2 lou4 si1 dung6 zung3 wan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是掉了一点点东西而已，不用兴师动众地找。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a small thing that fell, no need to make a big fuss looking for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗呢啲小事勞師動眾，真係冇必要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 lou4 si1 dung6 zung3, zan1 hai6 mou5 bit1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这些小事兴师动众，真是没有必要。
examples.english_sentence: It's really unnecessary to make such a fuss over these small matters.

english_meaning: to mobilize a large number of people; to make a big fuss; to make a mountain out of a molehill
explanation_mandarin: 形容动用很多人力物力去做一件小事，也指小题大做。
explanation_english: Describes mobilizing a large number of people and resources to do a small thing; also refers to making a mountain out of a molehill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔見咗張一百蚊紙啫，使唔使勞師動衆到報警呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gin3 zo2 zoeng1 jat1 baak3 man1 zi2 ze1, sai2 m4 sai2 lou4 si1 dung6 zung3 dou3 bou3 ging2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是丢了一张一百块的纸币而已，需要兴师动众到报警吗？
examples.english_sentence: It's just losing a hundred-dollar bill, do you need to make such a fuss and call the police?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵返隻貓，佢勞師動衆到全個屋苑咁搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 wan2 faan1 zek3 maau1, keoi5 lou4 si1 dung6 zung3 dou3 cyun4 go3 uk1 jyun2 gam2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找回那只猫，他兴师动众地在整个屋苑里找。
examples.english_sentence: To find the cat, he made a big fuss and searched the entire estate.

english_meaning: corvée; forced labor; hard labor
explanation_mandarin: 指强迫人民从事的无偿劳动或服役。也指强迫进行的繁重体力劳动。
explanation_english: Refers to unpaid labor or service that people are forced to perform. It also refers to arduous physical labor that is forced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都要勞役十幾個鐘，慘到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 lou4 jik6 sap6 gei2 go3 zung1, caam2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都要劳役十几个小时，惨不忍睹。
examples.english_sentence: They are forced to work more than ten hours every day, it's miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅奴隸都要受盡勞役。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 nou4 dai6 dou1 jiu3 sau6 zeon6 lou4 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的奴隶都要受尽劳役。
examples.english_sentence: Slaves in the past had to endure a life of forced labor.

english_meaning: to take pains; to worry; to trouble oneself; to be concerned
explanation_mandarin: 指费心思，操心，为某事感到担忧。
explanation_english: Refers to expending mental effort, worrying, or being concerned about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁複雜，真係要勞心去諗下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 lou4 sam1 heoi3 nam2 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么复杂，真的要费心去想一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated; I really need to take some time to think it over carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞心啦，交俾我搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou4 sam1 laa1, gaau1 bei2 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么费心了，交给我搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much. Just leave it to me, I'll handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為我勞心勞力，真係唔該晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 ngo5 lou4 sam1 lou4 lik6, zan1 hai6 m4 goi1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为我费心费力，真是太感谢了。
examples.english_sentence: You have troubled yourself and put in the effort for me, I'm truly grateful.

english_meaning: strain; wear and tear; overuse injury
explanation_mandarin: 因过度使用或长期承受压力而导致的身体组织损伤。
explanation_english: Damage to bodily tissues caused by overuse or prolonged stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢長期搬重嘢，搞到腰骨勞損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 coeng4 kei4 bun1 cung5 je5, gaau2 dou3 jiu1 gwat1 lou4 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作长期搬重物，导致腰部劳损。
examples.english_sentence: He works long hours lifting heavy objects, which caused strain in his back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長時間用電腦好易造成手腕勞損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 si4 gaan3 yung6 din6 nou5 hou2 ji6 zou6 sing4 sau2 wun2 lou4 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长时间使用电脑很容易造成手腕劳损。
examples.english_sentence: Using the computer for a long time can easily cause wrist strain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動員經常會出現膝頭勞損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 yun4 ging1 seong4 wui5 ceot1 hin3 sat1 tau4 lou4 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动员经常会出现膝盖劳损。
examples.english_sentence: Athletes often experience knee strain.

english_meaning: Rolls-Royce
explanation_mandarin: 英国豪华汽车品牌劳斯莱斯。
explanation_english: Rolls-Royce, a British luxury car brand. Often used metaphorically to represent something of extremely high quality or luxury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲服務真係勞斯萊斯級數㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 lou4 si1 loi4 si2 kap1 seoi3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务真是劳斯莱斯级别的！
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is really Rolls-Royce level!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋嘅裝修靚到好似勞斯萊斯咁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 ge3 zong1 sau1 leng3 dou3 hou2 ci5 lou4 si1 loi4 si2 gam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家的装修漂亮得像劳斯莱斯一样！
examples.english_sentence: The renovation of his house is as beautiful as a Rolls-Royce!

english_meaning: Labor rights, workers' rights
explanation_mandarin: 指劳动者在劳动过程中应当享有的各项权利，包括工资、工作条件、休息休假、社会保障等。
explanation_english: Refers to the rights that workers should enjoy during the labor process, including wages, working conditions, rest and vacation, social security, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要爭取自己嘅勞權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zang1 ceoi2 zi6 gei2 ge3 lou4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要争取自己的劳工权益。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fight for our labor rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅勞權保障唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lou4 kyun4 bou2 zoeng3 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的劳工权益保障不够。
examples.english_sentence: The protection of labor rights in Hong Kong is not enough.

english_meaning: a waste of manpower and resources; wasteful and detrimental to the people
explanation_mandarin: 耗费人民的劳力，损害国家的钱财。形容大兴土木或举办活动耗费大量人力物力，对人民和国家不利。
explanation_english: To waste people's labor and damage the nation's wealth. It describes projects or events that require a large amount of manpower and resources, which are detrimental to the people and the nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起咁大嘅廣場，真係勞民傷財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 gam3 daai6 ge3 gwong2 coeng4, zan1 hai6 lou4 man4 soeng1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建这么大的广场，真是劳民伤财。
examples.english_sentence: Building such a large square is truly a waste of manpower and resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多無謂嘅慶祝活動，簡直係勞民傷財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 mou4 wai6 ge3 hing3 zuk1 wut6 dung6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 lou4 man4 soeng1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞这么多无谓的庆祝活动，简直是劳民伤财。
examples.english_sentence: Organizing so many unnecessary celebrations is simply a waste of manpower and resources.

english_meaning: to bother; to trouble oneself; to get worked up (over something); to be annoyed
explanation_mandarin: 为了某事而感到烦恼或费心。指因为某事而感到生气、担忧，或者需要花费精力。
explanation_english: To bother, trouble, or worry oneself over something. It indicates feeling annoyed, concerned, or needing to expend effort because of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為呢啲小事勞氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai4 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 lou4 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为这些小事费心了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother yourself with these trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗件咁嘅事勞氣，真係唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 gin6 gam3 ge3 si6 lou4 hei3, zan1 hai6 m4 zik6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这种事费心，真是不值得。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not worth getting worked up over something like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔使勞氣，我會搞掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 sai2 lou4 hei3, ngo5 wui5 gaau2 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都不需要费心，我会搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to bother, I'll take care of it.

english_meaning: to trouble (someone); to bother (someone); excuse me (when asking for a favor)
explanation_mandarin: 客气用语，表示给对方带来麻烦或负担。
explanation_english: A polite expression used when requesting a favor or acknowledging that you are causing someone trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞煩你幫我攞埋個文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 faan4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 maai4 go3 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我把文件也拿过来。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me grab that document as well?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，勞煩你等咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, lou4 faan4 nei5 dang2 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，麻烦你等这么久。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for troubling you to wait for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞煩晒你嘅幫忙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 faan4 saai3 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太麻烦你帮忙了！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much for your help! (Sorry to have troubled you so much for your help!)

english_meaning: hardworking, to toil, to bustle about
explanation_mandarin: 指辛勤劳作，奔波忙碌。
explanation_english: Describes being hardworking and constantly busy, often involving physical labour and a lack of rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一世人都好勞碌，冇乜點休息過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sai3 dou1 hou2 lou4 luk6, mou5 mat1 dim2 jau1 sik1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子都很劳碌，没怎么休息过。
examples.english_sentence: He has been hardworking his whole life and hasn't rested much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞碌啦，都要注意下身體啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou4 luk6 laa1, dou1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 haa5 san1 tai2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么劳碌了，也要注意身体啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, you need to take care of your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗屋企，佢真係好勞碌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 uk1 kei5, keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou4 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了家庭，他真的很劳碌。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his family, he's really toiling away.

english_meaning: to trouble; to bother; to take trouble; to go to the trouble of
explanation_mandarin: 表示麻烦别人，使别人费心费力。
explanation_english: Expressing that one is troubling or bothering someone, causing them to put in effort or worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞神啦，我自己搞得掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou4 san4 laa1, ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么费神了，我自己能搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trouble yourself so much, I can handle it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 真係勞神你幫我搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan1 hai6 lou4 san4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真麻烦你帮我搬家。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really sorry to trouble you to help me move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲小事，唔使勞神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 siu2 si6, m4 sai2 lou4 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些小事，不用费神。
examples.english_sentence: These are small matters, no need to trouble yourself.

english_meaning: tired, fatigued, exhausted
explanation_mandarin: 指身体或精神因过度使用而感到疲惫。
explanation_english: Describes a state of physical or mental exhaustion due to overexertion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗成日嘢，真係好勞累呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 seng4 jat6 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 lou4 leoi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了一整天的事情，真是很劳累啊！
examples.english_sentence: I've been working all day, I'm really exhausted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢個樣咁勞累，都係俾佢休息下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 gam3 lou4 leoi6, dou1 hai6 bei2 keoi5 jau1 sik1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他样子这么劳累，还是让他休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Look at how tired he looks, let him rest for a while.

english_meaning: meritorious service; having contributed greatly through hard work
explanation_mandarin: 指辛勤劳动，建立了很大的功劳。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has made significant contributions and achieved great merit through hard work and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司做咗咁多年，真係勞苦功高，應該升佢做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, zan1 hai6 lou4 fu2 gung1 gou1, ying1 goi1 sing1 keoi5 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司工作这么多年，真是劳苦功高，应该升他做经理。
examples.english_sentence: He's worked in the company for so many years, he's truly meritorious, he should be promoted to manager.

english_meaning: Established brand; old shop with a good reputation; reputable brand
explanation_mandarin: 指历史悠久，信誉良好的商店或品牌。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop or brand with a long history and a good reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間茶樓係一間勞記，好多街坊都幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caa4 lau2 hai6 jat1 gaan1 lou4 gei3, hou2 do1 gaai1 fong1 dou1 bong1 caan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶楼是一家老字号，很多街坊都光顾。
examples.english_sentence: This teahouse is an established brand, many neighbours patronize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間衫嘅勞記品質真係好有保證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 saam1 ge3 lou4 gei3 ban2 zat1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 bou2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家服装的老字号品质真的很有保证。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this clothing's established brand is really guaranteed.

english_meaning: labor and management, labor-management (relations)
explanation_mandarin: 指劳工和资方，通常用来描述劳工与资本家之间的关系。
explanation_english: Refers to labor and capital (management), typically used to describe the relationship between workers and employers/management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞資關係好重要㗎，搞得唔好就好易有罷工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 zi1 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3, gaau2 dak1 m4 hou2 zau6 hou2 ji6 jau5 baa6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳资关系很重要，搞不好很容易有罢工。
examples.english_sentence: Labor-management relations are very important. If they are not handled well, it's easy to have strikes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司勞資糾紛搞咗好耐都未解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1 gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mei6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司劳资纠纷搞了很久都还没有解决。
examples.english_sentence: The labor-management dispute at this company has been going on for a long time and hasn't been resolved.

english_meaning: Labour Tribunal
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区设立的一个处理劳资纠纷的法定机构。
explanation_english: A statutory body established in Hong Kong to resolve labour disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司唔肯賠錢，你可以去勞資審裁處告佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 m4 hang2 pui4 cin2, nei5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 lou4 zi1 sam2 coi4 cyu3 gou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司不肯赔钱，你可以去劳资审裁处告它。
examples.english_sentence: If the company refuses to compensate, you can go to the Labour Tribunal to sue them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅勞資糾紛最後喺勞資審裁處解決咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1 zeoi3 hau6 hai2 lou4 zi1 sam2 coi4 cyu3 gaai2 kyut3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的劳资纠纷最后在劳资审裁处解决了。
examples.english_sentence: Their labour dispute was finally resolved at the Labour Tribunal.

english_meaning: labor dispute; industrial dispute
explanation_mandarin: 指劳方（工人、雇员）和资方（雇主）之间因劳动关系产生的争议。
explanation_english: A dispute between workers (employees) and management (employers) concerning terms and conditions of employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠最近成日都有勞資糾紛，搞到人心惶惶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1, gaau2 dou3 jan4 sam1 fong4 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家工厂最近经常有劳资纠纷，搞得人心惶惶。
examples.english_sentence: There have been frequent labor disputes at this factory recently, causing anxiety among the workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞資糾紛通常都係因為薪酬同待遇問題引起嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 san1 cau4 tung4 doi6 jyu6 man6 tai4 hei2 jan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劳资纠纷通常都是因为薪酬和待遇问题引起的。
examples.english_sentence: Labor disputes are usually caused by salary and benefit issues.

english_meaning: to salute or give comforts to the troops; to visit and encourage soldiers
explanation_mandarin: 指前往部队慰问，给予物质或精神上的支持。
explanation_english: To visit and show appreciation to the military troops, often providing them with supplies or entertainment to boost morale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年過年，都有好多機構去勞軍，送啲禮物俾佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 gwo3 nin4, dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 gei1 kau3 heoi3 lou4 gwan1, sung3 di1 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年过年，都有很多机构去慰问军队，送一些礼物给他们。
examples.english_sentence: Every year during Chinese New Year, many organizations visit the troops and give them gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅中秋節，我哋公司打算搞個活動去勞軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 zung1 cau1 zit3, ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gaau2 go3 wut6 dung6 heoi3 lou4 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的中秋节，我们公司打算举办一个活动去慰问军队。
examples.english_sentence: This year for the Mid-Autumn Festival, our company plans to hold an event to visit the troops.

english_meaning: excuse me; may I trouble you; pardon me
explanation_mandarin: 客气用语，表示请人帮忙或让路，相当于普通话的“麻烦您”。
explanation_english: A polite expression used when asking for help, asking someone to move, or when causing inconvenience to someone. Equivalent to "excuse me" or "may I trouble you."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞駕，唔該借借。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 gaa3, m4 goi1 ze3 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦您，请让一下。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, please let me through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞駕幫我攞埋嗰本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 gaa3 bong1 ngo5 lo2 maai4 go2 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我把那本书也拿过来。
examples.english_sentence: May I trouble you to also get that book for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 勞駕，我想問吓路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou4 gaa3, ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦您，我想问一下路。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I want to ask for directions.

english_meaning: to collect, to raise (funds), to recruit
explanation_mandarin: 征求，招引；集合；募集。
explanation_english: To collect, solicit, or recruit; to gather; to raise (funds).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋正喺度為災民募捐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zing3 hai2 dou6 wai4 zoi1 man4 mou6 gyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在为灾民募捐。
examples.english_sentence: They are collecting donations for the disaster victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算公開招募新員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gung1 hoi1 ziu1 mou6 san1 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算公开招募新员工。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to publicly recruit new employees.

english_meaning: to solicit donations; to raise funds
explanation_mandarin: 为公益事业、慈善事业等募集捐款。
explanation_english: To solicit donations or raise funds for public welfare or charitable causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校搞緊個慈善步行籌款，希望大家踴躍募捐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 gaau2 gan2 go3 ci4 sin6 bou6 hang4 cau4 fun2, hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 yung2 yeuk6 mou6 gyun1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校正在举办慈善步行筹款活动，希望大家踊跃募捐。
examples.english_sentence: Our school is organizing a charity walk to raise funds, we hope everyone will actively donate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少慈善機構都會喺街頭募捐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 dou1 wui5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 mou6 gyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少慈善机构都会在街头募捐。
examples.english_sentence: Many charities solicit donations on the street.

english_meaning: to recruit; to collect; to raise (funds)
explanation_mandarin: 公开征集人员、资金、物资等。
explanation_english: To publicly recruit people, funds, or materials; to solicit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家募集緊義工幫手搞活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 mou6 zip6 gan2 ji6 gung1 bong1 sau2 gaau2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司现在正在招募义工来帮忙搞活动。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently recruiting volunteers to help organize activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要募集更多嘅資金嚟支持呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 mou6 zip6 gang3 do1 ge3 zi1 gam1 lai4 zi1 chi4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要募集更多的资金来支持这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to raise more funds to support this project.

mandarin_meaning: 力量, 势力, 趋势, 情势
english_meaning: power, influence, momentum, trend, situation
explanation_mandarin: 力量，权力，情势；趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to power, influence, momentum, trend, or situation. Can describe a person's power or influence, or the general situation of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有勢力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 sai3 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司很有势力。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of influence in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家興環保嘅勢頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hing1 waan4 bou2 ge3 sai3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在流行环保的趋势。
examples.english_sentence: There's a trend towards environmental protection now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟佢哋贏梗，形勢大好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 keoi5 dei6 wing4 gang2, ying4 sai3 daai6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来他们肯定赢，形势大好。
examples.english_sentence: Looks like they will definitely win, the situation is very favorable.

english_meaning: irreconcilable; implacable; cannot exist together; be at daggers drawn
explanation_mandarin: 指双方势成水火，不能并存。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two sides are completely opposed and cannot coexist or reconcile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個自從爭女朋友之後，就勢不兩立啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zi6 cung4 zaang1 neoi5 pang4 jau5 zi1 hau6, zau6 sai3 bat1 loeng5 lap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他们两个争夺女朋友之后，就势不两立了。
examples.english_sentence: Since they competed for a girlfriend, the two of them have become irreconcilable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋咁落力鬥落去，到最後咪搞到勢不兩立？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gam3 lok6 lik6 dau3 lok6 heoi3, dou3 zeoi3 hau6 mai1 gaau2 dou3 sai3 bat1 loeng5 lap6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们这么努力地争斗下去，到最后不就是搞到势不两立吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you keep fighting so hard, won't you end up completely irreconcilable?

english_meaning: unstoppable; irresistible; overwhelming
explanation_mandarin: 形容来势迅猛，不可抵挡。
explanation_english: Describes a momentum that is swift and impossible to resist or stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅攻勢真係勢不可擋，我哋完全守唔住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 sai3 zan1 hai6 sai3 bat1 ho2 dong2, ngo5 dei6 wun4 cyun4 sau2 m4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的攻势真是势不可挡，我们完全守不住。
examples.english_sentence: Their offensive was truly unstoppable, we couldn't defend at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅發展勢頭勢不可擋，好快就會成為行業嘅領導者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2 sai3 tau4 sai3 bat1 ho2 dong2, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 sing4 wai4 hang4 jip6 ge3 ling5 dou6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的发展势头势不可挡，很快就会成为行业的领导者。
examples.english_sentence: This company's growth momentum is unstoppable; it will soon become a leader in the industry.

english_meaning: unexpectedly; surprisingly; hard to imagine
explanation_mandarin: 表示出乎意料，难以预料。形容事情的结果或发展令人惊讶，难以事先估计到。
explanation_english: Expresses something that is unexpected and difficult to foresee. Describes a situation or outcome that is surprising and hard to predict beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勢估唔到佢會咁快結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 wui5 gam3 faai3 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真是没想到他会这么快结婚。
examples.english_sentence: I really didn't expect him to get married so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠，真係勢估唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1, zan1 hai6 sai3 gu2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，真是意想不到。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, it was truly unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會贏到比賽，真係勢估唔到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 wing4 dou2 bi2 coi3, zan1 hai6 sai3 gu2 m4 dou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会赢得比赛，真是出乎意料！
examples.english_sentence: It was really unexpected that he would win the competition!

mandarin_meaning: 来势汹汹, 气势汹汹
english_meaning: aggressive, menacing, with a threatening attitude, displaying aggressive behavior
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物的气势很强，带有威胁性，让人感到害怕或不安。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something with a strong and threatening presence, making others feel afraid or uneasy. It implies an aggressive and potentially harmful attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日鬧交嘅時候勢兇噉樣，真係嚇死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 naau6 gaau1 ge3 si4 hau6 sai3 hung1 gam2 joeng2, zan1 hai6 haak3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天吵架的时候气势汹汹的样子，真是吓死人了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so aggressive when he argued yesterday, it was really scary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班債仔上門追數，勢兇噉，搞到佢哋成家都唔敢出門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 zaai3 zai2 soeng5 mun4 zeoi1 sou3, sai3 hung1 gam2, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 seng4 gaa1 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那帮债主上门讨债，气势汹汹的，搞得他们全家都不敢出门。
examples.english_sentence: Those debt collectors came to the door demanding payment, they were so aggressive that the whole family didn't dare to go out.

english_meaning: aggressive and unreasonable; displaying intimidating and bullying behavior
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人态度非常凶恶，仗势欺人，蛮不讲理的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone's attitude as extremely fierce, bullying, and unreasonable. It emphasizes the intimidating and aggressive nature of their behaviour, often implying they are abusing their power or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都勢兇夾狼，所以冇人鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 sai3 hung1 gaap3 long4, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是气势汹汹，所以没人喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is always aggressive and unreasonable at work, so nobody likes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勢兇夾狼，有咩嘢事都可以慢慢傾嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sai3 hung1 gaap3 long4, jau5 me1 je5 si6 dou1 ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 king1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么气势汹汹的，有什么事都可以慢慢谈的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so aggressive; we can talk things over calmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度勢兇夾狼啦，我唔會俾你嚇到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sai3 hung1 gaap3 long4 laa1, ngo5 m4 wui5 bei2 nei5 haak3 dou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里气势汹汹的，我不会被你吓到的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so aggressively here, I won't be intimidated by you.

english_meaning: Snobbish, opportunistic, materialistic and flattering the wealthy
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人看重权势和财富，对有权有势的人谄媚奉承，对没有权势的人轻视怠慢。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is snobbish, opportunistic, and materialistic, flattering the wealthy and powerful while looking down on those who are not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好勢利㗎，見你冇錢就唔睬你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 sai3 lei6 gaa3, gin3 nei5 mou5 cin2 zau6 m4 cai2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很势利的，见你没钱就不理你。
examples.english_sentence: They are very snobbish, they will ignore you if you don't have money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勢利啦，人窮都有人窮嘅好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sai3 lei6 laa1, jan4 kung4 dou1 jau5 jan4 kung4 ge3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么势利啦，人穷也有人穷的好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so snobbish, even poor people have their good qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，個人變得好勢利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, go3 jan4 bin3 dak1 hou2 sai3 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，人变得很势利。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he became very snobbish.

english_meaning: power, influence, force, strength; powerful group, influential circles
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会或政治方面的影响力和控制力；也指有权势的集团或人物。
explanation_english: Refers to influence and control in social or political aspects; also refers to a powerful group or person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺嗰間公司嘅勢力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sai3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司的势力很大。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of influence in that company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好得罪啲有勢力嘅人，好易惹麻煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dak1 zeui6 di1 jau5 sai3 lik6 ge3 jan4, hou2 ji6 je5 maa4 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要得罪那些有势力的人，很容易惹麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't offend powerful people, it's easy to get into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想擴大自己嘅勢力範圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 kwok3 daai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sai3 lik6 faan6 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想扩大自己的势力范围。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to expand his sphere of influence.

english_meaning: inevitable; bound to happen; imperative
explanation_mandarin: 事情的发展到了非做不可的地步，一定要实行。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is inevitable and must be done; it is an imperative course of action due to prevailing circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃經過咁多討論，又得到大部分人支持，睇嚟都勢在必行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 tou2 leon6, jau6 dak1 dou3 daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4 zi1 ci4, tai2 lai4 dou1 sai3 zoi6 bit1 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划经过这么多讨论，又得到大部分人的支持，看来是势在必行了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has undergone so much discussion and has gained the support of most people, it seems inevitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決交通擠塞問題，起新地鐵綫係勢在必行嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 gaau1 tung1 zai1 sak1 man6 tai4, hei2 san1 dei6 tit3 sin3 hai6 sai3 zoi6 bit1 hang4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了解决交通拥堵问题，修建新的地铁线路是势在必行的事情。
examples.english_sentence: To solve the traffic congestion problem, building a new subway line is an imperative.

english_meaning: evenly matched; well-matched; a contest between equally powerful opponents
explanation_mandarin: 形容双方实力相当，力量不相上下，可以互相匹敌。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two sides or opponents are equally matched in terms of strength, power, or ability, making them able to compete on equal terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽，兩隊都好勁，真係勢均力敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3, loeng5 deoi2 dou1 hou2 ging6, zan1 hai6 sai3 gwan1 lik6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的比赛，两队都很厉害，真是势均力敌。
examples.english_sentence: In this competition, both teams are very strong, they are really evenly matched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個辯論，講嘢又叻，反應又快，真係勢均力敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 bin6 leon6, gong2 je5 jau6 lek3, faan2 jing3 jau6 faai3, zan1 hai6 sai3 gwan1 lik6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个辩论，说话又厉害，反应又快，真是势均力敌。
examples.english_sentence: When the two of them debate, they are both eloquent and quick-witted, they are really evenly matched.

english_meaning: irresistible force; like splitting bamboo; to advance triumphantly
explanation_mandarin: 形容形势顺利，毫无阻挡，就像用刀劈开竹子一样。
explanation_english: Describes a situation progressing smoothly and irresistibly, without any obstacles, like splitting bamboo with a knife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅攻勢勢如破竹，好快就贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 sai3 sai3 jyu4 po3 zuk1, hou2 faai3 zau6 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的攻势势如破竹，很快就赢了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Their offensive was an irresistible force; they quickly won the match.

english_meaning: weak and isolated; lacking power and support
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量薄弱，缺乏支援，孤立无援的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being weak, lacking support, and isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁嘅環境下，佢哋勢孤力弱，唯有靠自己。

explanation_english: This proverb emphasizes the importance of hard work and learning, and the detrimental effects of indulging in play. It encourages people to be diligent in order to achieve something, while excessive entertainment is ultimately useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔，考緊DSE喇，唔好掛住打機啦，記住勤有功，戲無益啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2, haau2 gan2 DSE laa3, m4 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1 laa1, gei3 zyu6 kan4 jau5 gung1, hei3 mou4 jik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子，正在准备DSE考试了，别光顾着玩游戏了，记住勤奋努力有好处，玩乐嬉戏没有益处啊！
examples.english_sentence: Son, you're preparing for the DSE exams, don't just focus on playing games. Remember, diligence is beneficial, playing is useless!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都喺度睇電視，唔做功課，真係應驗咗句勤有功，戲無益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6, m4 zou6 gung1 fo3, zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2 geoi3 kan4 jau5 gung1, hei3 mou4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都在看电视，不做作业，真是应验了那句勤奋努力有好处，玩乐嬉戏没有益处。
examples.english_sentence: Every day you're just watching TV and not doing homework, it really proves the saying that diligence is beneficial, playing is useless.

english_meaning: meritorious service; distinguished service; merit; achievement
explanation_mandarin: 指对国家、人民或社会做出的巨大贡献和卓越的成就。
explanation_english: Refers to significant contributions and outstanding achievements made to a country, people, or society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為社會做咗好多貢獻，攞咗好多勳章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 se5 wui2 zou6 zo2 ho2 do1 gung3 hiun3, lo2 zo2 ho2 do1 fan1 zhang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为社会做了很多贡献，获得了很多勋章。
examples.english_sentence: He has made many contributions to society and received many medals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅卓越表現得到上級嘅嘉許，頒咗個勳章畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zoek3 jyut6 biu2 hin3 dak1 dou3 soeng6 kap1 ge3 ga1 heoi2, baan1 zo2 go3 fan1 zhang1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的卓越表现得到了上级的嘉许，颁发了勋章给他。
examples.english_sentence: His outstanding performance was recognized by his superiors, and he was awarded a medal.

english_meaning: medal, decoration
explanation_mandarin: 用金属制成，授予在战争或其它重要事业中作出贡献的人，作为荣誉的象征。
explanation_english: A metal object, typically disc-shaped, awarded to someone for distinguished service or achievement in war or other significant endeavors as a symbol of honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戰爭入面嘅英勇表現，攞咗個勳章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zin3 zang1 jap6 min6 ge3 ying1 yung5 biu2 hin3, lo2 zo2 go3 fan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在战争中的英勇表现，获得了一枚勋章。
examples.english_sentence: He received a medal for his heroic performance in the war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係佢嘅戰鬥勳章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 zin3 dau3 fan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是他的战斗勋章。
examples.english_sentence: This is his combat medal.

english_meaning: honours and titles; decoration and rank
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或机构授予的勋章和头衔，表示对个人的成就或贡献的认可和奖励。
explanation_english: Refers to decorations and titles awarded by governments or organizations to recognize and reward an individual's achievements or contributions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為對社會嘅貢獻，攞咗好多勳銜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 deoi3 se5 wui2 ge3 gung3 hi献, lo2 zo2 hou2 do1 fan1 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为对社会的贡献，获得了许多勋章和头衔。
examples.english_sentence: He received many honours and titles for his contributions to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲勳銜代表住佢一生嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fan1 haam4 doi6 biu2 zyu6 keoi5 yat1 sang1 ge3 sing4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些勋章代表了他一生的成就。
examples.english_sentence: These honours represent his lifetime achievement.

english_meaning: to encourage; to urge; to inspire
explanation_mandarin: 激励，使振作。
explanation_english: To encourage someone, to inspire them to make progress or feel more confident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要互相鼓勵，一齊進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wu6 seong1 gu2 lai6, jat1 cai4 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该互相鼓励，一起进步。
examples.english_sentence: We should encourage each other and make progress together.

english_meaning: inspiring, motivational, encouraging
explanation_mandarin: 鼓舞人的志气，激励人积极向上。
explanation_english: Inspiring one's ambition; encouraging someone to be positive and strive upwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好勵志，睇完之後覺得充滿動力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 lai6 zi3, tai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 gok3 dak1 cung1 mun5 dung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很励志，看完之后觉得充满动力。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very inspiring. After watching it, I feel full of motivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅故事好勵志，好多人都以佢為榜樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gu3 si2 hou2 lai6 zi3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ji5 keoi5 wai4 bong2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的故事很励志，很多人都以他为榜样。
examples.english_sentence: His story is very inspiring, and many people take him as an example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勵志咁克服咗所有困難，最後成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lai6 zi3 gam2 hak1 fuk6 zo2 so2 jau5 kwan3 naan4, zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很励志地克服了所有困难，最后成功了。
examples.english_sentence: He overcame all difficulties in an inspiring way and finally succeeded.

mandarin_meaning: 奋发图强，致力于国家治理
english_meaning: to strive for progress and prosperity in governing a country; to work hard for national rejuvenation
explanation_mandarin: 形容振奋精神，想办法治理好国家。多指君主励精图治，使国家繁荣昌盛。
explanation_english: Describes the act of invigorating oneself and devising methods to govern a country well. Often refers to a monarch striving for progress and prosperity to make the country flourish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上任之後，決定勵精圖治，要令香港變得更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 jam6 zi1 hau6, kyut3 ding6 lai6 zing1 tou4 zi6, jiu3 ling6 hoeng1 gong2 bin3 dak1 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上任之后，决定励精图治，要让香港变得更好。
examples.english_sentence: After taking office, he decided to strive for progress and prosperity in governing, aiming to make Hong Kong a better place.

english_meaning: to advise, to urge, to persuade, to exhort
explanation_mandarin: 用道理或好话开导人，使人接受某种意见或做法。
explanation_english: To advise, urge, or persuade someone to do or not to do something, often by offering reasons or encouragement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸你唔好咁夜瞓啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 je6 fan3 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝你不要这么晚睡了，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to sleep so late, it's not good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋勸我唔好辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hyun3 ngo5 m4 hou2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们劝我不要辞职。
examples.english_sentence: They advised me not to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸極佢都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 gik1 keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怎么劝他他都不听。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how much I advised him, he wouldn't listen.

english_meaning: to mediate a quarrel, to dissuade from fighting, to reconcile disputants
explanation_mandarin: 劝说争吵的人停止争斗，使双方和解。
explanation_english: To persuade people who are quarreling to stop fighting and reconcile with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧交鬧得好犀利，我哋快啲去勸交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 naau6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 heoi3 hyun3 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架吵得很厉害，我们快点去劝架吧。
examples.english_sentence: They are arguing fiercely, let's quickly go and mediate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想理佢哋啲家事，廢事勸交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 lei5 keoi5 dei6 di1 gaa1 si6, fai3 si6 hyun3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想管他们的家事，免得劝架。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get involved in their family affairs, to avoid mediating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆好識得勸交，成日幫鄰居排難解紛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hou2 sik1 dak1 hyun3 gaau1, seng4 jat6 bong1 leon4 geoi1 paai4 naan6 gaai2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶很会劝架，经常帮邻居排忧解难。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady is good at mediating, and often helps neighbors solve problems.

english_meaning: to encourage; to exhort; to urge
explanation_mandarin: 劝告并勉励。
explanation_english: To encourage and urge someone to do something, often to improve their performance or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師成日勸勉我哋要努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 sing4 jat6 hyun3 min5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师总是劝勉我们要努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher always encourages us to study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爸爸經常勸勉佢唔好放棄自己嘅理想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa4 baa1 ging1 seung4 hyun3 min5 keoi5 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸经常劝勉他不要放弃自己的理想。
examples.english_sentence: His father often encourages him not to give up on his dreams.

english_meaning: to advise, to exhort, to urge, to counsel
explanation_mandarin: 用好话劝人。
explanation_english: To advise or urge someone to do or not to do something, usually in a kind and persuasive manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸吿你唔好咁做，會有危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 gou3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, wui5 jau5 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝你不要这样做，会有危险的。
