examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to do that, it will be dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生勸吿佢要戒煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hyun3 gou3 keoi5 jiu3 gaai3 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生劝告他要戒烟。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor advised him to quit smoking.

english_meaning: to advise; to urge; to exhort; advice
explanation_mandarin: 劝人接受意见或改正错误。
explanation_english: To advise someone to accept an opinion or correct a mistake; advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好聲好氣咁勸告佢，希望佢可以改過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 seng1 hou2 hei3 gam2 hyun3 gou3 keoi5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 goi2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们好言相劝，希望他可以改正错误。
examples.english_sentence: We advised him nicely, hoping he would change his ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢完全唔聽人哋嘅勸告，一意孤行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun4 cyun4 m4 teng1 yan4 dei6 ge3 hyun3 gou3, jat1 ji3 gu1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全不听别人的劝告，一意孤行。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to anyone's advice at all and insists on having his own way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽下醫生嘅勸告，食藥休息多啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 haa5 yi1 sang1 ge3 hyun3 gou3, sik6 yoek6 yau1 sik1 do1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听医生的话，吃药多休息吧。
examples.english_sentence: Listen to the doctor's advice, take your medicine and get more rest.

english_meaning: to advise; to persuade; to urge; to admonish
explanation_mandarin: 劝告、劝说，使人听从。
explanation_english: To advise or persuade someone to do or not do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸喻過佢好多次唔好再賭錢，但佢都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 jyu6 gwo3 keoi5 hou2 do1 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 cin2, daan6 keoi5 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝告过他很多次不要再赌钱，但他都不听。
examples.english_sentence: I've advised him many times not to gamble again, but he doesn't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師勸喻學生們要專心讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hyun3 jyu6 hok6 sang1 mun4 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师劝谕学生们要专心读书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher advised the students to concentrate on their studies.

english_meaning: to advise, to exhort, to persuade
explanation_mandarin: 用道理劝人，使人听从。
explanation_english: To advise or persuade someone to do something by reasoning with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試下勸導佢唔好咁衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 hyun3 dou6 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试着劝导他不要这么冲动。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to advise him not to be so impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師一直勸導學生要努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jat1 zik6 hyun3 dou6 hok6 sang1 jiu3 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师一直劝导学生要努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher constantly advises the students to study hard.

english_meaning: to console, to comfort, to soothe
explanation_mandarin: 用好话安慰人，使人心情好转。
explanation_english: To comfort or console someone with kind words, aiming to improve their mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔開心嘅時候，我會勸慰佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 wui5 hyun3 wai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当他不开心的时候，我会劝慰他。
examples.english_sentence: When he's unhappy, I will console him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試吓勸慰佢，希望佢可以好返啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 hyun3 wai3 keoi5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 hou2 faan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试着劝慰他，希望他可以好一些。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to comfort him, hoping he can feel better.

english_meaning: to admonish, to advise and warn, to dissuade
explanation_mandarin: 劝告并告诫，使人改正错误或避免犯错误。
explanation_english: To advise and warn someone to correct their mistakes or avoid making mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸成日勸戒我唔好咁夜瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 seng4 jat6 hyun3 gaai3 ngo5 m4 hou2 gam3 je6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸总是劝诫我不要这么晚睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: My father always advises me not to sleep so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師勸戒學生要專心讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hyun3 gaai3 hok6 sang1 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师劝诫学生要专心读书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher admonishes the students to concentrate on studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸戒佢唔好再賭錢，但佢都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 gaai3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 cin2, daan6 keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝诫他不要再赌钱，但他都不听。
examples.english_sentence: I advised him not to gamble anymore, but he didn't listen.

english_meaning: to persuade, to convince
explanation_mandarin: 通过劝说使人接受自己的观点或意见。
explanation_english: To persuade someone to accept your opinion or point of view through reasoning and argumentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用咗好多時間先勸服到佢改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 si4 gaan3 sin1 hyun3 fuk6 dou3 keoi5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我花了很多时间才说服他改变主意。
examples.english_sentence: I spent a lot of time persuading him to change his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好固執，好難勸服佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gu3 chap1, hou2 naan4 hyun3 fuk6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很固执，很难说服他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very stubborn, it's difficult to persuade him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試吓勸服佢唔好咁衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 hyun3 fuk6 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试试劝说他不要这么冲动。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to persuade him not to be so impulsive.

english_meaning: to dissuade; to advise against; to stop someone from doing something
explanation_mandarin: 劝说制止，使不做某事。
explanation_english: To advise someone not to do something; to try to stop them from doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸止佢唔好飲咁多酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 zi2 keoi5 m4 hou2 yam2 gam3 do1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝他不要喝那么多酒。
examples.english_sentence: I advised him not to drink so much alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想去非法賽車，我哋一定要勸止佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 heoi3 fei1 faat3 saai3 ce1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hyun3 zi2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想去非法赛车，我们一定要劝阻他们。
examples.english_sentence: They want to go illegal racing, we must dissuade them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生勸止佢食太多甜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hyun3 zi2 keoi5 sik6 taai3 do1 tim4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生劝他不要吃太多甜的东西。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor advised him not to eat too many sweets.

english_meaning: to advise; to urge; to appeal
explanation_mandarin: 劝告和呼吁，希望对方听从自己的意见或建议。
explanation_english: To advise and appeal to someone, hoping they will listen to one's opinions or suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府勸籲市民盡快接種疫苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hyun3 jyu6 si5 man4 zeon6 faai3 zip3 chủng4 jik6 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府劝告市民尽快接种疫苗。
examples.english_sentence: The government is urging citizens to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋勸籲大家唔好亂拋垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hyun3 jyu6 daai6 ga1 m4 hou2 lyun6 pau1 laap1 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们呼吁大家不要乱扔垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: We urge everyone not to litter.

english_meaning: to advise and console; to mediate; to dissuade; to reconcile
explanation_mandarin: 劝说开导，使人解除烦恼或争端。
explanation_english: To advise and console someone, aiming to alleviate their worries or resolve a dispute; to mediate between conflicting parties; to dissuade someone from a particular course of action; to reconcile people who are at odds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧交鬧得好犀利，我去勸解吓佢哋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 naau6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, ngo5 hui3 hyun3 gaai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵得很厉害，我去劝解一下他们。
examples.english_sentence: They are arguing fiercely. I'll go and try to reconcile them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經勸解咗佢好多次，但係佢都係唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hyun3 gaai2 zo2 keoi5 hou2 do1 ci3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 si6 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经劝解他很多次了，但是他还是不听。
examples.english_sentence: I've advised him many times, but he still doesn't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩事慢慢講，唔好咁激動，等我勸解下你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 si6 maan6 maan6 gong2, m4 hou2 gam3 gik1 dung6, dang2 ngo5 hyun3 gaai2 haa5 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么事慢慢说，不要这么激动，让我劝解一下你们。
examples.english_sentence: Take your time and talk about it, don't get so agitated. Let me mediate between you.

english_meaning: to advise and admonish; to exhort; to warn and counsel
explanation_mandarin: 劝告并告诫，使人改正错误或避免犯错误。
explanation_english: To advise and admonish someone, urging them to correct mistakes or avoid making them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽成日勸誡佢唔好咁夜瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 hyun3 gaai3 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam3 je6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他妈妈总是劝诫他不要这么晚睡。
examples.english_sentence: His mother always advises and warns him not to sleep so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師勸誡我哋要努力讀書，將來先有出息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hyun3 gaai3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, zoeng1 loi4 sin1 jau5 cheut1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师劝诫我们要努力读书，将来才有出息。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher advises us to study hard so that we can be successful in the future.

english_meaning: to advise; to exhort; to counsel; to admonish
explanation_mandarin: 用恳切的言辞劝告，使人听从。
explanation_english: To advise and persuade someone earnestly to listen and obey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試吓勸諭佢唔好咁衝動啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 hyun3 jyu6 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试着劝谕他不要那么冲动了。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to advise him not to be so impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都勸諭我哋要努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hyun3 jyu6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是劝谕我们要努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: They always advise us to study hard.

english_meaning: to persuade (someone) to withdraw; to advise against; to discourage (someone) from continuing (especially in a job or competition)
explanation_mandarin: 劝说某人放弃，通常指在工作、学习或比赛中劝说其退出。
explanation_english: To persuade someone to withdraw or quit, usually from a job, study, or competition. It implies advising against continuing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得唔開心，老細都想勸退佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 m4 hoi1 sam1, lou5 sai2 dou1 soeng2 hyun3 teoi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作不开心，老板都想劝退他。
examples.english_sentence: He's unhappy at work, and the boss is thinking of persuading him to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見佢咁辛苦，我都有啲想勸退佢唔好再讀落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 gam3 san1 fu2, ngo5 dou1 jau5 di1 soeng2 hyun3 teoi3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 duk6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他这么辛苦，我都有些想劝他不要再读下去了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how hard he's working, I'm tempted to advise him to not continue studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練覺得佢狀態唔好，勸退咗佢，唔畀佢參加比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zong6 taai3 m4 hou2, hyun3 teoi3 zo2 keoi5, m4 bei2 keoi5 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练觉得他状态不好，劝退了他，不让他参加比赛。
examples.english_sentence: The coach felt he wasn't in good condition and persuaded him to withdraw, not allowing him to participate in the competition.

english_meaning: to dissuade, to advise against, to deter
explanation_mandarin: 劝说阻止别人做某事。
explanation_english: To advise someone against doing something; to try to prevent someone from doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試圖勸阻佢唔好辭職，但係佢唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 tou4 hyun3 zo2 keoi5 m4 hou2 ci4 zik1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试图劝阻他不要辞职，但是他不听。
examples.english_sentence: I tried to dissuade him from resigning, but he wouldn't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該勸阻佢唔好賭錢，賭錢害人害己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 goi1 hyun3 zo2 keoi5 m4 hou2 dou2 cin2, dou2 cin2 hoi6 yan4 hoi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该劝阻他不要赌钱，赌钱害人害己。
examples.english_sentence: You should dissuade him from gambling; gambling harms both himself and others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察勸阻咗佢哋衝擊警戒線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hyun3 zo2 keoi5 dei6 cung1 gik1 ging2 gaai3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察劝阻了他们冲击警戒线。
examples.english_sentence: The police dissuaded them from charging the police line.

english_meaning: to wrap; to contain; to include
explanation_mandarin: 本义为包裹，现在较少单独使用，多在其他字中作为偏旁。
explanation_english: The original meaning is 'to wrap'. It's rarely used alone now and mostly appears as a radical in other characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個包裹包得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 baau1 gwo2 baau1 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包裹包得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This package is wrapped beautifully.

english_meaning: to deceive; to swindle; to cheat; to scam
explanation_mandarin: 指欺骗，诓骗，尤指用花言巧语或虚假承诺来获取利益。
explanation_english: To deceive, swindle, or cheat someone, especially by using persuasive words or false promises to gain an advantage or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想勺人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 zoek3 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to cheat people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢，佢好鍾意勺你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 zoek3 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他很喜欢骗你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he really likes to cheat you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁易俾人勺，真係蠢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ji6 bei2 jan4 zoek3, zan1 hai6 ceon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么容易被骗，真是笨。
examples.english_sentence: You are so easily cheated, you're really stupid.

english_meaning: even, uniform, evenly distributed, average
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物分布或程度上的均匀、平均。
explanation_english: Describes something that is evenly distributed or of uniform quality or degree. Can also mean to distribute something evenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搽防曬要搽勻啲，唔係會曬傷㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 fong4 saai3 jiu3 caa4 wan4 di1, m4 hai6 wui5 saai3 soeng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 涂防晒霜要涂均匀一点，不然会被晒伤的。
examples.english_sentence: Apply sunscreen evenly, or you'll get sunburned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆將啲花紅勻俾啲員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zoeng1 di1 faa1 hung4 wan4 bei2 di1 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板把花红平均分给员工。
examples.english_sentence: The boss distributed the bonus evenly among the employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲麵粉撈勻佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 min6 fan2 lou1 wan4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把面粉搅拌均匀。
examples.english_sentence: Mix the flour evenly.

english_meaning: thorough, comprehensive, well-rounded
explanation_mandarin: 指考虑事情或安排事情非常周到、妥帖，面面俱到。
explanation_english: Describes something being thorough, comprehensive, and well-rounded. It implies that things are considered or arranged in a meticulous and all-encompassing manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好勻巡㗎，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 wan4 ceon4 gaa3, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很周到，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very thorough in his work, no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份計劃書寫得好勻巡，好清楚噉解釋晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gai3 waak6 syu1 se2 dak1 hou2 wan4 ceon4, hou2 cing1 co2 gam2 gai2 sik1晒啲嘢。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份计划书写得很周全，很清楚地解释了所有事情。
examples.english_sentence: This proposal is written very thoroughly, explaining everything clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考慮得好勻巡，所有嘅可能性都諗過晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 leoi6 dak1 hou2 wan4 ceon4, so2 jau5 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 dou1 nam2 gwo3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考虑得很周全，所有的可能性都考虑过了。
examples.english_sentence: He has considered everything thoroughly, all possibilities have been thought through.

mandarin_meaning: 规律; 周到; 妥帖
english_meaning: Thorough; meticulous; comprehensive; well-organized; methodical; even
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事周到仔细，有条不紊，或事物发展有规律。
explanation_english: Describes something being thorough, meticulous, well-organized, or following a consistent pattern or principle. It can also describe a person who is conscientious and methodical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好勻循，所以老闆好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢hou2 wan4 seon4, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很周到，所以老板很信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very thorough in his work, so the boss trusts him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅管理制度好勻循，所以運作得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 zai3 dou6 hou2 wan4 seon4, so2 ji5 wan6 zok3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理制度非常完善，所以运作得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This company's management system is very thorough, so it operates very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日嘅作息時間都好勻循，早睡早起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 ge3 zok3 sik1 si4 gaan3 dou1 hou2 wan4 seon4, zou2 seoi6 zou2 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天的作息时间都很有规律，早睡早起。
examples.english_sentence: His daily routine is very regular; he sleeps early and wakes up early.

english_meaning: well-proportioned, symmetrical, balanced
explanation_mandarin: 指形状、比例和谐，各部分配合适当。
explanation_english: Describes something that is well-proportioned, symmetrical, or balanced in its parts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身形好勻稱，著咩衫都好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 ying4 hou2 wan4 ching3, zoek3 me1 saam1 dou1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的身材很匀称，穿什么衣服都好看。
examples.english_sentence: Her figure is well-proportioned, so she looks good in anything she wears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅設計好勻稱，令人覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 wan4 ching3, ling6 yan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子的设计很匀称，让人觉得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this house is very well-proportioned, making it feel comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 连接; 串通; 勾引; 删去
english_meaning: to hook up; to connect; to collude; to seduce; to cross out
explanation_mandarin: 有多种含义，包括连接、串通、勾引、或者删除等，具体含义取决于语境。
explanation_english: Has multiple meanings, including to hook up, connect, collude, seduce, or cross out. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋勾手指尾，講掂數喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngau1 sau2 zi2 mei5, gong2 dim6 sou3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们勾小指，说定了！
examples.english_sentence: We pinky swear, it's settled!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋勾結埋一齊做壞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngau1 git3 maai4 jat1 cai4 zou6 waai6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们勾结在一起做坏事。
examples.english_sentence: They collude to do bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲錯嘅嘢勾咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 co3 ge3 je5 ngau1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把错的东西划掉。
examples.english_sentence: Cross out the wrong things.

mandarin_meaning: 拈花惹草, 勾搭成奸
english_meaning: to flirt around, to be promiscuous, to have affairs (especially outside of marriage)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人到处勾引异性，搞不正当男女关系。
explanation_english: Describes a person who flirts with many people and engages in illicit relationships, especially outside of marriage. It carries a negative connotation, implying immoral or unethical behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結咗婚都仲要勾三搭四，真係好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1 dou1 zung6 jiu3 gau1 saam1 daap3 sei3, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 yam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结了婚还要拈花惹草，真是不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he's married, he still flirts around. He's really irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢，佢個人成日勾三搭四㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 go3 yan4 seng4 jat6 gau1 saam1 daap3 sei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他，他这个人总是勾搭成奸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him; he's always flirting with everyone.

english_meaning: to seduce a man; to flirt with a man (with the intention of a romantic relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性以不正当的手段或不正当的目的去吸引或勾引男性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman using improper means or with an improper purpose to attract or seduce a man. It often implies that the woman is intentionally trying to take someone else's partner or is acting in a way that is considered immoral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁姣，成日都想勾佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 haau4, sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 ngau1 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么妖媚，整天都想勾引男人。
examples.english_sentence: She's so seductive and always trying to seduce men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞人哋男朋友，唔好勾佬啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 jan4 dei6 naam4 pang4 jau5, m4 hou2 ngau1 lou2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要打扰别人的男朋友，不要勾引男人啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with other people's boyfriends, don't seduce men!

english_meaning: to collude in acquiring land (often through illicit means); to scheme for land grabbing
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当手段（如贿赂、勾结）来获取土地。常带有负面含义，暗示有幕后交易或不公平竞争。
explanation_english: Refers to acquiring land through illicit means, such as bribery or collusion. It often carries a negative connotation, implying behind-the-scenes deals or unfair competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋俾人話勾地，起豪宅賣俾大陸佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 jan4 waa6 ngau1 dei6, hei2 hou4 zaak6 maai6 bei2 daai6 luk6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被人说勾结获取土地，盖豪宅卖给大陆人。
examples.english_sentence: They are accused of colluding to acquire land to build luxury houses and sell them to mainlanders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢嘅爭議點就係懷疑有人勾地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 ge3 zaang1 wai6 dim2 zau6 hai6 waai4 ji5 jau5 jan4 ngau1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事情的争议点就是怀疑有人勾结获取土地。
examples.english_sentence: The point of contention in this case is the suspicion that someone colluded to acquire land.

english_meaning: to seduce, to lure, to entice, to flirt with
explanation_mandarin: 用不正当的手段引诱；引诱（异性）。
explanation_english: To seduce or lure someone, especially sexually or romantically; to entice or tempt someone to do something questionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想勾引我男朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ngau1 jan5 ngo5 naam4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她想勾引我男朋友。
examples.english_sentence: She wants to seduce my boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住用啲手段嚟勾引人哋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 yung6 di1 sau2 dyun6 lai4 ngau1 jan5 jan4 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着用一些手段来勾引别人了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about using tricks to seduce others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得勾引男人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 ngau1 jan5 naam4 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很会勾引男人。
examples.english_sentence: She knows how to seduce men.

mandarin_meaning: 勾心斗角 (gōu xīn dòu jiǎo)
english_meaning: to engage in cutthroat infighting; to scheme against each other
explanation_mandarin: 形容用尽心机，互相排挤、争斗。
explanation_english: Describes people using every scheme and trick to fight, exclude, and compete with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺個辦公室入面，成日都勾心鬥角，好鬼辛苦嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 go3 baan6 gung1 sat1 jap6 min6, seng4 jat6 dou1 ngau1 sam1 dau3 gok3, hou2 gwai2 san1 fu2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在办公室里面，总是勾心斗角，非常辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: In the office, there's constant infighting, it's really exhausting.

synonyms: 爾虞我詐 (ji yu wo zha)

english_meaning: to collude; to gang up with; to seduce; to flirt; to hit on
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中勾结，不正当的联系；也指引诱、勾引异性；也指为了某种目的主动与人搭讪。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly colluding or having an improper relationship. It can also mean to seduce or flirt with someone. Furthermore, it can refer to initiating a conversation with someone for a particular purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個勾搭埋一齊，一定有陰謀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ngau1 daap3 maai4 jat1 cai4, jat1 ding6 jau5 jam1 mau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个勾结在一起，肯定有阴谋。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are colluding, there's definitely a conspiracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒吧度勾搭個靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zau2 baa1 dou6 ngau1 daap3 go3 leng3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒吧里勾引那个美女。
examples.english_sentence: He was flirting with that beautiful woman in the bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住勾搭老闆上位啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ngau1 daap3 lou5 baan2 soeng5 wai2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着勾引老板上位啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about trying to get ahead by seducing the boss.

english_meaning: to collude with a clique; to form a faction; to conspire with cronies
explanation_mandarin: 指互相勾结，组成小集团，做不正当的事。
explanation_english: Refers to colluding with each other to form a clique or faction and engage in improper or illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日勾朋結黨，肯定冇嘢好事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ngau1 pang4 git3 dong2, hang2 ding6 mou5 je5 hou2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是勾结朋党，肯定没什么好事。
examples.english_sentence: They are always colluding with each other, surely nothing good will come of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司內部勾朋結黨嘅情況好嚴重，所以好多員工都走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 ngau1 pang4 git3 dong2 ge3 cing4 kwong3 hou2 jim4 zung6, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 gung1 jyun4 dou1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司内部勾结朋党的情况很严重，所以很多员工都离开了。
examples.english_sentence: The situation of internal collusion within this company is very serious, so many employees have left.

english_meaning: to cancel, to write off, to annul
explanation_mandarin: 表示取消，作废，使失去效力。
explanation_english: To cancel, invalidate, nullify, or write off something. It implies reversing a previous action or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之前嘅約定，依家勾消咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 ge3 yoek3 ding6, ji1 gaa1 gau1 siu1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之前的约定，现在取消了。
examples.english_sentence: Our previous agreement is now cancelled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張單太耐冇找數，銀行可能會將佢勾消。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 daan1 taai3 noi6 mou5 zaau2 sou3, ngan4 hong4 ho2 nang4 wui5 zoeng1 keoi5 gau1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 账单太久没有付款，银行可能会把它勾销。
examples.english_sentence: If the bill hasn't been paid for too long, the bank might write it off.

english_meaning: to outline, to sketch, to delineate, to depict
explanation_mandarin: 用简单的线条描绘轮廓或简要地描述。
explanation_english: To draw the outline of something, or to describe something in a general way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用幾句說話就勾畫咗成件事嘅重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 gei2 geui3 syut3 waa6 jau6 gau1 waak6 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 jung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用几句话就概括了整件事的重点。
examples.english_sentence: He outlined the main points of the whole thing in just a few words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位藝術家擅長用炭筆勾畫人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 ngai6 seot1 gaa1 sin6 coeng4 yung6 taan3 bat1 gau1 waak6 yan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位艺术家擅长用炭笔勾勒人物。
examples.english_sentence: This artist is skilled at using charcoal to sketch figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師勾畫咗新大樓嘅草圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gai3 si1 gau1 waak6 zo2 san1 daai6 lau4 ge3 cou2 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 设计师勾勒了新大楼的草图。
examples.english_sentence: The designer sketched the blueprint of the new building.

mandarin_meaning: 勾当, 不正当的活动
english_meaning: dirty business, shady activity, underhanded dealings
explanation_mandarin: 指不正当的、见不得光的活动或事情。
explanation_english: Refers to underhanded, shady, or illicit activities, often involving some kind of wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一定喺度搞緊啲咩勾當，神神秘秘咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 hai2 dou6 gaau2 gan2 di1 me1 gau1 dong3, san4 san4 mai5 mai5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一定在搞什么勾当，神神秘秘的。
examples.english_sentence: They must be up to some shady business, acting so mysteriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲勾當早晚會俾人揭發嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau1 dong3 zou2 maan5 wui5 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些勾当迟早会被人揭发的。
examples.english_sentence: These underhanded dealings will be exposed sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同佢哋搞埋一齊，實有勾當㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 gaau2 maai4 jat1 cai4, sat6 jau5 gau1 dong3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要和他们混在一起，肯定有猫腻！
examples.english_sentence: You better not get involved with them, there's definitely something fishy going on!

english_meaning: to collude; to conspire; to gang up with
explanation_mandarin: 暗中互相串通，进行不正当的活动。
explanation_english: To collude; to conspire; to gang up with, usually for illegal or unethical purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋勾結埋一齊偷公司啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngau1 git3 maai4 jat1 cai4 tau1 gung1 si1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们勾结在一起偷公司的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They colluded to steal money from the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有證據顯示佢同黑社會勾結。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zing3 geoi3 hin2 si6 keoi5 tung4 hak1 se5 wui2 ngau1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有证据显示他与黑社会勾结。
examples.english_sentence: There is evidence to show that he is in collusion with the triads.

english_meaning: To flirt; to hit on someone (usually subtly); to connect lines (literally or figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 最初是连接电话线的动作，引申为试探性地与他人建立联系，特别是用于男女之间的调情。
explanation_english: Originally referred to connecting telephone lines. It has been extended to mean tentatively establishing a connection with someone, especially used for flirting between a man and a woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒吧度勾線，想識啲新朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jau5 baa1 dou6 ngau1 sin3, soeng2 sik1 di1 san1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在酒吧里勾线，想认识一些新朋友。
examples.english_sentence: She was flirting at the bar, trying to meet new people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我面前勾線啦，我唔鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 ngau1 sin3 laa1, ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在我面前勾线了，我不喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't flirt in front of me, I don't like it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你哋唔好淨係識得打機，都要勾線下搵女朋友㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 daa2 gei1, dou1 jiu3 ngau1 sin3 haa5 wan2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你们不要只会打游戏，也要勾线一下找女朋友啊。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, you guys shouldn't just play games, you also need to flirt to find a girlfriend.

english_meaning: To seduce a sworn brother's wife, to betray a friend by having an affair with their wife
explanation_mandarin: 指勾引朋友的妻子，是一种不道德的行为，违背了兄弟情义。
explanation_english: Refers to seducing or having an affair with a sworn brother's wife. This is considered an immoral act and a betrayal of brotherhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然勾義嫂，真係冇義氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 ngau1 ji6 sou2, zan1 hai6 mou5 ji6 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然勾引朋友的妻子，真是没义气！
examples.english_sentence: He actually seduced his sworn brother's wife, he's really unrighteous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲勾義嫂嘅行為，會俾人唾棄㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ngau1 ji6 sou2 ge3 hang4 wai4, wui5 bei2 jan4 to3 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种勾引朋友妻子的行为，会被人唾弃的。
examples.english_sentence: Such acts of seducing a sworn brother's wife will be scorned by others.

english_meaning: to evoke, to arouse, to bring back (memories), to trigger
explanation_mandarin: 引起回忆、兴趣、欲望等。使人想起某事或产生某种情感。
explanation_english: To evoke memories, interest, desire, etc. To make someone recall something or experience a certain feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌勾起咗我好多童年回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ngau1 hei2 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 tung4 nin4 wui4 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌勾起了我很多童年回忆。
examples.english_sentence: This song brought back a lot of childhood memories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅遭遇勾起咗大家嘅同情心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi1 ngau1 hei2 zo2 daai6 gaa1 ge3 tung4 ching4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的遭遇勾起了大家的同情心。
examples.english_sentence: His experiences aroused everyone's sympathy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相勾起咗佢對故鄉嘅思念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 ngau1 hei2 zo2 keoi5 deoi3 gu3 hoeng1 ge3 si1 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片勾起了他对故乡的思念。
examples.english_sentence: This photo evoked his longing for his hometown.

english_meaning: to cancel; to write off; to annul
explanation_mandarin: 取消；勾除。 指消除、取消或废除某种事物。
explanation_english: To cancel or eliminate something, such as a debt, agreement, or record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司決定勾銷佢嘅債務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gau1 siu1 keoi5 ge3 zaai3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定取消他的债务。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to write off his debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢犯咗法，佢嘅護照俾人勾銷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 keoi5 faan6 zo2 faat3, keoi5 ge3 wu6 ziu3 bei2 jan4 gau1 siu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他犯了法，他的护照被取消了。
examples.english_sentence: Because he broke the law, his passport was cancelled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔嚟，我就勾銷你嘅booking喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 lai4, ngo5 zau6 gau1 siu1 nei5 ge3 booking laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不来，我就取消你的预订了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't come, I will cancel your booking.

english_meaning: do not; don't
explanation_mandarin: 表示禁止或劝阻，相当于“不要”。
explanation_english: Indicates prohibition or discouragement; equivalent to "do not" or "don't". It's more formal than the common Cantonese equivalent "唔好 (m4 hou2)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請勿吸煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 mat1 kap1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请勿吸烟。
examples.english_sentence: Please do not smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請勿打擾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 mat1 daa2 jiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请勿打扰。
examples.english_sentence: Please do not disturb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閒人勿近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haan4 jan4 mat1 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 闲人勿近。
examples.english_sentence: Unauthorized personnel keep out.

mandarin_meaning: 不要吵; 别吭声; 闭嘴
english_meaning: Shut up; Don't speak; Keep quiet
explanation_mandarin: 表示叫别人停止说话或保持安静。语气比较强烈，略带负面情绪。
explanation_english: An imperative used to tell someone to stop talking or be quiet. The tone is relatively strong and carries a slightly negative emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都講咗成晚啦，勿歇啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gong2 zo2 sing4 maan5 laa1, mat1 hit1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都说了一整晚了，闭嘴吧！
examples.english_sentence: You've been talking all night, shut up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再嘈我就要你勿歇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 cou4 ngo5 zau6 jiu3 nei5 mat1 hit1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再吵我就要你闭嘴！
examples.english_sentence: If you make any more noise, I'll tell you to shut up!

english_meaning: even, uniform, to divide evenly, to share equally
explanation_mandarin: 指分布或分配得没有轻重或厚薄之分，平等地。也指使之平均。
explanation_english: Refers to distribution or allocation without differences in weight or thickness, equally. Also refers to making something even or uniform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將啲錢勻開佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 cin2 wan4 hoi1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们把钱平均分给他。
examples.english_sentence: We'll divide the money evenly among them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕切到匀啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 cit3 dou3 wan4 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕切得均匀一些啊。
examples.english_sentence: Cut this cake more evenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搽防曬要搽匀啲，唔係好易曬傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 fong4 saai3 jiu3 caa4 wan4 di1, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 saai3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 涂防晒霜要涂均匀一些，不然很容易晒伤。
examples.english_sentence: Apply sunscreen more evenly, otherwise you'll easily get sunburned.

english_meaning: even; uniform; consistent; evenly distributed
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或状态是均匀的，没有明显的差别。
explanation_english: Describes an object or state that is even, uniform, or consistently distributed without significant differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲顏色油得唔夠勻巡，有啲地方深色啲，有啲地方淺色啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ngaan4 sik1 jau4 dak1 m4 gau3 wan4 ceon4, jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 sam1 sik1 di1, jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 cin2 sik1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 油漆涂得不够均匀，有些地方深色一些，有些地方浅色一些。
examples.english_sentence: The paint wasn't applied evenly; some areas are darker, and some are lighter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕焗得好勻巡，每一啖都一樣咁鬆軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 guk6 dak1 hou2 wan4 ceon4, mui5 jat1 daam6 dou1 jat1 joeng6 gam3 sung1 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕烤得很均匀，每一口都一样松软。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is baked very evenly; every bite is equally fluffy.

mandarin_meaning: 顺利; 妥当; 周全
english_meaning: smooth; properly arranged; well-managed; all squared away
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情安排妥当、顺利，没有遗漏或问题。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything is well-arranged, smooth, and without any omissions or problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅计划全部都好匀循喇，可以开始喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hou2 wan4 seon4 laa3, ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划全部都安排妥当了，可以开始了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan is all squared away, we can start now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好匀循，唔使人担心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 wan4 seon4, m4 sai2 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很周全，不用人担心。
examples.english_sentence: He handles things very well, there's no need to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂晒啲文件，就匀循喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 man4 gin2, zau6 wan4 seon4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 处理完所有文件，就妥当了。
examples.english_sentence: Once all the documents are processed, it's all squared away.

english_meaning: well-proportioned, symmetrical, balanced, shapely
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或人的形体各部分比例合适，和谐美观。
explanation_english: Refers to the balanced and harmonious proportions of an object or a person's physique, resulting in a pleasing appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身材好匀稱，着咩衫都好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 coi4 hou2 wan4 cing3, zoek3 me1 saam1 dou1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她身材很匀称，穿什么衣服都好看。
examples.english_sentence: She has a well-proportioned figure, and she looks good in everything she wears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅設計好匀稱，睇落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 sai3 gai3 hou2 wan4 cing3, tai2 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的设计很匀称，看起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this house is very symmetrical, making it look comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 包裹; 承担; 包括; 保证
english_meaning: to wrap; to contain; to include; to guarantee; to take responsibility for; bag; bun
explanation_mandarin: 动词：包裹，包含，承担责任，保证。名词：袋子，包子。
explanation_english: Verb: to wrap, to contain, to take responsibility, to guarantee. Noun: bag, bun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅手袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 sau2 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的手提包。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new handbag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個包入面有叉燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baau1 jap6 min6 jau5 caa1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包子里面有叉烧。
examples.english_sentence: There is char siu (barbecue pork) inside this bun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 包喺我身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baau1 hai2 ngo5 san1 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 包在我身上。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take responsibility for it. / I've got it covered.

english_meaning: to keep a mistress; to maintain a concubine
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚男子长期供养一名情妇，提供金钱、住所等生活保障。
explanation_english: Refers to a married man providing long-term financial support and housing for a mistress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後就包二奶，真係唔要得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6 zau6 baau1 ji6 naai5, zan1 hai6 m4 jiu3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财之后就包养情妇，真是要不得。
examples.english_sentence: After he became rich, he started keeping a mistress, which is absolutely unacceptable.

english_meaning: To have meals together and share the cost; to share cooking and food expenses (usually among a group of people)
explanation_mandarin: 指一群人共同出资，一起做饭吃饭，分担伙食费用。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people contributing money to cook and eat together, sharing the cost of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幾個同學喺大學嘅時候成日包伙爨，慳唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gei2 go3 tung4 hok6 hai2 daai6 hok6 ge3 si4 hau6 sing4 jat6 baau1 fo2 cyun3, haan1 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们几个同学在大学的时候经常包伙食，省了不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: Several of us classmates often shared meals and costs when we were in university, saving a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔鍾意自己煮嘢食，然後同朋友包伙爨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 zung1 ji3 zi6 gei2 zyu2 je5 sik6, jin4 hau6 tung4 pang4 jau5 baau1 fo2 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人喜欢自己做饭，然后和朋友包伙食。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people like to cook their own food and then share meals with friends.

english_meaning: to include meals; to provide meals (usually in a working context, like a construction site)
explanation_mandarin: 指包含或提供膳食。通常用于工作场合，例如工地、工厂等，雇主提供员工的伙食。
explanation_english: Refers to including or providing meals. Usually used in a working context, such as a construction site or factory, where the employer provides meals for employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司包伙食，所以人工低啲都冇所謂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 baau1 fo2 sik6, so2 ji5 jan4 gung1 dai1 di1 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司包伙食，所以工资低一点也没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Their company includes meals, so it doesn't matter if the salary is a bit lower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳請人，包伙食，真係唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ceng2 jan4, baau1 fo2 sik6, zan1 hai6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅招人，包伙食，真是不错。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is hiring, and it includes meals. That's pretty good.

english_meaning: to include; to encompass; to cover; to protect; to guarantee
explanation_mandarin: 包含、包括；担保；保护。
explanation_english: To include or encompass something; to guarantee or assure; to protect or shield something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢包住所有費用，唔駛再俾其他錢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 baau1 zyu6 so2 jau5 fai3 jung6, m4 sai2 zoi3 bei2 kei4 taa1 cin2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格包含所有费用，不需要再付其他钱了。
examples.english_sentence: This price includes all the expenses; you don't need to pay any other fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司會包住你嘅醫療費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 wui5 baau1 zyu6 nei5 ge3 ji1 liu4 fai3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司会报销你的医疗费用。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will cover your medical expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心，我包住你冇事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1, ngo5 baau1 zyu6 nei5 mou5 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心，我保证你没事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee you'll be alright.

english_meaning: all-inclusive; all-in; everything is included; no extra charges
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部费用都包含在内，无需额外付费。
explanation_english: Indicates that all costs are included, and there are no additional charges. Usually used in the context of deals, packages, or pricing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個旅行團係包使嘅，機票酒店都包埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leoi5 hang4 tyun4 hai6 baau1 sai2 ge3, gei1 piu3 zau2 dim3 dou1 baau1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个旅行团是全包的，机票和酒店都包括在内。
examples.english_sentence: This tour package is all-inclusive; it includes both airfare and hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話間房包使，唔使再俾其他錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gaan1 fong2 baau1 sai2, m4 sai2 zoi3 bei2 kei4 taa1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说房间是全包的，不用再给其他钱。
examples.english_sentence: He said the room is all-inclusive, you don't need to pay any other money.

english_meaning: guarantee, assure
explanation_mandarin: 保证，担保，一定能够做到。
explanation_english: To guarantee, assure, promise that something will definitely happen or be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我包保佢會準時到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baau1 bou2 keoi5 wui5 zeon2 si4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我保证他会准时到。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee that he will arrive on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心，我包保搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1, ngo5 baau1 bou2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心，我保证搞定他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I assure you I'll take care of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 包保好食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baau1 bou2 hou2 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保证好吃！
examples.english_sentence: Guaranteed to be delicious!

english_meaning: Judge Bao; a paragon of justice and integrity
explanation_mandarin: 包拯，北宋时期官员，以清廉公正闻名。在粤语中，常用来形容非常公正廉明的人。
explanation_english: Judge Bao (Bao Zheng) was an official during the Northern Song Dynasty, known for his integrity and impartiality. In Cantonese, it's often used to describe someone who is extremely fair, just, and honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好似包公咁，唔會偏袒任何一方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 baau1 gung1 gam2, m4 wui5 pin1 taan2 jam6 ho4 jat1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事像包公一样，不会偏袒任何一方。
examples.english_sentence: He works like Judge Bao, he won't favor any side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個法官簡直係包公再世，鐵面無私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faat3 gun1 gaan2 zik6 hai6 baau1 gung1 zoi3 sai3, tit3 min6 mou4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个法官简直是包公再世，铁面无私。
examples.english_sentence: This judge is practically Judge Bao reincarnated, completely impartial.

english_meaning: Rock, Paper, Scissors
explanation_mandarin: 一种用手势来决胜负的游戏。 包代表石头，剪代表剪刀，揼代表布。石头胜剪刀，剪刀胜布，布胜石头。
explanation_english: A hand game used to make a decision or to have some fun. 'Bao' represents rock, 'zin' represents scissors, and 'dap' represents paper. Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, and paper beats rock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋包剪揼決定邊個請食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baau1 zin2 dap2 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 cheng2 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们石头剪刀布决定谁请客吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's play rock, paper, scissors to decide who will treat us to dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嘈啦，包剪揼分勝負咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caau4 laa1, baau1 zin2 dap2 fan1 sing3 fu6 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别吵了，石头剪刀布分胜负不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Stop arguing, just play rock, paper, scissors to decide the winner.

english_meaning: Rock, Paper, Scissors
explanation_mandarin: 一种用手势进行的猜拳游戏。包代表石头，剪代表剪刀，𢱕代表布。
explanation_english: A hand game where players simultaneously form one of three shapes with an outstretched hand. Rock (fist), Paper (flat hand), or Scissors (two fingers forming a V). Rock crushes Scissors, Scissors cuts Paper, and Paper covers Rock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋包剪𢱕，邊個輸咗就請飲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 baau1 zin2 dap1, bin1 go3 syu1 zo2 zau6 ceng2 yam2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们玩石头剪刀布，谁输了就请喝东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we play Rock, Paper, Scissors? The loser buys the drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋細個成日包剪𢱕嚟決定邊個先玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 baau1 zin2 dap1 lai4 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们小时候经常玩石头剪刀布来决定谁先玩。
examples.english_sentence: We used to play Rock, Paper, Scissors all the time when we were kids to decide who goes first.

english_meaning: Chubby cheeks, baby face
explanation_mandarin: 形容脸颊圆润，像包子一样。多用于形容小孩或年轻女性。
explanation_english: Describes round, chubby cheeks, resembling steamed buns. Usually used to describe children or young women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女包包面，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi2 baau1 baau1 min6, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女儿脸圆圆的，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: Her daughter has chubby cheeks, she's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我都有包包面㗎，大個咗就冇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dou1 jau5 baau1 baau1 min6 gaa3, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 mou5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我也有娃娃脸，长大了就没有了。
examples.english_sentence: I had chubby cheeks when I was a child, but I don't anymore now that I'm older.

english_meaning: to contain; to include
explanation_mandarin: 包括，含有
explanation_english: to contain, to include, to embody

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個套餐包含一杯咖啡同埋一件蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tou3 caan1 baau1 ham4 jat1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 tung4 maai4 jat1 gin6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个套餐包含一杯咖啡和一个蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: This set meal includes a cup of coffee and a piece of cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學費包含書簿費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 fai3 baau1 ham4 syu1 bou6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学费包含书费。
examples.english_sentence: Tuition fees include textbook expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約包含好多條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 baau1 ham4 hou2 do1 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同包含很多条款。
examples.english_sentence: This contract contains many clauses.

english_meaning: To take responsibility for something; to leave something to someone; to count on someone to do something.
explanation_mandarin: 表示承担责任，或者将某事委托给某人。
explanation_english: Indicates taking responsibility for something, or entrusting something to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事包喺我身上，你放心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 baau1 hai2 ngo5 san1 soeng5, nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事包在我身上，你放心吧。
examples.english_sentence: Leave this to me, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使擔心，呢個項目包喺佢身上，佢一定會搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 baau1 hai2 keoi5 san1 soeng5, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用担心，这个项目包在他身上，他一定会搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry, this project is in his hands, he will definitely get it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔得閒，咁就包喺我身上啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 dak1 haan4, gam2 zau6 baau1 hai2 ngo5 san1 soeng5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他没空，那就包在我身上吧。
examples.english_sentence: If he's not free, then leave it to me.

english_meaning: to surround, to encircle, to hem in, to besiege
explanation_mandarin: 从四面或多个方向把某物或某地围住。
explanation_english: To surround something or a place from all sides or multiple directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察包圍咗間屋，捉晒啲賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 chaat3 baau1 wai4 zo2 gaan1 uk1, juk1 saai3 di1 chaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察包围了那间房子，抓住了所有的贼。
examples.english_sentence: The police surrounded the house and caught all the thieves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成班fans包圍住個明星，想同佢影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 baan1 fans1 baau1 wai4 zyu6 go3 ming4 sing1, soeng2 tung4 keoi5 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群粉丝包围着那个明星，想和他拍照。
examples.english_sentence: A group of fans surrounded the celebrity, wanting to take photos with him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敵人包圍咗成個城市，想逼我哋投降。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik6 yan4 baau1 wai4 zo2 seng4 go3 sing4 si5, soeng2 bik1 ngo5 dei6 tau4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敌人包围了整个城市，想逼我们投降。
examples.english_sentence: The enemy surrounded the entire city, trying to force us to surrender.

english_meaning: to book an entire venue (e.g., movie theater, restaurant) for private use
explanation_mandarin: 指预订整个场地，例如电影院、餐厅等，供私人使用。
explanation_english: To rent or book an entire venue or space, such as a movie theater, restaurant, or function room, for a private event or exclusive use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚包場睇戲啦，唔使同其他人逼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 baau1 coeng4 tai2 hei3 laa1, m4 sai2 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚包场看电影啦，不用和其他人挤。
examples.english_sentence: We're booking the whole movie theater tonight, so we don't have to squeeze with other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有錢到包場搞生日派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 cin2 dou3 baau1 coeng4 gaau2 saang1 jat6 paai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有钱到包场举办生日派对。
examples.english_sentence: They are so rich that they book a whole venue to hold a birthday party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳可以包場，適合搞大型活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ho2 ji5 baau1 coeng4, sik1 hap6 gaau2 daai6 jing4 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅可以包场，适合举办大型活动。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant can be booked entirely, suitable for holding large events.

english_meaning: Steamed bun; idiot; fool; pushover
explanation_mandarin: 本意是指包子，一种食物。在粤语中，有时也用来形容人愚笨、容易被欺负，类似于“笨蛋”、“蠢材”。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a steamed bun, a type of food. In Cantonese, it can also be used to describe someone who is foolish, easily taken advantage of, or a pushover. Similar to 'idiot' or 'fool'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日俾人呃，真係個包子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 aak1, zan1 hai6 go3 baau1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是被人骗，真是个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He's always getting scammed; he's such an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁包子啦，要硬淨啲呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 baau1 zi2 laa1, jiu3 ngaang6 geng3 di1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么没用啦，要坚强一点啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a pushover, you need to be stronger!

mandarin_meaning: 全部, 总是, 一定
english_meaning: Always, definitely, certainly; invariably; all the time
explanation_mandarin: 表示总是，一定，通常带有不好的语气。例如：他包字頭都遲到。（他总是迟到。）
explanation_english: Indicates always, definitely, or invariably, often with a negative connotation. For example: 他包字頭都遲到 (He's always late.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢包字頭都係咁樣，唔使期望佢會改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baau1 zi6 tau4 dou1 hai6 gam2 joeng2, m4 sai2 kei4 mong6 keoi5 wui5 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这样，不用期望他会改变。
examples.english_sentence: He's always like this, there's no need to expect him to change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳包字頭都咁多人排隊，一定好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 baau1 zi6 tau4 dou1 gam3 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2, jat1 ding6 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅总是这么多人排队，一定很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant always has so many people lining up, it must be very delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢發咗達之後，就包字頭睇唔起人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6, zau6 baau1 zi6 tau4 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他发财之后，就总是看不起人。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he became rich, he always looks down on people.

english_meaning: to tolerate, to forgive, to be understanding, to show understanding and acceptance, inclusiveness
explanation_mandarin: 宽容，原谅，容忍，对别人的缺点和错误表示理解和接受。
explanation_english: To tolerate, forgive, or be understanding towards others, especially in regards to their shortcomings or mistakes. Implies acceptance and understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅包容心好大，乜嘢都肯體諒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 baau1 jung4 sam1 hou2 daai6, mat1 je5 dou1 hang2 tai2 loeng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的包容心很大，什么都肯体谅别人。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very tolerant heart; he is willing to understand others in everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會要多啲包容，先至可以共融。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 jiu3 do1 di1 baau1 jung4, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gung6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会要多一些包容，才可以共融。
examples.english_sentence: Society needs more inclusiveness in order to achieve integration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母應該對小朋友嘅錯誤多啲包容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ying1 goi1 deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 cu3 ng6 do1 di1 baau1 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母应该对小朋友的错误多一些包容。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should be more tolerant of their children's mistakes.

english_meaning: to come last; to be at the bottom; to be the last place
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛、考试等活动中获得最后一名，处于最差的位置。
explanation_english: Refers to being in the last place in a competition, exam, or other activity; being in the worst position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我包尾啊，真係好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 baau1 mei5 aa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我垫底了，真的很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: I came last in this exam, I'm really unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波成日都包尾，都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deui2 bo1 seng4 jat6 dou1 baau1 mei5, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队总是垫底，真不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: Our team is always in last place, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績一直包尾，所以俾老師鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 jat1 zik6 baau1 mei5, so2 ji5 bei2 lou5 si1 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩一直垫底，所以被老师骂了。
examples.english_sentence: His grades have always been at the bottom, so he was scolded by the teacher.

mandarin_meaning: 垫底第一名；最后一名却自以为是
english_meaning: Last place but acting like you're number one; dead last but showing off; bottom of the barrel but acting important.
explanation_mandarin: 指排名最后的人，却表现得好像自己很了不起，带有讽刺意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is in last place but behaves as if they are superior or important, often used sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次考試都包尾大幡，但係又成日話自己好醒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 baau1 mei5 daai6 faan1, daan6 hai6 jau6 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 seng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次考试都垫底，但是又总是说自己很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes in last in exams, but he always says he's very smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做包尾大幡啦，努力啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 baau1 mei5 daai6 faan1 laa1, nu5 lik6 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做垫底还自以为是的人了，努力一些吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a dead last braggart, try harder!

english_meaning: Dead last; Bringing up the rear
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛、考试或其他竞争中获得最后一名的人或队伍。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or team that comes in last place in a competition, exam, or other contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我包尾大班，真係好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 baau1 mei5 daai6 baan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我倒数第一名，真的很失望。
examples.english_sentence: I came in dead last on this exam; I'm really disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波成日都係包尾大班，無乜進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 baau1 mei5 daai6 baan1, mou5 mat1 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们队总是倒数第一名，没什么进步。
examples.english_sentence: Their team is always dead last, there's not much improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 垫底大翻身 / 最后一名大逆转
english_meaning: A huge comeback from last place / A massive turnaround from being at the bottom
explanation_mandarin: 原指在比赛或竞争中，原本是最后一名，后来却成功逆转，获得胜利或取得显著进步。形容情况从最糟糕变为最好，发生巨大的转变。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a situation in a competition or race where someone who was in last place makes a dramatic comeback to win or achieve significant progress. It describes a massive turnaround from the worst situation to the best, a huge transformation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先考試包尾，估唔到最後佢竟然攞咗第一名，真係包尾大翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 haau2 si3 baau1 mei5, gu2 m4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 ging2 jin4 lo2 zo2 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 baau1 mei5 daai6 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才考试是最后一名，没想到最后他竟然拿了第一名，真是垫底大翻身。
examples.english_sentence: He was in last place in the exam earlier, but unexpectedly he ended up getting first place, it's a true comeback from last place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司差啲執笠，但係佢哋搵到個新嘅投資者，而家包尾大翻，生意好翻晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 caa1 di1 zap1 laap1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 wan2 dou2 go3 san1 ge3 tau4 zi1 ze2, ji4 gaa1 baau1 mei5 daai6 faan1, seng1 ji3 hou2 faan1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司差点倒闭，但是他们找到了一个新的投资者，现在咸鱼翻身，生意好转了。
examples.english_sentence: The company was almost bankrupt, but they found a new investor, and now they've made a huge comeback, and business has improved greatly.

synonyms: 鹹魚翻身 (haam4 jyu2 faan1 san1)

english_meaning: to shield; to harbor; to cover up; to protect (someone who has done wrong)
explanation_mandarin: 袒护、袒护罪犯或坏人。
explanation_english: To shield or protect someone who has committed a crime or done wrong; to cover up for them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日包庇佢啲親戚，啲員工好唔服氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 baau1 bei3 keoi5 di1 can1 cik1, di1 wun4 gung1 hou2 m4 fuk6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是包庇他的亲戚，员工们很不服气。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always shields his relatives, and the employees are very dissatisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以包庇佢犯法啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 baau1 bei3 keoi5 faan6 faat3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能包庇他犯法啊！
examples.english_sentence: You can't cover up for him breaking the law!

english_meaning: to guarantee a minimum (payment, amount, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 保证最低限度；担保最低的收益或数量。
explanation_english: To guarantee a minimum; to ensure a minimum payment, quantity, or result. Often used in situations where there's a risk of fluctuating income or output.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司包底俾佢每個月至少有一萬蚊人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 baau1 dai2 bei2 keoi5 mui5 go3 jyut6 zi3 siu2 jau5 jat1 maan6 man1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司保底给他每个月至少一万元的工资。
examples.english_sentence: The company guarantees him a minimum salary of 10,000 dollars per month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次演唱會嘅票房唔係咁好，好彩主辦單位有包底，所以歌手唔使蝕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 piu3 fong2 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2, hou2 coi2 zyu2 baan6 daan1 wai2 jau5 baau1 dai2, so2 ji5 go1 sau2 m4 sai2 sit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次演唱会的票房不是很好，幸好主办单位有保底，所以歌手不用亏本。
examples.english_sentence: The concert's ticket sales weren't very good, but fortunately the organizers guaranteed a minimum payment, so the singer doesn't have to lose money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同個老闆傾掂數，老闆包底俾佢賣夠一百件貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 go3 lou5 baan2 king1 dim6 sou3, lou5 baan2 baau1 dai2 bei2 keoi5 maai6 gau3 jat1 baak3 gin6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和老板谈好了，老板保证他卖够一百件货。
examples.english_sentence: He negotiated with the boss, and the boss guaranteed that he would sell at least 100 items.

english_meaning: private room; booth (in a restaurant, karaoke, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指餐厅、卡拉OK等场所中相对独立的房间，通常为顾客提供更私密的空间。
explanation_english: Refers to a relatively independent room in places like restaurants, karaoke bars, etc., usually providing a more private space for customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚book咗間包廂唱K。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 book1 zo2 gaan1 baau1 soeng1 coeng3 K.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚预定了一个包间唱K。
examples.english_sentence: We booked a private room for karaoke tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅包廂好靚，好適合搞生日派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 baau1 soeng1 hou2 leng3, hou2 sik1 hap6 gaau2 saang1 jat6 paai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的包间很漂亮，很适合举办生日派对。
examples.english_sentence: The private rooms in this restaurant are very beautiful and perfect for birthday parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗保障私隱，我哋揀咗坐包廂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bou2 zoeng3 si1 yan2, ngo5 dei6 gaan2 zo2 co5 baau1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了保障隐私，我们选择了坐包间。
examples.english_sentence: To ensure privacy, we chose to sit in a private room.

mandarin_meaning: 卷心菜, 包菜, 椰菜
english_meaning: Cabbage
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的蔬菜，叶子紧密包裹成球状。
explanation_english: A common vegetable with tightly packed leaves forming a head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲包心菜幾新鮮喎，買返個炒嚟食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 baau1 sam1 coi3 gei2 san1 sin1 wo3, maai5 faan1 go3 caau2 lai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的卷心菜挺新鲜的，买一个回去炒着吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: The cabbage looks pretty fresh today. Let's buy one and stir-fry it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食醋溜包心菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 cou3 liu1 baau1 sam1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃醋溜卷心菜。
examples.english_sentence: I like vinegared cabbage.

mandarin_meaning: 保证搞定; 一切包在我身上
english_meaning: Guarantee to handle it; I'll take care of everything
explanation_mandarin: 表示保证完成某项任务或解决某个问题，并承担全部责任。 语气比较强烈，带有自信和承诺的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses a guarantee to complete a task or solve a problem and take full responsibility. The tone is strong, carrying a sense of confidence and commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放心啦，呢件事包打包殺，一定幫你搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 sam1 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 baau1 daa2 baau1 saat3, jat1 ding6 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放心吧，这件事包打包杀，一定帮你搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee to handle this. I'll definitely get it done for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我搞掂個project，我應承佢包打包殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 go3 project, ngo5 jing3 sing4 keoi5 baau1 daa2 baau1 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我完成这个项目，我答应他包打包杀。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked me to complete this project, and I promised him I'd take care of everything.

synonyms: 冇問題 (mou5 man6 tai4) - No problem

english_meaning: to outflank; to surround; to encircle; to go around and attack from behind; (in sports) to flank
explanation_mandarin: 从两侧或后方迂回进攻，形成包围。
explanation_english: To attack from the flanks or rear, forming an encirclement. Can be used literally in a military context, or figuratively in sports or other situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想包抄我哋，但係俾我哋發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 baau1 caau1 ngo5 dei6, daan6 hai6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想包抄我们，但是被我们发现了。
examples.english_sentence: They tried to outflank us, but we discovered it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 籃球比賽入面，佢哋經常包抄對方嘅控球後衛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laam4 kau4 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, keoi5 dei6 ging1 seong4 baau1 caau1 deoi3 fong1 ge3 hung3 kau4 hau6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在篮球比赛中，他们经常包抄对方的控球后卫。
examples.english_sentence: In basketball games, they often flank the opponent's point guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察包抄咗間賭檔，捉咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 baau1 caau1 zo2 gaan1 dou2 dong3, zuk1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察包抄了那个赌档，抓了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The police surrounded the gambling den and arrested many people.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, argumentative, contrarian (for the sake of it)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，喜欢和别人对着干，明明知道是对的也要反驳。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stubborn and likes to argue with others, even if they know what's right, they will still argue against it just for the sake of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁包拗頸，遲早得罪晒啲人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 baau1 aau3 geng2, ci4 zou2 dak1 zeoi6晒 di1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么固执，迟早会得罪所有人的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so stubborn, you'll offend everyone sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係包拗頸，咩都要反對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 baau1 aau3 geng2, me1 dou1 jiu3 faan2 doi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个爱抬杠的人，什么都要反对。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a contrarian, he objects to everything.

english_meaning: to include; to consist of; to comprise
explanation_mandarin: 包含，涵盖
explanation_english: To contain or include something as a part of a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 價錢包括機票同酒店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 cin2 baau1 kwut3 gei1 piu3 tung4 zau2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 价格包括机票和酒店。
examples.english_sentence: The price includes the air ticket and the hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程包括咗三個單元。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 baau1 kwut3 zo2 saam1 go3 daan1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程包括了三个单元。
examples.english_sentence: This course includes three modules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工作包括咗見客同埋寫報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 baau1 kwut3 zo2 gin3 haak3 tung4 maai4 se2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作包括了见客户和写报告。
examples.english_sentence: His work includes meeting clients and writing reports.

mandarin_meaning: 保证满意；保证能达到目的
english_meaning: Guaranteed satisfaction; guaranteed to achieve the goal; guaranteed to get what you want (often with an ulterior motive)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事保证能够成功或者令人满意。通常暗示背后有某种交换或保证达成目的的承诺，可能带有一定的负面含义，例如承诺提供特殊服务来换取利益。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is guaranteed to be successful or satisfactory. It often implies a hidden exchange or a promise to achieve a goal, potentially with a negative connotation, such as promising special services in exchange for benefits. It suggests a guarantee that you will get what you want, often with an expectation or unspoken arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你搞掂佢，包揼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, baau1 dam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你搞定他，保证让你满意！
examples.english_sentence: I'll help you settle him, guaranteed satisfaction!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話買呢啲嘢包揼升值，我唔係咁信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 maai5 ni1 di1 je5 baau1 dam2 sing1 zik6, ngo5 m4 hai6 gam2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说买这些东西保证升值，我不是那么相信。
examples.english_sentence: He said buying these things is guaranteed to appreciate in value, I don't quite believe it.

english_meaning: to monopolize; to take on everything; to take over; to handle everything
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情全部承揽下来，不让别人参与。也指垄断。
explanation_english: To take on everything, not allowing others to participate. Also refers to monopolizing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都想包攬晒，搞到自己好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 soeng2 baau1 laam5 saai3, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都想包揽，搞得自己很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to handle everything, making himself very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好包攬咁多嘢啦，分啲俾其他人做下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baau1 laam5 gam3 do1 je5 laa1, fan1 di1 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 zou6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要包揽这么多东西了，分一些给其他人做一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take on so much, share some of the work with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司俾佢哋集團包攬咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zaap6 tyun4 baau1 laam5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司被他们的集团包揽了。
examples.english_sentence: This company has been monopolized by their group.

english_meaning: Soliciting lawsuits; stirring up litigation; maintenance and champerty
explanation_mandarin: 指以不正当手段怂恿、唆使他人进行诉讼，从中牟利的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of improperly encouraging or instigating others to litigate in order to profit from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司專門包攬訴訟，幫人打官司搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 baau1 laam5 sou3 gung1, bong1 jan4 daa2 gun1 si1 wan2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司专门包揽诉讼，帮人打官司赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in soliciting lawsuits, helping people litigate to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 包攬訴訟喺好多地方都係犯法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baau1 laam5 sou3 gung1 hai2 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 hai6 faan6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 包揽诉讼在很多地方都是违法的。
examples.english_sentence: Soliciting lawsuits is illegal in many places.

english_meaning: Absolutely certain; Guaranteed; Definitely no problem
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情绝对可靠，保证没有问题。强调事情的确定性。
explanation_english: Describes something as absolutely reliable, guaranteeing no problems. Emphasizes the certainty of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我包支包結幫你搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 baau1 zi1 baau1 git3 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，我保证帮你搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee I'll sort it out for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃包支包結會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 baau1 zi1 baau1 git3 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划肯定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is guaranteed to succeed.

english_meaning: to cover books (with protective material)
explanation_mandarin: 用纸或其他材料（通常是塑料）把书的封面和封底包起来，以保护书本。
explanation_english: To cover books with paper, plastic, or other protective material to protect them from damage and wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開學之前，阿媽會幫我哋包書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 hok6 zi1 cin4, aa3 maa1 wui5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 baau1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开学之前，妈妈会帮我们包书皮。
examples.english_sentence: Before the start of school, my mom will help us cover our books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲學生通常唔包書，直接用膠袋裝住啲書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hok6 sang1 tung1 soeng4 m4 baau1 syu1, zik6 zip3 yung6 gaau1 doi2 zong1 zyu6 di1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的学生通常不包书皮，直接用塑料袋装着书。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, students usually don't cover their books; they just put them in plastic bags.

english_meaning: Book covering film, book cover plastic
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于包裹书本的塑料薄膜，起到保护书本的作用。
explanation_english: A thin plastic film used to cover books, providing protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫啲書包包書膠，就唔怕整污糟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 di1 syu1 baau1 baau1 syu1 gaau1, zau6 m4 paa3 zing2 wu1 zou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮这些书包上书皮胶，就不怕弄脏了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's put book covering film on these books so they won't get dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗卷新嘅包書膠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gyun2 san1 ge3 baau1 syu1 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一卷新的书皮胶。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new roll of book covering film.

english_meaning: to book a table (at a restaurant, often for a large group); to reserve a table
explanation_mandarin: 预先订下餐厅的整张桌子，通常是为了多人聚餐。
explanation_english: To reserve an entire table at a restaurant, often for a large group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚包枱食飯慶祝生日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 baau1 toi2 sik6 faan6 hing3 zuk1 saang1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚包桌吃饭庆祝生日。
examples.english_sentence: We're booking a table tonight to celebrate a birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳咁多人，最好包枱先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 do1 jan4, zeoi3 hou2 baau1 toi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么多人，最好先包桌。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is so crowded, it's best to book a table first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋幾多位啊？要唔要包枱？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gei2 do1 wai2 aa3? jiu3 m4 jiu3 baau1 toi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们几位？要不要包桌？
examples.english_sentence: How many people are in your party? Do you want to book a table?

english_meaning: to charter (a plane); charter flight
explanation_mandarin: 租用整个飞机，而不是只买一张机票。
explanation_english: To charter an entire airplane; a flight on a chartered airplane. It implies renting the whole plane instead of just buying a single ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司包機送員工去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 baau1 gei1 sung3 jyun4 gung1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司包机送员工去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: Our company chartered a plane to send employees on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情關係，好多人選擇包機返香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 yik6 ching4 gwaan1 hai6, ho2 do1 jan4 syun2 zaak6 baau1 gei1 faan1 Hoeng1 Gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情关系，很多人选择包机回香港。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, many people chose to charter a plane to return to Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to excuse, to forgive, to bear with (someone), to include, to contain
explanation_mandarin: 客气话，表示请人原谅，包含的意思也有，但较少用。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to ask for forgiveness or understanding. It can also mean 'to include' or 'to contain,' though this meaning is less common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，咁夜先嚟，包涵包涵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gam3 je2 sin1 lei4, baau1 haam4 baau1 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这么晚才来，请多多包涵。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry for arriving so late, please excuse me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我第一次做，做得唔好嘅話，請你多多包涵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zou6, zou6 dak1 m4 hou2 ge3 waa2, cing2 nei5 do1 do1 baau1 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我第一次做，如果做得不好，请你多多包涵。
examples.english_sentence: This is my first time doing this, please bear with me if I don't do well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據未必包涵所有個案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 mei6 bit1 baau1 haam4 so2 jau5 go3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据未必包含所有个案。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report may not include all cases.

english_meaning: guaranteed to give birth to a son; son-guaranteeing (often referring to something that is supposed to bring luck for having a son)
explanation_mandarin: 指保证能够生男孩。通常用于形容一些迷信的物品或行为，声称可以增加生男孩的几率。
explanation_english: Refers to a guarantee of giving birth to a son. Usually used to describe superstitious items or practices that claim to increase the chances of having a son. It's often used sarcastically or to highlight outdated beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人以前好信啲所謂「包生仔」嘅符咒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 ji5 cin4 hou2 seon3 di1 so2 wai6 "baau1 sang1 zai2" ge3 fu4 zau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们很相信那些所谓的“包生男孩”的符咒。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people really believed in those so-called 'son-guaranteeing' charms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁迷信啦，邊有乜嘢包生仔㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mai4 seon3 laa1, bin1 jau5 mat1 je5 baau1 sang1 zai2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么迷信了，哪里有什么保证生男孩的？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so superstitious. There's no such thing as guaranteeing to have a son, right?

english_meaning: foreskin
explanation_mandarin: 覆盖男性阴茎龟头的一层皮肤。
explanation_english: The fold of skin covering the glans of the penis; the foreskin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢個仔有包皮過長，建議做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 go3 zai2 jau5 baau1 pei4 gwo3 coeng4, gin3 ji5 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他儿子有包皮过长，建议做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his son has phimosis and suggested surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 糟糕的环境；不利的环境；令人感到压抑的环境
english_meaning: Unfavorable environment; oppressive environment; restrictive environment; a situation where one feels trapped or stifled.
explanation_mandarin: 形容令人感到压抑、不舒服，难以发展或施展才能的环境。 类似于包皮过长带来的不适感，引申为令人不快的环境。
explanation_english: Describes an environment that is oppressive, uncomfortable, and hinders development or the ability to showcase talents. Similar to the discomfort caused by phimosis (包皮过长), it's used figuratively to describe an unpleasant or restrictive environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司簡直係包皮環境，啲規矩多到離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gaan2 zik6 hai6 baau1 pei4 waan4 ging2, di1 kwai1 geoi2 do1 dou3 lei4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司简直就是糟糕的环境，规矩多得离谱。
examples.english_sentence: This company is such a restrictive environment; the rules are ridiculously excessive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個包皮環境下，我覺得自己好難有進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 baau1 pei4 waan4 ging2 haa6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 naan4 jau5 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种不利的环境下，我觉得自己很难进步。
examples.english_sentence: In this oppressive environment, I feel it's difficult for me to make progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得間學校嘅風氣太保守，好似包皮環境噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 fung1 hei3 taai3 bou2 sau2, hou2 ci5 baau1 pei4 waan4 ging2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得这所学校的风气太保守，像个令人窒息的环境一样。
