examples.english_sentence: He feels the school's atmosphere is too conservative, like a restrictive environment.

synonyms: 烏煙瘴氣 (wu1 jin1 zoeng3 hei3)
死氣沉沉 (sei2 hei3 cam4 cam4)

english_meaning: to rent (a property in full); lease
explanation_mandarin: 整体租用，指租用整个物业或设施。
explanation_english: To rent an entire property or facility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋包租成層樓嚟做辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baau1 zou1 seng4 cang4 lau2 lai4 zou6 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们包租了一整层楼来做办公室。
examples.english_sentence: We rented the entire floor to use as an office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢包租咗架遊艇去開party。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baau1 zou1 zo2 gaa3 jau4 ting5 heoi3 hoi1 party.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他包租了一艘游艇去开派对。
examples.english_sentence: He chartered a yacht to have a party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司包租咗成間酒店畀員工度假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 baau1 zou1 zo2 seng4 gaan1 zau2 dim3 bei2 jyun4 gung1 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司包租了整间酒店给员工度假。
examples.english_sentence: The company chartered the whole hotel for the employees' vacation.

english_meaning: landlord
explanation_mandarin: 指靠出租房屋收取租金为生的男性房东。
explanation_english: A male landlord who makes a living by renting out properties and collecting rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個包租公成日上嚟催租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 baau1 zu1 gung1 seng4 jat6 soeng5 lei4 ceoi1 zu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的房东总是上来催房租。
examples.english_sentence: My landlord always comes up to urge me to pay the rent.

english_meaning: Landlady; female landlord (often used stereotypically to refer to a harsh or demanding landlady)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的房东。通常带有一种刻板印象，指那些比较苛刻、精明的女房东，尤其是住在旧式唐楼里的。
explanation_english: Refers to a female landlord. It often carries a stereotype of a harsh, shrewd, and sometimes unpleasant landlady, particularly one who owns and manages apartments in older tenement buildings (Tong Lau).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個包租婆日日都嚟收租，好煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 baau1 zu1 po4 jat6 jat6 dou1 lai4 sau1 zu1, hou2 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女房东每天都来收租，很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: Her landlady comes to collect the rent every day, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為個個包租婆都係惡死㗎，我個包租婆好好人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 go3 go3 baau1 zu1 po4 dou1 hai6 ok3 sei2 gaa3, ngo5 go3 baau1 zu1 po4 hou2 hou2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为每个女房东都很凶，我的女房东人很好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume that every landlady is fierce, my landlady is a very kind person.

english_meaning: to guarantee; to ensure; to bet (on something); sure thing
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事有把握，保证一定能做到；也指打赌。
explanation_english: To guarantee or ensure something; to be certain about something; also can mean to bet on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我包種你今次考試一定合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baau1 zung2 nei5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 jat1 ding6 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我保证你这次考试一定及格。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee you'll pass this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我包種呢隻馬會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baau1 zung2 ni1 zek3 maa5 wui5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我保证这匹马会赢。
examples.english_sentence: I bet this horse will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我包種佢唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baau1 zung2 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我确定他不会来。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sure he won't come.

english_meaning: guarantee, assure, vouch for
explanation_mandarin: 表示一定能做到，保证。
explanation_english: To guarantee; to assure; to vouch for. Indicates a certainty that something will happen or be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我包管搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 baau1 gun2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，我保证搞定他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee I'll sort him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔係咁好食，我包管退錢俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 sik6, ngo5 baau1 gun2 teoi3 cin2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不是那么好吃，我保证退钱给你。
examples.english_sentence: If it's not that delicious, I guarantee I'll give you a refund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢包管可以喺限時之內完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baau1 gun2 ho2 ji5 hai2 haan6 si4 zi1 noi6 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他保证可以在限定时间内完成。
examples.english_sentence: He guarantees he can finish it within the time limit.

english_meaning: corn, maize
explanation_mandarin: 指玉米，也叫玉米棒子。
explanation_english: Refers to corn or maize, also known as corn on the cob.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日喺街市買咗啲包粟返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 di1 baau1 suk1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天在菜市场买了一些玉米回来。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some corn at the market today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個包粟好甜啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baau1 suk1 hou2 tim4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个玉米好甜啊！
examples.english_sentence: This corn is so sweet!

english_meaning: to bandage; to dress (a wound)
explanation_mandarin: 用纱布、绷带等包扎伤口。
explanation_english: To cover a wound or injury with a bandage or dressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親之後要即刻包紮傷口呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 zi1 hau6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 baau1 zaat3 soeng1 hau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒之后要立刻包扎伤口啊。
examples.english_sentence: After falling down, you need to bandage the wound immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我包紮咗隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 baau1 zaat3 zo2 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我包扎了手。
examples.english_sentence: He bandaged my hand.

english_meaning: all-encompassing, all-inclusive, comprehensive, covering everything
explanation_mandarin: 形容内容非常丰富，应有尽有。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely rich in content, containing everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間百貨公司嘅貨品包羅萬有，你想買乜嘢都應該搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 ge3 fo3 pan2 baau1 lo4 maan6 jau5, nei5 soeng2 maai5 mat1 je5 dou1 jing1 goi1 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家百货公司的商品包罗万象，你想买什么都应该能找到。
examples.english_sentence: The goods in this department store are all-encompassing. You should be able to find whatever you want to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 互聯網上嘅資訊包羅萬有，但係都要小心判斷真偽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 lyun4 mong5 soeng6 ge3 zi1 seon3 baau1 lo4 maan6 jau5, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 pun3 dyun3 zan1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 互联网上的信息包罗万象，但是也要小心判断真伪。
examples.english_sentence: The information on the internet is all-encompassing, but you still need to be careful to judge the truth.

english_meaning: all-embracing; all-inclusive; to cover a wide range of things; encyclopedic
explanation_mandarin: 形容内容非常丰富，应有尽有。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very rich in content, encompassing everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個博物館真係包羅萬象，乜嘢都有得睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bok3 mat6 gun2 zan1 hai6 baau1 lo4 maan6 zoeng6, mat1 je5 dou1 jau5 dak1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个博物馆真是包罗万象，什么都能看到。
examples.english_sentence: This museum is truly all-embracing; you can see everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅知識真係包羅萬象，問乜都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi1 sik1 zan1 hai6 baau1 lo4 maan6 zoeng6, man6 mat1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的知识真是包罗万象，问什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: His knowledge is truly all-encompassing; he knows everything you ask.

english_meaning: to expose; to reveal (a scandal or wrongdoing); to 'spill the beans';
explanation_mandarin: 指揭露内幕、爆料，通常指揭发负面或丑闻事件。
explanation_english: Refers to revealing inside stories, exposing secrets, often concerning negative or scandalous events. It carries a connotation of 'spilling the beans' or revealing something that was meant to be kept secret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司啲黑幕俾人包膠爆晒出嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 di1 hak1 muk6 bei2 jan4 baau1 gaau1 baau3 saai3 ceot1 lai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的内幕被爆料全部揭发出来了。
examples.english_sentence: The inside secrets of their company have been exposed and revealed completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好包膠我㗎，我驚俾人搞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baau1 gaau1 ngo5 gaa3, ngo5 geng3 bei2 jan4 gaau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要揭发我啊，我怕被人整啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't expose me, I'm afraid of being messed with.

english_meaning: To charter a boat; to hire a boat exclusively; to rent a boat
explanation_mandarin: 指租用整条船，而非只购买一张船票。
explanation_english: Refers to hiring an entire boat, rather than just buying a ticket for a seat. It implies exclusive use of the boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日包艇出海釣魚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 baau1 teng5 ceot1 hoi2 diu3 yu4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天包船出海钓鱼啊！
examples.english_sentence: We're chartering a boat to go fishing at sea tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年公司包咗幾架艇搞員工旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gung1 si1 baau1 zo2 gei2 gaa3 teng5 gaau2 jyun4 gung1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年公司包了几艘船搞员工旅游。
examples.english_sentence: The company chartered several boats for the employee trip this year.

english_meaning: to harbor evil intentions; to have a sinister design; to have ulterior motives
explanation_mandarin: 心里怀着害人的念头。指隐藏着阴险的企图或不可告人的目的。
explanation_english: To harbor evil or malicious intentions; to conceal a sinister plot or ulterior motive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日笑騎騎咁，其實包藏禍心，你小心啲呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 siu3 ke4 ke4 gam2, kei4 sat6 baau1 cong4 wo6 sam1, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是笑嘻嘻的，其实包藏祸心，你小心点啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's always smiling, but he's actually harboring evil intentions. Be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個商業計劃睇落好好，但係我哋要小心，可能會包藏禍心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1 jip6 gai3 waak6 tai2 lok6 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, ho2 nang4 wui5 baau1 cong4 wo6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个商业计划看起来很好，但是我们要小心，可能包藏祸心。
examples.english_sentence: This business plan looks good, but we need to be careful, it might harbor evil intentions.

synonyms: 心懷鬼胎 (sam1 waai4 gwai2 toi1)

english_meaning: swaddling clothes; to wrap up (a baby); swaddle
explanation_mandarin: 用布或其他材料包裹婴儿；用于包裹婴儿的布或毯子。
explanation_english: Cloth or material used to wrap a baby; to wrap a baby (in swaddling clothes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆用塊布包被住個BB。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 yung6 faai3 bou3 baau1 pei1 zyu6 go3 bi1 bi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶用一块布包裹着那个婴儿。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is using a piece of cloth to swaddle the baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB瞓覺要包被先瞓得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 fan3 gaau3 yiu3 baau1 pei1 sin1 fan3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿睡觉要用襁褓包裹才能睡得好。
examples.english_sentence: Babies sleep better when they are swaddled.

english_meaning: burden, encumbrance; (comedic) gag, comedic material
explanation_mandarin: 指精神上或物质上的负担、累赘；在粤语中也指喜剧演员的笑料、段子。
explanation_english: Refers to a burden, encumbrance, or something that weighs one down, either physically or mentally. In Cantonese, it can also refer to comedic material or gags used by comedians.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁重包袱啦，放鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung5 baau1 fuk6 laa1, fong3 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要有这么重的包袱，放松一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't carry such a heavy burden, relax a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲棟篤笑包袱好好笑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 dung6 duk6 siu3 baau1 fuk6 hou2 hou2 siu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的栋笃笑的包袱很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: His stand-up comedy gags are very funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放低晒啲包袱，先可以重新出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 dai1晒啲baau1 fuk6, sin1 ho2 ji5 cung4 san1 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放下所有的包袱，才可以重新出发。
examples.english_sentence: Only by letting go of all burdens can you start anew.

english_meaning: Packaging; to package; to wrap; to present (in a certain way); to gild; to embellish
explanation_mandarin: 指将物品包裹起来，或指对某事物进行美化、修饰，使其更具吸引力。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of wrapping or covering something, or to beautify or embellish something to make it more attractive. Can also refer to the act of presenting something in a specific manner, often to enhance its appeal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個禮物嘅包裝好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lai5 mat6 ge3 baau1 zong1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个礼物的包装很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: The packaging of this gift is so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得包裝自己，所以好多人鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 baau1 zong1 zi6 gei2, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会包装自己，所以很多人喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to present himself well, so a lot of people like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇包裝，要睇實際內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 baau1 zong1, jiu3 tai2 sat6 zai3 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看包装，要看实际内容。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at the packaging, look at the actual content.

english_meaning: parcel; package
explanation_mandarin: 用纸、布等包起来的东西，一般指邮寄或运输的货物。
explanation_english: An item wrapped in paper, cloth, etc., usually referring to goods sent by post or transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日收到個包裹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 go3 baau1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天收到一个包裹。
examples.english_sentence: I received a parcel yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我寄個包裹去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 gei3 go3 baau1 gwo2 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我寄一个包裹去美国。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me send a parcel to America.

english_meaning: to buy out; to monopolize; to take responsibility for; to take (someone) under one's wing; to sponsor
explanation_mandarin: 全部买下，垄断；承担责任；包养；赞助。
explanation_english: To buy out or monopolize something; to take responsibility for something; to 'take care of' or sponsor someone, often with financial support; to take someone under one's wing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢包起咗成間餐廳，淨係請佢啲朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baau1 hei2 zo2 seng4 gaan1 caan1 teng1, zing6 hai6 ceng2 keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他包下了整个餐厅，只邀请他的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He bought out the entire restaurant and only invited his friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使擔心，呢件事我包起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 baau1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用担心，这件事我包了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I'll take responsibility for this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢畀個有錢佬包起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 bei2 go3 jau5 cin2 lou2 baau1 hei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说她被一个有钱人包养了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard she's being sponsored by a rich man.

english_meaning: to charter a vehicle, to rent a vehicle (exclusively)
explanation_mandarin: 指租用整辆车，而非按座位或里程计费。
explanation_english: To charter or rent a vehicle for exclusive use, rather than paying per seat or per distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋包車去機場，方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baau1 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, faang1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们包车去机场，方便一些。
examples.english_sentence: We'll charter a car to the airport, it's more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果人多嘅話，包車仲抵過搭的士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jan4 do1 ge3 waa2, baau1 ce1 zung2 dai2 gwo3 daap3 dik1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果人多的话，包车比打的士还划算。
examples.english_sentence: If there are a lot of people, chartering a car is cheaper than taking a taxi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋包咗架旅遊車，去郊外玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baau1 zo2 gaa3 leoi5 jau4 ce1, heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们包了一辆旅游车，去郊外玩。
examples.english_sentence: They chartered a tour bus to go to the countryside.

english_meaning: to take care of everything; to monopolize; to handle alone; to do everything oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或一个机构负责处理全部事务，不让别人参与。
explanation_english: Refers to one person or organization being responsible for handling all matters, not allowing others to participate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽咩都幫佢包辦晒，搞到佢好似個BB仔咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 me1 dou1 bong1 keoi5 baau1 baan6 saai3, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 hou2 ci5 go3 BB zai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他妈妈什么都帮他包办了，搞得他好像个小宝宝一样。
examples.english_sentence: His mother takes care of everything for him, making him like a baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司所有嘅活動都俾佢包辦晒，其他人冇晒機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 so2 jau5 ge3 wut6 dung6 dou1 bei2 keoi5 baau1 baan6 saai3, kei4 taa1 jan4 mou5 saai3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司所有的活动都被他包办了，其他人没有机会了。
examples.english_sentence: He monopolizes all the activities in the company, and no one else has a chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咩都想包辦，要學識分配工作俾其他人做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 me1 dou1 soeng2 baau1 baan6, jiu3 hok6 sik1 fan1 pui3 gung1 zok3 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要什么都想包办，要学会分配工作给其他人做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to handle everything yourself; you need to learn to delegate work to others.

english_meaning: Free shipping
explanation_mandarin: 指商家承担运费，买家不需要支付运费。
explanation_english: Refers to the seller bearing the shipping costs, so the buyer does not need to pay for shipping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個網店買滿一百蚊就包郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mong5 dim3 maai5 mun5 jat1 baak3 man1 zau6 baau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个网店买满一百块就包邮。
examples.english_sentence: This online store offers free shipping for orders over one hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話買兩件衫就包郵，咁我就買多件啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 maai5 loeng5 gin6 saam1 zau6 baau1 jau4, gam2 ngo5 zau6 maai5 do1 gin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说买两件衣服就包邮，那我就多买一件吧。
examples.english_sentence: He said free shipping is offered for purchasing two items of clothing, so I'll buy one more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多網店都做緊包郵嘅優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 mong5 dim3 dou1 zou6 gan2 baau1 jau4 ge3 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多网店都在做包邮的优惠。
examples.english_sentence: Many online stores are offering free shipping promotions.

english_meaning: gold-plated; to gold-plate
explanation_mandarin: 指在物品表面镀上一层金。
explanation_english: To gold-plate; to cover something with a thin layer of gold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻戒指包金嘅，唔係純金㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gaai3 zi2 baau1 gam1 ge3, m4 hai6 seon4 gam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个戒指是镀金的，不是纯金的。
examples.english_sentence: This ring is gold-plated, it's not pure gold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司專門幫人包金首飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 baau1 gam1 sau2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司专门帮人镀金首饰。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in gold-plating jewelry for people.

mandarin_meaning: 心怀鬼胎; 不安好心
english_meaning: To have ulterior motives; to harbor ill intentions; to have a hidden agenda
explanation_mandarin: 比喻心中怀有不可告人的目的，居心不良。
explanation_english: A metaphor for harboring hidden, often malicious, intentions or ulterior motives. It implies that someone's actions are not what they seem and that they are secretly planning something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日笑咪咪咁對你，其實包雲吞㗎，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 deoi3 nei5, kei4 sat6 baau1 wan4 tan1 gaa3, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是笑眯眯地对你，其实不安好心，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's always smiling at you, but he's actually got ulterior motives, so be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢呀，佢包雲吞，想呃你啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 baau1 wan4 tan1, soeng2 ngaak1 nei5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他不安好心，想骗你的钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he has ulterior motives, he wants to scam you out of your money.

mandarin_meaning: 包拯；清官；公正廉明的人
english_meaning: Justice Bao; an honest and upright official; a person of utmost integrity
explanation_mandarin: 指北宋时期著名的清官包拯，也用来比喻公正廉明、铁面无私的人。
explanation_english: Refers to Bao Zheng, a famous honest and upright official of the Northern Song Dynasty. It is also used as a metaphor for a person who is fair, just, incorruptible, and impartial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好似包青天咁，公正唔阿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 baau1 cing1 tin1 gam2, gung1 zeng3 m4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事像包青天一样，公正不偏袒。
examples.english_sentence: He works like Justice Bao, fair and impartial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔係包青天，憑咩判我有罪？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hai6 baau1 cing1 tin1, pang4 me1 pun3 ngo5 jau5 zeoi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又不是包青天，凭什么判我有罪？
examples.english_sentence: You're not Justice Bao, what gives you the right to judge me guilty?

english_meaning: to talk back; to argue back; to be argumentative
explanation_mandarin: 指晚辈或下属不听从长辈或上级的指示，反而反驳或争辩。语气较强，带有不尊重和不服从的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a junior or subordinate arguing back or disputing instructions from a senior or superior. The tone is strong and implies disrespect and disobedience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日包頂頸啦，阿媽講嘅嘢都有道理㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 baau1 ding2 geng2 laa1, aa3 maa1 gong2 ge3 je5 dou1 jau5 dou6 lei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是顶嘴，妈妈说的话也有道理的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always talk back; what Mom says makes sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細講乜你都包頂頸，咁樣好難升職㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gong2 mat1 nei5 dou1 baau1 ding2 geng2, gam2 joeng2 hou2 naan4 sing1 zik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说什么你都要顶嘴，这样很难升职的。
examples.english_sentence: You argue back at everything the boss says, it's hard to get promoted that way.

english_meaning: guarantee success; a sure thing; a lock
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情有很高的成功把握，几乎可以确定一定会成功。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high probability of success, almost certain to succeed. It suggests that something is guaranteed or a sure thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅project，有佢幫手，包頭掂啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 project, jau5 keoi5 bong1 sau2, baau1 tau4 dim3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目，有他帮忙，肯定成功啦！
examples.english_sentence: This project, with his help, is guaranteed to be a success!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁有經驗，呢個比賽包頭贏硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jau5 ging1 jim6, ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 baau1 tau4 wing4 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么有经验，这个比赛肯定赢。
examples.english_sentence: You're so experienced, you're guaranteed to win this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有佢嘅支持，我哋嘅計劃包頭可以順利進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 keoi5 ge3 zi1 chi4, ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 baau1 tau4 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 gan2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有他的支持，我们的计划肯定可以顺利进行。
examples.english_sentence: With his support, our plan is guaranteed to proceed smoothly.

english_meaning: Head covering bag; hood; a bag or cloth used to cover the head.
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来遮盖头部的袋子或布。 通常用于保护头部免受灰尘、阳光或其他环境因素的影响。 在香港，有时候也指代某些宗教场合使用的头巾。
explanation_english: A bag or cloth used to cover the head. It is typically used to protect the head from dust, sunlight, or other environmental factors. In Hong Kong, it can sometimes refer to headscarves used in certain religious occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住個包頭袋，睇唔到佢嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zoek3 go3 baau1 tau4 doi2, tai2 m4 dou2 keoi5 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着头巾，看不清她的样子。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a head covering bag, so I can't see her face clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨喇，攞個包頭袋遮住頭先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 laa3, lo2 go3 baau1 tau4 doi2 ze1 zyu6 tau4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，先拿个头罩遮住头。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, grab a head covering to cover your head first.

english_meaning: to keep (a mistress/lover); to provide for someone financially in exchange for companionship or sexual favors; sugar daddy/mommy relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指以金钱或其他物质上的资助，来维持和某人的情侣关系或性关系。通常涉及一方提供经济支持，另一方提供陪伴或性服务。
explanation_english: Refers to providing financial support or other material assistance to maintain a romantic or sexual relationship with someone. It usually involves one party providing economic support and the other party providing companionship or sexual services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾個有錢佬包養咗，唔使做都有錢使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 jau5 cin2 lou2 baau1 joeng5 zo2, m4 sai2 zou6 dou1 jau5 cin2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被一个有钱人包养了，不用工作也有钱花。
examples.english_sentence: She's being kept by a rich man and doesn't have to work to have money to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想靠自己，諗住搵個有錢人包養佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 kaau3 zi6 gei2, nam2 zyu2 wan2 go3 jau5 cin2 jan4 baau1 joeng5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不想靠自己，想着找个有钱人包养她。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't want to rely on herself and is thinking of finding a rich person to keep her.

english_meaning: hurried; rushed; hastily
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间紧迫，行动快速。
explanation_english: Describing a state of being in a hurry or rushing; doing something quickly due to limited time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢匆匆忙忙咁行開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 cung1 mong4 mong4 gam2 haang4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他匆匆忙忙地走开了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked away in a hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁匆，慢慢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1, maan6 maan2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么匆忙，慢慢来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush, take your time.

english_meaning: hurriedly, hastily, in a rush
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间短促，事情仓促；也形容动作迅速。
explanation_english: Describes something done quickly, hastily, or in a rush, often because of time constraints or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢匆匆咁食完飯就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 cung1 gam2 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他匆匆忙忙地吃完饭就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He hurriedly finished his meal and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋時間唔多，要匆匆搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 si4 gaan3 m4 do1, jiu3 cung1 cung1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的时间不多，要匆匆忙忙地把它完成。
examples.english_sentence: We don't have much time, we need to get it done quickly.

synonyms: 急急忙忙 (gap1 gap1 mong4 mong4)

english_meaning: hurriedly; in a rush; hastily
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常匆忙的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being very rushed and hurried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都匆匆忙忙咁，唔知做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 cung1 cung1 mong4 mong4 gam2, m4 zi1 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是匆匆忙忙的，不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always in a rush, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早返工，個個都匆匆忙忙，好似打仗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 faan1 gung1, go3 go3 dou1 cung1 cung1 mong4 mong4, hou2 ci5 daa2 zoeng3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上上班，每个人都匆匆忙忙的，好像打仗一样。
examples.english_sentence: In the morning going to work, everyone is in a rush, like a war.

english_meaning: hurried, rushed
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间紧迫，行动急速。
explanation_english: Describing a state of being hurried or rushed, often due to lack of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝太匆忙，冇食早餐就出門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 taai3 cung1 mong4, mou5 sik6 zou2 caan1 zau6 ceot1 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上太匆忙了，没吃早餐就出门了。
examples.english_sentence: I was too rushed this morning, I left home without having breakfast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好匆忙咁離開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 mong4 gam2 lei4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很匆忙地离开了。
examples.english_sentence: He left in a hurry.

english_meaning: fierce; violent; terrible; ominous; unlucky
explanation_mandarin: 指凶恶的，不吉利的，可怕的。
explanation_english: Refers to something fierce, ominous, terrible, or unlucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好匈，唔敢埋佢身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 hung1, m4 gam2 maai4 keoi5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子很凶，不敢靠近他。
examples.english_sentence: He looks very fierce, I don't dare to get close to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係好匈，出街都撞到唔好嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hung1, chut1 gaai1 dou1 zong6 dou2 m4 hou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真倒霉，出门都碰到不好的事。
examples.english_sentence: Today is really unlucky, I encountered bad things when I went out.

mandarin_meaning: 蛮夷; 骂人的话，指不讲理的人
english_meaning: Barbarian; unreasonable person (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，除了指古代的匈奴民族，也常用来骂人野蛮、不讲理、粗鲁。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, besides referring to the ancient Xiongnu people, it's often used as a derogatory term to scold someone for being barbaric, unreasonable, or rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁匈奴，邊個想同你合作啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 hung1 nou4, bin1 go3 soeng2 tung4 nei5 hap6 jok3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么蛮横，谁想和你合作啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're so unreasonable in your work, who would want to cooperate with you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢个人真系好匈奴，成日唔听人讲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hung1 nou4, seng4 jat6 m4 ting1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的很野蛮，总是听不进别人的话。
examples.english_sentence: He's a really unreasonable person, always ignoring what others say.

english_meaning: Hungary
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲国家，匈牙利
explanation_english: Hungary, a country in Central Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去匈牙利旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 hung1 ngaa5 lei6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去匈牙利旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Hungary for a trip next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講匈牙利文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 hung1 ngaa5 lei6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说匈牙利语。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak Hungarian.

english_meaning: to crawl
explanation_mandarin: 指用手和膝盖贴地向前移动。
explanation_english: To move forward on one's hands and knees; to crawl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔啱啱學行路，成日都喺度匍嚟匍去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hok6 haang4 lou6, sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 pou4 lai4 pou4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子刚学会走路，整天都在那里爬来爬去。
examples.english_sentence: The child just learned to walk and crawls around all day.

english_meaning: to crawl, to lie prone
explanation_mandarin: 身体向前倾斜，用手脚着地前进。
explanation_english: To move forward with the body close to the ground, using hands and feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時成日喺地下匐嚟匐去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 hai2 dei6 haa2 buk6 lai4 buk6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候总是在地上爬来爬去。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a child, he often crawled around on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir叫我哋做掌上壓，我哋就要伏低身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 zoeng2 soeng6 aat3, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 fuk6 dai1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师让我们做俯卧撑，我们就要趴下。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher told us to do push-ups, and we had to lie prone.

english_meaning: spoon
explanation_mandarin: 指一种舀东西的餐具，通常用于喝汤或舀饭。
explanation_english: A utensil used for eating soup or other liquids, or for serving food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾隻匕我，我想飲啖湯呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zek3 bei2 ngo5, ngo5 soeng2 jam2 daam6 tong1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一把勺子，我想喝口汤。
examples.english_sentence: Give me a spoon, I want to have a sip of soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用匕食飯方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 bei2 sik6 faan6 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用勺子吃饭方便一些。
examples.english_sentence: It's more convenient to eat rice with a spoon.

english_meaning: dagger, short knife
explanation_mandarin: 一种短小的刀，通常是双刃的，用于刺或割。
explanation_english: A short, double-edged knife or dagger used for stabbing or cutting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢袋咗把匕首防身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 zo2 baa2 bi2 sau2 fong4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他带了一把匕首防身。
examples.english_sentence: He carried a dagger for self-defense.

english_meaning: to melt; to change; to transform; to turn into; to 'become' (something in a slang sense)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 溶化：固体变成液体。2. 变化：改变性质或状态。 3. （俚语）指花费，通常指花费了很多钱。
explanation_english: 1. To melt: To change from a solid to a liquid. 2. To change: To alter in nature or state. 3. (Slang) To spend, usually a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲冰化咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bing1 faa3 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冰融化了。
examples.english_sentence: The ice has melted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢化咗好多錢買衫。

english_meaning: Turn crisis into opportunity; turn danger into advantage
explanation_mandarin: 将危险的局面转化为有利的机遇。形容善于处理危机，将不利因素转化为有利条件。
explanation_english: To turn a crisis into an opportunity; to turn a dangerous situation into an advantageous one. It describes the ability to handle crises effectively and transform unfavorable factors into favorable conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然今次疫情對公司嘅生意有影響，但係我哋要化危為機，發展網上銷售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 gam1 ci3 jik1 ching4 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 saang1 ji3 jau5 jing2 hoeng2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faa3 ngai4 wai4 gei1, faat3 zin2 mong5 soeng6 siu1 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这次疫情对公司的生意有影响，但是我们要化危为机，发展网上销售。
examples.english_sentence: Although this pandemic has affected the company's business, we need to turn the crisis into an opportunity and develop online sales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對經濟衰退，企業要積極諗方法，化危為機，唔好齋係埋怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3, kei5 jip6 jiu3 zik1 gik1 nam2 fong1 faat3, faa3 ngai4 wai4 gei1, m4 hou2 zaai1 hai6 maai4 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对经济衰退，企业要积极想办法，化危为机，不要只是抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with economic recession, businesses need to actively find ways to turn the crisis into an opportunity, and not just complain.

synonyms: 轉禍為福 (zyun2 wo6 wai4 fuk1)

mandarin_meaning: 化险为夷; 转危为安; 变危机为机遇
english_meaning: Turn crisis into opportunity; turn danger into safety; capitalize on a crisis

explanation_english: To turn a dangerous or unfavorable situation into an opportunity. It describes the ability to take advantage of a crisis to gain benefits or achieve goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然疫情對公司造成咗好大嘅衝擊，但係我哋成功化危爲機，開拓咗新嘅市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jik1 ching4 deoi3 gung1 si1 jo6 sing4 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 chung1 gik1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 faa3 ngai4 wai4 gei1, hoi1 tok3 zo2 san1 ge3 si5 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然疫情对公司造成了很大的冲击，但是我们成功地化危为机，开拓了新的市场。
examples.english_sentence: Although the pandemic has had a big impact on the company, we successfully turned the crisis into an opportunity and opened up new markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅生意失敗咗，但係佢都冇放棄，反而化危爲機，搵到另一個更好嘅發展方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 saang1 yi3 sat1 baai6 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 mou5 fong3 hei3, faan2 ji4 faa3 ngai4 wai4 gei1, wan2 dou3 ling6 jat1 go3 gang3 hou2 ge3 faat3 zin2 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生意失败了，但是他都没有放弃，反而化危为机，找到了另一个更好的发展方向。
examples.english_sentence: His business failed, but he didn't give up. Instead, he turned the crisis into an opportunity and found another better direction for development.

english_meaning: chemical combination, to combine chemically, compound
explanation_mandarin: 指两种或多种物质通过化学反应结合成一种新的物质。
explanation_english: Refers to the combination of two or more substances through a chemical reaction to form a new substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 氧氣同氫氣可以化合成水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joeng5 hei3 tung4 hing1 hei3 ho2 ji5 faa3 hap6 sing4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 氧气和氢气可以化合成水。
examples.english_sentence: Oxygen and hydrogen can combine chemically to form water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩種物質好容易化合。

english_meaning: chemical compound
explanation_mandarin: 由两种或多种元素以固定比例通过化学键结合而成的物质。
explanation_english: A substance consisting of two or more elements combined chemically in fixed proportions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 水係一種好重要嘅化合物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi2 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 waa1 hap6 mat6.

english_meaning: alias, pseudonym, assumed name

explanation_english: A false name used to conceal one's real identity.

examples.english_sentence: He used a pseudonym to write novels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方公布咗疑犯嘅化名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gung1 bou3 zo2 yi4 faan6 ge3 faa3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方公布了嫌疑犯的化名。
examples.english_sentence: The police announced the suspect's alias.

english_meaning: to put on makeup; makeup
explanation_mandarin: 使用化妆品修饰容貌。
explanation_english: To apply cosmetics to the face; also refers to makeup itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都化妝先出門口。

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 go3 faa3 zong1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天的妆容真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: Your makeup looks very beautiful today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢化咗個淡妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa3 zo2 go3 daam6 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她化了个淡妆。
examples.english_sentence: She put on light makeup.

english_meaning: cosmetics; makeup
explanation_mandarin: 用于美化和修饰面部及身体的各种产品。
explanation_english: Products used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face and body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意買化妝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 maai5 faa3 zong1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很喜欢买化妆品。
examples.english_sentence: She likes buying cosmetics a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個牌子嘅化妝品好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 faa3 zong1 ban2 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个牌子的化妆品很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This brand of cosmetics is very famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇化妝，唔想見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faa3 zong1, m4 soeng2 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没化妆，不想见人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not wearing makeup today, I don't want to see anyone.

english_meaning: makeup artist
explanation_mandarin: 专门从事化妆工作的人。
explanation_english: A professional who applies makeup to others, often for performances, photoshoots, or special occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係成為一個專業嘅化妝師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 zyun1 jip6 ge3 faa3 zong1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一个专业的化妆师。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a professional makeup artist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵咗個化妝師幫佢化新娘妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 zo2 go3 faa3 zong1 si1 bong1 keoi5 faa3 san1 noeng2 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她找了一个化妆师帮她化新娘妆。
examples.english_sentence: She hired a makeup artist to do her bridal makeup.

mandarin_meaning: 不正规的提供性服务的场所；卖淫场所
english_meaning: brothel disguised as a massage parlor, hair salon, or other business; illegal sex establishment
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上从事正当行业，实际上提供性服务的场所。 通常以按摩院，美容院，发廊等名义经营。
explanation_english: Refers to a place that ostensibly operates a legitimate business but in reality provides sexual services. These are often disguised as massage parlors, beauty salons, or hair salons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條街好多化妝樓，晚晚都好多人出入。

examples.english_sentence: There are many brothels disguised as legitimate businesses on that street, and many people go in and out every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人掃蕩咗一間化妝樓，拉咗幾個人。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的化妆包里有很多口红。
examples.english_sentence: There are many lipsticks in my makeup bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺佢個化妝袋度搵嘢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是在她的化妆包里找东西。
examples.english_sentence: She's always looking for things in her makeup bag.

mandarin_meaning: 化学反应；（引申义）合不来，不协调
english_meaning: chemistry; (extended meaning) awkward, incompatible, not clicking
explanation_mandarin: 本义指化学，科学的一个分支。引申义指人与人之间相处不融洽，产生不协调的感觉。
explanation_english: Literally means chemistry, a branch of science. The extended meaning refers to a situation where people don't get along well, creating an awkward or incompatible feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似唔係咁夾，有啲化學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gam3 gaap3, jau5 di1 faa3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个好像不太合得来，有点不对劲。
examples.english_sentence: Those two don't seem to get along well; there's something awkward between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢真係冇化學，一齊做嘢好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zan1 hai6 mou5 faa3 hok6, jat1 cai4 zou6 je5 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他真的不合拍，一起工作很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: There's really no chemistry between me and him; it's hard to work together.

mandarin_meaning: 化学作用；产生化学反应；比喻人或事物之间相互影响
english_meaning: Chemical reaction; Chemistry (between people); rapport; the dynamic between individuals or things.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是化学反应。也用来比喻人或事物之间产生的相互影响和作用，多指好的、积极的效果，类似于“来电”、“有火花”。
explanation_english: Literally means 'chemical reaction'. Figuratively, it refers to the interaction and mutual influence between people or things, often with a positive or favorable outcome, similar to 'chemistry', 'spark', or 'rapport'. It suggests a strong connection or dynamic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似有啲化學作用喎，成日黐埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 faa3 hok6 zok3 yung6 wo3, sing4 jat6 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个好像有点化学作用哦，总是黏在一起。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like there's some chemistry between those two; they're always sticking together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個演員嘅化學作用好好，令部戲好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 go3 jin2 jyun4 ge3 faa3 hok6 zok3 yung6 hou2 hou2, ling6 bou6 hei3 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个演员的化学作用很好，让这部戏很好看。
examples.english_sentence: The chemistry between these two actors is great, making the film very enjoyable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間冇乜化學作用，所以合作得唔係咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 mou5 mat1 faa3 hok6 zok3 yung6, so2 ji5 hap6 zok3 dak1 m4 hai6 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间没什么化学作用，所以合作得不是很顺利。
examples.english_sentence: There's not much chemistry between them, so the collaboration isn't going very smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 假朋友; 没有真感情的朋友
english_meaning: Fake friend; someone who acts like a friend but isn't genuine
explanation_mandarin: 形容那些表面上对你很好，但实际上并不真心，只是逢场作戏的朋友。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts friendly and kind on the surface but is not genuine or sincere as a friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時對你好好咁，但其實係個化學公仔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 deoi3 nei5 hou2 hou2 gam2, daan6 kei4 sat6 hai6 go3 faa3 hok6 gung1 zai2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时对你很好，但其实是个假朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is usually very nice to you, but he's actually a fake friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易信人，好容易遇到化學公仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 yi6 seon3 jan4, hou2 jung4 yi6 jyu6 dou2 faa3 hok6 gung1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易相信别人，很容易遇到假朋友的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily; it's easy to encounter fake friends.

english_meaning: chemical formula
explanation_mandarin: 表示物质分子组成的化学符号式子。
explanation_english: A symbolic representation of the chemical composition of a substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺化學堂度學緊點樣寫化學式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 faa3 hok6 tong4 dou6 hok6 gan2 dim2 joeng2 se2 faa3 hok6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在化学课上学如何写化学式。
examples.english_sentence: We are learning how to write chemical formulas in chemistry class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 水嘅化學式係 H2O。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 水的化学式是 H2O。
examples.english_sentence: The chemical formula for water is H2O.

english_meaning: Chemical weapon
explanation_mandarin: 指利用化学物质的毒性、刺激性或其他化学效应来伤害或杀死人类、动物或破坏植物的武器。
explanation_english: A chemical weapon is a weapon that uses the toxic properties of chemical substances to injure, incapacitate, or kill humans, animals, or damage plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化學武器對人類嘅威脅好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 hok6 mou5 hei3 deoi3 jan4 leoi5 ge3 wai1 hip3 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化学武器对人类的威胁很大。
examples.english_sentence: Chemical weapons pose a great threat to humanity.

english_meaning: chemical energy
explanation_mandarin: 物质内部储存的能量，因化学反应而释放或吸收。
explanation_english: Energy stored in the bonds of chemical compounds. It is released or absorbed during chemical reactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲燃料燒咗之後，就會釋放化學能出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jyun4 liu2 siu1 zo2 zi1 hau6, zau6 wui5 sik1 fong3 faa3 hok6 nang4 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 燃料燃烧之后，就会释放化学能出来。
examples.english_sentence: After the fuel is burned, it releases chemical energy.

english_meaning: chemical bond
explanation_mandarin: 化学键是指原子之间或分子之间通过相互作用形成的强烈的结合力。
explanation_english: A chemical bond is a lasting attraction between atoms, ions, or molecules that enables the formation of chemical compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲化學鍵決定咗啲物質嘅特性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 faa3 hok6 gin6 kyut3 ding6 zo2 di1 mat6 zat1 ge3 dak6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些化学键决定了这些物质的特性。
examples.english_sentence: These chemical bonds determine the properties of these substances.

english_meaning: to burn joss paper (spirit money) as an offering to ancestors or deities
explanation_mandarin: 指焚烧纸钱、纸扎等祭品，以供奉先人或神祇。
explanation_english: To burn joss paper, paper offerings, or other sacrificial items as an offering to ancestors or deities. This is a common practice in Chinese folk religion and is believed to provide wealth and necessities to the deceased in the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嗰陣，我哋會去掃墓同埋化寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 sou3 mou6 tung4 maai4 faa3 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，我们会去扫墓和焚烧纸钱。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, we go to clean the graves and burn joss paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話要買多啲紙紮，化寶俾過身嘅親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 jiu3 maai5 do1 di1 zi2 zaat3, faa3 bou2 bei2 gwo3 san1 ge3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说要多买一些纸扎，焚烧给过世的亲人。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said she needs to buy more paper offerings to burn for the deceased relatives.

english_meaning: Incinerator for joss paper offerings; brazier for burning paper offerings
explanation_mandarin: 用于焚烧纸钱、金银纸等祭祀用品的炉子。常见于祭祀场所、墓地等地方。
explanation_english: A brazier or incinerator specifically used for burning joss paper, paper money, and other paper offerings, often found in temples, cemeteries, and other places of worship or remembrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嗰陣，好多人會去掃墓，喺化寶爐度燒啲金銀紙俾先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 sou3 mou6, hai2 faa3 bou2 lou4 dou6 siu1 di1 gam1 ngan4 zi2 bei2 sin1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，很多人会去扫墓，在化宝炉里烧一些金银纸给先人。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, many people visit ancestral graves and burn joss paper in the incinerator for their ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜完神之後，記得將啲衣紙攞去化寶爐燒咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 jyun4 san4 zi1 hau6, gei3 dak1 zoeng1 di1 ji1 zi2 lo2 heoi3 faa3 bou2 lou4 siu1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜完神之后，记得把那些衣纸拿到化宝炉烧掉。
examples.english_sentence: After praying to the gods, remember to take the paper offerings to the incinerator and burn them.

english_meaning: chemical engineering; chemical industry; (slang) artificial, fake (referring to appearance, often involving cosmetic surgery or makeup)
explanation_mandarin: 本意为化学工程、化学工业。在粤语俚语中，指通过化妆、整容等手段改变外貌，使其看起来像是“人造”的。多用于形容女性。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to chemical engineering or the chemical industry. In Cantonese slang, it refers to changing one's appearance through makeup, cosmetic surgery, etc., to make it look "artificial" or "fake." It's often used to describe women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢化咗好重嘅妝，成個樣好似化工咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa3 zo2 hou2 cung5 ge3 zong1, seng4 go3 joeng2 hou2 ci5 haan4 gung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她化了很浓的妆，整个人看起来像化工产品一样。
examples.english_sentence: She put on very heavy makeup; her whole face looks like it's made of chemicals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁話人哋啦，可能人哋天生麗質，唔係化工嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 waa6 jan4 dei6 laa1, ho2 nang4 jan4 dei6 tin1 sang1 lai6 zat1, m4 hai6 haan4 gung1 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人啦，可能人家天生丽质，不是靠化工的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about others, maybe they were born beautiful, it's not artificial.

jyutping: faa3 gon1 go1 wai4 juk6 bok6
english_meaning: to turn hostility into friendship; to bury the hatchet; to turn weapons of war into gifts of peace
explanation_mandarin: 干戈：古代的兵器，借指战争；玉帛：玉器和丝织品，借指和好。比喻使战争转变为和平。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of transforming conflict and animosity into peace and goodwill. It signifies resolving disputes and establishing friendly relations after a period of hostility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾掂數，決定化干戈為玉帛，以後唔再針鋒相對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 dim6 sou3, kyut3 ding6 faa3 gon1 go1 wai4 juk6 bok6, ji5 hau6 m4 zoi3 zam1 fung1 soeng1 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈判达成协议，决定化干戈为玉帛，以后不再针锋相对。
examples.english_sentence: They reached an agreement and decided to bury the hatchet, no longer confronting each other head-on.

jyutping: faa3 gon1 gwo1 wai4 juk6 bok6
english_meaning: To turn hostility into friendship; to bury the hatchet; to turn weapons of war into gifts of peace.
explanation_mandarin: 干戈：古代的兵器，借指战争；玉帛：玉器和丝织品，借指和好。 比喻使战争转变为和平。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of resolving conflict and turning hostility into friendship and peace. It signifies a shift from a state of war to one of amicable relations, symbolizing the exchange of weapons for gifts of peace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經過幾輪談判之後，終於化干戈爲玉帛，簽咗合作協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 gei2 leon4 taam4 pun3 zi1 hau6, zung1 jyu1 faa3 gon1 gwo1 wai4 juk6 bok6, cim1 zo2 hap6 zok3 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经过几轮谈判之后，终于化干戈为玉帛，签了合作协议。
examples.english_sentence: After several rounds of negotiations, they finally buried the hatchet and signed a cooperation agreement.

jyutping: faa3 bei1 fan5 wai4 sik6 loeng6
english_meaning: Transform grief and indignation into appetite; Eat one's feelings; Eat out of sadness/anger.
explanation_mandarin: 把悲伤和愤怒的情绪转化为食欲，通过吃东西来发泄情绪。
explanation_english: To transform feelings of sadness or anger into a strong appetite; to use eating as a way to cope with negative emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後日日都化悲憤為食量，肥咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 jat1 jat1 dou1 faa3 bei1 fan5 wai4 sik6 loeng6, fei4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她失恋之后每天都化悲愤为食量，胖了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up, she transformed her grief and indignation into appetite every day, and gained a lot of weight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好化悲憤為食量啦，食咁多對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 faa3 bei1 fan5 wai4 sik6 loeng6 laa1, sik6 gam3 do1 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要化悲愤为食量了，吃这么多对身体不好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat your feelings. Eating so much is not good for your health.

english_meaning: to break up the whole into parts; to decentralize; to disintegrate a unified force
explanation_mandarin: 将整体分成若干个小部分。通常指分散力量，各个击破。
explanation_english: To break a whole into parts; to decentralize; to disintegrate a unified force. Often refers to dispersing strength to defeat the enemy one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想將公司嘅業務化整為零，分畀唔同嘅團隊負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 mou6 faa3 zing2 wai4 ling4, fan1 bei2 m4 tung4 ge3 teoi2 deoi2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想把公司的业务化整为零，分配给不同的团队负责。
examples.english_sentence: They want to break up the company's business into smaller parts and assign them to different teams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁強嘅對手，我哋唔可以硬碰硬，要化整為零，打游擊戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 koeng4 ge3 deoi3 sau2, ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 ngaang6 pung3 ngaang6, jiu3 faa3 zing2 wai4 ling4, daa2 jau4 gik1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么强的对手，我们不能硬碰硬，要化整为零，打游击战。
examples.english_sentence: Facing such a strong opponent, we can't confront them head-on; we need to break up our forces and fight a guerrilla war.

mandarin_meaning: 化整为零 (huà zhěng wéi líng)
english_meaning: To break up the whole into parts; To disintegrate a whole into smaller units; To split up a large force into smaller units (often for easier deployment or disguise)
explanation_mandarin: 将整体分散成零散的部分。 多用于军事上，指将大的队伍分散成小股力量。
explanation_english: To break up a unified whole into smaller, scattered parts. Often used in military contexts to describe dispersing a large force into smaller units.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要化整爲零，分開行，唔好咁多人一齊，易畀人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faa3 zing2 wai4 ling4, fan1 hoi1 haang4, m4 hou2 gam3 do1 jan4 jat1 cai4, ji6 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该化整为零，分开走，不要这么多人一起，容易被人抓到。
examples.english_sentence: We should break up into smaller groups and split up, don't travel together in such a large group, it's easy to get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想化整爲零咁賣啲業務出去，等盤數好睇啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 faa3 zing2 wai4 ling4 gam2 maai6 di1 jip6 mou6 ceot1 heoi3, dang2 pun4 sou3 hou2 tai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想化整为零地把一些业务卖出去，让账目好看一些。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to sell off some business units separately to make the accounts look better.

english_meaning: unpredictable, with many tricks up one's sleeve, versatile, having many forms or appearances
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或者事物变化多端，难以捉摸。可以指一个人鬼点子多，或者一个事物变化迅速，捉摸不定。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as unpredictable and difficult to grasp. It can refer to a person with many tricks or a thing that changes rapidly and is uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人化朗到呢，你都唔知佢下一秒會做啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 faa3 long4 dou3 ni1, nei5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 haa6 jat1 miu5 wui5 zou6 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人变化多端，你都不知道他下一秒会做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's so unpredictable, you never know what he'll do next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個股市化朗到死，今日升聽日跌，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 si5 faa3 long4 dou3 sei2, gam1 jat6 sing1 ting1 jat6 dit3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个股市变化莫测，今天涨明天跌，真不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: This stock market is so unpredictable, it goes up today and down tomorrow, I really don't know what to do.

english_meaning: chemical weapon
explanation_mandarin: 指利用化学物质的毒性，对人员、动物或植物造成伤害或死亡的武器。
explanation_english: A chemical weapon is a weapon that uses the toxic properties of chemical substances to cause harm or death to humans, animals, or plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少國家都簽咗唔用化武嘅條約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 cim1 zo2 m4 yung6 faa3 mou5 ge3 tiu4 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多国家都签署了不使用化学武器的条约。
examples.english_sentence: Many countries have signed treaties not to use chemical weapons.

english_meaning: To fall through, to fizzle out, to fail to materialize, to be wasted (especially money or effort)
explanation_mandarin: 指计划、期望等没有实现，像水一样消失了。也指浪费了钱或努力。
explanation_english: Refers to a plan, expectation, etc., that has not been realized, disappearing like water. It can also refer to wasted money or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾咗咁耐嘅單生意，最後都係化水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 gam3 noi6 ge3 daan1 saang1 ji3, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 faa3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈了这么久的这单生意，最后还是泡汤了。
examples.english_sentence: The business deal we've been negotiating for so long ultimately fell through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資落呢度肯定化水，唔好搞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 lok6 ni1 dou6 kat1 ding6 faa3 seoi2, m4 hou2 gaau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资在这里肯定会打水漂，别弄了。
examples.english_sentence: Investing here is definitely going to be a waste of money, don't do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢準備咗咁耐，點知考試前病咗，所有努力都化水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 bei6 zo2 gam3 noi6, dim2 zi1 haau2 si5 cin4 beng6 zo2, so2 jau5 nou5 lik6 dou1 faa3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他准备了这么久，谁知考试前病了，所有的努力都白费了。
examples.english_sentence: He prepared for so long, but unexpectedly got sick before the exam, all his efforts were wasted.

mandarin_meaning: 去除油腻; 消除尷尬
english_meaning: To dissolve greasiness; to defuse an awkward situation; to smooth things over
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指去除油腻。引申义指通过某种方式消除尴尬的局面，缓和气氛，使事情变得顺利。
explanation_english: Literally means to dissolve greasiness or oil. Figuratively, it refers to defusing an awkward situation, easing tension, or smoothing things over to make things go smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一句笑話就化咗油，大家都唔再尷尬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 geoi3 siu3 waa6 zau6 faa3 zo2 jau4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zoi3 gaam3 gaai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一句玩笑就消除了尴尬，大家都不再尴尬了。
examples.english_sentence: He cracked a joke and smoothed things over, everyone was no longer awkward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個清潔劑好化油，啲污漬好快就搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing1 git3 zai1 hou2 faa3 jau4, di1 wu1 zik1 hou2 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款清洁剂很去油，那些污渍很快就搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: This cleaner is very effective at dissolving grease, the stains are taken care of quickly.

english_meaning: I'd recognize you even if you were ashes; I'd recognize you anywhere; I know you that well.
explanation_mandarin: 即使某人化为灰烬也能认出来。形容对某人印象极其深刻，非常熟悉。
explanation_english: Describes a deep familiarity with someone, to the point where you would recognize them even in an unrecognizable state.  It implies a strong visual memory or connection with the person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅樣咁特別，化灰都認到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 joeng2 gam3 dak6 bit6, faa3 fui1 dou1 jing6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子那么特别，化成灰也认得。
examples.english_sentence: His face is so unique; I'd recognize him even if he were ashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把聲咁獨特，化灰都認到你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 seng1 gam3 duk6 dak6, faa3 fui1 dou1 jing6 dou2 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的声音这么独特，化成灰也认得你呀。
examples.english_sentence: Your voice is so unique, I'd recognize you anywhere.

english_meaning: I would recognize even if (they were) turned to ashes; I would recognize them anywhere/anyhow.
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某人或某事印象极其深刻，即使发生很大变化，也能认出来。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely deep impression of someone or something, such that you would recognize them even if they were drastically changed (e.g., reduced to ashes). Often used to express intense hatred, familiarity, or a strong memory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條衰仔，化灰都認得佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 seoi1 zai2, faa3 fui1 dou1 jing6 dak1 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那个坏小子，化成灰我也认得他！
examples.english_sentence: That no-good kid, I'd recognize him even if he were turned to ashes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻歌我聽咗咁多次，就算化灰都認得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 go1 ngo5 teng1 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, zau6 syun3 faa3 fui1 dou1 jing6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌我听了这么多遍，就算化成灰我也认得。
examples.english_sentence: I've listened to this song so many times, I'd recognize it even if it were reduced to ashes.

english_meaning: to turn into; to transform into; to become
explanation_mandarin: 转变成另一种状态或形式。
explanation_english: To transform into something else; to change form or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅努力最終化為成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 zeoi3 zung1 faa3 wai4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的努力最终化为成功。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts eventually turned into success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滴水可以化為石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik1 seoi2 ho2 ji5 faa3 wai4 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滴水可以化为石头。
examples.english_sentence: Droplets of water can turn into stone (eventually).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將悲傷化為力量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 bei1 soeng1 faa3 wai4 lik6 loeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把悲伤化为力量。
examples.english_sentence: He turned his sadness into strength.

english_meaning: to vanish into thin air; to come to naught; to disappear without a trace
explanation_mandarin: 指事物完全消失，什么都不剩。
explanation_english: Describes something that completely disappears, leaving nothing behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅努力最後都化為烏有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nu5 lik6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 faa3 wai4 wu1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的努力最终都化为乌有。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts ultimately came to nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔合作，呢個計劃就會化為烏有㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 hap6 jok3, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 wui5 faa3 wai4 wu1 jau5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不合作，这个计划就会化为乌有了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't cooperate, this plan will vanish into thin air.

english_meaning: to be reduced to ashes; to be burnt to ashes
explanation_mandarin: 指事物被烧毁成灰。比喻彻底消失或毁灭。
explanation_english: Refers to something being burned and reduced to ashes. Figuratively, it means to disappear completely or be destroyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場大火將間屋化爲灰燼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 daai6 fo2 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 faa3 wai4 fui1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一场大火将房子化为灰烬。
examples.english_sentence: A big fire reduced the house to ashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅希望化爲灰燼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hei1 mong6 faa3 wai4 fui1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的希望化为灰烬。
examples.english_sentence: Their hopes were reduced to ashes.

english_meaning: To vanish into thin air; to come to nothing; to go up in smoke; to be reduced to nothing
explanation_mandarin: 比喻完全消失或落空。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that completely disappears, comes to nothing, or is reduced to nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋所有嘅投資都化爲烏有啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 so2 jau5 ge3 tau4 zi1 dou1 faa3 wai4 wu1 jau5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们所有的投资都化为乌有了。
examples.english_sentence: All of their investments have vanished into thin air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，我哋嘅計劃就會化爲烏有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 zau6 wui5 faa3 wai4 wu1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，我们的计划就会化为乌有。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, our plan will come to nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場大火將佢成世人嘅努力都化爲烏有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 daai6 fo2 zoeng1 keoi5 sing4 sai3 jan4 ge3 nu5 lik6 dou1 faa3 wai4 wu1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一场大火把他一生的努力都化为乌有了。
examples.english_sentence: The great fire reduced all his life's efforts to nothing.

english_meaning: to dissolve phlegm; to relieve phlegm
explanation_mandarin: 使痰液稀释并容易咳出。
explanation_english: To dissolve phlegm, making it easier to cough up; to relieve phlegm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲啲化痰嘅藥會好啲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 di1 faa3 taam4 ge3 yoek6 wui5 hou2 di1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝一些化痰的药会好一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking some medicine to relieve phlegm will be better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要飲啲嘢化痰，所以煲咗雪梨水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 yam2 di1 ye5 faa3 taam4, so2 ji5 bou1 zo2 syut3 lei4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要喝些东西化痰，所以煲了雪梨水。
examples.english_sentence: He said he needed to drink something to relieve phlegm, so he boiled some pear syrup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻糖可以化痰止咳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 tong2 ho2 ji5 faa3 taam4 zi2 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种糖可以化痰止咳。
examples.english_sentence: This candy can dissolve phlegm and relieve cough.

english_meaning: chemotherapy
explanation_mandarin: 利用化学药物治疗疾病，特别是癌症。
explanation_english: Treatment of disease, especially cancer, with chemical substances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱開始做化療，身體好虛弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 chi2 zou6 faa3 liu4, san1 tai2 hou2 heoi1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚开始做化疗，身体很虚弱。
examples.english_sentence: He just started chemotherapy, and his body is very weak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化療嘅副作用都幾大，例如甩頭髮同埋嘔吐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 liu4 ge3 fu3 zuk1 yung6 dou1 gei2 daai6, lai6 jyu4 lat1 tau4 faat3 tung4 maai4 au2 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化疗的副作用挺大的，例如脱发和呕吐。
examples.english_sentence: The side effects of chemotherapy are quite significant, such as hair loss and vomiting.

mandarin_meaning: 没劲儿; 不起劲; 疲软
english_meaning: lackluster; listless; unenthusiastic; to lose steam; to not be in the mood
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物提不起劲，感觉没劲儿，状态不好。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that lacks energy or enthusiasm; feeling listless or not in a good state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔知點解，個人好化皮，乜嘢都唔想做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 dim2 gai2, go3 jan4 hou2 faa3 pei4, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不知道为什么，我感觉很没劲儿，什么都不想做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why, but I feel so listless today. I don't want to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱病好，個人仲有啲化皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 beng6 hou2, go3 jan4 zung6 jau5 di1 faa3 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚病好，人还有点没劲儿。
examples.english_sentence: He just recovered from his illness, so he's still a bit lackluster.

english_meaning: fossil
explanation_mandarin: 指地质历史时期的动植物遗骸或遗迹埋藏在地层中经过石化作用而形成的。
explanation_english: The petrified remains or traces of an animal or plant of a past geological age embedded in the earth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館入面有好多唔同嘅恐龍化石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 hung2 lung4 faa3 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆里面有很多不同的恐龙化石。

mandarin_meaning: 形容打扮土气、穿着不时尚的女性
english_meaning: A woman who is unfashionable or dressed in a frumpy/uncool way.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻打扮老土，不懂得时尚潮流的女性。 北菇（香菇）和鸡都是比较常见的食物，组合在一起给人一种朴素、简单的感觉，因此被用来形容打扮不够精致，缺乏时尚感的女性。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a woman who dresses in an old-fashioned or unfashionable way, lacking a sense of current trends. 'Bak gu' (dried shiitake mushroom) and 'gai' (chicken) are both common and simple ingredients, so the combination is used to describe a woman whose style is unrefined and lacks chic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到好似北菇雞咁，唔係咁掂喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 ci5 bak1 gu1 gai1 gam2, m4 hai6 gam2 dim6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得像个土包子一样，不太行啊。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed like a frumpy woman today, it's not good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日話人哋係北菇雞啦，人哋鍾意點著咪點著囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 waa6 jan4 dei6 hai6 bak1 gu1 gai1 laa1, jan4 dei6 zung1 ji3 dim2 zoek3 mai1 dim2 zoek3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是说别人是土包子，人家喜欢怎么穿就怎么穿呗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always call people frumpy, let them wear whatever they like.

english_meaning: Ugly girlfriend; (derogatory) a girlfriend who is not attractive.
explanation_mandarin: 一个比较贬义的词语，用来形容外貌不佳的女朋友。 北菇是一种蘑菇，有时被用来形容某人外貌比较普通甚至是不好看，加上“鸡”字，多用于形容女朋友，带有贬低和嘲讽的意味。 使用时需谨慎，可能冒犯他人。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to describe a girlfriend who is considered unattractive.  '北菇' (bak1 gu1, North Mushroom) is sometimes used to describe someone with a plain or even unattractive appearance. Adding '雞' (gai1, chicken) further emphasizes this negative connotation, specifically when referring to a girlfriend.  Use with caution as it is offensive.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人的女朋友了，这样很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about other people's girlfriends like that. It's very rude.

examples.english_sentence: It's truly unbelievable that he actually gave up such a great opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅解釋匪夷所思，完全唔合邏輯。

examples.english_sentence: His explanation is inconceivable and completely illogical.

examples.english_sentence: The police successfully arrested those gangsters.

explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会或犯罪团伙使用的秘密语言或行话，通常难以理解，用于隐藏真实意图。
explanation_english: Refers to the secret language or jargon used by triads, gangs, or criminal groups. It is often difficult to understand and used to conceal true intentions.

explanation_mandarin: 动词：汇集，聚集；汇款；名词：汇款，汇票。

explanation_english: The value of one currency expressed in terms of another currency.

examples.english_sentence: The exchange rate has been fluctuating a lot recently.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lau4 yi3 haa5 wui6 gaa3 zau2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要留意一下汇率的走势。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pay attention to the exchange rate trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間找換店嘅匯價唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zaau2 wun6 dim3 ge3 wui6 gaa3 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家兑换店的汇率不错。
examples.english_sentence: The exchange rate at this money exchange shop is not bad.

english_meaning: to converge; to join; to merge; to unite
explanation_mandarin: 指水流、人流等聚集在一起。
explanation_english: Refers to the gathering together of water flow, people flow, etc.

examples.english_sentence: All the rivers eventually converge into the ocean.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 wui6 hap6, jin4 hau6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3.

examples.english_sentence: Many charities pool resources to help people in need.

english_meaning: to report; to give an account
explanation_mandarin: 向上级或有关部门报告情况。
explanation_english: To report to a superior or relevant department, giving an account of a situation or progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要向老細匯報進度。

examples.english_sentence: He reported the sales data from last week at the meeting.

english_meaning: Foreign exchange market, Forex market
explanation_mandarin: 指进行外汇交易的市场。

examples.english_sentence: The foreign exchange market fluctuated greatly today.

english_meaning: Remittance, to remit money
explanation_mandarin: 指将钱款从一个地方汇到另一个地方。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行处理国际汇款的手续费很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The handling fee for international remittances at the bank is very expensive.

english_meaning: Remittance; Pooling money; To contribute money (often for illegal or dubious purposes)
explanation_mandarin: 动词：把钱汇过去；名词：集合起来的钱。在香港，有时也指黑社会收保护费等。
explanation_english: Verb: To remit money; Noun: Money that has been pooled together. In Hong Kong slang, it can also refer to protection money collected by triads.

english_meaning: gala performance, variety show, presentation of various performances

explanation_english: Refers to a country that manipulates its currency exchange rate, typically by intervening in the foreign exchange market, to gain an unfair trade advantage. Usually an economic or political term.

examples.english_sentence: The United States once called China a currency manipulator.

examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jat1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 bei2 jan4 lit6 zou6 wui6 leot2 caau1 zung3 gwok3, ho2 nang4 wui5 min6 deoi3 mau6 jik6 zai3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果一个国家被列为汇率操纵国，可能会面临贸易制裁。
examples.english_sentence: If a country is designated as a currency manipulator, it may face trade sanctions.

explanation_english: To transfer money from one party to another, usually through a bank or other financial institution.

explanation_english: Refers to an ordinary person, often with a derogatory connotation, describing someone who lacks knowledge or courage and wisdom.

english_meaning: to match; to rival; to be a match for

explanation_english: To be comparable to, to match, to rival; implying similar strength, ability, or quality.

mandarin_meaning: 匹配; 配对; 符合

explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，通常放在句末或句中，表示说话者的惊讶、疑问、不确定等语气。语气较轻。
explanation_english: An interjection used at the end or middle of a sentence to express surprise, doubt, questioning, or uncertainty. The tone is relatively light.

examples.english_sentence: Are you mistaken?

english_meaning: horizontal inscribed board; plaque
explanation_mandarin: 悬挂在门上或墙上的题字牌，通常是长方形的。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 caan2 pin2 jau5 mat1 je5 keoi1 bit6 aa3?

examples.english_sentence: What's the difference between these two products?

english_meaning: to differentiate, to segregate, to compartmentalize, to distinguish, to separate

english_meaning: Walking; to walk; shank's pony
explanation_mandarin: 指用两条腿走路，依靠步行作为交通方式。因为人的两只脚形状像数字“11”，所以用“十一号”来比喻双脚，而“巴士”则是一种交通工具。
explanation_english: Refers to walking as a means of transportation, relying on one's two legs. The number "11" is used metaphorically to represent the two legs, as they resemble the numeral. "巴士" (baa1 si2) refers to bus, which is a mode of transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日無車搭，我唯有用十一號巴士返屋企囉。

english_meaning: Mahjong term: Thirteen Orphans
explanation_mandarin: 麻将中的一种特殊牌型，由十三张不同的幺九牌组成，包括东南西北中发白各一张，再加上任意一张幺九牌。 也比喻人精神不正常，有点疯癫。
explanation_english: A special winning hand in Mahjong consisting of thirteen different terminal and honor tiles (1 and 9 of each suit, plus the winds and dragons). It also metaphorically describes someone who is mentally unstable, a bit crazy or eccentric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打親麻雀都想整十三么，真係發咗癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 can1 maa4 zoek3 dou1 soeng2 zing2 sap6 saam1 maa1, zan1 hai6 faat3 zo2 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次打麻将都想做十三幺，真是疯了。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to make a Thirteen Orphans hand when playing Mahjong, he's really gone crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁十三么，冇人會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 sap6 saam1 maa1, mou5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么疯癫，没人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: You're talking so crazily, no one will believe you.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻一群有势力，但行为不正的人
english_meaning: Thirteen Protectors; metaphor for a group of powerful but morally questionable individuals or gang members.
explanation_mandarin: 源自《说唐演义全传》，指李克用手下的十三位义子，都骁勇善战。后来引申为形容一群有势力，但行为不正的人，类似于黑社会。
explanation_english: Originates from the novel "Shuo Tang Yanyi Quan Zhuan," referring to Li Keyong's thirteen adopted sons, all skilled warriors. Later, it became a metaphor for a group of powerful but morally questionable individuals, similar to gang members or individuals involved in shady activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺條街度搞事，咪就係嗰班十三太保囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 gaau2 si6, mai1 zau6 hai6 go2 baan1 sap6 saam1 taai3 bou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在街上惹事，不就是那一伙十三太保吗。
examples.english_sentence: They're always causing trouble on the street, isn't that the group of the 'Thirteen Protectors'?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好埋佢哋堆，佢哋全部都係十三太保，冇個好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 maai4 keoi5 dei6 deoi1, keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 sap6 saam1 taai3 bou2, mou5 go3 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要和他们混在一起，他们全部都是十三太保，没有一个好人。
examples.english_sentence: You better not hang out with them, they're all 'Thirteen Protectors', not one of them is a good person.

english_meaning: Thirteen Orphans (Mahjong term); used figuratively to describe someone who is eccentric, unconventional, or a lone wolf.
explanation_mandarin: 麻将的一种牌型，由十三种不同的幺九牌组成，难度很高。引申为形容行为或想法与众不同、特立独行的人或事。
explanation_english: In Mahjong, "Thirteen Orphans" is a special hand consisting of thirteen different terminal and honor tiles, which is difficult to achieve. Figuratively, it's used to describe someone who is eccentric, unconventional, a lone wolf, or something that stands out as unique and different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好十三幺㗎，成日都做啲人哋諗都諗唔到嘅嘢。

examples.english_sentence: He's a real eccentric, always doing things that other people wouldn't even think of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好十三幺，同附近嘅舖頭完全唔同。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很十三幺，和附近的店铺完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very unique and different from the surrounding shops.

mandarin_meaning: 十三张扑克牌; 一种扑克牌游戏
english_meaning: Thirteen Card Poker; A poker game
explanation_mandarin: 十三张是一种扑克牌游戏，通常需要2-4人玩。 每位玩家分发十三张牌，然后将牌分成三墩：头墩3张，中墩5张，尾墩5张。 然后根据牌型大小进行比较。
explanation_english: Thirteen Card Poker is a poker game usually played by 2-4 players. Each player is dealt thirteen cards, which they then arrange into three hands: a 3-card front hand, a 5-card middle hand, and a 5-card back hand. The hands are then compared based on poker hand rankings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想唔想打十三張啊？

examples.cantonese_sentence: 十三張都要鬥牌型㗎。

examples.english_sentence: In Thirteen Card Poker, you also need to compare the hand rankings.

explanation_mandarin: 表示可能性非常大，相当于“大多数”，“很可能”。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high probability, equivalent to "most likely" or "the vast majority". It means something is highly probable or almost certain to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試十之八九都會合格嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sap6 zi1 baat3 gau2 dou1 wui5 hap6 gaak3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试十有八九都会及格的。
examples.english_sentence: He's eight or nine out of ten going to pass this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨嘅機會十之八九啦，記得帶遮啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 gei1 wui2 sap6 zi1 baat3 gau2 laa1, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨的机会十有八九了，记得带伞啊。
examples.english_sentence: There's an eight or nine out of ten chance it will rain tomorrow, remember to bring an umbrella.

english_meaning: Silly, foolish, idiotic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有点傻，不聪明，或者做了愚蠢的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being a bit silly, not very smart, or having done something foolish. It implies a mild form of stupidity or lack of common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜咁十九呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 gam3 sap6 gau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛这么傻？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so silly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都十九嘅，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sap6 gau2 ge3, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是傻乎乎的，别理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being silly, don't pay attention to him.

english_meaning: duodenum
explanation_mandarin: 位于胃和空肠之间的消化道的第一部分。
explanation_english: The first part of the small intestine immediately beyond the stomach, leading to the jejunum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢十二指腸潰瘍，成日都覺得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap6 ji6 zi2 coeng4 kui2 joeng2, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他十二指肠溃疡，经常都觉得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He has a duodenal ulcer and often feels uncomfortable.

english_meaning: December
explanation_mandarin: 公历的第十二个月份
explanation_english: The twelfth month of the Gregorian calendar, December.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋十二月會去日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sap6 ji6 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们十二月会去日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We will travel to Japan in December.

english_meaning: The twelve zodiac animals
explanation_mandarin: 指中国传统文化中的十二种动物，代表不同的年份。 它们依次是：鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪。
explanation_english: Refers to the twelve animals in the Chinese zodiac, each representing a year in a repeating cycle. The animals are: Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat (or Sheep), Monkey, Rooster, Dog, and Pig.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屬咩生肖呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 suk6 me1 sang1 ciu3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我属什么生肖？
examples.english_sentence: What zodiac animal am I?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年係豬年，十二生肖入面最後一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hai6 zyu1 nin4, sap6 ji6 sang1 ciu3 jap6 min6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年是猪年，十二生肖里面最后一个。
