examples.english_sentence: This year is the year of the pig, the last one in the twelve zodiac animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好信十二生肖，話屬龍嘅人特別叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 seon3 sap6 ji6 sang1 ciu3, waa6 suk6 lung4 ge3 jan4 dak6 bit1 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很相信十二生肖，说属龙的人特别厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He really believes in the Chinese zodiac, saying that people born in the year of the Dragon are especially talented.

english_meaning: Penalty kick (in football/soccer)
explanation_mandarin: 足球比赛中，对犯规一方的惩罚方式，在离球门十二码处进行射门。
explanation_english: A penalty kick in football (soccer). It is a direct free kick taken from the penalty spot, which is 12 yards from the goal line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺最後一分鐘攞到個十二碼，真係好彩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 lo2 dou2 go3 sap6 ji6 maa5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在最后一分钟获得了一个点球，真是幸运！
examples.english_sentence: They got a penalty kick in the last minute, they were so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢射十二碼好叻㗎，幾乎每次都入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se6 sap6 ji6 maa5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, gei2 fu1 mui5 ci3 dou1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他射点球很厉害，几乎每次都进。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at taking penalty kicks, he scores almost every time.

mandarin_meaning: 犹豫不决, 拿不定主意
english_meaning: undecided, indecisive, hesitant, wavering
explanation_mandarin: 形容人遇到事情犹豫不决，拿不定主意，不知道应该如何选择。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is indecisive, hesitant, or wavering when faced with a decision, unable to make up their mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好十五十六啦，快啲決定去唔去啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sap6 ng5 sap6 luk6 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要犹豫不决了，快点决定去不去吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so indecisive, just decide whether to go or not!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢十五十六咗好耐，都係決定唔到買邊個款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap6 ng5 sap6 luk6 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 hai6 kyut3 ding6 m4 dou2 maai5 bin1 go3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犹豫了很久，还是决定不了买哪个款式。
examples.english_sentence: He's been indecisive for a long time and still can't decide which model to buy.

synonyms: 猶豫不決 (jau4 jyu6 bat1 kyut3)
左揀右揀 (zo2 gaan2 jau6 gaan2)

mandarin_meaning: 靠不住; 不可靠; 不稳当
english_meaning: unreliable; untrustworthy; flaky; unpredictable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事不可靠，变化莫测，难以信任。 像農曆十五的月亮，因為雲層遮蓋有時可見有時不可見，所以形容一個人或事物變化多端，難以捉摸。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as unreliable, unpredictable, and difficult to trust. It's like the full moon on the 15th day of the lunar month, which is sometimes visible and sometimes hidden by clouds, thus describing a person or thing as changeable and elusive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好十五湖㗎，講嘅嘢都唔好信晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 hou2 sap6 ng5 wu4 gaa3, gong2 ge3 ye5 dou1 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很不靠谱，说的话都不要全信。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very unreliable person, don't trust everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅前景好十五湖，唔建議你投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 cin4 ging2 hou2 sap6 ng5 wu4, m4 gin3 yi5 nei5 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的前景很不稳定，不建议你投资。
examples.english_sentence: The prospects of this company are very uncertain, I don't recommend you invest.

english_meaning: Informant; turncoat; snitch; rat; someone who betrays their group
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛自己团体，向敌方或警方告密的人。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who betrays their own group by informing the enemy or the police. Usually carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個十仔嚟㗎，千祈唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 sap6 zai2 lei4 gaa3, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个告密者，千万不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a snitch, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做十仔呀，冇人會尊重你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 sap6 zai2 aa3, mou5 jan4 wui5 zyun1 zung6 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要当叛徒，没有人会尊重你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a rat, no one will respect you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 懷疑公司內部有十仔將啲機密資料洩漏咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waai4 ji4 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 jau5 sap6 zai2 zoeng1 di1 gei1 mat6 zi1 liu2 sit3 lau6 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 怀疑公司内部有内鬼把一些机密资料泄露出去了。
examples.english_sentence: We suspect there's a rat in the company who leaked some confidential information.

jyutping: sap6 go3 bou1 gau2 go3 goi3
mandarin_meaning: 捉襟见肘, 僧多粥少
english_meaning: To be short of resources; not enough to go around; insufficient to meet demand; literally, 'ten pots, nine lids'.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻资源短缺，供不应求，或者人手不足，无法完成所有工作。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a situation where there aren't enough resources to meet the demand. It can refer to physical resources, manpower, or anything that is insufficient to cover the required needs. It literally translates to 'ten pots, nine lids', implying that one pot will be left without a lid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家間公司咁多人走咗，真係十個煲九個蓋，好多嘢都冇人做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gam3 do1 jan4 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 sap6 go3 bou1 gau2 go3 goi3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 mou5 jan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在公司这么多人走了，真是捉襟见肘，很多事情都没人做。
examples.english_sentence: With so many people leaving the company, it's really stretched thin, and many tasks are left undone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目咁大，但係得咁少人，真係十個煲九個蓋，唔知點搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 gam3 daai6, daan6 hai6 dak1 gam3 siu2 jan4, zan1 hai6 sap6 go3 bou1 gau2 go3 goi3, m4 zi1 dim2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么大，但是只有这么少的人，真是僧多粥少，不知道怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so big, but with so few people, it's really a case of not enough to go around, I don't know what to do.

synonyms: 僧多粥少 (sang1 do1 zuk1 siu2)

english_meaning: perfect, flawless, impeccable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物完美无缺，毫无瑕疵。
explanation_english: Describes something as perfect, flawless, and without any imperfections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界上冇十全十美嘅嘢㗎，唔使咁執著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 mou5 sap6 cyun4 sap6 mei5 ge3 je5 gaa3, m4 sai2 gam3 zap1 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界上没有十全十美的东西，不用这么执着。
examples.english_sentence: Nothing in this world is perfect, so don't be so hung up on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢唔係十全十美，但係我好欣賞佢嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 m4 hai6 sap6 cyun4 sap6 mei5, daan6 hai6 ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他不是十全十美，但是我非常欣赏他的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's not perfect, I really admire his effort.

english_meaning: The eighteen districts (of Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港的十八个行政区域。
explanation_english: Refers to the eighteen administrative districts of Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港分咗做十八區，你住邊區啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 fan1 zo2 zou6 sap6 baat3 khu1, nei5 zyu6 bin1 khu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港分成了十八个区，你住哪个区啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is divided into eighteen districts, which district do you live in?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個十八區嘅特色都唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 sap6 baat3 khu1 ge3 te1 sik1 dou1 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个十八区的特色都不一样。
examples.english_sentence: Each of the eighteen districts has its own unique characteristics.

english_meaning: Young and beautiful; in the prime of youth
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子年轻貌美，正值青春年华。指大约十八到二十二岁的年龄段，是女性最美好的时期。
explanation_english: Describes a young woman as being beautiful and in her prime of youth. Refers to the age range of roughly eighteen to twenty-two, considered the most beautiful time for women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個女十八廿二，生得幾標緻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 neoi2 sap6 baat3 jaa6 ji6, saang1 dak1 gei2 biu1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的女儿十八九岁，长得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Their daughter is about eighteen or nineteen, and she's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿梅十八廿二嗰陣，好多人追佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 mui4 sap6 baat3 jaa6 ji6 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 zeoi1 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿梅十八九岁的时候，很多人追她的。
examples.english_sentence: When Ah Mui was around eighteen or nineteen, many people were chasing after her.

mandarin_meaning: 女大十八变，越变越好看
english_meaning: There are no ugly women after the age of eighteen; a woman's beauty develops as she matures.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性随着年龄增长，会越来越注重打扮，也懂得如何展现自己的魅力，因此看起来会越来越漂亮。强调女性成年后会变得更美丽。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that women tend to become more attractive as they grow older. It implies that with maturity and self-awareness, women learn to enhance their appearance and project their beauty more effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇佢細個嘅時候唔係幾靚，話唔定大個咗之後會變成一個大美人，「十八無醜婦」嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hai6 gei2 leng3, waa6 m4 ding6 daai6 go3 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui bin3 sing4 jat1 go3 daai6 mei5 jan4, "sap6 baat3 mou4 cau2 fu5" maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看她小时候不太漂亮，说不定长大以后会变成一个大美人，女大十八变嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge her appearance when she's young. Who knows, she might grow up to be a great beauty; there are no ugly women after eighteen.

english_meaning: 18+, 18 and over, adult only, restricted to adults, rated R
explanation_mandarin: 指内容涉及成人话题，例如性、暴力等，未成年人禁止观看或参与。
explanation_english: Refers to content that involves adult topics, such as sex, violence, etc., that minors are prohibited from watching or participating in. Used to describe content that is rated for adults only.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲係十八禁㗎，未夠秤唔睇得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 sap6 baat3 gam3 gaa3, mei6 gau3 ceng3 m4 tai2 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是十八禁的，未成年人不能看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is rated 18+, minors can't watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本雜誌專登賣啲十八禁嘅嘢嚟吸引讀者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 zaap6 zi3 zyun1 dang1 maai6 di1 sap6 baat3 gam3 ge3 je5 lai4 kap1 jan5 duk6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的杂志故意卖一些十八禁的东西来吸引读者。
examples.english_sentence: His magazine deliberately sells some 18+ content to attract readers.

english_meaning: Eighteen Villages; a general area in the New Territories, Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 十八乡是香港新界元朗区的一个地方，泛指元朗平原一带的乡村地区。虽然叫「十八乡」，但实际上并不一定只有十八个乡村。
explanation_english: "Sap Baat Hoeng" (Eighteen Villages) is a general term referring to the rural areas in the Yuen Long Plain, New Territories, Hong Kong. Despite its name, it doesn't necessarily consist of only eighteen villages. It represents a larger area with numerous villages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣住喺十八鄉，成日周圍跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2陣zyun6住hai2 sap6 baat3 hoeng1, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候住在十八乡，经常到处跑。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I lived in the Eighteen Villages and ran around everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家十八鄉都起咗好多樓，唔似以前咁多田啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sap6 baat3 hoeng1 dou1 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 lau2, m4 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 do1 tin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在十八乡都建了很多楼，不像以前那么多田地了。
examples.english_sentence: Now, many buildings have been built in the Eighteen Villages, and there aren't as many fields as before.

english_meaning: Round of 16 (in a competition); top 16
explanation_mandarin: 指比赛中进入前十六名的队伍或选手。
explanation_english: Refers to the round of 16 in a competition, indicating that a team or competitor has reached the top 16.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波今年入咗十六強喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam1 nin4 jap6 zo2 sap6 luk6 koeng4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队今年进入了十六强了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team made it to the round of 16 this year!

english_meaning: Deep-seated resentment; a lot of grievances and grudges
explanation_mandarin: 形容积怨很深，几乎全是仇恨。表示双方的矛盾冲突非常激烈，难以化解。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are many accumulated grievances and grudges, almost entirely fueled by hatred. It indicates intense conflict between two parties that is difficult to resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家人之間嘅關係，簡直係十冤九仇咁，唔會咁容易解決㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 jan4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sap6 jyun1 gau2 sau4 gam2, m4 wui5 gam3 jung4 ji6 gaai2 kyut3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家人之间的关系，简直就是积怨很深，不会那么容易解决的。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between those two families is full of deep-seated resentment, it won't be solved that easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為一啲生意上嘅糾紛，搞到十冤九仇咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 jat1 dik1 saang1 ji3 soeng6 ge3 gau2 fan1, gaau2 dou3 sap6 jyun1 gau2 sau4 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为一些生意上的纠纷，搞得积怨很深的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Because of some business disputes, they ended up having deep-seated resentment towards each other.

english_meaning: very, extremely, fully, completely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，相当于“非常”、“很”。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree, equivalent to 'very' or 'extremely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我十分鍾意呢間餐廳嘅嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sap6 fan1 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢这家餐厅的食物。
examples.english_sentence: I really like the food in this restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅戲十分好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 hei3 sap6 fan1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的电影非常好看。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's movie is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢十分努力，所以考試考得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap6 fan1 nu5 lik6, so2 ji5 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他十分努力，所以考试考得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is very hardworking, so he did well in the exam.

english_meaning: extremely, very, thoroughly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很高，相当于“非常”、“十分”的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree; equivalent to "very", "extremely", "thoroughly". Used to emphasize a quality or feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人十分之好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 sap6 fan1 zi1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人非常好。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very nice person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲十分之好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 sap6 fan1 zi1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影非常好看了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is extremely good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我十分之鍾意食呢間餐廳嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sap6 fan1 zi1 zung1 ji3 sik6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢吃这家餐厅的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I thoroughly enjoy eating at this restaurant.

jyutping: sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3
english_meaning: The first stroke hasn't even been made yet; it's not even a start; nothing has been done yet; it's still a long way off.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情还没有眉目，还没有开始做。
explanation_english: This idiom means that something is not even close to being accomplished, or that it hasn't even begun.  It implies a very early stage where progress is practically non-existent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個計劃十劃都未有一撇，你唔好咁快期望太高啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 gai3 waak6 sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划八字还没一撇，你不要这么快期望太高了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan isn't even off the ground yet, don't get your hopes up too quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係十劃都未有一撇，你估佢哋會結婚？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3, nei5 gu2 keoi5 dei6 wui5 git3 fan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系八字还没一撇，你觉得他们会结婚？
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship isn't even off the ground yet, do you think they will get married?

english_meaning: Support; to support
explanation_mandarin: 源自英文单词“support”的音译，表示支持、支持、赞同等意思。
explanation_english: A transliteration of the English word "support," meaning to support, endorse, agree with, or root for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我十卜你啊，加油啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sap6 bok1 nei5 aa3, gaa1 jau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我支持你啊，加油啊！
examples.english_sentence: I support you, keep it up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家一齊十卜香港電影啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 sap6 bok1 hoeng1 gong2 din6 jing2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起支持香港电影吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's all support Hong Kong cinema together!

english_meaning: unresponsive, not answering most questions, ignoring most questions
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人对别人的提问或请求置之不理，或者反应迟钝，大部分问题都不回应。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unresponsive, ignores questions or requests, or is slow to react, not answering most questions asked of them. It implies a lack of engagement or deliberate ignoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你叫佢，佢都十問九唔應嘅，唔知做咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 giu3 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 sap6 man6 gau2 m4 jing3 ge3, m4 zi1 zou6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你叫他，他都不理不睬的，不知道在干什么。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, you're calling him, but he's not responding to most of your questions; I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問佢借錢，佢十問九唔應，擺明唔想借啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 keoi5 ze3 cin2, keoi5 sap6 man6 gau2 m4 jing3, baai2 ming4 m4 soeng2 ze3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问他借钱，他不理不睬的，摆明不想借了。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him to borrow money, and he's ignoring most of my questions. It's obvious he doesn't want to lend it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔打機打到十問九唔應，完全聽唔到我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 sap6 man6 gau2 m4 jing3, jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 dou2 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子打游戏打到不理不睬的，完全听不到我说话。
examples.english_sentence: My son is so engrossed in playing video games that he's not responding to most of my questions; he can't hear a word I'm saying.

synonyms: 唔睬唔理 (m4 caai2 m4 lei5)

english_meaning: To be uncommunicative; to answer almost none of the questions asked; tight-lipped.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不愿回答问题，或者回避问题，即使问了很多问题，也几乎不回答。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unwilling to answer questions, or evades them. Even when asked many questions, they answer very few.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問佢功課做得點，佢十問九唔答，都唔知佢搞咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 keoi5 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 dim2, keoi5 sap6 man6 gau2 m4 daap3, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 gaau2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问他作业做得怎么样，他十问九不答，都不知道他在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him how his homework was going, but he was uncommunicative and didn't answer almost anything. I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問佢攞錢，佢一定十問九唔答㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 keoi5 lo2 cin2, keoi5 jat1 ding6 sap6 man6 gau2 m4 daap3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问他要钱，他肯定十问九不答的。
examples.english_sentence: If you ask him for money, he will definitely be uncommunicative and not answer you.

synonyms: 守口如瓶 (sau2 hau2 jyu4 ping4)

english_meaning: 14K Triad (Hong Kong Triad society)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一个历史悠久的黑社会组织的名字。 "十四K"是该组织的一个简称。
explanation_english: The name of a historical Hong Kong Triad society. "14K" is a shortened form of the organization's name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣時好似喺十四K撈過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2陣zan6 si4 hou2 ci5 hai2 sap6 sei3 K lou1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候好像在十四K混过。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like he was involved with the 14K when he was young.

english_meaning: Young gang member; underage delinquent
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄在十四岁左右，加入黑社会或童党的不良少年。
explanation_english: Refers to young people, around the age of fourteen, who join triads or youth gangs and are involved in delinquent activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就跟埋班十四仔周圍搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 gan1 maai4 baan1 sap6 sei3 zai2 zau1 wai4 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就跟着一帮十四仔到处惹事。
examples.english_sentence: He started following a group of young gang members to make trouble everywhere since he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好行埋啲十四仔度，會學壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haang4 maai4 di1 sap6 sei3 zai2 dou6, wui5 hok6 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和那些未成年混混混在一起，会学坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hang out with those underage delinquents, you'll learn bad habits.

english_meaning: Public Light Bus (PLB), minibus
explanation_mandarin: 香港常见的公共交通工具，一种小型巴士，以前通常是14个座位，因此得名。
explanation_english: A common form of public transportation in Hong Kong, a minibus. It was originally named 'fourteen seats' because it typically had 14 seats. While newer models often have more seats, the name has stuck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭十四座去旺角好快㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 sap6 sei3 zo6 heoi3 wong6 gok3 hou2 faai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐小巴去旺角很快的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking the minibus to Mong Kok is very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺紅磡搭十四座去西貢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hung4 ham3 daap3 sap6 sei3 zo6 heoi3 sai1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从红磡坐小巴去西贡。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking the minibus from Hung Hom to Sai Kung.

mandarin_meaning: 形容说话或唱歌走音严重，非常难听
english_meaning: Describes speaking or singing completely off-key, extremely unpleasant to listen to; tone-deaf.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或唱歌的时候，音调完全不对，跑调跑到十个国家那么远，表示非常难听。通常用来形容唱歌或说话走音非常严重。
explanation_english: Describes when someone speaks or sings completely off-key. The phrase likens the off-key-ness to being as far off as ten countries, implying that it is extremely unpleasant to listen to. Commonly used to describe severely out-of-tune singing or speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到十國咁，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheung3 go1 cheung3 dou3 sap6 gwok3 gam2, jan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得太难听了，实在受不了。
examples.english_sentence: He sings so off-key, it's unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再唱啦，唱到十國咁，我頂唔順呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cheung3 laa1, cheung3 dou3 sap6 gwok3 gam2, ngo5 ding2 m4 seon6 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再唱了，唱得太难听了，我受不了啊！
examples.english_sentence: Please stop singing, you're singing so off-key, I can't take it anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲本身就麻麻哋，一唱K就十國咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 bun2 san1 zau6 maa4 maa2 dei2, jat1 cheung3 K zau6 sap6 gwok3 gam2 yeung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嗓音本来就一般，一唱K就跑调到十万八千里。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is already so-so, and when he does Karaoke, he sings completely off-key.

english_meaning: crucifix; cross
explanation_mandarin: 基督教的象征，由两根木条交叉而成。
explanation_english: A cross-shaped object, especially the one on which Jesus Christ was crucified; a symbol of Christianity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸上面戴住個十字架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng2 soeng6 min6 daai3 zyu6 go3 sap6 zi6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脖子上戴着一个十字架。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing a crucifix on his neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教堂上面有個好大嘅十字架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 tong4 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 sap6 zi6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教堂上面有一个很大的十字架。
examples.english_sentence: There is a very big cross on the church.

english_meaning: Hypocritical; feigned kindness; putting on an act of being kind or helpful when one's true intentions are different.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人表面上对你很好很关心，但实际上并不是真心实意的，可能另有目的。
explanation_english: Describes someone who appears kind and caring on the surface, but their intentions are insincere and possibly self-serving. The "十字界" (cross shape) suggests a facade or a manufactured image of virtue, covering up the true nature, which, like soft tofu, lacks substance and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都十字界豆腐咁對你笑，小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sap6 zi6 gaai3 dau6 fu6 gam2 deoi3 nei5 siu3, siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是假惺惺地对你笑，小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: He's always smiling at you in a hypocritical way; be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘢啊，佢十字界界啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5 aa3, keoi5 sap6 zi6 gaai3 gaai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他只是在装模作样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's just putting on an act.

english_meaning: Crossroads, intersection
explanation_mandarin: 两条或多条道路交叉汇合的地方。
explanation_english: A place where two or more roads intersect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺十字路口轉左就到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 zyun3 zo2 zau6 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在十字路口左转就到了。
examples.english_sentence: Turn left at the crossroads and you'll be there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有好多十字路口，要小心選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 jau5 hou2 do1 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有很多十字路口，要小心选择。
examples.english_sentence: Life has many crossroads, you need to choose carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約喺十字路口等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约在十字路口等。
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet at the crossroads.

english_meaning: Ambulance
explanation_mandarin: 指救护车，因车身通常涂有红色十字标志而得名。
explanation_english: Refers to an ambulance, named after the red cross symbol commonly painted on its body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲叫架十字車嚟啦，佢晕咗呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 giu3 gaa3 sap6 zi6 ce1 lai4 laa1, keoi5 wan4 zo2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点叫辆救护车来，他晕倒了！
examples.english_sentence: Call an ambulance quickly, he fainted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺医院门口见到一架十字車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 mun4 hau2 gin3 dou2 jat1 gaa3 sap6 zi6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在医院门口看到一辆救护车。
examples.english_sentence: I saw an ambulance at the entrance of the hospital.

english_meaning: Idiot, fool, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 指头脑迟钝、愚笨的人。常用于责骂或嘲讽。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is slow-witted, foolish, or stupid. Often used to scold or ridicule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係十字鋤嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 sap6 zi6 co4 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这都不知道，真是个傻瓜！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this? You're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁十字鋤啦，諗清楚先講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sap6 zi6 co4 laa1, nam2 cing1 chu2 sin1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻了，想清楚再说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, think clearly before you speak.

english_meaning: Describes a person as being extremely stingy or miserly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人抠门到极点，连豆腐都要切成十字，寓意将一份东西分成很多份，不愿意分享或花费。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely stingy. The image of cutting tofu into a cross symbolizes dividing something into many small portions, implying an unwillingness to share or spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係十字鎅豆腐咁㗎，一蚊都唔捨得俾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 sap6 zi6 gaai3 dau6 fu6 gam3 gaa3, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是抠门到家了，一分钱都舍不得给。
examples.english_sentence: He is so stingy, he wouldn't even give away a single dollar.

english_meaning: cruciate ligament
explanation_mandarin: 位于膝关节内的韧带，包括前十字韧带和后十字韧带，对膝关节的稳定性起重要作用。
explanation_english: Ligaments located within the knee joint, including the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and posterior cruciate ligament (PCL), which play a vital role in knee stability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波嗰陣扭親隻腳，搞到十字韌帶撕裂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 nau2 can1 zek3 goek3, gaau2 dou3 sap6 zi6 ngan6 daai2 si1 lit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢球的时候扭伤了脚，导致十字韧带撕裂了。
examples.english_sentence: He twisted his foot while playing soccer, resulting in a torn cruciate ligament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 十字韌帶受傷通常要做手術先可以完全康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6 zi6 ngan6 daai2 sau6 soeng1 tung1 soeng4 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 sin1 ho2 ji5 wun4 cyun4 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 十字韧带受伤通常要做手术才能完全康复。
examples.english_sentence: Cruciate ligament injuries usually require surgery for a full recovery.

english_meaning: To make unnecessary moves; to go out of one's way to complicate something; to be meddlesome.
explanation_mandarin: 形容没事找事，本来简单的事情，故意把它弄复杂。就像在豆腐上划十字，本来切一块就可以了，非要划成很多小块，显得很麻烦，多此一举。
explanation_english: Describes someone who makes unnecessary moves or complicates a simple task. It's like cutting a cross on tofu when a single cut would suffice, turning it into many small pieces and making it needlessly complicated and meddlesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明撳個制就得，點解要拆開部機嚟整啊？咪即係十字𠝹豆腐囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 gam6 go3 zai3 zau6 dak1, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 caak3 hoi1 bou6 gei1 lai4 zeng2 aa3? mai1 zik1 hai6 sap6 zi6 gai1 dau6 fu6 lo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明按个按钮就行了，为什么要拆开机器来修啊？这不是没事找事吗！
examples.english_sentence: You could have just pressed the button, why did you have to take the whole machine apart to fix it? That's just complicating things!

synonyms: 多此一舉 (do1 ci2 jat1 geoi2)

english_meaning: ten rooms, nine empty; describing a situation where most houses are empty, often due to war, famine, or disease.
explanation_mandarin: 形容因灾荒、战争或疾病等原因，大部分房屋空无一人。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where most houses are empty, often due to disasters, wars, or diseases, leaving few people behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過場大瘟疫之後，條村幾乎十室九空，慘不忍睹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 coeng4 daai6 wan1 yik6 zi1 hau6, tiu4 cyun1 gei1 fu2 sap6 sat1 gau2 hung1, caam2 bat1 jan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一场大瘟疫之后，这条村几乎十室九空，惨不忍睹。
examples.english_sentence: After the great plague, the village was almost deserted; it was a terrible sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰亂搞到啲人走晒佬，好多地方都十室九空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 lyun6 gaau2 dou3 di1 jan4 zau2 saai3 lou2, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 sap6 sat1 gau2 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战乱搞得人们都逃走了，很多地方都十室九空。
examples.english_sentence: The war caused people to flee, leaving many places deserted.

english_meaning: nine out of ten; almost certain; highly likely
explanation_mandarin: 表示绝大多数情况或可能性。指十分之九，形容可能性很大。
explanation_english: This idiom means "nine out of ten", indicating a very high probability or almost certainty that something will happen or is true. It signifies that in most cases, the situation will be as described.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年經濟咁差，十居其九啲公司都會裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, sap6 geoi1 kei4 gau2 di1 gung1 si1 dou1 wui5 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年经济这么差，十之八九公司都会裁员。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad this year, nine out of ten companies will lay off employees.

jyutping: sap6 nin4 jan4 si6 gei2 faan1 san1
english_meaning: A lot of changes can happen in ten years; times change a lot.
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间流逝，人事变迁很大，变化很快。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how much things can change over a decade. It emphasizes the rapid pace of change and the mutability of human affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，十年人事幾番新，呢度嘅變化真係好大呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, sap6 nin4 jan4 si6 gei2 faan1 san1, ni1 dou6 ge3 bin3 faa3 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，真是十年人事变化很大，这里变化真大啊！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, a lot of changes can happen in ten years, the changes here are really huge!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋畢業之後，各有發展，真係十年人事幾番新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, gok3 jau5 faat3 zin2, zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 jan4 si6 gei2 faan1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们毕业之后，各自发展，真是十年人事变化很大。
examples.english_sentence: After graduation, we all developed our own careers, it's true that a lot of changes can happen in ten years.

mandarin_meaning: 好几年; 长期; 很久
english_meaning: quite a few years; a long time; several years
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间比较长，但不确切。指十年左右的时间。
explanation_english: Describes a relatively long period of time, but not precisely defined. Roughly refers to about ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話過十年八載都唔會返嚟香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gwo3 sap6 nin4 baat3 zoi2 dou1 m4 wui5 faan1 lei4 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说过好几年都不会回香港。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't be back in Hong Kong for several years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程要十年八載先可以完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jiu3 sap6 nin4 baat3 zoi2 sin1 ho2 ji5 wun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程要好几年才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This project will take quite a few years to complete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住儲夠錢，都要十年八載先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 cou5 gau3 cin2, dou1 jiu3 sap6 nin4 baat3 zoi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想存够钱，也得好几年才行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to save enough money, but it will take several years.

jyutping: sap6 nin4 m4 gaang1, gau2 nin4 m4 zung2
english_meaning: Extremely lazy and unproductive, never putting in any effort.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻非常懒惰，十年也不耕田，九年也不播种。形容人什么也不做，毫无作为。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is extremely lazy and unproductive, implying they never put in any effort to work or achieve anything. It literally translates to 'Ten years no ploughing, nine years no sowing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係十年唔耕，九年唔種，成日淨係識得攤喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 m4 gaang1, gau2 nin4 m4 zung2, seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 taan1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是十年不耕，九年不种，整天就知道躺在那里。
examples.english_sentence: He's really 'ten years no ploughing, nine years no sowing', all he knows is to lie around all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好十年唔耕，九年唔種，趁後生學多啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sap6 nin4 m4 gaang1, gau2 nin4 m4 zung2, can3 hau6 saang1 hok6 do1 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要懒惰，趁年轻多学点东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be lazy, take advantage of your youth and learn more things.

jyutping: sap6 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6
english_meaning: Once in a blue moon; extremely rare; hardly ever happens
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情极少发生或非常难得。
explanation_english: Describes something that happens extremely rarely or is very difficult to come by. Literally translates to "Not even once in ten years."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孤寒，請人食飯真係十年唔逢一潤㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gu1 hon4, ceng2 jan4 sik6 faan6 zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么吝啬，请人吃饭真是千载难逢啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stingy, it's really once in a blue moon that he treats someone to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲樓價咁貴，佢竟然可以執到平貨，真係十年唔逢一潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, keoi5 ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 zap1 dou2 ping4 fo3, zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 m4 fung4 jat1 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在房价这么贵，他竟然可以捡到便宜货，真是千载难逢。
examples.english_sentence: Now that the property prices are so expensive, it's really once in a blue moon that he manages to find a bargain.

synonyms: 千載難逢 (cin1 zoi2 naan4 fung4)

english_meaning: ten years like one day; unchanging; consistent over a long period
explanation_mandarin: 形容长时期一贯保持老样子，没有变化。
explanation_english: Describes something that remains the same over a long period, showing no change or variation; consistent over a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人十年如一日咁勤力，真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 sap6 nin4 jyu4 jat1 jat6 gam3 kan4 lik6, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人十年如一日那么勤奋，真是很难得。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working diligently for ten years as if it were one day, it's truly remarkable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅味道十年如一日，都係咁好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 mei6 dou6 sap6 nin4 jyu4 jat1 jat6, dou1 hai6 gam3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的味道十年如一日，还是这么好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The taste of this restaurant has been consistently delicious for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆嘅感情十年如一日，依然咁恩愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 ge3 gam2 cing4 sap6 nin4 jyu4 jat1 jat6, ji1 jin4 gam3 yan1 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩的感情十年如一日，依然那么恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the couple has remained loving and unchanged for ten years.

english_meaning: ten years of bitter study; years of hard study
explanation_mandarin: 形容长期苦读。比喻长期闭门苦读，也指为了应付科举考试而长期苦读。
explanation_english: Describes years of arduous study. It often refers to a long period of secluded study, especially to prepare for civil service examinations in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗考入大學，真係十年寒窗，日日都溫書溫到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6, zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 hon4 coeng1, jat1 jat1 dou1 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了考入大学，他真是十年寒窗，每天都复习功课到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get into university, he really studied hard for years, reviewing his lessons every day until very late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲學生唔使好似以前咁十年寒窗，都有好多出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hok6 sang1 m4 sai2 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 sap6 nin4 hon4 coeng1, dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的学生不用像以前那样十年寒窗，也有很多出路。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, students don't need to study as hard as before to have many career options.

jyutping: sap6 nin4 syu6 muk6, baak3 nin4 syu6 jan4
english_meaning: It takes ten years to grow a tree, but a hundred years to cultivate a person; To educate people takes a long time and effort.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻培养人才是长久之计，需要花费很长的时间和精力。
explanation_english: This idiom highlights the importance of long-term planning and effort in education and nurturing talent. It emphasizes that developing individuals is a far more complex and time-consuming process than simply growing trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教育下一代唔係一件容易嘅事，真係要十年樹木，百年樹人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 juk6 haa6 jat1 daai6 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 jung4 ji6 ge3 si6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 sap6 nin4 syu6 muk6, baak3 nin4 syu6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育下一代不是一件容易的事，真的需要十年树木，百年树人。
examples.english_sentence: Educating the next generation is not an easy task; it truly requires ten years to grow a tree, but a hundred years to cultivate a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資教育就係十年樹木，百年樹人嘅最佳例子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 gaau3 juk6 zau6 hai6 sap6 nin4 syu6 muk6, baak3 nin4 syu6 jan4 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 lai6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资教育就是十年树木，百年树人的最佳例子。
examples.english_sentence: Investing in education is the best example of taking ten years to grow a tree, but a hundred years to cultivate a person.

english_meaning: To hone a sword for ten years; to dedicate a long time to perfecting a skill; to spend a decade preparing for a task.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻长期刻苦磨练，终能有所成就。也比喻长期积蓄力量，一旦发挥便能奏效。
explanation_english: This idiom describes dedicating a long period of time to honing a skill or preparing for a task. It implies that through sustained effort and perseverance, one can achieve a significant accomplishment or success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢十年磨一劍，終於喺奧運攞到金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap6 nin4 mo4 jat1 gim3, zung1 jyu1 hai2 ou3 wan6 lo2 dou2 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他十年磨一剑，终于在奥运会上获得了金牌。
examples.english_sentence: He honed his skills for ten years, and finally won a gold medal at the Olympics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫呢個程式，佢用咗十年時間去磨練，真係十年磨一劍啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 ni1 go3 cing4 sik1, keoi5 yung6 zo2 sap6 nin4 si4 gaan3 heoi3 mo4 lin6, zan1 hai6 sap6 nin4 mo4 jat1 gim3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 编写这个程序，他用了十年时间去磨练，真是十年磨一剑啊。
examples.english_sentence: Writing this program, he spent ten years honing his skills, truly ten years to forge a sword.

synonyms: 厚積薄發 (hau5 zik1 bok6 faat3)

english_meaning: guilty of unpardonable crimes; heinous; unforgivable; deserving of the severest punishment
explanation_mandarin: 指罪行极其严重，即使处以最严厉的惩罚也不足以弥补，无法被饶恕。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose crimes are so serious that they are unforgivable and deserving of the harshest punishment. Literally, 'ten evils unforgivable'. It originates from the 'Ten Abominations' in ancient Chinese law, which were considered the most heinous crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咁多衰嘢，真係十惡不赦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, zan1 hai6 sap6 ok3 bat1 se3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，真是罪大恶极！
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things; he is truly guilty of unpardonable crimes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污咁多錢，簡直係十惡不赦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 gam3 do1 cin2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sap6 ok3 bat1 se3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污这么多钱，简直是罪大恶极。
examples.english_sentence: Embezzling so much money is simply unforgivable.

mandarin_meaning: 十之八九; 大部分; 几乎
english_meaning: almost certainly; very likely; ninety percent
explanation_mandarin: 表示可能性很高，接近百分之百。形容事情发生的可能性非常大，接近确定的程度。
explanation_english: Indicates a high probability, close to one hundred percent. Describes a situation where the likelihood of something happening is very high, approaching certainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試十成九都合格啦，佢溫咗咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sap6 sing4 gau2 dou1 hap6 gaak3 laa1, keoi5 wan1 zo2 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试十之八九都会及格的，他复习了这么久。
examples.english_sentence: He'll almost certainly pass the exam this time, he's been studying for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨嘅機會十成九啦，天氣報告都咁講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 gei1 wui2 sap6 sing4 gau2 laa1, tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 dou1 gam3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨的机会十之八九了，天气报告都这么说。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of rain tomorrow is very high, the weather forecast says so too.

english_meaning: One hundred percent; absolutely; certainly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，完全确定，百分之百。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree of certainty; absolutely, one hundred percent, without a doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我十成十肯定佢會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sap6 sing4 sap6 hang2 ding6 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我百分之百肯定他会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I'm one hundred percent sure he will be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法十成十work嘅，你放心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 sap6 sing4 sap6 wok1 ge3, nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法肯定有效，你放心吧。
examples.english_sentence: This method will definitely work, don't worry.

jyutping: sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4
mandarin_meaning: 几乎成功，差一点就成功
english_meaning: Almost completely successful, just shy of perfect; nearly there
explanation_mandarin: 形容几乎完全成功，只差一点点。类似于“功亏一篑”或“差之毫厘，失之千里”。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is almost completely successful, missing perfection by a very small margin. Similar to "so close, yet so far" or "a near miss". It implies a high degree of success with a minor imperfection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃我哋十成着咗九成，差在最後嘅資金未到位啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ngo5 dei6 sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4, caa1 zoi6 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 zi1 gam1 mei6 dou3 wai2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划我们几乎完全成功了，就差最后的资金还没到位。
examples.english_sentence: This project is almost completely successful; we're only lacking the final funding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢準備咗咁耐，比賽十成着咗九成，可惜最後一關跌咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 gam3 noi6, bei2 coi3 sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4, ho2 sik1 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 gwaan1 dit3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他准备了这么久，比赛几乎就成功了，可惜最后一关摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He had prepared for so long, the competition was almost completely successful, but he unfortunately fell in the last stage.

jyutping: sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4
english_meaning: Almost certainly; nine out of ten; highly likely
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的可能性非常高，接近百分之百，但实际上稍微逊色一点。
explanation_english: Expresses a very high probability of something happening, close to 100%, but slightly less. Implies near certainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風，聽日停工十成著咗九成啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1, ting1 jat6 ting4 gung1 sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天刮台风，明天停工几乎是肯定的。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a typhoon tomorrow, it's almost certain that work will be suspended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，今次考試十成著咗九成會合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sap6 sing4 zoek3 zo2 gau2 sing4 wui5 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，这次考试十有八九会及格。
examples.english_sentence: He's so hardworking, he's almost certain to pass this exam.

mandarin_meaning: 十有八九; 很有把握
english_meaning: ninety percent sure; almost certain; a safe bet
explanation_mandarin: 形容很有把握，成功率非常高。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where success is almost guaranteed or highly probable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試我溫晒書，十拿九穩攞A啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 wan1晒syu1, sap6 naa4 gau2 wan2 lo2 ei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我复习完了，十有八九能拿到A了！
examples.english_sentence: I studied everything for this exam, I'm almost certain I'll get an A!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經驗咁豐富，呢個project交俾佢做，十拿九穩搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 gim6 gam3 fung1 fu3, ni1 go3 project gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6, sap6 naa4 gau2 wan2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经验这么丰富，这个项目交给他做，十有八九能完成。
examples.english_sentence: He's so experienced; if we give this project to him, it's almost certain he'll complete it.

jyutping: sap6 zi2 bat1 zim1 joeng4 ceon1 seoi2
english_meaning: To not lift a finger in housework; to be pampered and sheltered; to never have done manual labour.
explanation_mandarin: 形容养尊处优，生活富足，从不做家务，手指从来没有沾过水。比喻生活安逸，不用操劳的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is pampered and lives a life of luxury, never having to do housework or manual labor. It implies that their fingers have never touched water (implying they don't do dishes or laundry). It refers to someone who lives a comfortable and carefree life, without having to toil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁大個女都重十指不沾陽春水，乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 daai6 go3 neoi2 dou1 cung4 sap6 zi2 bat1 zim1 joeng4 ceon1 seoi2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她都这么大了，还是十指不沾阳春水，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: She's so old, and yet she hasn't lifted a finger in housework, she can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆真係好幸福，結婚之後都唔使做嘢，真係十指不沾陽春水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hang6 fuk1, git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 sap6 zi2 bat1 zim1 joeng4 ceon1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老婆真幸福，结婚之后都不用工作，真是十指不沾阳春水。
examples.english_sentence: His wife is really happy, she doesn't need to work after getting married, she really lives a life without lifting a finger.

english_meaning: holding hands (interlocking fingers); fingers interlocked
explanation_mandarin: 指双手手指互相交叉紧握，通常表示亲密、爱情或团结。
explanation_english: Refers to holding hands with fingers interlocked, usually indicating intimacy, love, or unity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋十指孖埋行街，真係好sweet啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sap6 zi2 maa1 maai4 haang4 gaai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们十指紧扣地逛街，真是好甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: They were holding hands (interlocking fingers) walking down the street, so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋十指孖埋，互相支持，一齊面對困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sap6 zi2 maa1 maai4, wu6 soeng1 zi1 ci4, jat1 cai4 min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们十指紧扣，互相支持，一起面对困难。
examples.english_sentence: They held hands, supported each other, and faced the difficulties together.

english_meaning: to interlock fingers, to hold hands tightly (with interlocking fingers)
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣或关系亲密的人紧紧地握住彼此的手，手指互相交错。
explanation_english: Describes a couple or people with a close relationship holding hands tightly, with their fingers interlocked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋行街成日都十指緊扣，好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haang4 gaai1 seng4 jat6 dou1 sap6 zi2 gan2 kau3, hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们逛街总是十指相扣，好甜蜜呀！
examples.english_sentence: They always interlock fingers when walking, so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢同另一個人十指緊扣，我先知原來佢哋拍緊拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 tung4 ling6 jat1 go3 jan4 sap6 zi2 gan2 kau3, ngo5 sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 keoi5 dei6 paak3 gan2 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他和另一个人十指相扣，我才知道原来他们在谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him holding hands with someone else, I realized they were dating.

english_meaning: delicate and slender fingers
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子手指纤细而美丽。常用來形容女性的手指非常修长好看。
explanation_english: Describes fingers that are delicate, slender, and beautiful, usually referring to a woman's long and attractive fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對手十指纖纖，好似藝術品咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sau2 sap6 zi2 sin1 sin1, hou2 ci5 ngai6 seot6 ban2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的手十指纤纤，好像艺术品一样。
examples.english_sentence: Her hands have delicate and slender fingers, like a work of art.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 彈鋼琴嘅女仔通常十指纖纖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 gong3 kam4 ge3 neoi5 zai2 tong1 soeng4 sap6 zi2 sin1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弹钢琴的女孩通常十指纤纤。
examples.english_sentence: Girls who play the piano usually have delicate and slender fingers.

english_meaning: October
explanation_mandarin: 公历的第十个月份。
explanation_english: The tenth month of the Gregorian calendar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋十月結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sap6 jyut6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们十月结婚。
examples.english_sentence: We are getting married in October.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 十月嘅香港天氣開始涼爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6 jyut6 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 loeng4 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 十月的香港天气开始凉爽。
examples.english_sentence: The weather in Hong Kong starts to cool down in October.

english_meaning: to be pregnant for ten months; the ten months of pregnancy
explanation_mandarin: 指妇女怀孕十个月的时间。 比喻事情需要经过长时间的酝酿和准备。
explanation_english: Refers to the ten months of a woman's pregnancy. It also metaphorically means that things need a long period of gestation and preparation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話佢當年都係十月懷胎，先至生到我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 keoi5 dong1 nin4 dou1 hai6 sap6 jyut6 waai4 toi1, sin1 zi3 sang1 dou2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说她当年也是十月怀胎，才生下我们。
examples.english_sentence: Mom said that she was pregnant for ten months to give birth to us back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃醞釀咗咁耐，真係好似十月懷胎咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wan3 joeng6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 sap6 jyut6 waai4 toi1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划酝酿了这么久，真像十月怀胎一样。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has been brewing for so long, it's really like a ten-month pregnancy.

mandarin_meaning: 起心肝；下决心；重新振作
english_meaning: To have a fresh start; to turn over a new leaf; to make a resolution (usually after a period of laxity)
explanation_mandarin: 指过了季节的芥菜重新生长出来。比喻人下决心重新开始，改过自新。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to mustard greens sprouting again in October, after the typical growing season has passed. It is a metaphor for someone making a resolution to start anew, often after a period of laziness, mistakes, or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前好懶惰，但係依家佢決心十月芥菜，發奮讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 hou2 laan5 do6, daan6 hai6 ji1 gaa1 keoi5 kyut3 sam1 sap6 jyut6 gaai3 coi3, faat3 fan5 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前很懒惰，但是现在他决心重新振作，发奋读书。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be very lazy, but now he is determined to turn over a new leaf and study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗咁多失敗，佢終於決定十月芥菜，重新開始自己嘅事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 sat1 baai6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 sap6 jyut6 gaai3 coi3, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2 zi6 gei2 ge3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多失败，他终于决定重新振作，重新开始自己的事业。
examples.english_sentence: After so many failures, he finally decided to have a fresh start and restart his career.

jyutping: sap6 jyut6 gaai3 coi3 -- hei2 sam1
english_meaning: To have feelings for someone (often romantic), to have ulterior motives, to have a crush on someone, to start having impure thoughts.
explanation_mandarin: 十月是芥菜开始长出菜心的季节。 “起心”指开始有菜心，引申为开始有想法，特别是开始有非分之想或对某人产生好感。
explanation_english: October is the season when mustard greens start to develop a heart (the central part of the vegetable). "起心 (hei2 sam1)" refers to this process of the vegetable developing a heart, metaphorically meaning to start having thoughts, especially ulterior motives or to develop feelings for someone, often romantically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日望住你，唔通對你起心？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mong5 zyu6 nei5, m4 tung1 deoi3 nei5 hei2 sam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是看着你，难道他对你动心了？
examples.english_sentence: He keeps looking at you. Could it be that he has feelings for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好對佢起心啊，佢已經有男朋友㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 deoi3 keoi5 hei2 sam1 aa3, keoi5 ji5 ging1 jau5 naam4 pang4 jau5 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要对她有非分之想，她已经有男朋友了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get any ideas about her; she already has a boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明成日幫阿 May，唔通佢對阿 May 起心？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 seng4 jat6 bong1 aa3 May, m4 tung1 keoi5 deoi3 aa3 May hei2 sam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明总是帮助阿 May，难道他对阿 May 有意思？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is always helping Ah May. Could it be that he has feelings for her?

english_meaning: October Revolution
explanation_mandarin: 指1917年俄国爆发的十月社会主义革命，是俄国历史上一次重要的政治事件。
explanation_english: Refers to the October Socialist Revolution in Russia in 1917, a significant political event in Russian history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史課我哋學咗關於十月革命嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 fo3 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zo2 gwaan1 jyu1 sap6 jyut6 gaak3 ming6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史课我们学了关于十月革命的事。
examples.english_sentence: We learned about the October Revolution in history class.

english_meaning: cross (Christian symbol)
explanation_mandarin: 指基督教中耶稣被钉死的十字架，也常用于基督教信仰的象征。
explanation_english: Refers to the cross on which Jesus was crucified in Christianity, and is often used as a symbol of Christian faith.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教堂上面有個好大嘅十架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 tong4 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 sap6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教堂上面有一个很大的十字架。
examples.english_sentence: There's a big cross on top of the church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係基督徒，頸上面戴住個十架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gei1 duk1 tou4, geng2 soeng6 min6 daai3 zyu6 go3 sap6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是基督徒，脖子上戴着一个十字架。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Christian, and he wears a cross around his neck.

jyutping: sap6 waak6 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3
english_meaning: Nothing has been done yet; not even the first step has been taken; it's far from being settled.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情离成功还早得很，一点眉目都没有。形容事情还远未有头绪，没有成功的希望。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a situation where nothing has even started, and there is no sign of progress or success. It means the matter is still very far from being settled and lacks any concrete development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司嘅融資計劃，十畫未有一撇，唔好咁快諗住成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jung4 zi1 gai3 waak6, sap6 waak6 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 nam2 zoek3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的融资计划，八字还没一撇，不要那么快就以为会成功。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's financing plan is nowhere near being finalized. Don't assume it will succeed so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事十畫未有一撇，而家講成功仲早咗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sap6 waak6 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3, ji4 gaa1 gong2 sing4 gung1 zung6 zou2 zo2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事八字还没一撇，现在说成功还太早了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is still in its very early stages. It's too early to talk about success now.

jyutping: sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3
mandarin_meaning: 事情还刚开始，没什么眉目
english_meaning: Nothing has even started yet; not even the slightest progress has been made.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情刚开始，连初步的迹象都还没有出现。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is just beginning and not even the slightest progress or indication of success has been made. Literally means 'not even the first stroke (of the character 十) has been written'. The first stroke of 十 is a horizontal line, '一'. The second stroke is a vertical line, '丨'. '撇' refers to the diagonal stroke in Chinese characters, but in this idiom, it is a generic term referring to the beginning of a stroke, indicating minimal progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司盤數爭咁多，想佢一年內搞掂，而家都十畫都未有一撇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 pun4 sou3 zaang1 gam3 do1, soeng2 keoi5 jat1 nin4 noi6 gaau2 dim6, ji4 gaa1 dou1 sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的账目差这么多，想让她一年内搞定，现在还没开始呢。
examples.english_sentence: The company's accounts are so messed up, expecting her to sort it out in a year, nothing has even started yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃嘅 funding 都未有着落，而家咪十畫都未有一撇囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 funding dou1 mei6 jau5 zoek6 lok6, ji4 gaa1 mai1 sap6 waak6 dou1 mei6 jau5 jat1 pit3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的资金还没到位，现在还没开始呢。
examples.english_sentence: The funding for the project hasn't been secured yet, so nothing has even started.

english_meaning: clumsy, awkward, fumbling
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作笨拙，不灵活，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, awkward, and prone to making mistakes due to a lack of dexterity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日都十碌八碌，做嘢好論盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 sing4 jat6 dou1 sap6 luk1 baat3 luk1, zou6 je5 hou2 leon6 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人总是笨手笨脚的，做事很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He is always clumsy and awkward, making things difficult when he works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁十碌八碌啦，小心打烂啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sap6 luk1 baat3 luk1 laa1, siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨手笨脚的啦，小心打破东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, be careful not to break anything.

english_meaning: Almost; nearly; very close to
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量接近某个数值，但稍微差一点。常用来形容非常接近，差不多达到某个目标或数量。
explanation_english: Indicates that a quantity is close to a certain value, but slightly less. It is often used to describe something very close to, or almost reaching a certain goal or quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考到九十九分，十萬九千七就一百分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dou3 gau2 sap6 gau2 fan1, sap6 maan6 gau2 cin1 cat1 zau6 jat1 baak3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了九十九分，差一点就一百分了。
examples.english_sentence: He got 99 marks in the exam, almost 100.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋執咗咁耐，間屋十萬九千七就執完啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zap1 zo2 gam3 noi6, gaan1 uk1 sap6 maan6 gau2 cin1 cat1 zau6 zap1 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收拾了这么久，房子就快收拾完了。
examples.english_sentence: We've been tidying up for so long, the house is almost completely tidied up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫打完折都要九千七蚊，十萬九千七就一萬蚊，都幾貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 daa2 jyun4 zit3 dou1 jiu3 gau2 cin1 cat1 man1, sap6 maan6 gau2 cin1 cat1 zau6 jat1 maan6 man1, dou1 gei2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服打完折也要九千七块钱，差一点就一万块钱了，还挺贵的。
examples.english_sentence: Even after the discount, this piece of clothing costs nine thousand seven dollars, it's almost ten thousand dollars, quite expensive.

english_meaning: a great distance; a far cry; worlds apart
explanation_mandarin: 形容距离非常遥远，也可以比喻差别很大。
explanation_english: Describes a very long distance, literally hundreds of thousands of miles. Figuratively, it can also mean a huge difference or something that is worlds apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅諗法真係差十萬八千里，根本冇可能溝通到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3 zan1 hai6 caa1 sap6 maan6 baat3 cin1 lei5, gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 kau1 tung1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的想法真是差十万八千里，根本不可能沟通。
examples.english_sentence: Their ideas are worlds apart; it's impossible for them to communicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港離北京真係十萬八千里咁遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lei4 bak1 ging1 zan1 hai6 sap6 maan6 baat3 cin1 lei5 gam3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港离北京真是十万八千里那么远。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is really a great distance away from Beijing.

english_meaning: extremely urgent; of utmost urgency; top priority
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常紧急，刻不容缓。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is extremely urgent and requires immediate action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，阿Sir，呢件事十萬火急，你一定要幫手搞掂佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, aa3 Sir, ni1 gin6 si6 sap6 maan6 fo2 gap1, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bong1 sau2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，警官，这件事十万火急，你一定要帮忙解决啊！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, officer, this is extremely urgent, you must help to resolve it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆突然暈低，情況十萬火急，快啲call白車呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 dat6 jin4 wan4 dai1, cing4 kwong3 sap6 maan6 fo2 gap1, faai3 di1 call baak6 ce1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶突然晕倒了，情况十万火急，快点叫救护车啊！
examples.english_sentence: My grandma suddenly fainted, the situation is extremely urgent, quickly call an ambulance!

english_meaning: Hurricane Signal No. 10, the highest typhoon signal
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一种台风警告信号，表示香港正受到飓风级别的台风直接威胁。
explanation_english: A typhoon warning signal in Hong Kong, indicating that Hong Kong is under direct threat from a hurricane-force typhoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台掛咗十號風球，所有學校都停課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man1 toi4 gwaa3 zo2 sap6 hou6 fung1 kau4, so2 jau5 hok6 haau6 dou1 ting4 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台挂了十号风球，所有学校都停课。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Observatory hoisted the Hurricane Signal No. 10, and all schools are suspended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日唔使返工喇，因為掛咗十號風球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 laa3, jan1 wai6 gwaa3 zo2 sap6 hou6 fung1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天不用上班了，因为挂了十号风球。
examples.english_sentence: No need to go to work tomorrow, because the Hurricane Signal No. 10 has been hoisted.

english_meaning: Hurricane Signal No. 10
explanation_mandarin: 香港最高级别的热带气旋警告信号，表示香港正受到或预期将受到飓风或更强风力的侵袭。
explanation_english: The highest tropical cyclone warning signal in Hong Kong, indicating that Hong Kong is being or is expected to be affected by hurricane-force winds or stronger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台掛咗十號波，聽日唔使返工啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 gwaa3 zo2 sap6 hou6 bo1, ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台挂了十号风球，明天不用上班啦！
examples.english_sentence: The Observatory has hoisted Hurricane Signal No. 10, we don't have to go to work tomorrow!

mandarin_meaning: 十号风球 (最高级别的台风警告)
english_meaning: Typhoon Signal No. 10 (highest typhoon warning signal)
explanation_mandarin: 香港最高级别的热带气旋警告信号，表示香港正受到或预期会受到飓风（持续风速达到118公里/小时或以上）的影响。
explanation_english: The highest tropical cyclone warning signal issued in Hong Kong. It indicates that Hong Kong is being, or is expected to be, affected by a hurricane (sustained winds reaching 118 km/h or above).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台啱啱掛咗十號風球，大家要留喺屋企，唔好周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 ngaam1 ngaam1 gwaa3 zo2 sap6 hou6 fung1 kau4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2, m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台刚刚悬挂了十号风球，大家要留在家里，不要到处走。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Observatory just hoisted Typhoon Signal No. 10. Everyone should stay home and not wander around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果聽日仲係十號風球，咁就唔使返工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ting1 jat6 zung6 hai6 sap6 hou6 fung1 kau4, gam2 zau6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明天还是十号风球，那么就不用上班了。
examples.english_sentence: If it's still Typhoon Signal No. 10 tomorrow, then we don't have to go to work.

english_meaning: Nine times out of ten, gambling results in losing.
explanation_mandarin: 形容赌博的危害性，多半是输钱的。
explanation_english: Describes the harmful nature of gambling, where losing money is the most likely outcome. It emphasizes that gambling is a losing proposition for most people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再賭啦，十賭九輸㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 laa1, sap6 dou2 gau2 syu1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再赌了，十赌九输啊！
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't gamble anymore, nine times out of ten you'll lose!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 信我啦，十賭九輸，唔好諗住可以靠賭發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon3 ngo5 laa1, sap6 dou2 gau2 syu1, m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 kaau3 dou2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相信我，十赌九输，别想着可以靠赌发财。
examples.english_sentence: Believe me, nine times out of ten you'll lose, don't think you can get rich by gambling.

mandarin_meaning: 十足; 充分; 完全
english_meaning: full; complete; 100 percent; pure; utter
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“十分”、“非常”、“完全”。也可以形容某事物是纯粹的，没有掺杂其他成分。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree, equivalent to 'very' or 'completely'. It can also describe something as pure and unadulterated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅語氣十足十似佢老豆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3 sap6 zuk1 sap6 sik1 ci5 keoi5 lou5 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的语气十足像他爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: The tone of his voice is exactly like his father's.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲十足係一套愛情片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 sap6 zuk1 hai6 jat1 tou3 oi3 ching4 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影十足是一部爱情片。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is completely a romance film.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得十足準備先去考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 sap6 zuk1 zhun2 bei6 sin1 heui3 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了充分的准备才去考试。
examples.english_sentence: He made full preparations before going to the exam.

english_meaning: Completely; totally; one hundred percent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“完全”、“十足”、“百分之百”，强调程度非常高。
explanation_english: Expresses a high degree, equivalent to "completely", "totally", or "one hundred percent". It emphasizes a very high degree or extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢十足十係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 sap6 zuk1 sap6 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的东西百分之百是真的。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is completely true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個戲十足十係攞獎之作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hei3 sap6 zuk1 sap6 hai6 lo2 zoeng2 zi1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影完全是拿奖之作。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is definitely an award-winning piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢十足十似佢阿爸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap6 zuk1 sap6 ci5 keoi5 aa3 baa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全像他爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: He looks exactly like his father.

english_meaning: decimal system
explanation_mandarin: 一种计数系统，以10为基数。
explanation_english: A numeral system with a base of 10.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋平時用嘅數都係十進制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ping4 si4 yung6 ge3 sou3 dou1 hai6 sap6 zeon3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们平时用的数字都是十进制。
examples.english_sentence: The numbers we usually use are in decimal system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電腦內部唔係用十進制嘅，佢哋用二進制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 nou5 noi6 bou6 m4 hai6 yung6 sap6 zeon3 zai3 ge3, keoi5 dei6 yung6 ji6 zeon3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑内部不是用十进制的，它们用二进制。
examples.english_sentence: Computers don't use the decimal system internally; they use the binary system.

jyutping: sap6 zek3 sau2 zi2 jau5 coeng4 dyun2
english_meaning: Even fingers are not of the same length; to each their own; people have different abilities and qualities; there are bound to be differences.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人与人之间存在差异，能力、天赋等各不相同；也指对待事物不能要求完全平等，因为客观条件本来就存在差异。
explanation_english: This idiom means that just like fingers are not all the same length, people are different and have varying abilities, talents, and qualities. It also implies that it's unrealistic to expect absolute equality in all situations because inherent differences exist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁唔開心嘅，十隻手指有長短，每個人都有自己嘅優點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3, sap6 zek3 sau2 zi2 jau5 coeng4 dyun2, mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 jau1 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没必要这么不开心，十个手指头有长短，每个人都有自己的优点。
examples.english_sentence: There's no need to be so upset. Even fingers are not of the same length, everyone has their own strengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分配資源嘅時候，都應該考慮到十隻手指有長短，唔可以一刀切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 pui3 zi1 jyun4 ge3 si4 hau6, dou1 jing1 goi1 hau2 leoi6 dou3 sap6 zek3 sau2 zi2 jau5 coeng4 dyun2, m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 dou1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分配资源的时候，都应该考虑到十个手指头有长短，不能一刀切。
examples.english_sentence: When allocating resources, we should consider that people are different and have varying abilities, and we cannot apply a one-size-fits-all approach.

english_meaning: All-rounder, versatile, jack-of-all-trades
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人在各个方面都表现出色，能力全面，非常优秀。
explanation_english: Describes a person who excels in all aspects, with comprehensive abilities and excellent performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係十項全能，又識唱歌又識跳舞又識畫畫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 sap6 hong6 cyun4 nang4, jau6 sik1 cheung3 go1 jau6 sik1 tiu3 mou5 jau6 sik1 waak6 waa2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是十项全能，又会唱歌又会跳舞又会画画！
examples.english_sentence: He is truly an all-rounder, he can sing, dance, and paint!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺公司入面俾人叫做十項全能，因為佢乜嘢都識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 sap6 hong6 cyun4 nang4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在公司里被称为十项全能，因为他什么都会做。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is known as an all-rounder in the company because he knows how to do everything.

english_meaning: thousand
explanation_mandarin: 表示一千的数量。
explanation_english: Represents the quantity of one thousand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車要成千蚊先買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 jiu3 seng4 cin1 man1 sin1 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车要一千块钱才能买到。
examples.english_sentence: This car costs a thousand dollars to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有成千上萬個朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 seng4 cin1 soeng6 maan6 go3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有成千上万个朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He has thousands upon thousands of friends.

cantonese: 千㨂萬㨂，㨂著個爛燈盞
jyutping: cin1 dung2 maan6 dung2, dung2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2*
mandarin_meaning: 千挑万选，选了个最差的
english_meaning: After much picking and choosing, ended up with the worst option.
explanation_mandarin: 形容费尽心思挑选，结果却选择了最差的东西。比喻花费很多精力和时间做某事，但结果却适得其反，或者得到的结果非常差。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone meticulously picks and chooses, but ends up selecting the worst option. It implies that despite careful consideration and effort, the outcome is undesirable or counterproductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住搵份好啲嘅工，點知千㨂萬㨂，㨂著個爛燈盞，依家仲慘過之前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 wan2 fan6 hou2 di1 ge3 gung1, dim2 zi1 cin1 dung2 maan6 dung2, dung2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2, ji1 gaa1 zung2 caam2 gwo3 zi1 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来想找个好一点的工作，谁知道千挑万选，选了个最差的，现在比以前还惨。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I'd find a better job, but after much picking and choosing, I ended up with the worst option. Now it's even worse than before.

cantonese: 千㨂萬㨂，㨂著個爛燈膽
jyutping: cin1 dung2 maan6 dung2, dung2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 daam2
mandarin_meaning: 千挑万选，选了个坏灯泡
english_meaning: After much picking and choosing, (I) ended up with a broken light bulb. / To choose the worst option after careful consideration.
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费很多心思挑选，结果却选到了最差的或者没用的东西。比喻费尽心思选择，结果却选了个糟糕的。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone spends a lot of effort and time choosing something, only to end up with the worst or a useless option. It's a metaphor for making a bad choice despite careful consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買個好嘅電話，點知千㨂萬㨂，㨂著個爛燈膽，用咗冇幾耐就壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 maai5 go3 hou2 ge3 din6 waa2, dim2 zi1 cin1 dung2 maan6 dung2, dung2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 daam2, yung6 zo2 mou5 gei2 noi6 zau6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本想买个好手机，结果千挑万选，选了个坏灯泡，用了没多久就坏了。
examples.english_sentence: I intended to buy a good phone, but after much deliberation, I ended up with a lemon, and it broke down shortly after using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好叻，揀女朋友千㨂萬㨂，結果㨂著個爛燈膽，成日嗌交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, gaan2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 cin1 dung2 maan6 dung2, git3 gwo2 dung2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 daam2, seng4 jat6 aai3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很聪明，挑女朋友千挑万选，结果选了个烂灯泡，整天吵架。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he was so smart, carefully choosing a girlfriend, but ended up with a lemon, and they argue all the time.

english_meaning: extremely obedient; docile and compliant; doing everything one is told
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常顺从，什么都听从别人的。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely obedient and compliant, doing everything they are told without question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢男朋友千依百順，咩都聽晒佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 cin1 ji1 baak3 seon6, me1 dou1 teng1晒 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她对她男朋友百依百顺，什么都听他的。
examples.english_sentence: She is extremely obedient to her boyfriend, listening to everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好對個仔千依百順，咁樣會縱壞佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 deoi3 go3 zai2 cin1 ji1 baak3 seon6, gam2 joeng2 wui zung3 waai6 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要对儿子百依百顺，这样会宠坏他的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obedient to your son, it will spoil him.

english_meaning: kilogram, kg
explanation_mandarin: 重量单位，等于一公斤。
explanation_english: A unit of mass, equal to one kilogram.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包米有五千克重呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 mai5 jau5 ng5 cin1 hak1 zung6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这包米有五公斤重啊。
examples.english_sentence: This bag of rice weighs five kilograms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想減肥，目標係減十千克。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaam2 fei4, muk6 biu1 hai6 gaam2 sap6 cin1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想减肥，目标是减十公斤。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to lose weight, his goal is to lose ten kilograms.

english_meaning: percent
explanation_mandarin: 表示千分率，也就是百分比。
explanation_english: Indicates parts per thousand, more commonly understood as a percentage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估計成功嘅機會都有千分之五十㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 gai3 sing4 gung1 ge3 gei1 wui2 dou1 jau5 cin1 fan1 zi1 ng5 sap6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计成功的机会也有百分之五十啊！
examples.english_sentence: I estimate there's a 50 percent chance of success!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅答啱嘅機會得千分之五咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 daap3 ngaam1 ge3 gei1 wui2 dak1 cin1 fan1 zi1 ng5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你回答正确的机会只有百分之零点五。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of your answer being correct is only 0.5 percent.

english_meaning: thousands upon thousands; countless; a great many
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，数不清。
explanation_english: Describes a vast, uncountable number or quantity; countless; a great many.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住儲千千萬萬蚊退休。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 cou5 cin1 cin1 maan6 maan6 man1 teoi3 yau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想存成千上万块钱退休。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to save thousands upon thousands of dollars to retire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會現場有千千萬萬嘅歌迷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin2 cheung3 wui2 yim6 cheung4 jau5 cin1 cin1 maan6 maan6 ge3 go1 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会现场有成千上万的歌迷。
examples.english_sentence: There were thousands upon thousands of fans at the concert.

english_meaning: forever; for all time; throughout the ages; eternally
explanation_mandarin: 指非常长远的时间，可以表示“永远”、“永久”的意思，通常用于形容某种影响或意义持续很长时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a very long period of time, meaning 'forever' or 'eternally'. It's often used to describe an influence or significance that lasts for a very long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅貢獻將會千古流芳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung3 hiun3 zoeng1 wui5 cin1 gu2 lau4 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的贡献将会千古流芳。
examples.english_sentence: His contribution will be remembered for all time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一定會俾人千古傳頌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 ding6 wui5 bei2 jan4 cin1 gu2 cyun4 sung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一定会被人千古传颂。
examples.english_sentence: This event will definitely be praised and remembered forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秦始皇係一個千古罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon4 ci2 wong4 hai6 jat1 go3 cin1 gu2 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秦始皇是一个千古罪人。
examples.english_sentence: Qin Shi Huang was a villain for all time.

mandarin_meaning: 遗臭万年的人; 千古罪人
english_meaning: Sinner for eternity; a person condemned by history; someone who will be remembered for their crimes/wrongdoings.
explanation_mandarin: 形容罪大恶极，为后世所唾弃的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose crimes are so heinous that they will be condemned by future generations. It refers to a person who will be remembered for their grave misdeeds and will bear the burden of historical condemnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅所作所為，肯定會俾歷史定為千古罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 so2 zok3 so2 wai4, hang2 ding6 wui5 bei2 lik6 si2 ding6 wai4 cin1 gu2 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的所作所为，肯定会被历史定位为千古罪人。
examples.english_sentence: His actions will definitely be judged by history and he'll be labelled as a sinner for eternity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我出賣你哋，我咪變成千古罪人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ceot1 maai6 nei5 dei6, ngo5 mai1 bin3 sing4 cin1 gu2 zeoi6 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我出卖你们，我不就变成千古罪人了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If I betray you guys, wouldn't I become a sinner for eternity?

english_meaning: to repeatedly urge and advise; to give someone a thousand instructions and ten thousand admonitions
explanation_mandarin: 形容再三叮嘱，生怕对方忘记或出错。
explanation_english: Describes repeatedly urging and advising someone, fearing that they might forget or make mistakes. It emphasizes the importance and urgency of the instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽送我出國讀書，千叮萬囑我要照顧好自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sung3 ngo5 ceot1 gwok3 duk6 syu1, cin1 ding1 maan6 zuk1 ngo5 jiu3 ziu3 gu3 hou2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈送我出国读书，千叮咛万嘱咐我要照顾好自己。
examples.english_sentence: When my mother sent me abroad to study, she repeatedly urged me to take good care of myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨走嘅時候，佢千叮萬囑我記得熄燈鎖門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 zau2 ge3 si4 hau2, keoi5 cin1 ding1 maan6 zuk1 ngo5 gei3 dak1 sik1 dang1 so2 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 临走的时候，他千叮咛万嘱咐我记得关灯锁门。
examples.english_sentence: Before leaving, he repeatedly reminded me to remember to turn off the lights and lock the door.

english_meaning: after repeated requests and summons; after much urging
explanation_mandarin: 形容多次呼唤，催促，才能使人或事物出现。指经过长时间的等待或困难的过程才得以实现。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something or someone finally appears or happens after much calling, urging, or repeated requests. It implies a long wait or a difficult process before something is achieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個巴士等咗好耐都唔嚟，真係千呼萬喚先至出現啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 baa1 si2 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 lei4, zan1 hai6 cin1 fu1 maan6 waan6 sin1 zi3 ceot1 jin6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公共汽车等了很久都不来，真是千呼万唤才出现啊！
examples.english_sentence: The bus took so long to arrive; it finally showed up after much waiting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫咗好耐都未搞掂，要千呼萬喚佢先交出嚟。
