examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mei6 gaau2 dim6, jiu3 cin1 fu1 maan6 waan6 keoi5 sin1 gaau1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写了很久都没完成，要再三催促他才交出来。
examples.english_sentence: The report took a long time to write and still wasn't finished; it took a lot of urging to get him to submit it.

english_meaning: Condemned by a thousand people; universally condemned; to be the target of universal condemnation.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人行为极其恶劣，受到所有人的谴责和唾弃。通常用于负面评价。
explanation_english: Describes a person's behavior as extremely atrocious, deserving of condemnation and contempt from everyone. Typically used for negative evaluations. It implies widespread and severe disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多衰嘢，真係千夫所指，抵佢俾人鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, zan1 hai6 cin1 fu1 so2 zi2, dai2 keoi5 bei2 jan4 nau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，真是千夫所指，活该被骂。
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things, he is truly universally condemned, it's his own fault that he is being scolded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污嘅官員一定會受到千夫所指，冇好下場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 ge3 gun1 jyun4 jat1 ding6 wui5 sau6 dou3 cin1 fu1 so2 zi2, mou5 hou2 haa6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污的官员一定会受到千夫所指，没有好下场。
examples.english_sentence: Corrupt officials will certainly be universally condemned and will not have a good ending.

english_meaning: strange and varied; all sorts of odd things; bizarre; outlandish
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常奇怪，种类繁多。
explanation_english: Describes something as being very strange, bizarre, or outlandish and varied in type.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間博物館入邊啲展品千奇百怪，真係大開眼界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 bin1 ge3 zin2 pan2 cin1 kei4 baak3 gwaai3, zan1 hai6 daai6 hoi1 ngaan5 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间博物馆里的展品千奇百怪，真是大开眼界。
examples.english_sentence: The exhibits in that museum were strange and varied, it was truly eye-opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗埋啲千奇百怪嘅嘢，唔知佢個腦點解咁得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 cin1 kei4 baak3 gwaai3 ge3 je5, m4 zi1 keoi5 go3 nou5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想些千奇百怪的东西，不知道他的脑子为什么这么有趣。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks of strange and bizarre things, I wonder why his brain is so interesting.

english_meaning: in thousands of postures; in all manner of shapes and forms; multifarious
explanation_mandarin: 形容姿态多种多样，各不相同。
explanation_english: Describes the countless forms, shapes, and postures of something; a variety of states or appearances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜景千姿百態，好靚㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 ging2 cin1 zi1 baak3 taai3, hou2 leng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜景千姿百态，非常漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong night view is multifarious and very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 馬戲團入邊啲表演千姿百態，觀眾睇到好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa5 hei3 tyun4 jap6 bin1 di1 biu2 jin2 cin1 zi1 baak3 taai3, gun1 zung3 tai2 dou3 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 马戏团里的表演千姿百态，观众看得很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: The performances in the circus are in all manner of shapes and forms, and the audience is very happy to watch.

mandarin_meaning: 形容女子姿态美好，极具魅力
english_meaning: Exquisitely charming and alluring (describing a woman); possessing countless charms
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子容貌姿态极其美丽动人，有各种各样的娇媚之态。多用于赞美女性。
explanation_english: Describes a woman as extremely beautiful and captivating in appearance and demeanor, possessing a multitude of charming qualities. Often used to praise women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打扮到千嬌百媚，肯定要去溝仔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2 baan6 dou3 cin1 giu1 baak3 mei6, hang2 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 kau1 zai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得千娇百媚，肯定要去钓凯子了。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed up so charmingly today, she's definitely going to pick up a guy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲啲女主角個個都千嬌百媚，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 di1 neoi5 zyu2 gok3 go3 go3 dou1 cin1 giu1 baak3 mei6, hou2 kap1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的女主角们个个都千娇百媚，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The actresses in this movie are all so charming and beautiful, it's very attractive.

mandarin_meaning: 冗长的文章，话很多但没重点的文章
english_meaning: A long and rambling text; a lengthy and pointless speech; a speech or writing that is long-winded and lacking substance.
explanation_mandarin: 指内容空洞、冗长、缺乏重点的文章或讲话。 常带有负面评价，形容对方说话或写字囉嗦、不知所云。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of writing or speech that is lengthy, pointless, and lacking substance. It often carries a negative connotation, describing someone's speech or writing as long-winded and incomprehensible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又喺度講埋啲千字文，都唔知佢嗡乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 hai2 dou6 gong2 maai4 di1 cin1 zi6 man4, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 ung2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又在那里讲一堆没重点的话，都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's talking a load of rambling nonsense again, I have no idea what he's on about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫到千字文咁長，但係都冇解決到問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 cin1 zi6 man4 gam3 coeng4, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得像一篇冗长的文章，但是都没有解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: The report is as long as a rambling text, but it didn't solve the problem at all.

mandarin_meaning: 千层糕 (a type of steamed layered cake)
english_meaning: Thousand-layer cake; mille-feuille cake (Cantonese steamed version)
explanation_mandarin: 一种广东点心，用多种原料蒸制而成，层次分明。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dim sum dish, made from multiple ingredients and steamed to create distinct layers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意食千層糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 cin1 cang4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢吃千层糕。
examples.english_sentence: I loved eating thousand-layer cake when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲茶嘅時候，我哋通常都會叫千層糕嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 caa4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 giu3 cin1 cang4 gou1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝茶的时候，我们通常都会叫千层糕来吃。
examples.english_sentence: When having dim sum, we usually order thousand-layer cake.

english_meaning: Lasagne, lasagna
explanation_mandarin: 一种意大利面食，由多层宽面、肉酱、奶酪和酱汁层叠而成，再经烤制而成。
explanation_english: A type of Italian pasta dish made of layers of wide, flat pasta sheets interleaved with sauces such as ragù (ground meat and tomato sauce), béchamel sauce, and cheese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食千層麪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 soeng2 sik6 cin1 cang4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃千层面。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat lasagne tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅千層麪做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cin1 cang4 min6 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的千层面做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant makes very authentic lasagne.

english_meaning: lasagna
explanation_mandarin: 一种意大利面食，由多层面皮、肉酱、奶酪等材料叠放而成。
explanation_english: A type of Italian pasta dish made of stacked layers of flat pasta sheets, meat sauce, cheese, and other fillings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚不如煮千層麵啦，好耐冇食喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 bat1 jyu4 zyu2 cin1 cang4 min6 laa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不如煮千层面吧，好久没吃了。
examples.english_sentence: How about cooking lasagna tonight? It's been a long time since we had it.

english_meaning: Thousand-year kill (literal); a playful prank of poking someone in the butt with fingers
explanation_mandarin: 一种恶作剧，用手指戳人的屁股。字面意思是“千年杀”。
explanation_english: A playful prank where someone pokes another person in the butt with their fingers, typically from behind. The literal translation is "thousand-year kill."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪搞啦！你唔好成日千年殺我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gaau2 laa1! nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 chin1 nin4 saat3 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别闹了！你不要老是千年杀我！
examples.english_sentence: Stop it! Don't keep giving me the thousand-year kill!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時成日同啲同學玩千年殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 tung4 hok6 waan2 chin1 nin4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常和同学们玩千年杀。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often played the thousand-year kill with my classmates.

english_meaning: to choose very carefully; to pick and choose from among many
explanation_mandarin: 形容经过非常仔细和慎重的挑选。
explanation_english: Describes the act of selecting something after a very careful and meticulous process, implying a wide range of options and a high level of discernment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係我千挑萬選嘅，一定襯你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 ngo5 cin1 tiu1 maan6 syun2 ge3, jat1 ding6 can3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是我精挑细选的，一定适合你。
examples.english_sentence: I chose this shirt very carefully; it's definitely going to suit you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋佢千挑萬選先至決定買嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 keoi5 cin1 tiu1 maan6 syun2 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6 maai5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子他是精挑细选才决定买的。
examples.english_sentence: He chose this house very carefully before deciding to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次請嘅演員都係導演千挑萬選㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ceng2 ge3 jin2 jyun4 dou1 hai6 dou6 jin2 cin1 tiu1 maan6 syun2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次请的演员都是导演精挑细选的。
examples.english_sentence: The actors hired this time were all carefully selected by the director.

english_meaning: To pick and choose very carefully; to be extremely picky; to be overly selective.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常挑剔，经过很多次的挑选才作出选择。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely picky and making a choice only after a great deal of careful selection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買嘢千揀萬揀，次次都要睇好耐先決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 je5 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, ci3 ci3 dou1 jiu3 tai2 hou2 noi6 sin1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她买东西精挑细选，每次都要看很久才决定。
examples.english_sentence: She's very picky when buying things, she always takes a long time to decide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵男朋友唔好千揀萬揀，最緊要啱自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 naam4 pang4 jau5 m4 hou2 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ngaam1 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找男朋友不要过于挑剔，最重要的是适合自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be too picky when finding a boyfriend, the most important thing is that he suits you.

jyutping: cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2 gaan2 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2
mandarin_meaning: 千挑万选选了个破烂货
english_meaning: To choose and choose repeatedly, only to end up with a defective product; to be picky and end up with something worse.
explanation_mandarin: 形容经过多次挑选，结果却选到了质量很差的东西。比喻非常挑剔，最终却得到了不好的结果。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is very picky and choosy, but ends up with something of poor quality. It implies that being overly selective can lead to an undesirable outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀男朋友揀咗好耐，點知最後都係千揀萬揀揀個爛燈盞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 naam4 pang4 jau5 gaan2 zo2 hou2 noi6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2 gaan2 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她选男朋友选了很久，结果最后还是千挑万选选了个破烂货。
examples.english_sentence: She spent a long time choosing a boyfriend, but in the end, she was picky and ended up with someone terrible.

cantonese: 千揀萬揀，揀著個爛燈盞
jyutping: cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2
mandarin_meaning: 千挑万选，选了个破烂的灯盏
english_meaning: To pick and choose very carefully, only to end up with something broken and undesirable; To be picky and end up with something worse than you started with.
explanation_mandarin: 形容经过仔细挑选，结果却选到了一个很差的东西。比喻花费了很多时间和精力，结果却选到了一个不如意的对象或物品。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is very picky and chooses carefully, only to end up with something of poor quality or undesirable. It implies that despite the effort spent in selecting, the result is disappointing and worse than expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵男朋友千揀萬揀，點知揀著個爛燈盞，成日都唔理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 naam4 pang4 jau5 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, dim2 zi1 gaan2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她找男朋友千挑万选，结果选了个破烂货，整天都不理她。
examples.english_sentence: She was so picky in choosing a boyfriend, but she ended up with a real dud who ignores her all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓千揀萬揀，揀著間漏水嘅，真係千揀萬揀，揀著個爛燈盞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek3 gaan1 lau6 seoi2 ge3, zan1 hai6 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek3 go3 laan6 dang1 zaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房千挑万选，选了个漏水的，真是千挑万选，选了个破烂货。
examples.english_sentence: I was so picky when buying a house, but I ended up with one that leaks. It's a classic case of picking and choosing and ending up with something broken.

cantonese: 千揀萬揀，揀著個爛燈膽
jyutping: cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek6 go3 laan6 dang1 daam2
mandarin_meaning: 千挑万选，选了个坏灯泡
english_meaning: After much picking and choosing, ended up with a defective lightbulb; after much deliberation, ended up with a bad choice.
explanation_mandarin: 形容经过多次选择，结果却选到了最差的东西，带有讽刺意味。灯胆指灯泡，烂灯胆比喻不好的东西或人。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where after a lot of careful choosing, someone ends up with the worst possible option. It's often used sarcastically. "爛燈膽" (laan6 dang1 daam2 - broken lightbulb) is a metaphor for something or someone undesirable or defective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我千揀萬揀，揀著個唔聽話嘅仔，真係激死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek6 go3 m4 teng1 waa6 ge3 zai2, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我千挑万选，选了个不听话的儿子，真是气死我。
examples.english_sentence: After all my choosing, I ended up with a disobedient son, it's really driving me mad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢千揀萬揀，揀咗份人工低又辛苦嘅工，真係千揀萬揀，揀著個爛燈膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zo2 fan6 yan4 gung1 dai1 jau6 san1 fu2 ge3 gung1, zan1 hai6 cin1 gaan2 maan6 gaan2, gaan2 zoek6 go3 laan6 dang1 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他千挑万选，选了份工资低又辛苦的工作，真是千挑万选，选了个坏灯泡。
examples.english_sentence: After all his choosing, he chose a low-paying and tiring job. Truly, after much deliberation, he ended up with a bad choice.

synonyms: 揀嚟揀去，揀咗個死魚 (gaan2 lai4 gaan2 heoi3, gaan2 zo2 go3 sei2 yu2)

english_meaning: jack (lifting device)
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于提升重物的工具，通常用于汽车维修，更换轮胎等。
explanation_english: A tool used for lifting heavy objects, commonly used for car repair, tire changes, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車爆咗呔，要攞返個千斤頂出嚟換呔呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 baau3 zo2 taai1, jiu3 lo2 faan1 go3 cin1 gan1 ding2 ceot1 lai4 wun6 taai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车胎爆了，要拿出千斤顶来换轮胎。
examples.english_sentence: The car has a flat tire, we need to get the jack out to change the tire.

english_meaning: by every possible means; by hook or by crook; to try every possible way
explanation_mandarin: 想尽或用尽各种方法。
explanation_english: To exhaust all possible methods; to try every possible means to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢千方百計都想贏呢場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin1 fong1 baak3 gai2 dou1 soeng2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他千方百计都想赢得这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He tries by every possible means to win this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵返佢隻狗，佢千方百計咁樣去搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 faan1 keoi5 zek3 gau2, keoi5 cin1 fong1 baak3 gai2 gam2 joeng2 heoi3 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找回他的狗，他千方百计地去找。
examples.english_sentence: In order to find his dog back, he tried every possible way to look for it.

mandarin_meaning: 训练不足，未经实战检验的军队
english_meaning: An army that is poorly trained and untested in battle; a force that is more for show than actual combat.
explanation_mandarin: 指训练时间不足，缺乏实战经验的军队或队伍。比喻看起来人数众多，但实际战斗力很差的组织或团队。
explanation_english: Refers to an army or team with insufficient training and lacking real combat experience. It is a metaphor for an organization or team that appears large in number but has very weak actual combat capabilities. It can also be used humorously to describe a group that seems impressive but is ultimately ineffective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司好似好多人咁，但其實咪又係一班千日軍團，做嘢慢吞吞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 hou2 do1 jan4 gam2, daan6 kei4 sat6 mai1 jau6 hai6 jat1 baan1 cin1 jat6 gwan1 tyun4, zou6 je5 maan6 tan1 tan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司看起来人很多，但其实也就是一群训练不足的人，做事慢吞吞。
examples.english_sentence: Their company seems to have a lot of people, but in reality, they're just a bunch of poorly trained workers, working at a snail's pace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班新丁咪以為自己好勁，其實都係千日軍團，一打仗就散晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 san1 ding1 mai1 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 ging6, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 cin1 jat6 gwan1 tyun4, jat1 daa2 zoeng3 zau6 saan3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群新兵别以为自己很厉害，其实都是未经实战训练的，一打仗就散了。
examples.english_sentence: These rookies shouldn't think they're so great. They're just an untested force; they'll scatter as soon as a fight breaks out.

english_meaning: to guess wildly; to make random guesses; wild guesses
explanation_mandarin: 指没有根据、没有逻辑的随意猜测，通常带有不确定和不负责任的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to guessing randomly without basis or logic, often with an implication of uncertainty and irresponsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千猜都猜唔中㗎，不如我直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 caai1 dou1 caai1 m4 zung1 gaa3, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你胡乱猜也猜不中的，不如我直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: You won't guess it even if you make wild guesses, so I'll just tell you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好千猜啦，問清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cin1 caai1 laa1, man6 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱猜了，先问清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make wild guesses, ask clearly first.

english_meaning: kilowatt (kW)
explanation_mandarin: 功率单位，等于一千瓦特。
explanation_english: A unit of power equal to one thousand watts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣機用幾多千瓦電呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 yung6 gei2 do1 cin1 ngaa5 din6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台空调用多少千瓦的电啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many kilowatts of electricity does this air conditioner use?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽能發電廠可以產生幾百萬千瓦嘅電力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 yeung4 nang4 faat3 din6 chong2 ho2 ji5 chan2 sang1 gei2 baak3 maan6 cin1 ngaa5 ge3 din6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳能发电厂可以产生几百万千瓦的电力。
examples.english_sentence: The solar power plant can generate several million kilowatts of electricity.

english_meaning: riddled with holes; full of holes; riddled with problems; in a terrible state
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物破損嚴重，漏洞很多。也比喻社會、國家等問題重重，情況惡劣。
explanation_english: Describes something that is severely damaged and full of holes. It can also be used metaphorically to describe a society, country, or organization that is riddled with problems and in a terrible state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋已經千瘡百孔，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 ji5 ging1 cin1 cong1 baak3 hung2, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子已经千疮百孔，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: The house is already riddled with holes, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅戰爭，個國家已經千瘡百孔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 zin3 zang1, go3 gwok3 gaa1 ji5 ging1 cin1 cong1 baak3 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的战争，那个国家已经千疮百孔。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of war, that country is already riddled with problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅財務狀況千瘡百孔，隨時會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 mou6 zong6 fong3 cin1 cong1 baak3 hung2, ceoi4 si4 wui5 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财务状况千疮百孔，随时会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The financial situation of this company is riddled with problems, it could go bankrupt at any time.

english_meaning: absolutely true; definitely true; completely authentic; beyond all doubt
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常真实可靠，绝对没错。
explanation_english: Describes something that is absolutely true, reliable, and without a doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢中咗六合彩頭獎，千眞萬確㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2, cin1 zan1 maan6 kok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他中了六合彩头奖，千真万确的。
examples.english_sentence: He said he won the first prize in the Mark Six lottery, it's absolutely true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我親眼見到佢偷嘢，千眞萬確，唔會有錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 can1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 tau1 je5, cin1 zan1 maan6 kok3, m4 wui5 jau5 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我亲眼看见他偷东西，千真万确，不会有错的。
examples.english_sentence: I saw him stealing with my own eyes, it's absolutely true, there's no mistake.

english_meaning: absolutely true; definitely true; undoubtedly true
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常真实，确实可靠。
explanation_english: Describes something that is absolutely true, reliable, and without a doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢中咗六合彩，千真萬確㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, cin1 zan1 maan6 kok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他中了彩票，千真万确的。
examples.english_sentence: He said he won the lottery, it's absolutely true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋親眼見到佢偷嘢，千真萬確，冇講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 can1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 tau1嘢, cin1 zan1 maan6 kok3, mou5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们亲眼看见他偷东西，千真万确，没有说谎。
examples.english_sentence: We saw him stealing with our own eyes, it's absolutely true, we aren't lying.

english_meaning: by all means; be sure to; whatever you do; absolutely must; don't ever
explanation_mandarin: 表示千万、一定。强调语气，提醒对方务必做到或切勿发生。
explanation_english: Used to emphasize the importance of doing or not doing something; indicates 'by all means', 'be sure to', 'absolutely must', or 'don't ever'. It's a strong reminder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好唔記得帶鎖匙啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要忘记带钥匙啊。
examples.english_sentence: By all means, don't forget to bring your keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever you do, don't trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈要小心啲啊，嗰度好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3, go2 dou6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一定要小心点啊，那里很滑。
examples.english_sentence: Be sure to be careful, it's very slippery there.

english_meaning: Millennium, the year 2000
explanation_mandarin: 指新千年，通常特指2000年。
explanation_english: Refers to the new millennium, usually specifically referring to the year 2000.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千禧年嗰陣時，好多人都驚電腦會出現千年蟲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 hei1 nin4 go2 zan6 si4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 geng1 din6 nou5 wui5 ceot1 hin3 cin1 nin4 cung4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在千禧年的时候，很多人都担心电脑会出现千年虫问题。
examples.english_sentence: During the millennium year, many people were worried that computers would have the Y2K bug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千禧世代嘅人好習慣用科技產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 hei1 sai3 dai6 ge3 jan4 hou2 gwaak3 gwaan3 yung6 fo1 gei6 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千禧世代的人很习惯用科技产品。
examples.english_sentence: Millennials are very used to using technology products.

english_meaning: eternity; long time; ages; era
explanation_mandarin: 名词时指时间长久，形容词时指久远的，时代的。
explanation_english: As a noun, it refers to a long period of time; as an adjective, it describes something long-lasting or referring to an era.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功績會流傳千秋萬世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 jik1 wui5 lau4 cyun4 cin1 cau1 maan6 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功绩会流传千秋万代。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements will be remembered for all time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個建築設計真係千秋傑作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gin3 zuk1 sat3 gai3 zan1 hai6 cin1 cau1 git6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个建筑设计真是千秋杰作。
examples.english_sentence: This architectural design is truly a masterpiece for the ages.

english_meaning: for all eternity; for generations to come; forever and ever
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常久远，延续到无穷的未来。常用于赞美功德或事业的永恒。
explanation_english: Describes a very long period of time, extending into an infinite future. Often used to praise the eternity of achievements or undertakings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望呢個傳統文化可以千秋萬世噉流傳落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ni1 go3 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 ho2 ji5 cin1 cau1 maan6 sai3 gam2 lau4 cyun4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这个传统文化可以千秋万代地流传下去。
examples.english_sentence: I hope that this traditional culture can be passed down for all eternity.

english_meaning: stereotyped, following the same pattern, monotonous, all the same
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物形式陈旧、呆板，没有变化。
explanation_english: Describes something as being outdated, rigid, and lacking variation; stereotyped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲戲劇情節千篇一律，睇到悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hei3 kek6 cing4 zit3 cin1 pin1 jat1 leot6, tai2 dou3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些戏剧的情节千篇一律，看得都腻了。
examples.english_sentence: The plots of these dramas are all the same, it's boring to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅設計千篇一律，冇乜新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 cit3 gai3 cin1 pin1 jat1 leot6, mou5 mat1 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的设计千篇一律，没什么新意。
examples.english_sentence: Their designs are all the same, there's nothing new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間間餐廳嘅menu都差唔多，真係千篇一律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 menu dou1 caa1 m4 do1, zan1 hai6 cin1 pin1 jat1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每家餐厅的菜单都差不多，真是千篇一律。
examples.english_sentence: Every restaurant's menu is almost the same, it's really monotonous.

english_meaning: kilometer; kilometre
explanation_mandarin: 长度单位，等于一千米。
explanation_english: A unit of length equal to one thousand meters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條隧道有兩千米咁長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 jau5 loeng5 cin1 mai5 gam3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条隧道有两千米那么长。
examples.english_sentence: This tunnel is two kilometers long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋跑咗五千米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 paau2 zo2 ng5 cin1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们跑了五千米。
examples.english_sentence: We ran five kilometers.

english_meaning: thousands of strands; countless connections; intricate relationship
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，错综复杂，像无数条丝线一样纠缠在一起。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where relationships are very close, intricate, and complex, like countless strands of silk tangled together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅關係，千絲萬縷，好難講得清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, cin1 si1 maan6 leu5, hou2 naan4 gong2 dak1 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的关系，千丝万缕，很难说得清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between them is so intricate that it's hard to explain clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅來龍去脈，千絲萬縷，我一時之間都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6, cin1 si1 maan6 leu5, ngo5 jat1 si4 zi1 gaan1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的来龙去脉，千丝万缕，我一时之间都不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: The ins and outs of this matter are so complex that I don't know what to do for the time being.

mandarin_meaning: 各种各样; 千方百计
english_meaning: In every possible way; by all means; various kinds
explanation_mandarin: 表示多种多样，形容数量多或者方式多，常常用于表示努力去做某事或者面对各种不同的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates variety, describing a large number or numerous ways. It is often used to express trying hard to do something or facing various different situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我千般請求佢都唔肯幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cin1 bun1 cing2 kau4 keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我千方百计地请求他，他都不肯帮我。
examples.english_sentence: I pleaded with him in every possible way, but he still refused to help me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢千般唔願意都好，都一定要去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin1 bun1 m4 wun1 ji3 dou1 hou2, dou1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使他万般不愿意，也一定要去。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he's extremely unwilling, he still has to go.

english_meaning: by all means; absolutely; be sure to
explanation_mandarin: 表示叮嘱或强调，一定要。
explanation_english: Used to urge or emphasize that something must be done without fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出門口要千萬小心啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 jiu3 cin1 maan6 siu2 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出门一定要小心啊！
examples.english_sentence: You must be very careful when you go out!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千萬唔好信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 maan6 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你千万不要相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: You absolutely must not believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅機會千萬唔好錯過啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gei1 wui6 cin1 maan6 m4 hou2 co3 gwo3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的机会千万不要错过啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't miss this opportunity for anything!

english_meaning: cheating techniques, scamming tricks, deception
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博或其他场合中使用的欺骗手段、作弊技巧。也泛指各种骗人的伎俩。
explanation_english: Refers to cheating techniques or scamming tricks used in gambling or other situations. It can also refer to various deceptive tactics or schemes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢成日用千術，梗係贏錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 sing4 jat6 yung6 cin1 seot6, gang2 hai6 wing4 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱总是用骗术，当然赢钱啦。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses cheating techniques when gambling, of course he wins money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住用千術呃人，好快會俾人發現㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 yung6 cin1 seot6 aak1 jan4, hou2 faai3 wui5 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想着用骗术骗人，很快会被人发现的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about using scamming tricks to deceive people, you'll be discovered quickly.

english_meaning: Thousands of words; countless words
explanation_mandarin: 形容要说的话非常多，也指有很多话想说。
explanation_english: Describes having a great deal to say; also refers to having many things you want to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間有千言萬語都講唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 cin1 jin4 maan6 jyu5 dou1 gong2 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间有千言万语也说不完。
examples.english_sentence: We have thousands of words to say, it's impossible to finish saying them all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋分開咗咁耐，再見嗰陣時，千言萬語都唔知從何說起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan1 hoi1 zo2 gam3 noi6, zoi3 gin3 go2 zan6 si4, cin1 jin4 maan6 jyu5 dou1 bat1 zhi1 cung4 ho4 syut3 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们分开了这么久，再次见面的时候，千言万语都不知道从何说起。
examples.english_sentence: They've been separated for so long that when they meet again, they don't know where to begin with all the things they want to say.

english_meaning: ever-changing; constantly changing; kaleidoscopic; myriad changes
explanation_mandarin: 形容变化极多，呈现出各种不同的形态或状态。
explanation_english: Describes something that changes constantly and in many ways, presenting various forms or states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界千變萬化，我哋要不斷學習先至可以跟得上時代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 cin1 bin3 maan6 faa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 hok6 zaap6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gan1 dak1 soeng5 si4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界千变万化，我们要不断学习才可以跟得上时代。
examples.english_sentence: This world is ever-changing, we need to keep learning to keep up with the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技千變萬化，演咩角色都好似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 cin1 bin3 maan6 faa3, jin2 me1 gok3 sik1 dou1 hou2 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技千变万化，演什么角色都像。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills are ever-changing, he looks like any character he plays.

english_meaning: Pure gold, 24K gold
explanation_mandarin: 指纯度很高的黄金，通常指含金量达到99.9%或以上的黄金。
explanation_english: Refers to gold with a very high purity, usually referring to gold with a gold content of 99.9% or more. Commonly known as 24K gold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽生日，我買咗條千足金嘅頸鏈俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 saang1 jat6, ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 cin1 zuk1 gam1 ge3 geng2 lin2 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈生日，我买了条纯金的项链给她。
examples.english_sentence: It's my mother's birthday, so I bought her a 24K gold necklace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻千足金戒指睇落好閃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 cin1 zuk1 gam1 gaaai3 zi2 tai2 lok6 hou2 sim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这枚纯金戒指看起来很闪耀。
examples.english_sentence: This 24K gold ring looks very shiny.

english_meaning: a large army; a vast army; a mighty force
explanation_mandarin: 形容军队阵容强大或声势浩大。
explanation_english: Describes a large army, or the powerful momentum of a large force. Can also be used figuratively to describe a situation involving a large number of people or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好似千軍萬馬噉湧入商場搶購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 cin1 gwan1 maan6 maa5 gam2 jung2 jap6 soeng1 coeng4 coeng2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们好像千军万马一样涌入商场抢购。
examples.english_sentence: They rushed into the shopping mall to snap up bargains like a vast army.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對住千軍萬馬嘅競爭者，佢仍然充滿信心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 zyu6 cin1 gwan1 maan6 maa5 ge3 ging6 zang1 ze2, keoi5 jing4 jin4 cung1 mun5 seon3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对着千军万马的竞争者，他仍然充满信心。
examples.english_sentence: Despite facing a massive number of competitors, he is still full of confidence.

mandarin_meaning: 千载难逢 (qiān zǎi nán féng)
english_meaning: Once in a blue moon; a rare opportunity; very hard to come by
explanation_mandarin: 形容机会极其难得，一千年也难碰到一次。比喻机会极其稀少，非常难得。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely rare opportunity, something that only happens once in a thousand years. It's a metaphor for opportunities that are extremely rare and precious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個千載難逢嘅機會，你一定要好好把握呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cin1 zoi2 naan4 fung4 ge3 gei1 wui2, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 baa2 ak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个千载难逢的机会，你一定要好好把握啊！
examples.english_sentence: This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, you must seize it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅投資機會千載難逢，唔好錯過啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 tau4 zi1 gei1 wui2 cin1 zoi2 naan4 fung4, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的投资机会千载难逢，不要错过啊。
examples.english_sentence: This investment opportunity is a once-in-a-lifetime chance, don't miss it.

synonyms: 百年不遇 (baak3 nin4 bat1 jyu6)

english_meaning: to go through untold hardships; after all kinds of hardships; to suffer every kind of hardship
explanation_mandarin: 形容经历非常多的艰难困苦。
explanation_english: Describes experiencing a great many difficulties and hardships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋千辛萬苦，終於都完成咗呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cin1 san1 maan6 fu2, zung1 jyu1 dou1 waan4 sing4 zo2 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们历经千辛万苦，终于完成了这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We went through all kinds of hardships, and finally we completed this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢千辛萬苦咁供個仔讀大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin1 san1 maan6 fu2 gam2 gung1 go3 zai2 duk6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他千辛万苦地供儿子读大学。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered all kinds of hardships to support his son's university education.

jyutping: cin1 lei5 zi1 hang4, si2 jyu1 zuk1 haa6
english_meaning: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻任何伟大的事业都是从最基础开始的。强调从小处着手，逐步积累，才能最终成功。
explanation_english: This idiom means that any great undertaking begins with a single step. It emphasizes starting from the basics, accumulating gradually, and eventually achieving success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住一步登天，千里之行，始於足下，慢慢嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1, cin1 lei5 zi1 hang4, si2 jyu1 zuk1 haa6, maan6 maan2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着一步登天，千里之行，始于足下，慢慢来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about achieving success overnight. A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, take it slowly.

english_meaning: Clairvoyant, one with extraordinary vision; the name of a Taoist deity with the power of far-sightedness.
explanation_mandarin: 传说中具有能看到千里之外景象的能力的人或神仙。在粤语中，多指眼力好，能观察到很远的地方或很细微的事物。也指神话人物千里眼。
explanation_english: A mythical figure or deity said to have the ability to see things thousands of miles away. In Cantonese, it often refers to someone with good eyesight who can observe things far away or very subtle details. Also refers to the mythological figure Qianliyan (Thousand-Mile Eyes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁遠都睇到，真係千里眼咁喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jyun5 dou1 tai2 dou2, zan1 hai6 cin1 lei5 ngaan5 gam2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么远都能看到，真是千里眼啊！
examples.english_sentence: You can see from so far away, you're like someone with a thousand-mile eye!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似千里眼咁，乜都睇得一清二楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 cin1 lei5 ngaan5 gam2, mat1 dou1 tai2 dak1 jat1 cing1 ji6 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像千里眼一样，什么都看得一清二楚。
examples.english_sentence: He's like someone with a thousand-mile eye, he can see everything clearly.

english_meaning: From afar; from a great distance; a long way off
explanation_mandarin: 形容路途遥远。
explanation_english: Describes a long and arduous journey or a great distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢千里迢迢噉由美國返嚟探你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin1 lei5 tiu4 tiu4 gam2 jau4 mei5 gwok3 faan1 lai4 taam3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他千里迢迢地从美国回来探望你。
examples.english_sentence: He came all the way from America to visit you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗買到呢個限量版嘅玩具，我千里迢迢去咗日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 maai5 dou2 ni1 go3 haan6 loeng6 baan2 ge3 wun6 geoi6, ngo5 cin1 lei5 tiu4 tiu4 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了买到这个限量版的玩具，我千里迢迢去了日本。
examples.english_sentence: In order to buy this limited edition toy, I traveled a long way to Japan.

cantonese: 千里送鵝毛，物輕情義重
jyutping: cin1 lei5 sung3 ngo4 mou4, mat6 hing1 cing4 ji6 zung6
english_meaning: A small gift can carry great meaning; it's the thought that counts.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻礼物虽然微薄，但情意深重。
explanation_english: This idiom means that although a gift may be small or inexpensive, the sentiment behind it is of great importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然呢份禮物唔係好貴，但係千里送鵝毛，物輕情義重啊嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 m4 hai6 hou2 gwai3, daan6 hai6 cin1 lei5 sung3 ngo4 mou4, mat6 hing1 cing4 ji6 zung6 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这份礼物不是很贵，但是礼轻情意重嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Although this gift isn't very expensive, it's the thought that counts.

jyutping: chin1 lei5 daat6 kap6 do1 baa1 go1
english_meaning: Trinidad and Tobago
explanation_mandarin: 一个位于加勒比海南部，靠近委内瑞拉海岸的岛国。
explanation_english: An island country in the southern Caribbean, off the coast of Venezuela.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講千里達及多巴哥嘅嘉年華好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 chin1 lei5 daat6 kap6 do1 baa1 go1 ge3 ga1 nin4 waa4 hou2 cheut1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说特立尼达和多巴哥的嘉年华很有名。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that Trinidad and Tobago's Carnival is very famous.

english_meaning: A talent; a gifted person; (lit.) a horse that can run a thousand li in a day
explanation_mandarin: 比喻有才能的人，也指才能出众的人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a talented and capable person, someone who stands out for their abilities. Refers to a horse that is capable of running a thousand li (a Chinese unit of distance) in a day, symbolizing exceptional speed and ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就咁叻，真係千里馬嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 gam3 lek1, zan1 hai6 cin1 lei5 maa5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就这么厉害，真是千里马啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so capable at such a young age, he's truly a talented individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話要發掘公司嘅千里馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 faat3 kyut3 gung1 si1 ge3 cin1 lei5 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要发掘公司的千里马。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said they want to discover the talented people within the company.

english_meaning: A thousand gold coins; daughter of a rich family; precious, valuable
explanation_mandarin: 原本指很多金钱，后来常用作形容富贵人家的女儿，或形容非常贵重的东西。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a large amount of money. It is often used to describe the daughter of a wealthy family or something that is very precious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係李生嘅千金小姐，當然唔憂柴米啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lei5 saang1 ge3 cin1 gam1 siu2 ze2, dong1 jin4 m4 yau1 caai4 mai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是李先生的千金小姐，当然不愁吃穿了。
examples.english_sentence: She is Mr. Li's daughter from a rich family, of course, she doesn't have to worry about food and clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間係千金難買㗎，要好好珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 hai6 cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 gaa3, jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间是千金难买的，要好好珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: Time is precious and can't be bought with money, you must cherish it.

english_meaning: rich girl, daughter of a wealthy family
explanation_mandarin: 指富贵人家出身的女儿，通常指未经世事的年轻女子。
explanation_english: Refers to a daughter born into a wealthy family, usually implying a young woman who is naive and inexperienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企咁有錢，咪係千金小姐囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 gam3 jau5 cin2, mai6 hai6 cin1 gam1 siu2 ze2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她家这么有钱，当然是千金小姐了。
examples.english_sentence: Her family is so rich, of course she's a rich girl.

jyutping: cin1 gam1 siu2 je2 dong3 aa1 waan4 maai6
english_meaning: To sell a wealthy young lady as a servant; To seriously undervalue someone or something; To waste talent or resources.
explanation_mandarin: 形容把原本价值很高的人或事物，当作低贱的东西来对待，白白浪费。
explanation_english: Describes treating someone or something of high value as something worthless, thus wasting them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾佢做埋啲咁低賤嘅嘢，咪即係千金小姐當丫鬟賣囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 keoi5 zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 dai1 zin6 ge3 je5, mai1 zik1 hai6 cin1 gam1 siu2 je2 dong3 aa1 waan4 maai6 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你让她做这么低贱的事情，不就是把千金小姐当丫鬟卖吗！
examples.english_sentence: You're having her do such demeaning things, isn't that like selling a rich young lady as a servant!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司咁樣用佢哋啲人才，根本就係千金小姐當丫鬟賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam2 joeng2 jung6 keoi5 dei6 di1 jan4 coi4, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 cin1 gam1 siu2 je2 dong3 aa1 waan4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司这样用他们的人才，根本就是把千金小姐当丫鬟卖。
examples.english_sentence: The way this company utilizes their talent is essentially selling a rich young lady as a servant.

jyutping: cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 hoeng3 naam4 lau2
english_meaning: A south-facing house is worth more than a thousand pieces of gold (difficult to buy).  It's extremely desirable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容坐北朝南的房屋非常珍贵，难以用金钱买到。因为朝南的房屋采光好，冬暖夏凉，住起来舒适。
explanation_english: Describes how valuable a south-facing house is, to the point that it is difficult to buy even with a thousand pieces of gold. South-facing houses have good sunlight, are warm in winter and cool in summer, making them comfortable to live in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港地，千金難買向南樓，有錢都未必搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dei6, cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 hoeng3 naam4 lau2, jau5 cin2 dou1 mei6 bit1 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，千金难买朝南的房子，有钱都不一定能找到。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, a south-facing house is hard to buy even with a lot of money; you might not even find one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋雖然舊咗啲，但係向南，真係千金難買向南樓㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 seoi1 jin4 gau6 zo2 di1, daan6 hai6 hoeng3 naam4, zan1 hai6 cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 hoeng3 naam4 lau2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家房子虽然旧了一点，但是朝南，真是千金难买朝南的房子啊！
examples.english_sentence: Although our house is a bit old, it faces south, it really is a south-facing house that's hard to buy!

jyutping: cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 sam1 tau4 hou2
mandarin_meaning: 千金难买心头好 (qiān jīn nán mǎi xīntóuhǎo)
english_meaning: A treasure you love is priceless; what one truly loves is hard to find even with a fortune.
explanation_mandarin: 形容自己非常喜爱的东西，就算用再多的钱也难以买到。强调个人喜好的价值。
explanation_english: Describes something that one deeply loves or treasures, suggesting that its value is beyond monetary worth and that it is difficult to acquire something so perfectly suited to one's tastes even with great wealth. It highlights the importance of personal preference and emotional value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻古董錶我好鍾意㗎，千金難買心頭好嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 dung2 biu1 ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 gaa3, cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 sam1 tau4 hou2 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢这只古董表，毕竟千金难买心头好啊。
examples.english_sentence: I really love this antique watch. After all, you can't buy what your heart desires with any amount of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢部車唔係最貴，但係佢好錫住，千金難買心頭好，佢覺得好就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 bou6 ce1 m4 hai6 zeoi3 gwai3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hou2 sek3 zyu6, cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 sam1 tau4 hou2, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他的车不是最贵的，但是他很珍惜，千金难买心头好，他觉得好就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Although his car isn't the most expensive, he cherishes it. You can't buy what your heart desires; if he likes it, that's all that matters.

english_meaning: hairbreadth escape; imminent peril; a very close call
explanation_mandarin: 比喻情况非常危急，就像一根头发挂着千钧重物一样。形容极其危险。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely dangerous situation, like a thousand catties hanging by a single hair.  It means a situation where one is very close to disaster or danger, a hair's breadth away from calamity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車差啲就撞到佢，真係千鈞一髮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 caa1 di1 zau6 zong6 dou2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 cin1 gwan1 jat1 faat3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车差点就撞到他了，真是千钧一发呀！
examples.english_sentence: The car almost hit him, it was a hairbreadth escape!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做真係好冒險，成件事千鈞一髮，唔小心就會失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou6 him2, sing4 gin6 si6 cin1 gwan1 jat1 faat3, m4 siu2 sam1 zau6 wui5 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做真的很冒险，整件事千钧一发，不小心就会失败。
examples.english_sentence: What he's doing is very risky; the whole thing is a very close call, he'll fail if he's not careful.

english_meaning: To be tempered and forged thousands of times; severely tempered; well-tested and refined.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻经过多次艰苦的锻炼和考验。
explanation_english: Describes something that has been through many hardships, trials, and refining processes, resulting in something stronger and more resilient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅友誼經歷過好多考驗，真係千錘百錬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jau5 ji5 ging1 lik6 gwo3 hou2 do1 haau2 jim6, zan1 hai6 cin1 ceoi4 baak3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的友谊经历了很多考验，真是千锤百炼。
examples.english_sentence: Their friendship has been through many trials, it is truly well-tested and refined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計經歷咗千錘百錬，先至可以咁完美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 ging1 lik6 zo2 cin1 ceoi4 baak3 lin6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gam3 jyun4 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计经过了千锤百炼，才可以这么完美。
examples.english_sentence: This design has undergone many refinements before it could be so perfect.

english_meaning: to temper repeatedly (metals); to undergo repeated trials; well-forged; highly seasoned; thoroughly disciplined; well-honed
explanation_mandarin: 比喻经历多次艰苦斗争的锻炼和考验。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes something or someone who has been through numerous hardships, trials, and tribulations, resulting in them becoming stronger and more resilient. Similar to metal being repeatedly hammered and forged to achieve its best form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意志千錘百鍊，唔會輕易放棄嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yi3 zi3 cin1 ceoi4 baak3 lin6, m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意志千锤百炼，不会轻易放弃的。
examples.english_sentence: His will is well-forged, he won't give up easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅磨練，佢嘅演技已經千錘百鍊，爐火純青。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 mo4 lin6, keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei3 ji5 ging1 cin1 ceoi4 baak3 lin6, lou4 fo2 seon4 ceng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的磨练，他的演技已经千锤百炼，炉火纯青。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of honing, his acting skills have been thoroughly refined, reaching perfection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲古董刀劍，千錘百鍊，非常珍貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gu2 dung2 dou1 gim3, cin1 ceoi4 baak3 lin6, fei1 soeng4 zan1 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些古董刀剑，千锤百炼，非常珍贵。
examples.english_sentence: These antique swords, forged repeatedly, are very precious.

english_meaning: absolutely wrong; totally wrong; all the fault
explanation_mandarin: 表示承认错误，承担责任，强调错误非常严重，一切都是自己的错。
explanation_english: An idiom expressing deep remorse and admission of fault, emphasizing that the mistake is entirely one's own responsibility and is very serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千錯萬錯都係我唔啱，我唔應該咁樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 co3 maan6 co3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 m4 ngaam1, ngo5 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千错万错都是我的错，我不应该这样做。
examples.english_sentence: It's entirely my fault, I shouldn't have done it that way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事搞成咁，千錯萬錯都係我個決定錯咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si2 gaau2 sing4 gam2, cin1 co3 maan6 co3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 go3 kyut3 ding6 co3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次事情变成这样，千错万错都是我的决定错了。
examples.english_sentence: The situation has become like this, it's entirely my fault for making the wrong decision.

english_meaning: thirty
explanation_mandarin: 数字，表示三十。
explanation_english: A number representing thirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年卅歲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 saa3 seoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年三十岁了。
examples.english_sentence: He is thirty years old this year.

mandarin_meaning: 上升; 升高; 晋升
english_meaning: rise; ascend; promote; litre
explanation_mandarin: （动）向上移动；提高地位或等级；（量）公制的容量单位，等于一公升。
explanation_english: (verb) to go up; to rise; to ascend; to be promoted; (noun) litre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波升起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 sing1 hei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球升起来了。
examples.english_sentence: The ball has risen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買一升牛奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 jat1 sing1 ngau4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买一升牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: Buy one litre of milk.

english_meaning: to level up, to upgrade (skill, position, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指在游戏中升级，引申指在工作、技能等方面得到提升。
explanation_english: Originally refers to leveling up in a game, and is extended to mean getting promoted, improved skills, or advancing in rank or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我努力啲做嘢，希望快啲可以升lv啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nou5 lik6 di1 zou6 je5, hei1 mong6 faai3 di1 ho2 ji5 sing1 lev1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我努力工作，希望快点可以升级。
examples.english_sentence: I'm working hard, hoping to get a promotion soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到升lv升到癲咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 sing1 lev1 sing1 dou3 din1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他玩游戏玩到升级升得疯狂了。
examples.english_sentence: He's gone crazy from leveling up so much in the game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學多啲嘢，增值自己，先可以升lv㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 do1 di1 je5, zang1 zik6 zi6 gei2, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 lev1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多学点东西，增值自己，才可以升级啊。
examples.english_sentence: Learn more things and add value to yourself, then you can level up.

english_meaning: to be promoted, to be appointed to a higher position
explanation_mandarin: 指职位得到提升，晋升到更高的职位。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of being promoted to a higher position or rank in a job or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你升任經理啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 sing1 jam6 ging1 lei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你升任经理啊！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on your promotion to manager!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力，所以老闆決定升任佢做部門主管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 sing1 jam6 keoi5 zou6 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力，所以老板决定升职他做部门主管。
examples.english_sentence: He's very hardworking, so the boss decided to promote him to head of the department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢做得好出色，相信好快就會升任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 zou6 dak1 hou2 seot1 sik1, soeng1 seon3 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 sing1 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作做得非常出色，相信很快就会升职。
examples.english_sentence: He does his work very well, I believe he will be promoted soon.

english_meaning: to appreciate (in value); to increase in value; appreciation
explanation_mandarin: 指价值上涨，通常用于描述资产或货币的价值提升。
explanation_english: To increase in value, typically referring to assets, currency, or investments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買嗰隻股票升值好多呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 go2 zek3 gu2 piu3 sing1 zik6 hou2 do1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买的那支股票升值了很多啊！
examples.english_sentence: The stock I bought has appreciated a lot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢區嘅樓價升值得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 keoi1 ge3 lau2 gaa3 sing1 zik6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地区的房价升值很快。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices in this area are appreciating very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果港幣升值，出口就會受到影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gong2 bai6 sing1 zik6, ceot1 hau2 zau6 wui5 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果港币升值，出口就会受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: If the Hong Kong dollar appreciates, exports will be affected.

english_meaning: level up; upgrade; improve
explanation_mandarin: 原指网络游戏中的角色升级，等级提升。后来引申为各方面的升级、提升，例如能力、地位、生活水平等。
explanation_english: Originally referred to leveling up a character in online games. It has been extended to mean upgrading or improving in various aspects, such as abilities, status, or living standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁落力，好快就升呢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢咁lok6 lik6, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 ne1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么努力，很快就会升级的。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard, he will level up soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗好多新技能，個人升呢咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 gei1 nang4, go3 jan4 sing1 ne1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了很多新技能，个人提升了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He has learned many new skills, his personal level has improved a lot.

english_meaning: to ascend to heaven; to die (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指升上天空，常用于宗教语境。也常用来作为委婉语表示死亡。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to ascend to heaven'. Often used in a religious context. It's also commonly used as a euphemism for death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日升天喇，好可惜呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 sing1 tin1 laa3, hou2 ho2 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天去世了，真可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away yesterday, it's such a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗仔病咗好耐，終於都升天啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 zai2 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 dou1 sing1 tin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只小狗病了很久，终于都去世了。
examples.english_sentence: That puppy has been sick for a long time, and finally passed away.

english_meaning: to pursue further education; to advance to a higher level of schooling; to continue one's studies
explanation_mandarin: 指完成一个教育阶段后，进入更高一级的教育阶段学习。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of continuing one's education to a higher level after completing a previous stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年中學畢業，準備升學去大學讀醫科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zung1 hok6 bat1 jip6, zyun2 bei6 sing1 hok6 heoi3 daai6 hok6 duk6 ji1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年中学毕业，准备升学去大学读医科。
examples.english_sentence: He is graduating from secondary school this year and is preparing to go to university to study medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多家長都好關注仔女嘅升學問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 gaa1 coeng2 dou1 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3 zai2 neoi5 ge3 sing1 hok6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多家长都很关注子女的升学问题。
examples.english_sentence: Many parents are very concerned about their children's education advancement issues.

english_meaning: to be promoted in government office; to get a promotion
explanation_mandarin: 指在官场上得到晋升，职位提高。
explanation_english: Refers to being promoted in a government office, meaning one's position has been elevated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁叻，好快就會升官㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 gam3 lek1, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 sing1 gun1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作那么能干，很快就会升官的。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 在那个年代，贪污才容易升官。
examples.english_sentence: In that era, it was easier to get promoted through corruption.

english_meaning: Promotion and fortune; To get promoted and become rich; May you get promoted and become rich.
explanation_mandarin: 指仕途顺利，官运亨通，同时财富增加，生活富裕。通常作为一种祝福语。
explanation_english: A common blessing wishing someone career advancement, official promotion, and financial success. It encapsulates the desire for both increased power (promotion) and increased wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，祝你升官發財！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, zuk1 nei5 sing1 gun1 faat3 coi4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，祝你升官发财！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year, I wish you promotion and fortune!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你今年可以升官發財，萬事如意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 sing1 gun1 faat3 coi4, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你今年可以升官发财，万事如意！
examples.english_sentence: I hope you can get promoted and make a fortune this year, and that everything goes your way!

english_meaning: increase, rise, margin of increase
explanation_mandarin: 上升的幅度。指增长的数量或百分比。
explanation_english: The extent of an increase; the amount or percentage by which something increases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年樓價嘅升幅好驚人啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 lau4 gaa3 ge3 sing1 fuk1 hou2 ging1 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年房价的升幅很惊人啊。
examples.english_sentence: The increase in house prices this year is astonishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅營業額升幅超過預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jing4 jip6 ngaak2 sing1 fuk1 ciu1 gwo3 jyu6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的营业额升幅超过预期。
examples.english_sentence: The company's turnover increase exceeded expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋加咗人工，但係升幅唔係好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zo2 jan4 gung1, daan6 hai6 sing1 fuk1 m4 hai6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们涨了工资，但是升幅不是很多。
examples.english_sentence: They got a pay raise, but the increase wasn't much.

english_meaning: meager income; a small amount; a pittance
explanation_mandarin: 指很少的收入，只能勉强维持生计。也指很少的粮食或钱财。
explanation_english: Refers to a very small income that is barely enough to make a living. Also refers to a small amount of grain or money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁辛苦，都係搵得嗰少少升斗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 gam3 san1 fu2, dou1 hai6 wan2 dak1 gwo2 siu2 siu2 sing1 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么辛苦，也只能赚到一点点微薄的收入。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard, but he only earns a small pittance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 靠住呢啲升斗，根本養唔起頭家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kaau3 zyu6 ni1 di1 sing1 dau2, gan1 bun2 joeng5 m4 hei2 tau4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 靠这些微薄的收入，根本养不起家。
examples.english_sentence: With this meager income, I simply can't support a family.

english_meaning: Ordinary citizens, common people, grassroots
explanation_mandarin: 指生活在社会底层，为生计奔波的普通百姓。比喻生活困苦、平凡的小人物。
explanation_english: Refers to ordinary citizens living at the bottom of society, struggling to make a living. It implies a hard life and an unremarkable existence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港地生活艱難，好多都係升斗市民，為層樓捱生捱死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dei6 sang1 wut6 gaan1 naan4, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 sing1 dau2 si5 man4, wai4 cang4 lau2 ngaai4 sang1 ngaai4 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港生活很艰难，很多人都是小市民，为了房子拼死拼活。
examples.english_sentence: Life in Hong Kong is tough. Many are just ordinary citizens, struggling to death for an apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係一個升斗市民，每日都為咗兩餐奔波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 sing1 dau2 si5 man4, mui5 jat6 dou1 wai4 zo2 loeng5 caan1 ban1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是一个小市民，每天都为了两餐奔波。
examples.english_sentence: He's just an ordinary citizen, hustling for his daily meals.

english_meaning: raise a flag; (slang) to have an erection
explanation_mandarin: 1. 将旗帜升到旗杆顶端。2. (俚语) 指男性勃起。
explanation_english: 1. To raise a flag to the top of a flagpole. 2. (slang) To have an erection (said of a man).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早喺學校會升旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 hai2 hok6 haau6 wui5 sing1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上在学校会升旗。
examples.english_sentence: The flag will be raised at school in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話覺得自己好尷尬，因為升咗旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 gaam3 gaai3, jan1 wai6 sing1 zo2 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说觉得自己很尴尬，因为勃起了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he felt very embarrassed because he had an erection.

english_meaning: to be upgraded; to be promoted (in status or level)
explanation_mandarin: 指级别或地位得到提升。
explanation_english: Refers to an increase in level or status; to be upgraded or promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳升格咗做米芝蓮星級餐廳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing1 gaak3 zo2 zou6 mai5 zi1 lin4 sing1 kap1 caan1 teng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的餐厅升级为米其林星级餐厅了。
examples.english_sentence: His restaurant has been upgraded to a Michelin-starred restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾公司升格做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 gung1 si1 sing1 gaak3 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被公司提拔为经理。
examples.english_sentence: He was promoted to manager by the company.

english_meaning: rising trend; upward surge; bull market (in finance)
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或情况呈现上升的趋势，尤指股票市场或经济形势的良好发展。
explanation_english: Refers to an upward trend in something, especially the positive development of the stock market or the economy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近樓市好似出現升浪，好多人都急住入市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 lau4 si5 hou2 ci5 ceot1 jin6 sing1 long6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gap1 zyu6 jap6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近房地产市场好像出现了上涨趋势，很多人都急着入市。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the property market seems to be experiencing a rising trend, and many people are rushing to enter the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市升浪持續咗咁耐，要小心隨時會調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 sing1 long6 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gam3 noi6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 ceoi4 si4 wui5 tiu4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市上涨趋势持续了这么久，要小心随时会调整。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market's upward surge has lasted so long, you have to be careful of a possible correction at any time.

english_meaning: to heat up; to warm up; to rise in temperature; to intensify (e.g., emotions, relations)
explanation_mandarin: 温度升高；比喻关系或气氛变得热烈。
explanation_english: Literally means to increase in temperature. Figuratively, it refers to a situation or relationship becoming warmer, more intense, or heated up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣開始升溫，好快就熱到飛起啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 hoi1 chi2 sing1 wan1, hou2 faai3 zau6 jit6 dou3 fei1 hei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气开始升温，很快就会热到不行了。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has started to warm up recently, it will be unbearably hot soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅關係升溫得好快，唔知會唔會一齊呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 sing1 wan1 dak1 hou2 faai3, m4 zi1 wui5 m4 wui5 jat1 cai4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的关系升温得很快，不知道会不会在一起呢？
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is heating up quickly, I wonder if they'll get together?

english_meaning: to heat up, to warm up, to increase in temperature; to escalate (situation, relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 温度升高；比喻关系或局势变得紧张或激烈。
explanation_english: To increase in temperature; metaphorically, to describe a relationship or situation becoming more intense or heated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排天氣開始升溫，熱咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 tin1 hei3 hoi1 chi2 sing1 wan1, jit6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气开始升温，热了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has started to heat up recently; it's much hotter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嗌交之後，關係即刻升溫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 aai3 gaau1 zi1 hau6, gwaan1 hai6 zik1 hak1 sing1 wan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个吵架之后，关系立刻升温。
examples.english_sentence: After the two of them argued, their relationship immediately became heated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近樓市升溫，好多人搶住買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 lau4 si5 sing1 wan1, hou2 do1 jan4 coeng2 zyu6 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近楼市升温，很多人抢着买房。
examples.english_sentence: The property market has been heating up recently; many people are rushing to buy apartments.

english_meaning: to heat up, to warm up, to increase in temperature
explanation_mandarin: 指温度升高，变得更热。
explanation_english: Refers to an increase in temperature, becoming hotter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排天氣升溫，熱到人都癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 tin1 hei3 sing1 wan1, jit6 dou3 jan4 dou1 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气升温，热得人都疯了。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been heating up lately, it's so hot that it drives people crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯要慢慢升溫先夠入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 jiu3 maan6 maan2 sing1 wan1 sin1 gau3 jap6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲汤要慢慢升温才够入味。
examples.english_sentence: When making soup, it needs to heat up slowly to allow the flavors to develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係開始升溫，成日一齊出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hoi1 chi2 sing1 wan1, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 cheot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系开始升温，经常一起出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship started to heat up, and they often go out to play together.

english_meaning: to move up a class/grade; to be promoted (at school or work)
explanation_mandarin: （学校）升级；（工作）升职。
explanation_english: (School) To move up a grade; (Work) To be promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年考得好好，可以升班啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2, ho2 ji5 sing1 baan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年考得很好，可以升级了。
examples.english_sentence: He did very well on his exams this year and can move up a grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做咗咁耐，終於升班喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 sing1 baan1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做了这么久，终于升职了！
examples.english_sentence: I've been working for so long, and I finally got promoted!

english_meaning: To rise sharply (stock market); To get a major promotion/boost (career or otherwise)
explanation_mandarin: 原指股市大幅上涨，现在也用来形容事业、生活等方面的显著提升或飞跃。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a sharp rise in the stock market. Now it is also used to describe a significant improvement or leap in career, life, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撈咗幾年，今年終於升球大墊，做咗經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou1 zo2 gei2 nin4, gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 sing1 kau4 daai6 din3, zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作了几年，今年终于升职加薪，当了经理。
examples.english_sentence: He worked for a few years and finally got a major promotion this year and became a manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻股票今日升球大墊，賺死我喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gu2 piu3 gam1 jat6 sing1 kau4 daai6 din3, zaan6 sei2 ngo5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支股票今天大涨，我赚翻了！
examples.english_sentence: This stock rose sharply today, I made a fortune!

english_meaning: to ascend into the sky; to take off (airplane, rocket); to be launched
explanation_mandarin: 指物体向上升到空中，通常用于描述飞机、火箭等飞行器起飞。
explanation_english: Refers to an object ascending into the sky. It is commonly used to describe the takeoff of aircraft, rockets, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機準備升空喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zeon2 bei6 sing1 hung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机准备起飞了。
examples.english_sentence: The plane is preparing to take off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻火箭成功升空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 fo2 zin2 sing4 gung1 sing1 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火箭成功发射升空。
examples.english_sentence: The rocket was successfully launched into space.

examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 yin1 faa1 sing1 hung1 zi1 hau6 hou2 leng3 aa3.

examples.english_sentence: The fireworks are very beautiful after they go up into the sky.

english_meaning: to upgrade; to promote; promotion; to escalate
explanation_mandarin: 指提升等级或质量，例如软件升级，职位晋升，情况恶化升级等。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of increasing in rank, quality, or intensity. Examples include software upgrades, job promotions, or the escalation of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年年尾有機會升級喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 nin4 mei5 jau5 gei1 wui2 sing1 gap1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年年底有机会升级呢。
examples.english_sentence: There's a chance of getting promoted at our company at the end of this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你部電腦嘅軟件要升級喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 jyun5 gin2 jiu3 sing1 gap1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你电脑的软件需要升级了。
examples.english_sentence: Your computer's software needs to be upgraded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事越搞越大，升級到國際層面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 jyut6 gaau2 jyut6 daai6, sing1 gap1 dou3 gwok3 zai3 cang4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情越闹越大，升级到国际层面。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is getting bigger and bigger, escalating to an international level.

english_meaning: to get a promotion, to be promoted
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作中得到职位上的晋升，通常伴随着更高的薪水和责任。
explanation_english: To be promoted in one's job, usually involving a higher salary and more responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，所以好快就升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力，所以很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very hardworking, so he got promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望今年可以升職加人工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1 gaa1 yan4 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望今年可以升职加薪。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can get a promotion and a raise this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你升職呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 sing1 zik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你升职啊！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on your promotion!

english_meaning: promotion; to be promoted; to raise one's voice (tone); to increase in level or status
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指职位上的晋升，级别提升。 2. 指提高说话的声调。
explanation_english: 1. To be promoted in one's job or to a higher rank. 2. To raise one's voice or tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年升調咗，做咗經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 sing1 diu6 zo2, zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年升职了，当了经理。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted this year and became a manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好升調鬧人呀，有咩嘢慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing1 diu6 naau6 jan4 aa3, jau5 me1 je5 maan6 maan2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要提高嗓门骂人啊，有什么事慢慢说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't raise your voice to scold people, let's talk things over calmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢講到升調晒，一定好激動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dou3 sing1 diu6 saai3, jat1 ding6 hou2 gik1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说起话来都提高了声调，肯定很激动。
examples.english_sentence: He raised his voice when he was talking, he must be very excited.

english_meaning: to advance to a higher level of education; to continue one's studies
explanation_mandarin: 指从一个教育阶段升到另一个更高的教育阶段，例如从小学升到中学，或者从中学升到大学。
explanation_english: Refers to progressing from one level of education to a higher level, such as from primary school to secondary school, or from secondary school to university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年中學畢業，打算升讀大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zung1 hok6 bat1 jip6, daa2 syun3 sing1 duk6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年中学毕业，打算升读大学。
examples.english_sentence: He is graduating from secondary school this year and plans to go to university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績好好，一定可以升讀到心儀嘅大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 hou2 hou2, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 sing1 duk6 dou3 sam1 ji4 ge3 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩很好，一定可以升读到心仪的大学。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are very good, he will definitely be able to get into the university he desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 升讀邊間大學好？我仲未決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 duk6 bin1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 hou2? ngo5 zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 升读哪所大学好？我还没决定。
examples.english_sentence: Which university is good to go to? I haven't decided yet.

english_meaning: promotion (in job), to get promoted
explanation_mandarin: 职位得到提升。
explanation_english: To be promoted to a higher position, or the act of being promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，好快就升遷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 chin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤奋，很快就升迁了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and got promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望可以升遷，所以好努力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing1 chin1, so2 ji5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gung1 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望能够升迁，所以很努力工作。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to get promoted, so he works very hard.

english_meaning: rise and fall; ascend and descend; fluctuate
explanation_mandarin: 指上升和下降的动作或状态；也可以表示价格、水平等上下浮动。
explanation_english: Refers to the action or state of rising and falling; can also indicate the fluctuation of prices, levels, etc.
