examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ying1 man2 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6, yan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 bun3 tong4 faan1, sai3 go3 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语说得很流利，因为他是混血儿，小时候在国外长大。
examples.english_sentence: His English is very fluent because he's Eurasian and grew up abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日叫佢做半唐番，其實好唔尊重人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi5 gin2 di1 yan4 seng4 jat6 giu3 keoi5 zou6 bun3 tong4 faan1, kei4 sat6 hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人总是叫他混血儿，其实很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: People used to always call him 'half-foreigner', which is actually very disrespectful.

english_meaning: half-cooked; undercooked; half-baked; unripe (literally and figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物煮得不够熟透，或者比喻事情做得不够完善。
explanation_english: Describes food that is undercooked, or used metaphorically to describe something that is not well-done or incomplete. Can also refer to unripe fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗飯煮到半唥鯁，好難食啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 faan6 zyu2 dou3 bun3 laang4 gang2, hou2 naan4 sik6 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗饭煮得半生不熟，很难吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: This rice is undercooked, it's hard to eat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃都仲係半唥鯁，好多細節都未諗清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 dou1 zung1 hai6 bun3 laang4 gang2, hou2 do1 sai3 zit3 dou1 mei6 naam2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划还只是半生不熟的，很多细节都还没想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is still half-baked, many details are not yet thought out clearly.

english_meaning: semicircle; half circle
explanation_mandarin: 几何学上的概念，指圆的一半。
explanation_english: A geometric shape that is half of a circle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個足球場嘅其中一邊係半圓形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zuk1 kau4 coeng4 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 bin1 hai6 bun3 jyun4 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 足球场的一侧是半圆形的。
examples.english_sentence: One side of the soccer field is a semicircle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用圓規畫咗個半圓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 jyun4 kwai1 waak6 zo2 go3 bun3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用圆规画了一个半圆。
examples.english_sentence: He drew a semicircle with a compass.

english_meaning: Half time; half of a game; halfway; incomplete; unfinished
explanation_mandarin: 指比赛的中间休息时间；比喻事情只做了一半，未完成。
explanation_english: Refers to halftime in a game or match; also used figuratively to mean halfway through something, incomplete, or unfinished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 波踢咗半場，我哋都冇入到波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bo1 tek3 zo2 bun3 coeng4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou5 jap6 dou2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球赛踢了半场，我们都没进球。
examples.english_sentence: We've played half the game and haven't scored yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project做到半場，突然冇晒funding，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project zou6 dou3 bun3 coeng4, dat6 jin4 mou5 saai3 funding, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目做到一半，突然没有了资金，真是惨。
examples.english_sentence: This project was halfway done, and suddenly there's no funding anymore. That's terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都只係行咗半場山路，仲有排先到山頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 zi2 hai6 haang4 zo2 bun3 coeng4 saan1 lou6, zung6 jau5 paai4 sin1 dou3 saan1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们才走了一半的山路，离山顶还远着呢。
examples.english_sentence: We've only walked halfway up the mountain, and we still have a long way to go to the top.

english_meaning: half the country; a significant portion (of something, not necessarily land)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻国家或事业被分割为两部分；也指占据重要的地位或份额。
explanation_english: Originally refers to half of the country's territory. Figuratively, it means that something is divided into two parts; or it signifies occupying a significant position or share of something (e.g., a market, an industry, etc.). Can also refer to a person contributing significantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司做咗咁多年，都算係半壁江山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, dou1 syun3 hai6 bun3 bik1 gong1 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司做了这么多年，也算是半壁江山了。
examples.english_sentence: He's worked at this company for so many years, you could say he's a significant figure here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心，佔咗香港點心界嘅半壁江山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1, zim3 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 dim2 sam1 gaai3 ge3 bun3 bik1 gong1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心，占据了香港点心界的半壁江山。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant accounts for a significant portion of the dim sum industry in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: midnight, middle of the night
explanation_mandarin: 指午夜时分，深夜。
explanation_english: Refers to midnight or the middle of the night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我半夜嘅時候俾啲聲嘈醒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun3 je2 ge3 si4 hau6 bei2 di1 seng1 cou4 sing2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我半夜的时候被一些声音吵醒了。
examples.english_sentence: I was woken up by some noises in the middle of the night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日半夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bun3 je2 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常半夜才回家。
examples.english_sentence: He often doesn't get home until midnight.

english_meaning: in the dead of night, in the wee hours of the morning
explanation_mandarin: 指深夜。三更：古代把一夜分为五更，每更大约两小时，三更指半夜十二点左右。
explanation_english: Refers to the deep night.  'Sam1 gaang1' (三更) refers to the third watch in the ancient Chinese system of dividing the night into five watches. Each watch lasted approximately two hours, so 'sam1 gaang1' corresponds to around midnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 半夜三更唔好嘈住人瞓覺啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun3 je6 saam1 gaang1 m4 hou2 cou4 zyu6 jan4 fan3 gaau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 半夜三更不要吵别人睡觉了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make noise and disturb people's sleep in the dead of night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日半夜三更都仲係度打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bun3 je6 saam1 gaang1 dou1 zung6 hai6 dou6 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常半夜三更还在打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He's often still playing video games in the wee hours of the morning.

mandarin_meaning: 半夜鸡叫；无事生非；胡说八道
english_meaning: cock crowing at midnight; to make a fuss over nothing; to talk nonsense
explanation_mandarin: 比喻无端生事，无事生非；也形容毫无根据，乱说一气。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a cock crowing at midnight, which is considered an unnatural and ominous event. It often means to make trouble out of nothing, to create unnecessary drama, or to talk nonsense without any basis in reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日半夜雞啼，搞到大家都唔安樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bun3 je6 gai1 tai4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 on1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天无事生非，搞得大家都不安宁。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making a fuss over nothing, making everyone uneasy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好聽佢半夜雞啼，佢講嘢冇句真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 bun3 je6 gai1 tai4, keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 geoi3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别听他胡说八道，他说话没有一句真话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense; nothing he says is true.

english_meaning: Unclear; ambiguous; not understood
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发生得突然，或者原因不明确，让人摸不着头脑。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that happens suddenly or whose cause is unclear, leaving people confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事發生得好突然，我真係半夜食黃瓜，唔知點解會咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 dak1 hou2 dat6 jin4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 bun3 je6 sik6 wong4 gwaa1, m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事发生得很突然，我真是摸不着头脑，不知道为什么会这样。
examples.english_sentence: This happened so suddenly, I'm completely baffled, I don't know why it happened like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無啦啦辭職，真係半夜食黃瓜，唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 ci4 zik1, zan1 hai6 bun3 je6 sik6 wong4 gwaa1, m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他无缘无故辞职，真是让人摸不着头脑，不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He resigned for no apparent reason, it's really baffling, I don't know what he's thinking.

english_meaning: untruthful; to make a false accusation; to cry wolf; literally, a rooster crowing at midnight
explanation_mandarin: 比喻无事生非，或指虚构事实诬告他人。也形容非常罕见或不正常的事情发生。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe someone who makes trouble out of nothing or makes false accusations against others. It also describes something very rare or abnormal happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日半夜雞啼，屈人偷佢啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bun3 je6 gai1 tai4, wat1 jan4 tau1 keoi5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是无中生有，冤枉别人偷他的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes false accusations, wrongly accusing people of stealing his things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日半夜鷄啼，搞到大家都唔安樂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 bun3 je6 gai1 tai4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 on1 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是无事生非，搞得大家都不得安宁。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always make trouble out of nothing, causing unrest for everyone.

english_meaning: half a day; a long time; quite a while
explanation_mandarin: 指一段时间，可以表示半天的时间，也可以表示很长一段时间。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time, can mean half a day, or a long time/quite a while, depending on the context. Often used to express a relatively long duration or delay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗你半天啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 bun3 tin1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等你半天了！
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for you for half a day!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗咗半天才諗到答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zo2 bun3 tin1 coi4 lam2 dou3 daap3 aan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想了半天才想到答案。
examples.english_sentence: He took quite a while to think of the answer.

mandarin_meaning: 半途而废; 悬在半空
english_meaning: To leave something unfinished; Half-finished; Hanging in mid-air; Incomplete
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情做到一半就停止，没有完成；也形容物体悬在半空中。
explanation_english: Describes something that is left unfinished or abandoned halfway. Also describes an object hanging in mid-air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都半天吊，冇乜嘢可以堅持到尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bun3 tin1 diu3, mou5 mat1 je5 ho2 ji5 gin1 ci4 dou3 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是半途而废，没有什么事情可以坚持到底。
examples.english_sentence: He always leaves things unfinished; he can't stick to anything to the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 盞燈甩咗粒螺絲，半天吊咁樣吊喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaan2 dang1 lat1 zo2 lap1 lo4 si1, bun3 tin1 diu3 gam2 joeng2 diu3 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盏灯掉了一颗螺丝，半天吊地挂在那里。
examples.english_sentence: The lamp lost a screw and is hanging there in mid-air.

synonyms: 虎頭蛇尾 (fu2 tau4 se4 mei5)
有頭無尾 (jau5 tau4 mou4 mei5)

english_meaning: semiconductor
explanation_mandarin: 一种导电能力介于导体和绝缘体之间的材料，是现代电子工业的基础。
explanation_english: A material with electrical conductivity between that of a conductor and an insulator, forming the basis of modern electronics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港政府大力支持半導體產業嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zing3 fu2 daai6 lik6 zhi1 chi4 bun3 dou6 tai2 chan2 jip6 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港政府大力支持半导体产业的发展。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong government strongly supports the development of the semiconductor industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司專門生產半導體元件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 sang1 caan2 bun3 dou6 tai2 jyun4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司专门生产半导体元件。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in manufacturing semiconductor components.

english_meaning: Mid-Levels (a residential area in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港岛中环至太平山之间的住宅区，地势较高，环境优美，是香港著名的豪宅区。
explanation_english: Mid-Levels is a residential area on Hong Kong Island, located between Central and Victoria Peak. It is known for its elevated position, pleasant environment, and high-end residential properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺半山，所以環境好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 bun3 saan1, so2 ji5 waan4 ging2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在半山，所以环境很好。
examples.english_sentence: They live in Mid-Levels, so the environment is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 半山啲樓好貴㗎，唔係普通人住得起㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun3 saan1 di1 lau2 hou2 gwai3 gaa3, m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 zyu6 dak1 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 半山的房子很贵，不是普通人住得起的。
examples.english_sentence: Apartments in Mid-Levels are very expensive; ordinary people can't afford to live there.

english_meaning: Midway up a mountain; halfway up the hill
explanation_mandarin: 指山的一半高度的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to the halfway point or the middle altitude of a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行到半山腰就已經好攰喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 bun3 saan1 jiu1 zau6 ji5 ging1 hou2 gu3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走到半山腰就已经很累了。
examples.english_sentence: We were already very tired when we reached halfway up the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋喺半山腰，風景一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hai2 bun3 saan1 jiu1, fung1 ging2 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子在半山腰，风景一流。
examples.english_sentence: The house is located halfway up the hill, with first-class scenery.

english_meaning: peninsula
explanation_mandarin: 一块陆地，三面环水，一面连接大陆。
explanation_english: A piece of land almost surrounded by water or projecting out into a body of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 九龍半島嘅夜景好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau2 lung4 bun3 dou2 ge3 je6 ging2 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 九龙半岛的夜景很美。
examples.english_sentence: The night view of Kowloon Peninsula is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港半島酒店好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 bun3 dou2 zau2 dim3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港半岛酒店很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The Peninsula Hotel in Hong Kong is very famous.

english_meaning: The Peninsula Hotel
explanation_mandarin: 香港著名的豪华酒店，位于九龙尖沙咀。
explanation_english: A famous luxury hotel in Hong Kong, located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去半島酒店食 high tea 啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 bun3 dou2 zau2 dim3 sik6 hai1 ti1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去半岛酒店吃下午茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the Peninsula Hotel for high tea tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講半島酒店嘅服務好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 bun3 dou2 zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说半岛酒店的服务很好。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that the service at the Peninsula Hotel is very good.

english_meaning: work-study
explanation_mandarin: 一边工作，一边读书。
explanation_english: To work part-time while studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗減輕屋企負擔，決定半工讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gaam2 hing1 uk1 kei2 fu6 daam1, kyut3 ding6 bun3 gung1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了减轻家里的负担，他决定半工半读。
examples.english_sentence: In order to reduce the burden on his family, he decided to work-study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家好多大學生都會半工讀，累積工作經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 daai6 hok6 sang1 dou1 wui5 bun3 gung1 duk6, leoi5 zik1 gung1 zok3 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多大学生都会半工半读，积累工作经验。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many university students work-study to accumulate work experience.

english_meaning: radius
explanation_mandarin: 从圆心到圆周上任意一点的线段，也指线段的长度。
explanation_english: The distance from the center of a circle or sphere to any point on its circumference or surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個圓嘅半徑係五厘米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyun4 ge3 bun3 ging3 hai6 ng5 lim4 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个圆的半径是五厘米。
examples.english_sentence: The radius of this circle is five centimeters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋講到嘅影響範圍，以佢屋企為中心，半徑五公里。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gong2 dou3 ge3 ying2 heong2 faan6 wai4, yi5 keoi5 uk1 kei2 wai4 zung1 sam1, bun3 ging3 ng5 gung1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说的影响范围，以他家为中心，半径五公里。
examples.english_sentence: The area of impact they mentioned is a five-kilometer radius around his house.

english_meaning: skirt (especially a short or knee-length skirt)
explanation_mandarin: 指长度在膝盖或以上的裙子，可以是短裙或及膝裙。
explanation_english: Refers to a skirt that is at or above the knee, can be a short skirt or a knee-length skirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着咗條好靚嘅半截裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 hou2 leng3 ge3 bun3 zit6 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一条很好看的半截裙。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a very pretty skirt today.

english_meaning: to half-heartedly refuse; to feign reluctance; to give in reluctantly
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面上推辞，实际上是同意或顺从。也形容犹豫不决的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone superficially refuses something but actually agrees or complies. It can also describe a hesitant or indecisive manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路話唔想去，但最後都係半推半就咁跟埋我哋去咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 waa6 m4 soeng2 heoi3, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 bun3 teoi1 bun3 zau6 gam2 gan1 maai4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直说不想去，但最后还是半推半就地跟我们去了。
examples.english_sentence: He kept saying he didn't want to go, but in the end, he reluctantly came with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿妹收到花嗰陣，半推半就咁收咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 mui2 sau1 dou2 faa1 go2 zan6, bun3 teoi1 bun3 zau6 gam2 sau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妹妹收到花的时候，半推半就地收下了。
examples.english_sentence: When the younger sister received the flowers, she accepted them with feigned reluctance.

english_meaning: half; half the number; fifty percent
explanation_mandarin: 一半的数量。指数量的一半。
explanation_english: Half the number; referring to half of a quantity or number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投票結果出咗，超過半數人贊成呢個方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 piu3 git3 gwo2 ceot1 zo2, ciu1 gwo3 bun3 sou3 jan4 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投票结果出来了，超过半数人赞成这个方案。
examples.english_sentence: The voting results are out; more than half of the people support this proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅員工半數以上都係後生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 waan4 gung1 bun3 sou3 ji5 soeng6 dou1 hai6 hau6 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的员工半数以上都是年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: More than half of the employees in our company are young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅學生半數都考到大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hok6 sang1 bun3 sou3 dou1 haau2 dou3 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的学生半数都考上了大学。
examples.english_sentence: Half of their students got into university.

english_meaning: six of one, half a dozen of the other; essentially the same; no real difference
explanation_mandarin: 旧制一斤等于十六两，半斤等于八两。比喻两者一样，没有差别。
explanation_english: Literally, half a catty equals eight taels. (One catty used to be equal to sixteen taels). It means that two things are essentially the same or of equal value/importance; there's no real difference between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅畫功半斤八両啫，邊個叻啲都好難講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leong5 go3 ge3 waa2 gung1 bun3 gan1 baat3 loeng2 ze1, bin1 go3 lek1 di1 dou1 hou2 naan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的画功半斤八两，很难说谁更厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Their drawing skills are six of one, half a dozen of the other; it's hard to say who's better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間間大學都差唔多，半斤八両啦，揀邊間都冇所謂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 dou1 caa1 m4 do1, bun3 gan1 baat3 loeng2 laa1, gaan2 bin1 gaan1 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每间大学都差不多，半斤八两，选哪间都无所谓。
examples.english_sentence: Every university is about the same, six of one, half a dozen of the other; it doesn't matter which one you choose.

english_meaning: six of one, half a dozen of the other; no difference
explanation_mandarin: 旧制一斤等于十六两，所以半斤和八两相等。比喻彼此一样，没有多大差别，一般指不好的方面。
explanation_english: Literally, half a catty (a unit of weight) equals eight taels (another unit of weight, where one catty equals sixteen taels). Figuratively, it means there is no significant difference between two things, often used in a negative context to indicate that two things are equally bad or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個嘅表現都差唔多，咪又係半斤八兩囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 ge3 biu2 hin3 dou1 caa1 m4 do1, mai1 jau6 hai6 bun3 gan1 baat3 loeng2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的表现都差不多，还不是半斤八两。
examples.english_sentence: Their performances are about the same, they are just six of one, half a dozen of the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間間公司都差唔多，半斤八兩，轉去邊間都一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 caa1 m4 do1, bun3 gan1 baat3 loeng2, zyun2 heoi3 bin1 gaan1 dou1 jat1 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每家公司都差不多，半斤八两，换去哪家都一样。
examples.english_sentence: Every company is pretty much the same, six of one, half a dozen of the other, it's the same no matter which company you switch to.

english_meaning: half a day; a long time; quite a while
explanation_mandarin: （1）指半天的时间。（2）表示很长时间，相当于“好久”
explanation_english: (1) Refers to half a day's time. (2) Indicates a long time, equivalent to "a long time".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗你半日，你先至嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 bun3 jat6, nei5 sin1 zi3 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了你半天，你才来！
examples.english_sentence: I've waited for you half a day before you finally came!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵佢搵咗半日都搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 keoi5 wan2 zo2 bun3 jat6 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找他找了半天都没找到。
examples.english_sentence: I looked for him for ages but couldn't find him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咗半日，原來係咁簡單嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 zo2 bun3 jat6, jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弄了半天，原来是这么简单的。
examples.english_sentence: After all that effort, it turned out to be so simple.

english_meaning: Good afternoon
explanation_mandarin: 下午好的问候语，通常在中午到傍晚之间使用。
explanation_english: An afternoon greeting, usually used between noon and evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 半日安呀，你食咗飯未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun3 jat6 on1 aa3, nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 午安，你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Good afternoon, have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 半日安，今日天氣都幾好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun3 jat6 on1, gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 dou1 gei2 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 午安，今天天气还不错。
examples.english_sentence: Good afternoon, the weather is quite nice today.

english_meaning: half a day; morning
explanation_mandarin: 指从早上到中午的时间，即半天。
explanation_english: Refers to the time from morning to noon, i.e., half a day, typically referring to the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝起身忙咗半晝，乜嘢都未食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hei2 san1 mong4 zo2 bun3 zau3, mat1 je5 dou1 mei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上起来忙了半天，什么都没吃。
examples.english_sentence: I've been busy all morning since I woke up, and I haven't eaten anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗半晝時間嚟清潔間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 bun3 zau3 si4 gaan3 lai4 cing1 git3 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了半天的时间来清洁房间。
examples.english_sentence: He spent half a day cleaning the house.

english_meaning: a half-bucket of water; a smatterer; a person with incomplete knowledge or skills; a jack-of-all-trades, master of none
explanation_mandarin: 比喻知识或技能掌握不全面、不精通的人。装不满的水桶，稍微晃动就会发出响声，引申为那些只有半桶水的人，喜欢卖弄自己不精通的知识或技能。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who has incomplete knowledge or skills; a smatterer. Like a half-full bucket of water, which makes a lot of noise when shaken, it refers to those who only have a superficial understanding and like to show off their limited knowledge or skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾日電腦就以為自己好叻，其實咪又係半桶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 jat6 din6 nou5 zau6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, kei4 sat6 mai1 jau6 hai6 bun3 tung2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几天电脑就以为自己很厉害，其实还不是个半吊子。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he was great after learning computers for a few days, but he's actually just a smatterer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己好醒，你都係半桶水啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 seng2, nei5 dou1 hai6 bun3 tung2 seoi2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为自己很聪明，你也只是个半吊子而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're so clever, you're just a smatterer.

english_meaning: half a life; nearly dead; extremely exhausted
explanation_mandarin: 形容状态非常差，接近死亡或者非常疲惫。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being very poor, close to death, or extremely exhausted. Often used to express extreme fatigue or near-death experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日 OT 到三點，返到屋企得返半條人命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 OT dou3 saam1 dim2, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 dak1 faan1 bun3 tiu4 jan4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天加班到三点，回到家只剩半条命了。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I worked overtime until 3 AM, I was nearly dead when I got home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完馬拉松，真係好似冇咗半條人命咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 maa5 laai1 sung3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 mou5 zo2 bun3 tiu4 jan4 ming6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完马拉松，真的好像失去了半条命一样。
examples.english_sentence: After running the marathon, I really felt like I lost half my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發高燒燒到佢得返半條人命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gou1 siu1 siu1 dou3 keoi5 dak1 faan1 bun3 tiu4 jan4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发高烧烧得他只剩半条命了。
examples.english_sentence: The high fever burned him down to half a life.

english_meaning: half a life; nearly dead; severely exhausted
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常疲惫或经历过非常痛苦的事情，几乎失去生命。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme exhaustion or having undergone a harrowing experience, feeling close to death or completely drained of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日OT到凌晨三點，真係攞咗我半條命啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 OT dou3 ling4 san4 saam1 dim2, zan1 hai6 lo2 zo2 ngo5 bun3 tiu4 ming6 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天加班到凌晨三点，真的要了我的半条命啊！
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I worked overtime until 3 AM, it nearly killed me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，我好似冇咗半條命咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 hou2 ci5 mou5 zo2 bun3 tiu4 ming6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试之后，我好像失去了半条命一样。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, I felt like I lost half my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行完個山，攰到得返半條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jyun4 go3 saan1, gui6 dou3 dak1 faan1 bun3 tiu4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬完山，累得只剩下半条命。
examples.english_sentence: After hiking the mountain, I'm so tired I only have half a life left.

mandarin_meaning: 半瓶子醋 (bàn píng zi cù)
english_meaning: A person who only has a smattering of knowledge; a superficial know-it-all; a half-baked scholar
explanation_mandarin: 形容人学识不深，略懂皮毛，却喜欢炫耀自己。
explanation_english: Describes a person who only has a superficial understanding of something and likes to show off their limited knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識少少哋，就扮晒專家，真係半瓶醋噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 siu2 siu2 dei2, zau6 baan6 saai3 zhun1 gaa1, zhan1 hai6 bun3 ping4 cou3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂一点点，就装作专家，真是半瓶子醋。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, just a little bit, and pretends to be an expert. He's such a half-baked scholar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做半瓶醋，識少少就扮晒嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 bun3 ping4 cou3, sik1 siu2 siu2 zau6 baan6 saai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做半瓶子醋，懂一点点就装模作样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a superficial know-it-all, pretending to know everything when you only know a little.

synonyms: 一知半解 (jat1 zi1 bun3 gaai2)
唔湯唔水 (m4 tong1 m4 seoi2)

english_meaning: half-cooked; undercooked; also used figuratively to mean not proficient; not fully familiar with something
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是食物没有完全煮熟。也比喻不熟练、不精通。
explanation_english: Literally means half-cooked or undercooked food. Figuratively, it refers to someone being not proficient or not fully familiar with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻蛋半生熟，我唔敢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 daan2 bun3 sang1 suk6, ngo5 m4 gam2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个鸡蛋半生不熟的，我不敢吃。
examples.english_sentence: This egg is undercooked, I don't dare to eat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學廣東話都係半生熟，好多嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 dou1 hai6 bun3 sang1 suk6, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学粤语也只是半生不熟，很多东西都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese is still half-baked, he doesn't understand many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個軟件嘅操作都係半生熟，仲要多啲練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 jyun5 gin2 ge3 caau1 zok3 dou1 hai6 bun3 sang1 suk6, zung6 jiu3 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个软件的操作还不是很熟练，还需要多加练习。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very proficient in operating this software yet, I still need more practice.

mandarin_meaning: 半熟的人; 不成熟的人
english_meaning: Half-ripe; immature person; greenhorn
explanation_mandarin: 比喻涉世未深，经验不足，或者做事不够成熟稳重的人。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to someone who is inexperienced, immature, or lacks worldly experience; a greenhorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁衝動，真係半生瓜嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 cung1 dung6, zan1 hai6 bun3 sang1 gwaa1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事这么冲动，真是个半生瓜。
examples.english_sentence: He's so impulsive when he works, he's really a greenhorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好怪佢啦，佢都係半生瓜，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 bun3 sang1 gwaa1, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怪他了，他还是个半生瓜，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him, he's still immature and doesn't know anything.

english_meaning: Jack of all trades, master of none; someone who has superficial knowledge of many things but isn't an expert in anything.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人对很多事情都懂一点，但不精通，只是略懂皮毛，类似于“半桶水”。
explanation_english: Describes someone who knows a little about many things but isn't particularly skilled or knowledgeable in any one area. Similar to the English idiom 'Jack of all trades, master of none'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都識啲，但係其實都係半神科啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 sik1 di1, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 bun3 san4 fo1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都懂一点，但其实都是半桶水而已。
examples.english_sentence: He knows a little about everything, but he's really just a jack of all trades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢好叻，佢咪又係半神科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hou2 lek1, keoi5 mai1 jau6 hai6 bun3 san4 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为他很厉害，他不也是半桶水吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't think he's great, he's just a jack of all trades.

synonyms: 有限公司 (jau5 haan6 gung1 si1)

english_meaning: mid-air; halfway up; in the sky; in the air
explanation_mandarin: 指空间中的中间位置，不高不低，接近天空但未到天空的程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the middle position in space, neither high nor low, close to the sky but not reaching the sky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機喺半空度盤旋緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 hai2 bun3 hung1 dou6 pun4 syun4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机在半空中盘旋。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane is circling in mid-air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個波拋到半空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 bo1 paau1 dou3 bun3 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把球抛到半空。
examples.english_sentence: He tossed the ball into the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部無人機停咗喺半空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 mou4 jan4 gei1 ting4 zo2 hai2 bun3 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无人机停在了半空。
examples.english_sentence: The drone stopped in mid-air.

english_meaning: half a lychee
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是半个荔枝。也可以用来形容某人不太聪明或不太灵光，带有轻微的贬义。
explanation_english: Literally means half a lychee. It can also be used to describe someone who is not very smart or quick-witted, with a slightly derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人半粒荔枝咁嘅，成日都唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 bun3 lap1 lai6 zi1 gam2 ge3, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不太聪明，总是不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's not very bright; I never know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁半粒荔枝啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都諗唔明？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 bun3 lap1 lai6 zi1 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 lam2 m4 ming4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨，这么简单的事情都想不明白？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow, can't you figure out something this simple?

mandarin_meaning: 不红不紫, 半红不紫
english_meaning: so-so, neither popular nor unpopular, mediocre, on the fringe of success
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物处于一种不上不下的状态，例如事业发展平平，知名度不高。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is in an in-between state, neither successful nor unsuccessful, neither popular nor unpopular. Often used to describe a career that is developing slowly or someone with low public recognition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗行咁耐都仲係半紅不黑，真係幾慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 hang4 gam3 noi6 dou1 cung4 hai6 bun3 hung4 bat1 hak1, zan1 hai6 gei2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他入行这么久了还是不红不紫的，真的很惨。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in the industry for so long and he's still so-so. It's quite pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅生意一直都係半紅不黑，唔知點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 saang1 ji3 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 bun3 hung4 bat1 hak1, m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的生意一直都不温不火，不知道为什么。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's business has always been mediocre. I don't know why.

english_meaning: Half fat and half lean (meat)
explanation_mandarin: 形容肉类脂肪和瘦肉各占一半，通常指猪肉。很多人认为这种比例的肉口感最好。
explanation_english: Describes meat, usually pork, that is half fat and half lean. Many people consider this proportion to provide the best taste and texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆，我想買斤半肥瘦嘅叉燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gan1 bun3 fei4 sau3 ge3 caa1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，我想买一斤半肥瘦的叉烧。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, I want to buy a pound of char siu with half fat and half lean meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢鍾意食半肥瘦嘅腩肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung1 ji3 sik6 bun3 fei4 sau3 ge3 naam5 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他喜欢吃半肥瘦的腩肉。
examples.english_sentence: He said he likes to eat pork belly that's half fat and half lean.

english_meaning: semi-automatic; partially automatic
explanation_mandarin: 指并非完全自动，需要部分人工操作或干预的过程或设备。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is not fully automatic and requires some degree of manual operation or intervention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部咖啡機係半自動嘅，要自己加咖啡粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gaa3 fe1 gei1 hai6 bun3 zi6 dung6 ge3, jiu3 zi6 gei2 gaa1 gaa3 fe1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个咖啡机是半自动的，需要自己加咖啡粉。
examples.english_sentence: This coffee machine is semi-automatic; you need to add the coffee powder yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工廠啲生產線好多都係半自動化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong2 di1 sang1 caan2 sin3 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 bun3 zi6 dung6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂里的生产线很多都是半自动化。
examples.english_sentence: Many of the production lines in the factory are semi-automated.

english_meaning: half-life
explanation_mandarin: 物理学、化学等领域中表示放射性物质衰变速度的术语，指某种物质的原子核经过放射性衰变，数量减少到原来一半所需的时间。
explanation_english: The time required for a quantity to reduce to half its initial value. Commonly used in physics and chemistry to describe the decay of radioactive substances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲放射性物質嘅半衰期好長㗎，要好耐先會變得安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fong3 se6 sing3 mat6 zat1 ge3 bun3 seoi1 kei4 hou2 coeng4 gaa3, jiu3 hou2 noi6 sin1 wui bin3 dak1 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些放射性物质的半衰期很长，需要很长时间才会变得安全。
examples.english_sentence: The half-life of these radioactive materials is very long; it takes a long time for them to become safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保核廢料得到適當嘅處理，因為佢哋嘅半衰期可以好長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 hat6 fai3 liu2 dak1 dou3 sik1 dong3 ge3 cyu2 lei5, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bun3 seoi1 kei4 ho2 ji5 hou2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要确保核废料得到适当的处理，因为它们的半衰期可能很长。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure that nuclear waste is properly handled, because their half-lives can be very long.

mandarin_meaning: 马虎; 不认真; 不在意
english_meaning: Careless; sloppy; not serious; half-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，马马虎虎，敷衍了事。 多用来形容态度不端正，或者事情完成的质量不高。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless, sloppy, and does not take things seriously. Often used to describe a negative attitude or the poor quality of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁半費啦，認真啲做好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 bun3 fai3 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou2 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么马虎啦，认真一点做好它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, do it properly and seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都半費費，所以老闆唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bun3 fai3 fai3, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是马马虎虎的，所以老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always sloppy at work, so the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好半費到咁，呢件事好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bun3 fai3 dou3 gam3, ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 cung4 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么不认真，这件事很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, this matter is very important.

english_meaning: half-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，不尽力，敷衍了事。
explanation_english: Describes doing something half-heartedly, not putting in much effort, or being perfunctory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁半賣啦，認真啲得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 bun3 maai6 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么半吊子，认真一点行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things so half-heartedly. Can you be more serious?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課做得好半賣，都唔知佢有冇用心做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 bun3 maai6, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 mou5 jung6 sam1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的作业很敷衍，都不知道他有没有用心做。
examples.english_sentence: His homework was done so half-heartedly; I don't know if he put any effort into it.

english_meaning: Half-selling, half-giving; practically giving away
explanation_mandarin: 形容价格非常低廉，接近免费赠送。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is sold at a very low price, almost like giving it away for free. It implies a significant discount or that the seller is barely making a profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲商場做緊大減價，啲衫半賣半送噉滯呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 soeng1 coeng4 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, di1 saam1 bun3 maai6 bun3 sung3 gam2 zai6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在商场正在做大减价，那些衣服几乎是半卖半送的。
examples.english_sentence: The shopping malls are having a big sale now. Those clothes are practically giving them away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊書我唔要喇，半賣半送俾你算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 syu1 ngo5 m4 jiu3 laa3, bun3 maai6 bun3 sung3 bei2 nei5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧书我不要了，半卖半送给你算了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want these old books anymore, I'll practically give them to you.

english_meaning: halfway; midway; en route
explanation_mandarin: 指路途的一半，或在路途中。
explanation_english: Refers to the middle of a journey, or while on the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行到半路，突然落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6, dat6 jin4 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走到一半，突然下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: We were halfway there when it suddenly started raining heavily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車半路死火，搞到我遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 bun3 lou6 si2 fo2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子半路抛锚了，导致我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down halfway, causing me to be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好半路放棄呀，要堅持落去！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bun3 lou6 fong3 hei3 aa3, jiu3 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要半途而废，要坚持下去！
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up halfway, you must persevere!

english_meaning: to become a monk (or take up a profession) halfway through life; to start learning something late in life; to start a profession untrained
explanation_mandarin: 指原来不是做这个的，后来才改行做这个。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who did not originally do this profession but changed to it later. It implies a lack of initial training or a late start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本身係個會計師，但係後尾半路出家做咗個廚師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 san1 hai6 go3 wui6 gai3 si1, daan6 hai6 hau6 mei5 bun3 lou6 ceot1 gaa1 zou6 zo2 go3 cyu4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来是个会计师，但是后来半路出家做了个厨师。
examples.english_sentence: He was originally an accountant, but later he became a chef after starting late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋老闆唔係讀電影出身，佢係半路出家㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lou5 baan2 m4 hai6 duk6 din6 ying2 ceot1 san1, keoi5 hai6 bun3 lou6 ceot1 gaa1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的老板不是学电影出身的，他是半路出家的。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss didn't study film, he's a latecomer to the field.

english_meaning: mid-heel shoes, low-heel shoes
explanation_mandarin: 指鞋跟高度适中的鞋子，比平底鞋高，但比高跟鞋低。
explanation_english: Refers to shoes with heels of moderate height, higher than flat shoes but lower than high heels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意著半踭鞋返工，舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 bun3 zaang1 haai4 faan1 gung1, syu1 fuk1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢穿半高跟鞋上班，舒服一点。
examples.english_sentence: I like to wear mid-heel shoes to work, it's more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗對紅色嘅半踭鞋，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 deoi3 hung4 sik1 ge3 bun3 zaang1 haai4, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一双红色的半高跟鞋，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a pair of red mid-heel shoes today, very eye-catching.

english_meaning: half of the body; from the waist up
explanation_mandarin: 指身体的上半部分，通常是从腰部往上。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper half of the body, usually from the waist up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，搞到半身都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, gaau2 dou3 bun3 san1 dou1 sip3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒了，弄得半身都湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and got half of his body completely wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相淨係影到佢半身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 zing6 hai6 ying2 dou3 keoi5 bun3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片只拍到他的半身。
examples.english_sentence: The photo only shows half of his body.

english_meaning: hemiplegia, paralysis of one side of the body
explanation_mandarin: 指身体一侧肢体瘫痪，失去运动功能。
explanation_english: Paralysis of one side of the body, resulting in the loss of motor function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗風之後半身不遂，行唔到路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 fung1 zi1 hau6 bun3 san1 bat1 seoi6, hang4 m4 dou2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中风后半身不遂，走不了路。
examples.english_sentence: He had a stroke and became hemiplegic, unable to walk.

english_meaning: translucent, semi-transparent
explanation_mandarin: 指部分光线可以通过，但物体轮廓模糊不清的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the state where some light can pass through, but the outline of objects is blurred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊玻璃係半透明嘅，睇唔清楚出面嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 bo1 lei1 hai6 bun3 tou3 ming4 ge3, tai2 m4 cing1 chu2 chut1 min6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块玻璃是半透明的，看不清楚外面的东西。
examples.english_sentence: The glass is translucent, so I can't see what's outside clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫係半透明嘅質料，着咗入面都要打底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hai6 bun3 tou3 ming4 ge3 zat1 liu2, zoek3 zo2 jap6 min6 dou1 jiu3 daa2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的衣服是半透明的材质，穿在里面都要穿打底衫。
examples.english_sentence: Her shirt is made of translucent material, so you need to wear an undershirt inside.

english_meaning: halfway; midway; en route; unfinished
explanation_mandarin: 指路程、事情等进行到一半的时候。也指做到一半就停止。
explanation_english: Refers to the middle of a journey or task. It can also mean to stop halfway through something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行到半途，突然落大雨，逼住要返轉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 bun3 tou4, dat6 jin4 lok6 daai6 jyu5, bik1 zyu6 jiu3 faan1 zyun2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走到半路，突然下大雨，被迫要返回。
examples.english_sentence: We were halfway when it suddenly started raining heavily, forcing us to turn back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咩嘢都唔好半途而廢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 me1 je5 dou1 m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做任何事都不要半途而废啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up halfway in whatever you do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾個月就半途而廢，冇再學落去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3, mou5 zoi3 hok6 lok6 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几个月就半途而废，没有再学下去了。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up halfway after studying for a few months and didn't continue learning.

english_meaning: to become a monk/nun halfway through life; to start a career or learn a skill after having already worked in another field; late starter
explanation_mandarin: 原指中年以后才出家当和尚或尼姑。现在比喻中途改行，从事新的事业或学习新的技能。
explanation_english: Originally referred to becoming a monk or nun in middle age. Now it is a metaphor for changing careers or starting a new business or learning new skills after having already worked in another field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢原本係做會計嘅，後尾半途出家去做咗廚師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyun4 bun2 hai6 zou6 wui6 gai3 ge3, hau6 mei5 bun3 tou4 ceot1 gaa1 heoi3 zou6 zo2 cyu4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他原本是做会计的，后来半路出家去做了厨师。
examples.english_sentence: He was originally an accountant, but later in life he switched careers and became a chef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我雖然係半途出家，但係我會盡力學好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jin4 hai6 bun3 tou4 ceot1 gaa1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 hok6 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我虽然是半路出家，但是我一定会尽力学好它。
examples.english_sentence: Although I'm a late starter, I will try my best to learn it well.

english_meaning: to give up halfway; to leave something unfinished
explanation_mandarin: 指事情做到一半就停止，没有坚持到底。
explanation_english: To abandon an effort or undertaking before it is completed; to give up halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好半途而廢呀，都就嚟成功㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3 aa3, dou1 zau6 lai4 sing4 gung1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要半途而废呀，都快要成功了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up halfway, you're almost there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾堂鋼琴就半途而廢，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 tong4 gong3 kam4 zau6 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几堂钢琴就半途而废，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up learning piano after a few lessons, it's such a pity.

english_meaning: semimetal; metalloid
explanation_mandarin: 在化学中，指一种具有介于金属和非金属之间性质的元素。也被称为类金属。
explanation_english: In chemistry, it refers to an element that has properties intermediate between those of a metal and a nonmetal; a metalloid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 矽係一種半金屬，常用嚟製造電腦晶片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 hai6 jat1 zung2 bun3 gam1 suk6, soeng4 yung6 lai4 zai3 zou6 din6 nou5 zing1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 硅是一种半金属，常用来制造电脑芯片。
examples.english_sentence: Silicon is a semimetal, often used to manufacture computer chips.

english_meaning: Hermaphrodite, Androgynous, neither fully male nor female, (derogatory) effeminate man
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人既不像男人也不像女人，指外貌或行为举止比较女性化的男性。有时带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is neither fully male nor fully female. Often used to describe a man whose appearance or behavior is effeminate. Sometimes used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日化濃妝，有啲人話佢半陰陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faa3 nung4 zong1, jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 bun3 jam1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是化浓妆，有些人说他娘娘腔。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears heavy makeup, some people say he's effeminate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣講人哋，半陰陽都係一種生活方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 gong2 jan4 dei6, bun3 jam1 joeng4 dou1 hai6 jat1 zung2 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人，不男不女也是一种生活方式。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about people like that, being androgynous is also a lifestyle.

english_meaning: half marathon
explanation_mandarin: 指距离为半程马拉松的跑步比赛，通常为21.0975公里。
explanation_english: Refers to a half marathon running race, typically 21.0975 kilometers in length.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年打算挑戰人生第一次半馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 daa2 syun3 tiu1 zin3 jan4 sang1 dai6 jat1 ci3 bun3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年打算挑战我人生中的第一次半程马拉松。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to challenge my first half marathon this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑半馬跑咗個幾鐘，好勁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 bun3 maa5 paau2 zo2 go3 gei2 zung1, hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑半程马拉松跑了一个多小时，好厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He ran the half marathon in over an hour, that's amazing!

english_meaning: Half-surprised and half-delighted; mixed feelings of fear/surprise and joy
explanation_mandarin: 形容既感到惊讶或害怕，又感到喜悦的一种复杂心情。
explanation_english: Describes a complex emotion that is a mixture of surprise or fear and joy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到第一名，半驚半喜，驚自己壓力大咗，喜自己嘅努力冇白費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 dai6 jat1 ming4, bun3 ging1 bun3 hei2, ging1 zi6 gei2 aat3 lik6 daai6 zo2, hei2 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6 mou5 baak6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了第一名，又惊又喜，怕自己压力大了，喜自己的努力没有白费。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place, he was half-surprised and half-delighted, afraid of the increased pressure, and delighted that his efforts were not in vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到意外嘅禮物，佢半驚半喜，唔知點樣回應好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou2 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 lai5 mat6, keoi5 bun3 ging1 bun3 hei2, m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2 wui4 ying3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到意外的礼物，他又惊又喜，不知道怎么回应好。
examples.english_sentence: Receiving an unexpected gift, he was half-surprised and half-delighted, unsure how to respond.

english_meaning: half-baked, broken (language skills); so-so; mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 形容语言（特别是外语）说得不好，不流利，不地道。 也可用来形容其他方面做的不够好，不够熟练。
explanation_english: Describes language skills (especially foreign languages) that are not fluent or proficient. Can also be used to describe other skills or tasks done poorly or with mediocre skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講英文半鹹半淡，好多時都唔知佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jing1 man2 bun3 haam4 bun3 daam6, hou2 do1 si4 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说英语半生不熟的，很多时候都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: His English is broken; a lot of times, I don't know what he's saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲普通話都係半鹹半淡，唔敢喺北京人面前獻醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 pou2 tung1 waa2 dou1 hai6 bun3 haam4 bun3 daam6, m4 gam2 hai2 bak1 ging1 jan4 min6 cin4 hin3 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的普通话也只是半生不熟，不敢在北京人面前献丑。
examples.english_sentence: My Mandarin is so-so; I don't dare to embarrass myself in front of people from Beijing.

english_meaning: Broken (language), half-baked (language proficiency), with a mixed accent
explanation_mandarin: 形容语言不标准、不地道，带有明显的口音，或者水平不高。
explanation_english: Describes language that is not standard or authentic, with a noticeable accent, or of low proficiency. Often used to describe someone who speaks Cantonese (or another language) with a mixed or foreign accent, or whose fluency is limited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲廣東話半鹹淡，好明顯唔係本地人。

english_meaning: forty

examples.english_sentence: This company has a history of forty years.

english_meaning: ten thousand; myriad; all
explanation_mandarin: 表示很大的数量，也可以表示一切、所有。
explanation_english: Represents a large quantity, or can mean everything, all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係好忙，有成卍咁多嘢要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mong4, jau5 seng4 maan6 gam3 do1 je5 jiu3 zou6.

examples.english_sentence: I'm really busy; I have a myriad of things to do.

explanation_english: In Cantonese, "华" can refer to splendid, luxurious, or magnificent. It can also refer to China. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿衣服很华丽。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses very elegantly.

mandarin_meaning: 低微, 谦卑, 卑鄙
english_meaning: lowly, humble, base, despicable

explanation_english: "卑" generally refers to low status, humility, or base and despicable behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好卑鄙㗎，乜嘢都做得出。

examples.english_sentence: He is a despicable person who is capable of anything.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obsequious; stand firm.

english_meaning: despicable, base, mean, contemptible
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的行为、品质等十分恶劣、不道德，令人鄙视。
explanation_english: Describes behavior or character that is extremely bad, immoral, and deserving of contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手段好卑劣，為咗贏可以去到幾盡。

examples.english_sentence: Don't use such despicable methods to deal with people.

english_meaning: humble, lowly, insignificant, submissive
explanation_mandarin: 指地位低下，微不足道，或者形容态度谦卑，顺从。
explanation_english: Refers to a low social status, insignificance, or describes a humble and submissive attitude.

examples.english_sentence: She feels so insignificant that she doesn't deserve her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺老闆面前，佢顯得好卑微。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4, keoi5 hin2 dak1 hou2 bei1 mei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在老板面前，他显得很卑微。
examples.english_sentence: He seems very submissive in front of the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁卑微嘅，你都好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 bei1 mei4 ge3, nei5 dou1 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么卑微的，你也很棒的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so humble, you're also very good.

english_meaning: I, your humble servant; my humble position (used by subordinates when addressing superiors)
explanation_mandarin: 古代官场中下级官员对上级官员的自称，表示谦卑和尊敬。现代有时在讽刺或戏谑的语境中使用。
explanation_english: A humble self-reference used by subordinates when addressing their superiors in ancient officialdom, indicating humility and respect. It is sometimes used in modern contexts in a sarcastic or joking manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 卑職一定盡力完成任務。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 下属一定尽力完成任务。
examples.english_sentence: I, your humble servant, will certainly do my best to complete the task.

examples.jyutping_sentence: bei1 zik1 gou3 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下属告退。
examples.english_sentence: I, your humble servant, take my leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: （戲謔地）卑職嘅意見唔知啱唔啱呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: (hei3 juek3 dei6) bei1 zik1 ge3 ji3 gin3 m4 zi1 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: （戏谑地）下属的意见不知道对不对呢？
examples.english_sentence: (Jokingly) I, in my humble position, wonder if my opinion is correct?

english_meaning: British Columbia (BC)
explanation_mandarin: 加拿大的一个省份，全称是不列颠哥伦比亚省。
explanation_english: A province in Canada, short for British Columbia.

examples.english_sentence: The housing prices in British Columbia are very expensive!

english_meaning: lowly, base, mean, contemptible
explanation_mandarin: 指地位低下，身份卑微，也形容品格低下，行为不端。
explanation_english: Refers to a low social status or humble position. Also used to describe someone with a low character or immoral behavior.

explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely humble and servile, flattering and ingratiating themselves to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，對老細卑躬屈膝，真係好肉酸。

english_meaning: despicable; base; mean; contemptible
explanation_mandarin: 指人的行为或思想非常恶劣，不道德，令人鄙视。
explanation_english: Describes behaviour or thoughts that are very bad, immoral, and deserving of contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手段好卑鄙，為咗贏不擇手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 dyun6 hou2 bei1 pei2, wai6 zo2 win4 bat1 zaak6 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手段很卑鄙，为了赢不择手段。
examples.english_sentence: His methods are very despicable; he will do anything to win.

explanation_mandarin: 共同合作完成某项任务或工作。
explanation_english: To work jointly with others, especially in an intellectual endeavor; to cooperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要大家協作先可以完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 hip3 zok3 sin1 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要大家协作才可以完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need everyone to collaborate in order to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一個團隊協作嘅好例子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 teoi1 deoi2 hip3 zok3 ge3 hou2 lai6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个团队协作的好例子。
examples.english_sentence: This is a good example of teamwork and collaboration.

english_meaning: cooperation; collaboration; to cooperate; to collaborate
explanation_mandarin: 指共同出力，合作完成某事。
explanation_english: Refers to working together and cooperating to accomplish something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要協力完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hip3 lik6 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该协力完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We should cooperate to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有賴大家嘅協力，件事先可以咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 laai6 daai6 gaa1 ge3 hip3 lik6, gin6 si6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有赖于大家的合作，事情才可以这么顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to everyone's cooperation, things can go so smoothly.

english_meaning: to assist; to help; assistance
explanation_mandarin: 帮助，辅助。
explanation_english: To provide help or support; to aid someone in doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會協助你完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 hip3 zo6 nei5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会协助你完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: I will assist you in completing this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好樂意協助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lok6 ji3 hip3 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很乐意协助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very willing to help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要你協助搬啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 hip3 zo6 bun1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要你协助搬一些东西。
examples.english_sentence: I need your assistance in moving some things.

english_meaning: to negotiate; negotiation; to consult
explanation_mandarin: 为了达成协议或解决问题而进行的商议、讨论。
explanation_english: To discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement; to consult with someone in order to reach a compromise or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要同佢哋協商下個合約嘅條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 dei6 hip3 soeng1 haa5 go3 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4款.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要和他们协商一下合同的条款。
examples.english_sentence: We need to negotiate the terms of the contract with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過長時間嘅協商，雙方終於達成咗共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 hip3 soeng1, soeng1 fong1 zung1 jyu1 daat6 sing4 zo2 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过长时间的协商，双方终于达成了共识。
examples.english_sentence: After a long period of negotiation, both sides finally reached a consensus.

english_meaning: agreement; treaty; protocol
explanation_mandarin: 指经过协商而达成的正式协议。
explanation_english: A formal agreement or treaty reached after negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個公司簽咗個協定，一齊合作搞個新project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gung1 si1 cim1 zo2 go3 hip3 ding6, jat1 cai4 hop6 jok3 gaau2 go3 san1 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两家公司签了一个协定，一起合作做一个新项目。
examples.english_sentence: Our two companies signed an agreement to collaborate on a new project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府同地產商達成咗一個協定，增加房屋供應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tung4 dei6 saan2 soeng1 daat6 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 hip3 ding6, zeng1 gaa1 fong4 uk1 gung1 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府和房地产商达成了一个协定，增加房屋供应。
examples.english_sentence: The government and real estate developers reached an agreement to increase the housing supply.

english_meaning: association, society, organization
explanation_mandarin: 指为了共同目的而组成的社会团体。
explanation_english: An organized group of people with a common purpose or interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港律師協會係一個專業團體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 leot6 si1 hip3 wui2 hai6 jat1 go3 zyun1 jip6 tyun4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港律师协会是一个专业团体。
examples.english_sentence: The Law Society of Hong Kong is a professional organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗攝影協會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 sip3 ying2 hip3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了摄影协会。
examples.english_sentence: He joined the photographic association.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 環保協會致力於保護環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan4 bou2 hip3 wui2 zi3 lik6 jyu1 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 环保协会致力于保护环境。
examples.english_sentence: The environmental protection association is dedicated to protecting the environment.

english_meaning: Entente Powers, Allied Powers (WWI)
explanation_mandarin: 指第一次世界大战期间的协约国，主要包括英国、法国和俄国等。也可泛指结盟的国家。
explanation_english: Refers to the Entente Powers (also known as Allied Powers) during World War I, primarily consisting of Great Britain, France, and Russia. Can also refer more generally to allied nations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次世界大戰嘅協約國包括英國、法國同俄羅斯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3 ge3 hip3 joek3 gwok3 baau1 kut3 jing1 gwok3, faat3 gwok3 tung4 ngo4 lo4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次世界大战的协约国包括英国、法国和俄罗斯。
examples.english_sentence: The Entente Powers in World War I included Great Britain, France, and Russia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個國家組成協約國嚟對抗共同嘅敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 zo2 sing4 hip3 joek3 gwok3 lai4 deoi3 kong3 gung1 tung4 ge3 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个国家组成协约国来对抗共同的敌人。
examples.english_sentence: The two countries formed an alliance to fight against a common enemy.

english_meaning: to coordinate; to harmonize; to bring into line; to reconcile
explanation_mandarin: 使各方面配合得适当；使事物和谐一致。
explanation_english: To bring into harmonious relationship or adjustment; to make different things work together effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要協調吓時間，先可以一齊去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hip3 diu6 haa5 si4 gaan3, sin1 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得协调一下时间，才可以一起去喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: We need to coordinate our schedules so we can go for a drink together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工作主要係協調唔同部門之間嘅合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 hip3 diu6 m4 tung4 bou6 mun4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作主要是协调不同部门之间的合作。
examples.english_sentence: His job is mainly to coordinate cooperation between different departments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目需要好好協調各方嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 seoi1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 hip3 diu6 gok3 fong1 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目需要好好协调各方的意见。
examples.english_sentence: This project requires careful coordination of the opinions of all parties.

english_meaning: agreement, pact, protocol, to agree on
explanation_mandarin: 经过协商后达成的共同意见或制定的共同行动计划。
explanation_english: An agreement or understanding reached after negotiation between two or more parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾掂咗個協議，聽日就簽約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 dim6 zo2 go3 hip3 yi5, ting1 jat6 zau6 cim1 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经谈妥了协议，明天就签约。
examples.english_sentence: We have reached an agreement, and we will sign the contract tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雙方達成咗共識協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seung1 fong1 daat6 sing4 zo2 gung6 sik1 hip3 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 双方达成了共识协议。
examples.english_sentence: Both parties have reached a consensus agreement.

english_meaning: agreement; written agreement; contract
explanation_mandarin: 指双方或多方经过协商达成一致意见后，以书面形式记录下来的文件，具有法律效力。
explanation_english: A written document that records the agreement reached by two or more parties through negotiation. It has legal effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋簽咗份協議書，保障雙方嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cim1 zo2 fan6 hip3 yi5 syu1, bou2 zoeng3 soeng1 fong1 ge3 kuen4 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们签了一份协议书，保障双方的权益。
examples.english_sentence: We signed an agreement to protect the rights of both parties.

english_meaning: to co-organize, to assist in organizing
explanation_mandarin: 协助办理，共同承办。
explanation_english: To assist in organizing or managing something; to co-organize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年會同政府部門協辦一個大型嘅環保活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 wui5 tung4 zing3 fu2 bu6 mun4 hip3 baan6 jat1 go3 daai6 hing4 ge3 waan4 bou2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年会和政府部门协办一个大型的环保活动。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will co-organize a large-scale environmental protection activity with the government department this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校邀請咗唔同嘅機構嚟協辦畢業典禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 jiu1 cing2 zo2 m4 tung4 ge3 gei1 kau3 lai4 hip3 baan6 bat1 jip6 din2 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校邀请了不同的机构来协办毕业典礼。
examples.english_sentence: This school invited different organizations to co-organize the graduation ceremony.

english_meaning: homophonic; punning; using words that sound alike
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个字或词语发音相似或相同，利用这种相似性来表达不同的含义，常用于幽默、双关或修辞手法。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more words or phrases that sound similar or identical. This similarity is used to express different meanings, often for humor, puns, or rhetorical effect. It's a common linguistic device, especially in Cantonese due to its many homophones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都用協音嚟講笑，好搞笑㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 yung6 hip3 jam1 lai4 gong2 siu3, hou2 gaau2 siu3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是用谐音来开玩笑，很好笑的！
examples.english_sentence: He always uses puns to tell jokes, it's very funny!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東話嘅協音文化好有趣，好多新年嘅吉祥話都係用協音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 hip3 jam1 man4 faa3 hou2 jau5 cheoi3, hou2 do1 san1 nin4 ge3 gat1 cheung4 waa2 dou1 hai6 yung6 hip3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广东话的谐音文化很有趣，很多新年吉祥话都是用谐音。
examples.english_sentence: The punning culture in Cantonese is very interesting. Many auspicious sayings for the New Year use homophones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆炒魷魚唔係因為你做得唔好，係因為你經常協音講埋啲唔吉利嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 chaau2 jau4 yu2 m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 nei5 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2, hai6 jan1 wai6 nei5 ging1 seung4 hip3 jam1 gong2 maai4 di1 m4 gat1 lei6 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板炒你鱿鱼不是因为你做得不好，是因为你经常用谐音说一些不吉利的话。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired you not because you didn't do well, but because you often used puns to say unlucky things.

english_meaning: south
explanation_mandarin: 方位词。指方向，与“北”相对。
explanation_english: Directional word. Refers to the direction, opposite of 'north'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺中國嘅南邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai2 zung1 gwok3 ge3 naam4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港在中国南方。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is in the south of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去南丫島。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 naam4 aa1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去南丫岛。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Lamma Island today.

english_meaning: to go south, to move southward
explanation_mandarin: 指向南方移动或发展。
explanation_english: To move or go towards the south; often refers to movement or migration of people, businesses, or resources to southern regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年好多香港人都選擇南下大灣區發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 nin4 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 syun2 zaak6 naam4 haa5 daai6 waan1 keoi1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来很多香港人都选择南下大湾区发展。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, many Hong Kong people have chosen to move south to the Greater Bay Area for development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲候鳥每年冬天都會南下避寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hau6 niu5 mui5 nin4 dung1 tin1 dou1 wui5 naam4 haa5 bei6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些候鸟每年冬天都会南下避寒。
examples.english_sentence: Those migratory birds go south every winter to avoid the cold.

english_meaning: Lamma Island
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一个岛屿，位于香港岛的西南面。
explanation_english: An island in Hong Kong, located southwest of Hong Kong Island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去南丫島行山呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 naam4 aa1 dou2 haang4 saan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去南丫岛徒步旅行吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go hiking on Lamma Island tomorrow.

english_meaning: fermented red bean curd; red bean curd cheese
explanation_mandarin: 一种用豆腐乳发酵制成的食品，呈红色，味道浓郁。
explanation_english: A type of fermented bean curd that has a distinctive reddish color and a strong, savory flavor. It is made by fermenting cubes of bean curd in a brine solution and adding red yeast rice for color and flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用南乳炆豬肉，好惹味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 naam4 jyu5 man1 zyu1 juk6, hou2 je5 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用腐乳炖猪肉，非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: I like to braise pork with fermented red bean curd, it's very flavorful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲南乳餅好香口，細個成日食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 naam4 jyu5 beng2 hou2 hoeng1 hau2, sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些腐乳饼很香脆，小时候经常吃。
examples.english_sentence: These red bean curd biscuits are very fragrant, I used to eat them all the time when I was a kid.

english_meaning: Red fermented bean curd pork; Pork braised in fermented bean curd
explanation_mandarin: 一种用红腐乳腌制后烹调的猪肉菜肴。味道咸香，色泽红润。
explanation_english: A dish of pork braised or cooked after being marinated in red fermented bean curd. It has a savory and fragrant taste, and a reddish color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食婆婆整嘅南乳肉，好入味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 po4 po4 zeng2 ge3 naam4 jyu5 juk6, hou2 jap6 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃奶奶做的南乳肉，很入味！
examples.english_sentence: I love eating the red fermented bean curd pork made by my grandma. It's very flavorful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅南乳肉做得唔錯，你可以試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 naam4 jyu5 juk6 zou6 dak1 m4 co3, nei5 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的南乳肉做得不错，你可以试试。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's red fermented bean curd pork is quite good, you can give it a try.

english_meaning: Fermented bean curd peanuts
explanation_mandarin: 一种用南乳（腐乳）调味的炒花生，味道咸香。
explanation_english: A type of roasted peanuts seasoned with fermented bean curd (nam yue). They have a savory and slightly salty flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日食南乳花生送粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 sik6 naam4 jyu5 faa1 sang1 sung3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常吃腐乳花生配粥。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often ate fermented bean curd peanuts with congee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 南乳花生好惹味，一食就停唔到口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naam4 jyu5 faa1 sang1 hou2 je5 mei6, jat1 sik6 zau6 ting4 m4 dou2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 腐乳花生很好吃，一吃就停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: Fermented bean curd peanuts are so tasty, you can't stop eating them once you start.

english_meaning: South Asia
explanation_mandarin: 指亚洲南部地区，包括印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、尼泊尔、斯里兰卡、马尔代夫、不丹等国家。
explanation_english: Refers to the region of South Asia, including countries such as India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Bhutan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有唔少南亞裔嘅人喺度住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 m4 siu2 naam4 aa3 jeui6 ge3 jan4 hai2 dou6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有不少南亚裔的人住在这里。
examples.english_sentence: There are many South Asians living in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳啲咖喱好正宗，好有南亞風味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 ga1 lei1 hou2 zeng3 zung3, hou2 jau5 naam4 aa3 fung1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那家餐厅的咖喱很正宗，很有南亚风味。
examples.english_sentence: The curry at his restaurant is very authentic and has a South Asian flavour.

english_meaning: South Asian
explanation_mandarin: 指来自南亚地区的人，包括印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊尔、孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、不丹和马尔代夫等国家。
explanation_english: Refers to people of South Asian descent, including those from countries such as India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, and the Maldives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港都有好多南亞裔嘅人住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 naam4 aa3 jeoi6 ge3 jan4 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港也有很多南亚裔的人居住。
examples.english_sentence: There are many South Asians living in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少南亞裔嘅細路喺香港出世同長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 naam4 aa3 jeoi6 ge3 sai3 lou2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 sai3 tung4 zoeng2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少南亚裔的小孩在香港出生和长大。
examples.english_sentence: Many South Asian children are born and raised in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: slow-witted; slow on the uptake; dense
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，理解能力差。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow-witted, slow to understand, or dense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁南京㗎，講咗咁多次都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 naam4 ging1 gaa3, gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么迟钝啊，说了这么多次都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: You're so slow, you still don't understand after I've explained it so many times.
